dataset: DVSA vehicle safety recalls — bulk download (RecallsFile.csv, "all recalls since 1992")
publisher: Driver and Vehicle Standards Agency (DVSA), Vehicle Safety Branch — GOV.UK
updateCadence: Source CSV is regenerated by DVSA daily (Last-Modified header); refreshed here monthly.

filter.rule: recalls launched from 1 January 2016 (10 calendar years before the fetch year) to the fetch date

verificationMethod: Full download of DVSA's RecallsFile.csv (the file linked from the check-vehicle-recalls service home page) on `fetched`; rows grouped by recall number (the CSV repeats a recall once per model), dates converted from dd/mm/yyyy, texts never edited. makeSlug is databutler's normalisation of the published make (importer suffixes such as "(GB) PLC" dropped); make is as published.

records.concern: 25C79 Kuga - Powertrain Control Module Software Update
records.defect: On affected vehicles the software repair for previous recall 25C79 may not have been delivered properly and the Powertrain Control Module software may deliver lower power output than intended.
records.remedy: Update the Powertrain Control Module software and perform an additional verification process to ensure the configuration has been installed correctly.

records.concern: Multi Vehicle Line: Traffic Sign Recognition (TSR) Unexpected Activation / Deactivation
records.defect: Affected vehicles have been identified where the Traffic Sign Recognition and Driver Alert System are being turned on or off without the expected notification to the driver.
records.remedy: Update the vehicles configuration and Software.

records.concern: Transit Custom - Potential Touch Condition Between Bulkhead Bolt And Fuel Tank – Product Safety Recall
records.defect: On affected vehicles there may be insufficient clearance between a bulkhead bolt and the fuel tank which could cause damage over time and lead to a fuel leak.
records.remedy: Replace the bulkhead bolt.

records.concern: Puma – Exhaust system cold end replacement – Compliance Recall
records.defect: On affected vehicles the incorrect exhaust system cold end may have been fitted during production.
records.remedy: Replace the cold end of the exhaust system.

records.concern: Instrument Cluster Malfunction - Risk of Crash
records.defect: On affected vehicles depending on driver usage of USB and Bluetooth connections a communication failure or memory leak may occur within the instrument cluster. This condition can cause the cluster to temporarily reset freeze or become persistently blank. Physical telltales will continue to function properly. An inoperative or frozen instrument cluster will fail to display critical safety information including vehicle speed and warning telltales. Additionally during a cluster reset turn signals and hazard lights will temporarily deactivate or fail to respond. These conditions reduce the driver's awareness of vehicle status and limit the ability of surrounding road users to recognize the driver’s intent increasing the risk of a crash.
records.remedy: Install modified software via an over-the-air (OTA) update.

records.concern: SRPC2603 - Drive Shaft Joint
records.defect: Mercedes-Benz AG has determined that on certain 4MATIC E-Class (213 platform) S-Class Coupé (217 platform) S-Class (222 platform) E-Class Coupe/Convertible (238 platform) GLC (253 platform) and CLS (257 platform) vehicles increased wear of the universal joint on the drive shaft might occur.
records.remedy: As a remedy Mercedes-Benz AG via its Mercedes-Benz service partners will check the drive shaft on the affected vehicles and replace it if necessary.

records.concern: 26S62 Kuga – EDS Wiring touch
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have a touch condition between a fixing screw and push nut to the Instrument Panel (IP) wiring harness. If the vehicle’s wiring is damaged different warning messages may appear depending on which wire is affected. These could include warnings for the airbag system eCall stability control or driver assistance features such as Lane Keeping Aid or Pre-Collision Assist. The airbags will not deploy by accident but if an airbag warning is ignored the airbags may not work correctly in a crash. In some cases the vehicle could lose power while driving and display a “Stop safely now” message. If this happens braking and steering will still work so the driver can safely bring the vehicle to a stop. Damaged wiring could also cause a short circuit which may increase the risk of fire.
records.remedy: Inspect and reposition wiring harness to increase clearance and protect surfaces and if necessary repair or replace the instrument panel wiring harness.

records.concern: Installation of the Heat Shield
records.defect: Mercedes-Benz AG has determined that on certain GLE (167 platform) vehicles with OM654 and hybrid drive a heat shield in the firewall area might not be installed according to specification.
records.remedy: As a remedy Mercedes-Benz AG via its Mercedes-Benz service partners will check the heat shield and the fuel line on the affected vehicles and rework it if necessary.

records.concern: The vehicle may have incorrectly secured front seat belt anchor points
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have incorrectly secured front seat belt anchor points. This may result in a lack of protection in the event of a vehicle collision.
records.remedy: A modification will be applied to the seat belt anchor area to rectify the concern

records.concern: L87 Engine Loss of Propulsion
records.defect: The connecting rod and/or crankshaft engine components in these vehicles may have manufacturing defects that can lead to engine damage and engine failure. If the engine fails while driving the vehicle will lose propulsion increasing the risk of a crash.
records.remedy: Dealers will inspect the engine. If the vehicle fails the inspection procedure the engine will be repaired or replaced. Vehicles that pass inspection will be provided a higher viscosity oil which will also require a new oil fill cap identifying the new required oil grade an oil filter replacement and an owner’s manual insert free of charge.

records.concern: Some vehicles may have a potential issue with one module within the high voltage battery which may have been manufactured with misaligned electrodes.
records.defect: Affected vehicles may contain a suspect HV (high voltage) battery module manufactured by the supplier during a specific production period. It is recommended that the vehicle is to be parked in a well ventilated area. The vehicle can be used as normal.
records.remedy: Replacement of the high voltage battery module will be carried out.

records.concern: 26C32 Mustang - Windshield Wipers and Washer System Potentially Inoperative During Freezing Temperatures
records.defect: On affected vehicles during freezing temperatures or below the windshield wipers may become inoperative. In other cases the windshield wipers may operate only at the high-speed setting and an inoperative windshield washer system may prevent washer fluid from being effectively used to clean the windshield.
records.remedy: Inspect the windshield wiper system and replace the wiper motor if necessary.

records.concern: Identification plate wrong value
records.defect: Affected vehicles have been delivered with missing labels that carry information about the manufacturer’s representative and wrongly stamped chassis plates.
records.remedy: Replace the incorrect chassis plate and install the missing information label.

records.concern: Replacing TAKATA driver airbag
records.defect: On affected vehicles in the event of an accident in which the airbag is deployed the front airbag gas generator could burst sending metal fragments into the vehicle. This could cause serious harm or fatal injuries to the driver and their passengers.
records.remedy: Replace the front airbag on the driver side.

records.concern: Ignition lock may fail
records.defect: In affected machines a component of the ignition steering-lock assembly may in isolated cases develop vibration induced wear which can lead to loss of electrical contact and consequently to loss of ignition. If ignition is interrupted the engine will stop and all electrical functions (lighting instrument cluster assistance systems) will no longer be available.
records.remedy: Update software and check function of ignition lock

records.concern: 165-ISOFIX
records.defect: For certain vehicles the ISOFIX mountings may have inadequate weld seams at the attachment points. In the event of a vehicle crash the forces transmitted through a child seat attached to the ISOFIX anchorages may cause the bracket to fracture resulting in an increased risk of injury to the child.
records.remedy: Vehicle owners are instructed not to use the ISOFIX attachment points until a technical inspection and if necessary a retrofit or repair has been carried out by an authorised dealer. Vehicles that pass the inspection may continue to be used; vehicles that fail will be retrofitted accordingly.

records.concern: Astra L - VSM software- SLI performance.
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have Vehicle Supervision Module (VSM) software that displays incorrect speed-limit indications resulting in non-compliance with applicable regulatory requirements.
records.remedy: Update the VSM software and update the In-Vehicle-Infotainment software via Over-The-Air at the dealer if necessary.

records.concern: Title of Recall Rear Door Outside Handle replacement on Urban Cruiser
records.defect: During the manufacturing process of the rear outer door handle an insufficient amount of grease may have been applied to components of the internal linkage. As a result corrosion may develop on an internal spring over time. Which may cause it to bind or seize.
records.remedy: Replacement of the rear door handles

records.concern: 26S35 – Ranger – Engine failure
records.defect: On affected vehicles it may be possible that one or more engine camshaft roller finger followers were not properly installed at the time of assembly. An improperly installed camshaft roller finger follower may result in engine failure resulting in a no-start condition or a loss of motive power.
records.remedy: Replace the engine.

records.concern: 26S10 - Kuga Ranger - Potential Exhaust Gas Recirculation Valve Failure
records.defect: On affected vehicles the Exhaust Gas Recirculation (EGR) valve may fail leading to weak acceleration engine vibration a no start condition or a loss of power.
records.remedy: Replace the EGR valve.

records.concern: Inspect Aguti ISOFIX bracket and replace if necessary
records.defect: For affected vehicles with a rear seat equipped with an ISOFIX attachment system the welded joints of the ISOFIX attachment points may have been manufactured with a defect and could fail in the event of an accident.
records.remedy: Users are asked to stop using ISOFIX connection points to attach child seats with immediate effect. Dealers or garages will inspect and if necessary replace the ISOFIX bracket.

records.concern: Range Rover (L405) Front Suspension Knuckle Crack – Incorrect Repair
records.defect: For affected vehicles the repair procedure for a prior safety recall was incorrect. As a result the front suspension knuckles have been replaced with those of an incorrect specification.
records.remedy: Vehicles will have both front suspension knuckles replaced.

records.concern: SRPC-2608 Electric drive unit power electronics
records.defect: Mercedes-Benz AG has determined that in certain CLA (174 platform) and GLB (244 platform) vehicles the circuit board for the power electronics of the rear electric drive unit might not meet the specifications.
records.remedy: As a remedy Mercedes-Benz AG via its Mercedes-Benz service partners will replace the rear axle.

records.concern: Kia EV6 HV Battery Cell Misalignment
records.defect: ​​Due to a quality deviation by the supplier certain battery cells within the High Voltage Battery System Assembly manufactured in limited production periods may have been produced with a misaligned electrode. A misaligned electrode may over time result in an internal short circuit in certain situations thereby increasing the risk of fire.​
records.remedy: If the HV battery State of Health is greater than 90% Kia UK will replace the defective module in the pack if 90% or lower the complete battery pack assembly will be replaced.

records.concern: BALL PIN NOT HARDENED
records.defect: Following a process carried out by the supplier of the ball joints mounted on the steering transverse tie rod [track rod tube] and in order to protect end customers and guarantee the highest quality standards IVECO has decided to launch a recall campaign.
records.remedy: The remedy is to replace the track rod assembly with new ball joint ends OR drag link assembly depending on vehicle configuration.

records.concern: Fuel Hose Detached Under Fuel Tank
records.defect: On affected motorcycles the fuel hose connected to the fuel tank could become detached while riding due to incorrect positioning of the bank angle sensor against the fuel line quick connector resulting in fuel leakage. In the worst case leaked fuel may spill onto the rear wheel increasing the risk of falling and fire.
records.remedy: Inspect and reroute wiring harness and replace the fuel hose.

records.concern: 26S57 Explorer – Panoramic Roof Partial Detachment
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have a panoramic roof with an improper adhesion bond. This could result in wind noise water leak or separation from the vehicle.
records.remedy: Test the adhesion bonding of the panoramic roof. and replace if necessary

records.concern: Bevel Gear installed with Wrong Ratio
records.defect: The wrong bevel gear may be installed on the front axle steering. The required gear ratio for HD HDH SHD RHD and Intouro is 1.117:1. A Bevel gear with ratio of 1:1 was installed. For eCitaro models the reverse misinstallation may have occurred. If a 1:1 bevel gear is installed instead of 1.117:1 the wheel steering angles required in accordance with UN ECE-R 79 (section 6.2.5) in the event of a steering system failure can no longer be achieved. Since the calculated vehicle movement does not exactly match the actual vehicle movement in a event of fault unauthorized intervention by the ESP or in articulated buses the articulation angle control (ATC) is also conceivable. This could lead to a sudden reduction of drive torque and braking of individual wheels which may impair the ability to maintain the intended driving direction. A risk to other road users therefore cannot be ruled out.
records.remedy: Remedy is to check the bevel gear and replace them with a correct version if necessary

records.concern: BCM software update – Black screen
records.defect: On affected vehicles a software defect in the instrument cluster may prevent the cluster display from switching on when the vehicle is started resulting in a black screen.
records.remedy: Update the Body Control Module software.

records.concern: BMC software update – Black screen
records.defect: On affected vehicles a software defect in the instrument cluster may prevent the cluster display from switching on when the vehicle is started resulting in a black screen.
records.remedy: Update the Body Control Module software.

records.concern: BCM software update – Black screen
records.defect: On affected vehicles a software defect in the instrument cluster may prevent the cluster display from switching on when the vehicle is started resulting in a black screen.
records.remedy: Update the Body Control Module software.

records.concern: Electrical Harness Protection
records.defect: On the affected vehicles the main front wiring harness may contact a metal ground stud due to a design change resulting in a possible loss of electrical vehicle functions and in rare cases a risk of fire.
records.remedy: Add a protective rubber cap to the ground stud.

records.concern: Impairment of display messages in the instrument cluster (ICUC Gen6) on B2E vehicles
records.defect: On vehicles equipped with the B2E electrical/electronic architecture and the ICUC Gen6 instrument cluster certain status and fault messages are not consistently displayed to the driver in the ICUC. The root cause is an error in the adaptation of the filter logic for messages originating from control units and the Vehicle Message Matrix (VMM) during the transition from ICUC Gen5 to ICUC Gen6. Among others fault messages from the ACM (Aftertreatment Control Module) and the VRDU3 (Video Radar Decision Unit) control units are affected. As a result it cannot be ruled out that individual warning messages required for the safe and proper operation of the vehicle and/or mandated by legislation may not be displayed reliably.
records.remedy: Remedy is to correct the failure through a software update

records.concern: Replacement of LH & RH Rear Outside Door Handles
records.defect: On affected vehicles there is a possibility of the rear doors being unable to open from either the inside or outside of the vehicle.
records.remedy: Replace the outer rear door handles.

records.concern: Correct speed restriction
records.defect: On affected vehicles the speed limit of 70 mph is not implemented as described in the technical data and stated in the vehicle registration document.
records.remedy: Adjust the software in various control units.

records.concern: Replacement of rear brake caliper
records.defect: On affected motorcycles under certain riding conditions the rear brake caliper may be subjected to excessive stress which in the worst case can lead to the rear brake caliper breaking.
records.remedy: Replace the rear brake caliper including the caliper bracket on all affected motorcycles.

records.concern: Rear Brake Caliper Replacement
records.defect: On affected motorcycles under certain riding conditions the rear brake caliper may be subjected to excessive stress which in the worst case can lead to the rear brake caliper breaking.
records.remedy: Replace the rear brake caliper including the caliper bracket on all affected motorcycles.

records.concern: Checking lap belt tensioner
records.defect: On affected vehicles the seat belt webbing may not be connected correctly to the vehicle's load-bearing structure meaning it would not be able to restrain the occupant in the event of an accident.
records.remedy: Check the affected seat belt and replace if necessary.

records.concern: SRC260707 – RC2602 – Check replace the link rod on the upper supporting joint
records.defect: As part of our continuous product monitoring we have identified that a defined production batch of the link rod for the upper supporting joint has not acquired the required material hardness in the production process due to insufficient inductive hardening. This may reduce the strength of the component and in extreme cases lead to fracture. Even after a fracture the brakes and steering continue to operate so that the vehicle can be driven to a safe location.However a potential fragment may end up on the roadway creating a safety risk for following traffic.
records.remedy: Check replace the link rod on the upper supporting joint.

records.concern: SRC260720 – RC2603 – Replacment of the IAB brake actuator on the rear axle
records.defect: As part of our continuous product monitoring we have identified that the affected vehicles were delivered with a faulty batch of parking brake actuators the movement of which may be restricted due to dimensional inaccuracies. In this process there may be malfunctions such as the warning lamp lighting up seized or abrading rear-wheel brakes and even locking rear-wheel brakes. In the worst case there may be a risk of fire due to increased heat development.
records.remedy: As part of the planned recall campaign the model plates of the brake actuators on the brake calipers of the rear axle undergo a visual check. If the findings indicate this the affected brake actuators will be replaced. The replacement parts required for the recall are not expected to be available until October 2026. Please use regular replacement parts if vehicles fail in the meantime due to the above-mentioned problem.

records.concern: SRC260709 – RC2502 – Failure of turn signal lamp in main headlamp
records.defect: As part of our continuous product monitoring we have identified that due to insufficient contact pressure from the front turn signal indicator socket inside the headlamp unit loss of contact may occur during driving operation. As a consequence of the loss of contact thermal damage may occur on the sockets' contact surfaces which may cause the turn signal indicator to fail. There is currently no information on damage or accidents that are connected to the fault profile mentioned.
records.remedy: As part of the planned product safety recall the bulb holders of the turn signal lamps of both main headlamps on the potentially affected vehicles will be checked and replaced if found to be defective.

records.concern: Hose topic
records.defect: The hoses at issue are professional B2B aftermarket replacement parts for commercial trailers i.e. heavy commercial vehicles (i.e. not passenger cars). If used as trailer brake hoses depending on the brake hose connection and trailer configuration holes cannot be ruled out that may negatively affect braking performance.
records.remedy: Identify and replace affected B2B parts.

records.concern: Electronic Brake System (EBS) module
records.defect: On some vehicles the Electronics Stability Control (ESC) warning light and the relative warning message may appear on the Instrument Panel Cluster (IPC) and the ESC may deactivate. In the worst case the vehicle could lose controllability when braking due to Electronic Brake-force Distribution (EBD) and Anti-lock Braking System (ABS) not being available.
records.remedy: Replace the Electronic Brake System (EBS) Module.

records.concern: Jaecoo 7 - Wiring Harness Incorrect Routing
records.defect: On a specific batch of vehicles the drivers seat wiring harness may not have been routed correctly which over time may cause it to wear or become damaged. This may stop the seat adjustment working illuminate warning lights cause a loss of the ability to change gear and in rare cases lead to unexpected engine stalling while driving increasing the risk of a collision.
records.remedy: Carry out the required inspection of the drivers seat wiring harness and inspect its condition. If necessary the wiring harness will be rerouted and any damage to the insulation repaired.

records.concern: Kia PV5 Composite Bonnet Recall
records.defect: Due to changes in production some areas have uneven material and strength to improve the bonnets outer appearance. As a result if the vehicle impacts a pedestrian the risk of injury may be higher.
records.remedy: Check the LOT number of the bonnet replace if in the affected range.

records.concern: Kia PV5 Seat Belt Retaining Bolts
records.defect: Front & 2nd row (left & right side) seat belt retaining bolts are not correctly fastened on some vehicles. If affected the seat belt restraint is compromised and there is a chance of an increase in passenger injury during a collision.
records.remedy: Check all seat belt retaining bolts & apply the correct torque setting.

records.concern: 26C36 - Transit – Vehicle Identification Number Label Missing Mandatory Weight Information
records.defect: On affected vehicles the B-pillar label displays the Vehicle Identification Number but the fields for mandatory vehicle weight information may be blank.
records.remedy: Remove the existing label clean the area and install a new replacement displaying the correct mandatory information.

records.concern: Vehicle Total upgrade via sVDS 2.0
records.defect: It has come to our attention that your vehicle is part of a very small number of smart #5 vehicles of which under very specific circumstances the braking software may underperform and lead to unexpected skidding on specific surfaces in icy or wet weather conditions. Test results have shown that this scenario can occur on low friction surfaces (e.g. epoxy or tilted floors). The issue could not be reproduced on normal road surfaces. Should these specific circumstances occur it cannot be ruled out that the braking leads to skidding and loss of control of the vehicle.
records.remedy: The corrective measure consisting of the release of a new braking software that will correct the deviated behaviour.

records.concern: 25S75 Cross Carline - Low Pressure Fuel Pump Potential Failure
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have an issue with the fuel lift pump that could cause the engine to stall.
records.remedy: Update the Power Control Module software.

records.concern: 26S49 – Transit and Transit/Tourneo Custom – Automatic Transmission Snap Ring
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have an Electronic One-Way Clutch Assembly built with an unseated snap ring which may lead to a sudden and unexpected loss of forward or reverse movement.
records.remedy: Disassemble the transmission to check the snap ring is correctly seated and replace any necessary parts.

records.concern: Meter Control Program Defect
records.defect: Symptom 1 The speedometer is fixed at 0 MPH.2 The speed unit and odometer characters are not displayed.3 ENG cannot start due to software issue. Cause The meter startup/shutdown program is incorrect as a mandatory process was missed during manufacture leading to incorrect operation.
records.remedy: Software update to re-write the meter program

records.concern: INTERSTAR XDD/XDE Emissions Label
records.defect: For affected vehicles an incorrect Emissions Label may have been installed . As a result the label does not accurately reflect the vehicle’s actual emissions.
records.remedy: Replace the Emissions Label with the correct European specification label.

records.concern: Reprogramming matrix beam headlights
records.defect: On affected vehicles when driving with the advanced full beam assist function a deviation of the light distribution of the Matrix Beam headlights occurs resulting in glare for both the vehicle in front and the oncoming vehicle.
records.remedy: Reprogram the Matrix Beam headlight adjustment control and update the vehicle baseline.

records.concern: SRL260624 – LESCHUSTA – Check drag link
records.defect: Through a self-disclosure by the supplier ZF Friedrichshafen AG Daimler Truck AG was informed that there may have been a manufacturing deviation in vehicles of the models Atego 967 Actros 963 Arocs 964 and eActros 983 on the ball joints that are installed in steering components (e. g. drag links steering links tie rods). It cannot be ruled out that individual components did not fully undergo the prescribed hardening process and have therefore gotten into vehicles with insufficient material hardness. This may result in increased wear and in later phases reduced fatigue strength to the point of a possible fatigue fracture which would probably occur at low speeds with high steering forces (e.g. when maneuvering). In the event of such a fracture vehicle can no longer be steered and there would be a risk of accident.
records.remedy: As part of our planned recall campaign and as a precautionary measure we want to check whether insufficiently hardened components were installed in the potentially affected vehicles. Insufficiently hardened components will be replaced as part of the check.

records.concern: Adaption Measure for the Emission Control System R60 / R61 N47T
records.defect: For certain vehicles BMW Group has developed a package of measures (hardware and software) for the emission control system of the MINI R60/R61.
records.remedy: Installation of the hardware package including the required software measures

records.concern: The vehicle three-way coolant valve may become defective during the vehicle operation.
records.defect: The vehicle three way coolant valve may become defective during the vehicle operation. This may result in a risk of the affected component melting.
records.remedy: Replacement of the three way coolant valve.

records.concern: Kia Picanto Possible Under Bonnet Fuel Leak
records.defect: ​​Fuel leakage may occur due to contact between the fuel line and the battery tray cable. For affected cars this may lead to damage of the fuel line and the risk of a fuel leak.​
records.remedy: ​​Carry out a visual inspection pipe if no damage re-route and secure the pipe. If damaged replace the pipe and re-route.

records.concern: Inspect Aguti ISOFIX bracket and replace if necessary
records.defect: On affected vehicles the welded connection of the ISOFIX anchorage points may have been manufactured incorrectly. In very isolated cases it cannot be completely ruled out that the ISOFIX brackets could break in the event of a rear-end collision or vehicle crash.
records.remedy: The ISOFIX system will be inspected and replaced if necessary.

records.concern: Lift recall
records.defect: Under certain conditions the platform lift motor could remain energised and move unintentionally despite the lift operator commanding the lift to stop increasing the risk of injury to the lift occupant or others in the vicinity.
records.remedy: Install two diodes within the lift electrical system wiring to prevent voltage from a failed contactor maintaining a closed condition and to ensure proper de-energisation of the motor contactor when the operator commands the lift to stop.

records.concern: Replace the Brake Master Cylinders
records.defect: On affected vehicles in a combination of very specific conditions the seal within one of the brake master cylinders can deform. This can lead to brake fluid not being released back into the reservoir causing drag and leading to an increase in temperature increasing the risk of a localised fire.
records.remedy: The revised remedy parts are not yet available. Aston Martin will contact owners to schedule a time date and location for brake master cylinder replacement when parts are available.

records.concern: SRL260623 – KUGESPU – Replace tie rod
records.defect: Through a self-disclosure by supplier ZF Friedrichshafen AG Daimler Truck AG was informed that there may have been a manufacturing deviation in Atego 967 Actros 963 Arocs 964 and eActros 983 model vehicles on the ball joints that are installed in steering components (e.g. drag links steering links tie rods). It cannot be ruled out that individual components did not fully undergo the prescribed hardening process and have therefore gotten into vehicles with insufficient material hardness. This may result in increased wear and in later phases reduced fatigue strength to the point of a possible fatigue fracture which would probably occur at low speeds with high steering forces (e.g. when maneuvering). In the event of such a fracture vehicle can no longer be steered and there would be a risk of accident.
records.remedy: As part of our planned recall campaign and as a precautionary measure we want to check whether insufficiently hardened components were installed in the potentially affected vehicles. Insufficiently hardened components will be replaced as part of the check.

records.concern: Aguti 272
records.defect: For affected vehicles with a rear seat equipped with an ISOFIX attachment system the welded joints of the ISOFIX attachment points may have been manufactured with a defect and could fail in the event of an accident.
records.remedy: Users are asked to stop using ISOFIX connection points to attach child seats with immediate effect. Dealers or garages will inspect and if necessary replace the ISOFIX bracket.

records.concern: Engine Management System (EMS) software Update
records.defect: On affected vehicles aged NOx sensors could result in higher NOx emissions when driving leading to a noncompliance of regulations.
records.remedy: Install updated NOx monitoring software.

records.concern: SRL260702 – 2605U46W07 – Replace tie rod
records.defect: Through a self-disclosure by supplier ZF Friedrichshafen AG Daimler Truck AG was informed that there may have been a manufacturing deviation in Unimog 405 and 437 model vehicles on the ball joints that are installed in steering components (e.g. drag links steering links tie rods). It cannot be ruled out that individual components did not fully undergo the prescribed hardening process and have therefore gotten into vehicles with insufficient material hardness. This may result in increased wear and in later phases reduced fatigue strength to the point of a possible fatigue fracture which would probably occur at low speeds with high steering forces (e.g. when maneuvering). In the event of such a fracture vehicle can no longer be steered and there would be a risk of accident.
records.remedy: As part of our planned recall campaign and as a precautionary measure we want to check whether insufficiently hardened components were installed in the potentially affected vehicles. Insufficiently hardened components will be replaced as part of the check.

records.concern: Vehicle configuration (Proxi) update on certain Toyota Proace Max BEV
records.defect: For certain vehicles the Body Control Module (BCM) is not properly configured to detect turn signal lamp failures. As a result if a bulb fails the BCM does not recognize the fault and fails to activate a mandatory tell-tale and warning to the driver.
records.remedy: Software update to Body Control Module (BCM)

records.concern: SRL260522 – AGM-BATT – Check printed circuit board on battery for damage
records.defect: As part of our continuous quality monitoring we have identified that in Actros 963 Arocs 964 vehicles with integral rear area and eActros 300/400 with fleece battery (absorbent glass mat) a thermal reaction may occur due to corrosion on the ACE chip (Advanced Connected Energy). Battery data can be evaluated via a Bluetooth interface using the integrated ACE chip. During assembly of the ACE chip at the supplier’s premises it is inserted into the recess provided between the battery terminals poured with resin (liquid plastic) and closed with the battery cover to protect against corrosion in a fully automated and quantity-controlled process. When filling with resin there may have been an insufficient fill level in the niche as well as an ACE chip inserted at an angle. The exposed connection points of the supply lines or the chip itself may corrode due to inadequate sealing. A corroded connection or corroded ACE chip may lead to increased electrical transitional resistance which may trigger a thermal reaction leading to a battery fire. In the worst case flames may spread to surrounding components or the vehicle. There is a risk of fire.
records.remedy: Check printed circuit board in on-board electrical system battery for damage. Replace on-board electrical system battery (after check) if necessary.

records.concern: Replacement front seat belt
records.defect: On affected vehicles a joint at the pyrotechnic inflator of the front seat belt retractors was not welded correctly presenting a risk of vehicle occupants being injured by small parts coming loose in the event of an accident.
records.remedy: Replace the affected seat belts.

records.concern: QASHQAI J12 Lithium Ion Battery
records.defect: For affected vehicles there is an issue involving the E power Battery Management system (BMS) where warnings and entering limp mode or loss of power cannot be ruled out. Vehicle will not return to normal function until power-latch (IGN off for approximately 30 mins and key away from vehicle).
records.remedy: Reprogram the Battery Management System (BMS).

records.concern: Replacement front seat belt
records.defect: On affected vehicles a joint at the pyrotechnic inflator of the front seat belt retractors was not welded correctly presenting a risk of vehicle occupants being injured by small parts coming loose in the event of an accident.
records.remedy: Replace the affected seat belts.

records.concern: CMA Cell Modules
records.defect: On affected vehicles the High Voltage (HV) Battery may have a manufacturing defect which could cause the Battery Cells to overheat when the HV Battery is fully charged. In a worst-case scenario there is a risk of fire when the vehicle is parked up with a fully charged HV Battery.
records.remedy: Check and replace the HV Battery Cells if necessary and install modified software.

records.concern: C Evolution wiring harness repair
records.defect: ​​Due to an insufficiently sealed cable shoe moisture can rise within the cable and in unfavourable cases reach the 12 V connector to the DC/DC converter. This can lead to corrosion on the electrical contacts and as a result to increased contact resistance. The increased electrical resistance can cause the connector to heat up. In rare individual cases the heat generated may affect adjacent components.​
records.remedy: A repair wiring harness with be installed on the motorcycle

records.concern: Kia K4 Rear Centre Seatbelt Buckle
records.defect: The rear centre seatbelt anchor buckle may not latch properly. This is due to a manufacturing error by the supplier the buckle may fail to fully engage when the tongue is inserted. A seatbelt anchor buckle that does not latch correctly may not provide adequate occupant restraint during certain collision events increasing the risk of injury.
records.remedy: Carry out a visual inspection of the buckle replace if faulty.

records.concern: 26C31 – Transit M2 – Missing MOIS (Moving Off Information System
records.defect: On affected vehicles the Moving Off Information System (MOIS) has been disabled so it is unable to warn of pedestrians or cyclists close to and in front of the vehicle.
records.remedy: Update the software to enable the MOIS.

records.concern: X-TRAIL T33 Lithium Ion Battery
records.defect: For affected vehicles the lithium-ion battery controller (LBC) on some X-Trail (T33) vehicles may not properly maintain diagnostic robustness. It has been found that these ICs may misdiagnose abnormalities and as a result the system may enter fail-safe mode during driving which restricts motor output and prohibits charging. Under certain conditions a loss of motive power may occur and the vehicle may stop while driving due to the loss of propulsion.
records.remedy: Update to the Battery Management Software (BMW)

records.concern: Relay software – turn signal detection.
records.defect: On affected vehicles the Body Control Module is not correctly configured to detect a failure in the indicator lamps. As a result if a turn indicator bulb fails it's not detected and the indicator warning does not activate.
records.remedy: Update the vehicle configuration and the Secure Gateway Electronic Control Unit.

records.concern: Boxer software – turn signal detection.
records.defect: On affected vehicles the Body Control Module is not correctly configured to detect a failure in the indicator lamps. As a result if a turn indicator bulb fails it's not detected and the indicator warning does not activate.
records.remedy: Update the vehicle configuration and the Secure Gateway Electronic Control Unit.

records.concern: Movano software - turn signal detection.
records.defect: On affected vehicles the Body Control Module is not correctly configured to detect a failure in the indicator lamps. As a result if a turn indicator bulb fails it's not detected and the indicator warning does not activate.
records.remedy: Update the vehicle configuration and the Secure Gateway Electronic Control Unit.

records.concern: 26S33 – Transit Custom – Seatbelt fraying
records.defect: On affected vehicles the front outboard seatbelts may show fraying due to coming into contact with metal swarf from the production process.
records.remedy: Replace the front outboard seatbelts.

records.concern: Wrong Tire Class in CoC
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have a tyre class mismatch between the technical specification declared in the Certificate of Conformity and the actual vehicle configuration.
records.remedy: Check the tyre class of all vehicle tyres and exchange all 4 for Class A+ tyres if necessary

records.concern: Check the Interior Mirror Holder Replace if Necessary
records.defect: The Safety Recall relates to the interior rear-view mirror. The interior mirror mounting plate may not have been bonded to the windscreen sufficiently. Due to an insufficient adhesive surface on the mounting plate (bracket) the rearview mirror could become partially or even completely detached from the windshield. If the rearview mirror becomes partially or even completely detached this could impair the visibility while driving. In the event of an accident this could increase the risk of injury.
records.remedy: The windscreen will be replaced on all vehicles.

records.concern: Reworking the PVC Seam in the Rear Light Housing
records.defect: The safety recall relates to a PVC seam seal defect which may have occurred in the body area of the right real light housing. It is possible that seam sealant was not applied to a panel overlap area this may result in water ingress into the vehicle in the area of the right rear light. If water does enter the trunk in the area of the right rear light it may result in water ingress onto the exposed power distribution box as well as adjacent wiring harnesses and electrical components. It cannot be reliably excluded that electrical contacts may be affected particularly due to capillary effects. In this case moisture ingress and the resulting long-term corrosion may lead to increased contact resistance as well as functional degradation or failure of individual electrical components. Over the service life a thermal event cannot be completely ruled out.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the PVC seam will be checked and if necessary reworked.

records.concern: Multi Vehicle Line: Unintended High Beam Behaviour - Compliance
records.defect: Affected vehicles may experience erratic behaviour of the Glare Free High Beam function under certain circumstances.
records.remedy: Update the Advanced Driver Assistance Systems Electronic Control Unit software.

records.concern: AJ20-D6 Idler Pulley Clash
records.defect: A concern has been identified on certain AJ20-D6 engines where the Front End Auxiliary Drive (FEAD) belt idler pulley may over-rotate following a high torsion input and lead to a clash with and damage to the oil pressure and temperature sensor.
records.remedy: Vehicles will have the Front-End Auxiliary Drive (FEAD) idler pulley replaced.

records.concern: ISOFIX connection system for rear seats of motorhomes and camper vans
records.defect: For affected vehicles with a rear seat equipped with an ISOFIX attachment system the welded joints of the ISOFIX attachment points may have been manufactured with a defect and could fail in the event of an accident.
records.remedy: Users are asked to stop using ISOFIX connection points to attach child seats with immediate effect. Dealers or garages will inspect and if necessary replace the ISOFIX bracket.

records.concern: 26S37 – Transit and Transit Custom – Wiper Motor
records.defect: On affected vehicles the front wiper motor may not operate or may operate intermittently resulting in reduced or lost visibility in certain conditions.
records.remedy: Update the wiper motor software and if necessary replace the wiper motor.

records.concern: AJ20-D6 Idler Pulley Clash
records.defect: A concern has been identified on certain AJ20-D6 engines where the Front End Auxiliary Drive (FEAD) belt idler pulley may over-rotate following a high torsion input and lead to a clash with and damage to the oil pressure and temperature sensor. A damaged oil pressure and temperature sensor can lead to an oil leak from the engine which can result in a slip hazard for following road users particularly two-wheeled vehicles.
records.remedy: Vehicles will have the Front-End Auxiliary Drive (FEAD) idler pulley replaced.

records.concern: Two speed power transfer unit failure. Loss of power.
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have been built with an improperly seated input shaft snap ring on the power transfer unit (PTU). An input shaft snap ring that is not fully seated may allow uncontrolled movement of the input shaft inward which can cause an unexpected loss of motive power or loss of PARK function while stationary. A loss of motive power can cause a vehicle crash without prior warning. A loss of PARK function can cause a vehicle crash without prior warning and/or injury to others outside the vehicle.
records.remedy: Install modified software in the Drivetrain Control Module (DTCM) and the PTU to detect and monitor for excessive wear within the PTU. If a PTU failure is confirmed by the software the PTU will be replaced.

records.concern: M0410 EMS ECM SW Update FH FM 4
records.defect: On affected vehicles aged NOx sensors could result in higher NOx emissions when driving leading to a noncompliance of regulations.
records.remedy: Install updated NOx monitoring software.

records.concern: Replacement of the turn signal bulbs
records.defect: On eligible units of 2025 & 2026 W230 (BJ230A) and Meguro S1 (BJ230B) models the turn signal bulbs may fail prematurely due to an improper manufacturing process.
records.remedy: To overcome this problem Kawasaki has initiated a recall campaign to replace the front and rear turn signal bulbs.

records.concern: Emergency Valve may malfunction
records.defect: It has been determined that the external emergency valves may malfunction. The issue is caused by an excessively large bore diameter in a component of the door control valve. Because the diameter lies outside the specified tolerance (0.74 mm instead of the required 0.65 mm) compressed air flows back faster than the system can vent. Consequently the pneumatic self‑holding mechanism does not release and the door can only be opened if the internal emergency valve is actuated first. If the external emergency valve is actuated first the defect may prevent the door from opening. In an emergency this could hinder the evacuation of passengers by rescue services.
records.remedy: Remedy is to replace the door control valves on all doors on affected vehicles.

records.concern: 26C30 – Transit and Tourneo Custom – Door Module lost communication
records.defect: Affected vehicles may experience loss of communication with the Door modules resulting in the Blind Spot Indicator System (BLIS) feature Window regulator mirror adjust and turn indicator repeater not working during this time. The mirror-mounted indicator lamps lack of function combined with the absence of a driver tell-tale results in a non-compliance with mandatory lighting standards.
records.remedy: Install updated door control software.

records.concern: Coolant pump control software
records.defect: Mercedes-Benz AG has determined that on certain GLE/GLS (167 platform) C-Class (205 platform) E-Class (213 platform) S-Class (223 platform) GLC (253 platform) and CLS (257 platform) vehicles with diesel engine the vacuum‑controlled coolant pump might exhibit a leakage between the vacuum system and the coolant circuit.
records.remedy: As a remedy Mercedes-Benz AG via its Mercedes-Benz service partners will update the software of the coolant pump and replace the electrical switch valve on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: ISOFIX connection system for rear seats of motorhomes and camper vans
records.defect: For affected vehicles with a rear seat equipped with an ISOFIX attachment system the welded joints of the ISOFIX attachment points may have been manufactured with a defect and could fail in the event of an accident.
records.remedy: Users are asked to stop using ISOFIX connection points to attach child seats with immediate effect. Dealers or garages will inspect and if necessary replace the ISOFIX bracket.

records.concern: 26S19 Ranger PHEV - High Voltage Battery Tray Retaining Bracket Replacement
records.defect: Affected vehicles may experience a fracture of the High Voltage Battery front mounting bracket lower legs potentially causing the battery to drop onto the chassis frame.
records.remedy: Replace the High Voltage Battery which contains the retaining brackets

records.concern: Driver’s Airbag Potential Non-Deployment
records.defect: A concern has been identified where the connector to the driver’s airbag at the clockspring may experience fretting corrosion over time. This can lead to an increased resistance in the driver’s airbag circuit potentially resulting in the airbag failing to deploy when requested to do so. An airbag which fails to deploy as-intended will increase the risk of injury in the event of a crash.
records.remedy: Vehicles will have a protective lubricant gel applied to the driver’s airbag connector terminals.

records.concern: SRPC2607 – Rear Seat Belt Bolting
records.defect: Mercedes-Benz AG has determined that on certain GLE/GLS (167 platform) vehicles the bolting connection of the rear seat belts might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: As a remedy Mercedes-Benz AG via its Mercedes-Benz service partners will rework the bolting connection of the affected rear seat belts on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: Kia EV5 Rear Seat Bolts
records.defect: On some vehicles the second-row lower seat bolts may not have been installed. On effected cars a missing bolt may increase the risk of injury if the vehicle was subjected to a collision from behind.
records.remedy: Check the security of all the rear seat retaining bolts & install a new bolt if found missing

records.concern: PV5 Front Shock Absorber Lower Bracket Welding - Safety Recall
records.defect: Potential that the right-hand front shock absorber lower bracket welding may fail and the shock absorber becomes detached from the lower arm. This would cause the vehicle ride height to drop at the front right side.
records.remedy: Check LOT number if within affected range replace shock absorber.

records.concern: Consumer safety warning and product recall: Motorhomes – potential defect in the ISOFIX child restraint anchorage system
records.defect: For certain vehicles the ISOFIX mountings may have inadequate weld seams at the attachment points. In the event of a vehicle crash the forces transmitted through a child seat attached to the ISOFIX anchorages may cause the bracket to fracture resulting in an increased risk of injury to the child.
records.remedy: Vehicle owners are instructed not to use the ISOFIX attachment points until a technical inspection and if necessary a retrofit or repair has been carried out by an authorised dealer. Vehicles that pass the inspection may continue to be used; vehicles that fail will be retrofitted accordingly.

records.concern: 26C22 - Transit Custom and Tourneo Custom - Driver Status Monitoring Camera Control Module Replacement
records.defect: Affected vehicles may be equipped with a Driver Facing Camera that may not work as intended and therefore not compliant with current regulatory requirements.
records.remedy: Replace the Driver Status Monitoring Camera Control Module.

records.concern: Rear Suspension Springs
records.defect: For certain vehicles there may be a non-conformity of the rear suspension springs that could lead to breakage.
records.remedy: As a preventative measure replace Left-hand and right-hand rear suspension springs

records.concern: Transit Courier: Diesel DV-Neo Engine Coolant Pump Update
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have been repaired using a coolant pump with a potential issue. This issue may lead to incorrect engine timing resulting in an engine failure causing a sudden loss of power without prior warning. The engine cannot be restarted.
records.remedy: Check and replace the water pump and timing belt if necessary.

records.concern: Some vehicles fitted with a high voltage battery may have internal cell voltage deviation
records.defect: Some vehicles fitted with a high voltage battery may have internal cell voltage deviation. If this occurs it may result in the risk of an electrical short circuit inside the battery. Until the high voltage battery software has been updated we recommend the vehicle to be parked in a well ventilated area. The vehicle can be used as normal.
records.remedy: High Voltage Battery Software Update or replacement if required.

records.concern: Defender and Discovery 2026 Model Year Fuel Tank Wall Thickness
records.defect: A concern has been identified where the fuel tank wall thickness may be below design specification near the inlet check valve. A fuel tank with a thinner-than-designed wall may not perform adequately in the event of a crash leading to increased risk of fuel spillage and potentially fire.
records.remedy: Affected vehicles will have the fuel tank replaced.

records.concern: E-PACE F-PACE Defender Discovery Sport Range Rover Evoque and Range Rover Velar PHEV Traction Battery Fire Risk
records.defect: Vehicles have experienced thermal overload which may manifest in smoke or fire that may occur underneath the rear of the vehicle where the high voltage traction battery is located. The root cause is not yet known and investigations are continuing. A vehicle thermal overload condition such as fire or smoke can result in increased risk of occupant injury and/or injury to persons outside the vehicle as well as property damage.
records.remedy: Vehicles will be inspected by the retailer and as required at-risk battery packs will be replaced.

records.concern: E-PACE F-PACE Defender Discovery Sport Range Rover Evoque and Range Rover Velar PHEV Traction Battery Fire Risk
records.defect: Vehicles have experienced thermal overload which may manifest in smoke or fire that may occur underneath the rear of the vehicle where the high voltage traction battery is located. The root cause is not yet known and investigations are continuing. A vehicle thermal overload condition such as fire or smoke can result in increased risk of occupant injury and/or injury to persons outside the vehicle as well as property damage.
records.remedy: Vehicles will be inspected by the retailer and as required at-risk battery packs will be replaced.

records.concern: SRPC2604 – Windshield bonding
records.defect: Mercedes-Benz AG has determined that on certain S-Class (223 platform) and EQS (297 platform) vehicles the bonding of the windshield might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: As a remedy Mercedes-Benz AG via its Mercedes-Benz service partners will replace the windshield.

records.concern: Water pump replacement on certain Toyota Proace and Proace City
records.defect: ​​Vehicles equipped with a 1.5L engine may be subject to engine failure and loss of engine power caused by water pump pulley slippage. This condition may result in timing belt misalignment and engine shutdown. The pulley may detach from the shaft leading to the loss of vehicle components on the roadway and complete loss of engine power increasing the risk of an accident.​
records.remedy: ​​Engine Water Pump Replacement​

records.concern: Liberty 50-125-150 iGet Headlamp – Safety Recall Campaign
records.defect: For the machines identified the headlamp is not functioning affecting either the low beam the high beam or both.
records.remedy: Check of the headlight and if necessary replace

records.concern: Software version of communication module
records.defect: Mercedes-Benz AG has determined that on certain CLA (174 platform) and GLB (244 platform) vehicles the software of the communication module might not meet the intended specification.
records.remedy: As a remedy Mercedes-Benz AG via its Mercedes-Benz service partners will update the software on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: Peugeot 208 Horn sound volume
records.defect: Affected vehicle have a horn volume which does not comply with regulatory requirements.
records.remedy: Replace the horn with one of a higher volume.

records.concern: Check the Head Airbag Threaded Connection; Rework if Necessary
records.defect: BMW has decided to initiate the safety recall “Curtain Airbag” with regard to the BMW model NA5. On affected vehicles both curtain airbags (left and right) may not have been properly screwed according to specification. If the curtain airbag is not installed properly it cannot be ruled out that noises (rattling) may occur while driving. Furthermore if the airbag deploys this may result in altered deployment characteristics and the inflator generator may become separated. This could increase the risk of injury.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles the screw connection of the curtain airbags (left and right) will be checked and reworked if necessary.

records.concern: VSM software Interior door handles
records.defect: Affected vehicles may experience an unexpected deactivation of the interior door handles when the key is in engine-running mode which could result in occupants being unable to exit.
records.remedy: Update the Vehicle Supervision Module software.

records.concern: VSM software Interior door handles
records.defect: Affected vehicles may experience an unexpected deactivation of the interior door handles when the key is in engine-running mode which could result in occupants being unable to exit.
records.remedy: Update the Vehicle Supervision Module software.

records.concern: VSM software Interior door handles
records.defect: Affected vehicles may experience an unexpected deactivation of the interior door handles when the key is in engine-running mode which could result in occupants being unable to exit.
records.remedy: Update the Vehicle Supervision Module software.

records.concern: VSM software Interior door handles
records.defect: Affected vehicles may experience an unexpected deactivation of the interior door handles when the key is in engine-running mode which could result in occupants being unable to exit.
records.remedy: Update the Vehicle Supervision Module software.

records.concern: RECALL CAMPAIGN – Bentley Continental GT Continental GT Convertible Flying Spur - Incorrect Front Driveshafts (RE26/14 RD93)
records.defect: On affected vehicles the front axles may have been assembled with an incorrect drive shaft which is shorter than intended. If an incorrect front driveshaft has been fitted it may result in the hub securing nut becoming loose over time.
records.remedy: Inspect the front driveshafts and replace them if required.

records.concern: Replacing the Convenience Charging Electronics
records.defect: BMW has decided to initiate the safety recall “Replace the Onboard Charger” with regards to the certain BMW NA5 models. On affected vehicles the onboard charger will be replaced. If there is a reduced insulation there is an extremely low risk of a dangerous voltage on the vehicle chassis. The fault is not detectable by the customer.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles the onboard charger will be replaced.

records.concern: Risk of wrong fuel pipe routing
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have an incorrectly routed fuel pipe at risk of contact with other components which could lead to a fuel leak or risk of fire.
records.remedy: Check the correct routing of the fuel pipe and replace if necessary.

records.concern: 1074 Product safety recall booster cabling Xtura (wiring harness Vers.1) // 1075 Product safety recall booster cabling Xtura (wiring harness Vers.2)
records.defect: The 6 mm² cable cross-sections of the charging boosters may be too small to safely carry fault currents which could cause the cables to overload and overheat potentially leading to a fire.The charging booster’s wiring will be replaced and a pre-fuse will be fitted.
records.remedy: The charging booster’s wiring will be replaced and a pre-fuse will be fitted.

records.concern: Risk of wrong fuel pipe routing
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have an incorrectly routed fuel pipe at risk of contact with other components which could lead to a fuel leak or risk of fire.
records.remedy: Check the correct routing of the fuel pipe and replace if necessary.

records.concern: SRT 382 - Incorrect Vertical Load Value on Trailer Hitch Label for 2024-2025MY Crosstrek Vehicles
records.defect: For 2024-2025MY Crosstrek vehicles equipped with the genuine accessory trailer hitch for the European market the trailer hitch carries a vertical load value on its label that is lower than the vehicle’s vertical load value indicated in the Certificate of Conformity (CoC).
records.remedy: For all the vehicles with the affected parts Subaru dealers will replace the trailer hitch assembly with the countermeasure part.

records.concern: Relay Smart Tachograph.
records.defect: Affected vehicles have a smart tachograph fitted that may not comply with regulatory requirements.
records.remedy: Replace the Tachograph Sensor Antenna(s) and adding Wiring Harnesses if necessary.

records.concern: Boxer Smart Tachograph.
records.defect: Affected vehicles have a smart tachograph fitted that may not comply with regulatory requirements.
records.remedy: Replace the Tachograph Sensor Antenna(s) and adding Wiring Harnesses if necessary.

records.concern: Movano Smart Tachograph
records.defect: Affected vehicles have a smart tachograph fitted that may not comply with regulatory requirements.
records.remedy: Replace the Tachograph Sensor Antenna(s) and adding Wiring Harnesses if necessary.

records.concern: Battery Tray lockstop missing
records.defect: Potential issue with the 12V battery tray. The battery tray may become detached during service or maintenance work due to missing lock stop. Vehicles need to be inspected and install any missing stops where applicable.
records.remedy: Vehicles need to be inspected and install any missing stops where applicable.

records.concern: MVL: REAR-VIEW CAMERA DISTORTED AND/OR LOSS OF IMAGE
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have an issue with the rear-view camera. Drivers may experience a distorted or loss of image.
records.remedy: Check vehicle and replace camera as required.

records.concern: Range Rover Range Rover Sport and Range Rover Velar Audio Amplifier Water Damage
records.defect: A concern has been identified on certain 2026 model year Range Rover Range Rover Sport and Range Rover Velar vehicles where the audio amplifiers may have been subject to water damage and may not provide any audio output including no seat belt reminder audible warnings to the driver. A seat belt reminder audible warning chime that does not alert of an unlatched seat belt can increase the risk of occupant injury in the event of a crash.
records.remedy: Affected vehicles will have the audio amplifier replaced.

records.concern: Upper section of the front bumper (softnose)
records.defect: For affected vehicles the upper section of the front bumper (Soft nose) -presents a risk of weld failure between the skin and the liner
records.remedy: Replacement of the upper part of the front bumper.

records.concern: Range Rover and Range Rover Sport Panoramic Roof Side Finisher Loose
records.defect: The manufacturer has identified a concern on certain Range Rover and Range Rover Sport vehicles where the adhesion process used to re-attach the panoramic roof side finishers during vehicle quality rework operations in the assembly plant may not have been sufficient. An inadequately adhered panoramic roof side finisher could over time come partially or completely loose. This could result in distraction to the driver or other road users or in the event of complete detachment harm to other road users particularly pedestrians or two-wheeled vehicles and increase the risk of injury or a crash.
records.remedy: Vehicles will have the panoramic roof side finisher removed and securely attached.

records.concern: Front lower control arm fasteningg Loose
records.defect: On affected vehicles the front suspension lower control arm upper bolts may not have been tightened according to specification during assembly.
records.remedy: Check the bolts for the correct torque and replace if necessary.

records.concern: SRPC2602 - Wheel Bolt Variant
records.defect: Mercedes-Benz AG has determined that on certain G-Class (465 platform) vehicles with fully electric drive the wheel bolts might not meet the requirements.
records.remedy: As a remedy Mercedes-Benz AG via its Mercedes-Benz service partners will replace the wheel bolts on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: Software Update to U-Baseline
records.defect: An issue has been found which may make the vehicle non-compliant . The concern we have noted relates to the instrument cluster warnings may not activate as intended in certain full emergency braking scenarios resulting in insufficient warning indications to the driver.
records.remedy: The vehicle will require the Vehicle Baseline Software to be updated to the latest level.

records.concern: SRL260420 – MICHELIN26 – Check Tyres
records.defect: At Mercedes-Benz we constantly monitor our products to ensure the highest quality and safety. The tyre supplier Michelin notified Daimler Truck AG as part of a voluntary declaration that a circumferential crack in the tyre sidewall may occur on your vehicle with 355/50 R 22.5 Michelin X MULTI Z and X LINE ENERGY Z type truck tyres. Vehicles that have been equipped with potentially affected Michelin tyres should therefore be checked.
records.remedy: As part of our planned recall campaign we will check the tires on potentially affected vehicles as a precautionary measure. Affected tires are then directly reported to Michelin and replaced.

records.concern: 26S31 – Transit and Transit Custom – Fuel line cracked
records.defect: On affected left-hand drive (LHD) vehicles there is a risk of a leak from a fuel line on to the diesel particulate filter (DPF) and/or exhaust components which may in a worst-case scenario result in an under-bonnet fire.
records.remedy: Fit modified fuel feed line.

records.concern: Low pressure fuel pump replacement
records.defect: For certain vehicles which are equipped with a low-pressure fuel pump that supplies fuel through use of an impeller made of resin the material in this impeller may swell sufficiently to interfere with surrounding components potentially causing the fuel pump to become inoperative
records.remedy: Replacement of the fuel pump

records.concern: 25S19 Ranger – Automatic Transmission no reverse
records.defect: Ford constantly monitors production processes and vehicles in service. While monitoring vehicles in operation we have become aware of a number of Ranger automatic transmission vehicles where you may experience no reverse motion when the gear selector is placed in reverse due to a potential issue with the transmission main control valve body. The Malfunction Indicator Light (MIL) and Wrench light will illuminate when this malfunction occurs. The vehicle could roll forward despite the gear selector being in the reverse position depending on where parked. Unexpected vehicle motion can increase the risk of a crash.
records.remedy: Replace the transmission main control valve body

records.concern: Grandland EPS software update
records.defect: Due to a mechanical failure in the reducer bearing combined with a specific defect in the Electric Power Steering (EPS) software calibration affected vehicles may experience a loss of power steering which in the worst case could lead to steering lock.
records.remedy: Update the EPS software calibration to prevent the potential loss of steering assistance.

records.concern: DBX Rear Lower Arm Bolt
records.defect: On affected vehicles a reduced diameter shank bolt can cause the pin for the torque reaction link to move within the joint causing excessive wear and potential early failure. In a worst-case scenario failure of the rear lower suspension arm can affect vehicle handling and braking with an increased risk of a crash.
records.remedy: Replace the rear torque reaction bolts and if necessary replace the rear lower suspension arms.

records.concern: Multi Vehicle Line (MVL): Telecommunications Control Module (TCU) loss of Function Software Update
records.defect: Affected vehicles may experience a loss of emergency call system (eCall) functionality which impacts both automatic and manual eCall events.
records.remedy: Update the Telematics Control Unit software to the latest level.

records.concern: Replacing seat belt with tensioner
records.defect: On Audi Q5 vehicles manufactured within a specific period the belt tensioning function on the front seats does not comply with technical requirements. Although the seat belt is tightened in the event of an accident which requires this it cannot be held tight reliably which reduces the protective effect. For this reason one or both front seat belts – as required – will be replaced on affected Q5 vehicles.
records.remedy: Recall campaign 69GT must be performed on affected vehicles and the affected seat belts must be replaced as described in the Workshop Manual.

records.concern: Some vehicles fitted with a high voltage battery may have internal cell voltage deviation
records.defect: Some vehicles fitted with a high voltage battery may have internal cell voltage deviation. If this occurs it may result in the risk of an electrical short circuit inside the battery. Until the high voltage battery software has been updated we recommend the vehicle to be parked in a well ventilated area. The vehicle can be used as normal.
records.remedy: Hyundai has launched a Safety Recall to update the battery management system (BMS) software.

records.concern: Two wheeler motorcycle helmets Type: JET ‘J’ Approval No.: E11*22R05/03*0527*02
records.defect: Affected helmets do not meet the requirements of ECE 22.05 and present a danger to users.
records.remedy: Affected helmets will be replaced and scrapped.

records.concern: Urea Pump Replace
records.defect: On affected vehicles an inadequate flow of AdBlue causes increased NOx and other pollutant emissions.
records.remedy: Replace the AdBlue pump.

records.concern: 2024-2026 MILWAUKEE-EIGHT AIRBOX BASEPLATE
records.defect: The airbox baseplate may have a blocked breather port due to a supplier manufacturing issue. A blocked breather port can result in pressure build-up in the crankcase. If the dipstick is removed while the Version: 3.0 (Jan 2025) crankcase is pressurized oil may be discharged from the fill spout creating a risk of injury.
records.remedy: Verify that air flows through the hose and into air box backing plate. If the air box backing plate port is blocked rework the breather passage.

records.concern: 25C74 Transit Connect Tourneo Connect - Position Lights Not Operating Correctly
records.defect: Affected vehicles may not have the remedy for recall 22C32 installed correctly. These vehicles may still have the incorrect configuration loaded onto the Body Control Module which may prevent the position lights from functioning as intended.
records.remedy: Update the Daytime Running Lamps configuration and perform a software verification procedure.

records.concern: Steering Lock Screw Failure
records.defect: For affected machines the screw fixing the steering lock to the bottom bridge was not tightened enough and in some cases it can loosen during riding and become caught in the steering area making the steering impossible to operate and causing a fall or the steering lock to become detached.
records.remedy: Campaign 3S4 – Temporary Repair - Until parts allocation is confirmed late May 2026 – Carry out inspection of steering lock free play with the following outcomes:- Free play detected: Replace Lock Screws. No free play detected: Retailer should mark the screw heads and instruct the customer to check the marks before each ride. If marks do not align the customer should immediately stop riding and contact their nearest Honda Authorized Retailer for advice. Campaign. 3RY – Final Repair - Following sufficient parts allocation- Replacement of the steering lock screw will be performed free of charge to all affected units. During replacement a thread-locking agent will be applied and screws tightened to the specified torque.

records.concern: Range Rover and Range Rover Sport Plug-in Hybrid Battery Capacity
records.defect: The manufacturer has identified a concern on certain Range Rover and Range Rover Sport plug-in hybrid vehicles where due to inadequate penetration of welding between the cells the battery’s capacity and therefore the vehicle’s electric range may be depleted below the design intent condition. A below-specification electric range will not meet the as-certified value for the vehicle and is therefore non-compliant to emissions legislation.
records.remedy: Vehicles will have the hybrid battery/modules replaced.

records.concern: Restoration of Grey Water Tank Screws
records.defect: For certain vehicles the screws securing the grey water tank mounting brackets may fail causing the tank to detach.
records.remedy: The repair involves drilling and re-tapping the chassis fixing hole then installing bolts of a greater size.

records.concern: BCM software missing telltale if LKA unavailable
records.defect: On affected vehicles the Lane Keep Assist tell-tale fails to illuminate if the front camera is blocked meaning no warning light appears in the instrument cluster.
records.remedy: Update the Body Control Module software.

records.concern: BCM software missing telltale if LKA unavailable

records.concern: 25C56 Transit - Potential Incorrect CO2 Emissions Recorded On The Certificate Of Conformity
records.defect: On affected vehicles the Certificate of Conformity (CoC) may contain inaccurate CO2 data. As a result the CoCs state a lower CO2 value than intended.
records.remedy: Dealers will exchange CoC papers and help owners update their vehicle’s registration documentation. Ford will reimburse any underpaid purchase tax due as a result of the vehicle’s re-registration.

records.concern: Puma -Certificate of Conformity (CoC) Update Tyre Mismatch
records.defect: While monitoring vehicles in operation Ford has become aware that a number of Puma Gen-E vehicles may show a mismatch between the Tyre information on the Certificate of Conformity (COC) and Homologation documents and may not meet regulatory requirements.
records.remedy: Document exchange

records.concern: MCU inverter
records.defect: On affected vehicles the Motor Control Unit (MCU) Inverter may have a manufacturing deviation which could lead to gearbox malfunctions and the risk of an internal electrical short circuit leading to overheating or a fire.
records.remedy: Replace the MCU Inverter.

records.concern: MCU inverter
records.defect: On affected vehicles the Motor Control Unit (MCU) Inverter may have a manufacturing deviation which could lead to gearbox malfunctions and the risk of an internal electrical short circuit leading to overheating or a fire.
records.remedy: Replace the MCU Inverter.

records.concern: Kia Cluster Malfunction Recall
records.defect: The instrument cluster screen may respond slowly immediately after starting the vehicle. During this condition activating the turn signal can cause the cluster to reset or the Blind View Monitor (BVM) within the cluster to turn green. The malfunction is caused by PMIC noise induced falsely high temperature sensor readings which trigger the chip protection logic above a certain threshold and lead to performance limitation up to reboot or black screen.
records.remedy: Over The Air software update or dealer software update

records.concern: Modification of the front axle brake lines
records.defect: The manufacturer has determined that affected vehicles may be fitted with a front-axle braking system that does not fully comply with the regulatory authority’s requirements.
records.remedy: Modification and optimisation of front axle brake lines on 4x2 vehicles.

records.concern: 26C16 Mustang - Lane Keeping System Software Update
records.defect: According to Ford’s records certain Mustang vehicles may not have the remedy for Compliance Recall 21C11 installed correctly but were recorded as having received the repair successfully. Because the correct software update may not have been installed on these vehicles the underlying condition may still exist therefore these vehicles may still have the incorrect software loaded for the Lane Keeping System (LKS). On affected vehicles not having the latest Lane Keeping System (LKS) software may lead to non-compliance with the current regulations relating to Hands-On-Off (HOO) chime requirements that became effective from April 1 2021. Dealers will update the Image Processing Module A (IPMA) and the Power Steering Control Module (PSCM) to the latest available software level free of charge.
records.remedy: Dealers will update the Image Processing Module A (IPMA) and the Power Steering Control Module (PSCM) to the latest available software level free of charge.

records.concern: 26C15 Transit - Instrument Panel Cluster Configuration Update
records.defect: According to Ford’s records certain Transit vehicles may not have the remedy for Compliance Recall 21C32 installed correctly but were recorded as having received the repair successfully. Because the correct configuration update may not have been installed on these vehicles the underlying condition may still exist therefore these vehicles may still have the incorrect configuration loaded onto the Instrument Panel Cluster (IPC). On affected vehicles an incorrect Instrument Panel Cluster (IPC) configuration may have disabled the Advanced Emergency Braking System warning messages. Although the system remains functional the instrument cluster may not display the required warning message and no chime may sound which could result in the vehicle not complying with applicable regulations. Dealers will update the Instrument Panel Cluster (IPC) configuration to the latest available level.
records.remedy: Dealers will update the Instrument Panel Cluster (IPC) configuration to the latest available level.

records.concern: 26S15 Puma - Driveshaft Inspection
records.defect: Affected vehicles may experience a right-hand sided front driveshaft failure resulting in a loss of drive.
records.remedy: Inspect the right-hand side front driveshaft and replace if necessary.

records.concern: Bridgestone Duravis Eco R660 16'' Tyre Recall
records.defect: The affected tyre is more susceptible to cuts and partial penetrations than anticipated when used in rugged and wet environments. These cuts can lead to moisture intrusion and subsequent oxidation of the tyre belt. resulting in tyre deformation and if use continues without detection may result in tread delamination. (The number of vehicles affected to which these tyres are fitted is 62216 vehicles)
records.remedy: Replacement of affected tyres.

records.concern: VSM software missing AEB telltale in case of blind camera.
records.defect: On certain DS vehicles the Automatic Emergency Braking Assist telltale fails to illuminate if the front camera is blocked. No AEB warning telltale meaning no warning light appears in the instrument cluster. An additional pop-up appears for around 10 seconds at each key on/key off (Driving Assistance Sensor Blind: clean sensor see User Manual). The Automatic Emergency Braking system is operating in a degraded mode but remains functional due to radar support.
records.remedy: To rectify this issue we will update the Vehicle System Management software
