records.concern: Rovelo All Weather 4RS tyres - displaying incorrect directional marking
records.defect: Due to a manufacturing error an ‘inside’ sidewall marking has been printed on the outer sidewall on some tyres. The 'inside' marking should not be printed on directional tyres at all.
records.remedy: Replace the incorrectly marked tyre with a new tyre.

records.concern: Body Height sensor
records.defect: Affected vehicles may exhibit improper headlamp levelling due to an incorrectly assembled Body Height Sensor.
records.remedy: Change the body height sensor.

records.concern: 2nd Seat Spring Replacement on Highlander
records.defect: For certain vehicles equipped with second row seats that use recliner assemblies to unlock the seatbacks allow for seatback angle adjustment and locking due to a design change made by the supplier the recliner teeth may not fully engage during seatback adjustment. This could lead to the seatback not remaining in a locked position increasing the risk of injury in the event of a crash at higher speeds.
records.remedy: Replace the return springs in the recliner assembly with improved ones.

records.concern: C0544 Rear Axle Hub nut replace
records.defect: There is a combined risk that rear axle hub nuts might have the tightening torque relaxed and the hub might not have been locked looked correctly. In the worst case it could lead the vehicle to lose a rear wheel set on road.
records.remedy: The current hub nut will be replaced by a new hub nut the specified torque will be applied and the nut will be crimped against the axle housing.

records.concern: Checking brake servo
records.defect: On affected vehicles the bolted connection for the push rod between the brake pedal and brake servo may come loose with the risk that it will no longer be possible to stop by using the brake pedal.
records.remedy: Check the bolted connection for the push rod between the brake pedal and brake servo and tighten if necessary.

records.concern: 2025 AND 2026 SOFTAIL REAR BRAKELINE
records.defect: The rear brake line may contact the Body Control Module (BCM) due to insufficient clearance. Contact between the brake line and the BCM over time could lead to a hole in the brake line and a loss of brake fluid. If brake fluid loss remains undetected rear braking may be compromised increasing the risk of a crash.
records.remedy: The BCM caddy and associated hardware will be replaced on all affected vehicles. In addition the rear brake line will be inspected and if damaged will be replaced along with associated parts.

records.concern: Goodyear Eagle F1 Supersport 255/35ZR20 97Y & 305/30ZR21 104Y
records.defect: On affected tyres the references do not comply with regulatory high-speed requirements which may lead to tread deformation or crown separation when running at high speed.
records.remedy: Replace affected tyres.

records.concern: MCV MY24: VEHICLE WITH IC AEBS STEP1 AND 5G0 PERFORMED
records.defect: The manufacturer has determined that affected vehicles have both an earlier version and a later more advanced version of the AEBS control software installed. This co-occurrence may result in different information being displayed on the diagnostic dashboard and these differences could be mistakenly interpreted as an error or a failure of the AEBS
records.remedy: Instrument Cluster Software update.

records.concern: Check the cable routing next to the battery on ScaniaTouring
records.defect: The manufacturer has identified there is a risk that the battery cable could chafe against the battery holder bracket and make short circuit.
records.remedy: Chafe protection to be fitted to affected battery cables.

records.concern: Potential Fatigue Failure of Front Brake Caliper Support - Loss of Front Braking
records.defect: On affected motorcycles a fatigue failure of the front brake caliper support may occur after multiple hard or emergency braking. If the support fails front braking will be lost and it will increase the risk of a crash causing injury or even death.
records.remedy: Install a Caliper Support Reinforcement Kit on the front brake caliper support.

records.concern: SRPC2601 - Interior Door Handle Release
records.defect: Mercedes-Benz AG has determined that on certain CLA (174 platform) A-Class (177 platform) and GLA (247 platform) vehicles the bowden cable of the release mechanism of one or more doors might not have been properly mounted.
records.remedy: As a precautionary measure Mercedes-Benz AG via its Mercedes-Benz service partners will check the bowden cables of the doors on the affected vehicles and mount them correctly if necessary.

records.concern: MCV MY24: VEHICLES WITH AEBS IC STEP1 AND IMPROVED ADAS PERFORMANCE
records.defect: ​Affected vehicles may have both an earlier version and a later more advanced version of the AEBS control software installed. This co-occurrence may result in different information being displayed on the diagnostic dashboard and these differences could be mistakenly interpreted as an error or a failure of the AEBS.
records.remedy: ​​Software update of all control units involved in the operation of ADAS systems.​

records.defect: As part of our continuous product monitoring we have found that the detection range of the blind spot assist monitoring sensor may be partially covered or restricted by the vehicle body or attachments (e.g. side underride guard). This condition can potentially lead to false alarms. Road users or obstacles that are in the detection range during cornering may not be detected by the safety system or may be detected with a delay which increases the risk of accidents. There is currently no information on damage or accidents that are connected to the fault profile mentioned.
records.remedy: The blind spot assist will be checked

records.concern: 25SA7 - Mustang - Powertrain Control Module Software Update
records.defect: On affected vehicles equipped with a Ford Performance Whipple Supercharger Upgrade Kit the updated software may not be able to detect module hardware errors leading to unintended acceleration or unintended vehicle movement increasing the risk of a crash.
records.remedy: Update the Powertrain Control Module software.

records.concern: Cooling spray nozzle potentially missing
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have a cylinder block with a missing cooling nozzle. A missing nozzle means the piston may not be adequately cooled causing it to weaken deform or break and leading to sudden engine failure resulting in a loss of power and in the worst‑case scenario a thermal incident.
records.remedy: Check the presence of all cooling nozzles and replace if missing.

records.concern: Speed Limitation – BCM software
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have the incorrect speed limit displayed.
records.remedy: Update the Body Control Module Software.

records.concern: Battery check
records.defect: Certain vehicles manufactured during a limited production period a high-voltage battery module may not meet quality standards. This may result in significantly reduced autonomy a yellow warning light coming on or a thermal overload inside the high-voltage battery. A thermal overload of this kind may cause a fire in the vehicle
records.remedy: A battery check is carried out on the vehicles. If the check identifies high-voltage battery modules which may be faulty the identified modules must be replaced.

records.concern: Transit Courier - Instrument Panel defect Affecting Passenger Airbag Operation
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have been built with a potential defect on the instrument panel due to a manufacturing process which could affect passenger airbag operation in the event of a crash.
records.remedy: Replace the instrument panel.

records.concern: 25SD9 - E-Transit – Halfshaft Retention Force
records.defect: On affected vehicles left-hand rear half shafts were not fully seated into the electric drive assembly which may result in premature wear and a leak. This may eventually lead to a loss of motive power or unintended vehicle movement while the vehicle is in Park (if the parking brake is not applied).
records.remedy: Check with a gauge disassemble and check further if necessary. Replace parts if required.

records.concern: Renewing complete multi-function switch on left handlebar
records.defect: The indicator switch may self cancel when activated
records.remedy: Replace multi-function switch on handlebar

records.concern: Fuel particulate filter pressure pipe
records.defect: On affected vehicles due to a production nonconformity there may be contact or a reduced clearance between the fuel Particulate Filter pipe and the pole protection cup of the 48V Belt Starter Generator. Under wet conditions there is a possibility that this insufficient clearance may lead to water infiltration creating an electrical arc which could trigger a thermal event such as overheating. In the worst-case scenario this could result in a risk of fire in the engine compartment.
records.remedy: Replace the pole protection cup of the 48V Belt Starter Generator. In addition check the distance between the fuel Particulate Filter pipe and the pole protection cup of the 48V Belt Starter Generator. If the distance is less than 10 mm re-position the pipe or replace the pipe if damaged.

records.concern: The vehicle fuel pump may have an internal malfunction which may fail over time.
records.defect: The vehicle fuel pump may have an internal malfunction which may fail over time. The malfunction indicator light MIL on the vehicle instrument cluster may illuminate when this symptom occurs and if ignored and the vehicle continues to be driven the vehicle may lose motive power.
records.remedy: The affected vehicles will have the fuel pump replaced as a permanent solution

records.concern: Replace clutch assembly
records.defect: Mercedes-Benz AG has determined that on certain Citan model vehicles the clutch pressure plate might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: As a remedy Mercedes-Benz AG via its Mercedes-Benz service partners will replace the clutch on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: Some vehicles may have an instrument cluster operational concern whilst driving the vehicle
records.defect: Some vehicles may face a concern where the instrument cluster panel may reboot during vehicle operation potentially resulting in a blank instrument cluster display screen.
records.remedy: To correct this an ‘Over the Air ‘ software update to the vehicles will be deployed remotely.

records.concern: Some vehicles may have an instrument cluster operational concern whilst driving the vehicle
records.defect: Some vehicles may face a concern where the instrument cluster panel may reboot during vehicle operation potentially resulting in a blank instrument cluster display screen.
records.remedy: To correct this an ‘Over the Air ‘ software update to the vehicles will be deployed remotely.

records.concern: Transit Courier: Diesel DV-Neo Engine Coolant Pump Update
records.defect: Certain vehicles were built with a potential issue affecting the coolant pump. This issue may lead to an engine failure causing a sudden loss of power without prior warning.
records.remedy: Replace the coolant pump including a prior level gear without water steam treatment.

records.concern: Nv400 X62 AdBlue Dosing Inactive
records.defect: For affected vehicles the AdBlue Dosing Module may not have been initialised during the production process. In this condition the AdBlue Dosing Module does not trigger AdBlue injection and therefore NOx emissions are not controlled.
records.remedy: The AdBlue dosing control module (ADCM) activation status will be checked. If it is not active the AdBlue Injector will be replaced and the AdBlue Dosing Control Module activated.

records.concern: Defender Third Row Lower Seat Belt Anchorage Bracket
records.defect: On affected vehicles a concern has been identified where the third-row lower seat belt anchorage bracket may contain a weld stud of insufficient ISO strength due to material contamination at the supplier. An insufficiently strong weld stud in this position could result in the safety restraint system not functioning correctly in the event of a crash increasing the risk of occupant injury.
records.remedy: Vehicles will have the third-row lower seat belt anchorage bracket replaced.

records.concern: MDEG/HDEP Euro VI standard NOx sensor monitoring inoperative
records.defect: The EU directive for commercial vehicles with the Euro 6 emissions standard stipulates that the NOx sensor signal is regularly checked for plausibility. The IUPR monitor (In Use Performance Ratio) was defined for this purpose. At a minimum 50% of vehicles in a class must have this monitor be active at least 10% of the possible time. This is not the case for the affected vehicles. Cause Parameter error in data record creation.
records.remedy: To remedy this an update software version in engine management (MCM) and exhaust gas aftertreatment (ACM) control units is required.

records.concern: Alarm triggered randomly - BCM software
records.defect: On affected vehicles due to a Body Control Module (BCM) software weakness an alarm siren may randomly trigger when the vehicle is locked.
records.remedy: Update the BCM software.

records.concern: McLaren 765LT polycarbonate tailgate recall
records.defect: On affected vehicles de-bonding of the rear polycarbonate cabin window may occur when driven at high speeds with the windows open.
records.remedy: Install mechanical fastenings on the tailgate polycarbonate window.

records.concern: Ranger: 10R80 Transmission Oil Pump Gears Software Update
records.defect: On affected vehicles the software repair for previous recall 20S10 may not have been delivered properly and vehicles may exhibit an issue where the transmission lubricant pump gear could fail.
records.remedy: Update the Power Control Module and Transmission Control Module and perform an additional verification process to ensure the configuration has been installed correctly.

records.concern: 26S20 Transit - Lower Arm Rear Bolt Replacement
records.defect: On affected vehicles one of the front suspension bolts may have been overtightened during manufacturer which may cause it to weaken and fracture over time.
records.remedy: Replace the affected front suspension bolt.

records.concern: RR31 Rear Seat Belt Bolt Connection Check
records.defect: ​​This safety recall involves bolts which fix the left and right side rear seat safety belts to the vehicle body or bolts which fix the rear bench seat configuration backrest locking brackets to the vehicle body. One of these bolts may not have been tightened to specifications and over time could loosen and also potentially cause damage to either the left or right side rear seat safety belt webbing.​
records.remedy: ​​The possibly affected fixing bolts will be checked and either tightened to specifications or replaced as necessary. The condition of the left and right side rear seat safety belts will be checked and if necessary replaced.​

records.concern: Winker Wiring Harness Short Circuit
records.defect: On affected motorcycles the indicator wire may have been incorrectly routed during production which may cause a short circuit that can lead to malfunctions in the turn signal system (front and rear) brake lights horn meter hazard lights taillight and license light.
records.remedy: Check and reroute wiring harness and repair or replace it if necessary.

records.concern: Passenger airbag inflator
records.defect: Passenger air bag may deploy incorrectly if activated.
records.remedy: Replace the passenger air bag inflator.

records.concern: Passenger airbag inflator
records.defect: Passenger air bag may deploy incorrectly if activated.
records.remedy: Replace the passenger air bag inflator.

records.concern: Passenger airbag inflator
records.defect: The front passenger airbag inflator (PAB) may contain propellant that could possibly degrade over a period of time. This may cause metal fragments to pass through the air bag and into the vehicle interior at high speed which may result in injury to vehicle occupants in the event of a deployment event.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the inflator assembly.

records.concern: Passenger airbag inflator
records.defect: In the event that the airbag is activated excessive internal pressure may cause the inflator body to rupture and metal fragments may pass through the cushion material causing injury to the vehicle occupants and / or in worst cases a fatality. The concern is caused by moisture in the air getting past faulty seals and being absorbed by the pyrotechnic biscuits in the inflator. As a result it is more likely to occur sooner in areas of high humidity and high temperature difference.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the passenger front air bag module which includes the inflator.

records.concern: Driver airbag inflator
records.defect: The driver airbag inflator housing may rupture due to excessive internal pressure during normal airbag deployment events. This condition is more likely to occur if the vehicle has been exposed to high levels of absolute humidity for extended periods of time.
records.remedy: Replace the driver airbag inflator.

records.concern: 9027TRen TGA TGL TGM TGS TGX eTGS eTGX hTGX Truck chassis: Replace affected drag links and/or track rods.
records.defect: A breakage of steering pushrods and steering rods ball studs cannot be ruled out.
records.remedy: Replace affected drag links and/or track rods.

records.concern: 25C75 Focus - Lane Centering Assist Software Update
records.defect: Certain affected vehicles may not have the remedy for Compliance Recall 24C12 installed correctly
records.remedy: Dealers will update Audio Front Control Module (ACM) software to the latest level available.

records.concern: Checking and re-securing the air-conditioning wiring harness
records.defect: The Safety Recall relates to the air-conditioning wiring harness located behind the dashboard. On the affected vehicles the wiring harness was fixed very close to a screw connection on the interior microfilter housing cover. The microfilter of the air conditioning system will be regularly replaced as part of the oil service. It cannot be ruled out that cables may be damaged when replacing the microfilter during a workshop visit. The filter cover has to be removed from the lower part of the instrument panel. After replacing the filter the cover has to be refitted at which point the wires may become damaged or trapped. If the wiring harness is damaged this could lead to malfunctions of the air conditioning system as well as to a short circuit. In case of a short circuit a sensor may overheat while the vehicle is in operation. As a result smoke may develop from the instrument panel and subsequently a fire cannot be ruled out.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the air-conditioning wiring harness will be checked repaired if necessary and re-secured in a modified fixing.

records.concern: Water Pump Pulley
records.defect: On affected vehicles due to a production nonconformity the water pump may malfunction which may cause a loss of engine power and result in the engine shutting down.
records.remedy: Replace the water pump.

records.concern: Relay and Wire Harness installation on certain Prius
records.defect: For affected vehicles that are equipped with an electric rear door lock system which includes a door opener switch and a rear door lock release actuator If the seal performance for this switch is reduced this can temporarily allow water to enter the switch which can cause the switch to activate and the door could open unexpectedly.
records.remedy: Installation of relay and wire harness.

records.concern: Water Pump Pulley
records.defect: On affected vehicles due to a production nonconformity the water pump may malfunction which may cause a loss of engine power and result in the engine shutting down.
records.remedy: Replace the water pump.

records.concern: Water pump pulley
records.defect: On affected vehicles due to a production nonconformity the water pump may malfunction which may cause a loss of engine power and result in the engine shutting down.
records.remedy: Replace the water pump.

records.concern: 26S16 - Transit and Tourneo Courier – Handbrake cable slippage
records.defect: On affected vehicles the handbrake jumper cable may slip leading to a complete loss of parking-brake holding capability.
records.remedy: Test measure and replace parking brake cable jumper harness if necessary.

records.concern: Battery Check
records.defect: For affected vehicles battery cells were fitted in the high-voltage battery that can demonstrate an increased self-discharge due to a production fault. In the event of heavy self-discharge the yellow indicator lamps may light up.
records.remedy: The affected battery modules must be checked and if necessary replaced. The vehicle may only be charged outdoors and up to maximum 80%.

records.concern: Error in Handbook for Operation of Window Lock
records.defect: Amendment to the Owners Handbook – Correction of an error in the operating instructions in paragraph 3.22 relating to the operation of the window lifter: incorrect description of the rear door locking procedure
records.remedy: Registered keeper will be sent a corrected page

records.concern: USA Imported vehicle Recall Driver side airbag module replacement
records.defect: USA Recall for Imported vehicles NITSA 20V785. Volkswagen has detected that on some USA Imported Beetle models that the driver front airbag inflator can explode due to propellant degradation that occurs after exposure to high absolute humidity high temperatures and high temperature cycling. An inflator explosion in these circumstances can result in injury to the driver or other occupants due to the ejection of metal fragments during the airbag explosion.
records.remedy: For safety reasons the driver airbag unit must be replaced. The work required will take approximately 1.5 hours and will of course be performed free of charge.

records.concern: M0399 UDS pump replace (wave 4). FL/FE (3)
records.defect: Faulty Urea pump membrane could lead to that the vehicle to be non-compliant to legislation.
records.remedy: Replacement of the UDS pump unit to correct membrane.

records.concern: Power Steering Wiring Harness.
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have a power steering harness routed between two screws where minor vibrations could cause harness damage resulting in a possible short circuit. This could lead to a loss of power‑steering assistance and in worst case a fire.
records.remedy: Ensure new routing and protection of the harness by replacing the existing clip with a new one and add a cap on the bolt thread.

records.concern: Alternator protection
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have been assembled with contact or with a reduced clearance between the Gasoline Particulate Filter pipe and the pole protection cap of the 48V Belt Starter Generator. There is a possibility of contact between these components leading to water infiltration and an electrical arch which could trigger a thermal event.
records.remedy: Replace the pole protection cap of the 48V Belt Starter Generator. Check the distance between the Gasoline Particulate Filter pipe and the pole protection cap of the 48V Belt Starter Generator and re‑position or replace the pipe if required.

records.concern: Alternator protection
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have been assembled with contact or with a reduced clearance between the Gasoline Particulate Filter pipe and the pole protection cap of the 48V Belt Starter Generator. There is a possibility of contact between these components leading to water infiltration and an electrical arch which could trigger a thermal event.
records.remedy: Replace the pole protection cap of the 48V Belt Starter Generator. Check the distance between the Gasoline Particulate Filter pipe and the pole protection cap of the 48V Belt Starter Generator and re‑position or replace the pipe if required.

records.concern: Alternator protection
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have been assembled with contact or with a reduced clearance between the Gasoline Particulate Filter pipe and the pole protection cap of the 48V Belt Starter Generator. There is a possibility of contact between these components leading to water infiltration and an electrical arch which could trigger a thermal event.
records.remedy: Replace the pole protection cap of the 48V Belt Starter Generator. Check the distance between the Gasoline Particulate Filter pipe and the pole protection cap of the 48V Belt Starter Generator and re‑position or replace the pipe if required.

records.concern: Alternator protection
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have been assembled with contact or with a reduced clearance between the Gasoline Particulate Filter pipe and the pole protection cap of the 48V Belt Starter Generator. There is a possibility of contact between these components leading to water infiltration and an electrical arch which could trigger a thermal event.
records.remedy: Replace the pole protection cap of the 48V Belt Starter Generator. Check the distance between the Gasoline Particulate Filter pipe and the pole protection cap of the 48V Belt Starter Generator and re‑position or replace the pipe if required.

records.concern: TSI2026-01 FRONT BRAKE CALIPER MALFUNCTIONING
records.defect: Due to a malfunction of the front brake caliper the caliper piston is unable to move back fully to its rest position after releasing the brake lever. In the event of problems brake drag could occur. This could lead to a loss of control of the vehicle.
records.remedy: Affected units must have Front brake caliper and Master Cylinder replaced with the countermeasure components specified.

records.concern: 9040TR TGM TGS TGX The tyres may be manufactured incorrectly. Michelin
records.defect: TGM TGS TGX: The tyres may be manufactured incorrectly. (Michelin)
records.remedy: Check the batch number on the tyres check the affected batches for cracks and replace faulty tyres.

records.concern: 2019 to 2021 Model Year Jaguar I-PACE Battery Fire or Smoke
records.defect: Some vehicles have experienced thermal overload in the high voltage traction battery pack which may present as smoke or fire. Since the installation of protective software field evidence has shown that there remains a risk of thermal overload in vehicles with battery packs manufactured up to the end of 2021 model year.
records.remedy: As an interim repair the vehicles will have software installed to restrict the maximum state of charge to 90% whilst a permanent remedy is developed.

records.concern: SLI disconnection to server “Here” not monitored.
records.defect: On affected vehicles the front camera module calibration may be incorrect which may lead to non-compliance with the speed limit indication system regulatory requirement.
records.remedy: Update the central vehicle management software.

records.concern: Front lower arm Bolts
records.defect: For certain vehicles and as a preventative measure there is concern involving the locking nuts in the area of the front suspension lower arm ball joints for where loosening of the fixings cannot be ruled out.
records.remedy: Check of the tightening of the front suspension lower arm ball joint nuts and if necessary replace both nuts

records.concern: Jaecoo 7 ICE (T1EJ) - Wiring Harness Interference Issue
records.defect: We have recently identified an issue concerning the Electronic Control Unit wiring harness clip in a specific batch of vehicles. Our investigation found that the ECU harness clip was not fully engaged during the assembly process. The incomplete engagement of the ECU harness clip may lead to engine warning light and an unexpected engine stall while the vehicle is in motion thereby increasing the risk of a crash.
records.remedy: ​​For vehicles within the risk scope a recall will be initiated and provide free inspection and repair for all affected vehicles. The solution includes checking and ensuring the correct installation of the harness fastener and replacing any worn harness if necessary.​

records.concern: 2018-2022 Jeep Wrangler Check Engine Malfunction Indicator Lamp Incorrect operation and warning
records.defect: On affected vehicles the Malfunction Indicator Lamp (MIL) may not function as intended in the Instrument Panel Cluster (IPC). This condition will not affect emissions. However in the event of an emission issue that would require illumination of the MIL the driver may not be alerted due to the MIL not illuminating.
records.remedy: Install updated software.

records.concern: Replace the Engine Starter Motor
records.defect: The Safety Recall relates to the engine starter motor. The fault relates to the RSW22 starter RWT (reinforced water tightness). It was found that with RWT starters an increased abrasion of the magnetic contact can cause the growth of deposits at the lowest point of the relay interior. This in turn may increase the relay contact resistance resulting in false starts or even causing short circuits and possibly a thermal reaction. In case of a short circuit the possibility of a thermal event cannot be excluded. This may happen while attempting to start the vehicle or while driving due to vibrations causing a short circuit due to moving deposits.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the starter motor will be replaced with a variant by another supplier with a different design. Until the repair has been completed it is recommended to not leave the vehicle running unattended after starting the engine.

records.concern: 25SC5 Transit Automatic Transmission Wiring Damage
records.defect: On affected vehicles insufficient clearance between the wiring harness and transmission housing may lead to damaged wiring or chafing which can cause a short circuit and arcing increasing the risk of fire.
records.remedy: Check the wiring harness. Repair reposition and secure if necessary. .

records.concern: Replacing Takata driver airbag
records.defect: The safety of our customers and the reliability and long-term service life of our models represent our top priority. For this reason Audi conducts programmes to constantly monitor the quality of its products.Extensive analyses have found that the gas generator housing for your vehicle’s front airbag may in extremely rare cases be overloaded and even burst when the front airbag is triggered. If this were to happen small metal parts could become dislodged from the housing and potentially cause life-threatening injury to a vehicle occupant.
records.remedy: As a precautionary safety measure it is necessary to replace the airbag unit. The work required will take approximately two hours and will of course be performed free of charge. Please note for organisational reasons the Audi Centre may require your vehicle for longer they will advise you of this at the point of booking.

records.concern: 26S06 Capri Explorer - Torque Inspection On Various Joints
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have rear axle joints that were not tightened to the specified torque during manufacturing.
records.remedy: Check toe and camber links to subframe torques and if not according to specification change the fixings. A check of wheel alignment is also required.

records.concern: LGTV 201 Pop-Up Spoiler Fixing
records.defect: On affected vehicles there is the possibility for detachment of the front high level spoiler.
records.remedy: Install additional fixings.

records.concern: C0507 – IRMU & EMC FILTER REPLACE
records.defect: On affected vehicles there is a risk of electric shock if the AC charging inlet socket (or the power cable to external equipment) is severely damaged and you touch an exposed electrical conducting part and at the same time touch the chassis or other earth connected part of the vehicle.
records.remedy: The insulation monitoring device (IMD) will be replaced by an upgraded version a residual current device (RCPF sensor) will be installed inside the insulation resistance measurement unit and software updated. If necessary some vehicles will have the EMC filter reinstalled.

records.concern: Seat backrest frame cover
records.defect: Škoda Auto has discovered that there is a risk with the Kodiaq model from a limited production period that the edge of the inner frame of the front seats may compromise the integrity of the side airbag when activated. This situation may reduce the protective effect of the side airbag which could result in an increased risk of injury to passengers in the event of an accident.For safety reasons your vehicle must be repaired. We strongly recommend that you contact an authorized Škoda service center as soon as possible to arrange a repair date. In the first instance we ask that you contact your local ŠKODA authorised repairer as soon as possible to make an appointment. The ŠKODA authorised repairer closest to you can be found on https://tools.skoda.co.uk/find-a-retailer
records.remedy: The vehicle will be fitted with sharp edge protection for the inner frame of the front seats to prevent damage to the integrity of the side airbag when it is deployed.

records.concern: Removal of alternator to main harness connector
records.defect: On affected vehicles under specific environmental conditions a localised high impedance area can occur within the connector leading to high current though small contact areas. This can lead to excessive heat causing the connector to deform. In this event the alternator may not continue to provide energy to the system which may lead to a low battery warning and cause the bike to power off as well as potential thermal/degradation concerns.
records.remedy: Removal of Alternator to Main Harness Connector.

records.concern: Hopper Rear Door Cylinder Pin
records.defect: Occasion has arisen where the pin securing the hydraulic rear door cylinder has failed owing to corrosion and seizing of the pin causing the door to drop to its vertical position if the door is in an open position.
records.remedy: The pin must be replaced by a revised pin made of a high strength high hardness corrosion resistant stainless steel.

records.concern: CR311 Replacement of rigid duct for rear brake hose
records.defect: Potential malfunction of the rear brake.
records.remedy: Replacement of rigid duct for rear brake hose located on the swinging arm. Background: To further improve the thermal protection of the rear braking system thereby reducing exposure to heat from the rear bank exhaust manifold a new elongated rigid duct complete with a specific heat reflective sleeve has been designed and introduced for the rear brake hose. The heat reflective sleeve must be intact and left in place during the upgrade. This CR311 replaces and cancels the CR285. Bikes already updated with the CR285: must ALSO perform this new upgrade. Bikes not yet updated with the CR285: must ONLY perform this upgrade.

records.concern: Vans circuit brake pipe
records.defect: During drilling to install the seatbelt mast base plate the drill may penetrate too far and damage the brake hoses under the floor.
records.remedy: Carry out a check of the brake circuit pipe situated vertically to the belt mast attachment (potentially behind the thermal protection plate). Repair if necessary

records.concern: Engine Management System (EMS) software Update
records.defect: On affected vehicles the Engine Management System (EMS) Indicator Diagnostic Trouble Code (IDTC) may not update correctly.
records.remedy: Install updated software.

records.concern: Fiat Professional 2025 Doblo and Scudo. Fuel injection common rail. Fuel leak
records.defect: On affected vehicles a non-conformity issue with the fuel injection common rail may lead to a loosening of the nut and a potential fuel leak.
records.remedy: Check the fuel injection common rail and if necessary replace the rail and high-pressure fuel pipes.

records.concern: Potential defect on fuel return pipes on certain Toyota Proace Max
records.defect: For certain vehicles the fuel return pipe was produced in an out-of-specification condition in which certain rubber hose sections may not have been properly vulcanized. This could weaken the connections with other parts and potentially lead to fuel leakage.
records.remedy: Inspect and replace the fuel return pipe if necessary.

records.concern: RWT (reinforced water tightness) starter on Toyota 4-cylinder GR Supra
records.defect: For affected vehicles due to unexpected wear on an internal component the starter motor may not function properly. In some cases this could lead to a non-starting engine or in extreme cases cause a thermal event or fire when attempting to start the engine or while driving.
records.remedy: Replacement of the Starter motor.

records.concern: 2020-2025 Jeep Wrangler and 2022-2026 Jeep Grand Cherokee PHEV vehicles. High voltage battery.
records.defect: On affected vehicles the High Voltage (HV) battery may have been built with a battery pack which contains cells which are susceptible to separator damage which combined with other complex interactions within the cells may lead to a vehicle fire.
records.remedy: Reprogram the battery pack control module with modified software and check and if necessary replace the HV Battery.

records.concern: Civic Wheel Steel Bushes Missing (Accessory)
records.defect: On affected vehicles the alloy steel bushes may be missing in all five positions of the alloy wheel. This may result in the wheel nuts falling off or in the worst-case scenario wheel detachment.
records.remedy: Inspect the wheels for the presence of bush and replace wheel(s) in case of missing bushes.

records.concern: Emergency open door warning software Update
records.defect: On affected vehicles the Emergency door buzzer does not work when the passenger door is opened using the emergency switch.
records.remedy: Install updated software.

records.concern: 25C84 Mach-E - SYNC Software Update
records.defect: On affected vehicles the software repair for previous recall 21C16 may not have been delivered properly and the underlying condition may still exist meaning the incorrect software could cause the eCall system to not work as intended.
records.remedy: Update the SYNC module software and perform an additional verification process to ensure the configuration has been installed correctly.

records.concern: 25C81 Puma - Instrument Panel Cluster Software Update
records.defect: On affected vehicles the software repair for previous recall 24C18 may not have been delivered properly and vehicles may still have an intermittent Instrument Panel Cluster (IPC) display issue.
records.remedy: Update the IPC software and perform an additional verification process to ensure the configuration has been installed correctly.

records.concern: 25C77 Focus Telematics Control Unit Software Update
records.defect: On affected vehicles the software repair for previous recall 20C22 may not have been delivered properly and the Telematics Control Unit (TCU) in these vehicles may disconnect from Ford’s Service Delivery Network and become unresponsive.
records.remedy: Update the TCU software and perform an additional verification process to ensure the configuration has been installed correctly.

records.concern: Fiat Professional 2025/2026 Ducato (290/295). Fuel pipe leak
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have been fitted with fuel return pipes not according to specification which can lead to a fuel leak.
records.remedy: Check the fuel return pipes and replace if necessary.

records.concern: Fiat Professional Scudo and Doblo. IVI software via OTA update.
records.defect: Affected vehicle may face a black screen on the Instrument Panel Cluster with several functions not available to view.
records.remedy: Update the In-Vehicle-Infotainment software via Over-the-Air.

records.concern: Alfa Romeo Giulia cable (wiring harness) branch
records.defect: On affected vehicles due to a production nonconformity the wiring harness leading to the headlamp ECU could become damaged by tyre interference with the wheel arch liner which could result in error messages being displayed and a loss of headlamp low beam functionality.
records.remedy: Inspect wiring harness and wheel arch liner for damage and repair or replace as necessary.

records.concern: SPORTSTER S UPPER TRIPLE CLAMP AND RECALL
records.defect: The upper triple clamp may fracture under extreme loading conditions. An upper triple clamp that fractures while the motorcycle is being operated could lead to a loss of control increasing the risk of a crash.
records.remedy: Inspection of the upper triple clamp to determine if an old revision or a casting anomaly is present. If a concern is present the upper triple clamp will be replaced.

records.concern: Steering Road Assemblies
records.defect: Affected components may not have been correctly heat-treated during production resulting in reduced durability of the ball pins which may increase the risk of a subsequent drag link separation. A complete breakage in the drag link could sever the connection between the steering rod and both vehicle wheels leading to a lack of steerability and potentially to an increased accident risk with personal injury.
records.remedy: Affected components will be replaced.

records.concern: 25C62 - Transit – Double Chassis Side Marker Lamps Missing
records.defect: Affected vehicles have been produced without the required front side marker lamps.
records.remedy: Remove the existing front door body side mouldings and replace with new body side mouldings that include the side marker lamps.

records.concern: Range Rover and Range Rover Sport Samsung PHEV Battery Cell Degradation
records.defect: A concern has been identified on certain Range Rover & Range Rover Sport PHEV (Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle) vehicles containing high-voltage batteries with cells manufactured between 11th and 12th April 2018. Cathode damage introduced during the cell folding process can lead to high time-in-service cell degradation.
records.remedy: Data will be extracted from vehicles then the high voltage traction battery pack will be replaced.

records.concern: Seat Recliner
records.defect: On affected vehicles equipped with manually operated front seats there is a potential issue on the front seats due to insufficient welding strength between the recliner and the lower bracket on the seat backrest which may compromise the backrest’s ability to provide optimal occupant protection in the event of an impact.
records.remedy: Inspect both front seats and install additional brackets as required.

records.concern: Primastar X82 Tyre Configuration
records.defect: For affected vehicles the tyre size has been incorrectly configured in some of the control units. In this condition the calculation of the vehicle speed for display is made using incorrect data. As a result the vehicle displays a calculated vehicle speed that is 2% lower than the actual speed of the vehicle.
records.remedy: Reconfigure the Body Control Module (BCM) Anti-Lock braking System (ABS) and Front Camera with the correct tyre size.

records.concern: 25C80 Transit - Body Control Module Software Update
records.defect: On affected vehicles the software repair for previous recall 25C80 may not have been delivered properly and incorrect Body Control Module (BCM) software may prevent the side parking lights from functioning as intended
records.remedy: Update the BCM software and perform an additional verification process to ensure the configuration has been installed correctly.

records.concern: 25C76 EcoSport - Powertrain Control Module Software Update
records.defect: On affected vehicles the software repair for previous recall 21C08 may not have been delivered properly and diagnostic equipment connected via the Onboard diagnostic port will not read out the long term fuel consumption and distance values as per required regulation.
records.remedy: Update the Powertrain Control Module and perform an additional verification process to ensure the configuration has been installed correctly.

records.concern: 25SF3 Puma Restraint Control Module Software
records.defect: On affected vehicles the software repair for previous recall 25SF3 may not have been delivered properly and may still have incorrect Restraint Control Module (RCM) software. If the incorrect software is installed the system will not display any warnings and the restraints system performance could be degraded in an accident increasing the risk of injury.
records.remedy: Update the RCM and perform an additional verification process to ensure the configuration has been installed correctly.

records.concern: 25C83 Mustang - Powertrain Control Module Software Update
records.defect: On affected vehicles the software repair for previous recall 20C06 may not have been delivered properly and the underlying condition may still exist. The condition may cause the Gear Shift Indication to recommend gear changes at intervals that do not meet the specification.
records.remedy: Update the Powertrain Control Module software and perform an additional verification process to ensure the configuration has been installed correctly.

records.concern: High-voltage modules replacement
records.defect: On affected vehicles it's possible a faulty module has been installed in the high-voltage battery which may cause either a loss of range a yellow warning lamp to light up or a risk of the battery overheating leading to a fire.
records.remedy: Check and replace the affected battery modules.

records.concern: 25C78 Transit Courier Tourneo Courier - Audio Front Control Module Software
records.defect: On affected vehicles the software repair for previous recall 24C06 may not have been delivered properly and certain warning chimes may not be audible.
records.remedy: Update the Audio Front Control Module software and perform an additional verification process to ensure the configuration has been installed correctly.

records.concern: Potential Loosening of Wheel Hub Nut
records.defect: Market feedback has identified a few limited instances of an improperly locked driveshaft nut that may cause wheel vibration and abnormal noise on Omoda 5 and E5 models.
records.remedy: To address this issue authorised dealers are required to inspect the driveshaft nut locking condition on all affected vehicles. Where any non conformity is identified corrective measures shall be undertaken in accordance with Omoda and Jaecoo UK Limited s technical instructions.

records.concern: Citroen C3 Front Camera Software versions update.
records.defect: Affected vehicles equipped with a multifunctional front camera module may face a non-compliance to regulatory requirements due to incorrect front camera module calibration.
records.remedy: Update the front camera module software and the vehicle software configuration.

records.concern: Potential defect of fuel supply rail on certain Toyota Proace and Proace City
records.defect: For certain vehicles equipped with diesel engines there is a possibility that you may experience fuel leakage from the common rail. As a result fuel leaking between the nut and the common rail cone may create fuel vapour and fuel flow towards the hot exhaust system with a risk of a thermal event.
records.remedy: Check and if required replacement of the common rail.

records.concern: Citroen Relay Fuel Pipe Leak
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have been fitted with fuel return pipes not according to specification which can lead to a fuel leak.
records.remedy: Check the fuel return pipes and replace if necessary.

records.concern: Peugeot Boxer Fuel Pipe Leak
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have been fitted with fuel return pipes not according to specification which can lead to a fuel leak.
records.remedy: Check the fuel return pipes and replace if necessary.

records.concern: Vauxhall Movano Fuel Pipe Leak
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have been fitted with fuel return pipes not according to specification which can lead to a fuel leak.
records.remedy: Check the fuel return pipes and replace if necessary.

records.concern: 25SE6 – Transit and Transit Custom – 12V Battery Venting
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have 12V batteries that have been incorrectly vented allowing any potential venting to be directed into the cabin.
records.remedy: Inspect the battery and replace if required. Fit a battery vent tube to expel any gases.

records.concern: Peugeot 3008 Wheel Bolt Tightening.
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have improperly tightened wheel nuts following a faulty rework.
records.remedy: Check the torque of the wheel nuts on all for wheels and re-tighten if necessary.

records.concern: TGS TGX with Euro 6c engine D2676LF. Renew the lower main bearing shells
records.defect: MAN - TGS TGX with D2676LF Euro 6c engine: Replace the lower main bearing shells this applies to vehicles identified where maintenance was critically exceeded this is to prevent engine damage and potential fire.
records.remedy: Replacement of the lower main-bearing shells.

records.concern: Interstar (XDD/XDE) Accelerator Pedal
records.defect: For certain vehicles the end-stop breaking force of the accelerator pedal is lower than the intended technical specification. This may lead to a rupture of the accelerator pedal assembly if the pedal is pressed vigorously.
records.remedy: Replacement of the accelerator pedal assembly.

records.concern: M0387 Silencer particulate filter insert gasket replace
records.defect: On affected vehicles there is a risk DPF bypass leakage can occur due to gasket assembly and material issues at the supplier. The bypass leakage can lead to excessive particle number emissions from the engine and after treatment system.
records.remedy: Remove DPF and fit an improved gasket.

records.concern: HV Battery
records.defect: On affected vehicles following charging there is a risk of an overheating High Voltage Battery Cell which could lead to a risk of fire.
records.remedy: Volvo Cars is confident that limiting the battery s maximum state of charge to 70% will eliminate the risk of overheating. Additionally we would advise the following precautions. Do not leave your vehicle unattended whilst charging within buildings or covered areas. If you see any vehicle warnings in the car or app during or after charging seek assistance. The HV Battery modules will be inspected and replaced.

records.concern: Citroen Cross carline Fuel injection common rail.
records.defect: On affected vehicles a non-conformity issue with the fuel injection common rail may lead to a loosening of the nut and a potential fuel leak.
records.remedy: Check the fuel injection common rail and if necessary replace the rail and high-pressure fuel pipes.

records.concern: Peugeot Cross carline Fuel Injection common rail.
records.defect: On affected vehicles a non-conformity issue with the fuel injection common rail may lead to a loosening of the nut and a potential fuel leak.
records.remedy: Check the fuel injection common rail and if necessary replace the rail and high-pressure fuel pipes.

records.concern: Vauxhall Cross carline Fuel Injection common rail
records.defect: On affected vehicles a non-conformity issue with the fuel injection common rail may lead to a loosening of the nut and a potential fuel leak.
records.remedy: Check the fuel injection common rail and if necessary replace the rail and high-pressure fuel pipes.

records.concern: SRL251215 – VER-RADBLE
records.defect: As part of our ongoing quality monitoring we have determined that on Actros 963 and eActros 983 vehicles the rear wheel arch cover on the front axle could fall off. A design-related plastic rib that is too high leads to a collision between the wheel arch cover and the fender. Due to the excessively high plastic rib on the rear wheel arch cover of the front axle this may be installed with preload and thus some fastening points may not be fully engaged. As a consequence the engaged fastening points of the wheel arch cover may fracture and the wheel arch cover (931 mm x 652 mm x 70 mm approx. 1.81 kg) may completely detach from the vehicle and fall off due to the dynamic load during driving operation. This may increase the risk of accidents for other road users.
records.remedy: As part of the recall campaign the excessively high plastic rib must be shortened on the potentially affected vehicles.

records.concern: Gear Change Pedal Bolt
records.defect: On affected motorcycles due to the proximity of the exhaust to the gear change pivot bolt radiant heat from the exhaust system increases the temperature of the gear change pivot bolt seat causing the painted surface to buckle and the bolt to loosen. In some cases the pivot bolt can fall off and the gear change pedal sags leaving the rider unable to change gear.
records.remedy: Remove paint from the Gear change pedal fastening seat surface and install a modified Gear change pedal pivot bolt and additional washer.

records.concern: 23-24M e:Ny1 Combination Meter Total Mileage Display Malfunction
records.defect: On affected vehicles after the voltage of the 12V battery drops when the vehicle is started after charging or replacing the battery the ODO distance displayed on the Meter is reset to 0 miles. This does not comply with the relevant regulations.
records.remedy: Install updated software.

records.concern: High Oil Consumption
records.defect: For affected machines the rate of engine oil consumption may deteriorate quickly. Continued riding without noticing that the amount of oil has decreased could result in reduced oil pressure that may lead to seizure.
records.remedy: The repair will be completed at a Honda European repair centre the motorcycle will have the piston and piston rings replaced or an engine replacement.

records.concern: SRPC2521 – Routing of transmission wiring harness
records.defect: Mercedes-Benz AG has determined that on certain E-Class AMG (214 platform) vehicles with 4-wheel-drive the routing of the transmission wiring harness might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: As a precautionary measure Mercedes-Benz AG via its Mercedes-Benz service partners will check the routing of the transmission wiring harness on the affected vehicles and rework it if necessary.

records.concern: The vehicle windscreen upper moulding may partially detach
records.defect: The vehicle windscreen upper moulding may partially detach. This may be noticeable as a rattling noise may be heard from the upper windscreen area whilst the vehicle is being driven.
records.remedy: The windshield upper moulding will be replaced to rectify this issue.

records.concern: ASB1 Recall campaign - Check wiring harness of the front seats and rework if necessary
records.defect: For affected vehicles there is a possibility that the wiring harness for the front seats has not been installed in accordance with specifications and the harness may be damaged by seat adjustment over the lifetime of the vehicle.
records.remedy: To prevent this the installation of the affected wiring harness is to be checked and if necessary reworked.

records.concern: Bentley Bentayga Hybrid – Software Update For HV Battery Management Controller (RE25/46 RD74)
records.defect: For certain vehicles a defect may be present in the cell modules of the 48Ah High Voltage Battery which could result in overheating during charging. Overheating of the battery cell modules during charging (or shortly afterwards) may lead to a thermal event.
records.remedy: Installation of new software into the Battery Management controller (BMC) to detect potential issues with the performance of the battery modules.

records.concern: In-Vehicle Infotainment ECU software update via OTA on certain Toyota Proace and Proace City
records.defect: For affected vehicles both displays (the multimedia screen and the instrument cluster) may turn completely black after ignition is turned ON due to a software bug. When this condition occurs the issue is permanent.
records.remedy: Accept and successfully install an Over the Air (OTA) update.

records.concern: Replace the Driver’s Airbag – Takata PSDI-5
records.defect: Affected vehicles may be fitted with a drivers airbag which may deploy with too much explosive force causing sharp metal fragments to be released into the cabin. It has the potential to fatally or seriously injure vehicle occupants.
records.remedy: Affected vehicles will have the airbag replaced.

records.concern: Land Rover Range Rover Evoque Inappropriate Passenger Airbag Deployment
records.defect: On 2021 – 2024 and certain 2020 and 2025 Model Year Range Rover Evoque vehicles during a passenger airbag deployment the airbag may tear as a result of improper folding of the airbag during the airbag assembly process.
records.remedy: Affected Vehicles will have the passenger airbag module and associated components replaced.

records.concern: C0500 – IRMU Replace
records.defect: The AC inlet socket and the power outlet for body builder equipment might be incorrectly energized. It happens because these two features are not fully electrically isolated from each other. Therefore in vehicles where AC or DC power outlets are installed there might be voltage with low leakage current inadvertently present inside the AC inlet socket when the power outlet is active. Also when AC charging there might be a voltage with low leakage current inadvertently present on the power outlet .
records.remedy: Inspection and replacement of the Insulation Resistance Monitoring (IRM) Junction box.

records.concern: TGS TGX with Euro 6c engine D2676LF: Renewing the lower main-bearing shells.
records.defect: MAN TGS TGX with Euro 6c engine D2676LF: Renewing the lower main-bearing shells.
records.remedy: Engine main bearing shell replacement

records.concern: TGS TGX with Euro 6c engine D2676LF: Customers who originally rejected measures 8235TW 8236TW or 8626TW are requested to have the lower main bearing shells renewed.
records.defect: MAN TGS TGX with Euro 6c engine D2676LF: Customers who originally rejected measures 8235TW 8236TW or 8626TW are requested to have the lower main bearing shells renewed.
records.remedy: Engine main bearing replacement

records.concern: Bolting of front seats and belt buckles
records.defect: Mercedes-Benz AG has determined that on certain CLA (174 platform) vehicles the bolting of the front seats and/or belt buckles might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: As a remedy Mercedes-Benz AG via its Mercedes-Benz service partners will rework the front seat and belt buckle bolting on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: SRPC2523 - Variant of 48V Wiring Harness
records.defect: Mercedes-Benz AG has determined that on certain CLA (178 platform) vehicles with 4-cylinder gasoline engine the 48V wiring harness might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: As a remedy Mercedes-Benz AG via its Mercedes-Benz service partners will check the wiring harness on the affected vehicles and rework it if necessary.

records.concern: Headlight Beam
records.defect: On affected motorcycles whilst riding there is a risk the headlamp may flicker and eventually shut off.
records.remedy: Replace the headlamp assembly with a modified part.

records.concern: Citroen Berlingo (K9) Wrong Wheel Bolts.
records.defect: On affected vehicles the incorrect wheel bolts may have been fitted which could result in loosening or loss of the bolts.
records.remedy: Check the correct bolts are fitted and replace if necessary.

records.concern: Peugeot Rifter/Partner (K9) Wrong wheel Bolts.
records.defect: On affected vehicles the incorrect wheel bolts may have been fitted which could result in loosening or loss of the bolts.
records.remedy: Check the correct bolts are fitted and replace if necessary.

records.concern: Vauxhall Combo (K9) Wrong Wheel bolts
records.defect: On affected vehicles the incorrect wheel bolts may have been fitted which could result in loosening or loss of the bolts.
records.remedy: Check the correct bolts are fitted and replace if necessary.

records.concern: Camera Re-routing
records.defect: On affected vehicles the cable for the Digital Video Recorder (DVR) and camera has been routed in front of the roof mounted passenger airbag.
records.remedy: Reroute the DVR and camera cables along the manufacturer's loom located behind the airbag unit.

records.concern: No AdBlue consumption is shown in the cluster.
records.defect: On affected vehicles due to a production nonconformity no AdBlue consumption is shown in the instrument cluster and therefore does not comply with the relevant regulations.
records.remedy: Activation of the Urea Dosing Module (UDM) check and if necessary replace the urea injector.

records.concern: C0515 – Accelerator pedal support replace
records.defect: For certain vehicles there is a concern involving the accelerator pedal for where breakage cannot be ruled out.
records.remedy: Replacement of the accelerator pedal assembly.

records.concern: Replace battery modules
records.defect: On affected vehicles a module in the high-voltage battery may not meet the manufacturer's quality standards. This could lead to a noticeable loss of range or to the yellow warning lamp coming on. Furthermore there is a risk of overheating within the high-voltage battery. Overheating can lead to a vehicle fire with a risk of severe or deadly injuries for the vehicle occupants.
records.remedy: Check and replace affected battery modules.

records.concern: Steering Box Mating Surfaces Contaminated with Anti-Corrosion Paint
records.defect: During anti-corrosion treatment the steering box mounting surfaces were not adequately masked. As a result anti-corrosion paint contaminated the mating surfaces leading to insufficient metal-to-metal contact when the steering box was installed. This can cause the steering box to loosen over time potentially affecting steering control.
records.remedy: Removed anti corrosion paint from mating surfaces.

records.concern: Rear Brake reservoir cap screw tightening
records.defect: For affected machines the tightening torque of the screws for fixing the rear brake reservoir tank cap was insufficient. If the motorcycle continues to be used in this condition the screw might be loosened.
records.remedy: Tighten the rear brake reservoir tank cap screws to the specified torque during factory assembly.

records.concern: Jeep Avenger 2025. Brake pedal
records.defect: On affected vehicles due to a production nonconformity there is a requirement to inspect the brake pedal bracket connection and if necessary perform a rework to eliminate any potential risk of brake pedal disengagement. In the event of brake pedal failure the Electronic Park Brake located on the centre console can be applied while driving to bring the vehicle to a controlled stop. Additionally when active the Automatic Emergency Braking system will intervene if it detects an imminent collision.
records.remedy: Check for the presence of the clip confirming correct assembly and reworking it if necessary.

records.concern: Citroen Spacetourer (K0) Berlingo (K9) IVI software via OTA update.
records.defect: Affected vehicle may face a black screen on the Instrument Panel Cluster with several functions not available to view.
records.remedy: Update the In-Vehicle-Infotainment software via Over-the-Air.

records.concern: Peugeot Traveller/Expert (K0)Rifter/Partner (K9) IVI s/w via OTA update.
records.defect: Affected vehicle may face a black screen on the Instrument Panel Cluster with several functions not available to view.
records.remedy: Update the In-Vehicle-Infotainment software via Over-the-Air.

records.concern: Vauxhall Vivaro (K0) Combo (K9) IVI software via OTA update.
records.defect: Affected vehicle may face a black screen on the Instrument Panel Cluster with several functions not available to view.
records.remedy: Update the In-Vehicle-Infotainment software via Over-the-Air.

records.concern: C0519 Front axle screws retightening/replace
records.defect: On affected vehicles there is a risk that screws for the front axle attachment might lose torque or come loose. It might lead to strange behaviour of the truck and noise and in worst case loss of steering control.
records.remedy: Check the torque level on the screws retorque and if necessary replace parts.

records.concern: CR310 Positioning of ABS fuses
records.defect: Affected motorcycles may contain a wiring harness supplied with an incorrect configuration involving the ABS fuses and/or their respective fuse holders being reversed. There is a risk of improper ABS operation during braking conditions that require its activation (e.g. in an emergency or on a slippery surface) which could lead to one of the wheels locking unintentionally.
records.remedy: Check the motorcycle both visually and with specialised diagnostic tools and to update it if required.

records.concern: Citroen C3 v5 Autonomous telematics box cannot connect to server
records.defect: On affected vehicles there may be a software bug in the Body Control Module (BCM) which prevents a connection to the server and affects the speed limit indication system.
records.remedy: Update the BCM software.

records.concern: Weld seam on rear axle brake mounting flange
records.defect: Mercedes-Benz AG has determined that on certain Sprinter 907 model vehicles with a gross vehicle weight of 5.0 tons a brake connection flange might not have been properly welded to the support tube of the rear axle.
records.remedy: As a remedy Mercedes-Benz AG via its Mercedes-Benz service partners will replace the rear axle on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: Title of Recall Replacement Side Stand Spring (Forged side stand)
records.defect: For affected machines it has been determined that engine vibrations may cause the side stand spring on forged side stands to break.
records.remedy: Replacement of the side stand spring and fit a rubber protector

records.concern: Takata Driver and/or Passenger Airbag Recall (Global VINs)
records.defect: Affected vehicles are already included in Safety Recalls within the markets they have previously resided in. The vehicles may be fitted with a driver and/or passenger airbag/s which if deployed may do so with excessive force causing sharp metal fragments to be released this may cause serious injury which could prove fatal to people in the vicinity.
records.remedy: Vehicles will have the affected airbags checked and if necessary replaced.

records.concern: Bracket for air conditioning rear
records.defect: On affected vehicles brackets with sharp edges were fitted to the rear air conditioning block. In the event of an accident when the side airbags are triggered there is a risk of damage from the sharp edges which could significantly affect the function of the airbag.
records.remedy: Replace the bracket for one without sharp edges.

records.concern: 2025 RAM 1500 Pickup. Front wheel bearing encoder ring
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have been built with damaged encoder rings. This may cause a loss of wheel speed signal (WSS) which may disable the Electronic Stability Control (ESC).
records.remedy: The repair involves an inspection and if necessary replace the front wheel bearing hub assembly/encoder ring.

records.concern: Hybrid battery management reprogramming
records.defect: On Touareg vehicles with hybrid drive systems and of a limited production period there may be deviations on the high-voltage battery system. A measure is necessary because on individual battery modules deviations with important technical parameters were established. Over the life of the vehicle these can cause a fault in the affected battery modules. As a result charging the high-voltage battery can cause a danger of fire with the risk of severe to life threatening injuries for persons in and/or outside of the vehicle as well as severe material damage. NOTE: Until the check of your vehicle has been completed we ask that you do not charge the high-voltage battery externally. In hybrid mode select the setting “battery hold” at a charge level of max. 50%. Also avoid pure electric driving.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the software in the control unit for hybrid battery management is updated

records.concern: Re – tightening of the crankcase fastening bolts
records.defect: On affected motorcycles the crankcase fastening bolts may have been over-tightened during production. This can cause seizure of the crankshaft main bearing leading to abnormal noise and engine stalling.
records.remedy: Check crankshaft main bearing and retighten the crankcase fastening bolts.

records.concern: Textar bi-metallic (two piece) brake disc
records.defect: Some brake discs within the aforementioned article numbers have not been manufactured in accordance with specifications. These defective brake discs pose a risk that the vehicle may skid when braking or experience a longer braking distance.
records.remedy: Replace defective discs

records.concern: Composition of window-airbag fabric
records.defect: Mercedes-Benz AG has determined that on certain CLA (174 platform) vehicles the composition of the window-airbag fabric might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: As a remedy Mercedes-Benz AG via its Mercedes-Benz service partners will replace the window-airbags on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: SRPC2517 - Software of driving assistance system
records.defect: Mercedes-Benz AG has determined that on certain CLA (174 platform) vehicles the software of the driving assistance system might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: As a remedy Mercedes-Benz AG via its Mercedes-Benz service partners will update the software of the driving assistance system on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: SRPC2518 - Routing of window-airbag wiring harness
records.defect: Mercedes-Benz AG has determined that on certain CLA (174 platform) vehicles the routing of a window-airbag wiring harness in the area of the D-pillar might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: As a remedy Mercedes-Benz AG via its Mercedes-Benz service partners will check the routing of the wiring harness on the affected vehicles and rework it if necessary.

records.concern: SRPC2516 - Mechanics of the seat belt buckle
records.defect: Mercedes-Benz AG has determined that on certain CLA (174 platform) vehicles the belt buckles of the driver and passenger seats might not meet specifications respectively.
records.remedy: As a remedy Mercedes-Benz AG via its Mercedes-Benz service partners will replace the seat belt buckles on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: Combination Meter Reprogramming or Replacement – Early Notification
records.defect: On affected vehicles equipped with a combination meter system where various information is displayed (warning and indicator lights vehicle gauges messages etc.) due to improper programming the memory device within the combination meter can deteriorate. If this occurs the monitor will not be displayed after IG-ON and will remain in this state permanently. Driving without speedometer and any warning may result in an increased risk of an accident in certain driving conditions.
records.remedy: For Across (PHEV) models check and install modified software or if necessary replace the combination meter. For Swace models install modified software.

records.concern: Programming Control Units (Steering Gear)
records.defect: A quality check has revealed a potential issue with the steering gear software program which monitors the function of two sensors and compares the signals. In the vehicles concerned due to an error in the software the failure of a sensor may not always be detected correctly. When a failure has been detected correctly the driver is notified of it by a Check Control message on the Central Display and minimal change to steering feel.
records.remedy: To ensure your vehicle is in perfect working order we would like to program the vehicles control units. This work will be free of charge.

records.concern: Vauxhall Combo (K9) Headlamp Height Level Sensor
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have the Headlamp Height Level sensor fitted with incorrect orientation causing the Headlamp beam to be aimed too low and does not adjust as it should.
records.remedy: Check the Height Level Sensor for correct assembly and replace if necessary.

records.concern: 25S92 Mustang - Potential Seat Belt Anchor Pretensioner Issue
records.defect: Affected vehicles may experience corrosion that can weaken or detach the seatbelt anchor pretensioner cables for both front seats. A corroded pretensioner cable may not adequately restrain an occupant in a crash.
records.remedy: Replacement parts are not yet available. If corrosion is detected dealers will provide the affected customer with a rental car until replacement seat belt pretensioner parts are available to be installed.

records.concern: Engine Control Module calibration Low In-Use Performance-Ratio
records.defect: On affected vehicles there is a requirement to update the Engine Control Module (ECM) calibration due to a production non-conformity and not fulfilling emission regulatory requirements.
records.remedy: Update the ECM software calibration

records.concern: Title of Recall Voluntary recall of Yokohama truck tyre
records.defect: The affected tyres may have been manufactured with irregular geometry in the sidewall (shoulder) area of the tyre. Under certain circumstances this irregular geometry may lead to a sidewall crack at the shoulder area which may cause air loss leading to a risk of accident.
records.remedy: Replacement of affected tyres

records.concern: Abarth 600E BEV. Brake pedal

Additionally when active the Automatic Emergency Braking system will intervene if it detects an imminent collision.
records.remedy: The permanent repair involves the Abarth dealer checking for the presence of the clip confirming correct assembly and reworking it if necessary in accordance with Abarth reference F53F.

records.concern: Alfa Romeo Junior BEV and MHEV. Brake pedal
records.defect: On a number of Alfa Romeo Junior vehicles due to a production nonconformity there is a requirement to inspect the brake pedal bracket connection and if necessary perform a rework to eliminate any potential risk of brake pedal disengagement In the event of brake pedal failure the Electronic Park Brake located on the centre console can be applied while driving to bring the vehicle to a controlled stop.
