records.remedy: The permanent repair involves the Alfa Romeo dealer checking for the presence of the clip confirming correct assembly and reworking it if necessary in accordance with Alfa Romeo reference F53E .

records.concern: Fiat 600 BEV and MHEV. Brake pedal
records.defect: On a number of Fiat 600 vehicles due to a production nonconformity there is a requirement to inspect the brake pedal bracket connection and if necessary perform a rework to eliminate any potential risk of brake pedal disengagement In the event of brake pedal failure the Electronic Park Brake located on the centre console can be applied while driving to bring the vehicle to a controlled stop. Additionally when active the Automatic Emergency Braking system will intervene if it detects an imminent collision.
records.remedy: The permanent repair involves the Fiat dealer checking for the presence of the clip confirming correct assembly and reworking it if necessary in accordance with Fiat reference F53D.

records.concern: Mustang Brake Fluid Level Indicator Update
records.defect: The software repair for a previous recall may not have been properly delivered to the vehicle. The underlying noncompliance specified in the recall still exists and customers will not receive a warning if there is a reduction in brake fluid below the recommended level in the master cylinder brake fluid reservoir.
records.remedy: Update the Body Controller Module (BCM) software and / or replace it if necessary.

records.concern: Morbidelli T125X
records.defect: For affected machines there is a potential defect concerning some welds on the frame which may have insufficient strength. Riding on uneven road surfaces or through potholes may result in cracks forming causing the welded area to break without warning and the lower cradle to separate from the steering head and the frame to collapse.
records.remedy: ​​All affected machines will be fitted with a new updated replacement frame.​

records.concern: Injection Computer Software Update
records.defect: For certain vehicles reprogramming of the injection computer is required. Without this software update it could lead to breakdown or the vehicle failing to start.
records.remedy: Reprogramme the injection computer

records.concern: Accelerator Pedal Assembley
records.defect: For certain vehicles the end-stop breaking force of the accelerator pedal is lower than the intended technical specification. This may lead to a rupture of the accelerator pedal assembly if the pedal is pressed vigorously.
records.remedy: Replacement of the accelerator pedal assembly.

records.concern: Stromer ST3 ST5 and ST7 Bicycles fitted with WREN Front Suspension Forks (2512-0123)
records.defect: The front fork steer tube can fatigue prematurely and crack break or separate during use. As a result the rider may lose control of their bike posing a fall and injury hazard.
records.remedy: Replace the suspension fork.

records.concern: 25SD2 – E-Transit Custom – HV Battery Bolts Loose
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have High Voltage (HV) battery bolts that are loose which over time could lead to a loss of motive power. .
records.remedy: Check the HV battery bolts for security and fitment and replace if necessary.

records.concern: Front seat belts
records.defect: On affected vehicles the front left seat bolts may not have been torqued according to specification which could reduce the occupant protection in an impact.
records.remedy: Re-torque front seat bolts.

records.concern: 25S99 - E-Transit - 12V Battery Venting
records.defect: Affected vehicles could experience venting of the 12 Volt batteries. Customers may experience one or more of acid smell or smell of rotten eggs in the cabin hissing sound the battery visibly venting gas or heat in the front seats.
records.remedy: Inspect the batteries and replace if necessary. Install a vent tube to the batteries and update the Power Control Module software.

records.concern: Security Guidance
records.defect: Jaguar Land Rover in conjunction with law enforcement and insurance bodies is aware of the increase in thefts of vehicles in specific geographical locations within the United Kingdom. There is no fault with Jaguar Land Rover's security systems and they continue to meet stringent automotive legislation. Jaguar Land Rover is offering owners guidance on how to maximise vehicle security and protect against theft
records.remedy: Vehicle registered keepers will be sent a security guidance letter only - there is no repair action.

records.concern: Vauxhall cross carline Driver’s Airbag - Takata
records.defect: On affected vehicles the chemicals in the Takata airbag inflators may deteriorate over time. This may cause the inflators to rupture with too much force in a crash leading to serious injury or death in a worst-case scenario.
records.remedy: Replace the driver airbag module.

records.concern: SRT374 - Software update for Parking Assist ECU on certain 2023MY-2025MY Solterra
records.defect: On affected vehicles the Parking Assist ECU software may cause (1) the rearview image to freeze briefly during the backing event if reverse is selected within a specific time after ignition is turned on; or (2) the rearview image not to display on the next ignition on if the ignition is turned on and off within a specific time
records.remedy: Parking Assist ECU software to be updated.

records.concern: Wheel hub and nut loose on Hilux
records.defect: For affected vehicles that previously had the chassis frame replaced in a special facility there is a possibility that some joints were not correctly tightened.
records.remedy: Retighten nuts and/or bolts in specific mounting or joint portions.

records.concern: Parking Assist ECU reprogram on multiple models
records.defect: For certain vehicles equipped with a Parking Assist ECU a component of the Panoramic View Monitor (PVM) system that displays the rear view image the software may cause the rear view image to freeze or not display
records.remedy: Reprogram the parking assist ECU.

records.concern: Parking Assist ECU reprogram on multiple models

records.remedy: Reprogram the parking assist ECU.

records.concern: Program control units (CoC documents)

records.remedy: To ensure your vehicle is in perfect working order we would like to program the control units to adapt the vehicle's software level to the CoC documents. as soon as possible. Naturally this work will be free of charge.

records.concern: Software Update Engine Control Unit
records.defect: For certain machines there is an increased risk of stalling at low revs for where loss of power cannot be ruled out.
records.remedy: Software update to the engine control unit (ECU).

records.defect: For certain machines there is an increased risk of stalling at low revs for where loss of power cannot be ruled out.

records.defect: On certain 2021 to 2024 Model Year Jaguar E-PACE vehicles during a passenger airbag deployment the airbag may tear as a result of improper folding of the airbag during the airbag assembly process.
records.remedy: Affected Vehicles will have the passenger airbag module and associated components replaced.

records.concern: Ball Joint Bracket fixation.
records.defect: On affected vehicles the front left and right control arm ball-joint bracket screws are at risk of fracture which could affect the vehicle's controllability.
records.remedy: Inspect the marking on the left and right front ball-joint bracket and change if necessary.

records.concern: Vauxhall Grandland Ball joint bracket fixation.
records.defect: On affected vehicles the front left and right control arm ball-joint bracket screws are at risk of fracture which could affect the vehicle's controllability.
records.remedy: Inspect the marking on the left and right front ball-joint bracket and change if necessary.

records.concern: ​C0506 - HPCU SW update. FHE/FME/FMLE (4) (Phase 1) / C0520 IRMU replace. FHE/FME (4) (Phase 2) / C0521 IRMU replace FHE/FME/FMLE (4) / FLE/FEE (3) (Phase 3)​
records.defect: On affected vehicles the AC inlet socket and the power outlet for body builder equipment might be incorrectly energized. Therefore in vehicles where AC or DC power outlets are installed there might be voltage with low leakage current inadvertently present inside the AC inlet socket when the power outlet is active. records.concern: Puma Gen-E & E-Transit Courier: Rear eDrum brake Bolt Inspection
records.defect: On affected vehicles rear brake drums (eDrums) may be missing the reaction block bolts or fitted with reaction block bolts which were not tightened correctly. Missing or loose bolts could result in wheel lock or a brake fluid leak.
records.remedy: Check the torque on the rear brake eDrum bolts and if any of the bolts are missing install new ones.

records.concern: Engine control unit reprogramming due to IUPR calculation problem on certain Toyota Proace and Proace Verso models
records.defect: For certain vehicles there is an error in the specific software calibrations of the Engine Control Unit. In certain cases this condition may result in a delayed activation of the malfunction indicator (MIL) allowing the vehicle to operate with tailpipe emissions exceeding limits before the MIL is triggered
records.remedy: Update to the software calibration of the Engine electronic control unit (ECU).

records.concern: Combination Meter Reprogramming on Multiple Models (Lexus)
records.defect: For certain vehicles equipped with the combination meter system (where various information is displayed) that due to an improper programming of the combination meter unnecessarily repetitive data is written to a memory device. This may cause the memory device to deteriorate and the monitor to not display during the meter at start up and remain in this state permanently.
records.remedy: Reprogram or replace the combination meter.

records.concern: Combination Meter Reprogramming on Multiple Models

records.concern: Citroen C3 C3 Aircross Brake Pedal Bracket Connection.

records.concern: Vauxhall Frontera Brake Pedal Bracket Connection.
records.defect: On affected vehicles there may be an insufficient brake pedal bracket connection due to a missing or incorrectly assembled pin. If the pin falls out the brake pedal will potentially disengage.

records.concern: 25SC2 Focus Transit Courier - Potential leak from fuel rail
records.defect: Affected vehicles may experience a fuel leak from the fuel rail due to a manufacturing defect.
records.remedy: Install a new fuel rail.

records.concern: JEEP GRAND CHEROKEE PHEV 2022-2026 HYBRID CONTROL PROCESSOR SOFTWARE UPDATE
records.defect: On a number of 2022-2026 Jeep Grand Cherokee Plug-In Hybrid Electric Vehicles (PHEV) due to a software error the Hybrid Control Processor (HCP) may incorrectly interpret a signal from the Battery Pack Control Module (BPCM). This condition can cause a loss of drive power. An unexpected loss of drive power can cause a vehicle crash without prior warning.
records.remedy: The permanent repair is your dealer will reprogram the BPCM with updated software.

records.concern: Ariya (FE0) Headlamp

records.concern: 2014-2019 RAM 1500 Pickup 3.0L diesel. Loss of crankshaft reference position. Software update.

records.concern: 2014-2020 Jeep Grand Cherokee 3.0L diesel. Loss of crankshaft reference position. Software update.

records.concern: Replacing the fuel tank cap seal

records.concern: Replacing the fuel tank cap seal

records.concern: A risk of loss of Steering
records.defect: For certain vehicles there is a risk of rupture of the steering rack when subjected to high mechanical stress which could lead to loss of control and risk of an accident. Customers are requested to immediately stop driving their vehicles.
records.remedy: Replacement of the steering rack.

records.concern: The vehicle charge port door outer panel may detach
records.defect: The vehicle charge port door outer panel may have insufficient engagement between the outer panel retaining hooks and the charging port door increasing the risk of detachment during operation.
records.remedy: To rectify this issue the charge port door outer panel assembly will be adhered as a permanent solution.

records.concern: Driver-side Airbag (DAB) Inflator may not deploy as intended
records.defect: Driver-side Airbag (DAB) Inflator may not deploy as intended. This may result in a component entering into the vehicle occupant compartment.

records.concern: Possibility for front seat to delatch in a front collision.

records.concern: Exterior door handle software update

records.concern: Belt buckle rivet missing
records.defect: On affected vehicles an important connection in the seat belt buckle may not have been produced correctly during the assembly process.

records.concern: Title of Recall SRL250925 – Change parameters in front radar sensor (RDF) control unit – RDF-HOE
records.defect: As part of our continuous quality monitoring we have identified that the vehicle-specific RDF3 (radar front end) installation height value has not been parameterized in Econic 956 Actros 963 Arocs 964 Atego 967 and eActros 983 model vehicles. Instead of the vehicle-specific installation height value a substitute value of 1 m has been entered. The substitute value is always higher than the actual installation situation. RDF3 is responsible for object recognition detecting clearance as well as close and long-range processing. It can also detect the ability to drive under and over objects which enables a radar-only reaction as part of the ABA functionality. Since the sensor value is parameterized higher than the actual installation height trucks ahead may not be detected particularly on inclines. This may lead to the fact that automatic braking by the ABA may not being triggered. Furthermore incorrect parameterization may lead to objects on the ground such as tracks manhole covers etc. being erroneously detected as obstacles causing ABA to brake the vehicle. This may increase the risk of accident.
records.remedy: As a permanent measure we wish to determine the installation height of the RDF3 manually and parameterize the determined value in potentially affected vehicles as part of this recall campaign.

records.concern: SRL250829 – Replace front axle springs – 2BLAFEVA
records.defect: As part of our continuous quality monitoring we have found that the leaf springs of the front axle could break on Actros 963 vehicles. The cause of the breakage may be edge corrosion due to insufficient descaling or surface defects during the rolling process. Each of the two fault profiles can cause a fracture independently of the other. The defective part analysis indicates that edge corrosion may result from scale residues not fully removed during the supplier's production run. Additionally the fault profile reveals that surface defects occurring during the rolling process—specifically near the edge—coincide with the initiation of breakage which is attributed to system malfunctions at the supplier's end. The progressive edge corrosion or the surface defects from the rolling process can lead to material fatigue in the affected area. Failure of the component or breakage at the heavily stressed points of the lower leaf spring could be the consequence. Partial component loss during driving operation cannot be ruled out. The size of a potentially lost leaf spring part depends on the individual fracture pattern. This can increase the risk of an accident.
records.remedy: In the scope of the recall campaign both leaf springs of the front axle must be replaced on the potentially affected vehicles as a precautionary measure.

records.concern: SRL250617 – Check electrical connection of the electric power steering pump for trailing axle – SCHKAEHPS2
records.defect: A thermal reaction may occur at the battery connection bolts of the electronically controlled power steering pump (EHPS (Electrohydraulic Power Steering)) of the trailing axle on vehicles of models eActros 983 and eEconic 956. The two battery connection points of the electronically controlled power steering pump of the trailing axle are located at the bottom in the installation position and are provided with a cover cap to protect against contact. Rain and splash water can collect in the cover cap. The water can no longer drain off due to missing drain holes. Because the battery connection points are standing in water electrochemical corrosion occurs that decomposes the bolts beyond the usual surface corrosion of the components. As a result of the corroded contact surface the transitional resistance at the terminal stud to the battery line increases and energy is released in the form of heat. Depending on the intensity and duration of the thermal reaction the battery lines and the circuit board of the electronically controlled power steering pump could ignite and in an unfavourable case flames could spread to surrounding components or the vehicle. This may increase the risk of fire. Failure of the electronically controlled power steering pump of the trailing axle has only minor effects on driving operation. There are only restrictions when reversing which however correspond to the operation of a non-steerable trailing axle. The turning circle could also be increased. However this is hardly noticeable to the driver.
records.remedy: As part of the recall campaign the cover caps on the affected vehicles must be replaced with cover caps with a water drain hole and the battery terminal studs must be cleaned and sealed with corrosion protection spray.

records.concern: 25S79 Explorer Capri - Ground Connection Inspection
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have a ground connection where the correct tightening torque was not achieved during manufacturing. This may lead to the malfunction of specific features engine stalling and arcing with an increased risk of localised melting.
records.remedy: Inspect the ground connection and if necessary tighten the nut to the correct specification.

records.concern: SK350LC-11E Stage-V 6HK1 engine exhaust pipe crack
records.defect: For affected excavators equipped with ISUZU Stage-V 6HK1 engine the exhaust pipe between engines turbocharger and after treatment system might be cracked due to poor durability.
records.remedy: Replacement of the exhaust pipe.

records.concern: Range Rover (L405) Front Suspension Knuckle Crack – Incorrect Repair
records.defect: The manufacturer identified that on a small number of vehicles the JLR N759 safety recall repair procedure had not been carried out correctly. The suspension knuckles had not been replaced in all cases where the repair instruction directed a replacement leaving the defect present on the vehicles.
records.remedy: Both front suspension knuckles will be inspected for the presence of any cracks. Where no crack is present and where available a retaining bracket will be fitted to the joint. Where cracks are found or a bracket is not available the front suspension knuckle will be replaced.

records.concern: SRX2502 – Variant of driver's airbag
records.defect: Mercedes-Benz AG has determined that on certain Vito/Viano (639 platform) vehicles an airbag module from Takata might have been installed during a driver airbag replacement.
records.remedy: As a remedy Mercedes-Benz AG via its Mercedes-Benz service partners will check the airbag on the affected vehicles and replace it if necessary.

records.concern: SRX2501 – Variant of driver's airbag
records.defect: Mercedes-Benz AG has determined that on certain Vito/Viano (639 platform) vehicles an airbag module from Takata might have been installed during a driver airbag replacement.
records.remedy: As a remedy Mercedes-Benz AG via its Mercedes-Benz service partners will checkthe airbag on the affected vehicles and replace it if necessary.

records.concern: 25S39 Ranger - Potential Camshaft Sprocket Failure
records.defect: On affected vehicles the left-side camshaft sprocket on the engine could fracture due to a manufacturing defect resulting in an engine stall.
records.remedy: Inspect the left-side camshaft sprocket and replace if necessary.

records.concern: Electric Power Inverter Converter B (EPICB) Software Update
records.defect: On affected vehicles due to a software issue in the Electric Power Inverter Converter B (EPICB) it is possible that as the high voltage battery depletes during driving in EV mode the engine may not restart when the state of charge reduces and the vehicle will therefore lose power. There will not be an associated warning to the driver.
records.remedy: Vehicle’s software to be updated in the Electric Power Inverter Converter B (EPICB) and other modules as required to ensure complete cross-module integration. In parallel an over-the-air update will be rolled out and customers who successfully complete this update will not need to visit a retailer.

records.concern: Electric Power Inverter Converter B (EPICB) Software Update
records.defect: On affected vehicles due to a software issue in the Electric Power Inverter Converter B (EPICB) it is possible that as the high voltage battery depletes during driving in EV mode the engine may not restart when the state of charge reduces and the vehicle will therefore lose power. There will not be an associated warning to the driver.
records.remedy: Vehicle’s software to be updated in the Electric Power Inverter Converter B (EPICB) and other modules as required to ensure complete cross-module integration. In parallel an over-the-air update will be rolled out and customers who successfully complete this update will not need to visit a retailer.

records.concern: Check driver's airbag replace if necessary
records.defect: The manufacturer has determined that on affected vehicles a potentially defective airbag module from Takata might have been installed during a driver-airbag replacement. In the event of an accident with airbag deployment the airbag may not provide any restraining effect and there could be a risk of injury to the occupants from separating inflator parts.
records.remedy: Check the airbag on the affected vehicles and replace it if necessary.

records.concern: Check driver's airbag replace if necessary
records.defect: The manufacturer has determined that on affected vehicles a potentially defective airbag module from Takata might have been installed during a driver-airbag replacement. In the event of an accident with airbag deployment the airbag may not provide any restraining effect and there could be a risk of injury to the occupants from separating inflator parts.
records.remedy: Check the airbag on the affected vehicles and replace it if necessary.

records.concern: Fixation of the steering gearbox on the frame
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have been built with a fixation of the steering gearbox on the frame which can get loose due to an incorrect tightening torque.
records.remedy: Inspection of the steering gearbox fixation and a potential retightening or a substitution of the steering gearbox including the support and screws.

records.concern: Citroen Dispatch (K0) Lower Control Arm Bushing
records.defect: On affected vehicles the bolts on the front wishbone may break due to corrosion.
records.remedy: Replace the bolts and bushings on both sides of the front wishbone.

records.concern: Peugeot Expert (K0) Lower Control Arm Bushing
records.defect: On affected vehicles the bolts on the front wishbone may break due to corrosion.
records.remedy: Replace the bolts and bushings on both sides of the front wishbone.

records.concern: Vauxhall Vivaro (K0) Lower Control Arm Bushing.
records.defect: On affected vehicles the bolts on the front wishbone may break due to corrosion.
records.remedy: Replace the bolts and bushings on both sides of the front wishbone.

records.defect: On affected vehicles a screw fixture may come into contact with a section of the vehicles gas pipe which can lead to chaffing and a possible gas leak.
records.remedy: Affected vehicles will have a re-routed gas pipe fitted.

records.concern: Wiper Wiring Harness MINI F65 F66 F67
records.defect: On affected vehicles the windscreen wiper wiring harness may be routed incorrectly and can be damaged by contact with the windscreen wiper mechanism.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the wiper wiring harness will be inspected and re-routed if required. If any damaged wires are discovered these will be repaired and the control unit will be replaced.

records.concern: Citroen C4 Citroen DS5 Driver Airbag (Takata)
records.defect: On affected vehicles the Takata airbag inflators may deteriorate over time. This may cause some inflators to rupture with too much force in a crash capable of causing serious injury or death in a worst-case scenario.
records.remedy: Replace Driver Airbag module. You are advised not to drive the vehicle.

records.concern: SRL250714 – Retrofit screws of cover caps in rubber profile of side trim – ABD-KAP
records.defect: On affected vehicles the cover caps are plugged onto the retaining strip of the lower profile seal of the side trim. The catch lugs of the cover caps attached to the profile seals of the side trim frame may may break unnoticed during assembly and the cap may therefore only be inserted loosely. If a cover cap is lost the profile seal might wander and be lost from the vehicle.
records.remedy: Replace the plugged-in cover caps with screwed-on cover caps

records.concern: Updating of Airbag Node (NAB) software in compliance with Regulation UNECE R160
records.defect: For certain vehicles a fault within the EDR (Event Data Recorder) software on the NAB (Air Bag Node) ECU will lead to a non-compliance with UNECE R160. The fault has no impact on vehicle safety and the correct functioning of the NAB (Airbag Node) control unit.
records.remedy: Update of the NAB (Air Bag Node) ECU software

records.concern: 25S58 – Transit Custom PHEV and Explorer PHEV – Software update
records.defect: On affected vehicles the remedy software for a previous recall may not have been installed correctly. In the event of a high voltage battery cell internal short customers may experience a battery power off resulting in a loss of motive power with coasting and battery thermal venting potentially resulting in a vehicle fire.
records.remedy: Update the Battery Energy Control Module software. If a high voltage battery cell capacity anomaly is detected replace the high voltage battery pack.

records.concern: Citroen Berlingo Tyre Pressure Label
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have incorrect or missing information on the tyre pressure label.
records.remedy: Replace the tyre pressure label.

records.concern: Peugeot Partner Tyre Pressure Label
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have incorrect or missing information on the tyre pressure label.
records.remedy: Replace the tyre pressure label.

records.concern: Vauxhall Combo Tyre Pressure Label.
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have incorrect or missing information on the tyre pressure label.
records.remedy: Replace the tyre pressure label.

records.concern: TGS TGX bus/coach bus/coach chassis with Euro 6c engine D26: Renew oil filter lid.
records.defect: On affected vehicles the oil filter lid may be made from unstable material. This may enable unfiltered oil to enter into the clean oil side of the engine. This can lead to risk of a thermal event.
records.remedy: The oil filter lid will be replaced.

records.concern: Driver airbag inflator
records.defect: On affected vehicles the driver’s airbag inflator housing may rupture due to excessive internal pressure during normal airbag deployment events. An inflator rupture during airbag deployment events could result in metal fragments striking and potentially seriously injuring the vehicle occupant(s).
records.remedy: Replace the drivers airbag.

records.concern: Takata front drivers or passenger airbag replacement
records.defect: Urgent Safety Warning – Do Not Drive Your Vehicle Issue: The front airbag in your SEAT vehicle contains an ageing inflator propellant that may explode when deployed due to long-term exposure to heat and humidity. Risk: If the airbag inflator explodes metal fragments may be ejected causing life-threatening or fatal injuries to anyone in the vehicle. Immediate Action Required: Stop driving your vehicle immediately. Contact the SEAT Takata Stop Drive helpline at 0113 526 9646 (Monday to Friday 9:00am to 5:00pm) to arrange your recall service. Mobility assistance is available if needed.
records.remedy: For important safety reasons it is necessary to replace the inflator or driver/passenger seat’s airbag module of your vehicle.

records.concern: Checking front seat backrest frame/301
records.defect: On affected vehicles there is a possibility a faulty part was fitted in the backrest frame of the front seats.
records.remedy: Check the seat back rest and replace if necessary.

records.concern: Replacing the Cell Module of the High-Voltage Battery
records.defect: On affected vehicles the battery module frame may have been manufactured using too much force. In conjunction with swelling force of the battery this could lead to failure and a possible thermal event within the vehicles life time.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles the modules will be replaced.

records.concern: TGS TGX bus/coach bus/coach chassis with Euro 6c engine D26: Renew oil filter lid.
records.defect: On affected vehicles the oil filter lid may be made from unstable material. This may enable unfiltered oil to enter into the clean oil side of the engine. This can lead to risk of a thermal event.
records.remedy: The oil filter lid will be replaced.

records.concern: Takata drivers side front airbag
records.defect: On affected vehicles the propellant in the front airbag may deteriorate due to high humidity and temperature fluctuations. As a result in the event of an accident and airbag deployment fragments could detach from the generator housing and injure the vehicle occupants.
records.remedy: Replace the front airbag on the driver's side.

records.concern: DS Automobiles Fuel Pipe
records.defect: On affected vehicles there may be loose connections between a high-pressure fuel pipe and the engine fuel rail which potentially could lead to a leak and risk of fire.
records.remedy: Retighten the affected connections.

records.concern: Citroen Fuel Pipe
records.defect: On affected vehicles there there may be loose connections between a high-pressure fuel pipe and the engine fuel rail which potentially could lead to a leak and risk of fire.
records.remedy: Retighten the affected connections.

records.concern: Vauxhall Fuel Pipe
records.defect: On affected vehicles there there may be loose connections between a high-pressure fuel pipe and the engine fuel rail which potentially could lead to a leak and risk of fire.
records.remedy: Retighten the affected connections.

records.concern: Peugeot Fuel Pipe
records.defect: On affected vehicles there there may be loose connections between a high-pressure fuel pipe and the engine fuel rail which potentially could lead to a leak and risk of fire.
records.remedy: Retighten the affected connections.

records.concern: Checking the Threaded Connection of Grounding Cable PCU48
records.defect: On affected vehicles the ground connection cable on the 48V power supply control unit may not have been torqued to the correct specification.
records.remedy: Affected vehicles will have the ground connection checked and re-torqued. If required the relevant cable and Power Control Unit will be replaced.

records.concern: Checking the Threaded Connection of Grounding Cable PCU48
records.defect: On affected vehicles the ground connection cable on the 48V power supply control unit may not have been torqued to the correct specification.
records.remedy: Affected vehicles will have the ground connection checked and re-torqued. If required the relevant cable and Power Control Unit will be replaced.

records.concern: 25S51 Transit Custom – Passenger airbag replacement required
records.defect: On affected vehicles in the event of a crash that triggers the passenger airbag the inflator tube may rupture. The rupture can result in metal fragmentation damage to the airbag cushion complete loss of airbag functionality and an increased risk of injury or death.
records.remedy: Replace the passenger airbag.

records.concern: Recall of motorhomes due to possible brake line abrasion
records.defect: On affected vehicles there may be insufficient clearance between the rear brake pipe and the air suspension bellow.
records.remedy: Affected vehicles will have new brake pipe brackets fitted to increase the clearance and if necessary the brake pipes will be replaced.

records.concern: 8881TR TGL TGM TGS TGX . Inspect installation of universal joint of steering drive shaft
records.defect: On affected vehicles the universal steering joint may not be fully located onto the steering shaft.
records.remedy: Affected vehicles will be checked. Damaged components will be replaced if necessary and the steering shaft correctly installed.

records.concern: SV-RCL-025-017 FST Adventure Brake Line Inspection Recall
records.defect: Affected motorcycles may have been produced with the front brake hose from the Hydraulic Control Unit (HCU) to front calliper’s twisted 180° which restricts its flexibility. This may cause it to rub and damage the outer layers of the brake hose potentially leading to brake fluid leakage and possible loss of brake pressure.
records.remedy: Check and if necessary replace the front brake hose.

records.concern: Heating Ventilation and Air Conditioning (HVAC) blower motor inoperable
records.defect: On affected vehicles the Heating Ventilation and Air Conditioning (HVAC) blower motor may have been built with a damaged connector which could cause the blower motor to stop working which may result in decreased visibility.
records.remedy: Check and replace the HVAC blower motor if necessary.

records.concern: Peugeot 308 Seat belt fastening
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have been equipped with seat belt anchors not in line with regulatory requirements.
records.remedy: Reinforce the seatbelt anchorage on the 2nd seat row.

records.concern: MAN TGS TGX Bus/Coach Bus /Coach Chassis with EURO6 C Engine – Renew Oil Filter Lid.
records.defect: On affected vehicles the oil filter lid may be made from unstable material. This may enable unfiltered oil to enter into the clean oil side of the engine. This can lead to risk of a thermal event.
records.remedy: The oil filter lid will be replaced.

records.concern: SRC250624 – Check update software for the vehicle control unit (SSAM) RC2501
records.defect: On affected vehicles the frequency and synchronization tests of the control unit (SSAM) are overly sensitive this may cause the SSAM to reset unexpectedly. If such a fault occurs while the vehicle is in operation it could result in the failure of critical systems such as the headlights taillights turn indicators position lights licence plate lights and windscreen wipers.
records.remedy: Update vehicle control unit (SSAM) software.

records.concern: SRL250605 – Replace rear right and left side trim on fender RD-LA-BLE
records.defect: The rear wheel arch panel of the wheel arch cover on the front axle may not be fully engaged on Actros 963 vehicles. Due to incorrectly executed geometry by the supplier three out of five clips of the wheel arch panel could come loose. As a consequence the remaining correctly executed mounting clips and the lower screw point may fail and the wheel arch panel may detach completely from the vehicle and fall off. This may increase the risk of an accident for the following traffic.
records.remedy: As part of the recall campaign the wheel arch panels must be replaced on the potentially affected vehicles.

records.concern: SRL250603 – Replace right air suspension support on the front axle – GEWIK09T
records.defect: Daimler Truck AG was informed that the thread flanks of the right mounting support of the 9 t front axle bolted to the axle housing on Actros 963 and eActros 983 vehicles are not sufficiently formed. As a consequence the threaded connection of the right mounting support to the axle housing is not permanently ensured.
records.remedy: Replacement of mounting support.

records.concern: Passenger Airbag
records.defect: On affected vehicles there is a risk in the event of an accident that if the passenger airbag is activated the protective effect of the airbag may be reduced and the gas generator cover may rupture resulting in serious or fatal injuries.
records.remedy: Replace the passenger airbag. Whilst waiting for repair vehicle owners are advised to deactivate the passenger airbag according to the owner's manual and not to use the passenger seat during this time.

records.concern: Front belt webbing
records.defect: On Golf vehicles of a limited production period belt systems were fitted to front passenger seat that may not have been correctly attached to the anchoring point near the lower B pillar.
records.remedy: The anchoring point of the belt system on the front passenger seat is inspected and dependant on results seat belt may need replacing.

records.concern: Front belt webbing
records.defect: On Golf vehicles of a limited production period belt systems were fitted to front passenger seat that may not have been correctly attached to the anchoring point near the lower B pillar.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the anchoring point of the belt system on the front passenger seat is inspected and dependant on results seat belt may need replacing.

records.concern: ASA6 - Check the air suspension strut on the front axle and rework if necessary
records.defect: There is a possibility that a locking ring on the air-spring strut at the front left and right was not fitted according to specifications on the affected vehicles. If this is the case the locking ring on the upper side of the respective spring strut can loosen and air can thus escape from the air spring. As a result the driving characteristics may be impaired which increases the risk of an accident.
records.remedy: The locking ring on the air-spring strut at the front left and right must be checked and reworked depending on the test result

records.concern: 24B36 Transit - Chassis Inspection
records.defect: Ford constantly monitors production processes and vehicles in operation. While monitoring vehicles in operation we have become aware of a number of Transit Chassis vehicles which may require a strengthening plate to be fitted to the vehicle’s chassis. The strengthening plate is precautionary and will provide additional strength and durability for the life of the vehicle.
records.remedy: The Ford dealer will visually inspect the affected chassis section for any initial damage and will install a reinforcement plate to prevent any potential future deformation.

records.concern: DAM 08 Retightening the Crankcase Fastening Bolts
records.defect: The crankcase fastening bolts may have been over-tightened during production. This can cause seizure of the crankshaft main bearing leading to abnormal noise and engine stalling.
records.remedy: Check crankshaft main bearing and retighten the crankcase fastening bolts.

records.concern: 25S54 Kuga S-Max and Galaxy - Powertrain Control Module (PCM) Software Update
records.defect: Certain Kuga S-Max and Galaxy vehicles equipped with a 2.5L HEV/PHEV Engine may not have the remedy for Safety Recall 23S27 installed correctly but were recorded as having received the repair successfully. Because the correct software update may not have been installed on these vehicles the underlying condition specified in Safety Recall 23S27 potential under hood fire may still exist.
records.remedy: Dealers are to update the Powertrain Control Module (PCM) software.

records.concern: RP1063 PS3 Cable Harness Replacement
records.defect: On affected vehicles there is an issue with the inline connector that joins the bumper wiring harness and the engine bay harness. There is a risk of fluid ingress into the connector housing resulting in corrosion of the connector pins.
records.remedy: Replace the bumper wiring harness and the inline connector on the engine bay harness.

records.concern: 25S69 Explorer Capri - Rear Right Seatbelt Bracket Potential Spot Weld Missing
records.defect: Affected vehicles have been manufactured with a rear right seatbelt bracket that could potentially have a missing weld. The absence of the weld could compromise the integrity of the seatbelt system during an accident.
records.remedy: Install a nut and bolt to restore the integrity of the rear right seatbelt bracket.

records.concern: Peugeot 2008 BEV Motor Control Unit Software.
records.defect: On affected vehicles the Motor Control Unit does not communicate with the Body Control Unit. This may cause an immobiliser malfunction leading to a possible vehicle non-start and anti-theft protection not guaranteed.
records.remedy: Pair the Motor Control Unit with the Body Control Unit.

records.concern: DS Automobiles DV5R Engines Camshaft Chain
records.defect: Vehicles may be affected by premature wearing of the camshaft drive chain leading to abnormal noise or to a breakage of the chain in the worst case.
records.remedy: Update the software to improve oil pressure and reduce wear. Check the engine noise and replace the chain if required. If no problem found change the oil to one with higher viscosity and special anti-wear additives.

records.concern: Citroen DV5R Engines Camshaft Chain.
records.defect: Vehicles may be affected by premature wearing of the camshaft drive chain leading to abnormal noise or to a breakage of the chain in the worst case.
records.remedy: Update the software to improve oil pressure and reduce wear. Check the engine noise and replace the chain if required. If no problem found change the oil to one with higher viscosity and special anti-wear additives.

records.concern: Peugeot DV5R Engines Camshaft Chain.
records.defect: Vehicles may be affected by premature wearing of the camshaft drive chain leading to abnormal noise or to a breakage of the chain in the worst case.
records.remedy: Update the software to improve oil pressure and reduce wear. Check the engine noise and replace the chain if required. If no problem found change the oil to one with higher viscosity and special anti-wear additives.

records.concern: Vauxhall DV5R Engines Camshaft Chain.
records.defect: Vehicles may be affected by premature wearing of the camshaft drive chain leading to abnormal noise or to a breakage of the chain in the worst case.
records.remedy: Update the software to improve oil pressure and reduce wear. Check the engine noise and replace the chain if required. If no problem found change the oil to one with higher viscosity and special anti-wear additives.

records.concern: Fault monitoring for SideGuard Assist inactive due to parameter error
records.defect: It has been determined that due to a parameter error of the VRDU3 in the event of a fault in the SideGuardAssist assistance system (for example in the form of a sensor fault) the driver is not notified of the assistance system fault as prescribed by UN ECE R 151. As the driver is not informed of the failure of the assistance function the protection of particularly vulnerable road users may be impaired.
records.remedy: Remedy is by way of a Software update.

records.concern: Passenger airbag inflator
records.defect: On affected vehicles the passenger airbag inflator housing may rupture due to excessive internal pressure during normal airbag deployment events. An inflator rupture during airbag deployment events could result in metal fragments striking and potentially seriously injuring the vehicle occupant(s).
records.remedy: Replace the passenger airbag.

records.concern: Checking air spring strut
records.defect: A retaining ring may not be securely seated in the area of the support mounting on the air spring struts on your vehicle. If the retaining ring comes loose from its groove air will escape from the affected air spring strut. This directly impairs the vehicle’s driving dynamics and results in an increased accident risk
records.remedy: Check the affected air spring struts and replace them if necessary.

records.concern: SRPC2509 – Mounting of Multi-Purpose Camera & Interior Mirror
records.defect: Mercedes-Benz AG has determined that on certain GLE/GLS (167 platform) and GLC (254 platform) vehicles the bonding of the multi-purpose camera and/or the interior mirror on the windscreen might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: As a precautionary measure Mercedes-Benz AG via its Mercedes-Benz service partners will replace the windscreen on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: SRPC2508 – Mounting of Multi-Purpose Camera & Interior Mirror
records.defect: Mercedes-Benz AG has determined that on certain GLE/GLS (167 platform) and GLC (254 platform) vehicles the bonding of the multi-purpose camera and/or the interior mirror on the windscreen might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: As a precautionary measure Mercedes-Benz AG via its Mercedes-Benz service partners will replace the windscreen on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: LEXMOTO LXS E55 Front disc
records.defect: For affected machines when the front brake is applied whilst riding it is catching the brake pad securing pin. Examination has shown that an incorrect wheel spacer and incorrectly sized caliper holding bracket may have been fitted during manufacture.
records.remedy: Replacement of the front wheel spacer caliper bracket and brake pads.

records.concern: Passenger airbag replacement
records.defect: On affected vehicles defective passenger airbags may have been fitted. On affected vehicles the passenger airbag should be deactivated and the passenger seat not used until the recall action has been completed.
records.remedy: Affected vehicles will be checked and the passenger airbags replaced if necessary.

records.concern: 25S86 Transit Transit Custom - Potential Panther Engine Timing Idler Gear Loose
records.defect: On affected vehicles the engine idler gear bolt may shear resulting in the idler gear dropping and primary drive failure. This can result in complete engine failure leading to a stall and/or no start condition.
records.remedy: Replace the idler gear and idler bolt.

records.concern: C0456 Gear selector switch replace
records.defect: On affected vehicles there is a risk of premature wear inside the gear selector switch. This could lead to the vehicle decelerating and moving backwards unintentionally without any command by the driver.
records.remedy: Fit a modified gear selector switch and install updated software.

records.concern: Trekker Brake Line Issue
records.defect: There is a potential issue with a vehicle brake line installation on a MY24/25 Trekker motorhome product. The freshwater tank installation which is designed and installed by Swift as part of the motorhome base vehicle conversion may have been positioned such that the tank comes into contact with the base vehicle's rear brake line when the suspension moves through its full range of travel. This has the potential to compromise the performance of the braking system.
records.remedy: Removal inspection and relocating of the tank.

records.concern: C0455 Traction Battery Inspect/Replace
records.defect: ESS Traction battery. There is a risk that a small metal piece from a broken terminal fixation might come loose and create a short circuit between battery cells inside the traction battery which might lead to overheating and a risk of fire. There will be a red warning in the instrument cluster to the driver if a short-circuit is detected inside the battery before the battery overheats.
records.remedy: Replacement of ESS Traction battery.

records.concern: BCM2 SW – Safety Notice
records.defect: Affected vehicles may experience a temporary loss of braking functionality after coasting downhill when using One Pedal Drive. This could potentially lead to a collision.
records.remedy: Install modified software via an Over the Air (OTA) update.

records.concern: BCM2 SW – Safety Notice
records.defect: Affected vehicles may experience a temporary loss of braking functionality after coasting downhill with ‘B’ mode selected or when using One Pedal Drive. This could potentially lead to a collision.
records.remedy: Install modified software via an Over the Air (OTA) update.

records.concern: Incorrect Front Fender bolts
records.defect: On affected machines the front fender may have fixings which are not of the correct length.
records.remedy: The front fender will have the mounting bolts replaced.

records.concern: Check rear diffuser
records.defect: On affected vehicles the rear diffuser may not be correctly attached.
records.remedy: Affected vehicles will be checked and repaired if necessary.

records.concern: Curtain airbag
records.defect: On Tiguan Allspace vehicles of a limited production period there is a possibility that one or several faulty curtain airbags may have been fitted in the vehicle.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the left and/or right curtain airbag must be replaced.

records.concern: INCORRECT TIGHTENING OF THE REAR AXLE SHAFT SCREWS
records.defect: On affected vehicles the half shaft screws to rear axle may not be properly tightened. The screws could therefore loosen up to a partial or total decoupling of the half-shaft from the rear axle with possible loss of direction and control of the vehicle.
records.remedy: Re-tightening of the screws of the rear axle half shafts to the required value.

records.concern: Kubota M6 Tractor front axle recall
records.defect: An issue with the front axle of certain Kubota M6 tractors (the “Concerned Units”) has been identified whereby cracks may cause the axle to malfunction or break during normal operation. This may cause the front wheel(s) to detach and/or significantly affect steering.
records.remedy: Kubota intends to replace the front axles of the Concerned Units. Additionally customers with Concerned Units that are equipped with front axles with more than 800 hours of use are advised to stop using their tractor until the front axle has been replaced.

records.concern: Alloy Rims May Crack
records.defect: Currently Wrightbus believe that there is a flaw in the wheel rim design contributing to the failure.
records.remedy: Replacement of Alloy wheels

records.concern: SRPC2510 – Locking Pin of Rear Spoiler Hydraulic Line
records.defect: Mercedes-Benz AG has determined that on AMG ONE (298 platform) vehicles locking pins on the hydraulic line of the rear spoiler might not be installed as required.
records.remedy: As a remedy Mercedes-Benz AG via its official AMG ONE Service Hubs will check the installation of the locking pins on the hydraulic line of the rear spoiler on the affected vehicles and correct it if necessary.

records.concern: Autonomous Telematics Box
records.defect: On affected vehicles the Autonomous Telematics Box (ATB) has no connectivity to the Connected Services features and therefore does not comply with regulatory requirements.
records.remedy: Replace the ATB to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.

records.concern: Autonomous Telematics Box
records.defect: On affected vehicles the Autonomous Telematics Box (ATB) has no connectivity to the Connected Services features and therefore does not comply with regulatory requirements.
records.remedy: Replace the ATB to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.

records.concern: 25E03 – Puma mHEV - Hybrid system fault
records.defect: Affected vehicles may experience a hybrid system fault (no torque assistance or regeneration and loss of Stop Start). This may be observed as a hybrid gauge not working poor performance or reduced fuel economy.
records.remedy: Update the Battery Energy Control Module software.

records.concern: Accessory Softail Rear Shock Pre-Load Adjuster
records.defect: On affected machines the rear shock pre-load adjuster mounting bracket may fracture under normal use potentially allowing the rear shock adjuster to contact the rear tyre. if contact between the rear shock adjuster and tyre remains undetected this may cause a sudden loss of tyre pressure.
records.remedy: Installation of a secondary bracket underneath the motorcycle’s rear shock absorber pre-load adjuster.

records.concern: Softail Rear Shock Pre-Load Adjuster
records.defect: On affected machines the rear shock pre-load adjuster mounting bracket may fracture under normal use potentially allowing the rear shock adjuster to contact the rear tyre. if contact between the rear shock adjuster and tyre remains undetected this may cause a sudden loss of tyre pressure.
records.remedy: Installation of a secondary bracket underneath the motorcycle’s rear shock absorber pre-load adjuster.

records.concern: Replace front passenger airbag
records.defect: The front passenger airbag may be faulty. In the event of an accident-related deployment the front passenger airbag may have a reduced protective effect also the gas generator housing may burst and components of the gas generator housing may come loose and cause serious or deadly injuries to vehicle occupants.
records.remedy: The passenger airbag must be replaced.

records.concern: 25S59 Transit Transit Custom - Potential exhaust manifold nut incorrectly torqued
records.defect: On affected vehicles the correct tightening torque was not reached on some of the exhaust manifold nuts during the manufacturing process. This could lead to exhaust gas leaking and the melting of the nearby plastic oil separator causing oil to leak on to hot surfaces and the risk of fire.
records.remedy: Visually check to confirm all nut positions and condition. Remove the engine and replace the nut and stud if not ok.

records.concern: Ranger XP Kinetic Charging Harness
records.defect: For affected vehicles there is concern that a crack may develop in the EMC (Electromagnetic Compatibility) filter(s) within the vehicle's charging system potentially allowing water to contact high voltage charging harness components.
records.remedy: Inspection of the EMC filter(s) and harness(s) for signs of damage and replace where required including installation of a cover assembly.

records.concern: C0457 Gear selector switch replace. FLE/FEE (3)
records.defect: On affected vehicles there is a risk of premature wear inside the gear selector switch. This could lead to the vehicle decelerating and moving backwards unintentionally without any command by the driver.
records.remedy: Fit a modified gear selector switch and install updated software.

records.concern: 25S34 Tourneo Connect - Potential Front Entertainment Control Module (FEM) Screen Freezing
records.defect: Affected vehicles could potentially have the Front Entertainment Control Module (FEM) screen freezing. The issue could increase the risk of missing persons or obstacles behind the vehicle when reversing with a frozen rear-view camera picture.
records.remedy: Update the FEM software and perform a verification process. Replace the FEM if necessary.

records.concern: Discovery (L319) and Range Rover Sport (L320) Tow Ball Detachment
records.defect: The manufacturer has determined that in affected vehicles the instructions provided on the method of use of detachable tow balls does not adequately warn of a non-obvious risk which could lead to a failure of the tow ball mechanism causing in-use detachment of the tow ball and trailer detachment.
records.remedy: Customers will be provided with an additional retaining bracket to fit to the vehicle when using the detachable tow ball together with full installation instructions.

records.concern: Rework/Replace the Starter Generator (SGR)
records.defect: On affected vehicles the screw connection of the positive battery cable onto the starter generator may not have been performed to specification.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles the starter generator will be replaced and positive cable will be reworked / replaced if required.

records.concern: Tray Carrying HV Cables On Exterior Of Roof On Single Deck EV Products May Fail
records.defect: Tray Carrying HV Cables On Exterior Of Roof On Single Deck EV Products May Fail.
records.remedy: Extra support brackets added.

records.concern: Peugeot 208 – Fuel Tank
records.defect: On affected vehicles there may be a defect present in the fuel tank threads which could potentially lead to a fuel leak.
records.remedy: Check the blown-molding engraved date marking date at the bottom of the fuel tank and replace the lock nut and O-ring if necessary.

records.concern: 25C10 - Transit Custom - Driver and Passenger Door Modules Software Update
records.defect: On affected vehicles the remedy software for a previous recall may not have been installed correctly. It may be possible the driver or passenger windows will not automatically reverse when encountering an obstruction.
records.remedy: Update the Driver and Passenger Door Modules with the latest software and verify the process to ensure correct installation.

records.concern: AJ21-D4 Turbo Oil Feed Pipe Leak - Incorrectly Repaired
records.defect: On affected vehicles the turbocharger oil feed pipe clamp may have been installed in the incorrect orientation. Incorrectly installed pipe clamp will not provide sufficient clamp load and therefore risk an oil leak.
records.remedy: Replace oil feed pipe O-rings and fit replacement pipe clamp correctly.

records.concern: AJ21-D4 Turbo Oil Feed Pipe Leak - Incorrectly Repaired
records.defect: On affected vehicles the turbocharger oil feed pipe clamp may have been installed in the incorrect orientation. Incorrectly installed pipe clamp will not provide sufficient clamp load and therefore risk an oil leak.
records.remedy: Replace oil feed pipe O-rings and fit replacement pipe clamp correctly.

records.concern: Exhaust Aftertreatment System (EATS) Rework
records.defect: On affected vehicles there is a risk that the Diesel Particulate Filter (DPF) may overheat when performing a regeneration if there is excessive soot accumulated inside it. In a worst-case scenario this could result in a vehicle fire.
records.remedy: Install modified software and pressure sensor.

records.concern: Roof Mounted H2 Fuel Tank Support Bracket Bolts May Loosen
records.defect: Bolts in the brackets supporting the five roof mounted H2 tanks located at each end of each tank have the potential to loosen and drop out permitting movement of the bracket(s) and attached tank(s) with secondary movement in the associated system pipework. Under extreme braking conditions or if the vehicle is involved in a road traffic accident the roof tanks may become dislodged or become detached from the vehicle.
records.remedy: replacement of all bolts and nuts on the frame and frame attachment

records.concern: HV Battery Cell Module MINI J01 J05
records.defect: On affected vehicles specific cells of the High Voltage battery may have been pre-damaged during production handling.
records.remedy: Affected vehicles will have the affected cell module of the HV battery replaced.

records.concern: Cylinder head cover bolts inspection
records.defect: Audi conducts programmes to constantly monitor the quality of its products. As part of this we have discovered that individual bolts in the cylinder head cover area on your vehicle may become loose as a result of a manufacturing issue. Depending on the extent to which the bolts become loose engine oil may leak and drip onto hot surfaces which poses a fire risk. If you notice smoke in the engine compartment park the vehicle safely and without delay.
records.remedy: To ensure the bolts are secured correctly a check must be performed.

records.concern: 2025-01 Faulty float gauge in the gas tank
records.defect: On affected vehicles may be fitted with a defective float gauge which could lead to overfilling of the gas tank. This could lead to the risk of a thermal event or deflagration in the heating system.
records.remedy: Affected vehicles will have the gas tank replaced.

records.concern: REPLACE STEERING DAMPER
records.defect: On affected machines the steering damper may suffer from manufacturing defects which may cause the steering damper to become stiffer than normal.
records.remedy: The steering damper will be replaced on affected motorcycles.

records.concern: Update software of control units
records.defect: Mercedes-Benz are updating the engine control unit software in diesel vehicles with emissions standard Euro 5 as part of a mandatory recall. This measure was supposedly carried out previously on the vehicles included in this measure but the software update was not properly documented in our systems at that time.
records.remedy: Mercedes-Benz will perform control unit programming on the vehicles affected using the Service Measure special process as part of a recall. As part of this the software of the affected control units will be updated. The scope of the affected control units may vary depending on the vehicle equipment.

records.concern: Too Low Exhauxt Temperature.
records.defect: On affected vehicles the exhaust temperature might be too low. This may lead to unrobust environmental performance.
records.remedy: Update the engine software.

records.concern: Instrument Panel Cluster Software
records.defect: On affected vehicles a low AdBlue level message may not be displayed on the Instrument Panel Cluster. This could lead to the possibility of not being able to start the vehicle due to an empty AdBlue tank.
records.remedy: Update the Instrument Panel Cluster software.

records.concern: Instrument Panel Cluster software
records.defect: On affected vehicles a low AdBlue level message may not be displayed on the Instrument Panel Cluster. This could lead to the possibility of not being able to start the vehicle due to an empty AdBlue tank.
records.remedy: Update the Instrument Panel Cluster software.

records.concern: Instrument Panel Cluster Software
records.defect: On affected vehicles a low AdBlue level message may not be displayed on the Instrument Panel Cluster. This could lead to the possibility of not being able to start the vehicle due to an empty AdBlue tank.
records.remedy: Update the Instrument Panel Cluster software.

records.concern: ASA5 Stop Delivery Safety Recall - Replacing passenger‘s airbag unit
records.defect: During regular conformity of production tests by the supplier a deviation at a component of the passenger’s airbag unit has been identified. As a result of this deviation the full protective effect of the passenger’s airbag may be impaired in the event of an accident triggering the restraint systems.
records.remedy: To ensure the full protective effect the passenger’s airbag unit of all affected vehicles must be replaced.

records.concern: 25S21 Kuga - Powertrain Control Module (PCM) Software Update
records.defect: On affected vehicles the remedy software for a previous recall which was needed to mitigate a potential fire risk may not have been installed correctly.
records.remedy: Update the Power Control Module software and perform an additional verification process to ensure the software has been installed correctly.

records.concern: Security Guidance
records.defect: Jaguar Land Rover in conjunction with law enforcement and insurance bodies is aware of the increase in thefts of vehicles in specific geographical locations within the United Kingdom. there is no fault with Jaguar Land Rover's security systems and they continue to meet stringent automotive legislation. Jaguar Land Rover is offering owners guidance on how to maximise vehicle security and protect against theft.
records.remedy: Vehicle registered keepers will be sent a security guidance letter only - there is no repair action.

records.concern: IAM Track Control Arm
records.defect: For affected components there is a manufacturing issue regarding the track control arm that during installation could potentially cause subframe stress and result in cracking or damage to the front axle carrier.
records.remedy: Replace track control arm and inspect the axle carrier for damage or cracking and replace if necessary.

records.concern: SRPC2504 - Ground connection bolting
records.defect: Mercedes-Benz AG has determined that on certain E-Class (214 platform) and GLC (254 platform) vehicles the bolts of certain 12V- and 48V- ground connections might not have been fastened with the specified torque.
records.remedy: As a remedy Mercedes-Benz AG via its Mercedes-Benz service partners will check the bolting of the ground connections and perform according repairs if necessary.

records.concern: Alfa Romeo Giulia and Stelvio. Lane Keep Assist acoustic signal
records.defect: Vehicle reliability and your safety are a major concern for Alfa Romeo. On a number of Alfa Romeo Giulia and Stelvio vehicles there is a requirement to update the software of the Instrument Panel Cluster. This is required to ensure that the acoustic emergency signal sounds after the Lane Keep Assist system is deactivated and ensure it complies with the regulatory requirements.
records.remedy: The free of charge repair is the Alfa Romeo retailer will update the vehicle software. Alfa Romeo ref: F538.

records.concern: ABS CABLE INVERSION ON FRONT AXLE BRAKE CONVERTERS 75E-100E (AOH)
records.defect: On affected vehicles the Anti-lock Braking System (ABS) connections to the front wheels maybe be inverted this may result in an increased stopping distance and/or reduced vehicle stability control during braking that requires ABS intervention.
records.remedy: Check and reposition ABS cable connectors as required.

records.concern: RA-18-2044 Replace the Rear Fuse Box Closing Panel Screws
records.defect: On affected vehicles incorrect length screws may have been used to attach the rear fuse box closing panel which could cause damage to the wiring harness and in a worst-case scenario a risk of fire.
records.remedy: Replace rear fuse box closing panel screws and inspect and if necessary replace any damaged parts.

records.concern: SRPC2506 - Driver seat belt fitting
records.defect: Mercedes-Benz AG has determined that on certain C-Class (206 platform) vehicles the safety cap of the seatbelt end fitting on the driver seat might not be installed correctly.
records.remedy: As a remedy Mercedes-Benz AG via its Mercedes-Benz service partners will check the safety cap of the seat belt end fitting on the affected vehicles and rework it if necessary.

records.concern: ECM Software Inspection & Correction
records.defect: The manufacturer has determined on affected vehicles the On- Board Fuel Consumption Monitor (OBFCM) correction calibrations included in the certification specifications were not reflected in the mass-production calibrations.
records.remedy: Update the vehicle ECM software to the latest level.

records.concern: CB/CBR650R (E-Clutch) 24YM Gear Change Arm Detached 3P9
records.defect: On affected motorcycles there is a risk the nut and bolt of the gear change arm may detach while riding and it will not be possible to operate the gear change lever.
records.remedy: Replace the gear change arm with a modified part.

records.concern: 784 Homologation Label Granturismo
records.defect: On affected vehicles the manufacturer’s plate may detach.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles the manufacturer’s plate will be replaced following a rework of the area which the plate is attached to.

records.concern: HV Battery Cell Module MINI J01 J05
records.defect: On affected vehicles specific cells of the High Voltage battery may not have been produced according to specification. This could lead to the risk of a thermal event even when the vehicle is not in operation.
records.remedy: Affected cells of the High Voltage battery will be replaced.

records.concern: 25S16 Kuga PHEV - Powertrain Control Module Software Update
records.defect: On affected vehicles software from a previous recall may not have been installed correctly. Vehicles may have Hybrid Powertrain Control Module (HPCM) software that can result in a forced neutral condition while driving.
records.remedy: Update and verify the software.

records.concern: 25S14 Mach-E - High Voltage Battery Control Module Update
records.defect: On affected vehicles software from a previous recall may not have been installed correctly. The high voltage battery main contactor may overheat which can result in either loss of power while driving or a vehicle no start condition.
records.remedy: Update and verify the software.

records.concern: Seat Belt Buckle
records.defect: On affected vehicles under certain circumstances the seatbelt buckle for the rear left passenger could open unintentionally while the vehicle is moving.
records.remedy: Install centre rear seatbelt buckle isolation surround

records.concern: 25C03 Transit Custom - Potential Child Lock Malfunction Issue
records.defect: Affected vehicles may experience a malfunctioning child lock feature on the dual power sliding doors due to a missing wire in the wiring harness.
records.remedy: Fit the missing wire and route alongside the existing loom.

records.concern: Recall of a Motorcycle helmet Brand: Matrix Model 'Duke'
records.defect: Affected motorcycle helmets have failed UNECE R22.05 linear Impact testing and are not approved.
records.remedy: Full refund or replacement of affected helmets with compliant ones offered.

records.concern: Starter Ring Gear
records.defect: For certain machines an issue involving the starter ring gear fixings may lead to the machine coming to a sudden stop during operation due to mechanical lock up.
records.remedy: Clean and degrease of the primary drive gear and starter ring gear and apply validated thread locker to each fixing.

records.concern: McLaren brake pipe recall (2025/002)
records.defect: On affected vehicles the anti-lock braking system (ABS) and electronic stability programme (ESP) may not function correctly due to the brake pipes being incorrectly connected into the control module.
records.remedy: Check pipes have been correctly connected and correct the connections if necessary.

records.concern: Fantic Caballero 700 Clutch Recall
records.defect: On affected vehicles clutch dragging may occur which could cause the vehicle to creep forward even when the clutch lever is fully depressed.
records.remedy: Affected vehicles will have the clutch plates and engine oil replaced.

records.concern: SRPC2500 – Update battery management system control unit software
records.defect: Mercedes-Benz AG has determined that on certain EQA (243 platform) vehicles a risk of fire of the high-voltage battery (EB330) cannot be ruled out.
records.remedy: As a remedy Mercedes-Benz AG via its Mercedes-Benz service partners will update the software of the battery management system on the affected vehicles. Until this remedy becomes available customers are instructed to charge their vehicle's battery only to a maximum of 80%.

records.concern: SRPC2503 - Variant of rear axle brake hose
records.defect: Mercedes-Benz AG has determined that on certain A-Class (177 platform) and CLA (118 platform) vehicles the length of the brake hoses on the rear axle might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: As a remedy Mercedes-Benz AG via its Mercedes-Benz service partners will check the brake hoses on the rear axle on the affected vehicles and replace them if necessary.

records.concern: Canister Replacement
records.defect: On affected vehicles the EVAP Carbon canister should be filled with activated carbon however an air gap may develop on the inside during use which may degrade its performance. There is a risk that fuel evaporation gas will leak into the atmosphere resulting in non-compliance with regulations.
records.remedy: Replace the EVAP Carbon cannister.

records.concern: Brake Pressure Modulator Valve
records.defect: On affected vehicles the Electronic Brake System Module is not according to specification which could potentially lead to light internal leakage of brake fluid.
records.remedy: Replace the Electronic Brake System Module.

records.concern: Brake Pressure Modulator Valve.
records.defect: On affected vehicles the Electronic Brake System Module is not according to specification which could potentially lead to light internal leakage of brake fluid.
records.remedy: Replace the Electronic Brake System Module.

records.concern: Brake Pressure Modulator Valve
records.defect: On affected vehicles the Electronic Brake System Module is not according to specification which could potentially lead to light internal leakage of brake fluid.
records.remedy: Replace the Electronic Brake System Module.

records.concern: TSI2025-05 INCORRECT FOOTREST FITTED.
records.defect: On affected machines footrests of an incorrect specification may have been fitted.
records.remedy: Affected machines will have the footrests replaced.

records.concern: Insufficient Traction battery control unit software on certain Toyota Proace City BEV and Proace BEV
records.defect: For affected vehicles there is an error in the specific software calibrations of the traction (high voltage) battery control unit. As a consequence a false detection of the battery cell voltage and/or the battery temperature could occur leading to loss of drive.
records.remedy: Update the software of the traction battery control unit.

records.concern: 24S56 Transit Custom PHEV
records.defect: On affected vehicles a component in the electric motor could over time slowly degrade and eventually fail leading to the electric motor failing without notice and a loss of propulsion.
records.remedy: Install a new electric motor.

records.concern: AN400A Fuel Hose Replacement
records.defect: On affected vehicles improper installation of the fuel supply hose assembly during production may cause the fuel supply hose to come into contact with the fuel vapor hose assembly. In a worst-case scenario the fuel supply hose can be abraded to the extent that fuel leaks resulting in an increased risk of fire.
records.remedy: Replace the fuel supply hose assembly and fuel vapor hose assembly

records.concern: TSI2025-06 BACK UP FUSE BLOWN
records.defect: On affected machines the power output of the Rectifier Regulator Assembly could cause the Back-Up Fuse to blow. If this occurs the engine may not start or may stall while the bike is in motion.
records.remedy: Affected machines will have the fuse replaced and associated information updated.

records.concern: Check axle drive module of rear axle
records.defect: Mercedes-Benz has determined that on certain eSprinter model 907 vehicles the weld seam of a gearwheel inside the rear axle drivetrain might not meet strength requirements.
records.remedy: As a remedy Mercedes-Benz via its Mercedes-Benz service partners will replace the rear axle electric drivetrain on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: P&A Touring Reflector Visability
records.defect: For affected machines the installation of certain accessory kits (Fairing Lowers and/or Inverted Forks) fitted on certain Model Year 2023 – 2025 Touring and CVO Touring machines may take the vehicle out of compliance.
records.remedy: Remove and correctly install replacement reflector.

records.concern: Qashqai (J12) Battery Management System
records.defect: For affected vehicles due to a software concern the calculated and displayed battery state of charge may rapidly fluctuate.
records.remedy: Reprograming of the battery management system with the latest software.

records.concern: Citroen C3 Front seat pretentioner wires inverted.
records.defect: Affected vehicles may face a front seat belt pretensioner malfunction in the event of a crash due to the inversion of command wires in the Airbag ECU connector.
records.remedy: Replace the affected PINS in the airbag ECU connector.

records.concern: Reflector replacement
records.defect: Rear and / or Side reflector fitted in the motorcycle may not meet the reflective performance requirements as per the safety standards.
records.remedy: Hence Royal Enfiled will Replace the Front and Rear Reflector under Free of Cost to the customers.

records.concern: Juke (F16) Front Seat Belt
records.defect: On affected vehicles the front seat belt may have been accidentally damaged during the parts preparation for assembly.
records.remedy: The retailers will inspect vehicles as identified as potentially affected and replace any affected seat belt assemblies.

records.concern: Reflector replacement
records.defect: Rear and/or front side reflectors fitted to the motorcycle may not meet the reflective performance requirements as per initial design.
records.remedy: Royal Enfield will Replace the rear and/or front side reflectors as required free of charge.

records.concern: SRL250303 – Retrofit screws for stabilizer link bearing bracket on vehicle frame BEF-ACHSL
records.defect: Actros 963 and Arocs 964 models depending on the model designation up to two screws per installed axle bearing bracket may be missing. The axle bearing bracket guides the rear axle in the longitudinal direction of the vehicle. Spontaneous failure of the threaded connection can be ruled out. According to the Development department’s assessment loosening of the installed screws is possible at the earliest after approx. 600000 km.
records.remedy: As part of the recall action it must be checked whether all specified threaded connections are present on the axle bearing brackets on the potentially affected vehicles. If not the missing threaded connections must be retrofitted and tightened to the specified torque.

records.concern: Kia Sorento MQ4 PDC Recall
records.defect: When the turn signal is switched off after operating the turn signal or hazard light more than 5 minutes the upper part of Daytime Running Light (DRL) stays off. The DRL will subsequently not meet the required intensity standard.
records.remedy: Kia will issue a software update via OTA (Over the Air) if this fails or a customer refuses the OTA update a Kia dealer will update the software.

records.concern: SRPC2501 - Processor Starter/Generator
records.defect: Mercedes-Benz has determined that on certain AMG GT Coupe (192 platform)S-Class (223 platform) SL (232 platform) GLC (254 platform) and AMG GT 4-doorsCoupe (290 platform) vehicles with hybrid powertrain the processor of the control unit of the high-voltage starter generator might experience sporadic overload.
records.remedy: As a remedy Mercedes-Benz AG via its Mercedes-Benz service partners will update the software of the high-voltage starter generator on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: Low Pressure Fuel Pipe
records.defect: On affected vehicles the low-pressure fuel pipe could come in to contact with one of the ignition coil screws. This could lead to fuel pipe damage over time resulting in a fuel leak.
records.remedy: Fix the low-pressure fuel pipe to the crankcase breather hose with a cable tie to ensure there is no contact between the ignition coil screw and the fuel pipe.

records.concern: Low Pressure Fuel Pipe
records.defect: On affected vehicles the low-pressure fuel pipe could come in to contact with one of the ignition coil screws. This could lead to fuel pipe damage over time resulting in a fuel leak.
records.remedy: Fix the low-pressure fuel pipe to the crankcase breather hose with a cable tie to ensure there is no contact between the ignition coil screw and the fuel pipe.

records.concern: Kia EV9 Seat Mounting Bolts
records.defect: Due to an error by a plant assembly worker some of the seat mounting bolts may be missing in the subject vehicles. Seats with missing seat mounting bolts may not properly restrain an occupant during certain collisions potentially resulting in injuries in case of a crash.
records.remedy: Inspect the mounting bolts and refit if required.

records.concern: DAL98 Clutch release shaft Welding Failure
