records.defect: On affected motorcycles the clutch release shaft was not properly welded to the lever due to an improper manufacturing process.
records.remedy: Replace the clutch release shaft.

records.concern: 22-25M Civic and Other Models EPS Gear Box Worm Wheel Swelling Failure 6JP
records.defect: On affected vehicles ​due to decrease of the grease amount in the worm wheel gear meshing area of the EPS gear box during use the sliding resistance at the meshing area increases and the torque fluctuation when turning the steering becomes larger resulting in an abnormal noise or a dangerous sticking occurs when turning the steering.​
records.remedy: For the Honda Civic (FL4 FE1) CR-V and ZR-V models replace the worm gear pre-load spring with a countermeasure part and add grease. For the Honda Civic Type R (FL5) model replace the Steering Gearbox with a countermeasure part.

records.concern: Solo ramp failure debonding
records.defect: On affected vehicles the bonding strength of the wheelchair ramp to hinge plate may not meet requirements. A de-bonded ramp could collapse without warning while in use.
records.remedy: Inspect wheelchair ramp and replace as necessary.

records.concern: Tyre 445/95R25 BF GOODRICH CRANE CONTROL - CAI 977200
records.defect: On affected tyres there is the potential for the occurrence of a circumferential crack in the bead area which could present an increased risk of rapid tyre pressure loss.
records.remedy: Replace the affected tyres.

records.concern: Loss of Rearview Camera Display Recall
records.defect: On a small percentage of affected vehicles upon vehicle power up the car computer board may experience a short resulting in the loss of rear view camera functionality .
records.remedy: Over the air software update or Car Computer replacement if necessary.

records.concern: Replace Rear Brake Hose G45
records.defect: On affected vehicles the rear brake hoses may not have been crimped correctly during production.
records.remedy: Affected vehicles will have the brake hoses replaced.

records.concern: Remove engine compartment cover
records.defect: On affected vehicles engine compartment covers were fitted that if incorrectly installed can come loose from their attachments. An unsecured engine compartment cover could touch the hot area of the turbocharger and result in smouldering damage or even a fire.
records.remedy: The engine compartment cover must be removed. Check for security prior to journey if loose remove if possible if not contact dealer immediately for rectification.

records.concern: Traction Battery software
records.defect: Affected vehicles may face an error in the Battery Monitoring Unit software.
records.remedy: Affected vehicles may face an error in the Battery Monitoring Unit software.

records.concern: Traction Battery software
records.defect: Affected vehicles may face an error in the Battery Monitoring Unit software.
records.remedy: Update the Battery Monitoring Unit software.

records.concern: Traction Battery software
records.defect: Affected vehicles may face an error in the Battery Monitoring Unit software.
records.remedy: Update the Battery Monitoring Unit software.

records.concern: Traction Battery software
records.defect: Affected vehicles may face an error in the Battery Monitoring Unit software.
records.remedy: Update the Battery Monitoring Unit software.

records.concern: SPA1 Cell Modules
records.defect: On affected vehicles the High Voltage (HV) Battery may have a manufacturing defect which could cause the battery cells to overheat when the HV Battery is fully charged. In a worst-case scenario there is a risk of fire when the vehicle is parked up with a fully charged HV Battery.
records.remedy: Check and replace the HV Battery if necessary and install modified software.

records.concern: The alternator electrical wiring harness may be incorrectly tightened within the engine bay junction box which may result in high electrical resistance
records.defect: Hyundai has identified that the alternator electrical wiring harness may be incorrectly tightened within the engine bay junction box which may result in a high electrical resistance.
records.remedy: Inspect and instal new retaining nut or wiring harness

records.concern: Incorrect information displayed on the registration document and CoC (certificate of Conformity)
records.defect: On affected vehicles incorrect data has been entered on the registration document and correspondingly the Certificate of Conformity (CoC).
records.remedy: The registration document must be amended and a new CoC issued.

records.concern: Incorrect information on the registration document and CoC (certificate of Conformity)
records.defect: On affected vehicles incorrect data has been entered on the registration document and correspondingly the Certificate of Conformity (CoC).
records.remedy: The registration document must be amended and a new CoC issued.

records.concern: Replacing rear seat backrest
records.defect: The rear seat backrest may not comply with crash safety requirements due to an inadequate weld joint. This means that there is an increased risk of rear seat passengers being injured in the event of a frontal collision if heavy loads are being transported in the luggage compartment. Until the repair has been performed we request that you do not transport any heavy loads in the luggage compartment.
records.remedy: For safety reasons it is necessary to replace the right rear seat backrest.

records.concern: 25S10 – Puma Fiesta Courier – Fuel line chafing
records.defect: Affected vehicles may experience chafing between the fuel line support shield and the fuel line which could result in damage to the fuel line.
records.remedy: Replace the fuel line support shield (bracket). Inspect the fuel lines and rework if necessary.

records.concern: 225/45R17 94Y Goodyear Eagle F1 Asymmetric 6
records.defect: Affected tyres do not comply with UNECE regulations which could potentially result in tread deformation or crown separation at high speeds.
records.remedy: Exchange non-compliant tyres.

records.concern: Autonomous Telematics Box connection
records.defect: Affected vehicles may experience an Autonomous Telematic Box (ATB) that cannot connect to the remote server.
records.remedy: Change the ATB.

records.concern: Autonomous Telematics Box connection
records.defect: Affected vehicles may face an error in the Battery Monitoring Unit software.
records.remedy: Change the ATB.

records.concern: Motor drive battery packs inspection – Recall
records.defect: On affected motorcycles there is a risk the terminals of the motor drive battery packs may become dislodged during plugging or unplugging of the battery packs due to a manufacturing error.
records.remedy: Inspect and replace battery packs if necessary.

records.concern: RH HANDLEBAR SWITCH ASSY REPLACEMENT — CFORCE 850/1000 TOURING
records.defect: On affected vehicles the throttle lever may not fully return to the idle position.
records.remedy: Affected vehicles will have the handlebar switch assembly replaced.

records.concern: Kubota MGX-IV and M6 series
records.defect: Kubota has identified that in specific circumstances during drives on the road for long periods of time at high speed and without pushing the brake pedal pushing the brake pedal for the first time may not properly activate the braking system due to the presence of air in the brake pipe. Pushing the brake pedal again 2-3 times allows for proper braking.
records.remedy: Dealers will follow a specified procedure which involves (i) cleaning certain parts of the braking system; (ii) supplying new oil to the braking system; and (iii) bleeding the air from the brake system.

records.concern: C0440 Traction Battery Inspect/Replace
records.defect: On affected vehicles there is a risk of an internal short circuit within the HV Traction Battery that may result in overheating with a risk of a thermal event.
records.remedy: Inspect and replace HV Traction Battery.

records.concern: Update Vehicle Software To Rectify EPAS Functionality
records.defect: On affected vehicles operating with a software release prior to 2023.38.4 an overvoltage breakdown in the steering rack may overstress motor drive components on the printed circuit board. If the overstress condition occurs while the vehicle is driving steering assistance will not be affected and a visual alert will illuminate. Once the vehicle speed comes to a standstill a loss of steering assistance may occur and loss of steering assistance will persist when the vehicle is driven again. Manual steering without steering assistance remains available to the driver.
records.remedy: Install modified software via an Over the Air (OTA) wireless update.

records.concern: Range Rover and Range Rover Sport Second Row Centre Seat Belt Buckle Cable Misaligned
records.defect: On affected vehicles the second-row centre seat belt buckle may have been manufactured incorrectly. An internal obstruction to the seat belt tongue can prevent correct latching. In the event of a crash an insecurely latched seat belt buckle could increase the risk of personal injury.
records.remedy: Vehicles will have the centre seat belt buckle and buckle retaining bolt replaced.

records.concern: POSSIBLE PRESENCE OF INCORRECT BRACKET AND BUFFER ON REAR SUSPENSION
records.defect: The manufacturer has determined that affected vehicles may have missing or incorrect rear suspension brackets and buffer installed onto the vehicle. This could result in increased roll with a possible loss of control that could result in a roll-over of the vehicle in extreme cases.
records.remedy: The remedial action is to replace the bracket with correct buffer.

records.concern: C0446 Traction Battery Replace & C0485 Traction Battery repair
records.defect: There is a risk that a small metal piece from a broken terminal fixation might come loose and create a short circuit between battery cells inside the traction battery which might lead to overheating. There will be a red warning in the instrument cluster to the driver if a short-circuit is detected inside the battery before the battery overheats.
records.remedy: Replace Traction batteries

records.concern: Defender 90” Classic Works LP Fuel Line Clash to Bracket
records.defect: The manufacturer has determined on affected vehicles the routing of low-pressure fuel pipes may clash with the rear right-hand damper. There is a risk that the fuel pipe could abrade and cause a fuel leak.
records.remedy: Vehicles will have the fuel line replaced and an additional fuel line bracket fitted together with revised routing for the fuel pipe

records.concern: Voluntary Recall: MEYLE no. 416 050 0005 + 416 050 0005/S suitable for Porsche 911 Boxster and Cayman
records.defect: Due to a manufacturing defect there may be a dimensional deviation in the affected control arms which can cause damage to the sub-frame and lead to steering problems.
records.remedy: Affected control arms will be replaced.

records.concern: Replacing front passenger airbag
records.defect: On some Audi A6 and A7 vehicles manufactured within a specific period the front passenger airbag installed may show signs of damage in transit. As a result in the event of an accident in which the front passenger airbag is triggered its restraining effect will be hindered.
records.remedy: The front passenger airbag unit must be replaced on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: Update Vehicle Firmware To Restore Post-Crash eCall Functionality
records.defect: On affected vehicles the eCall audio system will not operate in compliance with Regulations when the front passenger seat is occupied. As a result communications between the occupants of the vehicle and an eCall public safety answer point are unavailable post-crash.
records.remedy: Install modified software via an Over the Air (OTA) wireless update.

records.concern: Citroen C3 DS3 Driver and Passenger Airbag (Takata)
records.defect: On affected vehicles the chemicals in the Takata airbags may deteriorate over time which may cause the inflator to rupture and lead to serious injury.
records.remedy: Owners of affected vehicles should immediately cease using their vehicle when safe to do so until the recall action has been completed. Affected vehicles will have the airbag modules replaced.

records.concern: B4.5 and B6.7 Engine Control Module Replacement Safety Campaign
records.defect: On affected engines the Engine Control Module (ECM) may develop an internal electrical short circuit that could possibly blow a fuse in the ECM’s electrical supply resulting in an engine stall without warning.
records.remedy: Replace the existing ECM with a new (remedy) ECM.

records.concern: SRL250116 – EL-LEHEPU Replace electric power-steering pump.
records.defect: The electrohydraulic power steering pumps (EHPS) may fail on eActros 983 and eEconic 956 model vehicles. Due to insufficient anti-corrosion protection at the electrical connections and production tolerances the electrohydraulic power steering pumps may fail. If both electrohydraulic power steering pumps at the front axle fail the steering forces suddenly and significantly increase as soon as the second electrohydraulic power steering pump fails.
records.remedy: Replace the electrohydraulic power steering pumps with optimized electrohydraulic power steering pumps as a precautionary measure on the potentially affected vehicles.

records.concern: C0444 Traction Battery Replace FLE FEE 3 and C0470 Traction Battery repair FLE FEE 3 and C0510 Traction battery replace wave 2 FLE FEE 3 C0529 Traction battery replace wave 3 FLE FEE 3)
records.defect: There is a risk that a small metal piece from a broken terminal fixation might come loose and create a short circuit between battery cells inside the traction battery which might lead to overheating. There will be a red warning in the instrument cluster to the driver if a short-circuit is detected inside the battery before the battery overheats.
records.remedy: Replace Traction batteries

records.concern: Citroen Autonomous Telematics Box failure after OTA update
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have been equipped with an Autonomous Telematic Box (ATB) which does not work.
records.remedy: Change the ATB.

records.concern: SRPC2502 - Manufacturing of automatic Transmission AMG SPEEDSHIFT
records.defect: Mercedes-Benz has determined that on certain G-Class (465 platform) vehicles the inner surface of the housing of the automatic transmission AMG SPEEDSHIFT might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: As a remedy Mercedes-Benz via its Mercedes-Benz service partners will replace the automatic transmission and oil cooler on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: Defender P425 Dynamic Mode Stability
records.defect: Affected vehicles have had an incorrect set of settings in Dynamic Mode. Dynamic Mode therefore does not provide adequate stability suspension stiffness nor provide adequate stability control system operation thereby increasing the risk of loss of vehicle control.
records.remedy: Vehicles will have dynamic mode disabled.

records.concern: Rework Starter Generator Electrical Connection
records.defect: On affected vehicles the 48v connection to the starter generator may not be secured to the correct specification.
records.remedy: Affected vehicles will have the connection checked and reworked if required.

records.concern: XTRAIL (T33) Intelligent Speed Assistance
records.defect: For certain vehicles due to incorrect software calibration the Intelligent Speed Assistance may not behave as intended.
records.remedy: Reconfigure the associated control units to address the issue.

records.concern: XTRAIL (T33) Adaptive LED Headlight
records.defect: On affected vehicles the Adaptive LED Headlight (ALH) configuration may be out of specification. In this condition the ALH may not function as intended and alternate between high and low beam mode despite the presence of other vehicles.
records.remedy: Update the adaptive LED headlights (ALH) control module software configuration with revised parameters.

records.concern: Kia Niro HCA Fuse Replacement
records.defect: The printed circuit board (PCB) in the Hydraulic Clutch Actuator (HCA) may become contaminated with fluid. A fluid contaminated PCB may lead to an electrical short circuit which in extreme cases may potentially result in a fire in the engine compartment while driving.
records.remedy: Check vehicle for Diagnostic Trouble Codes (DTC) if HCA related codes are found replace the HCA the connector and reduced amperage fuse. If no related DTC are recorded fit reduced amperage fuse only.

records.concern: Kia Ceed PHEV HCA Fuse Replacement
records.defect: The printed circuit board (PCB) in the Hydraulic Clutch Actuator (HCA) may become contaminated with fluid. A fluid contaminated PCB may lead to an electrical short circuit which in extreme cases may potentially result in a fire in the engine compartment while driving.
records.remedy: Check vehicle for Diagnostic Trouble Codes if HCA related codes are found replace the HCA its connector and reduced amperage fuse modifying the fuse board to suit. If no related DTC are recorded fit reduced amperage fuse only modifying the fuse board to suit.

records.concern: Non-compliant motorcycle helmets and eye wear
records.defect: Affected motorcycle helmets and eye protection do not meet UK safety standards.
records.remedy: Consumers should stop using these products immediately and contact the seller for return instructions and a refund.

records.concern: Software update for brake electronics control unit
records.defect: The central gear indicator can appear to display that Park is engaged when the parking brake is not set. Please check that the red parking brake warning lamp is displayed for multiple seconds before leaving the vehicle.
records.remedy: A new software version for the ABS control unit is required for safety reasons.

records.concern: MX-5 Parking Assist Unit Reprogramming
records.defect: On affected vehicles when reversing obstructions may not be detected correctly due to inappropriate software in the parking assist unit which may increase the risk of an accident.
records.remedy: Reprogram the parking assist unit.

records.concern: Hand Brake replacement
records.defect: The teeth of the mechanical park brake pawl and ratchet can wear abnormally fast and may degrade possibly resulting in a loss of grip upon engagement of the handbrake. In the unlikely event of the hand brake lever self dis-engaging due to abnormal wear of the parts it can lead to an unexpected movement of the tractor.
records.remedy: Replace either the hand brake lever assembly or for speciality ranges of tractors the hand brake lever pawl due to a different design of the part.
models: Farmall 90C Farmall 95C Farmall 100C Farmall 105C Farmall 110C Farmall 115C Farmall 120C

records.concern: Autonomous Telematics Box failure after OTA update.

records.remedy: Change the ATB.

records.concern: Autonomous Telematics Box failure after OTA update.
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have been equipped with an Autonomous Telematic Box (ATB) which does not work.
records.remedy: Change the ATB.

records.concern: ASA0 - Check rear seat belt buckles and rework if necessary
records.defect: Due to a process error in the production an aluminium butyl may have been positioned incorrectly and the screw connection of the rear left and right belt buckle was potentially not executed according to the specifications. If this is the case the correct fastening of the belt buckle cannot be guaranteed. The loosening of the rear belt buckles in the event of an accident or emergency braking cannot be ruled out. This could increase the associated risk of injury.
records.remedy: The positioning of the aluminium butyl mat on the left and right of the affected vehicles must be checked and depending on the test result the screw connection must be reworked.

records.concern: Citroen C3 Jet cooling nozzle failure
records.defect: On affected vehicles the engine is at risk of becoming damaged because of an inadequate oil supply from an oil jet cooling nozzle.
records.remedy: Replace the engine oil and filter.

records.concern: Peugeot 208 - Jet cooling nozzle failure
records.defect: On affected vehicles the engine is at risk of becoming damaged because of an inadequate oil supply from an oil jet cooling nozzle.
records.remedy: Replace the engine oil and filter.

records.concern: Vauxhall Corsa Jet cooling nozzle failure.
records.defect: On affected vehicles the engine is at risk of becoming damaged because of an inadequate oil supply from an oil jet cooling nozzle.
records.remedy: Replace the engine oil and filter.

records.concern: CR285
records.defect: Potential malfunction of the rear brake. On affected vehicles the heat reflective sheath may not correctly positioned or moves from the proper retainer on the rigid brake hose duct the ABS control unit/brake calliper rear brake hose could be damaged because of the heat coming from the rear bank exhaust manifold.
records.remedy: Changing the position of the heat reflective sheath on the ABS control unit/brake calliper rear brake hose and securing it with a new grey self-locking tie Part no.74142941A resistant to high temperatures.

records.concern: Measures Against Loosening of Steering Shaft Nut
records.defect: Steering wheel fastening insufficient the mounting nut may loosen resulting in an abnormal sound or rattling if the use is continued the fitting may become disengaged in the worst case the steering wheel operation may not be possible.
records.remedy: Check and clean the installation condition of the steering wheel in all vehicles install the steering wheel correctly and tighten the nut to the revised specified torque of 43Nm (before: 33Nm).

records.concern: GL1800 Primary Drive Gear Tightening Bolt Broken
records.defect: On affected vehicles the primary drive gear bolt may fail causing a loss of the ignition signal resulting in an engine stall.
records.remedy: Install a revised primary drive gear tightening bolt with greater strength.

records.concern: Curtain airbag 2nd seat row
records.defect: On affected vehicles the curtain airbags at the height of the C-pillar (2nd seat row) may not have been correctly fitted.
records.remedy: Check the curtain airbags for correct installation and reposition if necessary.

records.concern: Passenger Airbag
records.defect: On affected vehicles there is a possibility in the event of a crash the front passenger airbag may not open as intended because of a fault in the dash panel.
records.remedy: Visually check the vehicle dash panel and change the airbag if necessary.

records.concern: Citroen Automomous Telematics Box.
records.defect: Affected vehicles may experience an autonomous telematic box that cannot connect to the remote server making it not possible to make calls or use other connected services.
records.remedy: Disconnect the 12V battery and reconnect it after 15 seconds then check for a trouble code.

records.concern: Peugeot Automomous Telematics Box.

records.defect: Affected vehicles may face potential leakage of the under-bonnet fuel pipe due to a weakness of its crimping.

records.concern: Peugeot 3008 5008 Headrest
records.defect: On affected vehicles front seat headrests are not to specification.
records.remedy: Check the fixing notches of the front seat headrests and exchange them if necessary.

records.concern: Headlamp SW
records.defect: There is a potential risk that the headlamp hammer could temporarily close over the low/high beam lighting modules. Should this occur visibility will be reduced for a period of 2-3 seconds before it is restored.
records.remedy: Over the air software update the modified software can also be downloaded at a franchised Volvo retailer if preferred/requested

records.concern: Equipment Recall – Defender Raised Air Intake
records.defect: On affected vehicles the aftermarket-supplied raised air intake could become partially or fully detached from the vehicle due to inadequate attachment force at the A-pillar.
records.remedy: The vehicles will have their raised air intakes removed a revised fixing installed and refitted.

records.concern: 24C35 Mustang - Potential black instrument panel cluster
records.defect: On affected vehicles black Instrument cluster screen may occur randomly and persist until the next time the vehicle is turned on.
records.remedy: Update the software in the vehicle’s instrument cluster to the latest level.

records.concern: RETROFITTING PROTECTIVE RELAY FOR REVERSER CONTROL UNIT
records.defect: On affected vehicles the reverser control unit may be insufficiently sealed allowing moisture to lead to corrosion of the internal electrical contacts.
records.remedy: Affected vehicles will have a protective relay and addition wiring fitted. The control unit will also be reprogramed.

records.concern: DS Automobiles DS3 Crossback eVCU update
records.defect: Affected vehicles may not comply with test requirements in the matter of emissions test execution by competent authorities and energy consumption may be too high.
records.remedy: Update the electrical Vehicle Control Unit (eVCU) software.

records.concern: Citroen C4 C4X eVCU update
records.defect: Affected vehicles may not comply with test requirements in the matter of emissions test execution by competent authorities and energy consumption may be too high.

records.defect: Affected vehicles may not comply with test requirements in the matter of emissions test execution by competent authorities and energy consumption may be too high.

records.concern: Vauxhall Astra Corsa Mokka eVCU update
records.defect: Affected vehicles may not comply with test requirements in the matter of emissions test execution by competent authorities and energy consumption may be too high.
records.remedy: Update the electrical Vehicle Control Unit (eVCU) software.

records.concern: Vauxhall Grandland Front Seat harness
records.defect: On affected vehicles the wiring harness for both front seats may be routed incorrectly which may lead to a short circuit and the potential risk of a non-working airbag.
records.remedy: Check and if necessary re-route the wiring harness.

records.concern: Rear stub axle carrier mounting bolts
records.defect: On affected vehicles due to an insufficient tightening of the rear stub axle carrier mounting bolts at the factory the fatigue resistance of the bolt assembly is reduced.
records.remedy: Replace the rear stub axle carrier mounting bolts and tightening them at the correct torque.

records.concern: Chevrolet Takata Driver’s Airbag
records.defect: On affected vehicles the chemicals in the Takata airbags may deteriorate over time which may cause the inflator to rupture and lead to serious injury.
records.remedy: Exchange affected airbag modules as a precautionary measure.

records.concern: False Indicated Gear
records.defect: For affected machines the rider display on some Model Year 2025 Scout and Scout Sixty motorcycles may falsely indicate an incorrect gear.
records.remedy: Update of the Engine Control Module (ECM) software.

records.concern: Check and replace front brake caliper if necessary
records.defect: On affected vehicles irregularities may be found in the casting structure of the front brake caliper.
records.remedy: Affected vehicles will have the have the brake caliper checked and replaced if necessary.

records.concern: Trailer Hitch Incorrect Part Number Label Attached (Accessory)
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have been fitted with an incorrectly labelled trailer hitch of the wrong specification which may come into contact with the Integrated Power Unit (IPU) when a rear-end collision occurs and result in a short circuit in the high-voltage power system or a risk of fire. Cracks may also appear on the trailer hitch weld seams when towing excess weight for prolonged periods which could result in a risk of trailer hitch detachment.
records.remedy: Inspect and replace the trailer hitch with the correct part if necessary.

records.concern: Replacing Vario Cases
records.defect: On motorcycles fitted with the accessory Vario side cases it is possible the locking catches for the lid do not engage and the lid is not securely locked in this circumstance the lid may come open during use.
records.remedy: The affected boxes will be replaced

records.concern: Rear door hinges
records.defect: For certain vehicles there is an issue involving the conformity of the four hinges of the rear doors for where a missing shaft cannot be ruled out.
records.remedy: Inspect the hinges and if required replace.

records.concern: Safety Warning Wishbone ATEC
records.defect: For affected components the screw connection between the control arm and the ball joint may not be secure and can loosen or become detached.
records.remedy: Check independently according to the vehicle manufacturer's specifications the tightening torque of the screw connections.

records.concern: 2022-2025 YM CRF1100 Wheelie Control Setting Failure
records.defect: On affected machines when the rider operates the throttle under certain slow speed riding conditions with the Wheelie Control function activated it may result in abnormal drivability issues and the traction control light may flash. This is not compliant with regulations and in the worst case may cause the rider to fall.
records.remedy: Install updated software to the FI-ECU.

records.concern: Peugeot 308408 Door ECU software update.
records.defect: Affected vehicles have been equipped with a door control unit which does not have the latest software version.
records.remedy: Update the door control unit software on the driver and passenger side.

records.concern: Kubota RTV-X1110
records.defect: Kubota has identified that due to poor tightening of the bolts and nuts that connect the front suspension arm and the ball joint some of its utility vehicles RTV-X1110 may present a safety issue whereby a wheel could detach and the vehicle could become inoperable.
records.remedy: Inspect if any bolts or nuts are damaged replace the related parts with new ones if damaged. Tighten all to the specified torque.

records.concern: Combination Meter ECU reprogram for Remote Parking on Lexus NX
records.defect: The subject vehicles are equipped with an advanced park system that can be used through a smartphone app when the driver is outside the vehicle. The programming of the vehicle’s ‘Combination Meter’ ECU and/or the clearance warning ECU will not automatically activate the vehicle’s turn signal lamps as designed during these parking manoeuvres by the remote-control function.
records.remedy: Reprogram ‘Combination Meter’ ECU

records.concern: Security Enhancement
records.defect: For affected vehicles the manufacturer has developed a software enhancement to further increase vehicle security.
records.remedy: The software enhancement will deploy this update and reduce the theft risk.

records.concern: Propeller shaft weld seam

records.concern: Checking the B-Pillar U11
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have a B-Pillar which may have been produced using incorrect materials.

records.concern: High-Pressure Fuel Pump replacement on multiple models

records.concern: Kia Sportage Vacuum Pump Recall
records.defect: The vacuum pump drive gear may be damaged by a mechanical failure caused by high acceleration torque during the engine starting phase. If the pump fails an increase of the brake pedal force may be experienced while driving.
records.remedy: Complete a software update of the engine ECU. The ECU upgrade reduces the initial load caused by the Mild Hybrid Starter Generator during engine startup (cranking acceleration).

records.concern: Seat fixations are not according to specification on certain Toyota Proace and Proace Verso
records.defect: On affected vehicles the front and/or rear seat fixing points may have a reduced strength due to the thread of the fixing nut not being of the correct specification.
records.remedy: The fixings will be reworked with new nuts and bolts fitted.

records.concern: Hilux Occupant Classification System calibration
records.defect: For certain vehicles there is a possibility that the zero-point calibration of the Occupant Classification System (OCS) that provides input to the Supplemental Restraint System is incorrect.
records.remedy: Calibrate the Occupant Classification System (OCS).

records.concern: Skid control ECU Reprogramming
records.defect: On affected vehicles when the brake pedal is applied during cornering the driver may temporarily experience a hard brake pedal with reduced braking force causing the brake stopping distance to be more than expected. This may result in an increased risk of a crash.
records.remedy: Install modified software to Skid Control Electronic Control Unit.

records.concern: Revuelto Engine Oil Lines
records.defect: On affected vehicles the screws on the oil circuit connection flange from radiator to the oil tank may not have been properly torqued.
records.remedy: Check the tightening of the flange screws and rework if necessary.

records.concern: DS Automobiles DS7 Selective Catalytic Reduction diagnosis issues.

records.remedy: Upload modified software to the ECU.

records.concern: Peugeot 508 Selective Catalytic Reduction - diagnosis issues
records.defect: On affected vehicles the Engine Control Unit (ECU) software is not according to specification.
records.remedy: Upload modified software to the ECU.

records.concern: Vauxhall Mokka Front Tyres Damaged
records.defect: On affected vehicles the front tyres may have been damaged in the production process.
records.remedy: Check the front tyres and change if necessary.

records.concern: Update vehicle software to correct TPMS behaviour
records.defect: On affected vehicles upon detection of a malfunction with the tyre pressure monitoring system (TPMS) the TPMS tell tale does not persist between drive cycles where the vehicle is off or asleep between the drive cycles. Therefore the driver may not be adequately warned of potential under-inflation of the tyres increasing the risk of a collision.
records.remedy: Install modified software via an Over the Air (OTA) wireless update.

records.concern: REAR AXLE STUB AXLE CHECK
records.defect: On affected vehicles the rear stub axle material is not compliant to hardness specification. There is a risk the stub axle could break while driving.
records.remedy: Check the stub axle for cracks and replace if necessary.

records.concern: VECU SOFTWARE UPDATE

records.remedy: Update the accelerator pedal software.

records.concern: GKN Automotive Aftermarket Sideshafts and CV Joints
records.defect: Certain side shafts and CV joints manufactured in China do not meet GKN Automotive’s heightened original equipment level specifications for ultimate strength.
records.remedy: GKN Automotive will reimburse any customers for the cost of the recalled side shaft or CV joint and for their labour to install a replacement side shaft or CV joint of their choosing. GKN Automotive will also repurchase any remaining inventory from any distributors or retailers.

records.concern: SRPC2421 – Welding of rear axle carrier
records.defect: Mercedes-Benz AG has determined that on certain E-Class 214 platform and GLC 254 platform vehicles the welding of consoles to the rear axle carrier might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: As a remedy a Mercedes-Benz service partner will replace the rear axle carrier of the affected vehicles.

records.defect: Weaknesses identified in the exterior roof mounted hydrogen gas tanks support frame may lead to a failure of the frame during a vehicle impact.
records.remedy: Addition of structural beam and support brackets to the tank frame.

records.concern: PS2 FSAB
records.defect: On affected vehicles the Far-Side Airbag (FSAB) in the left-hand front seat of the car may fail to deploy as intended increasing the risk of injury in impacts from the right-hand side of the vehicle.
records.remedy: Replace the Far-Side Airbag (FSAB).

records.concern: PS3 HLCM Replacement
records.defect: On affected vehicles a fault within the High to Low voltage Converter Module (HLCM) reduces the available charging capacity to the 12V battery. In a worst-case scenario this could cause the vehicle to lose propulsion power without any prior warning message to the driver.
records.remedy: Replace the High to Low voltage Converter Module (HLCM).

records.concern: M0336 UDS pump replace FL FE
records.defect: Affected vehicles are fitted with a faulty Urea pump which could result in non-compliance to emissions regulations.
records.remedy: Replace Urea pump.

records.concern: 2024 Fiat 600 BEV and MHEV Advanced Driver Assistance Systems Radio software
records.defect: On affected vehicles equipped with an Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS) functionality the AEB/LKA (Active Emergency Brake/Lane Keep Assist) can be deactivated simultaneously. The vehicle does not therefore meet regulatory requirements.
records.remedy: Install updated software over the air (OTA).

records.concern: X-Car Powertain Control Module (PCM) Software Update
records.defect: Affected vehicles may develop a crack in the Diesel Particulate Filter (DPF).
records.remedy: Update software to prevent a cracked DPF. Test and replace DPFs that are already cracked.

records.concern: Lever for seat height adjustment
records.defect: Volkswagen AG has established that on VW Tiguan vehicles of a limited production period there is the possibility that because of a faulty protective felt in the event of a front crash a tear in the seat belt on the front seats could occur. In the event of an accident the seat belt could get caught in the side lever for seat height adjustment. The faulty protective felt on the lever for the seat height adjustment can cause the seat belt to tear in the event of a front crash. A torn seat belt increases the risk of severe or deadly injuries in the event of accidents.
records.remedy: For safety reasons the replacement of the faulty protective felt on the lever to the seat height adjustment of your vehicle is necessary. Until the check do not use your vehicle with the front seats in a seat position that is far back and low down. Otherwise there is a risk that the seat belt could tear in the event of a front crash and the risk of severe or deadly injuries is increased.

records.concern: 24S74 – Transit and Tourneo Custom PHEV – Wiring harness to brake line touch condition
records.defect: On affected vehicles there may be a clash between a wiring harness and the brake lines. This could lead to wear corrosion and a brake tube leak leading to reduced stopping performance.
records.remedy: Check the brake line and wiring harness and rework where necessary.

records.concern: Focus Clutch Pedal spring potential touch condition EPAS power Supply wiring
records.defect: On affected vehicles the clutch pedal spring may touch the Electric Power Assisted Steering wiring harness which may lead to clutch spring heat up and fall out a short circuit and loss of steering power assistance.
records.remedy: Inspect and adjust the position of the wiring and if necessary repair any wiring damage.

records.concern: Fiat Scudo. Multifunction screen fixings.
records.defect: On affected vehicles the radio display screen may be incorrectly secured.
records.remedy: Check the fixing of the screen and add any missing fixings.

records.concern: Vauxhall Grandland Risk of broken bolt front control arm ball joint
records.defect: On affected vehicles the fixing bolts on the front left or right bracket on the lower control arm may break. In the worst-case scenario 2 broken bolts could affect the controllability of the vehicle.
records.remedy: Change the front left and right ball joint brackets.

records.concern: Fiat 500 BEV High Voltage battery negative pole connection
records.defect: On affected vehicles the fastening nut may be missing from the negative terminal of the high-voltage battery pack which could result in a loss of torque failure to start the vehicle and in extreme cases it could present a possible fire hazard.
records.remedy: The affected vehicles will have the high-voltage battery replaced.

records.concern: Replace the high-voltage battery cell module
records.defect: On affected vehicles specific cell modules of the High Voltage (HV) battery may not have been produced according to specification.
records.remedy: Replacement of the affected cell module of the High Voltage (HV) battery will be replaced.

records.concern: Jeep Avenger Steering gear pinion safety recall
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have been fitted with a steering rack which does not conform to specification. This can lead to the need for increased force to rotate the steering wheel and in a worst-case scenario the steering may lock causing a crash.
records.remedy: Replace the steering rack.

records.concern: C0410 VECU SW update FLE FEE 3
records.defect: On affected vehicles there is a risk that the vehicle can start to accelerate when selecting drive or reverse and releasing the parking brake or brake pedal even if the accelerator pedal is not touched.
records.remedy: Install updated software to Vehicle Electrical Control Unit (VECU).

records.concern: Adaption measure for the emission control system
records.defect: For certain vehicles there is an adaptation measure for the emissions control system.
records.remedy: The vehicles will have some components of the emissions control system replaced with adapted parts and their control applications will be updated.

records.concern: Peugeot 30085008 Risk of broken bolt front control arm ball joint.
records.defect: On affected vehicles the fixing bolts on the front left or right bracket on the lower control arm may break. In the worst-case scenario 2 broken bolts could affect the controllability of the vehicle.
records.remedy: Change the front left and right ball joint brackets.

records.concern: Brake line botled connection
records.defect: On affected vehicles the rear right brake line may have been tightened incorrectly leading to loss of brake fluid adversely affecting braking performance.
records.remedy: Replace the brake line.

records.concern: McLaren GT - replace the bonnet latch assembly
records.defect: On affected vehicles the manual release cable of the bonnet latch assembly may have excessive tension which potentially may cause the latch to open causing an unexpected opening of the bonnet.
records.remedy: Replace the bonnet latch of the affected vehicles with a new bonnet latch which carries a different design.

records.concern: Replace right hand switch
records.defect: On affected vehicles the right-hand multifunction switch may allow moisture to ingress which may cause the ignition to turn off.
records.remedy: Affected vehicles will have the right-hand multifunction switch replaced.

records.concern: CHECK OIL FILTER REPLACE IF NECESSARY
records.defect: On affected vehicles the oil filter screw connection may come loose and oil may escape.
records.remedy: Vehicles will have the oil filter checked and replaced if affected.

records.concern: SRL241129 – SATP-MOD Change parameters in sATP control unit
records.defect: On affected vehicles a parameter may have erroneously not been deactivated on Actros 963 and Arocs 964 vehicles when they left the plant. If the parameter has not been deactivated the automatic application functions of the parking brake may be unavailable in the affected vehicles
records.remedy: Resetting of Parameter in vehicle ECU.

records.concern: Citroen C3 DS3 Driver and Passenger Airbag (Takata)
records.defect: On affected vehicles the chemicals in the Takata airbags may deteriorate over time which may cause the inflator to rupture and lead to serious injury.
records.remedy: Exchange affected airbag modules as a precautionary measure.

records.concern: 24S69 - Tourneo Connect Transt Connect - Potential leaky screw connection in the brake circuit
records.defect: Affected vehicles potentially have a leaking screw connection in the rear left brake circuit. There is potential for the brake system to lack hydraulic pressure resulting in longer brake pedal travel and reduced brake performance.
records.remedy: Replace the affected part.

records.concern: Servicing high-voltage battery
records.defect: On affected vehicles battery modules may become defective over the course of the vehicle’s service life. This may result in a fire hazard when charging the high-voltage battery with the associated risk of severe or fatal injuries to people inside and/or outside the vehicle as well as significant material damage. To minimise this risk do not charge the high-voltage battery using an external charging source. In addition do not use the e-tron modes “Battery charge” and “Battery hold” (refer to Owner’s Manual) until further notice.
records.remedy: Replace the defective modules. Further software fix being developed to improve monitoring.

records.concern: 23-25M High Pressure Fuel Pump Solenoid Component Part Breakage - 6YP
records.defect: On affected vehicles due to manufacturing issues the high pressure fuel pump could leak
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles check for leaks and replace the high pressure pump if necessary

records.concern: DS Automobiles DS7 Crossback Rear Axle Adjustment Rod.
records.defect: On affected vehicles the rear tie toe arm bushing was not crimped to specification which could allow movement of the arm on the bushing.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the rear tie toe arm will be replaced on both sides.

records.concern: DS Automobiles DS3 DS7 Radio software via OTA update
records.defect: On affected vehicles the Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS) functionality may not meet regulatory requirements and the Active Emergency Brake (AEB) and Lane Keep Assist (LKA) can inadvertently be deactivated by a long press of the ADAS button on the radio.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the radio software will be updated by an Over-The-Air update which will be remotely checked as successfully installed.

records.concern: Citroen C4 C4X Radio software via OTA update.
records.defect: On affected vehicles the Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS) functionality may not meet regulatory requirements and the Active Emergency Brake (AEB) and Lane Keep Assist (LKA) can inadvertently be deactivated by a long press of the ADAS button on the radio.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the radio software will be updated by an Over-The-Air update which will be remotely checked as successfully installed.

records.concern: Peugeot - Cross carline Radio software via OTA update
records.defect: On affected vehicles the Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS) functionality may not meet regulatory requirements and the Active Emergency Brake (AEB) and Lane Keep Assist (LKA) can inadvertently be deactivated by a long press of the ADAS button on the radio.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the radio software will be updated by an Over-The-Air update which will be remotely checked as successfully installed.

records.concern: Vauxhall Corsa Radio software via OTA update.
records.defect: On affected vehicles the Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS) functionality may not meet regulatory requirements and the Active Emergency Brake (AEB) and Lane Keep Assist (LKA) can inadvertently be deactivated by a long press of the ADAS button on the radio.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the radio software will be updated by an Over-The-Air update which will be remotely checked as successfully installed.

records.concern: Kia HECU Fuse Replacement
records.defect: The HECU hydraulic electronic control unit of affected vehicles equipped with Anti-lock Brake Systems ABS and Electronic Stability Control ESC could leak internally and cause an electrical short over time. In extreme cases the HECU could overheat with a possible risk of an under bonnet fire.
records.remedy: The recall will replace the fuses in the junction box with a lower rated version.

records.concern: 23YM Civic Lithium-Ion Battery Negative Terminal Defect
records.defect: On affected vehicles the Hybrid HV battery may develop a fault where battery electrolyte leakage occurs that may result in a vehicle fire in a worst-case scenario.
records.remedy: Replace the Hybrid HV battery with a modified component.

records.concern: SRPC2419 Misfire Detection M264
records.defect: The software of the engine control unit might not meet specifications regarding misfire detection.
records.remedy: Mercedes-Benz AG via its Mercedes-Benz service partners will update the software of the engine control unit on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: Mitsubishi ASX Exhaust
records.defect: On affected vehicles a crack may occur at the welded joint of rear muffler to tail pipe resulting in potential detachment of the tail pipe.
records.remedy: Replace muffler with a muffler fitted with a reinforcement bracket.

records.concern: ARC3 Recall campaign - Re-programming DME control unit
records.defect: The software version of the engine control unit does not correspond to the software version that should be on the vehicle.
records.remedy: Review the software version of the engine control unit and if necessary update it to the correct software version.

records.concern: ARC1 Recall campaign - Re-programming DME control unit
records.defect: The software version of the engine control unit does not correspond to the software version that should be on the vehicle.
records.remedy: Review the software version of the engine control unit and if necessary update it to the correct software version.

records.concern: ARC0 Recall campaign - Re-program DME control unit
records.defect: The software version of the engine control unit does not correspond to the software version that should be on the vehicle.
records.remedy: Review the software version of the engine control unit and if necessary update it to the correct software version.

records.concern: ARB9 Recall campaign - Re-program DME control unit
records.defect: The software version of the engine control unit does not correspond to the software version that should be on the vehicle.
records.remedy: Review the software version of the engine control unit and if necessary update it to the correct software version.

records.concern: ARC2 Recall campaign - Re-programming DME control unit
records.defect: The software version of the engine control unit does not correspond to the software version that should be on the vehicle.
records.remedy: Review the software version of the engine control unit and if necessary update it to the correct software version.

records.concern: SRPC2420 – Fastening of Steering Wheel Height Adjustment
records.defect: The fastening of the steering wheel height adjustment might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: Mercedes-Benz AG via its Mercedes-Benz service partners will replace the steering column tube on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: Fiat Scudo seat fixing
records.defect: On affected vehicles there may be insufficient fixing on the 1st and/or 2nd row of seats that could potentially allow seat movement in the event of a collision
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles seat fixings will be reworked

records.concern: Recall of Pirelli and Metzeler Motorcycle Tyres
records.defect: Under certain conditions of use over time the tyre belts may become damaged and tread could separate.
records.remedy: The manufacturer will replace the tyre for free.

records.concern: Instrument cluster module software concern
records.defect: On affected vehicles it is possible that a warning to prompt steering wheel operation may not be indicated on the instrument cluster when the driver releases or loosely grips the steering wheel for a certain period while using the Cruising & Traffic Support.
records.remedy: Reprogram the instrument cluster module.

records.concern: Inoperable defroster and seat belt warning light
records.defect: On affected vehicles When the hybrid system is powered on or the engine is started multiple warning messages may be displayed the PHEV high-voltage battery cooling system may not function as intended (only PHEV). The defroster seat belt warning and 360° view monitor functions may not operate as designed.
records.remedy: Reprogram the affected ECUs

records.concern: ECU Reprogramming
records.defect: On affected vehicles when the hybrid system is powered on or the engine is started multiple warning messages may be displayed the defroster seat belt warning and 360° view monitor functions may not operate the vehicle may to stall or fail to restart.
records.remedy: Reprogram the affected ECUs.

records.concern: Low Pressure Fuel Line Connection
records.defect: On affected vehicles a low-pressure fuel line may not have been secured to the correct specification.
records.remedy: Affected vehicles will have the low-pressure fuel line removed and reinstalled to the correct torque specification.

records.concern: 2nd Row Seat Bolts
records.defect: Volvo Cars investigations have identified that there is a potential risk that one or more of the fixation bolts for the 2nd row seats may have been torqued incorrectly at the factory. In the event of an impact this may increase the risk of injury.
records.remedy: Volvo retailer will inspect and if necessary re-torque all fixation bolts for the 2nd row seats.

records.concern: Vauxhall Movano B Fuel Pipe
records.defect: On affected vehicles the fuel pipe may chafe as a result of being in contact with the engine harness.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles check the fuel pipe and if necessary replace the pipe in addition a spacer will be fitted to avoid any risk of chafing.

records.concern: Fiat 600 MHEV and BEV. Front camera
records.defect: Affected vehicles are fitted with a front camera with an incorrect hardware ID which causes an error code within the car system. Once an error code is set and recorded the camera is always in fault mode whenever it is switched on. This will result in the ADAS (Advanced Driver Assistance System) remaining inactive. This inactive status is a nonconformity with regulatory requirements.
records.remedy: Replace the front camera.

records.concern: Fiat Ducato may have been fitted with the incorrect radio
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have been fitted with the incorrect radio. The radio fitted does not have rear view camera functionality and therefore may not comply with regulatory requirements.
records.remedy: Replace the radio.

records.concern: SRPC2416 – Lambda Control
records.defect: The manufacturer has determined on affected vehicles with 8-cylinder gasoline engine the lambda control in the software of the engine control unit might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: Update the software of the engine control unit.

records.concern: EMS Software Bug on M33B release
records.defect: Last EMS/ACM SW release introduced a bug in the Regeneration Management system on some B8R and B5LH/TL vehicles. This bug increases the AHI flow at start of regeneration resulting in too much fuel being injected into the muffler. As a consequence there is a risk of very high temperatures inside the muffler with a risk of a thermal event.
records.remedy: Volvo retailer will Reprogram the affected ECUs.

records.concern: Jeep Avenger all models 2023-2024. Front camera
records.defect: Affected vehicles have been equipped with a front camera with an incorrect hardware level ID causing an error code within the car system resulting in ADSA system remaining inactive.
records.remedy: Replace the front camera.

records.concern: Citroen Spacetourer K0 TBMU software.
records.defect: On affected vehicles they may have been supplied with incorrect software in the Traction Battery Management Unit (TBMU) that can lead to a non-compliance with regulatory requirements.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the TBMU software will be updated to meet regulatory requirements.

records.concern: Peugeot Expert K0 TBMU software
records.defect: On affected vehicles they may have been supplied with incorrect software in the Traction Battery Management Unit TBMU that can lead to a non-compliance with regulatory requirements.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the TBMU software will be updated to meet regulatory requirements.

records.concern: Vauxhall Vivaro TBMU software
records.defect: On affected vehicles they may have been supplied with incorrect software in the Traction Battery Management Unit TBMU that can lead to a non-compliance with regulatory requirements.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the TBMU software will be updated to meet regulatory requirements.

records.concern: Luggage Compartment Lashing Rail G01 F97
records.defect: On affected vehicles the screw connection for the luggage lashing rails may not withstand the forces in situations of a rear end impact. This may result in the lashing rail to not crumple as expected in these situations.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles the luggage lashing rail screws will be replaced with revised screws.

records.concern: 48V Harness Clash with Cross Brace
records.defect: On affected vehicles the 48V cable could become too close to an underbody cross-brace and rub against the metal cross-brace exposing the cable core resulting in a short circuit and risk of fire.
records.remedy: Inspect harness and as needed reposition the routing bracket as necessary.

records.concern: SRPC2417 - Function Cross Traffic Alert
records.defect: The manufacturer has determined on affected vehicles the software of the MBUX multi media system might not meet specifications. In this case a permanent deactivation of certain functions of assistance systems might occur.
records.remedy: Update the parking control unit settings

records.concern: SRPC2414 - Function Cross Traffic Alert
records.defect: The manufacturer has determined on affected vehicles the software of the MBUX multi media system might not meet specifications. In this case a permanent deactivation of certain functions of assistance systems might occur.
records.remedy: Update the parking control unit settings

records.concern: C0406 EMS ECM and ACM SW rollback. FL FE 3
records.defect: On affected vehicles there is a risk that the silencer may overheat when performing a regeneration which may result in a thermal event if there is excessive soot accumulated inside it.
records.remedy: Install modified software.

records.concern: SRPC2418 – Surface inner tyre side wall
records.defect: Mercedes-Benz AG has determined that the surface of the inner side wall of right-side installed tyres on certain GLB (247 platform) vehicles might be damaged.
records.remedy: As a precautionary measure Mercedes-Benz AG via its Mercedes-Benz service partners will check the tyres on the affected vehicles and replace it if necessary.

records.concern: EMS/ECM and SOFTWARE ROLLBACK
records.defect: On affected vehicles there is a risk that the silencer may overheat when performing a regeneration which may result in a thermal event if there is excessive soot accumulated inside it
records.remedy: Install modified software.

records.concern: AJ20-D6 and AJ20-P6 Engine Oil Filter Housing Cracked
records.defect: The manufacturer has determined on affected engines the oil filter housing will over time and with vehicle use crack allowing oil to leak out onto the engine and into the engine bay.
records.remedy: Replace the oil filter housing assembly complete with oil filter element and cap.

records.concern: GSX1300RRQ(Hayabusa) Front Brake Master Cylinder Replacement Recall Campaign (2ND)
records.defect: On affected vehicles under certain conditions the front braking system may experience a negative pressure which can lead to an in increase in brake lever play and in a worst-case scenario the lever contacts the throttle grip.
records.remedy: Replace the front brake master cylinder with a modified part.

records.concern: ARB6 recall campaign – Checking HVB cell modules and re-programming BMCe software
records.defect: A short circuit within the battery modules during the vehicle’s service life cannot be ruled out under certain circumstances which could lead to thermal events and later to a fire in the vehicle.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the battery modules must be replaced and the on-board diagnostic software (BMCe control unit) will be installed.

records.concern: Front seat belt
records.defect: On affected vehicles there is a possibility the seat belt for the driver seat was incorrectly anchored.
records.remedy: Check the seat belt fixing and reinstall correctly if needed.

records.concern: DL800DE Genuine Rear Tyre Recall
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have been equipped with a rear tyre that can develop cracking or other deformation of the tyre tread under higher-speed operation conditions. In the worst case under continued use portions of the tire tread may separate from the tyre structure and impact overall motorcycle dynamics.
records.remedy: Replace rear tyre.

records.concern: A potential issue regarding assembly/tightening of the low voltage C19 cable
records.defect: THE MANUFACTURER ADVISES NOT TO USE THE VEHICLE UNTIL AFTER RECTIFICATION. A potential issue regarding assembly/tightening of the low voltage C19 cable could cause it to deviate from its correct position which could compromise the isolation of the cable during the normal operation of the vehicle. This could cause a short circuit and potentially increase the risk of a fire. It may also cause the loss of all electrical power.
records.remedy: Vehicles will have the cable checked and if necessary correctly routed.

records.concern: 23-24M ZR-V and Others Overspeed Alarm Inoperative
records.defect: On affected vehicles after cancelling the ACC (Adaptive Cruise Control) the ISA (Intelligent Speed Assistance) will not alert the driver when over speed.
records.remedy: Update Multipurpose Camera Unit with modified software.

records.concern: Rework Front End Threaded Connection (MINI)
records.defect: On affected vehicles the screws connecting the front end to the vehicles body may have been tightened to a torque level lower than required.
records.remedy: The screws will be replaced if necessary and correctly torqued.

records.concern: Rework Front End Threaded Connection (BMW)
records.defect: On affected vehicles the screws connecting the front end to the vehicles body may have been tightened to a torque level lower than required.
records.remedy: The screws will be replaced if necessary and correctly torqued.

records.concern: Check high-voltage battery
records.defect: Some individual modules of the high-voltage battery may display technical irregularities. It cannot be ruled out that the battery may overheat under certain circumstances. For safety reasons affected cell modules must be replaced during a workshop visit. Vehicles affected by this should also not be charged above 80% until further notice.
records.remedy: The high-voltage battery must be checked on the affected vehicles and if necessary one or more modules must be replaced.

records.concern: Kia EV9 IEB Upgrade for RSPA Function
records.defect: On affected vehicles the manufacturer has determined that due to an error with the Integrated Electronic Brake (IEB) software repeated Remote Smart Parking Assist (RSPA) stops may result in extended stopping distances while using RSPA.
records.remedy: Update of the Integrated Electronic Brake (IEB) software with improved logic.

records.concern: UDS Pump. Replace
records.defect: On affected vehicles there is a possible fault with the UDS Ad Blue pump which might cause it to lose efficiency and lead to the vehicle emissions being non-compliant.
records.remedy: Change the UDS pump for a modified version.

records.concern: Tyre tread may separate
records.defect: On affected vehicles under certain tyre service conditions irregular tyre wear may develop which may result in breakage of the zero-degree reinforcement and lead to potential detachment of parts of the tread layer and/or sudden air loss.
records.remedy: Replace the rear tyre

records.concern: BCM2 – Push Road
records.defect: The rod connecting the brake pedal to the brake booster may not have been assembled correctly. The final torque might not be according to manufacturing specification due to deviations in the equipment. If the rod does disconnect the mechanical connection between brake pedal and brake booster cannot be guaranteed. In the worst-case scenario if the rod disconnects the brake pedal function cannot be guaranteed
records.remedy: A Volvo retailer will check and if necessary tighten the rod to correct specification.

records.concern: Citroen Spacetourer Dispatch K0 Seat Fixation
records.defect: On affected vehicles there may be insufficient fixing on the 1st and/or 2nd row of seats that could potentially allow seat movement in the event of a collision
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles seat fixings will be reworked

records.concern: Peugeot Traveller/Expert K0 Seat Fixation
records.defect: On affected vehicles there may be insufficient fixing on the 1st and/or 2nd row of seats that could potentially allow seat movement in the event of a collision
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles seat fixings will be reworked

records.concern: Vauxhall Vivaro K0 Seat Fixation
records.defect: On affected vehicles there may be insufficient fixing on the 1st and/or 2nd row of seats that could potentially allow seat movement in the event of a collision
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles seat fixings will be reworked

records.concern: C0397 Cab lower trim panel adjust. FH/FM/FHE/FME/FMLE (4)
records.defect: There is a risk that the lower trim panel might get loose and blow away mainly when driving on roadways at high speed.
records.remedy: The assembly of the panels will be inspected to make sure it is correctly done and the lower trim panel will be firmly attached to the cab by screws.

records.concern: 24C29 Transit - Side parking lights not operating correctly
records.defect: On affected vehicles the incorrect software could prevent the Side Parking Light function from operating as intended therefore failing to comply with existing regulations.
records.remedy: Update the Body Control Module software.

records.concern: 24S68 – Ranger Driver Seatbelt Webbing Inspection
records.defect: On affected vehicles the driver’s seatbelt webbing may have been incorrectly routed through the rubber anchor trim sleeve only instead of being routed through both the rubber and the metal anchor eyelet increasing the risk of injury in the event of a crash.
records.remedy: Inspect driver’s seat belt routing replace as necessary.

records.concern: T.50 Potential porosity in fuel tank fabrication
records.defect: On certain vehicles there is the Potential for porosity in the fabrication of the fuel tank
records.remedy: Check and replacement of the fuel tank

records.concern: Passenger airbag replacement
records.defect: Takata has advised that in the event of an accident with airbag activation the front passenger airbag gas generator housing may explode. The cause may be a deterioration of the propellant caused by high air humidity and temperature changes during an extended period of time. In the event of an accident with front passenger airbag activation fragments from the gas generator can cause injuries and endanger the life of the passengers.
records.remedy: Replace the passenger airbag as necessary.

records.concern: 2nd Row Rear Seat Back Frame On Certain Toyota Highlander
records.defect: On affected vehicles certain points on the ends of the 40% side of the rear seat-back mid-bar may not have been manufactured with a minimum radius.
records.remedy: Installation of a protective cover on the second-row rear 40% split seat back frame mid-bar end.

records.concern: Citroen C4 DriverPassenger Airbag (Takata)
records.defect: On affected vehicles the Driver and Passenger front airbags may not deploy properly in the event of a collision
records.remedy: On affected vehicles the Driver and Passenger front air bags will be replaced

records.concern: Peugeot 208 P21 Camera Video Module software
records.defect: On affected vehicles there may be a reduced alert time of 3 seconds instead of the regulatory requirement of 10 seconds to warn the driver that the Advanced Emergency Braking (AEB) is unavailable following an emergency braking event occurring.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the camera video module software and calibration will be updated.

records.concern: SRT 351 - Malfunction of inhibitor switch on CVT
records.defect: On affected vehicles the reverse lamp may not illuminate and / or the rear-view monitor may not display an image from the rear-view camera.
records.remedy: Replace the inhibitor switch with an improved part.

records.concern: The fixings and the relative support plates of the driveshafts to the gearbox may not be properly tight
records.defect: For certain vehicles the fixings and relative support plates of the driveshafts to the gearbox may have received an incorrect torque setting.
records.remedy: A check of the fixings and relative support plates of the driveshafts.

records.concern: NV400 (X62) GEN4 Fuel Pipe
records.defect: On certain vehicles Fuel Pipe characteristics may be out of specification and may have insufficient clearance between fuel pipe and engine harness.
records.remedy: Check of the fuel inlet pipe replacing if necessary and installing a rigid spacer on the pipe.

records.concern: NV300 (X82) Airbag
records.defect: On affected vehicles the airbag side impact sensors may not have been installed during production. Additionally some vehicles may lack the required wire harnesses for connection of the side impact sensors.
records.remedy: Installation of side impact sensors and where required associated cable kits.

records.concern: 2023-24 Jeep Avenger BEV Advanced Driver Assistance Systems
records.defect: On affected vehicles equipped with an Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS) functionality the AEB/LKA (Active Emergency Brake/Lane Keep Assist) can be deactivated simultaneously. The vehicle does not therefore meet regulatory requirements.
records.remedy: Install updated software.

records.concern: Replace Passenger Airbag G45
records.defect: For the affected vehicles the fabric of the passenger airbag may have been damaged during handling for airbag assembly.
records.remedy: Replacement of the passenger airbag.

records.concern: ARC4 Stop Use & Safety Recall - Wheel attachment with central locking
records.defect: On affected vehicles the wheel attachments using the central lock may not meet the required specifications. This can lead to damage / breakage and the possibility of wheel detachment.
records.remedy: Check the correct functioning of the central lock wheel fastening system and replace if necessary.

records.concern: The starter motor may become contaminated with water after driving the vehicle in abnormally wet weather conditions such as a water flooded area. This may result in an electrical short circuit occurring within the starter motor.
records.defect: On affected vehicles after driving though abnormally wet weather or flood water the starter motor may become contaminated which could result in a short circuit within the starter motor.
records.remedy: Replace the starter motor.

records.concern: Incorrect Label Tyre Informaiton
records.defect: On certain vehicles the wheel rim width - engraved on the rear wheel rims (left and right) is not compliant
records.remedy: Current engraving will be removed and replaced with correct new ones.

records.concern: Peugeot 3008 Cradle Bracket
records.defect: On affected vehicles the cradle bracket is not according to specification. In some cases this could lead to cracking of the bracket and structural integrity loss resulting in loss of vehicle control.
records.remedy: Check the cradle bracket and rework if necessary.

records.concern: Hydraulic Brake System Unit Replacement
records.defect: On affected vehicles the brake servomotor was improperly welded. The weld seam might not withstand the stresses caused under high brake pressure leading to a requirement for a higher brake effort increasing the braking distance.
records.remedy: Affected vehicles will have the hydraulic unit of the brake system replaced.

records.concern: Hydraulic Brake System Unit Replacement
records.defect: On affected vehicles the brake servomotor was improperly welded. The weld seam might not withstand the stresses caused under high brake pressure leading to a requirement for a higher brake effort increasing the braking distance.
records.remedy: Affected vehicles will have the hydraulic unit of the brake system replaced.

records.concern: SRPC2412 - Tightness of Transmission Wiring Harness Connector
records.defect: The manufacturer has determined on affected vehicles the electrical connector of the transmission wiring harness might not have been correctly remedied.
records.remedy: Replace the two-part wiring harness including the connector a with a new one-part variant

records.concern: SRPC2409 - Tightness of Transmission Wiring Harness Connector
records.defect: The manufacturer has determined on affected vehicles the electrical connector of the transmission wiring harness might not have been correctly remedied.
records.remedy: Replace the two-part wiring harness including the connector a with a new one-part variant.

records.concern: DS DS7 Crossback Steering Wheel Calibration
records.defect: On affected vehicles the steering wheel calibration may not be correct.
records.remedy: Check and re-calibrate the steering wheel.

records.concern: Alternator connector wire alignment clip
records.defect: The manufacturer has determined on affected vehicles the wires in the alternator connector system may form a bridge if they are exposed to a combination of different factors such as high temperatures heavy current loads and excessive lateral pulling on the wiring.
records.remedy: Fit a new cable alignment clip

records.concern: Citroen Dispatch (K0) Display Screws missing.
records.defect: On affected vehicles the radio display fixing screws may be missing allowing a potential detachment of the display during a collision.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the fixings will be checked and fitted if necessary.

records.concern: Peugeot Expert (K0) Display Screws missing.
records.defect: On affected vehicles the radio display fixing screws may be missing allowing a potential detachment of the display during a collision.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the fixings will be checked and fitted if necessary.

records.concern: Vauxhall Vivaro (K0) Display screws missing.
records.defect: On affected vehicles the radio display fixing screws may be missing allowing a potential detachment of the display during a collision.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the fixings will be checked and fitted if necessary.

records.concern: TB2024-0010 Caravan Chassis Torque – Rework Campaign
records.defect: The manufacturer has identified an irregularity with the calibration of the torque gun used to tighten the caravan chassis fixings during construction. This affects caravans built between 12th August 2024 and 3rd October 2024.
records.remedy: Recheck and where necessary tighten chassis fixings with a correctly calibrated torque tool. The Manufacturer will contact all registered owners and undertake the rework on their vehicles at their home address or place of storage.

records.concern: Replace Double Universal Joint (Steering)
records.defect: On affected vehicles there may have been a deviation in the production of the double universal joint on the steering column. Certain steering movements could result in the component failing.
records.remedy: Affected vehicles will have the double universal joint replaced.

records.concern: Check Driver’s Airbag for Conversion Takata SDI & PSDI-5
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have had a retrofit or conversion of the airbag using a previously recalled airbag variant which if deployed may do so with excessive force causing sharp metal fragments to be released this may cause serious injury possibly fatal to people in the vicinity. The original factory fitment airbag for the vehicle is not affected.
records.remedy: Vehicles will have the airbag checked and if necessary replaced.

records.concern: Incorrect Rear Coil Springs Installed on Certain Toyota Proace and Proace Verso
records.defect: On affected vehicles incorrect specification rear coil springs may have been installed.
records.remedy: Carry out check and replace coil springs if required.

records.concern: SRPC2415 - Sealing Ring of Exhaust Manifold
records.defect: On affected vehicles the sealing ring between the exhaust manifold and turbocharger might be missing.
records.remedy: Retrofit the sealing ring on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: ARB5 Recall Campaign - Replacing cell block module on high-voltage battery.
records.defect: On affected vehicles production issues may have occurred at the battery cell / module supplier. A short circuit within the battery modules leading to thermal events and fires cannot be ruled out.
records.remedy: Replace the affected battery module on the high-volt battery.

records.concern: Replace battery module
records.defect: Some individual cell modules of the high-voltage battery may display technical irregularities. It cannot be ruled out that the battery may overheat under certain circumstances with risk of fire and damage to persons or property.
records.remedy: Vehicles affected by this should also not be charged above 80% until further notice. Affected cell modules must be replaced during a workshop visit. The corresponding battery module must be replaced on the vehicles affected.

records.concern: Softail Brake Line Routing
records.defect: The front brake lines may contact the fuel tank due to unintended bending of the brake lines during assembly. Contact between the brake lines and the fuel tank could over time lead to a breach in a brake line and a loss of brake fluid.
records.remedy: Inspect affected machines and if required replace bent brake lines. In some cases a repair or replacement of the fuel tank may also be necessary.

records.concern: IVA required
records.defect: Affected trailers were produced and sold within the UK without any form of type approval. These trailers should have a minimum of an Individual Vehicle Approval certification.
records.remedy: Owners should contact the supplier using email address iva_dvsa@yahoo.com The supplier will then contact keepers and ask them to take the trailer to his premises and will arrange an IVA Appointment.

records.concern: The rear inlet and outlet heater coolant hoses may melt due to the diesel particulate filter overheating during regeneration
records.defect: The rear inlet and outlet heater coolant hoses may melt due to the diesel particulate filter overheating during regeneration
records.remedy: Install modified hoses.

records.concern: 24B64 - Transit Skeletal Chassis Inspection
records.defect: On affected vehicles there may be damage to a section of the vehicle’s chassis.
records.remedy: Check the vehicle chassis and if found with a defect in the areas shown the manufacturer will buy back the vehicle.

records.concern: Peugeot Rifter (K9) Front Brake Discs.
records.defect: On affected vehicles the front brake discs may not be to the required specification and may become noisy and in exceptional cases the brake disc may fail
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the front brake discs and pads will be replaced

records.concern: Citroen Berlingo (K9) Front Brake Discs.
