records.defect: On affected vehicles the front brake discs may not be to the required specification and may become noisy and in exceptional cases the brake disc may fail
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the front brake discs and pads will be replaced

records.concern: 24C22 - Transit Courier 17 tires with incorrect towing on the VIN label
records.defect: On affected vehicles there is mismatch of details between the Vehicle Identification (VIN) Label Certificate of Conformity (CoC) and vehicle registration documents with regards to towing.
records.remedy: Replace the VIN label exchange the CoC papers and help with updating registration documentation if required.

records.concern: Engine Output – Potential Loss of Drive Power
records.defect: On affected vehicles the output shaft installed may be exposed to stress concentration that could cause fatigue failure. Over time the output shaft may break resulting in a loss of drive power while driving. This can increase the risk of a crash.
records.remedy: Replace output shaft.

records.concern: Loose Motor Controller Unit (MCU) Cables
records.defect: On certain vehicles the high voltage cables on the Motor Controller Unit (MCU) can become loose.
records.remedy: Inspection of motor controller unit and its components for signs of electrical arc cable misalignment cross-threaded fasteners and general damage/wear.

records.concern: Luggage Compartment Lashing Rail ALPINA XD3
records.defect: On affected vehicles the screw connection for the luggage lashing rails may not withstand the forces in situations of a rear end impact. This may result in the lashing rail to not crumple as expected in these situations.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles the luggage lashing rail screws will be replaced along with additional washers.

records.concern: AST2267 AST2268 NST2267 NST2268
records.defect: For affected suspension wishbones the rear bush components may have been welded in an incorrect position during the manufacturing process.
records.remedy: Confirm the batch code and if required replace the wishbone.

records.concern: Citroen Relay (X250) Rear view camera.
records.defect: On affected vehicles an incorrect radio may be fitted that does not provide rear view camera functionality to comply with regulatory requirements.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the radio will be replaced

records.concern: Kia Picanto ISLA Upgrade
records.defect: The Intelligent Speed Limit Assist (ISLA) system may not function properly due to an incorrect software version of the instrument cluster and the ISLA camera coding partially missing. As a result there may be no audible or visual warning on the dashboard when the speed limit is exceeded. Without this system the vehicle may not meet EU ISA legislation.
records.remedy: Update the Cluster software and the front camera ISLA coding.

records.concern: Oil supply failure on left side engine cover
records.defect: On affected motorcycles the left side of the engine may have insufficient oil supply. Do not ride motorcycle any further until checked and engine replaced if necessary.
records.remedy: On affected motorcycles remove left side engine cover and inspect oil galleries for blockage.

records.concern: Rearview camera visibility
records.defect: On affected vehicles the rearview camera may not display an image when reverse is selected.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the radio software will be updated to rectify issue

records.concern: Rearview camera visibility
records.defect: On affected vehicles the rearview camera may not display an image when reverse is selected.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the radio software will be updated to rectify issue

records.concern: Anti-lock brake system module
records.defect: Affected vehicles may experience an Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS) module software malfunction which can disable the Electronic Stability Control (ESC) system. Failure of the ESC system can in certain driving conditions cause a vehicle crash without prior warning.
records.remedy: Install modified software to the ABS control module.

records.concern: Anti-lock brake system module
records.defect: Affected vehicles may experience an Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS) module software malfunction which can disable the Electronic Stability Control (ESC) system. Failure of the ESC system can in certain driving conditions cause a vehicle crash without prior warning.
records.remedy: Install modified software to the ABS control module.

records.concern: Replacing brake hoses
records.defect: On affected vehicles cracks may occur on the brake hoses on the front axle over time resulting in brake fluid escaping.
records.remedy: Replace the front axle brake hoses.

records.concern: High voltage emergency shutdown can be overridden by intelligent charging
records.defect: On affected vehicles the high voltage emergency shutdown can be overridden by intelligent charging when low voltage batteries state of charge drops below a specific level.
records.remedy: Update drive module software and dashboard display software

records.concern: Vauxhall Corsa D Passenger Airbag
records.defect: On affected vehicles the passenger front airbag may not deploy properly in the event of a collision.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles the passenger front air bag will be replaced.

records.concern: Citroen Relay (X250) Wrong weight values on manufacturer plate
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have been fitted with a metal Manufacturer plate located in the engine compartment that shows the wrong weight values. This can lead to a non-compliance to regulatory requirements.
records.remedy: Check and replace the metal Manufacturer plate.

records.concern: Peugeot Boxer (X250) Wrong weight values on Manufacturer Plate
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have been fitted with a metal Manufacturer plate located in the engine compartment that shows the wrong weight values. This can lead to a non-compliance to regulatory requirements.
records.remedy: Check and replace the metal Manufacturer plate.

records.concern: 24C28 - Transit Courier – Front right seat built with incorrect side airbag
records.defect: Affected vehicles have been fitted with an incorrect side airbag on the front right seat. There is no significant increase in severity of harm. In the case of a side impact airbag performance still meets ECE135 and ECE95 requirements.
records.remedy: Replace the front right-side airbag.

records.concern: Replace the Passenger Airbag
records.defect: On certain vehicles the passenger airbag may not have had the seam sewn according to the specifications.
records.remedy: Replacement of the passenger airbag

records.concern: Control unit for reverser
records.defect: On affected vehicles the reverser control unit may be insufficiently sealed allowing moisture to lead to corrosion of the internal electrical contacts.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles the reverser control unit will be permanently disconnected as an intermediate measure. The control unit will then be replaced by an improved part once available.

records.concern: Improper programming of transmission shift control system
records.defect: On affected machines there is a risk that the motorcycle may shift to neutral when the rider attempts to shift from 1st to 2nd gear due to improper programming of the shift control system.
records.remedy: Update the shift control system with modified software.

records.concern: SRL240710 - LEIT-SCHEU Check wiring harness routing
records.defect: The retrofitted DVS camera / sensor wiring harness along the chassis/cab frame may have been carried out incorrectly. As a result of an incorrectly installed DVS retrofitting scorching damage could occur in the area of the transition from the frame to the cab (swan neck) due to chafing of the wires. Depending on the nature of the damage / or level of chafing the possibility of a vehicle fire cannot be ruled out.
records.remedy: As part of the planned field measure we will check the DVS retrofit was carried out on behalf of DTUK as to whether the retrofitting of the cables was carried out in accordance with the specifications in WIS and the Bodybuilder Guideline and therefore if the chassis/cab frame wiring harness is still routed correctly.

records.concern: Luggage Compartment Lashing Rail G01 F97
records.defect: On affected vehicles the screw connection for the luggage lashing rails may not withstand the forces in situations of a rear end impact. This may result in the lashing rail to not crumple as expected in these situations.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles the luggage lashing rail screws will be replaced along with additional washers.

records.concern: DS3 Crossback Steering Gear Pinion
records.defect: On affected vehicles the steering rack fitted may not conform to specification and result in an increased force to rotate the steering wheel.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the steering rack will be replaced.

records.concern: Vauxhall Mokka Steering Gear Pinion.
records.defect: On affected vehicles the steering rack fitted may not conform to specification and result in an increased force to rotate the steering wheel.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the steering rack will be replaced.

records.concern: Leaking of GYTR racing fuel cap
records.defect: On affected motorcycles when the GYTR Racing Fuel Cap is installed there is a possibility that a small amount of gasoline leaks out of the fuel cap resulting in a risk of fire.
records.remedy: On the motorcycles fitted with the affected GYTR racing fuel cap the parts will be reworked using a modification kit

records.concern: Natural gas system leak test
records.defect: On Crafter “Grand California” vehicles of a limited production period there is a possibility that the leak test of the natural gas system was not correctly carried out. Leaks from the natural gas system cannot be ruled out.
records.remedy: On all affected vehicles a leak test of the natural gas system must be performed and if unsuccessful necessary repairs completed. After the repair the leak test of the natural gas system must be carried out again.

records.concern: Fiat 600 Steering gear pinion safety recall
records.defect: On affected vehicles the steering rack fitted may not conform to specification and result in an increased force to rotate the steering wheel.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the steering rack will be replaced

records.concern: RA-03-1973 – Oil Cooler Hoses
records.defect: On affected vehicles the oil hoses for the engine oil cooler may be prone to split with a resulting loss of oil and oil pressure.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the oil cooler hoses will be replaced

records.concern: High-Voltage Battery Cell Module J01 J05
records.defect: On affected vehicles a cell module may not have been manufactured to specification. In the worst case this may lead to a short circuit which may result in a vehicle fire.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles the defective cell module will be replaced. The affected vehicles must not have their batteries charged until rectified.

records.concern: 2024 FL Regulator Wiring
records.defect: The regulator output wire may rub against the crankcase which could cause a short circuit and the main fuse may fail. This would result in a loss of all electrical power including all lighting. This will affect propulsion and visibility.
records.remedy: Inspect wiring and either secure or repair depending on inspection outcome.

records.concern: The main floor wiring harness could become damaged due to contact with the second-row bench seat folding hinge assembly. This may result in a malfunction of the supplemental restraint system.
records.defect: Some Santa Fe (MX5) vehicles may experience the main floor wiring harness becoming damaged due to contact with the second-row bench seat folding hinge assembly.
records.remedy: The affected vehicles will be inspected and the main wiring harness will be secured and routed as specified within the Technical Service Bulletin. In the event the main wiring harness is damaged the main floor wire harness will be replaced

records.concern: ID.Buzz Cargo Shelf system strength Properties
records.defect: On affected vehicles the cargo shelf in the luggage compartment may become loose and penetrate into the passenger compartment presenting a risk of injury.
records.remedy: Remove the old rack with a new one to be built by the shelf system manufacturer.

records.concern: Integrated Braking System
records.defect: On certain vehicles the Integrated Brake (IB) system may be impaired due to contamination between electrical contacts.
records.remedy: Vehicles that may be affected by contamination are required to have the vehicle’s software updated which can detect signal interference before it occurs. If symptoms are detected you should refrain from use of the vehicle and the affected Integrated Brake (IB) system component will be replaced.

records.concern: Integrated Braking System
records.defect: On certain vehicles the Integrated Brake (IB) system may be impaired due to contamination between electrical contacts.
records.remedy: Vehicles that may be affected by contamination are required to have the vehicle’s software updated which can detect signal interference before it occurs. If symptoms are detected you should refrain from use of the vehicle and the affected Integrated Brake (IB) system component will be replaced.

records.concern: PS2 Seat Bolts
records.defect: On affected vehicles it has been identified that the four bolts on the left front seat may not have been torqued correctly at the factory.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles Inspection the torque of all four bolts will be carried out and if necessary adjust the torque to the correct specification.

records.concern: 24C24 - Transit Custom - Side window automatic reversal system / Compliance recall
records.defect: On affected vehicles there is potentially an issue with the window automatic reversal system (bounce back system). Under certain circumstances a closing window could exert a force of over 100N.
records.remedy: Update driver and passenger door modules software.

records.concern: Integrated Brake Module
records.defect: On affected vehicles the Intergrated Brake System module may experience an electronic signal interference which may reduce braking power.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles the Intergrated Brake System Module will be replaced.

records.concern: Fiat Ducato 2024. Proxy update. Vehicle does not comply to emission regulatory requirements
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have the urea system management menu missing from the instrument panel. This may result in warning messages not being displayed on the instrument panel cluster depending on the urea level. In this condition the vehicle does not comply to emission regulatory requirements.
records.remedy: Check and if necessary install modified software.

records.concern: 2023-2024 RAM 1500 Pickup steering column control module (SCCM) internal failure
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have a Steering Column Control Module (SCCM) that may have been built with an insufficient weld between an internal flexible flat cable (FFC) and busbar. This may prevent deployment of the driver airbag resulting in increased risk of injury to the driver in a crash.
records.remedy: Inspect and if necessary replace the Steering Column Control Module.

records.concern: 2023 Jeep Wrangler steering column control module (SCCM) internal failure
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have a Steering Column Control Module (SCCM) that may have been built with an insufficient weld between an internal flexible flat cable (FFC) and busbar. This may prevent deployment of the driver airbag resulting in increased risk of injury to the driver in a crash
records.remedy: Inspect and if necessary replace the Steering Column Control Module.

records.concern: 2023 Jeep Grand Cherokee steering column control module (SCCM) internal failure
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have a Steering Column Control Module (SCCM) that may have been built with an insufficient weld between an internal flexible flat cable (FFC) and busbar. This may prevent deployment of the driver airbag resulting in increased risk of injury to the driver in a crash
records.remedy: Inspect and if necessary replace the Steering Column Control Module.

records.concern: Fiat Scudo Rear suspension springs
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have been equipped with the incorrect rear springs which can result in impaired driving behaviour when fully loaded or a risk of rear spring detachment in a worst-case scenario when empty.
records.remedy: Replace both rear springs.

records.concern: 24S57 Transit Rear hub bearing
records.defect: Affected vehicles may experience a lack of lubrication to the rear wheel bearings leading to premature failure.
records.remedy: Check of vehicles current mileage and where necessary inspect bearing to ensure full lubrication with parts replaced as necessary.

records.concern: Track rod ball joint and wishbone bolted connection
records.defect: On certain vehicles there is a possibility that on one side of the front axle the bolted connection of the track rod ball joint and the wishbone were incorrectly carried out.
records.remedy: The bolted connection of the track rod ball joint on the wheel bearing housing and the wishbone on the swivel joint will be checked and if necessary the nuts are replaced.

records.concern: A potential safety defect has been identified which could occur within the ABS control unit. The ABS control unit within the affected VIN range could experience an electrical short circuit.
records.defect: On affected vehicles the HECU (Hydraulic Electronic Control Unit) for the ABS could experience an electrical short circuit with a potential that the malfunction indicator light may become illuminated (MIL and /or ABS light) and a burning smell may emanate from the engine compartment and the HECU components.
records.remedy: The affected vehicles will have a low-capacity fuse installed within the engine compartment junction box

records.concern: Clutch Dragging
records.defect: On affected vehicles clutch dragging may occur which could cause the vehicle to creep forward even when the clutch lever is fully depressed.
records.remedy: Affected vehicles will have the clutch and engine oil replaced.

records.concern: Replacing brake servo
records.defect: On certain Audi e-tron vehicles the bolted connection between the brake pedal and brake servo might not be properly secured. If it loosens the mechanical link between the foot brake and brake servo could fail. In such cases braking would only be possible using the controlled emergency braking function by holding the parking brake button on the centre console (see Owner’s Manual).
records.remedy: For safety reasons the brake servo must be replaced on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: Brake line bolted connection
records.defect: On Caddy vehicles of a limited production period a fault when tightening the rear left brake line can cause leaks from the brake hose connection. A leak can lead to a gradual loss of brake fluid. The resulting too low brake fluid level is shown with the illumination of a warning lamp or display in instrument cluster. The loss of brake fluid level can adversely affect the braking performance.
records.remedy: The affected rear left brake line bolted connection at the connection to the brake hose must be checked and modified.

records.concern: Programming Control Units (SME)
records.defect: For certain vehicles there is a software update available to improve the management of the high voltage battery in the event of an insulation fault.
records.remedy: The battery management control software will be updated.

records.concern: Replace labels
records.defect: On affected vehicles the Type Plate may contain incorrectly printed information or has information missing.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles the Type Plate will be replaced.

records.concern: Reworking Vario Top case latch
records.defect: On motorcycles fitted with the accessory Vario top cases it is possible the case is not securely locked to the motorcycle and may detach.
records.remedy: On the affected Vario top cases the latch mechanism will be reworked and the customer operating instructions updated.

records.concern: 295/30ZR22 (103Y) and 315/30ZR22 (107Y) GOODYEAR EAGLE F1 SUPERSPORT
records.defect: A small number of 295/30ZR22 (103Y) and 315/30ZR22 (107Y) tyres are subject to a manufacturing variation and are susceptible to experiencing tread deformation or crown separation when running at high speed possibly leading to a loss of control of the vehicle.
records.remedy: All the dealers who may have received tyres in scope will be contacted. If they have already sold tyres we ask them to contact their customers to whom they have sold tyres. All the tyres with DOT code 1L1K8 JB1R 1224 and 1L1HA JC1R 1224 will be exchanged free of charge.

records.concern: Engine fuel pipe check/replace
records.defect: On affected vehicles there is risk that a fuel hose may chafe against a wiring harness resulting in fuel leakage onto the engine which might cause smell of fuel inside the cabin excessive fuel consumption and a risk of a thermal event in the engine compartment.
records.remedy: Check fuel hose and replace if necessary and install a retainer.

records.concern: Kia EV9 and Niro SG2 Gear Drive Unit Recall
records.defect: On affected vehicles due to Improper torque applied to the Gear Drive Unit during assembly by the differential gear supplier they may exhibit a grinding noise while driving which can result in a loss of motive power and/or cause the differential to lock up.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the Gear Drive Unit will be replaced.

records.concern: 24S29 - Transit Connect Panoramic Roof
records.defect: Transit Connect vehicles fitted with glass panoramic roofs may be subject to wind noise water leak and in rare cases separation from the vehicle.
records.remedy: Remove and re-install glass roof.

records.concern: Seat Belt Buckle Bracket Improper Weld
records.defect: On affected vehicles the passenger seat belt mount for the buckle may not be properly welded. This could result in the anchor point separating from the frame.
records.remedy: Affected vehicles will be checked and if required a new seat belt crossbar will be fitted.

records.concern: FUEL PUMP FLANGE OUTLET LEAK
records.defect: Affected 2023-2024 model year Polaris Sportsman 850 XP 1000 and XP 1000 S ATVs may experience a fuel leak at the fuel pump flange outlet.
records.remedy: Replacement of the fuel pump and a PFA cover and jumper harness will be installed.

records.concern: LiveWire S2 Del Mar High Voltage Fuse Recall
records.defect: On affected machines the high voltage fuse on the MY24 LiveWire S2 Del Mar electric motorcycle may open under certain riding conditions resulting in a loss of propulsion.
records.remedy: Installation of a higher voltage fuse.

records.concern: Handpole Casting failure
records.defect: On affected vehicles the hand pole fixing bracket/casting at the celling may fracture and break free resulting in the potential risk of passenger fall and injury when using the hand pole.
records.remedy: Remedy is to replace the current hand pole casting with the previous design casting which can handle more force.

records.concern: Kia Picanto EGR Valve
records.defect: On affected vehicles a short circuit inside the EGR (Exhaust Gas Circulation) valve may occur potentially causing the engine to stall before a warning light is displayed.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the EGR Valve will be replaced.

records.concern: 2024 Jeep Renegade and Compass PHEV 12V cable connection
records.defect: On certain vehicles the under-seat intermediate connection or the rear connection to the Integrated Dual Charging Module (IDCM) may not be tightened to the proper torque which may cause overheating of the terminal with risk of thermal incident to surrounding parts.
records.remedy: Check the conformity of the fastener torque on the 12V cable connection and if required replacement of the cable.

records.concern: Jeep Wrangler 2016 (JK) Airbag clockspring
records.defect: On certain vehicles the steering wheel airbag clock spring may have been built with a design that can allow dust or dirt to enter the mechanism when exposed to certain environmental conditions.
records.remedy: Replacement of the steering wheel airbag clock spring.

records.concern: Starter Motor Cable
records.defect: On affected vehicles there is a risk that heat from the exhaust Turbo may cause the rubber protection cap covering the power feed cable terminal to the starter motor solenoid to heat up and ignite with a risk of fire.
records.remedy: Remove the rubber protection cap and if necessary replace the heat shield.

records.concern: Anti Roll Bar C Clamp Crack
records.defect: On affected vehicles the C Clamp supporting the anti-roll bar may deform and shear at the upper mounting face resulting in increased body roll.
records.remedy: Replace Anti-roll bar C clamps with redesigned clamp.

records.concern: Jaguar E-PACE Inappropriate Passenger Airbag Deployment
records.defect: On affected vehicles during a passenger airbag deployment the airbag may tear as a result of the facia airbag deployment door panel not being sufficiently weakened.
records.remedy: Vehicles will have the passenger airbag module and associated components replaced.

records.concern: TGL TGM TGS TGX: The 24V sockets in the instrument panel can overheat.
records.defect: On affected vehicles an incorrect build-up of heat in the 24-volt socket installed in the instrument panel may be produced. This may result in functional impairments and damage due to heat development resulting in a fire.
records.remedy: Check and replace the 24-volt socket.

records.concern: SRPC2410 – Bolting Connection Pre-Fuse Box
records.defect: On affected vehicles the bolting of an electrical wire on the pre-fuse box in the passenger-side footwell might have not been tightened with sufficient torque.
records.remedy: Check the bolting connection of the wiring harness to the pre-fuse box and repair if necessary.

records.concern: Ariya (FE0) Traction Motor
records.defect: On affected vehicles an oil seal within the traction motor may leak causing a malfunction resulting in the traction motor going into failsafe and traction torque reducing to zero.
records.remedy: Replace the traction motor.

records.concern: Heavyweight Shock Pushrod
records.defect: On affected machines the rear suspension pushrod may buckle under load.
records.remedy: Replacement of the rear suspension pushrod.

records.concern: KA1 Starter Relay
records.defect: On affected vehicles it cannot be excluded that the improved starter relay has been mechanically damaged during installation.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles the starter relay will be replaced.

records.concern: SRPC2413 - Screw connections of 12 V and 48 V ground points
records.defect: On affected vehicles the bolts of certain 12V and 48V ground connections might be fastened with an insufficient torque.
records.remedy: Check connections and repair if necessary.

records.concern: Engine Starter Motor / DME Software Update
records.defect: On affected vehicles the starter motor may be overloaded due to repeated lengthy attempts to start the engine as the software based overload protection is not sufficient.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles improved software will be installed on the DME (engine starter motor electronics control unit)

records.concern: Replace spring U-bolts of rear axle springs
records.defect: On affected vehicles the spring U-bolts may not have been subject to treatment to increase their hardness which may lead to them fracturing.
records.remedy: Replace the spring U-bolts on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: Replacing TAKATA driver airbag
records.defect: On imported Audi vehicles previously used in a warm climate zone and fitted with TAKATA driver airbag manufactured within a specific period it is possible that the gas generator housing may cause small metal parts to become dislodged from the housing and potentially injure the driver or a passenger.
records.remedy: As a precautionary safety measure it is necessary to replace the gas generator in the airbag unit on the driver side of the vehicle.

records.concern: Seat Base and Battery Contact
records.defect: On affected vehicles the red battery terminal cover can be damaged if the seat is not correctly mounted. A damaged or an improperly seated battery terminal cover may result in an exposed positive (+) battery post.
records.remedy: Verify the condition and if necessary replace the red terminal cover.

records.concern: Camera Replacement on Multiple Models
records.defect: Due to insufficient laser welding of the camera case at the supplier during a specific production period there is a possibility that the camera case may separate when exposed to external stress over time allowing water to leak into the camera. If this occurs the circuit inside the camera can short leading to an inability to display an image of the area in front of and/or behind the vehicle.
records.remedy: Inspect camera and replace if necessary.

records.concern: Camera Replacement on Multiple Models
records.defect: Due to insufficient laser welding of the camera case at the supplier during a specific production period there is a possibility that the camera case may separate when exposed to external stress over time allowing water to leak into the camera. If this occurs the circuit inside the camera can short leading to an inability to display an image of the area in front of and/or behind the vehicle.
records.remedy: Inspect camera and replace if necessary

records.concern: Kia Stinger Oil Feed Pipe Leak
records.defect: On affected vehicles due to exposure to radiant heat from the exhaust manifold the turbocharger oil feed pipe and hose assembly may deteriorate over time this could cause an oil leak.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles the turbocharger oil feed pipe and hose assembly will be replaced.

records.concern: EM40 & EM55 Control panel connector failing
records.defect: On affected vehicles the EM40 and EM55 vehicle battery ‘in’ (VB IN) connector can overheat and in certain circumstances fail losing all power to the unit with the possible loss of all rear road lights.
records.remedy: Keepers of affected vehicles should contact their supplying dealer or any NCC approved workshop for the replacement of the affected unit. Until rectification has been completed the manufacturer advise the refrigerator is turned ‘off’ whilst driving.

records.concern: VARIO SIDE CASE – CUSTOMER NOTIFICATION FOR CONTINUED USAGE
records.defect: On motorcycles fitted with the accessory Vario side cases it is possible the locking catches for the lid do not engage and the lid is not securely locked. In this circumstance the lid may come open during use.
records.remedy: On the affected motorcycles additional safety measures and a warning label will be fitted to allow continued use and once available the affected boxes will be replaced.

records.concern: Citroen Dispatch (K0) Rear Springs
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have been equipped with the incorrect rear springs which can result in impaired driving behaviour when fully loaded or a risk of rear spring detachment in a worst-case scenario when empty.
records.remedy: Replace both rear springs.

records.concern: Peugeot Expert (K0) Rear Springs
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have been equipped with the incorrect rear springs which can result in impaired driving behaviour when fully loaded or a risk of rear spring detachment in a worst-case scenario when empty.
records.remedy: Replace both rear springs.

records.concern: Vauxhall Vivaro (K0) Rear Springs
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have been equipped with the incorrect rear springs which can result in impaired driving behaviour when fully loaded or a risk of rear spring detachment in a worst-case scenario when empty.
records.remedy: Replace both rear springs.

records.concern: Revuelto Fuel Feed Line Quick Connectors
records.defect: On certain vehicles the hose fitted onto the quick connector of the fuel feed line may not have been assembled to manufacturing specification and may become loose while operating under pressure.
records.remedy: Replacement of the fuel feed lines.

records.concern: LSS & TSS 3.0 Forward Recognition Camera on Multiple Models
records.defect: Due to the programming of the forward recognition camera software there is a possibility that the memory inside the forward recognition camera could fail during processing when the ignition is turned OFF. If this occurs the PCS will not activate on the next ignition start causing warning lights to illuminate audible chimes to sound and messages to display on the instrument panel.
records.remedy: Reprogram the Forward Recognition Camera

records.concern: LSS & TSS 3.0 Forward Recognition Camera on Multiple Models
records.defect: Due to the programming of the forward recognition camera software there is a possibility that the memory inside the forward recognition camera could fail during processing when the ignition is turned OFF. If this occurs the PCS will not activate on the next ignition start causing warning lights to illuminate audible chimes to sound and messages to display on the instrument panel.
records.remedy: Reprogram the Forward Recognition Camera.

records.concern: ARB2 - Replacing upper trailing arm on the front axle
records.defect: On affected vehicles there’s a possibility the upper trailing arms on the nearside front axle do not meet required specifications. If this is the case the trailing arm may break.
records.remedy: Replace the nearside upper trailing arm on the front axle.

records.concern: Transmission Control Module (TCM) software concern
records.defect: On affected vehicles a fault relating to the software that controls the engine / electric motor clutch may prevent the clutch from re-engaging after braking is carried out.
records.remedy: Update the Transmission Control Module with revised software.

records.concern: SRPC2341 - Housing of the rear axle transmission
records.defect: On affected vehicles the housing of the rear axle transmission might not meet the strength requirements.
records.remedy: Replace axle centrepiece of rear axle.

records.concern: Risk of Product becoming detached from trailer
records.defect: On certain trailers the welds are breaking allowing the unit to move resulting in the inserts being pulled freeing the unit from its mountings. Or the inserts are pulling out loosening the remaining fasteners and freeing the unit from its mountings.
records.remedy: Inspect and if necessary modify the trailer's fittings and fixtures.

records.concern: Risk of Product becoming detached from trailer
records.defect: On certain trailers the welds are breaking allowing the unit to move resulting in the inserts being pulled freeing the unit from its mountings. Or the inserts are pulling out loosening the remaining fasteners and freeing the unit from its mountings.
records.remedy: Inspect and if necessary modify the trailer's fittings and fixtures.

records.concern: Checking the Seat Mechanism of the Left Front Seat U11
records.defect: On affected vehicles the seat mechanism of the front left seat may not have been manufactured within accordance to specifications It is possible that an incorrectly sized rivet was used during production. As a result the mechanism may fail in the event of an accident.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles the front left seat mechanism will be checked and if necessary replaced.

records.concern: ARB3 – Checking position of rear three-point seat belt and reworking if necessary
records.defect: On affected vehicles it is possible that the three-point belts of the rear seat belt system were not fitted according to the specifications. If this is the case the restraint function for passengers in the rear left and right seats is not guaranteed in the event of full braking or an accident.
records.remedy: Check routing of the belt straps of the rear three-point belts and correct routing depending on the check result.

records.concern: Possible abrasion wear of the fuel supply pipe
records.defect: On affected vehicles there is a possibility of abrasive wear of the fuel supply line. This can cause one or several possible effects: Fuel odour in the passenger compartment High fuel consumption Fuel leak in the engine compartment visible under the vehicle Risk of fire.
records.remedy: Check the fuel pipe and replace if required. All affected vehicles will be fitted with a mounting clip to protect the fuel pipe.

records.concern: DL800DE Genuine Rear Tyre Recall
records.defect: On affected motorcycles the rear tyre can develop cracking or other deformation of the tyre tread under higher-speed operation conditions. In the worst case under continued use portions of the tyre tread may separate from the tyre structure and impact overall motorcycle dynamics.
records.remedy: Replace the rear tyre

records.concern: Peugeot 208- Evaporation test results on EB2FA engines.
records.defect: Affected vehicles may exceed regulatory emission standards.
records.remedy: Replace the canister purge valve (CPV) and or fuel line.

records.concern: Vauxhall Corsa F- Evaporation test results on EB2FA engines.
records.defect: Affected vehicles may exceed regulatory emission standards
records.remedy: Replace the canister purge valve (CPV) and or fuel line.

records.concern: ECM and DCU Software update
records.defect: Affected vehicles fitted with 1.9 RZ4E engines may under very specific driving conditions experience engine management control that may result in temporary emission irregularities.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles an update to the Engine Management Control unit software will be carried out

records.concern: Ranger Idler Gear Failure
records.defect: A small number of Ranger vehicles that have been manufactured with an incorrectly assembled engine idler gear. An improperly installed engine idler gear may cause an engine stall with sudden loss of power whilst driving increasing the risk of crash or injury. A noise is typically observed from the engine in advance. In the event of a failure the vehicle will stall and/or not start.
records.remedy: Replace Idler assembly

records.concern: The rear inner driveshaft may develop noise resulting in a loss of drive
records.defect: On affected vehicles the rear inner driveshaft may develop noise resulting in a loss of drive.
records.remedy: On all affected vehicles replace the affected driveshaft and check properly fastened

records.concern: The Integrated Charging Control Unit (ICCU) may become defective and stop charging the 12-volt battery which can result in the vehicle entering into a ‘failsafe’ driving mode.
records.defect: On affected vehicles the Integrated Charging Control Unit (ICCU) may be come defective and stop charging the 12volt battery this can result in the vehicle entering a failsafe driving mode
records.remedy: On all affected vehicles update the ICCU software and check and replace if necessary the ICCU and fuse.

records.concern: Replacing front suspension link
records.defect: A suspension link on the front axle that has invisible cracks may have been fitted to your vehicle. This possible damage means the service life of the suspension link can no longer be guaranteed and the component may fail. A failure particularly at higher speeds may result in vehicle behaviour that is difficult to control.
records.remedy: For safety reasons it is necessary to replace the front upper left suspension link

records.concern: 2024 Model Year Range Rover and Range Rover Sport Loss of Drive
records.defect: For affected vehicles the clutch plates within the hybrid transmission may have been manufactured with a flatness out of tolerance to the engineering specification.
records.remedy: Diagnostic test to determine whether the clutch packs within the transmission are operating as expected. Any transmissions which fail the test will be replaced.

records.concern: 24C21 – Focus Passenger Beltminder Chime
records.defect: While monitoring vehicles in operation we have identified a number of Focus vehicles where the passenger belt minder chime is not activated when the vehicle goes over 15 mph. Regulatory requirements mandate that an audible chime must activate when the first-row passenger seatbelt is unfastened and the vehicle speed exceeds 15 mph.
records.remedy: Update the instrument panel cluster IPC configuration.

records.concern: Drivers side front airbag
records.defect: On affected vehicles a deterioration of the driver airbag propellant could occur. In the event of an accident and the activation of the driver airbag fragments of the generator housing could become detached and injure the vehicle occupants.
records.remedy: The driver side front airbag gas generator must be replaced in all affected vehicles.

records.concern: SRPC2411 – Parameter Data Set of Airbag Control Unit
records.defect: On affected vehicles the airbag control unit may not correspond to specifications. In the event of an accident the active bonnet may not be triggered.
records.remedy: Update the airbag control unit software.

records.concern: Brake line botled connection
records.defect: On affected vehicles a fault when tightening the rear left brake line can cause leaks from the brake hose connection leading to a gradual loss of brake fluid.
records.remedy: Check and secure the affected connection. Replace affected parts if leaking.

records.concern: C0390 FAS parameter update FH FM FHE FME 4
records.defect: There is a risk that the warnings and deactivation when the driver is not holding the steering wheel that is mandatory according to legal requirements do not occur when using the Pilot Assist System.
records.remedy: Update software to the latest level.

records.concern: SRT 360 - Software update for Forward Recognition Camera
records.defect: On affected vehicles a programming issue within the forward recognition camera system could potentially result in memory failure during processing and the Pre Collision Systems (PCS) not activating on the next ignition cycle with audible chimes and visual warning lights and messages displayed on the instrument panel.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles the forward recognition camera system will be reprogrammed

records.concern: Q50 (V37) M30/Q70 (Y51) Propeller Shaft
records.defect: On affected vehicles the propeller shaft does not meet Nissans' fatigue strength standards.
records.remedy: Replace the propeller shaft on affected vehicles.

records.concern: 24C18 Puma - Instrument panel cluster (IPC) software update -- Compliance recall
records.defect: Puma vehicles that might have an intermittent instrument panel cluster display issue due to an incorrect software configuration. If this happens the cluster will turn black when turning the ignition on or while driving. The Ford dealer will update the Instrument Panel Cluster (IPC).
records.remedy: Update the instrument panel cluster (IPC) software to the latest level.

records.concern: Check High-Voltage Battery F56 BEV
records.defect: On affected vehicles the seal on the high voltage battery housing may allow moisture to penetrate the battery and allow a fault to develop resulting in a check control message being displayed in some cases the High Voltage battery could switch off even when driving.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the seal will be checked and if required replace any faulty components.

records.concern: Replacing the Backrest Frame of the Front Left Seat
records.defect: On affected vehicles the welding of the recliner adjustment on the backrest of the left front seat may not have been performed to specification potentially resulting in insufficient locking of the backrest.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the Left front seat backrest will be replaced.

records.concern: Takata front passenger airbag
records.defect: On affected vehicles with passenger airbags from the manufacturer Takata in the event of an accident with airbag activation the passenger airbag gas generator housing may burst and produce fragments.
records.remedy: : Replace the passenger’s airbag on affected vehicles.

records.concern: ARB0 - Replacing brake hose on the left and right front axle
records.defect: On affected vehicles brake hoses were installed on the left and right of the front axle that were designed with too small a bending radius. Over time and under certain conditions this can lead to material fatigue and a defect in the brake hose.
records.remedy: Replace the front axle brake hoses.

records.concern: DS DS7 Crossback PHEV Traction Battery
records.defect: On affected vehicles there is a fault in the High Voltage (HV) Battery which could potentially lead to a breakdown charging issue and/or overheating and in a worst-case scenario a High Voltage Battery or vehicle fire.
records.remedy: Replace the High Voltage Battery.

records.concern: Citroen C5 Aircross PHEV Traction Battery
records.defect: On affected vehicles there is a fault in the High Voltage (HV) Battery which could potentially lead to a breakdown charging issue and/or overheating and in a worst-case scenario a High Voltage Battery or vehicle fire.
records.remedy: Replace the High Voltage Battery.

records.concern: Peugeot 3008508 PHEV. Traction Battery
records.defect: On affected vehicles there is a fault in the High Voltage (HV) Battery which could potentially lead to a breakdown charging issue and/or overheating and in a worst-case scenario a High Voltage Battery or vehicle fire.
records.remedy: Replace the High Voltage Battery.

records.concern: Vauxhall Grandland PHEV Traction Battery
records.defect: On affected vehicles there is a fault in the High Voltage (HV) Battery which could potentially lead to a breakdown charging issue and/or overheating and in a worst-case scenario a High Voltage Battery or vehicle fire.
records.remedy: Replace the High Voltage Battery.

records.concern: Owners Manual G05
records.defect: On affected vehicles in the owner’s manual the maximum permissible limits of the vehicle regarding weight data/additional load values that are specified are stated too high
records.remedy: On affected vehicles an updated insert sheet will be added to the owner’s manual.

records.concern: SRL240626 HV-BA-UESP Check high voltage batteries
records.defect: On affected vehicles the dielectric strength test for high voltage batteries in some cases was tested with too low a voltage
records.remedy: Test the battery dielectric strength with the correct voltage.

records.concern: 24S33 – Kuga 2.5L PHEV supercreep
records.defect: On affected vehicles a recent update to the Power Control Module (PCM) software could result in the vehicle shifting into neutral and coasting to a stop. The subsequent limp home mode results in unintended acceleration or 'supercreep'.
records.remedy: Update the Powertrain Control Module (PCM) software

records.concern: Front upper control arm to steering knuckle pinch bolts
records.defect: On affected vehicles the Upper Control Arm (UCA) pinch bolts may have been damaged during vehicle assembly. A damaged pinch bolt may break and result in the loss of clamp load between the UCA ball joint and the knuckle.
records.remedy: Replacement of the Upper Control Arm (UCA) pinch bolts.

records.concern: High pressure fuel pump
records.defect: On affected vehicles the high-pressure fuel pump (HPFP) may fail prematurely.
records.remedy: Replacement of the high-pressure fuel pump (HPFP) and inspection. If required replacement of additional fuel system components.

records.concern: EGIMOTORS ATV EXHAUST PIPE SPLIT
records.defect: On affected vehicles a crack can develop at the exhaust header resulting in an exhaust leak near combustible material posing a fire hazard.
records.remedy: A revised exhaust head pipe will be fitted to affected vehicles.

records.defect: The manufacturer advises DO NOT DRIVE . Affected vehicles may have a pressurised hydraulic hose fitted at the rear of the vehicle which has been compromised resulting in hydraulic fluid leakage. In rare circumstances a fire could occur.
records.remedy: All Koenigsegg Jesko hydraulic systems will now be checked and updated if needed.

records.concern: SRPC2408 - Memory Overflow Battery Management System
records.defect: On affected vehicles the software of the battery management system might lead to a shutdown of the high voltage system in specific situations resulting in an unannounced loss of propulsion.
records.remedy: Update the battery management system software.

records.concern: SRC240517 RC2405 Replacement of electrical switch for reverse gear
records.defect: On affected vehicles the reverse light switch on manual transmission may be faulty resulting in the reverse lamp and acoustic sounder not working.
records.remedy: Check serial number and replace the reverse light switch if required.

records.concern: AJ21-D4 Turbo Oil Feed Pipe Leak
records.defect: Affected vehicles have a Turbocharger oil feed pipe that may over time loosen and lead to an oil leak
records.remedy: Replace the Turbocharger oil feed pipe O-rings and install an additional clamp.

records.concern: C0367 HPCU SW UPDATE FHE FME4
records.defect: There is a risk that some screw joints inside the traction voltage batteries might not have been tightened according to our assembly process.
records.remedy: Update a software that can detect potential loose screw joints. It will then disconnect the suspect battery and prevent any incident.

records.concern: Longitudinal Chassis Beam
records.defect: On affected vehicles during production excessive force may have been applied to the rear left hand side chassis longitudinal beam which could lead to it cracking and affecting its structural strength.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles the rear left hand side chassis longitudinal beam will be checked and if necessary replaced.

records.concern: Checking brake lines
records.defect: On affected vehicles the bolts for the brake pressure lines may have been tightened too far. In such cases the bolted connection may fail resulting in brake fluid escaping.
records.remedy: Check the bolted connection and replace the brake pressure lines if required.

records.concern: Power cable chafing
records.defect: On affected vehicles power cables may chafe on the edge of an encapsulation plate due to edge protecting material might not have been correctly installed resulting in a potential risk of a short circuit and a consequential risk of a thermal event.
records.remedy: Check and adjust cable routing as necessary add rubber protection moulding as required.

records.concern: Focus Lane Centering Assist Software Update
records.defect: A number of Focus vehicles have been identified where the warning chimes may not be operating as intended. The chimes may not be audible when the driver is not holding the steering wheel for longer than 30 seconds while using Lane Centering Assist which does not meet ECE regulations.
records.remedy: Updating software in control unit.

records.concern: SCR (Selective Catalytic Reduction) Diagnosis issues
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have been equipped with Engine Control Unit (ECU) software not fulfilling regulation requirements.
records.remedy: Update to the ECU software.

records.concern: Kia Stinger High Pressure Fuel Pump Recall
records.defect: On affected vehicles misalignment of the fuel control valve plunger in the high pressure fuel pump can result in uneven wear. This may potentially result in loss of motive power and in some cases the check engine light may illuminate.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles the control software will be updated the high pressure fuel pump will be checked and if necessary replaced.

records.concern: Integrated Braking System
records.defect: On affected vehicles an unexpected loss of hydraulic brake assistance may occur and may result in a different pedal behaviour under specific conditions an extended braking distance may be experienced and ABS/Stability control may be impaired
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the Integrated Brake System will be replaced

records.concern: Juke (F16) Qashqai (J12) and Leaf (ZE1) VIN Scan
records.defect: On affected vehicles the VIN stored in the vehicle system may not match the actual VIN of the vehicle. This may lead to a situation where a vehicle user can see information related to a different vehicle resulting in a data security breach.
records.remedy: Replace the navigation display / control unit and the telematics control unit.

records.concern: Audio Head Unit Replacement on Certain Aygo X
records.defect: Affected vehicles are equipped with an audio head unit which has map data and speed limit information which are used as an input for the ISA (Intelligent Speed Assistance). Due to inappropriate software there is a possibility that the audio head unit display turns black and the unit stops working. If this condition occurs the rear camera image is not displayed during reverse manoeuvres and the ISA function does not work. As a result the vehicles do not comply with EU regulations and the risk of an accident increases.
records.remedy: Replace the audio head unit.

records.concern: AJ20-D6 and AJ20-P6 Engine Oil Filter Housing Cracked
records.defect: On affected vehicles the incorrect specification of plastic was used to manufacture the oil filter housing. This housing may over time and with vehicle use crack. This could result in oil under pressure leaking and coming into contact with hot components of the engine which may result in a fire. Additionally oil may leak onto the road surface posing a skid hazard.
records.remedy: Replace the oil filter housing complete with filter and associated O-rings.

records.concern: AJ20-D6 and AJ20-P6 Engine Oil Filter Housing Cracked
records.defect: On affected vehicles the incorrect specification of plastic was used to manufacture the oil filter housing. This housing may over time and with vehicle use crack. This could result in oil under pressure leaking and coming into contact with hot components of the engine which may result in a fire. Additionally oil may leak onto the road surface posing a skid hazard.
records.remedy: Replace the oil filter housing complete with filter and associated O-rings.

records.concern: Replace Rear Door Panel
records.defect: On affected vehicles the armrest on the rear door trim may not be secured to the correct specification which could damage side air bag during deployment
records.remedy: On affected vehicles the affected rear door trim will be replaced

records.concern: High voltage emergency shutdown can be overridden by intelligent charging
records.defect: On affected vehicles the high voltage emergency shutdown can be overridden by intelligent charging when low voltage batteries state of charge drops below a specific level.
records.remedy: Update drive module software and dashboard display software.

records.concern: Jeep Cherokee 2014-2014 Power liftgate module
records.defect: On affected vehicles the power liftgate control module may experience a short circuit. An electrical short in the power liftgate module may lead to a vehicle fire with the ignition on or off.
records.remedy: Relocate the power liftgate module to the D Pillar and install water barrier/curtain

records.concern: Ground connections
records.defect: On affected vehicles there could be a loss of certain ground connections for some electrical harnesses which may result in the loss of several vehicle functions.
records.remedy: Check and re-tighten the ground connections.

records.concern: High pressure fuel pump
records.defect: On affected vehicles the high-pressure fuel pump (HPFP) may fail prematurely.
records.remedy: Replacement of the high-pressure fuel pump (HPFP) and inspection. If required replacement of additional fuel system components.

records.concern: Malfunctioning Steering Column Control Module (SCCM)
records.defect: On affected vehicles the Steering Column Control Module (SCCM) may have a turn signal self-cancelling anti-jam component out of specification an internal short circuit on the SCCM printed circuit board (PCB) and/or a turn signal lever debouncing time limit which is too short.
records.remedy: Flash the SCCM with new software and complete the SCCM testing.

records.concern: Modification of charging wire
records.defect: On affected models the starter relay connector can overheat and melt which prevents the battery charging
records.remedy: Modify the wiring to the starter relay.

records.concern: Use of the contaminated compound in a limited number of tyres could result in a localised loss of adhesion between the steel belts.
records.defect: Use of a contaminated compound in a limited number of tyres could result in a localised loss of adhesion between the steel belts.
records.remedy: Contact the manufacturer/dealer from whom affected tyres were purchased and schedule an appointment for a free exchange of the tyres as soon as possible.

records.concern: SRC240607 RC2404 Inspection and replacement of the mounting supports on the vehicle frame
records.defect: On affected vehicles the body mounting supports can become deformed when the vehicle body is attached. This deformation can potentially cause the mounting support to break. In the worst-case scenario this can lead to the loss of the vehicle body.
records.remedy: Visual inspection of mounting supports any exhibiting deformation will be replaced. Version 1 mounting supports will also be reinforced with additional inserts to prevent deformation of the mounting supports.

records.concern: SRC240409 RC2401 Replacement of information label for airbag on front passenger sun visor
records.defect: On affected vehicles an incorrect airbag label is printed on the passenger sun visor. The label informs of the danger of using a child seat in a vehicle with a front passenger airbag. If a child seat is used and installed incorrectly the occupant may be injured in the event of a road traffic collision.
records.remedy: Check the label and replace the existing passenger sun visor if required.

records.concern: SRL240430 – ABH-FALT Change parameters in advanced signal acquision and actuation module (ASAM) Control unit
records.defect: On affected vehicles the data record of the folding door control was overwritten incorrectly resulting in the folding door closing automatically after “ignition off” and 60 seconds. The door control is de-energised so reversing and automatic reversing functions do not work. Very high closing forces can be generated resulting in personal injury.
records.remedy: Restore the original door control parameters.

records.concern: AJ21-D4 Turbo Oil Feed Pipe Leak
records.defect: On certain vehicles there may be insufficient clamp load on the turbocharger oil feed pipe which may over time loosen and lead to an oil leak.
records.remedy: The oil feed pipe will be removed the O-rings replaced lubricated and an additional clamp installed.

records.concern: Reverse gear switch not functioning as intended.
records.defect: On affected vehicles the reversing gear switch is not according to specification. This could result in a failure to illuminate the rear light of the vehicle during a reversing manoeuvre.
records.remedy: Check the reversing gear switch and replacement if required

records.concern: Egimotors Ranger EV Unfused Electrical Harness
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have an unfused electrical harness which may overheat posing a fire hazard and risk of serious injury.
records.remedy: Check and fit a fused wiring harness.

records.concern: ARA7 Recall campaign - Replace shift cable
records.defect: On affected vehicles the transmission shift cable may have had the safety clip on the shift cable incorrectly fitted or the cable sheath on the shift cable may be damaged resulting in the risk of a roll away incident after the vehicle is placed in park (P) if the parking brake is not applied.
records.remedy: Replace shift cable

records.concern: 24S18 - Transit Courier Tourneo Courier - Brake system potential contamination
records.defect: Courier vehicles on which the brake system may be contaminated with mineral oil. This can cause swelling of rubber components in the brake system (hydraulic seals brake hoses etc). In some circumstances if swelling occurs there is potential for the brake system to lack hydraulic pressure which may result in longer brake pedal travel and reduced brake performance therefore increasing the risk of an accident.
records.remedy: The Ford dealer will inspect the brake system on all affected vehicles and will replace all the parts affected by this condition.

records.concern: Reverse lamp height
records.defect: On certain vehicles built with a specific suspension package the reverse lamps may be above the UN ECE 48.04 height requirement.
records.remedy: Install the reverse lamp in accordance with the UN ECE 48.04 height requirement.

records.concern: Citroen Berlingo -K9 Engine Software
records.defect: Affected vehicles may suffer a loss of Hydraulic Brake Compensation (HBC). In a worst-case scenario this can lead to reduced brake performance.
records.remedy: Update the ECU (Engine Control Unit) calibration.

records.concern: Peugeot 2008/Rifter Engine software
records.defect: Affected vehicles may suffer a loss of Hydraulic Brake Compensation (HBC). In a worst-case scenario this can lead to reduced brake performance.
records.remedy: Update the ECU (Engine Control Unit) calibration.

records.concern: 3NP – Handlebar Grip Loose
records.defect: Insufficient bonded area of left handle grip may cause the grip to loosen.
records.remedy: Once your vehicle is received at the Retailer the Technician will remove the old grip apply the correct amount of adhesive and replace the left hand grip with a new one.

records.concern: 718 Ghibli and Quattroporte V8 short Fuel line replacement in engine compartment
records.defect: On affected vehicles the pressure/temperature sensor within the short fuel line may cause a possible fuel leakage in engine bay. This may lead to a loss of power and in the worst case a potential fire.
records.remedy: Replacement of the short fuel line containing the pressure sensor.

records.concern: Roof anti-pinch system
records.defect: Certain vehicles may have been equipped with an open roof anti-pinch system which does not operate according to specification.
records.remedy: If required the two motors will be replaced.

records.concern: Kia Soul SK3 Curtain Airbag Recall
records.defect: On affected vehicles unintended deployment of the curtain air bags may occur due to a welding issue within the hybrid inflator.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles carry out inspection of curtain air bags and replace if necessary

records.concern: Turnout 4E
records.defect: On affected swivel bases the safety guards which limit movement of the seat and swivel base in the event of a collision may not have been fitted.
records.remedy: Fit the safety guards to the affected swivel bases.

records.concern: B-Pillar Reinforcement
records.defect: On affected vehicles the weld points of a reinforcement in the right B-pillar may not correspond to the specifications. In this case the reinforcement in the B-pillar may work loose over time and fail to transmit the belt forces to the B-pillar as intended. This would increase the risk of injury in the event of an accident.
records.remedy: Rework the B-Pillar on the affected vehicles if necessary.

records.concern: Windscreen defrost
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have been built with incorrectly programmed Hybrid Control Processor (HCP) software which may result in a disabled windscreen defrost system under certain conditions.
records.remedy: Update the hybrid control Processor (HCP) software.

records.concern: 24C02 - Transit Courier Reversing Camera Black Screen
records.defect: A small number of Transit Courier vehicles which have been built where the rear-view camera turns black on the SYNC screen when the vehicle is placed in reverse. In addition some other Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS) features may not function as expected.
records.remedy: Updated software to be installed

records.concern: Peugeot 308 E-call not working due to duplicate IMEI
records.defect: On affected vehicles equipped with E-call the device may not function when trying to connect to E-Call (Emergency Call) and B-Call (Breakdown Call) due to incorrect BSRF (On-board radiocommunication transmitter) configuration and as a result does not comply with regulatory requirements.
records.remedy: Check and replace the Radio frequency connectivity box.

records.concern: Vauxhall Astra L E-call not working due to duplicate IMEI
records.defect: On affected vehicles equipped with E-call the device may not function when trying to connect to E-Call (Emergency Call) and B-Call (Breakdown Call) due to incorrect BSRF (On-board radiocommunication transmitter) configuration and as a result does not comply with regulatory requirements.
records.remedy: Check and replace the Radio frequency connectivity box.

records.concern: Fallback Level Brake Force Assistance
records.defect: On certain Mercedes eSprinter (907 model) vehicles the fallback level of the brake force assist function might not meet intended force requirements. As a result the required brake pedal application forces would be considerably increased compared to the intended fallback-level.
records.remedy: Update the software of the ESP control unit.

records.concern: Checking hydraulic unit
records.defect: On affected vehicles the Electronic Stabilisation Control (ESC) unit may fail resulting in the loss of braking effort it may also affect the operation of the ESC and Anti Lock Braking System (ABS). If Red brake fault warning is displayed safely stop the vehicle immediately the Electronic Parking brake (EPB) can always be used to stop the vehicle if required and do not use vehicle until obtained further advice from the manufacturer.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles the Electronic Stabilisation Control (ESC) unit will be checked and replaced if necessary.

records.concern: Incorrect tyre size data on Certificate of Conformity (CoC)
records.defect: Affected vehicles may display incorrect tyre size information on the Certificate of Conformity (CoC).
records.remedy: The CoC must be replaced.

records.concern: Incorrect tyre size data on Certificate of Conformity (CoC)
records.defect: Affected vehicles may display incorrect tyre size information on the Certificate of Conformity (CoC).
records.remedy: The CoC must be replaced.

records.concern: Incorrect tyre size data on Certificate of Conformity (CoC)
records.defect: Affected vehicles may display incorrect tyre size information on the Certificate of Conformity (CoC).
records.remedy: The CoC must be replaced.

records.concern: Brake Hose Leak
records.defect: On affected vehicles there is the possibility of the front brake hoses leaking.
records.remedy: Replace both front brake hoses and modify the hose routing and ride height sensor if necessary.

records.concern: Backrest bolted connection
records.defect: On VW ID.4 and ID.7 vehicles of a limited production period the bolted connection of the front seats between backrest and seat pan may be incorrect. The restraint effect of the seat may be insufficient in the event of an accident. There is therefore an increased risk for occupants.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles the bolts on both front seat backrests must be replaced.

records.concern: 24C10 - Transit Custom - Power Steering Control Module (PSCM) software update
records.defect: Transit Custom vehicles that might have been loaded with the incorrect software for the Power Steering Control Module (PSCM) during the manufacturing process. Having the incorrect software could lead to the Lane Change Warning Assist (LCWA) to not work as intended.
records.remedy: The Ford Dealer will update the software to the latest level in order to restore full functionality.

records.concern: Checking high-voltage battery
records.defect: Deviations to various important parameters were discovered on the affected battery modules. These may result in the affected battery modules becoming defective over the course of the vehicle’s service life. In turn this represents a fire hazard with the associated risk of severe or fatal injuries to people inside and/or outside the vehicle as well as significant material damage.
records.remedy: Check and if necessary replace individual modules of the high-voltage battery. To minimise this risk the manufacturer advises that you limit the charging target to 80 percent capacity until the inspection has been carried out. This significantly reduces the load on the battery during charging. You can adjust this setting in the Charging target menu in the MMI or in the ’myAudi’ app. As this setting may change during vehicle use the current value must always be checked prior to charging the vehicle and set to a maximum of 80 percent if necessary. Additionally until the inspection has been completed the manufacturer advises not to charge the vehicle under cover and or to ensure the vehicle is not parked adjacent to or under buildings.

records.concern: TGS TGX: Retighten the hex lock nut of the drag link renew the drop arm and drag link if necessary
records.defect: On certain vehicles the lock nut of the screw connection between the drag link and the drop arm may not be tightened with the correct torque.
records.remedy: Check the bolt connection between the drop arm and drag link. Renew the drop arm and drag link if necessary.

records.concern: Fuel Pump Impeller Swelling
records.defect: The impeller inside the fuel pump may become distorted and crack. This locks the impeller preventing fuel from being delivered
records.remedy: Inspection of the fuel pump LOT number and replacement as required

records.concern: Seat Belt Warning (Front Seat Belts)
records.defect: On affected vehicles the hall sensor in the driver and passenger front seat belt stalks may not have been correctly installed and it may indicate the seat belt is inserted correctly when it actually is not.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles the seat belt stalks will be tested and replaced if necessary.

records.concern: Kia EV6 Intergrated Charge Control Unit Recall
records.defect: On affected vehicles The Integrated Charging Control Unit (ICCU) may become damaged over time and may not be able to charge the 12-volt battery which can discharge gradually while driving with a progressive reduction of motive power.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles check for DTC P1A9096. If not present update the software in the ICCU. If the DTC is present replace the ICCU the fuse and check the software version is correct.

records.concern: The subject vehicles may experience a transmission malfunction resulting in a loss of drive.
records.defect: On affected vehicles they may experience a transmission malfunction resulting in a loss of drive
records.remedy: On all affected vehicles the transmission control unit software will be updated

records.concern: The subject vehicles may experience a transmission malfunction resulting in a loss of drive.
records.defect: On affected vehicles they may experience a transmission malfunction resulting in a loss of drive
records.remedy: On all affected vehicles the transmission control unit software will be updated

records.concern: Replace battery module
records.defect: Deviations to various important parameters were discovered on the affected battery modules. These may result in the affected battery modules becoming defective over the course of the vehicle’s service life. In turn this represents a fire hazard with the associated risk of severe or fatal injuries to people inside and/or outside the vehicle as well as significant material damage.
records.remedy: Replace individual modules of the high-voltage battery. To minimise this risk the manufacturer advises that you limit the charging target to 80 percent capacity until the inspection has been carried out. This significantly reduces the load on the battery during charging. You can adjust this setting in the Charging target menu in the MMI or in the’ myAudi’ app. As this setting may change during vehicle use the current value must always be checked prior to charging the vehicle and set to a maximum of 80 percent if necessary. Additionally until the inspection has been completed the manufacturer advises not to charge the vehicle under cover and or to ensure the vehicle is not parked adjacent to or under buildings.

records.concern: Land Rover Defender Incorrect Brake Pipe Routing
records.defect: On affected vehicles converted by JLR Classic Works the brake pipes may have been incorrectly assembled to the brake modulator.
records.remedy: Vehicles will have the brake pipe routing inspected and corrected if necessary.

records.concern: 24S34 – Courier Hand Brake Wiring
records.defect: Courier vehicles where the hand brake electrical wiring could get damaged. This could result in the park brake light being illuminated at all times regardless of whether the park brake lever is physically applied. There is a risk that the customer may assume the park brake is applied when it is not increasing the risk of vehicle roll-away. In some cases the park indicator light will not illuminate although the park brake is applied. There is no hand brake function loss due to this issue.
records.remedy: Inspect rework if required or replace if damaged.

records.concern: SRPC2407 – Battery Pole Cover
records.defect: On affected vehicles the cover for a pole of the 12V battery might not be installed.
records.remedy: Check whether the battery positive pole covers have been installed and if necessary install it.

records.concern: The rear inner driveshaft may develop noise resulting in a loss of drive
records.defect: On affected vehicles the rear inner driveshaft may develop noise resulting in a loss of drive.
records.remedy: On all affected vehicles replace the affected driveshaft and check properly fastened

records.concern: DHU Update
records.defect: A software error has been identified in relation to the display. In rare cases this could cause the screen to enter a “test mode” during vehicle start-up which will prevent key information including the vehicle speed from being displayed.
records.remedy: The solution is updated software available via OTA (over the air) or at a Volvo retailer.

records.concern: Citroen Dispatch -K0 – Ground Connections
records.defect: On affected vehicles there could be a loss of ground connections for some electrical harnesses which could result in a worst-case scenario in the loss of several vehicle functions with safety impacts and a risk of erratic behaviour of the vehicle.
records.remedy: Check and re-tighten the ground connections.

records.concern: Peugeot Expert – Ground Connections
records.defect: On affected vehicles there could be a loss of ground connections for some electrical harnesses which could result in a worst-case scenario in the loss of several vehicle functions with safety impacts and a risk of erratic behaviour of the vehicle.
records.remedy: Check and re-tighten the ground connections.

records.concern: Vauxhall Vivaro – Ground Connections
records.defect: On affected vehicles there could be a loss of ground connections for some electrical harnesses which could result in a worst-case scenario in the loss of several vehicle functions with safety impacts and a risk of erratic behaviour of the vehicle.
records.remedy: Check and re-tighten the ground connections.

records.concern: REDUCER SUPPORTCHECK/REPLACE
records.defect: On affected vehicles the electric motor support bracket screws could break allowing the electric motor to fall with risk of rupturing the power steering hydraulic hose resulting in a loss of steering power assistance.
records.remedy: Replacing fixing screws and support where necessary.

records.concern: SRPC2404 – Backup function of steering software
records.defect: On affected vehicles the backup function of the steering software might not meet specifications. As a result the steering power support might be impaired and a loss of steerability cannot be ruled out.
records.remedy: Update the software of the electric steering on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: The Integrated Charging Control Unit (ICCU) may become defective and stop charging the 12-volt battery which can result in the vehicle entering into a ‘failsafe’ driving mode.
records.defect: On affected vehicles the Integrated Charging Control Unit (ICCU) may be come defective and stop charging the 12volt battery this can result in the vehicle entering a failsafe driving mode
records.remedy: On all affected vehicles update the ICCU software and check and replace if necessary the ICCU and fuse.

records.concern: 24S30 Transit - Incorrect trailer tow installed
records.defect: A small number of Transit vehicles have been manufactured with an incorrect tow bar that does not meet the correct load specifications. It is important for the affected vehicles to be returned to a Ford Authorised Dealer. If the tow load is in excess of 2600kg this could potentially result in the trailer becoming detached or the tow bar assembly being damaged. A detached trailer or a damaged tow bar could increase the risk of an accident.
records.remedy: Install the correct tow bar free of charge parts and labour.

records.concern: Replace VANOS bolts N51 N52 N55
records.defect: On affected vehicles overtime the aluminium screws can loosen or break on the adjustable variable camshaft timing (VANOS) units potentially resulting in engine emergency mode being activated.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles the eight aluminium screws will be replaced if evidence of faulty screws is found then the VANOS adjustment unit will also be replaced.

records.concern: The rear driveshaft may develop noise resulting in a loss of drive
records.defect: On affected vehicles the rear driveshaft may develop noise resulting in loss of drive
records.remedy: On affected vehicles rear drive shafts will be replaced

records.concern: A risk of electrical short circuit within the engine compartment during a vehicle collision
records.defect: On affected vehicles a risk of an electrical short circuit within the engine compartment during a collision
records.remedy: On affected vehicles crush shields will be installed to protect the wiring

records.concern: Juke (F16) Right Hand Rear Door
records.defect: On affected vehicles the right-hand rear door welds may be out of specification. The door may rattle and a side impact may increase the risk of deformation. In the extreme impact could cause the hinge to fail and the door to open.
records.remedy: Replace the rear right-hand door.

records.concern: PHEV Traction Battery Busbar Weld Penetration
records.defect: For the affected vehicle a concern has been identified where the there is an inadequate depth of weld (penetration) between the busbar and the anode in the module of the Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle (PHEV) battery.
records.remedy: Replacement of the traction battery.

records.concern: SRPC2342 - Coding headlamp control unit
records.defect: On affected vehicles the coding of the headlamp control unit might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: Update the coding of the headlamp control unit on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: ECU cable to daytime running light Chaffing
