records.defect: ECU cable to daytime running light chaffing that may cause the daytime running lights to stop working
records.remedy: Inspect and replace if required

records.concern: Handbrake Valve Wrong Spring
records.defect: Park Brake Valve (PBV) may fail during vehicle operation causing the Park Brake to activate
records.remedy: Replace faulty park brake valve.

records.concern: SRPC2405 - Bolting of 48V ground connection
records.defect: On affected vehicles the 48V ground connection under the passenger seat might have come loose.
records.remedy: Check the bolting of the ground connection and correct it if necessary.

records.concern: 24S22 – Transit Rear Brake Line Inspection
records.defect: The wrong brake line hose may have been installed on the right rear. The longer brake line could create a touch condition with the rear wheel which could in turn cause a brake fluid leak. In the event of a leak you may notice a soft brake pedal feel and a red warning light will illuminate in the cluster. The brake system has two separate diagonal brake line circuits and in the event of one brake line circuit failure the vehicle is able to stop with the functionality of the secondary brake circuit. If the brake lines on both sides were to fail it may lead to a loss of brake function.
records.remedy: Inspect and replace with correct hose.

records.concern: Product recall V-Trec brake leverAprilia Shiver 750/900 and Dorsoduro 750/900
records.defect: In extreme heat insufficient free travel can cause the brake lever and brake pump to expand.
records.remedy: Replace the brake lever adapter with a revised version.

records.concern: 23S67 – Ranger Platinum Child Lock
records.defect: Ranger Platinum vehicles where the electronic child lock system may show as engaged on the orange light on the window switch pack on the door trim but the rear doors could be opened from the interior door release handle. A Child Lock Malfunction message in the cluster or a warning flash on the activation button may or may not illuminate.
records.remedy: Modification to system wiring and system reset.

records.concern: Standard lockable bar
records.defect: The Standard Lockable bar have 9 feet (screws) in the bar which are screwed in by a robot arm and then ‘swaged’ over in a press so that they cannot be undone. The ‘swaged’ process was not carried out correctly for some of the parts manufactured and so the screws could be undone by hand.
records.remedy: Install the replacement SL Lockable Seat Fixtures.

records.concern: Check suspension strut replace if necessary
records.defect: On affected vehicles due to a manufacturing defect the proportional valve in the suspension strut may loosen over the course of the service life. This can result in a loss of the damping function
records.remedy: On all affected vehicles check suspension strut and replace if necessary

records.concern: SRPC2406 - Routing of transmission wiring harness
records.defect: On affected vehicles the routing of the transmission wiring harness might not meet specifications. The distance of the wiring harness to the drive shaft might be too small causing it to chafe.
records.remedy: Check the routing of the transmission wiring harness and rework it if necessary.

records.concern: Inspection of Kingpin Bolted Connection F329
records.defect: In the case of tipper semi-trailers (S.KI) from a limited production period the bolted connection of the kingpin may not correspond to the prescribed torque. In extreme cases this can result in the tipper semi-trailer becoming separated from the tractor unit.
records.remedy: To avoid damage it is necessary that the kingpin bolts be inspected and if necessary retightened by an authorised Schmitz Cargobull service partner.

records.concern: MCU software
records.defect: On affected vehicles incorrect MCU (Motor Control Unit) calibration may result in a loss of propulsion while driving.
records.remedy: Update the MCU (Motor Control Unit) calibration

records.concern: MCU software
records.defect: On affected vehicles incorrect MCU (Motor Control Unit) calibration may result in a loss of propulsion while driving.
records.remedy: Update the MCU (Motor Control Unit) calibration

records.concern: 24S23 - Transit Skeletal Chassis Inspection
records.defect: While monitoring vehicles in operation we have become aware of a number of Transit Chassis vehicles may have damage to a section of the vehicle’s chassis. The chassis is the structural element of the vehicle.
records.remedy: Inspect and replace vehicle if required possible reworking.

records.concern: Transit Courier: Wiring Loom to Steering Column Potential Touch Condition
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have a touch condition between the dash panel wiring and the steering i-shaft. This may lead to damage of the wiring harness which can cause several issues depending on which wire is affected. Potential issues include loss of exterior lighting loss of tyre pressure monitoring system doors might show up as closed despite not being closed and other possible failure modes.
records.remedy: Inspect and resecure if required

records.concern: Transit and Tourneo Courier Infotainment Software Update
records.defect: A number of Transit and Tourneo Courier vehicles have been identified where the warning chimes may not be operating as intended the chimes may not be audible which does not meet ECE regulation. For vehicles affected by this concern the overall functionality of the vehicle is not affected but some warning chimes may fail to sound including but not limited to intelligent speed assist forward & reverse park aid active cruise control collision warning lane departure & keeping warnings park brake seat belt minder.
records.remedy: Apply software update

records.concern: I-PACE Traction Battery Thermal Overload - Elevated Risk
records.defect: On affected vehicles the traction battery packs which contain cells manufactured on or before 31 May 2018 are exposed to multiple technical issues that have shown to contribute to an elevated risk of thermal overload.
records.remedy: The traction battery pack will be replaced with a new pack or the vehicle will be re-acquired from the customer.

records.concern: Solo EV Roof Pod Detached
records.defect: On affected vehicles the GRP roof panels / POD may detach during adverse weather conditions. If the GRP roof pod detaches this may cause harm to pedestrians and other road users.
records.remedy: Remedy is to inspect roof panels in area of fixing screws and re-bond panels as required.

records.concern: SRL240201 - STABI-ACHS Retighten Stablizer Link Bearing cap screws on trailing axle
records.defect: On certain vehicles the lock-up value of the torque on one of the four screws on the stabilizer of the trailing axle which amplifies the effect of the stabilizer link installed as standard on back-heavy vehicles may be undershot.
records.remedy: Check and correct the lock-up value of the tightening torque of the screw on the stabilizer of the trailing axle as a precautionary measure.

records.concern: Kia EV6 and Niro SG2 Driveshaft Recall
records.defect: On affected vehicles an improperly treated driveshaft may break under load resulting in the loss of drive
records.remedy: On affected vehicles the driveshaft will be replaced

records.concern: SRPC2338 -Rear-Axle Wiring Harness
records.defect: On affected vehicles the rear-axle wiring harness might be pre-damaged due to a fixing which might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: Check and replace the rear-axle wiring harness if necessary.

records.concern: On affected vehicles if the brake wear indicator contacts the brake disc a fault occurs in the electric circuit which can cause the fuse to blow. If the vehicle operates with a trailer at the time both brake lamps and the left and right tail lamps on the trailer will fail.
records.defect: On affected vehicles if the brake wear indicator contacts the brake disc a fault occurs in the electric circuit which can cause the fuse to blow. If the vehicle operates with a trailer at the time both brake lamps and the left and right tail lamps on the trailer will fail.
records.remedy: Replace the wiring harness with a modified part and adapt the SAM control unit software.

records.concern: Driver's side front airbag
records.defect: On affected vehicles a deterioration of the driver airbag propellant could occur. In the event of an accident and the activation of the driver airbag fragments of the generator housing could become detached and injure the vehicle occupants.
records.remedy: The driver side front airbag gas generator must be replaced in all affected vehicles.

records.concern: ARA5 - Checking high-voltage battery and replacing cell block module if necessary
records.defect: On affected vehicles production issues may have occurred at the battery cell/battery module supplier. If this is the case a short circuit within the battery modules leading to possible thermal events and fires cannot be ruled out.
records.remedy: Replace affected battery modules in the high-volt battery.

records.concern: RA-03-1926– DBX707 Oil Cooler Hoses
records.defect: On affected vehicles oil cooler hoses may be prone to leak resulting in loss of oil and oil pressure
records.remedy: On affected vehicles oil cooler hoses will be replaced

records.concern: RA-63-1832 - DBX Battery Fusebox Cable Fixings
records.defect: On affected vehicles it is possible the fixings for the fuses are not correctly torqued
records.remedy: On affected vehicles check and replace fuse fixings as required

records.concern: SRPC2403 – Filling of Air Conditioning Refrigerant
records.defect: On affected vehicles the air-conditioning might not have been filled with the designated refrigerant.
records.remedy: Replace the air-conditioning refrigerant with the correct type.

records.concern: Jimny Fuel Pump Replacement
records.defect: The fuel feeding impeller may interfere with the fuel pump housing resulting in the fuel pump malfunction
records.remedy: Replace the fuel pump fitted to affected vehicles

records.concern: ARA4 Recall Campaign - Replacing cell block module on high-voltage battery.
records.defect: On affected vehicles production issues may have occurred at the battery cell/battery module supplier. If this is the case a short circuit within the battery modules leading to possible thermal events and fires cannot be ruled out.
records.remedy: Replace affected battery modules in the high-volt battery.

records.concern: Checking the secure mounting of the reducer gearbox.
records.defect: On affected vehicles there is a potential risk the electrical powertrain may not be secured correctly.
records.remedy: Check and change the electric traction reducer mounting if necessary.

records.concern: Replacing Takata passenger airbag
records.defect: On affected vehicles the passenger airbag may in extremely rare cases be overloaded and even burst when the passenger airbag is triggered. If this were to happen small metal parts could become dislodged from the housing and potentially cause life-threatening injury to a vehicle occupant.
records.remedy: For safety reasons it is necessary to check the passenger airbag and if required to replace the airbag module.

records.concern: Checking and if necessary replacing the tailgate trim
records.defect: On affected vehicles due to a potential bonding defect there is a risk of the tailgate external trim becoming detached
records.remedy: On affected vehicles the tailgate external trim will be inspected and if necessary replaced.

records.concern: Main Stand Hook Welding Malfunction
records.defect: The spring hook on the main stand lacks the strength of welding due to inappropriate settings of the welding machine. Therefore when the main stand is operated there is a risk that the spring hook may break and the vehicle could fall over. In addition if the spring hook comes off while riding in the worst-case scenario the main stand may touch the ground and cause the vehicle to fall.
records.remedy: Inspect and replace if required

records.concern: Spark Plug Replacement
records.defect: The spark plugs may have been damaged during the manufacturing process. Continued use in this condition may result in unstable idle and in the worst case lead to the engine stalling.
records.remedy: To overcome this problem Kawasaki will replace the spark plugs.

records.concern: Fuse install to prevent unexpected stop
records.defect: Short circuit on low voltage side has in other cases caused instant stop on the road without ability to driver vehicle safely to the side of the road.
records.remedy: In order to ensure short circuits ability to drive vehicle to the side of the road in case of a300A fuse is to be installed on the low voltage side to ensure power supply to control units is maintained in case DC/DC converter fails.

records.concern: Battery Cable Contact Short Circuit Problem
records.defect: In certain collisions the cable may be pinched between the body and the collision object and may be damaged. This may result in a short circuit to the power circuit and the battery cable can overheat increasing the risk of a fire and/or injury.
records.remedy: Install fuse in cable.

records.concern: AJ20-D6 Fuel Injector Clamp Cracked
records.defect: A concern has been identified where the clamps used to secure the fuel injectors into the cylinder head on certain AJ20-D6 engines may crack allowing the injector to come loose. This loose injector could become unseated allowing fuel to be pushed past the injector seal from the combustion chamber or the fuel feed system.
records.remedy: A fuel leak in this area could result in fuel spill onto hot engine components which may result in a fire.

records.concern: 24S16 - Kuga - PCM Programming and Drain Tube Installation
records.defect: A small number of vehicles on which the fuel injectors may crack and leak. In the event of an injector failing this may result in fuel accumulating on the top of the engine. The accumulation of fuel could become the catalyst for a fire due to the proximity to the exhaust system and lack of an escape route for the leaking fuel.
records.remedy: The dealer will fit a specially developed drain tube which will safely drain any leaking fuel away from hot surfaces like the cylinder head or exhaust. Also the vehicle software will be updated which will allow any drop in fuel pressure to be detected. This software will reduce the power of the engine if a drop in fuel pressure is detected and a warning light will be illuminated in the instrument cluster.

records.concern: SRPC 2402 - Downshift operation transmission software
records.defect: On certain vehicles the software of the transmission control unit might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: Update the transmission control unit software on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: SRPC2401 - System protection
records.defect: On certain vehicles some 80A fuses installed might not meet requirements.
records.remedy: Replace the respective main fuse boxes on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: SRPC2400 - Bolting of 48 volt ground connection
records.defect: On certain vehicles the 48V ground connection in the engine compartment might not be secured correctly.
records.remedy: Check the bolting of the ground connection on the affected vehicles and perform the respective repairs if necessary.

records.concern: Range Rover Sport Tail lamp Failure
records.defect: On affected vehicles the right-hand tailgate and body mounted rear lamps may experience water ingress leading to one or more lamp failures.
records.remedy: The right-hand tailgate and body mounted lamps will be replaced

records.concern: Potential touch condition between brake line union nut and fuel tank
records.defect: A small number of Courier vehicles that could potentially develop a touch condition over time between the brake line union nut and the fuel tank. If the brake line union nut connection becomes loose due to a touch condition with the fuel tank the friction with the fuel tank may lead to a brake fluid leak or in some cases a fuel leak from the fuel tank. If a brake fluid leak occurs the driver may notice reduced brake performance followed by a red warning light in the cluster. If a fuel leak occurs there is the potential for fuel to come into contact with hot surfaces from the exhaust system along with a strong smell of fuel.
records.remedy: The affected vehicles will be inspected and a protective spacer that was designed to prevent any potential chaffing will be installed.

records.concern: ARA3 - Check front and rear windows and replace if necessary

records.remedy: To minimise this risk temporarily do not charge the high-voltage battery above 80 percent capacity. The vehicle will be inspected and where necessary the individual cells within the high voltage battery will be replaced.

records.concern: Remote Parking via Mobile App on Certain Toyota C-HR
records.defect: Affected vehicles are equipped with an advanced park system which can be operated remotely by the driver when outside the vehicle using a smartphone application. There is a risk an error may occur in an Electronic Control Unit (ECU) when the finger movements on the smartphone application are stopped or the finger is removed within three seconds after the remote-control function is activated. If this occurs the shift range will be changed from Park to Drive or Reverse and the brakes will be released without any finger operation on the smartphone resulting in the vehicle creeping forward or backward which could increase the risk of a crash.
records.remedy: Reprogram the Clearance Sonar Electronic Control Unit (ECU) and Brake Electronic Control Unit (ECU) with modified software.

records.remedy: Replace affected components.

records.concern: DC-DC converter may have been damaged during production
records.defect: The plug-in hybrid system of the subject vehicles includes a DC-DC converter that reduces the voltage of the electricity from the Hybrid Vehicle (HV) battery in order to charge the vehicle�s 12V battery. Contained within the DC-DC converter is a current rectifying module that is installed on the circuit board. Some of these modules may have been damaged during production by the supplier and could fail so creating a short circuit. This allows current from the 12V battery to continue to flow through the module and the module will generate heat. Under certain conditions if excessive heat is generated components within and outside the DC-DC converter could sustain thermal damage increasing the risk of a vehicle fire.
records.remedy: Replace the DC-DC Converter.

records.concern: In transmissions for replacement free gearwheels 6th gear were installed that do not meet the specifications.
records.defect: In some cases the free gearwheels 6th gear that were installed do not meet the specifications. For this reason extended full load operation in 6th gear can cause increased wear of thegearshift forks. In the event of a fault the gear change is not performed correctly. this could lead to a dual engagement of two gears. A dual engagement can result in a blocked rear wheel and/or a shear off of the gear wheels depending on the speed and road friction coefficient.
records.remedy: To check transmission number and if in affected range then the free gearwheel for 6th gear to be replaced.
