records.concern: ONE OR BOTH HEADRESTS OF THE FIRST ROW 2-PERSON BENCH SEAT CANNOT BE LOCKED INTO PLACE
records.defect: There is a possibility that one or both headrests of the first row 2-person bench seat cannot be locked into place.
records.remedy: Inspect and replace the headrest(s) if necessary.

records.concern: INDIVIDUAL BOLTS OR CHAIN LINKS OF THE CAMSHAFT TIMING CHAIN MIGHT WEAR
records.defect: Individual bolts or chain links of the camshaft timing chain might wear in case of a long term operation under specific driving conditions.
records.remedy: Replace the camshaft timing chain on the affected vehicles

records.concern: THE WIND SCREEN WIPER MIGHT STOP WORKING ON THE TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH RAIN SENSOR
records.defect: There is a risk that the wind screen wiper might stop working.
records.remedy: Update vehicle software and replace the wiper relay.

records.concern: THE VEHICLES MAY HAVE THE WRONG VIN PRINTED ON THE B PILLAR VIN STICKER
records.defect: The vehicles may have the wrong VIN printed on the �B pillar� VIN sticker.
records.remedy: Check and if necessary replace the �B pillar� VIN sticker.

records.concern: A FAULT HAS BEEN IDENTIFIED IN THE MANUFACTURE OF THE FRONT L/H SEAT BELT PRE-TENSIONER
records.defect: A fault has been identified in the manufacture of the front L/H seatbelt pre-tensioner.
records.remedy: Replace the front L/H seatbelt pre-tensioner.

records.concern: THE FRONT CRASH SENSOR FIXINGS MAY NOT HAVE BEEN INSTALLED TO THE SPECIFIED TORQUE
records.defect: The front crash sensor fixings may not have been installed to the specified level of torque.
records.remedy: Check and tighten the front crash sensor fixing to the specified level of torque.

records.concern: A DEFECTIVE SCALE AT THE SUPPLIER DELIVERED WRONG OIL WEIGHT DATA FOR OIL FILLING FOR A CERTAIN NUMBER OF TRANSMISSIONS
records.defect: A defective scale at the supplier delivered wrong oil weight data for oil filling for a certain number of transmissions.
records.remedy: The oil level within the gearbox will be checked and corrected.

records.concern: THE PASSENGER SEATBELT WARNING CHIME MIGHT BE INOPERATIVE
records.defect: The passenger seatbelt warning chime might be inoperative.
records.remedy: Reprogram the Body Control Module software.

records.concern: SUPPLY CABLES FOR THE 48 VOLT BATTERY SYSTEM HAVE AN INCORRECT TIGHTENING TORQUE
records.defect: Supply cables for the 48Volt battery system have an incorrect tightening torque.
records.remedy: Inspect and retighten cable fixing screws for the 48Volt battery system.

records.concern: THE STEERING OF CERTAIN EQE (295 PLATFORM) VEHICLES MAY HAVE BEEN DAMAGED DURING THE ASSEMBLY PROCESS
records.defect: The steering of certain EQE (295 platform) vehicles may have been damaged during the assembly process.
records.remedy: Replace the steering on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: THE SELECTIVE CATALYTIC REDUCTION SYSTEM DOES NOT HEAT UP AS REQUIRED
records.defect: Selective Catalytic Reduction (SCR) system does not heat up as required.
records.remedy: Replace the affected Urea Reservoir.

records.concern: THE SOFTWARE OF THE REAR SIGNAL ACQUISITION AND ACTUATION MODULE MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: The software of the rear signal acquisition and actuation module might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: Update the software of the signal acquisition and actuation module on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: THE HANDS-OFF DETECTION MIGHT NOT DETECT WHEN THE DRIVER'S HANDS ARE AWAY FROM THE STEERING WHEEL
records.defect: The hands-off detection might not detect when the driver's hands are away from the steering wheel.
records.remedy: Update the coding of the hand detection system on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: ONE OR MORE CONTROL UNIT VEHICLE CONFIGURATIONS MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: Vehicles configurations were written into one or more control units that might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: Update the configuration of the affected control units on the vehicles.

records.concern: THE SOFTWARE OF THE HEADLAMPS MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS.
records.defect: The software of the headlamps might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: Replace the affected headlamp control units on the vehicles.

records.concern: THE RIVET USED TO RETAIN THE CURTAIN AIR BAG COULD BE INCORRECTLY FITTED
records.defect: The rivet used to retain the curtain airbag in some vehicles could be incorrectly fitted.
records.remedy: Check if the curtain airbag is correctly retained by the rivet and if necessary refit the curtain airbag correctly.

records.concern: THE SECOND ROW SEATS MAY NOT BE CORRECTLY ALIGNED AND LOCKED ON ALL SEAT RAILS
records.defect: The 2nd row seats may not be correctly aligned and locked on all seat rails.
records.remedy: Check and re-set the relative 2nd row seat rail positions to ensure proper engagement of the seat rail runners.

records.concern: THE COOLANT PUMP MIGHT HAVE A LEAKAGE BETWEEN THE VACUUM SYSTEM AND THE COOLANT CIRCUIT
records.defect: On certain vehicles with an OM654 engine the coolant pump which is controlled by vacuum might have a leakage between the vacuum system and the coolant circuit.
records.remedy: Update the software of the coolant pump and replace the electrical switch valve on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: THE FABRIC PROTECTIVE HOSE OF THE WIRING HARNESS OF THE FRONT SEATS CAN BE DAMAGED WHEN ADJUSTING THE SEAT IN THE LONGITUDINAL DIRECTION
records.defect: There is a possibility that the fabric protective hose of the wiring harness of the front seats can be damaged when adjusting the seat in the longitudinal direction and subsequently be pulled into the drive spindle of the seat adjustment.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles check the wiring harness of the front seats rework with textile tape and repair if necessary.

records.concern: HEADRESTS ON THE FRONT MODULAR SEAT DO NOT CONFORM TO THE DESIGN SPECIFICATION
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have been equipped with headrests on the front modular seat which do not conform to the design specification.
records.remedy: Check the conformity of the front headrests (presence of the catch); in cases of non-conformity the front headrests will be replaced.

records.concern: HEADRESTS ON THE FRONT MODULAR SEAT DO NOT CONFORM TO THE DESIGN SPECIFICATION
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have been equipped with headrests on the front modular seat which do not conform to the design specification.
records.remedy: Check the conformity of the front headrests (presence of the catch); in cases of non-conformity the front headrests will be replaced.

records.concern: CRACKS CAN OCCUR ON THE REAR SPOILER CARRIERS AND RADIATOR FLAPS
records.defect: Due to a weak supporting structure for the roof attachments cracks can occur on the rear spoiler carriers and the radiator flaps.
records.remedy: The components of the supporting structure for the rear spoiler carrier and radiator flap will be replaced by a reinforced version.

records.concern: THE BEHAVIOUR OF THE EMERGENCY CALL SYSTEM MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: The behaviour of the emergency call system might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: Update the software of the communication module for the emergency call system on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: CERTAIN SPOT WELDS MIGHT BE MISSING.
records.defect: With body panels that are spot-welded to the left and right front shock absorber mounting areas there is a possibility that certain spot-welds were missed.
records.remedy: Inspect the welding near the shock absorber mounting area. If any missing spot-weld is found welds will be added and damage to the vehicle if any will be repaired.

records.concern: THE MESH SIZE OF THE OIL STRAINER IN THE OIL SUPPLY FOR BOTH TURBOCHARGERS IS TOO SMALL
records.defect: The mesh size of the oil strainer in the oil supply for both turbochargers is too small.
records.remedy: The oil strainer will be replaced with a revised version with a larger mesh size.

records.concern: THE ELECTRICAL CONNECTOR TO THE PTC HEATER CAN OVERHEAT
records.defect: The PTC (positive temperature coefficient) heater in some Sorento diesel models can overheat due to damaged connector terminal.
records.remedy: Inspect and if the PTC connector is found damaged replace the PTC and relevant wiring connector. Upgrade the operating logic of the PTC

records.concern: A COMPONENT ON THE ELECTRONIC CIRCUIT BOARD OF THE AIR BAG CONTROL UNIT COULD BE DAMAGED OR DISPLACED
records.defect: On certain vehicles with the highline version of the airbag control unit a component on the electronic circuit board of the airbag control unit could be damaged or displaced.
records.remedy: Replace the airbag control unit on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: THE AIR BAG CONTROL UNIT MIGHT NOT HAVE BEEN BOLTED ACCORDING TO SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: The airbag control unit might not have been bolted according to specifications.
records.remedy: Check the bolting of the airbag control unit on the affected vehicles and correct it if necessary.

records.concern: SOME ENGINE AND BODY GROUND CONNECTIONS MAY NOT BE SECURED TO SPECIFICATION
records.defect: Some Engine and Body ground connections may not be secured to specification.
records.remedy: Check the ground connections and if necessary tighten them according to specifications.

records.concern: CERTIFICATE OF CONFORMITY CONTAINS INCORRECT CO2 AND FUEL ECONOMY VALUES
records.defect: The Certificate of Conformity (COC) paper contains the incorrect information.
records.remedy: Request customer to return old COC paper and issue new corrected COC paper.

records.concern: CRANKSHAFT MIGHT NOT MEET REQUIRED SPECIFICATION
records.defect: On certain vehicles with an OM654 classic diesel engine the crankshaft might not correspond with the required specification
records.remedy: As a precautionary measure the engines will be replaced on the affected vehicles

records.concern: REAR SUSPENSION PIVOT STRUTS ARE NOT TO THE CORRECT SPECIFICATION OR REQUIRED STABILITY
records.defect: During installation pivot struts that did not correspond to the specification and that did not have the required stability were installed on the rear suspension strut.
records.remedy: Replace the relay lever.

records.concern: THE OVERHEAD CONTROL PANEL MIGHT BE DEACTIVATED PERMANENTLY DUE TO A SOFTWARE ERROR
records.defect: The overhead control panel under certain circumstances might be deactivated permanently due to a software error.
records.remedy: Update the software of the overhead control panel.

records.concern: THE TAIL LAMP MAY START FLICKERING WHEN RECEIVING A VOLTAGE CLOSE TO THE MAXIMUM (16V)
records.defect: When the tail-lamp is receiving a voltage close to the maximum (16V) the tail-lamp may start flickering.
records.remedy: Check the production date of the tail-lamps if the fitted lamps are within the defective range replacement of the rear lamp/lamps will be required.

records.concern: THE REAR SPOILER MAY BE FITTED SO IT IS OVER HANGING THE ROOF.
records.defect: The rear spoiler may be fitted so it is overhanging the roof allowing contact with the roof when opening or closing the tailgate.
records.remedy: The rear spoiler will be inspected for correct installation. If needed the upper spoiler section will be replaced and the spoiler reattached to the vehicle.

records.concern: IN CERTAIN CONDITIONS THE USER INTERFACE (UI ) ON AFFECTED VEHICLES DISPLAYS VEHICLE SPEED BUT NOT A UNIT OF SPEED(I.E MPH OR KM/H)
records.defect: In certain conditions the user interface (�UI�) on affected vehicles displays vehicle speed but not a unit of speed (i.e. mph or km/h).
records.remedy: Tesla will deploy an over the air firmware update that will reintroduce the display of the speed unit when using Track Mode.

records.concern: THE ROOF SPOILER MAY NOT HAVE BEEN BONDED TO THE REAR LID WITH THE SPECIFIED PROCESS MATERIALS
records.defect: On all affected Polo vehicles there is a possibility that the roof spoiler may not have been bonded to the rear lid with the specified process materials.
records.remedy: On all affected vehicles the roof spoiler has to be replaced.

records.concern: ONE GROUND CABLE IS INCORRECTLY INSTALLED
records.defect: One ground cable is incorrectly installed which means an under dimensioned cable is incorrectly connected to the wrong grounding point.
records.remedy: Repair kits have been developed which include instruction on how to replace the affected cable.

records.concern: A LOSS OF LOW VOLTAGE SYSTEM SUPPORT MAY CAUSE THE AUDIO SUBSYSTEM TO BE UNAVAILABLE
records.defect: On certain vehicles that are running firmware release 2022.8 and that experience a loss of low voltage system support the audio subsystem may become unavailable including the use of eCall functionality.
records.remedy: Firmware release 2022.12.3 or later reverses the power management process introduced in firmware release 2022.8 and maintains eCall audio functionality.

records.concern: THE INITIALIZATION OF THE RADAR SENSOR MAY NOT HAVE BEEN COMPLETED CORRECTLY
records.defect: The initialization of the radar sensor may not have been completed correctly.
records.remedy: Inspect the radar sensor and if necessary properly initialize the radar sensor.

records.concern: THE FUEL TANK MODULE LOCKING RING HAS BECOME LOOSE
records.defect: It has been found on a small number of vehicles that fuel tank module locking ring has become loose.
records.remedy: Check for the position of the locking tabs of the locating ring and rework if not correct.

records.concern: THE LEVEL OF OIL IN THE GEARBOX MAY BE INSUFFICIENT
records.defect: The level of oil in the gearbox may be insufficient.
records.remedy: The gear oil level on the affected vehicles must be checked and topped up if necessary.

records.concern: THE COOLANT PUMP MIGHT HAVE A LEAKAGE.
records.defect: On certain vehicles the coolant pump which is controlled by vacuum might have a leakage between the vacuum system and the coolant circuit.
records.remedy: Update the software of the coolant pump and replace the electrical switch valve on the affected vehicles. Additionally a check of the vacuum system for possible contamination with coolant or engine oil will be carried out as a precautionary measure for the vehicles in this recall without the so-called fail-boost function on the ESP system.

records.concern: REAR BRAKE DISC BOLTS MAY LOOSEN.
records.defect: The rear Brake Disc bolts may loosen.
records.remedy: Replace the rear brake disc bolts on all the affected models.

records.concern: IN THE EVENT OF A FRONTAL COLLISION THE FRONT IMPACT SENSORS COULD BECOME DISCONNECTED AND THE AIR BAGS MAY NOT ACTIVATE AS EXPECTED
records.defect: In the event of a frontal collision the front impact sensors could become disconnected and the air bags may not activate as expected.
records.remedy: Update the software in the Air Bag Control (ACU) the improved collision algorithm will ensure that airbags deploy properly in the event of a collision.

records.concern: DAMAGE CAN OCCUR IN THE AIR BAG CONTROL UNIT
records.defect: Damage can occur within the vehicles Air Bag Control unit causing the warning light to be displayed and the Air Bag system deactivated.
records.remedy: Inspect the vehicles if the Air Bag warning light is already illuminated replace the control unit. If it is not update the software in the unit.

records.concern: The Certificate of Conformity (CoC) and the registration card must be updated due to the stated gross vehicle weight rating being incorrect (4835 kg instead of 4955 kg).
records.defect: The Certificate of Conformity (CoC) and the registration card must be updated due to the stated gross vehicle weight rating being incorrect.
records.remedy: The CoC and registration documents must be replaced to reflect the correct data.

records.concern: THE RIGHT-HAND ENGINE OIL SEPERATOR MAY HAVE BEEN DAMAGED PRIOR TO ENGINE ASSEMBLY.
records.defect: Certain vehicles could have an engine oil separator that may have been damaged prior to engine assembly.
records.remedy: Inspect the engine oil separator and if found to be damaged and/or leaking a replacement engine oil separator must be installed

records.concern: THE STANDING ASSIST SYSTEM DOES NOT RELEASE IMMEDIATELY AFTER DE-ACTIVATION
records.defect: In some situations the standing assist system does not release immediately after de-activation.
records.remedy: Do not use the Standing Assist function until the currently in-development modification has been installed.

records.concern: POSSIBILITY OF LEAKAGE OF FUEL FROM THE AUXILLARY HEATER UNIT.
records.defect: On some vehicles equipped with a Webasto auxiliary heating unit there is the possibility of a leakage of fuel from the auxiliary heater unit.
records.remedy: : Modify the Webasto additional heater unit power supply routing and update the body electronic control unit software.

records.concern: THE ELECTRIC RESISTANCE IN THE CIRCUIT BOARD OF THE AIR BAG CONTROL UNIT MAY BE INTERRUPTED IN THE EVENT OF AN ACCIDENT
records.defect: On certain vehicles with the highline version of the airbag control unit the electric resistance in the circuit board of the airbag control unit may be interrupted in the event of an accident.
records.remedy: Replace the airbag control unit.

records.concern: IN SOME VEHICLESTHE FUSE IN THE HIGH-VOLTAGE SYSTEM HAS BEEN PRODUCED IN PART WITH AN INSUFFICIENT AMOUNT OF EXTINGUISHING SAND
records.defect: In some vehicles the fuse in the high-voltage system has been produced in part with an insufficient amount of extinguishing sand.
records.remedy: An insulating mat must be placed above the switching unit for the high-voltage battery in all of the affected vehicles.

records.concern: THE FUSE IN THE HIGH-VOLTAGE SYSTEM OF PLUG-IN HYBRID VEHICLES WAS PARTLY PRODUCED WITH AN INSUFFICIENT AMOUNT OF SO-CALLED FIRE EXTINGUISHING SAND
records.defect: The fuse in the high-voltage system of plug-in hybrid vehicles was partly produced with an insufficient amount of so-called fire extinguishing sand.
records.remedy: An additional protective insulating mat is to be fitted over the switch box of the high-voltage battery.

records.concern: THE FUSE IN THE HIGH-VOLTAGE SYSTEM OF PLUG-IN HYBRID VEHICLES WAS IN SOME CASES PRODUCED WITH TOO LITTLE SO-CALLED FIRE SAND
records.defect: The fuse in the high-voltage system of plug-in hybrid vehicles was in some cases produced with too little so-called fire sand.
records.remedy: An additional protective insulating mat is to be fitted to the switching unit for high-voltage battery.

records.concern: THE FUSE IN THE HIGH-VOLTAGE SYSTEM MAY HAVE BEEN MANUFACTURED WITH AN INSUFFICIENT QUANTITY OF EXTINGUISHING SAND
records.defect: The fuse in the high-voltage system (HV system) in vehicles built within a limited period may have been manufactured with an insufficient quantity of extinguishing sand.
records.remedy: Insulation must be fitted above the switching unit for the high-voltage battery.

records.concern: THE FUEL TANK FEED LINE CONNECTION MAY NOT BE FITTED CORRECTLY
records.defect: The fuel tank feed line connection that is pre-fitted at the supplier to the fuel pump may not be fitted correctly.
records.remedy: The fuel tank will need to be lowered and the fuel line feed connection to be checked and refitted as necessary.

records.concern: VEHICLES WITH AN OM654 ENGINE MIGHT HAVE A LEAKAGE BETWEEN THE VACUUM SYSTEM AND THE COOLANT CIRCUIT
records.defect: On certain vehicles with a Diesel engine the coolant pump which is controlled by vacuum might have a leakage between the vacuum system and the coolant circuit.�
records.remedy: Update the software of the coolant pump and replace the electrical switch valve on the affected vehicles.�

records.concern: A POSSIBLE NON-CONFORMITY OF THE ZINC PLATING SURFACE TREATMENT OF A SMALL COMPONENT OF THE BRAKE HOSE TERMINALS MAY RESULT IN AN INCREASE IN THE BRAKE LEVER TRAVEL
records.defect: A possible non-conformity of the zinc plating surface treatment of a small component of the brake hose terminals may result in an increase in the brake lever travel.
records.remedy: Conduct checks of the brake lever and pedal movement and if necessary replace the brake fluid and bleed the system.

records.concern: THERE IS A RISK THAT THE PARKING BRAKE AIR TUBE CAN BE AFFECTED BY HEAT EXPOSURE
records.defect: During operation of the vehicle with high loads on the engine combined with an exhaust leakage in the engine compartment there is a risk that the parking brake air tube can be affected by heat exposure.
records.remedy: Retrofit a protection sleeve on the parking brake tube.

records.concern: THE WIRING HARNESS OF THE ALTERNATOR MAY POSSIBLY HAVE BEEN SWAPPED WITH THE WIRING HARNESS OF THE ELECTRIC STEERING
records.defect: The wiring harness of the alternator may have been swapped with the wiring harness of the electric steering in the assembly procedure of certain vehicles.
records.remedy: Check the affected lines and if necessary connect the correspondent wiring harnesses.

records.concern: INCORRECT FRONT PASSENGER SEAT BELT ASSEMBLIES WITHOUT AN AUTOMATIC LOCKING RETRACTOR FUNCTION (ALR) MAY HAVE BEEN INSTALLED
records.defect: Incorrect front passenger seat belt assemblies without an automatic locking retractor (ALR) function may have been installed.
records.remedy: Inspect the affected front seat belt assemblies and replace if necessary.

records.concern: THE MICRO GAS GENERATOR WITHIN THE FRONT SEATBELT'S RETRACTOR MAY HAVE BEEN DAMAGED
records.defect: The micro gas generator within the front seatbelt�s retractor may have been damaged and may not act according to the specification in the event of an accident.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the front seatbelts will be checked and replaced if they are found to have been damaged.

records.concern: THE MICRO GAS GENERATOR WITHIN THE FRONT SEATBELT'S RETRACTOR MAY HAVE BEEN DAMAGED
records.defect: The micro gas generator within the front seatbelt�s retractor may have been damaged and may not act according to the specification in the event of an accident.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the front seatbelts will be checked and replaced if they are found to have been damaged

records.concern: THE OBD SOFTWARE COULD MISINTERPRET CERTAIN INPUT PARAMETERS FOR THE ENGINE MANGEMENT SYSTEM
records.defect: During a service visit the affected vehicles have been updated with software that could misinterpret certain input parameters for the engine management system.
records.remedy: The control units will be reprogrammed with an improved version of software.

records.concern: THE SOUND GENERATOR (AVAS) MAY PERMANENTLY FAIL DUE TO A SOFTWARE ERROR
records.defect: The sound generator (AVAS - Acoustic Vehicle Alerting System) may permanently fail due to a software error
records.remedy: The sound generator (AVAS) installed in the vehicle will be replaced.

records.concern: VEHICLES DO NOT HOLD THE NECESSARY APPROVAL CERTIFICATION
records.defect: Vehicles do not hold the necessary approval certification.
records.remedy: Vehicles will be reworked to the approval standard and be VIN (Vehicle Identification Number) marked. This will include the fitment of e-marked lights/reflectors mirrors horn side stand and a compliant speedometer.The motor and motor controller will both be altered.

records.concern: EXTERIOR DOOR HANDLES MIGHT STAY OPEN AND THE DOOR WILL NOT BE LOCKED
records.defect: Exterior door handles might stay open and the door will not be locked.
records.remedy: Check the four door handles and replace them if necessary.

records.concern: A ROTATIONAL SPEED SENSOR IN THE TRANSMISSION COULD POSSIBLY CHAFE THE ELECTRICAL LINE
records.defect: A rotational speed sensor in the transmission could possibly chafe the electrical line.
records.remedy: Replace the rotational speed sensor and optimize the electrical line installation.

records.concern: BOLTING ON BRAKE CALIPER HOUSING MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: The bolting on the brake caliper housing might not meet torque specifications.�
records.remedy: Check and if necessary rework the bolting of the brake caliper housings on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: A PARTICLE IN THE FUEL RAIL MIGHT LEAD TO A LEAK BETWEEN THE FUEL RAIL AND THE INJECTOR
records.defect: A particle in the fuel rail might lead to a leak between the fuel rail and the fuel injector.�
records.remedy: Replace the fuel rail and fuel injectors on the affected vehicles.�

records.concern: ENGINE DESIGN COVERS COULD DETACH FROM THEIR FIXING
records.defect: In some vehicles within the range of specified VINs it is possible that they have engine design covers installed that could detach from their fixing depending on use (very sporty driving or poor road conditions) and the operating time.
records.remedy: The engine design cover must be removed on all affected vehicles.

records.concern: ENGINE COMPARTMENT COVERS COULD COME LOOSE FROM THEIR ATTACHMENT
records.defect: On affected vehicles engine compartment covers were fitted that regardless of use (very sporty driving style or poor road condition) and operating period could come loose from their attachment.
records.remedy: On all affected vehicles the engine compartment cover has to be removed.

records.concern: A SOFTWARE IMPLAUSIBILITY ERROR IN THE HV 'BATTERY GATEWAY' CONTROL UNIT MAY CAUSE THE CONTACTORS OF ALL HV BATTERIES TO BE OPENED UNNECESSARILY
records.defect: A software implausibility error in the HV �battery gateway� control unit may cause the contactors of all HV batteries to be opened unnecessarily.
records.remedy: Update the software of the HV �battery gateway� control unit.

records.concern: ENGINE STALL
records.defect: Due to an improper ECU program vehicles may be affected by engine stalling or limited throttle response.
records.remedy: Apply a software update to the ECU.

records.concern: ENGINE COMPARTMENT COVERS COULD COME LOOSE FROM THEIR ATTACHMENT
records.defect: On affected vehicles engine compartment covers were fitted that regardless of use (very sporty driving style or poor road condition) and operating period could come loose from their attachment.
records.remedy: On all affected vehicles the engine compartment cover has to be removed.

records.concern: THE DESIGN TRIM ON THE POWER UNIT CAN BECOME DETACHED FROM ITS RETAINERS
records.defect: The design trim on the power unit can become detached from its retainers.
records.remedy: The design trim on the power unit must be removed on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: ON CERTAIN VEHICLES THE ROUTING OF AN ELECTRIC CABLE IN THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: On certain vehicles the routing of an electric cable in the engine compartment might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: Check the cable routing on the affected vehicles and correct it if necessary.

records.concern: ON CERTAIN VEHICLESTHE LENGTH OF THE WIRING HARNESS OF THE FRONT WHEEL SPEED SENSORS MIGHT NOT MEET THE REQUIREMENTS
records.defect: On certain vehicles the length of the wiring harness of the front wheel speed sensors might not meet the requirements.
records.remedy: Replace the wiring harness of the front speed sensor on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: THE FUEL FEED HOSE ASSEMBLY MAY HAVE BEEN INCORRECTLY ROUTED
records.defect: The rubberised low-pressure fuel feed hose assembly may have been incorrectly routed during manufacture
records.remedy: Inspect the low-pressure fuel feed hose assembly and if misrouted replace the assembly.

records.concern: THE WIRING HARNESS FOR THE HORN MAY NOT BE DURABLE ENOUGH
records.defect: The wiring harness for the horn may not be durable enough.�
records.remedy: Replace the horn and bracket on all units and to modify the wiring harness.

records.concern: THE CONNECTION BETWEEN THE DRIVER AIRBAG AND THE OCCUPANT RESTRAINT CONTROLLER MAY NOT HAVE BEEN FULLY ENGAGED
records.defect: The connection between the driver airbag and the occupant restraint controller may not been fully engaged.
records.remedy: Check resistance values. If necessary remove the airbag and ensure that the secondary locking tab is correctly engaged.

records.concern: THE NUTS ON THE 48V BATTERY POLES MAY NOT BE TORQUED TO SPECIFICATION
records.defect: The nuts on the 48V battery poles may not be torqued to specification.
records.remedy: Remove both positive and negative poll nuts and inspect the wiring for signs of damage. Any damaged wiring will be replaced. Both nuts will be refitted and torqued to specification.

records.concern: THE EXTERNAL DOOR HANDLE SLIDERS MIGHT NOT BE MANUFACTURED TO THE CORRECT SPECIFICATION
records.defect: The external door handle sliders might not be manufactured to the correct specification.
records.remedy: Check the production date stamped on the door handle slider and replace the slider if needed.

records.concern: REPLACEMENT OF CDI UNIT TO ENSURE DURABILITY OF CONNECTING ROD
records.defect: The anticipated endurance of the connecting rod cannot be ensured.
records.remedy: Conduct a replacement of the CDI control unit with a reduced max RPM limiter.

records.concern: REPLACEMENT OF CDI UNIT TO ENSURE DURABILITY OF CONNECTING ROD
records.defect: The anticipated endurance of the connecting rod cannot be ensured.
records.remedy: Conduct a replacement of the CDI control unit with a reduced max RPM limiter.

records.concern: REPLACEMENT OF CDI UNIT TO ENSURE DURABILITY OF CONNECTING ROD
records.defect: The anticipated endurance of the connecting rod cannot be ensured.
records.remedy: Conduct a replacement of the CDI control unit with a reduced max RPM limiter.�

records.concern: THE FRONT MODULAR BENCH SEAT HEADRESTS MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION.
records.defect: The front modular bench seat headrests may not be to specification and might not be locked correctly.
records.remedy: Check and if necessary replace the affected headrests and guides

records.concern: THE HV BATTERIES MAY FAIL DUE TO IMPURITIES IN THE PRODUCTION PROCESS
records.defect: The HV batteries may fail due to impurities in the production process.
records.remedy: The affected high-voltage cell modules will be replaced

records.concern: LABEL MISSING AT VEHICLE CHARGING INLET
records.defect: Mandatory label may be missing at vehicle charging inlet
records.remedy: Install the decal in the front side of the charging plug on the vehicle

records.concern: DRIVER DOES NOT RECEIVE ANY SUPPORT FROM THE BLIND SPOT ASSISTANCE SYSTEM WITHIN THE SYSTM LIMITS
records.defect: Driver does not receive any support from the Blind Spot Assistance System within the system limits.
records.remedy: The parameter in the VRDU control unit must be changed on the potentially affected vehicles.

records.concern: THE ANNULUS GEAR MAY LOOSEN DURING OPERATION CAUSING ABNORMAL CONTACT BETWEEN THE GEAR AND HUB MOTOR.
records.defect: On certain bikes the annulus gear a component of the wheel hub may loosen during operation causing abnormal contact between the gear and hub motor.
records.remedy: Inspect and verify that the correct tightening torque is applied to the annulus gear component in the front and rear wheel and replace the hub motor seals and bearings. If the torque is not found to be adequate the motor will be replaced.

records.concern: THE ELECTRICAL WIRE FOR THE BELT- FASTENED SENSOR WAS NOT ROUTED ACCORDING TO SPECIFICATIONS AND CAN POTENTIALLY MAKE DIRECT CONTACT WITH THE ISOFIX NOUNTING ON THE RIGHT REAR SEAT
records.defect: The electrical wire for the belt-fastened sensor was not routed according to specifications and can potentially make direct contact with the ISOFIX mounting on the right rear seat.
records.remedy: The wiring harness for the centre rear seat belt buckle must be checked for damage and must be correctly routed and secured on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: THE HEAT INSULATION OF THE RESIN HOSE FOR THE OIL COOLER OUTLET PIPE IS INSUFFICIENT
records.defect: The heat insulation of the resin hose for the oil cooler outlet pipe is insufficient.
records.remedy: The oil cooler outlet pipe will be replaced with a new part. A heat guard will also be fitted to prevent heat from the exhaust damaging the oil cooler outlet pipe.

records.concern: THE SOFTWARE OF THE COMMUNICATION MODULE MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: On certain vehicles the software of the communication module might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: As a precautionary measure update the software of the communication module on the affected vehicles. This software update is planned to be performed over-the-air with no workshop visit being required.

records.concern: THE TRAVELLING SEAT BOLTS MAY HAVE BEEN OVER TORQUED
records.defect: The travelling seat bolts may have been over torqued.
records.remedy: Check the torque setting of the affected bolts and replace if necessary.

records.concern: THE LOCKING MECHANISM FOR THE ELECTRICAL CONNECTOR OF THE LEFT ACCELERATION CRASH SENSOR AT THE BENDING BEAM MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: On certain vehicles the locking mechanism for the electrical connector of the left acceleration crash sensor at the bending beam might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: Check the crash sensor at the bending beam on the affected vehicles and rework if necessary.

records.concern: THE SOFTWARE OF THE COMMUNICATION MODULE MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: On certain vehicles the software of the communication module might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: As a precautionary measure update the software of the communication module on the affected vehicles. This software update is planned to be performed over-the-air with no workshop visit being required.

records.concern: THE EYESIGHT LOGIC MAY CAUSE AN UN-NECESSARY ACTIVATION OF THE PRE-COLLISION BRAKING
records.defect: The Eyesight logic may cause un-necessary activation of the pre-collision braking.
records.remedy: Re-program the Eyesight software

records.concern: THE CRANKSHAFT MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: On certain vehicles with an OM654 classic engine the crankshaft might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: Replace the engines on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: THE MOUNTING PLATE COUNTERBORES MAY BE DRILLED TOO DEEP THEREFORE REDUCING THE STRENGTH OF THE BRAKING BOOSTER
records.defect: The mounting plate counterbores may be drilled too deep therefore reducing the strength of the braking booster.
records.remedy: Conduct a check of the brake booster and replace if necessary.

records.concern: THE CAP OF THE BRAKE OIL RESERVOIR MAY NOT BE ABLE TO ENSURE PROPER VENTILATION TO MAINTAIN THE ATMOSPHERIC PRESSURE INSIDE THE RESERVOIR
records.defect: The cap of the brake oil reservoir may not be able to ensure proper ventilation to maintain the atmospheric pressure inside the reservoir itself.�
records.remedy: Replacement of the brake oil reservoir cap and software update of the Instrument Panel Node.

records.concern: THE RADIATOR FAN CABLE HARNESS HAS THE WRONG TYPE OF WIRE SEALS IN THE POWER SUPPLY CONNECTORS FOR THE ELECTRIC COOLING FANS
records.defect: The radiator fan cable harness has the wrong type of wire seals in the power supply connectors for the electric cooling fans.
records.remedy: Replace the wire seal and if needed change components that have been damaged by water intrusion.

records.concern: THE BONDING OF THE FRONT DESTINATION DISPLAY GLASS MAY BECOME DETACHED
records.defect: The bonding of the front destination display glass may become detached. As a result the glass can become detached and fall out without any warning.
records.remedy: Check the bonding of the glass on the destination display and if necessary repair the destination display.

records.concern: THE INSTALLED SPACER ON THE REAR WHEEL BEHIND THE REAR WHEEL NUT IS THE INCORRECT THICKNESS THIS CAN CAUSE THE NUT TO BECOME LOOSE AND FALL OFF.
records.defect: The installed spacer on the rear wheel behind the rear wheel nut is the incorrect thickness this can cause the rear wheel nut to become loose and fall off.�
records.remedy: Replace the rear wheel spacer.

records.concern: INCORRECT PLASTIC COVERS OF THE LOCKING MECHANISM USED IN PRODUCTION
records.defect: Incorrect plastic covers for the roof box locking mechanism may have been used in production at the supplier.
records.remedy: Check for correct locks. If affected locks are found to be fitted replace roof box.

records.concern: THE FLANGED WHEEL NUTS MAY HAVE BEEN OVER- TORQUED
records.defect: The flanged wheel nuts may have been over-torqued.
records.remedy: Inspect all wheel studs and replace if necessary. Update the user manual.

records.concern: A FAULT COULD OCCUR TEMPORARILY IN THE TRANSMISSION PARKING LOCK FUNCTION
records.defect: A fault could occur temporarily in the transmission parking lock function.
records.remedy: Update the ESP control unit with the revised parameter data record

records.concern: THE CUSTOMER MIGHT NOT BE ALERTED TO A MALFUNCTION OF THE TURN INDICATOR
records.defect: The customer might not be alerted to a malfunction of the turn indicator.
records.remedy: Update the Built-in System Interface (BSI) module with new software.

records.concern: OVER HEATING OF AN INTERNAL COMPONENT IN THE ELECTRIC POWER STEERING
records.defect: Overheating of an internal component in the Electric Power Steering.
records.remedy: Recalibration of the Electronic Power Steering Calculator limiting the overheating at the end lock.

records.concern: ON CERTAIN VEHICLES THE AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION MIGHT HAVE BEEN FILLED WITH TOO MUCH TRANSMISSION OIL
records.defect: On certain vehicles the automatic transmission might have been filled with too much transmission oil.
records.remedy: Check the oil level of the transmission on the affected vehicles and adjust it if necessary.

records.concern: THE SIDE STAND MAY BEND OVER TIME AND USE CAUSING AN AFFECTED MOTORCYCLE TO LEAN BEYOND ITS DESIGNATED ANGLE WHEN PARKED
records.defect: The side stand leg may bend over time and use causing an affected motorcycle to lean beyond its designed angle when parked.
records.remedy: Replace the motorcycle side stand assembly

records.concern: IT IS POSSIBLE A SCREW OF MECHATRONICS TRANSMISSION CONTROL MAY BE MISSING
records.defect: It is possible that a screw of mechatronics transmission control may be missing.
records.remedy: The mechatronics unit will be replaced inside the transmission

records.concern: THE FRONT SUSPENSION SPRINGS MAY NOT BE CORRECTLY POSITIONED IN THE STRUT ASSEMBLY
records.defect: The front suspension springs may not be correctly positioned in the strut assembly.
records.remedy: Check the front suspension springs and correct the position of the spring if necessary.

records.concern: THE CHASSIS GEOMETRY ON THE REAR AXLE HAS DEVIATED IN SOME CASES
records.defect: During a data analysis with regard to carrying out recall campaign AMA9 we discovered that the chassis geometry on the rear axle has deviated in some cases.
records.remedy: The chassis setting on the affected vehicles must be checked and corrected if necessary.

records.concern: ON CERTAIN MODELS WITH AN OM654 CLASSIC DIESEL ENGINE THE CRANKSHAFT MIGHT NOT CORRESPOND WITH THE REQUIRED SPECIFICATION
records.defect: On certain vehicles with an OM654 classic diesel engine the crankshaft might not correspond with the required specification.
records.remedy: Replace the engines on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: A TEMPORARY FAULT WITH THE AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION INTERNAL PARK PAWL MECHANISM MAY OCCUR
records.defect: On certain vehicles fitted with an automatic transmission (gearbox) on rare occasions a temporary fault with the automatic transmission internal park pawl mechanism may occur resulting in the park pawl not engaging as intended.
records.remedy: As a precautionary measure the Mercedes-Benz service organisation will update the ESP control unit software with a revised parameter set on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: MISALIGNMENT OF THE HOOD LATCH MAY PREVENT LATCHING OF THE SECONDARY LATCH
records.defect: Misalignment of the hood latch may prevent latching of the secondary latch.
records.remedy: Inspect the secondary hood latch on affected vehicles. If the hood is not properly retained by the secondary latch the latch mechanism will be reassembled and repositioned to assure proper alignment.

records.concern: THE REAR-VIEW CAMERA HARNESS MAY FAIL CAUSING NO IMAGE IN THE CENTRE DISPLAY
records.defect: The rear-view camera harness may fail causing no image in the centre display.
records.remedy: Fit a harness guide protector and if necessary install a new harness.

records.concern: Some of the delivered control arms could have a non-conforming welding line near the bushing
records.defect: Some control arms could have a non-conforming welding line near the bushing.
records.remedy: Exchange of the affected control arm.

records.concern: DUE TO AN INSTRUMENT PANEL CLUSTER MISCONFIGURATION THE ADVANCED EMERGENCY BRAKING SYSTEM WARNING MESSAGES HAVE BEEN DISABLED
records.defect: Due to an Instrument Panel Cluster misconfiguration the Advanced Emergency Braking System warning messages have been disabled.
records.remedy: Update the Instrument cluster configuration.

records.concern: THE COMMUNICATION MODULE MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: On certain vehicles the communication module might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: Update the software including a correct configuration of the communication module on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: THE CONFIGURATION OF THE MBUX SYSTEM MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: On certain vehicles with an active and connected Mercedes me connect account the configuration of the MBUX system might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: Update the configuration of the MBUX system on affected vehicles.

records.concern: A POTENTIAL FOR AN INTERMITTENT INTERNAL CONNECTION ISSUE ON THE DC/DC CHIP OF THE ON-BOARD CHARGER
records.defect: A potential for an intermittent internal connection issue on the DC/DC chip of the on-board charger.
records.remedy: Check and if necessary replace the on-board charger and update with the latest software.

records.concern: A BATTERY MAY HAVE AN INCORRECTLY POSITIONED/WELDED BUSBAR IN ONE OF THE BATTERY ARRAYS
records.defect: A battery may have an incorrectly positioned/welded busbar in one of the battery arrays
records.remedy: Install a new High Voltage battery.

records.concern: FOLLOWING A PREVIOUS CAMPAIGN THE TOE AND/OR CAMBER VALUES ON THE REAR AXLE MAY IN CERTAIN CIRCUMSTANCES INCORRECTLY BE CHANGED WITHOUT THIS BEING NOTICED
records.defect: Following a previous campaign the toe and/or camber values on the rear axle may in certain circumstances incorrectly be changed without this being noticed.
records.remedy: The wheel alignment must be checked and if necessary the suspension must be serviced on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: THERE IS AN ERROR IN THE SPECIFIC SOFTWARE CALIBRATIONS OF THE ENGINE CONTROL UNIT
records.defect: There is an error in the specific software calibrations of the Engine Control Unit.
records.remedy: Reprogram the Engine ECU

records.concern: THE REAR WINDOW HEATER CABLE MAY BECOME DAMAGED DUE TO INSUFFICIENT FIXATION DESIGN
records.defect: The rear window heater cable may become damaged due to insufficient fixation design
records.remedy: Inspect and add a fixation clip. If necessary the tailgate glass will be replaced

records.concern: THE RADIATOR CAP MAY HAVE INSUFFICIENT SEALANT PERFORMANCE
records.defect: In the cooling system of the engine the radiator cap may have insufficient sealant performance due to small overlap allowance with the filler neck.
records.remedy: Inspect the motorcycle and replace the radiator cap with a counter measured part.

records.concern: VEHICLES MAY HAVE AN INCORRECT TIGHTENING TORQUE ON SEVERAL REAR AXLE COMPONENT FIXINGS
records.defect: Vehicles may have an incorrect tightening torque on several rear axle component fixings.
records.remedy: Check and retighten all fixings to the correct torque settings.

records.concern: VEHICLES MAY HAVE AN INCORRECT TIGHTENING TORQUE ON SEVERAL REAR AXLE COMPONENT FIXINGS
records.defect: Vehicles may have an incorrect tightening torque on several rear axle component fixings.
records.remedy: Check and retighten all fixings to the correct torque settings.

records.concern: DUE TO A NONCONFORMITY IN PRODUCTION THE SIDE MARKER LIGHTS ARE NOT FUNCTIONING
records.defect: Due to a nonconformity in production the side marker lights are not functioning.
records.remedy: The proxy file of the vehicle must be updated to allow the marker lights to function as intended.

records.concern: THE SOFTWARE OF THE ENGINE CONTROL UNIT MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: On certain vehicles the software of the engine control unit might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: Conduct an update the software of the engine control unit on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: VEHICLE MAY NOT MEET STANDARD ECE R55 WHERE A TOWING HOOK MUST HAVE AN ATTACHMENT FOR THE SAFETY WIRE
records.defect: Vehicle may not meet standard ECE R55 where a towing hook must also have an attachment for the safety wire.
records.remedy: Add attachment for safety wire.

records.concern: LEAF SPRING MAY BREAK DURING OPERATION OF THE VEHICLE
records.defect: Leaf spring may break during operation of the vehicle.
records.remedy: Replace the leaf springs.

records.concern: SIGNS OF FATIGUE AT SOME OF THE WELDED JOINTS OF THE HYDROGEN GAS TANK SUPPORTING STEEL FRAME
records.defect: The steel frame supporting the hydrogen gas tanks in the �engine bay� of the vehicle may show signs of fatigue at some of the welded joints leading in some cases to the failure of the joint.
records.remedy: Do not drive and rework the various areas of the frame with redesigned and strengthened bracketry.

records.concern: When the internal temperature of the instrument module (IM) is below 0 C the IM display may generate an error message
records.defect: When the internal temperature of the instrument module (IM) is below 0 �C the IM display may generate an error message and then shortly after go blank until the next ignition cycle when the IM temperature is above 0 �C.
records.remedy: Carry out an instrument module software update.

records.concern: THE REAR SUSPENSION SPRING MAY BECOME DETACHED FROM THE LOWER LOCATING CUP
records.defect: It is possible for the rear suspension spring to become detached from the lower locating cup.
records.remedy: Replace both rear suspension springs and their upper and lower locating cups.

records.concern: THE ACCELERATOR FUNCTION MAY NOT OPERATE AS INTENDED WHEN FULLY RELEASED
records.defect: The accelerator function may not operate as intended when fully released.
records.remedy: The software will be updated within the Electric Power Control Unit and an additional ground cable will be installed to the 3-phase motor.

records.concern: ELECTRICAL HARNESS COULD MOVE FROM ORIGINAL POSITION AND WEAKEN THE HARNESS
records.defect: The rear window electrical harness could become displaced from its original position and present a potential thermal issue.
records.remedy: Check the routing of harness and replace the electrical harness if necessary. Add a fastening clip to ensure that the electrical harness will be maintained in its normal position.

records.concern: ELECTRICAL HARNESS COULD MOVE FROM ORIGINAL POSITION AND WEAKEN THE HARNESS
records.defect: The rear window electrical harness could become displaced from its original position and present a potential thermal issue.
records.remedy: Check the routing of harness and replace the electrical harness if necessary. Add a fastening clip to ensure that the electrical harness will be maintained in its normal position.

records.concern: POWER SUPPLY CONNECTION OF POWER STEERING MIGHT HAVE BEEN CONTAMINATED WITH ADHESIVE
records.defect: On certain vehicles the power supply connection of the electric power steering might have been contaminated with melted adhesive.
records.remedy: Check the connection on the affected vehicles and perform repair measures if necessary.

records.concern: CRASH PADS MAY NOT HAVE BEEN INSTALLED ON THE HIGH VOLTAGE BATTERY DURING VEHICLE ASSEMBLY
records.defect: Crash pads may not have been installed on the high-voltage battery during vehicle assembly.
records.remedy: Vehicles will be inspected and if necessary the crash pads will be retrofitted.

records.concern: POSSIBILITY OF A FUEL LEAK FROM THE FUEL PRESSURE AND TEMPERATURE SENSOR
records.defect: Due to a production nonconformity there may be the possibility of a fuel leak from the fuel pressure and temperature sensor.
records.remedy: Replace the front fuel supply pipe and sensor.

records.concern: THE FUEL HEATER MAY FAIL DUE TO A DAMAGED CABLE
records.defect: The fuel heater may fail due to a cable damaged by heat at the electrical connection of the fuel filter heater.
records.remedy: Fit heat protection sleeve over fuel heater electrical connector and wiring.

records.concern: INADEQUATE FRONT WINDSHIELD ADHESION TO THE VEHICLE BODY STRUCTURE
records.defect: Inadequate front windshield adhesion to the vehicle body structure.
records.remedy: Remove & re-install the windscreen ensuring correct adhesion. Renew windscreen if damage occurs during the repair process.

records.concern: COOLANT PUMP MIGHT HAVE A LEAKAGE BETWEEN THE VACUUM SYSTEM AND THE COOLANT CIRCUIT
records.defect: On certain vehicles with a Diesel engine the coolant pump which is controlled by vacuum might have a leakage between the vacuum system and the coolant circuit.
records.remedy: Update the software of the coolant pump and replace the electrical switch valve on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: FUEL HEATER MIGHT FAIL BECAUSE OF DAMAGE CAUSED BY HEAT TO ELECTRICAL CONNECTION
records.defect: The fuel heater may fail due to a cable damaged by heat at the electrical connection of the fuel filter heater.
records.remedy: Fit heat protection sleeve over fuel heater electrical connector and wiring.

records.concern: REAR SEAT BELT BUCKLE ANCHORAGE ATTACHMENTS MAY NOT MEET THE DESIGN SPECIFICATION
records.defect: The rear seat belt buckle anchorage attachments may not meet the design specification.
records.remedy: Inspect and repair the seat belt anchorage points using a Helicoil repair kit.

records.concern: RISK OF INTERNAL SHORT CURCUIT TO THE BATTERY
records.defect: Risk of internal short-circuit to the battery.
records.remedy: Controlling the battery and replacing the module if necessary.

records.concern: IMPROVE THE ENGINE CONTROL SYSTEM IN TERMS OF NITROGEN OXIDE EMISSIONS
records.defect: Improve the engine control system in terms of nitrogen oxide emissions.
records.remedy: Engine control software will be updated.

records.concern: LOCKING PAWL SPRING OF THE LEFT HAND SIDE DOOR LOCKS MIGHT NOT BE GREASED CORRECTLY
records.defect: On certain vehicles with an additional door lock the locking pawl spring of the left side door locks might not be greased according to specifications.
records.remedy: Conduct greasing of the locking pawl spring on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: THE OPEN CIRCUIT DETECTION SYSTEM COULD BE OVER SENSITIVE CAUSING A NUMBER OF OPERATIONAL ISSUES
records.defect: A possibility that the open circuit detection system could be over-sensitivite causing a number of operational issues including sudden power loss.
records.remedy: Download the latest software configuration check some electronic units and replace them if necessary.

records.concern: THE OPEN CIRCUIT DETECTION SYSTEM COULD BE OVER SENSITIVE CAUSING A NUMBER OF OPERATIONAL ISSUES
records.defect: A possibility that the open circuit detection system could be over-sensitivite causing a number of operational issues including sudden power loss.
records.remedy: Download the latest software configuration check some electronic units and replace them if necessary.

records.concern: THE CRANKSHAFT MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: On certain vehicles with a 4-cylinder Diesel engine the crankshaft might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: Replace the engine on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: SOFTWARE OF ENGINE CONTROL UNIT MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: On certain vehicles the software of the engine control unit might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles conduct an update of the software on the engine control unit.

records.concern: THE CONFIGURATION OF THE MBUX SYSTEM MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS.
records.defect: On certain vehicles with an active and connected Mercedes me connect account the configuration of the MBUX system might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: A remote update of the configuration of the MBUX system will be conducted without the need for a workshop visit.

records.concern: CATALYTIC REDUCTION (SCR) SYSTEM WIRING MAY BECOME DAMAGED BY CONTAMINATION
records.defect: Catalytic Reduction (SCR) system wiring may become damaged by contamination
records.remedy: Inspect the SCR harness repair if necessary and fit protector.

records.concern: THE CORROSION PROTECTION OF THE HIGH VOLTAGE BATTERY HOUSING MIGHT NOT BE ENSURED OVER THE LIFETIME OF THE VEHICLE
records.defect: On certain vehicles the corrosion protection of the high-voltage battery housing might not be ensured over the lifetime of the vehicle.
records.remedy: Check the high-voltage battery of the affected vehicles and if necessary carry out rework measures.

records.concern: MOUNTING SCREWS OF FRONT AXLE BRAKE CALLIPERS MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: On vehicles with a fixed�caliper�brake system the mounting screws of the�calipers�on the front axle may not meet specifications.
records.remedy: Replace the screws on the front brake�calipers�on the affected vehicles.�

records.concern: TO ACHIEVE AN IMPROVEMENT IN THE EMISSIONS
records.defect: Daimler AG has come to an understanding with the (KBA) to achieve an improvement in the emissions.
records.remedy: Update the diesel engine control unit software.

records.concern: THE WINDOW AIR BAGS MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: The window airbags might not meet specifications
records.remedy: Replace the window airbags on the affected vehicles with�parts within specification

records.concern: THE SOFTWARE OF THE AIR BAG CONTROL UNIT MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: The software of the airbag control unit might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: Conduct an update of the software for the airbag control unit on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: VEHICLES COULD BE EQUIPPED WITH A FRONT AXLE BRAKE CALLIPER CARRIER WHICH COULD HAVE BEEN MANUFACTURED OUTSIDE THE SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: Vehicles could be equipped with a front axle brake calliper carrier which could have been manufactured outside the specifications
records.remedy: Check the brake calliper carriers on the front axle and as a precautionary measure renew any front axle brake calliper carrier should it be part of the affected batch.

records.concern: THE FITTED TYRES MAY ADVERSELY AFFECT VEHICLE EMISSION OUTPUTS
records.defect: The fitted tyres may adversely affect vehicle emission outputs.
records.remedy: Check whether the Pirelli PZero N0 tyres fitted ex-works are still on affected 981 Spyder vehicles and replace them with the successor model Pirelli PZero N1.

records.concern: DS7 4x4 eTense vehicles equipped with 205/55 R19 97V A class Michelin Primacy 3 tyres may experience premature wearing of the insides of the rear tyres
records.defect: DS7 4x4 eTense vehicles equipped with 205/55 R19 97V A class Michelin Primacy 3 tyres may experience premature wearing of the insides of the rear tyres.
records.remedy: Fit A class tyres of dimension 235/50 R19 103V as well as different wheel rims.

records.concern: THE ENGAGEMENT HOOKS OF THE CABLE DUCT OF THE STARTER-GENERATOR WIRING HARNESSMAY NOT BE FULLY LATCHED IN THE BATTERY CASE
records.defect: On certain vehicles the engagement hooks of the cable duct of the starter-generator wiring harness may not be fully latched in the battery case.
records.remedy: Check the fixings of the cable bracket and replace the engagement hooks of the affected cable duct with expanding rivets if required.

records.concern: RUBBER CAP ON SERVICE BRAKE AIR TANKS EBS VALUES AND TRAILER AIR BRAKE TANK MIGHT BE MISSING
records.defect: The rubber caps on the service brake air tanks EBS valves and trailer brake air tanks might be missing
records.remedy: Check rubber caps are assembled and if found to be missing fit caps as required

records.concern: LOW PRESSURE FUEL PUMP IMPELLER MIGHT BECOME DEFORMED
records.defect: The impeller in the low-pressure fuel pump may become deformed causing fuel pump failure.
records.remedy: Replace the low-pressure fuel pump with an improved part.

records.concern: THERE IS A POSSIBILITY THAT TYRES COULD SUDDENLY LOSE AIR
records.defect: There is a possibility that tyres could suddenly lose air.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the production data (DOT number) of all tyres including spare wheel are checked and if necessary tyres will be replaced.

records.concern: ABS INDICATOR LAMP DOES NOT LIGHT UPON DISPLAY SCREEN FOR 2 SECONDS DURING DISPLAY CHECK
records.defect: The data record of the Instrument control unit has software bug issues.
records.remedy: Re-parameterise the Instrument control unit with the latest data software record.

records.concern: THE MATERIAL QUALITY OF THE SCREWS USED FOR SEAT BELTS AND REAR SEATS MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATIONS.
records.defect: The material quality of seat and seatbelt screws may not be according to specification.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the screws will be replaced in specific locations on the seat belts or rear seats.

records.concern: THE SUN ROOF FRAME MAY NOT HAVE BEEN BONDED TO THE BODY ROOF
records.defect: The sunroof frame may not have been correctly bonded to the body roof.
records.remedy: Check and if necessary correctly bond the sunroof frame to the body roof.

records.concern: Rear tyres may crack and cause sudden pressure loss.
records.defect: Rear tyres may crack and cause sudden pressure loss.
records.remedy: Replace the rear tyres within 1875 miles of wear or within 1.5 years until revised specification tyres are available.

records.concern: THE CURTAIN SIDE AIRBAGS MAY NOT DEPLOY CORRECTLY
records.defect: The curtain side airbags may not deploy correctly.
records.remedy: Inspect for proper alignment and orientation of the left- and right-curtain side airbag. Re-align as necessary.

records.concern: THE FRONT SUSPENSION LATERAL LINK MAY BE INSUFFICIENTLY TORQUED
records.defect: The front suspension lateral link may be insufficiently torqued.
records.remedy: Inspect the connection of both front suspension lateral links to the sub-frame. Replace any related damaged components and ensure correct torque of fastening bolts.

records.concern: A STEERING SHAFT THAT IS NOT EQUIPPED WITH A FRICTION-REDUCED UNIVERSAL JOINT WAS INSTALLED
records.defect: A steering shaft that is not equipped with a friction-reduced universal joint was installed.
records.remedy: The steering shaft must be replaced on the potentially affected vehicles.

records.concern: POTENTIAL MANUFACTURING DEFECT WITHIN THE COMPONENT OF THE RIGHT HAND REAR CALIPER
records.defect: A manufacturing defect may be present within the right-hand rear brake calliper which may result in impaired brake performance.
records.remedy: Visually inspect and if the right-hand rear brake calliper is confirmed to be fitted with the affected batch code (1J24) it will be replaced.

records.concern: THE DISTANCE BETWEEN THE BRAKE LINE AND WIRING HARNESS MAY NOT BE SUFFICIENT
records.defect: On certain Mercedes-Benz Sprinter vehicles the distance between the brake line and the wiring harness may not be sufficient.
records.remedy: Check and apply an anti-chafe protection to the affected components. If damage to the components is already evident then the affected components will be replaced and anti-chafe protection applied.

records.concern: WIND NOISE AND WATER LEAKS AROUND THE PANORAMIC GLASS ROOF DUE TO ADHESION ISSUES.
records.defect: Vehicles could develop wind noise & water leaks around the panoramic glass roof. Should the roof glass loosen there is a risk that the glass could become detached from the vehicle.
records.remedy: Add additional urethane adhesive between the vehicle body and roof glass.

records.concern: THE ADAPTOR OF THE STEERING SHAFT HAS FRACTURED DURING MANUFACTURE
records.defect: During the manufacturing of the adapter of the steering shaft fracturing of the forged parts may have occurred
records.remedy: Replace the steering shaft with a correctly manufactured part

records.concern: RIDER'S SEAT BASE THREADED INSERT FAILURE
records.defect: Riders seat base threaded insert failure.
records.remedy: Replacement of seat base.

records.concern: EXCESSIVE INCREASE OF COOLING SYSTEM TEMPERATURE COULD LEAD TO A BURSTING OF THE HEATER MATRIX RADIATOR
records.defect: Excessive increase of cooling system temperature could (in a worst case) lead to a bursting of the heater matrix radiator.
records.remedy: Fitting an additional thermostat and modified hoses into the heating system to bypass the heat exchanger if overheating was to occur.

records.concern: THE STARTER MOTOR MAY ENGAGE INCORRECTLY
records.defect: The starter motor may engage incorrectly and this may lead to a noise when starting the engine or even non-start.
