records.remedy: Check the steering shaft on the affected vehicles and replace it if necessary.

records.concern: VEHICLES MAY BE EQUIPED AND FITTED WITH THE INCORRECT REAR RIGHT BRAKE CALIPER
records.defect: Vehicles may be equipped and fitted with the incorrect rear right brake caliper.
records.remedy: Visual inspection of the rear right brake Caliper to check the ��date of manufacture�� code. Replace the caliper if affected.

records.concern: THE FIXATION OF THE REAR HEADRESTS MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: The fixation of the rear headrests might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: Check the guide sleeves on the rear seats of the potentially affected vehicles and replace them if necessary.

records.concern: POOR PERFORMANCE OF THE FUEL INJECTION SYSTEM
records.defect: Poor performance of the fuel injection system due to a fuel contamination (not linked with a quality of the fuel itself).
records.remedy: Replacement of the fuel filter cartridge increasing the filtration system and testing the injectors. In case of checks with negative result the electro-injectors will be replaced.

records.concern: INTERNAL SOFTWARE ERROR IN THE HIGH-VOLTAGE POWER ELECTRONICS
records.defect: It is possible for the affected vehicles to display the warning message Drive control disturbed - Park vehicle safely in the instrument cluster.
records.remedy: The high-voltage power electronics must be reprogrammed with corrected software.

records.concern: THE BOLTING OF THE HIGH VOLTAGE BATTERY TO THE VEHICLE BODY IN THE LUGGAGE COMPARTMENT MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: The bolting of the high-voltage battery to the vehicle body in the luggage compartment might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: Check the bolting of the high-voltage battery to the vehicle body on the affected vehicles and rework if necessary.

records.concern: THE PASSENGER AIRBAG DEPLOYMENT DOOR INTEGRATED IN THE INSTRUMENT PANEL FACIA CONTAINS AN ADDITIONAL MESH LAYER
records.defect: The passenger airbag deployment door integrated in the instrument panel facia contains an additional mesh layer.
records.remedy: Replace the affected instrument panel facia with a part manufactured to the correct specification.

records.concern: THE RETURN HOSES OF THE POWER HYDRAULICS MAY NOT WITHSTAND THE SPECIFIED SYSTEM PRESSURE DUE TO THE AGING PROCESS
records.defect: The return hoses of the power hydraulics may not withstand the specified system pressure due to the aging process.
records.remedy: Replace the return hoses of the power hydraulics.

records.concern: THE BOLTING OF A SIDE CRASH SENSOR MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: The bolting of a side crash sensor may not meet specifications.
records.remedy: Check the bolting of the side crash sensor on the affected vehicles and rework it if necessary.

records.concern: DURING VEHICLE OPERATION THE AIR SPRING MEMBER CAN GET LOOSEAND A STEERING EFFECTMIGHT APPEAR FOR THE REAR AXLE
records.defect: Nuts used for the rear axle snow chain installation may have wrong material hardness.�
records.remedy: Replace nuts on all affected trucks

records.concern: SCREWS SECURING STEERING COLUMN TO STEERING GEAR DON'T MEET SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: The screws securing the steering column to the steering gear may not meet� the required specifications on�affected vehicles.�
records.remedy: The steering column screws must be replaced.�

records.concern: On affected vehicles there is a potential fault with the fuel pump module. This could result in the vehicle not starting and in rare circumstances a loss of torque or engine stalling.
records.defect: On affected vehicles there is a potential fault with the fuel pump module. This could result in the vehicle not starting and in rare circumstances a loss of torque or engine stalling.
records.remedy: Replace the fuel pump module and reprogram the injection computer.

records.concern: SOME VEHICLES MAY BE SUSCEPTIBLE TO DAMAGE TO THE ANTI-CORROSION COATING OF THE LOWER STEERING SHAFT
records.defect: Some vehicles may be susceptible to damage to the anti-corrosion coating of the lower steering shaft.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the steering shaft must be replaced.

records.concern: THE BRAKE PEDAL SHAFT COULD BECOME DETACHED FROM THE PEDAL CONTROLS BEARING MOUNT
records.defect: It is possible that the brake pedal shaft could become detached from the pedal controls bearing mount.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles the brake pedal bearing shaft must be secured in the pedal controls with a roll pin.

records.concern: FAILURE OF THE FRONT AXLE BEAM
records.defect: Possible failure of the front axle beam due to inadequate welds.
records.remedy: Weld a strengthening plate to the axle beam.

records.concern: THE SIDE CURTAIN AIRBAG COULD POTENTIALLY BE ASSEMBLED IN A TWISTED CONDITION
records.defect: The side curtain airbag could potentially be assembled in a twisted condition.
records.remedy: Affected vehicles will be inspected to ascertain if the airbag is correctly installed. If the airbag is twisted it will be removed and reinstalled correctly.

records.concern: THE ABS CONTROL UNIT PRINTED CIRCUIT BOARD COULD EXPERIENCE AN ELECTRICAL SHORT UNDER SPECIFIC CONDITIONS
records.defect: The ABS control unit printed circuit board (PCB) could experience an electrical short under specific conditions.
records.remedy: The HECU (ABS/ESC) control unit fuses will be reworked.

records.concern: IMPROPER DESIGN OF THE DRIVER SIDE AND THE PASSENGER SIDE DOOR HARNESSES MAY AFFECT AIR BAG OPERATION
records.defect: Improper design of the driver side and the passenger side door harnesses may affect air bag operation..
records.remedy: Replace the door harnesses of the affected vehicles.

records.concern: THE FUEL FEEDING IMPELLER IN THE FUEL PUMP MAY BE SWOLLEN AND DEFORMED
records.defect: The fuel feeding impeller in the fuel pump may be swollen and deformed.
records.remedy: Replace fuel pump.

records.concern: POSSIBLE THERMAL ESCALATION IN CAB HEATER DUE TO RELAY FAILURE
records.defect: Possible thermal escalation in cab heater due to relay failure.
records.remedy: Replacement of the power relays for cooling heater.

records.concern: THE REAR SPRING CENTRALISER MIGHT BE WELDED INCORRECTLY
records.defect: The rear spring centraliser might be welded incorrectly.
records.remedy: Add 3 weld spots to the rear spring centralisers

records.concern: VEHICLES MAY HAVE RECEIVED DURING A REPAIR A REMANUFACTURED STEERING RACK
records.defect: Vehicles may have received during a repair a remanufactured steering rack where the track rod ends have not been installed correctly.
records.remedy: Inspect the steering rack and repair if required

records.concern: THE NUTS OF THE 12V CONNECTOR MAY NOT BE TIGHTENED INCORRECTLY
records.defect: The nuts of the 12V connector may not be tightened correctly.
records.remedy: : Check the 12V earth connection and ensure correct torque is applied.

records.concern: THE REAR SPRING CENTRALISER MIGHT BE WELDED INCORRECTLY
records.defect: The rear spring centraliser might be welded incorrectly.
records.remedy: Add 3 weld spots to the rear spring centralisers.

records.concern: TEMPERATURE WARNING SYSTEM MAY NOT PROVIDE A WARNING WHEN INTENDED
records.defect: Temperature warning system for the third alternator may not provide a warning when intended.
records.remedy: Check if the temperature sensor is in correct position and adjust if required.

records.concern: THE RIGHT LINKAGE ADJUSTERS ON THE REAR AXLE WERE MANUFACTURED INCORRECTLY
records.defect: The right linkage adjusters on the rear axle were manufactured incorrectly.
records.remedy: Replacement of the right linkage adjusters on the rear axle.

records.concern: THE BEHAVIOUR OF THE EMERGENCY CALL SYSTEM MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: The behaviour of the emergency call system might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: Update the software of the communication module for the emergency call system on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: THERE MAY BE AN INCORRECT TIGHTENING TORQUE APPLICATION ON THE REAR WHEEL HUB
records.defect: There may be an incorrect tightening torque application on the rear wheel hub.
records.remedy: Check the rear wheel bearing hub screws and if necessary replace the screws on both sides of the vehicle.

records.concern: THE PLUG OF THE ACTIVATED CHARCOAL CANISTER DRAINAGE HOSE CAN BE DAMAGED BY HEAT FROM THE EXHAUST SYSTEM
records.defect: The plug of the activated charcoal canister drainage hose can be damaged by heat from the exhaust system.
records.remedy: The existing plug must be replaced by the new aluminum version.

records.concern: FAILURE OF CONNECTING RODS
records.defect: Failure of connecting rods resulting in catastrophic engine failure due to supplied connecting rods manufactured outside of specification.
records.remedy: Replace the engine with one that contains connecting rods that meet specification

records.concern: THE CURRENT SOFTWARE DOES NOT PROVIDE SUFFICIENT NOx MONITORING
records.defect: The current software does not provide sufficient NOx monitoring
records.remedy: Update EMS software.

records.concern: WHEN STARTING THE VEHICLE THE 'STOP & START' SYSTEM MAY NOT BE ACTIVATED THIS COULD LEAD TO AN INCREASE IN THE LEVEL OF EMISSIONS AND FUEL CONSUMPTION OF YOUR VEHICLE.
records.defect: When starting the vehicle the Stop & Start system may not be activated. This could lead to an increase in the level of emissions and fuel consumption of your vehicle.
records.remedy: Update the software for the Stop & Start system.

records.concern: THE CURRENT SOFTWARE DOES NOT PROVIDE SUFFICIENT NOx MONITORING
records.defect: The current software does not provide sufficient NOx monitoring.
records.remedy: Update EMS software.

records.concern: THE CURRENT SOFTWARE DOES NOT PROVIDE SUFFICIENT NOx MONITORING
records.defect: The current software does not provide sufficient NOx monitoring.
records.remedy: Update EMS software.

records.concern: THE MIDDLE FASTENING OF THE ROOF RAIL COULD COME LOOSE
records.defect: The middle fastening of the roof rail could come loose.
records.remedy: Carry out a check of the roof rail and replace if necessary.

records.concern: ON SOME VEHICLES WITH A REAR-VIEW CAMERA THE TAILGATE MAY BE UNLOCKED INDEPENDENTLY / AUTOMATICALLY
records.defect: On some vehicles with a rear-view camera the tailgate may be unlocked independently/automatically.
records.remedy: Seal the duct for the electrical wiring harness of reversing camera on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: A DEFECTIVE SHIFT DRUM MAY HAVE BEEN INSTALLED
records.defect: A defective shift drum may have been installed.
records.remedy: The shift drum must be replaced on all affected motorcycles.

records.concern: THE BOLTS AND NUTS OF THE CONTROL ARMS MIGHT BE INCORRECTLY TIGHTENED
records.defect: The bolts and nuts of both the control arms might be incorrectly tightened.
records.remedy: Replace the bolts and nuts of both the control arms and tighten to the correct specifications.

records.concern: THE INSIDE OF THE HIGH PRESSURE FUEL PUMP MAY BE WORN OR DAMAGED OVER TIME DURING OPERATION
records.defect: The inside of the high-pressure fuel pump may be worn or damaged over time during operation.
records.remedy: Inspect* and if necessary replace the high-pressure fuel pump. (*Based on engine variant and/or pump manufacturer/pump serial number.)

records.concern: THE INCORRECT WEIGHT INFORMATION WAS APPLIED TO THE CERTIFICATE OF CONFORMITY
records.defect: The incorrect weight information was applied to the Certificate of Conformity (COC).
records.remedy: To proactively update the Certificate of Conformity (COC) and replace the vehicle registration document of all potentially affected vehicles.

records.concern: THE AIR BAG INFLATOR MAY RUPTURE DURING DEPLOYMENT
records.defect: The air bag inflator may rupture during deployment.
records.remedy: Replacement of the air bag inflator.

records.concern: REAR AXLE SUSPENSION LINKS NUTS DO NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: One or more nuts which do not meet the specifications may have been fitted on the rear axle suspension links.
records.remedy: The affected nuts on the rear axle will be replaced on affected vehicles.

records.concern: THE RUBBERISED FUEL RETURN HOSE ASSEMBLY MAY HAVE BEEN INCORRECTLY MANUFACTURED
records.defect: The rubberised fuel return hose assembly may have been incorrectly manufactured.
records.remedy: Inspect the date code on the fuel return pipe and replace the part if necessary.

records.concern: THE RUBBERISED FUEL RETURN HOSE ASSEMBLY MAY HAVE BEEN INCORRECTLY MANUFACTURED
records.defect: The rubberised fuel return hose assembly may have been incorrectly manufactured.
records.remedy: Inspect the date code on the fuel return pipe and replace the part if necessary.

records.concern: ON CERTAIN FRONT WHEEL DRIVE VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH AN ADDITIONAL TRACTION BATTERY THE ATTACHMENT BOLTS ON THE FRAME OF THIS HIGH VOLTAGE BATTERY COULD BE LOOSE
records.defect: On certain front-wheel-drive vehicles equipped with an additional traction battery the attachment bolts on the frame of this high voltage battery could be loose.
records.remedy: Tighten the screwing of the high voltage battery module on the affected vehicles according to the respective specification.

records.concern: DUE TO INSUFFICIENT CONTACT OF THE BATTERY EARTH STUD TO THE CHASSIS THE VEHICLE MAY EXHIBIT VARIOUS ELECTRICAL FAULTS
records.defect: Due to insufficient contact of the battery earth stud to the chassis the vehicle may exhibit various electrical faults.
records.remedy: Replace the earth stud with a bespoke aftermarket specification part.

records.concern: THE OPERATION OF THE BRAKE VACUMN PUMP MAY BE AFFECTED DUE TO MATERIAL DETACHING FROM THE TIMING BELT
records.defect: The operation of the brake vacuum pump may be affected due to material detaching from the timing belt.
records.remedy: Check and if necessary replace the timing belt and other components of the braking assistance system including the vacuum pump. Additionally alter servicing schedules depending on usage.

records.concern: VEHICLE MAY BE EQUIPPED AND FITTED WITH THE INCORRECT REAR RIGHT BRAKE CALIPER
records.defect: Vehicle may be equipped and fitted with the incorrect rear right brake Caliper.
records.remedy: Visual inspection of the rear right brake Caliper to check the ��date of manufacture�� code. Replace the caliper if affected.

records.concern: THE ALIGNMENT OF THE GEAR TEETH ON THE LICENSE PLATE HOLDER AND SWING ARM MAY BE INADEQUATE
records.defect: The alignment of the gear teeth on the license plate holder and swingarm may be inadequate.
records.remedy: Check the mounting position of the license plate holder and realign if required.

records.concern: NUTS FITTED IN THE BOLTED CONNECTION OF THE RIGHT AND LEFT TRANSVERSE LINK MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFCATION
records.defect: Nuts of deviating material quality were fitted in the bolted connection of the right and left transverse link on the bottom of the multi-link rear axle.
records.remedy: The nuts of the right and left transverse link on the bottom of the multi-link rear axle will be replaced.

records.concern: A MICROPROCESSOR FAULT IN THE AIRBAG CONTROL UNIT CAN LEAD TO FAULTY OPERATING CONDITIONS
records.defect: A microprocessor fault in the airbag control unit can lead to faulty operating conditions.
records.remedy: The airbag control unit will be replaced.

records.concern: THE REINFORCEMENT RING (THIMBLE) MAY NOT HAVE BEEN SECURELY CRIMPED ONTO THE BELT TENSIONER'S STEEL CABLE
records.defect: The reinforcement ring (thimble) may not have been securely crimped onto the belt tensioner's steel cable.
records.remedy: Check the belt buckle and if necessary conduct replacement of the lower strap including belt tensioner.

records.concern: THE AIR CONDITIONING DRAIN HOSES MIGHT BE INCORRECTLY FITTED IN THE VEHICLE
records.defect: The air conditioning drain hoses might be incorrectly fitted in the vehicle.
records.remedy: Conduct a check of the air conditioning drain hoses and correct their installation if necessary.

records.concern: TAKATA AIR BAG INFLATOR COULD RUPTURE
records.defect: Driver airbags equipped with non-desiccated ammonium-nitrate airbag inflators in certain climatic circumstances could over time develop a chemical alteration of the propellant.
records.remedy: Replace the driver�s airbag and diode in potentially affected vehicles.

records.concern: TAKATA AIR BAG INFLATOR COULD RUPTURE
records.defect: Driver airbags equipped with non-desiccated ammonium-nitrate airbag inflators in certain climatic circumstances could over time develop a chemical alteration of the propellant.
records.remedy: Replace the driver�s airbag in potentially affected vehicles

records.concern: THE STOCK CVT AIR INTAKE MAY BECOME COMPLETELY OBSTRUCTED WHEN VEHICLES ARE EQUIPPED WITH A TRACK KIT AND USED IN SNOW
records.defect: The stock CVT air intake may become completely obstructed when vehicles are equipped with a track kit and used in snow.
records.remedy: BRP will reimburse or pay for the installation of a CVT air intake relocating kit.

records.concern: IMPROVED EMISSION CONTROL AND MONITORING IN THE EMS
records.defect: Error in emission control readings.
records.remedy: Carry out update to EMS and SW software.

records.concern: OIL FROM THE TURBO CHARGER BEARINGS CAN PASS OVER THE COMPRESSOR SIDE OF THE TURBO AND INTO THE ENGINE AIR INTAKE
records.defect: A risk of an unwanted engine acceleration or an engine failure due to a hydraulic lock caused by oil from the turbo charger bearings passing over to the compressor side of the turbo.
records.remedy: Replace the turbocharger before oil carry over becomes critical. Increase engine idle speed to 650 rpm modify idle shutdown to 5 minutes at above 40 C and replace the DPF differential pressure sensor.

records.concern: INCORRECT LOCATION INFORMATION MAY BE SENT FROM THE eCALL SYSTEM
records.defect: Incorrect location information may be sent from the eCall system.
records.remedy: A software update is required to SYNC module.

records.concern: THE LOWER TRAILING ARMS ON THE RIGHT FRONT AXLE MAY NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: There is a possibility that the right front lower trailing arms do not meet the required specifications.
records.remedy: The lower trailing arm on the right front axle must be replaced on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: THE EXHAUST GAS RECIRCULATION MODULE COULD LEAK OVER TIME
records.defect: The Exhaust Gas Recirculation (EGR) Module could leak over time�and cause thermal incident.
records.remedy: The EGR cooler will be internally inspected with an endoscope and replaced if evidence of leaking is found.

records.concern: DUE TO AN INAPPROPRIATE SOFTWARE THE SKID CONTROL ECU MAY NOT COMPLETE ALL ITS PROCESSING TASKS
records.defect: Due to an inappropriate software the Skid Control ECU may not complete all its processing tasks.
records.remedy: Reprogram the Skid control ECU.

records.concern: A MANUFACTURING ISSUE COULD PREVENT THE ACCELERATOR PEDAL FROM RETURNING TO ITS RESTING POSITION
records.defect: Inconsistent fitment of the fuse box and the electrical harness may prevent the accelerator pedal from returning to its resting position.
records.remedy: Check and if necessary rework the A-post lower trim ensuring correct clearance of the trim to the accelerator pedal.

records.concern: THE ROOF LINING STIFFENING PLATES MAY NOT BE BONDED CORRECTLY
records.defect: The roof lining stiffening plates may not be bonded correctly.
records.remedy: The roof headliner will be inspected and reworked or replaced if required.

records.concern: FUEL TANK STRAP BOLTS WERE NOT MANUFACTURED TO THE CORRECT HARDNESS SPECIFICATION
records.defect: Fuel tank strap bolts were not manufactured to the correct hardness specification.
records.remedy: Fit replacement bolt fixing and torque to the specified load.

records.concern: THE LOCK WASHER OF THE PIN JOINING THE BRAKE PEDAL TO THE BEARING PEDESTAL COULD COME LOOSE
records.defect: The lock washer of the pin joining the brake pedal to the bearing pedestal could come loose.
records.remedy: Provide additional securement of the bearing pedestal to the brake pedal by means of fitting an additional retaining ring.

records.concern: FUEL HOSE COULD PERISH OVER TIME
records.defect: Fuel hose may not be to correct specification.
records.remedy: Check and if necessary replace the affected fuel hose.

records.concern: THE RIGHT REAR BRAKE CALLIPER MIGHT NOT BE BUILT TO SPECIFICATION
records.defect: The right rear brake calliper might not be built to specification.
records.remedy: Check the production date stamp of the right rear brake calliper and replace the brake calliper if necessary.

records.concern: THE FRONT LOWER BALL JOINT LOCATING BOLT AND FIXING NUT MIGHT HAVE BEEN INCORRECTLY TIGHTENED OR NOT FITTED CORRECTLY
records.defect: The front lower ball-joint locating bolt and fixing nut might have been incorrectly tightened or not fitted correctly.
records.remedy: Replace the bolts and fixing nuts that attach both of the front lower ball joints to the front hub assemblies.

records.concern: THE REAR WHEEL HUB SHOCK ABSORBER AND BRAKE CALIPER ARE POSSIBLY NOT TIGHTENED ACCORDING TO SPECIFICATION
records.defect: The rear wheel hub the shock absorber and the brake calliper are possibly not tightened according to specification.
records.remedy: Check the affected bolted connections on the rear axle for correct tightening torque application and replace affected components if necessary.

records.concern: THE BEHAVIOUR OF THE EMERGENCY CALL SYSTEM MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: The behaviour of the emergency call system might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: Update the software of the communication module for the emergency call system on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: THE BEHAVIOUR OF THE EMERGENCY CALL SYSTEM MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: The behaviour of the emergency call system might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: Update the software of the communication module for the emergency call system on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: THERE IS A RISK THAT THE 15AMP FUSE COULD BLOW WHICH WILL PREVENT THE LOW PRESSURE FUEL PUMP FROM OPERATING
records.defect: There is a risk that the 15amp fuse could blow which will prevent the low pressure fuel pump operating.
records.remedy: Replace the 15A fuse with a 20A fuse which can withstand this peak.

records.concern: VEHICLES MAY HAVE BEEN FITTED WITH A HINGED TOWING BRACKET ON WHICH THE LOCKING MECHANISM IN THE HINGE MODULE COULD BE FAULTY
records.defect: Vehicles may have been fitted with a hinged towing bracket on which the locking mechanism in the hinge module could be faulty.
records.remedy: The hinge module for the towing bracket must be checked and where necessary replaced on the vehicles affected.

records.concern: A TOW BAR WITH A POSSIBLY DEFECTIVE LOCKING MECHANISM IN THE SWIVELLING MODULE HAS BEEN FITTED
records.defect: A tow bar with a possibly defective locking mechanism in the swivelling module has been fitted.
records.remedy: The tow bar has to be checked and if necessary the swivelling module of the tow bar replaced.

records.concern: POSSIBLE POOR CONDUCTION BY CORROSION OF THE SPEEDOMETER ASSEMBLY
records.defect: Due to�an�insufficient corrosion resistance of the inner parts of the speedometer assembly�corrosion�may cause poor conduction and�a�power supply loss to�the speed sensor
records.remedy: Replace�the speedometer assembly

records.concern: FUEL PIPES CHAFFING MIGHT CAUSE ABNORMAL WEAR AND CONSEQUENTLY FUEL LEAKAGES
records.defect: Fuel pipes chaffing might cause abnormal wear and consequently fuel leakages
records.remedy: Visual inspection adding protection on the fuel pipe replace pipe if applicable.

records.concern: THE SOFTWARE AND HARDWARE OF THE PARKING CONTROL UNIT MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: The software and hardware of the parking control unit might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: Replace the parking control unit on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: IF THE BATTERY CABLE CONNECTION HAS BEEN MOUNTED INCORRECTLY THIS MAY LEAD TO A GROUND FAULT
records.defect: The battery cables may be mounted incorrectly
records.remedy: The battery cable connections have to be checked and modified if required.

records.concern: IF THE BATTERY CABLE CONNECTION HAS BEEN MOUNTED INCORRECTLY THIS MAY LEAD TO A GROUND FAULT
records.defect: The battery cables may be mounted incorrectly.
records.remedy: The battery cable connections have to be checked and modified if required.

records.concern: THERE IS A POSSIBILITY THAT A CRACK FORMATION COULD OCCUR ON THE ENGINE CYLINDER BORES
records.defect: There is a possibility that a crack formation could occur on the engine cylinder bores.
records.remedy: The engine on the affected vehicles will be replaced.

records.concern: POSSIBLE LACK OF COTTER PIN OR WRONG COTTER PIN ASSEMBLY ON STEERING AXLE
records.defect: Possible lack of cotter pin on steering axle or possible wrong cotter pin assembly on steering axle.
records.remedy: Check and re-torque the nut and replacement of the cotter pin on the steering track rod.

records.concern: CRACKS COULD BE PRESENT IN THE CYLINDER BORE OF SPECIFIC V8 ENGINES
records.defect: Cracks could be present in the cylinder bore of specific V8 engines.
records.remedy: Replace the engine of affected vehicles

records.concern: THE NUT OF THE ECCENTRIC SCREW COULD BREAK ON THE REAR AXLE LOWER LEVER ARM
records.defect: The nut of the eccentric screw could break on the rear axle lower lever arm which may cause alterations in the wheel alignment of the rear axle.
records.remedy: Replace with new known correct nuts from outside identified manufacturing batches. If the screw connection is already damaged this will additionally be replaced.

records.concern: THERE IS A POSSIBILITY THAT THE EXHAUST GAS RECIRCULATION COOLER COULD DEVELOP AN INTERNAL COOLANT LEAK
records.defect: A possibility that the Exhaust Gas Recirculation (EGR) cooler could develop an internal coolant leak
records.remedy: Replace the EGR cooler in all involved vehicles and if necessary replace the inlet manifold.

records.concern: A FUEL LEAK MAY OCCUR DUE TO A CHAFING CONDITION BETWEEN THE FUEL FEED HOSE AND THE CAMSHAFT COVER
records.defect: A fuel leak may occur due to a chafing condition between the fuel feed hose and the camshaft cover.
records.remedy: Check the fuel feed hose replace it if damaged and add a protection to the hose to prevent a future chafing condition.

records.concern: THE BONDING BETWEEN THE GLASS PANEL AND THE SLIDING ROOF FRAME MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: The bonding between the glass panel and the sliding roof frame might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: Check the glass panel bonding on the affected vehicles and replace the sliding roof if necessary.

records.concern: THE STEERING KNUCKLES MAY DEFORM AFFECTING THE STEERING PERFORMANCE
records.defect: The steering knuckles may deform affecting the steering performance.
records.remedy: Replace the front knuckle steering at both sides of all potentially affected vehicles.

records.concern: THE RETAINING WASHER ON THE BOLT CONNECTING THE BRAKE PEDAL TO ITS BEARING BLOCK COULD COME LOOSE
records.defect: The retaining washer on the bolt connecting the brake pedal to its bearing block could come loose.
records.remedy: Secure the bearing bracket on the brake pedal by means of an additional retaining ring on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: THERE MAY BE A MALFUNCTION OF THE NEUTRAL POSITION SWITCH ON VEHICLES WITH A MANUAL TRANSMISSION
records.defect: The parking brake may be released due to an electrical fault in the neutral position switch.
records.remedy: Change parameter in Electronic Air-Processing Unit (EAPU) control unit.

records.concern: TOOL MARKS MAY OCCUR ON THE OIL PRESSURE LINE OF THE TURBOCHARGER WHICH MAY CAUSE AN OIL LEAK
records.defect: Tool marks may occur on the oil pressure line of the turbocharger which may cause an oil leak.
records.remedy: Replacement of the oil pressure line of the turbocharger.

records.concern: SEAT BELT D RING
records.defect: Front Seat belt top loop may not be secured correctly.
records.remedy: Check and secure the top loop as necessary.

records.concern: THE BRAKE CALLIPER BOLTS MAY NOT BE SECURED TO THE CORRECT SPECIFICATION
records.defect: The brake calliper bolts may not be secured to the correct specification.
records.remedy: Check and secure the brake calliper bolts to correct specification.

records.concern: THE HYDRAULIC HOSE OF THE FAN HYDRAULICS MAY DEVELOP A LEAK DUE TO A FAULTY CRIMPING
records.defect: The hydraulic hose of the fan hydraulics may develop a leak due to a faulty crimping.
records.remedy: Replace the hydraulic hose of the fan hydraulics.

records.concern: THE ELECTRICAL CIRCUIT WITHIN THE HECU MAY EXPERIENCE A SHORT CIRCUIT CONDITION
records.defect: The electrical circuit within the HECU may experience a short circuit condition that results in excessive current.
records.remedy: Install new fuses on affected vehicles and software update for cars equipped with Electronic Parking Brake (EPB).

records.concern: DURING BRAKEOPERATION THE BRAKE VALVE MAY ALLOW A SUDDEN SPIKE IN VOLTAGE WHICH MAY FEEDBACK THROUGH THE DRAWING VEHICLES CONTROL SYSTEMS.
records.defect: Wiring design for Wabco valve on affected trailers utilises the brake light circuit. During BRAKE operation this design may allow a sudden spike in voltage which may feedback through the drawing vehicles control systems.
records.remedy: Install a line protector to prevent excess voltage feeding back through the brake light circuit.

records.concern: SOME VEHICLES MAY HAVE BEEN BUILT WITH AN ADDITIONAL BOLT THAT MAY BE LOOSE WITHIN THE ELECTRIC POWER ASSISTED STEERING
records.defect: Some vehicles may have been built with an additional bolt that may be loose within the Electric Power Assisted Steering (EPAS).
records.remedy: Replace the steering gear on all vehicles affected.

records.concern: VEHICLES MAY HAVE AN ISSUE WITH THE CURRENT SOFTWARE THAT CONTOLS THE FUNTIONALITY OF THE ECALL SYSTEM
records.defect: Vehicles may have an issue with the current software that controls the functionality of the eCall system.
records.remedy: Carry out a software update.

records.concern: THE INSTALLATION POSITION OF THE CLAMPS FOR THE HYDRAULIC HOSES OF THE POWER STEERING MAY NOT BE CORRECT
records.defect: The installation position of the clamps for the hydraulic hoses of the power steering may not be correct.
records.remedy: Check the hydraulic hoses and clamps of the power steering and replace with new clamps if required.

records.concern: THE EMERGENCY LOCKING RETRACTOR IN THE FRONT RIGHT HAND SIDE SEAT BELT ASSEMBLY MAY NOT FUNCTION CORRECTLY
records.defect: The Emergency Locking Retractor (ELR) in the front right hand side seat belt assembly may not function correctly.
records.remedy: Inspect the seat belt assembly and replace if required.

records.concern: THE EMERGENCY LOCKING RETRACTOR IN THE FRONT RIGHT HAND SIDE SEAT BELT ASSEMBLY MAY NOT FUNCTION CORRECTLY
records.defect: The Emergency Locking Retractor (ELR) in the front right hand side seat belt assembly may not function correctly.
records.remedy: Inspect the seat belt assembly and replace if required.

records.concern: THE CURRENT SOFTWARE DOES NOT PROVIDE SUFFICIENT NOX MONITORING TO CONFIRM THE LEGAL REQUIREMENTS ARE MET
records.defect: The current software does not provide sufficient NOx monitoring to confirm that the legal requirements on NOx emissions are met.
records.remedy: Update EMS software.

records.concern: VEHICLE ROOF BARS WERE PREVIOUSLY RECORDED AS BEING NON-LOAD BEARING
records.defect: Vehicle roof bars were previously recorded as being non-load bearing.
records.remedy: Confirmation of vehicle roof being capable of carrying 35kg to be sent to dealers and customers

records.concern: THE SCREW CONNECTION OF THE FRONT SEAT BELT BUCKLE ASSEMBLY TO THE SEAT FRAME MAY NOT BE TIGHTENED PROPERLY
records.defect: The screw connection of the front seat belt buckle assembly to the seat frame may not be tightened properly.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles the screw connection of the lower belt of the front seats will be checked and if necessary reworked.

records.concern: THE ELECTRICAL CIRCUIT WITHIN THE HECU MAY EXPERIENCE A SHORT CIRCUIT CONDITION
records.defect: The electrical circuit within the HECU may experience a short circuit condition that results in excessive current.
records.remedy: Replace the multi fuse assembly with a lower amperage version & replace the junction box cover.

records.concern: THE BRAKE PEDAL BOX IS NOT ASSEMBLED ACCORDING TO SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: There is a risk that the Brake Pedal may fall down while driving resulting in the total loss of brake performance.
records.remedy: Check the assembly date range and replace the brake pedal box if affected.

records.concern: THE STEERING PROPSHAFT TO THE STEERING GEAR BOLT CONNECTION MAY NOT BE TIGHTENED CORRECTLY
records.defect: The bolt connection of the steering�propshaft�to the steering gear may�not be tightened correctly in�production�or the hex socket fit bolt may be missing.
records.remedy: If the hex socket fit bolt is present check for correct�torque and tighten if necessary. If the hex socket fit bolt is missing replace the lower part of the steering�propshaft�and both hex socket fit bolts.

records.concern: THE BREATHER PIPE MAY NOT BE PROPERLY WELDED TO THE FUEL TANK
records.defect: The breather pipe may not be properly welded to the fuel tank.
records.remedy: Fuel tank replacement.

records.concern: THE BEHAVIOUR OF THE EMERGENCY CALL SYSTEM MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: The behaviour of the emergency call system might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: Update the software of the communication module for the emergency call system.

records.concern: IMPROVED EMISSION CONTROL AND MONITORING IN THE EMS
records.defect: Error in emission control readings.
records.remedy: Update Engine Management System (EWS) software.

records.concern: THE BEHAVIOUR OF THE EMERGENCY CALL SYSTEM MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: The behaviour of the emergency call system might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: Update the software of the communication module for the emergency call system.
