records.defect: The behaviour of the emergency call system might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: Update the software of the communication module for the emergency call system.

records.concern: A FRICTION WELD SEAM HAS BEEN OVER TORQUED AT THE MANUFACTURER OF THE STEERING PROPSHAFT AND INCORRECT GUIDE RINGS INSTALLED
records.defect: A friction weld seam has been over torqued at the manufacturer of the steering propshaft and incorrect guide rings installed.
records.remedy: Replace the steering propshaft and guide rings.

records.concern: THE BEHAVIOUR OF THE EMERGENCY CALL SYSTEM MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: The behaviour of the emergency call system might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: Update the software of the communication module for the emergency call system.

records.concern: THE AFTER TREATMENT INJECTOR PIPE MAY CRACK AND LEAK
records.defect: The after treatment injector pipe may crack and leak.
records.remedy: Software update to provide a warning that system fault exists in the event of a cracked pipe.

records.concern: A FRONT AXLE BRAKE CALIPER CARRIER COULD HAVE BEEN MANUFACTURED OUTSIDE OF SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: Vehicles could be equipped with a front axle brake caliper carrier which could have been manufactured outside the specifications.
records.remedy: Conduct a check the brake caliper carriers on the front axle and as a precautionary measure renew any front axle brake caliper carrier should it be part of the affected batch.

records.concern: THE CONNECTION OF THE GAS LINES OF THE INERTISATION SYSTEM MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: The connection of the gas lines of the inertisation system might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: Check and if necessary rework the gas lines of the inertisation system.

records.concern: THE FRONT LOWER BALL JOINT MAY NOT HAVE BEEN PROPERLY INSTALLED INTO THE STEERING KNUCKLE
records.defect: The front lower ball joint may not have been properly installed into the steering knuckle.
records.remedy: Inspect and if required properly install the lower ball joint into the steering knuckle.

records.concern: A POSSIBILITY THAT LOCK NUTS WERE INSTALLED ON THE REAR AXLE TRAILING ARMS THAT WERE NOT MANUFACTURED ACCORDING TO THE REQUIRED PARAMETER FIELD
records.defect: A possibility that lock nuts were installed on the rear axle trailing arms that were not manufactured according to the required parameter field.
records.remedy: The lock nuts on the axle trailing arms of the rear axle must be replaced with nuts manufactured in accordance with the specifications.

records.concern: THE BEHAVIOUR OF THE EMERGENCY CALL SYSTEM MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: The behaviour of the emergency call system might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: Update the software of the communication module for the emergency call system.

records.concern: THE EMERGENCY CALL SYSTEM MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: The behaviour of the emergency call system might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: Update the software of the communication module for the emergency call system.

records.concern: THE BEHAVIOUR OF THE EMERGENCY CALL SYSTEM MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: The behaviour of the emergency call system might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: Update the software of the communication module for the emergency call system.

records.concern: THE BEHAVIOUR OF THE EMERGENCY CALL SYSTEM MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: The behaviour of the emergency call system might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: Update the software of the communication module for the emergency call system.

records.concern: THE EMERGENCY CALL SYSTEM MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: The behaviour of the emergency call system might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: Update the software of the communication module for the emergency call system.

records.concern: THE BEHAVIOUR OF THE EMERGENCY CALL SYSTEM MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: The behaviour of the emergency call system might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: Update the software of the communication module for the emergency call system.

records.concern: THE CORROSION PROTECTION OF THE HIGH VOLTAGE BATTERY HOUSING MAY NOT BE SUFFICIENT
records.defect: The corrosion protection of the high-voltage battery housing may not be sufficient.
records.remedy: Inspect clean and wax the housing of the high-voltage batteries. In cases of existing significant corrosion an affected battery module would be renewed.

records.concern: DUE TO ENGINE VIBRATION THE FILAMENT INSIDE THE HEADLAMP BULB MAY FAIL IN A SHORT PERIOD OF TIME
records.defect: Due to engine vibration the filament inside the headlamp bulb may fail in a short period of time
records.remedy: Carry out a headlamp bulb replacement

records.concern: THE SCREW CONNECTION OF THE POWER SUPPLY ON THE STARTER MIGHT NOT HAVE BEEN INSTALLED ACCORDING TO SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: The screw connection of the power supply on the starter motor might not have been installed according to specifications.
records.remedy: Check the screw connections of the starter motor and the position of the plus wire on the affected vehicles and correct them if necessary.

records.concern: POSSIBLE LACK OF COTTER PIN OR WRONG COTTER PIN ASSEMBLY ON STEERING AXLE
records.defect: Possible incorrect or missing cotter pin on steered axle joint.
records.remedy: Check and re-torque the nut and replacement of the cotter pin on the steering rod.

records.concern: THE LEFT CUSHION CONNECTING PLATE MAY BE INSTALLED WITH THE INSIDE AND OUTSIDE SURFACES REVERSED
records.defect: The left cushion connecting plate may be installed with the inside and outside surfaces reversed.
records.remedy: The motorcycle will be inspected and if the connecting plate is incorrectly installed the connecting plate will be replaced.

records.concern: SOME VALVE GUIDES COULD BE SUBJECT TO EARLY WEAR
records.defect: Some valve guides could be subject to early wear
records.remedy: Either replace the engine or cylinder heads.

records.concern: VEHICLES MAY BE EQUIPPED WITH PORTABLE FIRE EXTINGUISHES WHICH MAY NOT HAVE BEEN FITTED WITH A LOCK NUT ON THE STRIKE KNOB
records.defect: Vehicles may be equipped with portable fire extinguishers which may not be fitted with a lock nut on the strike knob.
records.remedy: Conduct a check of potentially affected fire extinguishers to establish if the lock nut is in place and if necessary have the fire extinguisher replaced.

records.concern: THE SIDE SPOILERS AT THE TAILGATE MAY NOT HAVE BEEN MOUNTED TO SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: The side spoilers at the tailgate might not have been mounted according to specifications.
records.remedy: Check the mounting of the side spoilers and replace them if necessary.

records.concern: THE FRONT FENDER WHEEL ARCH COVERS MIGHT NOT HAVE BEEN MOUNTED ACCORDING TO SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: The wheel arch covers on the front fenders might not have been mounted according to specifications.
records.remedy: Check the mounting of the front wheel arch covers on the affected vehicles and correct their installation if necessary.

records.concern: THE TWO GRAB HANDLES ON THE LEFT SIDE OF THE HEADLINER MAY NOT BE ATTACHED ACCORDING TO SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: The two grab handles on the left side of the headliner might not be attached according to specifications.
records.remedy: Inspect the mounting of the grab handles on the left side of the affected vehicles and correct it if necessary.

records.concern: THE ELECTRONIC POWER STEERING FUNCTION MAY NOT BE AVAILABLE
records.defect: The Electronic Power Steering function may not be available.
records.remedy: Replacement of steering rack.

records.concern: THE CONTROL RING OF THE BACKREST RECLINER IN THE SECOND SEAT ROW MAY BREAK
records.defect: The control ring of the recliner of the backrest in the second seat row may break due to insufficient material performance.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the seat frames of the second seat row will be replaced.

records.concern: INCORRECT HEADREST RODS MAY HAVE BEEN INSTALLED IN THE BACKREST OF THE SECOND ROW OF SEATS ON THE OUTER SIDE
records.defect: Incorrect headrest rods may have been installed in the backrest of the second row of seats on the outer side.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles the outer headrest of the second seat row will be checked and replaced if necessary.

records.concern: THE FRONT PASSENGER MAIN FRONTAL AIR BAG COULD SPLIT AT THE SEAM AND MAY NOT DEPLOY CORRECTLY WHEN ACTIVATED IN A COLLISION
records.defect: The front passenger main frontal airbag could split at the seam and may not deploy correctly when the airbag is activated in a collision.
records.remedy: Replace the airbag with an improved version

records.concern: THE FUEL SUPPLY PIPE MAY CONTACT THE CYLINDER HEAD COVER
records.defect: Contact of the fuel supply pipe with the cylinder head cover causing pipe wear.
records.remedy: Carry out a visual inspection of the fuel supply pipe and fit a pipe protector. If necessary replace the fuel supply pipe.

records.concern: FRONT TYRES OUTER TREAD MAY HAVE BEEN DAMAGED
records.defect: Front tyres outer tread may have been damaged.
records.remedy: Check and replace tyre if required

records.concern: IT MAY NOT BE POSSIBLE TO ENGAGE THE HANDBRAKE LEVER
records.defect: It may not be possible to engage the handbrake lever.
records.remedy: Check the handbrake lever locking mechanism and if necessary replace the handbrake lever.

records.concern: THE ENGINE TONE WHEEL WHICH PROVIDES A SIGNAL TO THE CRANKSHAFT POSITION SENSOR MAY FAIL
records.defect: The engine tone wheel which provides a signal to the crankshaft position sensor may fail.
records.remedy: Replace the engine tone wheel.

records.concern: POTENTIAL ELECTRICAL SHORT IN THE LITHIUM-ION BATTERY
records.defect: Potential electrical short in the lithium-ion battery.
records.remedy: Initial step to limit the charge state followed by eventual complete replacement of the battery assembly.

records.concern: OCCASIONAL ABRASION MAY OCCUR ON BOTH FUEL LINES AT THE FRONT OF THE TANK DURING OPERATION
records.defect: Occasional abrasion may occur on both fuel lines at the front of the fuel tank during operation.
records.remedy: Both fuel lines must be replaced as a precautionary measure.

records.concern: THE WELDING OF THE INDIVIDUAL COMPONENTS OF THE TOWBAR MIGHT NOT MEET THE CORRECT SPECIFICATION
records.defect: The welding of the individual components of the towbar might not meet the correct specification.
records.remedy: Check the identity label and replace the tow bar if affected.
models: SIARR/Westfalia Automotive Towbar system Article No. 315244600001 and Kit Nos. 315214900113 / 315244900113 / 315591910013

records.concern: FAULT IN THE AIR BAG CONTROL MODULE SOFTWARE
records.defect: Due to a fault in the airbag control module software the airbag system may fail to be active without this being indicated on the instrument panel.
records.remedy: Carry out an update to the airbag control module and instrument panel software.

records.concern: THE REAR RAIL ASSEMBLY MAY NOT HAVE THE SPECIFIED STRUCTURAL STRENGTH
records.defect: The rear rail assembly (rear longitudinal armatures) installed as part of an aftermarket repair may not have the specified structural strength.
records.remedy: Replacement parts will be installed in line with aftermarket welding standards.

records.concern: THE FIXINGS CONNECTING THE EXHAUST DOWNPIPE TO THE CATALYTIC CONVERTER MAY NOT HAVE BEEN TIGHTENED TO THE SPECIFIED TORQUE VALUE
records.defect: The fixings connecting the exhaust downpipe to the catalytic converter may not have been tightened to the specified torque value.
records.remedy: Inspect the exhaust downpipe to catalytic converter joint. If the fixings are present torque them up to the required torque specification. If any fixings are missing they will be replaced and torqued to the required specification.

records.concern: DUE TO A NONCONFORMITY OF THE FUEL RETURN PIPE DIESEL FUEL LEAKS MAY OCCUR
records.defect: Due to a nonconformity of the fuel return pipe diesel fuel leaks may occur.
records.remedy: Check the conformity of the fuel return pipe and if necessary replace.

records.concern: THE PRELOAD FORCE OF THE PISTON RETURN SPRING IN THE FRONT MASTER CYLINDER MAY LIE OUTSIDE THE SPECIFIED TOLERANCE
records.defect: The preload force of the piston return-spring in the front master cylinder may in individual cases lie outside the specified tolerance.
records.remedy: Replace the piston return-spring with a longer and harder spring.

records.concern: INDIVIDUAL SCREW CONNECTIONS OF THE SHOCK ABSORBERS ON THE FRONT AND REAR AXLE MAY HAVE BEEN IMPERMISSIBLY TIGHTENED SEVERAL TIMES
records.defect: Individual screw connections of the shock absorbers on the front axle and rear axle may have been impermissibly tightened several times.
records.remedy: The affected fastening screws must be replaced and tightened according to the original specifications. On vehicles where the front axle is affected the mounting saddles must also be replaced.

records.concern: WHEEL HUB CAPS MAY NOT HAVE BEEN MANUFACTURED ACCORDING TO SPECIFICATION
records.defect: Wheel hub caps may not have been manufactured according to specification.
records.remedy: Replace the wheel hub caps on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: THE VARIANT OF SPARK PLUGS INSTALLED MAY NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: The variant of spark plugs installed may not meet specifications.
records.remedy: Replace the spark plugs on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: THE CURRENT SOFTWARE DOES NOT PROVIDE SUFFICIENT NOX MONITORING TO CONFIRM THE LEGAL REQUIREMENTS ARE MET
records.defect: The current software does not provide sufficient NOx monitoring to confirm that the legal requirements on NOx emissions are met.
records.remedy: Update EMS software

records.concern: THE ENGINE PRE-HEATER RELAY MAY OVERHEAT AND FAIL
records.defect: The engine pre-heater relay may overheat and fail due to short circuit between the 24V and ground on the printed circuit board (PCB).
records.remedy: Modify pre-heater relay harness by connection of extension cable with fuse. Replace pre-heater relay as required.

records.concern: THE WHEEL BOLTS MAY HAVE AN INCOMPLETE THREAD
records.defect: On affected vehicles the wheel bolts may have an incomplete thread.
records.remedy: Check and if necessary replace the wheel bolts.

records.concern: THE BRAKE PEDAL MAY POTENTIALLY STICK AS A RESULT OF HIGH VEHICLE INTERIOR TEMPERATURES
records.defect: The brake pedal may potentially stick as a result of high vehicle interior temperatures causing the brake lights to activate without brake pedal pressure.
records.remedy: To reprogram the electronic brake control module (EBCM) to enable a warning message to display.

records.concern: VEHICLE SEATBELTS MAY HAVE A DEFECTIVE LOW G LOCKING MECHANISM
records.defect: Vehicle seatbelts may have a defective low G locking mechanism.
records.remedy: Inspect the seat belt label for date range. If within suspect range exchange seat belt retractor.

records.concern: CONTACT OF THE FUEL SUPPLY HOSE WITH THE CLYNDER HEAD COVER CAUSING HOSE WEAR
records.defect: Contact of the fuel supply hose with the cylinder head cover causing hose wear.
records.remedy: Carry out a visual inspection of the fuel supply hose and fit a protective sleeve. If necessary replace the fuel supply hose.

records.concern: THE KNEE ROLL AIR BAG WIRING WAS CROSSED AT THE AIR BAG CONTROL MODULE CONNECTOR
records.defect: The knee roll airbag wiring may be incorrect at the Airbag Control Module connector.
records.remedy: Correct the wiring at the Airbag Control Module Connector.

records.concern: NEW SOFTWARE REQUIRED TO IMPROVE THE EMISSION CONTROL AND MONITORING
records.defect: The current software does not provide sufficient emissions control and monitoring to confirm that the legal requirements on emissions are met.
records.remedy: Update EMS software

records.concern: THE LOWER NUT THAT SECURES THE CAB TILT CYLINDER TO A MOUNTING BRACKET MAY NOT BE CORRECTLY TIGHTENED
records.defect: The lower nut that secures the cab tilt cylinder to a mounting bracket may not be correctly tightened.
records.remedy: Check and ensure the tightening torque of the affected nut.

records.concern: THE RIGHT HAND FRONT SUPPLEMENTARY RESTRAINT SEATBELT PRE TENSIONER WILL NOT FUNCTION UNLESS THE LEFT HAND FRONT SEAT IS OCCUPIED
records.defect: The right hand front (RHF) (driver�s side) supplementary restraint seatbelt pre-tensioner will not function unless the left hand front seat (LHF) (passenger�s side) is occupied.
records.remedy: Dealers will re-orient the connections to align with the respective seating positions.

records.concern: THE ADDITIONAL LOCK FOR THE CONNECTOR OF THE SEAT BELT TENSIONER WIRING HARNESS IN THE CO DRIVER'S SEAT BENCH MAY NOT BE LOCKED
records.defect: The additional lock for the connector of the seat belt tensioner wiring harness in the co-driver�s seat bench may not be locked.
records.remedy: Check the condition of the additional lock and if necessary lock correctly.

records.concern: THE STATUTORY PLATE LABEL MAY BE MISSING THE WHOLE VEHICLE TYPE APPROVAL (WVTA) NUMBER
records.defect: The statutory plate label maybe missing the Whole Vehicle Type Approval (WVTA) number.
records.remedy: Replace the statutory plate Label with a new statutory plate label containing the WVTA number.

records.concern: VEHICLES HAVE BEEN DELIVERED WITH AN OPERATING MANUAL THAT DOESN'T CONTAIN A WARNING NOTICE FOR THE EXCLUSIVE USE OF AN APPROVED CHARGING CABLE FOR CHARGING THE HIGH VOLTAGE (HV) BATTERY
records.defect: Vehicles have been delivered with an operating manual that doesn�t contain a warning notice for the exclusive use of an approved charging cable for charging the high-voltage (HV) battery.
records.remedy: Attach a supplementary sheet with a corresponding warning notice in the operation manual for the affected vehicles.

records.concern: THE RESCUE CUTTING LINE LOCATED IN THE SEAT BOX OF THE DRIVER SEAT MAY NOT BE ACCESSIBLE
records.defect: The rescue cutting line located in the seat box of the driver seat may not be accessible.
records.remedy: Reposition the rescue loop on affected vehicles.

records.concern: AN INCORRECT FUSE TYPE FOR THE ELECTRIC SYSTEM OF THE AIR SUSPENSION COULD HAVE BEEN MOUNTED BY ERROR
records.defect: The fuse for the electric system for the air suspension may be incorrectly specified.
records.remedy: Check the currently installed fuse and control unit on the potentially affected vehicles and replace if necessary. Also replace the fuse assignment booklet if necessary.

records.concern: INTERNAL CONTACT FAILURE INSIDE THE WIPER SYSTEM MOTORS CAN CAUSE ISSUES WITH THE SYNCHRONISATION
records.defect: Synchronized wipers may fail and become stuck.
records.remedy: Check Wiper motors and replace if within the affected range.

records.concern: THE POWERED TAILGATE MAY PARTIALLY LOWER UNEXPECTEDLY FROM THE FULLY OPENED POSITION IN CERTAIN SITUATIONS
records.defect: The powered tailgate may partially lower unexpectedly from the fully opened position in certain situations.
records.remedy: Inspect the production information and update the software of the power tailgate drive unit. Where necessary replace the power tailgate drive unit.

records.concern: SUDDEN AIR LOSS OR BELT EGDE SEPARATION
records.defect: Sudden air loss or belt edge separation
records.remedy: Replacement of tyres
models: LT235/85R16 120/116S LRE FR Grabber AT3 OWL 10PR DOT A30RHMRA 0819 Mould No. 416165
LT265/70R17 121/118Q LRE FR Grabber X3 10PR DOT A3AHHMMM 1518 Mould No. 414719
LT235/85R16 120/116S LRE FR Grabber AT3 OWL 10PR DOT A30RHMRA 1318 Mould No. 416165

records.concern: THE GEAR RECOGNITION FUNCTION IN THE TRANSMISSION COULD NOT FUNCTION AS INTENDED
records.defect: The reverse gear light may occasionally be non-functional until the next ignition change or the next engine start.
records.remedy: Update the software responsible for gear recognition on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: THE POSITIVE BATTERY CABLE AND THE CONTROL UNIT CABLE MAY HAVE BEEN MIXED UP
records.defect: The positive battery cable and the cable to the control unit for battery monitoring on the main fuse box in the boot may have been mixed up.
records.remedy: Inspect the two connected cables on the main fuse box and if necessary swap them into the correct positions.

records.concern: INCORRECT TIGHTENING OF THE REAR WHEEL HUB BOLTS
records.defect: Noises may come from the rear wheel brake and wheel pinion socket due to incorrect tightening of the rear wheel hub bolts.
records.remedy: Replace the affected rear wheel hub bolts.

records.concern: CRACKS MAY OCCUR WITHIN THE MICROSTRUCTURE OF THE HANDLEBAR CLAMPS
records.defect: Cracks can cause the handlebar clamp to break off together with the mounted clip-on handlebars.
records.remedy: The handlebar mounts and clip-on handlebars must be replaced on all vehicles.

records.concern: DRIVER'S AIR BAG WARNING LIGHT DOESN'T SWITCH ON
records.defect: Driver's airbag warning light doesn't switch on in case of problems relating to the airbag system and related wiring.
records.remedy: Update vehicle software.

records.concern: SERVICE DOORS NOT OPENING WITH EMERGENCY CONTROLS
records.defect: Service doors not opening with emergency controls.
records.remedy: Carry out a software update

records.concern: THE SOFTWARE OF CERTAIN COMMUNICATION MODULES MAY NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: The software of certain communication modules may not meet specifications.
records.remedy: Carry out an update to the software of the communication module on affected vehicles.

records.concern: THE COMMUNICATION MODULE MAY BE DEACTIVATED
records.defect: The communication module may be deactivated
records.remedy: Carry out a check of the configuration of the communication module on affected vehicles and if necessary activate the communication module.

records.concern: THE DRIVER'S AIR BAG MAY TEAR DURING INFLATION
records.defect: The drivers� bag may tear during inflation.
records.remedy: Replace the drivers� airbag of all potentially affected vehicles.

records.concern: THE MATING SURFACES OF THE PROPSHAFT FLANGES MAY BE CONTAMINATED WITH PAINT
records.defect: The mating surfaces of the propshaft flanges may be contaminated with paint.
records.remedy: Remove the propshaft inspect and clean the flanges. Refit with new fixings.

records.concern: THE RETRACTOR OF THE THREE POINT AUTOMATIC SEAT BELT ON THE FRONT RIGHT SEAT MAY BE FAULTY.
records.defect: The retractor of the three-point automatic seat belt on the front right seat may be faulty.
records.remedy: The three-point automatic seat belt of the front right seat is to be replaced.

records.concern: THE REAR DRIVE SHAFTS MAY NOT FULFIL THE DURABILITY REQUIREMENTS
records.defect: The rear drive shafts may not fulfil the durability requirements.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles one or both output shafts will be replaced.

records.concern: THE FRONT PASSENGER AIRBAG MIGHT NOT INFLATE FULLY IN THE EVENT OF AN ACCIDENT
records.defect: In the event of an accident requiring the vehicle�s front passenger airbag to be activated the airbag might not inflate fully.
records.remedy: The dash panel must be checked on the affected vehicles and repaired or replaced if required

records.concern: A SETTING OF THE SOFTWARE PARAMETER FOR THE REMOTE DRIVE EXTERNAL PARKING BRAKE REQUEST IS SET TO AN ERRONEOUS VALUE
records.defect: A setting of the software parameter for the remote drive external parking brake request is set to an erroneous value.
records.remedy: Software update.

records.concern: VEHICLES MAY HAVE AN ENGINE COOLING RADIATOR AIR INTAKE MODULE SEALING BAFFLE MISSING
records.defect: Vehicles may have an engine cooling radiator air intake module sealing baffle missing.
records.remedy: Install the missing radiator air intake sealing baffle.

records.concern: A FUEL PUMP RELAY WHICH COULD OPERATE INTERMITTENTLY OR FAIL WITHOUT WARNING
records.defect: A fuel pump relay which could operate intermittently or fail without warning.
records.remedy: Replace the affected fuel pump and modify original wiring where necessary

records.concern: CONNECTING RODS INSTALLED MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION
records.defect: Connecting rods that were not manufactured according to specifications may have been installed in the engines of the affected vehicles.
records.remedy: The engine must be replaced.

records.concern: THE THREADED CONNECTIONS OF THE UPPER CONTROL ARMS AT THE REAR AXLE WERE NOT TIGHTENED WITH THE SPECIFIC TIGTENING TORQUE
records.defect: Threaded connections of the upper control arms at the rear axle may not be tightened with the specified tightening torque.
records.remedy: The chassis bolts will be replaced and tightened with the specified tightening torque.

records.concern: INDIVIDUAL THREADED CONNECTIONS AT THE VEHICLE'S SUSPENSION MIGHT NOT BE TIGHTENED TO THE SPECIFICATION DUE TO INSUFFICIENTLY CUT THREAD OF LOCKNUTS
records.defect: Individual threaded connections at the vehicle's suspension might not be tightened to the specification due to insufficiently cut thread of locknuts.
records.remedy: The affected screw joints must be replaced with a new nut and bolt and tightened to the original specification.

records.concern: THE DASHBOARD MIGHT NOT MEET THE SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: The dashboard might not meet specifications
records.remedy: Replace the dashboard on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: THE ENGINE CONTROL UNIT CANNOT DETECT AN ERROR OF ATMOSPHERIC PRESSURE SENSOR
records.defect: The engine control unit cannot detect an error of atmospheric pressure sensor.
records.remedy: Affected units must have the engine control unit reprogrammed

records.concern: THE GROUND CONNECTION OF THE PASSENGER AIR BAG MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: The ground connection of the passenger airbag might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: Check the ground connection of the passenger airbag and rework it if necessary.

records.concern: LOSS OF TORQUE OF ENGINE HOOD HINGE SCREWS MAY RESULT IN UNLATCHED HOOD
records.defect: Loss of torque of engine hood hinge screws may result in an unlatched hood.
records.remedy: Replace the hood hinge screws with ones with thread lock.

records.concern: AFFECTED TYRES MAY DEVELOP BULGES OR SEPARATIONS IN THE SIDEWALL AREA OF THE TYRE
records.defect: Affected tyres may develop bulges or separations in the sidewall area of the tyre.
records.remedy: Affected tyres will be replaced.

records.concern: DUE TO INCORRECT TYPE APPROVAL DATA PROCESSING THE MANUFACTURER'S PLATE (VIN PLATE) AND REGISTRATION DOCUMENT MUST BE REPLACED
records.defect: Due to incorrect type-approval data processing the manufacturer's plate (VIN plate) and registration document must be replaced.
records.remedy: Replace the VIN plate and update the registration document as required.

records.concern: THE EVAPORATIVE EMISSIONS CANISTER MAY BE UNABLE TO ABSORB THE NECESSARY AMOUNT OF FUEL VAPOUR DURING VEHICLE REFUELLING
records.defect: The Evaporative Emissions Canister may be unable to absorb the necessary amount of fuel vapour during vehicle refuelling.
records.remedy: Replace the Evaporative Emissions Canister.

records.concern: A HIGH HEAT COULD DEVELOP IN THE MUFFLER CAUSING THE UPPER RIGHT HAND VENT GRILL TO MELT
records.defect: In some specific riding conditions a high heat could develop in the muffler causing the upper right hand vent grill to melt.
records.remedy: Reprogram the ECM and install a heat reflective foil kit.

records.concern: THE REAR BRAKE CALLIPER MAY LEAK BRAKE FLUID INTO THE HOUSING OF THE ELECTRIC PARKING BRAKE
records.defect: The rear brake calliper may leak brake fluid into the housing of the electric parking brake.
records.remedy: Replace the rear brake callipers and update the ESP software.

records.concern: THE PASSENGER SEAT OCCUPANCY DETECTION SYSTEM DOES NOT CURRENTLY MEET THE REQUIRED STANDARD
records.defect: The passenger seat occupancy detection system does not currently meet the required standard.
records.remedy: The passenger seat occupancy detection sensor mats must be replaced.

records.concern: THE FRONT SEAT BELT RETRACTOR MAY HAVE BEEN BUILT WITH AN IMPROPERLY FORMED WAVE DISC
records.defect: The front seat belt retractor may have been built with an improperly formed wave disc.
records.remedy: Replace the front seat belt retractor.

records.concern: A SHORT CIRCUIT IN THE ABS CAN OCCUR WITHOUT WARNING WHEN THE ENGINE IS SWITCHED OFF
records.defect: A short circuit in the ABS can occur without warning when the engine is switched off.
records.remedy: Installing of a switch off relays to interrupt the power supply to the ABS ECU in vehicle key off condition.

records.concern: VEHICLES MAY BE FITTED WITH A NON CONFORM ACCESSORY TRAILER HITCH
records.defect: Vehicles may be fitted with a non-conform accessory trailer hitch.
records.remedy: Check the batch number and if necessary replace the trailer hitch.

records.concern: THE SEATBELT REMINDER IS NOT DISPLAYED
records.defect: The seatbelt reminder is not displayed.
records.remedy: Carry out a software update.

records.concern: THE ACCELERATOR PEDAL MAY NOT HAVE BEEN MOUNTED ON THE VEHICLE IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE SPECIFICATION
records.defect: The accelerator pedal may not have been mounted on the vehicle in accordance with the specification.
records.remedy: Check the correct installation of the accelerator pedal on the affected vehicles and if necessary renew it.

records.concern: AFFECTED VEHICLES MAY BE FITTED WITH BRAKE DISCS WHICH ARE NOT TO SPECIFICATION
records.defect: Affected vehicles may be fitted with brake discs which were not produced according to the specifications
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the brake discs will be checked and if necessary replaced

records.concern: THE BLOWER REGULATOR WIRING COULD BE DAMAGED AND COULD LEAD TO PARTIAL CONTACT OF INDIVIDUAL WIRE STRANDS
records.defect: The blower-regulator wiring could be damaged and could lead to partial contact of individual wire strands.
records.remedy: The blower regulator wiring harness will be inspected and a new part will be installed additional components will be replaced if necessary.

records.concern: A SOFTWARE UPDATE OF THE ELECTRONIC STABILITY PROGRAMME (ESP) CONTROL UNIT IS REQUIRED
records.defect: A software update of the Electronic Stability Programme (ESP) control unit is required.
records.remedy: Update the ESP control unit software in the affected vehicles.

records.concern: AN ELECTRICAL EARTH LINE HAS BEEN INSTALLED WITH TOO MUCH TENSION AND MAY FAIL
records.defect: An electrical earth line has been installed with too much tension and may fail.
records.remedy: Check and repair or adjust cable fitment as required.

records.concern: THE SCREW CONNECTION OF THE POWER SUPPLY ON THE STARTER MAY NOT HAVE BEEN INSTALLED ACCORDING TO SPECIFICATION
records.defect: The screw connection of the power supply on the starter might not have been installed according to specification.
records.remedy: Check the screw connections of the starter on the affected vehicles and correct them if necessary.

records.concern: SOME SEATBELT TONGUES MAY NOT HAVE BEEN SUFFICIENTLY HEAT TREATED
records.defect: Some seatbelt tongues may not have been sufficiently heat treated.
records.remedy: Inspect and test the affected components and replace if defective.

records.concern: THE ABS/ESC CONTROL UNIT MAY SHORT CIRCUIT
records.defect: The ABS/ESC control unit may short circuit.
records.remedy: ABS/ESC control unit wiring to be reworked together with amended amp fuses. Depending on specification the control unit software may also be updated.

records.concern: IMPROVED EMISSION CONTROL AND MONITORING
records.defect: Improved emission control and monitoring.
records.remedy: Update EMS and SW software.

records.concern: THE WELDING OF THE INDIVIDUAL COMPONENTS OF THE TOW BAR MIGHT NOT MEET THE CORRECT SPECIFICATION
records.defect: The welding of the individual components of the towbar might not meet the correct specification.
records.remedy: Check the identity label and replace the tow bar if affected

records.concern: THE WELDING OF THE INDIVIDUAL COMPONENTS OF THE TOWBAR MIGHT NOT MEET THE CORRECT SPECIFICATION
records.defect: The welding of the individual components of the towbar might not meet the correct specification.
records.remedy: Check the identity label and replace the tow bar if affected.

records.concern: A POSSIBILTY OF THE REAR BRAKE DISCS HAVING MICRO CRACKS
records.defect: There is a possibility of the rear brake discs having micro-cracks.
records.remedy: Replace the rear brake discs.

records.concern: NON CONFORMING STEERING KNUCKLES MAY HAVE BEEN FITTED
records.defect: Non-conforming steering knuckles may have been fitted.
records.remedy: Check the installed steering knuckles and replace if necessary.

records.concern: POSSIBLE TRANSMISSION STUD DAMAGE TO WIRING LOOM FOLLOWING REPAIR
records.defect: Possible transmission stud damage to wiring loom following repair.
records.remedy: Check that the correct transmission stud has been replaced. If not the correct stud must be replaced and the wiring loom should be inspected for damage and repaired as necessary.

records.concern: FRONT LOWER CONTROL ARM BOLTS COULD SEPARATE UNDER OPERATION
records.defect: The front lower control arm bolts could separate under operation.
records.remedy: Replace the front lower control arm bolts and washers with a higher-grade version.

records.concern: EXCESSIVE GREASE WAS APPLIED TO THE O RING OF THE RESERVOIR PISTON IN THE ABS MODULATOR
records.defect: Excessive grease was applied to the O-ring of the reservoir piston in the ABS modulator.
records.remedy: Check and if within the defective lot number range the ABS modulator will be replaced.

records.concern: THE FRONT AND SIDE SPOILER COVERS COULD COME ADRIFT DURING VEHICLE OPERATION
records.defect: The front and side spoiler side covers could come adrift during vehicle operation.
records.remedy: Inspect and if required carry out adjustments to the front spoiler side covers and add a new design to the side spoiler covers.

records.concern: A FAILING ESS HEATER RELAY CAN CAUSE AN UNEXPECTED HEAT DEVELOPMENT AND CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGE TO ELECTRIC WIRING
records.defect: A failing ESS heater relay can cause an unexpected heat development and consequential damage to electrical wiring.
records.remedy: Carry out a replacement of the ESS Heater relay with a modified version.

records.concern: THE STEERING LINK ROD RETAINER NUT MAY HAVE BEEN TIGHTENED INCORRECTLY
records.defect: The steering link rod retainer nut may have been tightened incorrectly
records.remedy: The torque of the link rod retainer nut will be assessed and if necessary the link rod and upper steering arm will be replaced.

records.concern: THE BRAKE PEDAL MAY POTENTIALLY STICK AS A RESULT OF HIGH VEHICLE INTERIOR TEMPERATURES
records.defect: The brake pedal may potentially stick as a result of high vehicle interior temperatures causing the brake lights to activate without brake pedal pressure.
records.remedy: To reprogram the electronic brake control module (EBCM) to enable a warning message to display.

records.concern: VEHICLE EMISSION OUTPUTS MAY NOT BE CORRECT
records.defect: Vehicle emission outputs may not be correct.
records.remedy: Software upgrade to be carried out

records.concern: HIGH VOLTAGE CONTACTORS IN THE BATTERY ENERGY CONTROL MODULE MAY OPEN DURING DRIVING
records.defect: High voltage contactors may open during driving resulting in a risk that the high voltage system may be unintentionally disconnected causing a loss of propulsion.
records.remedy: Software upgrade to be carried out.

records.concern: HIGH VOLTAGE CONTACTORS IN THE BATTERY ENERGY CONTROL MODULE MAY OPEN DURING DRIVING
records.defect: High voltage contactors may open during driving resulting in a risk that the high voltage system may be unintentionally disconnected causing a loss of propulsion.
records.remedy: Software upgrade to be carried out.

records.concern: THE SIDE STAND FASTENING BRACKET MAY DEFORM FROM REPEATED STRESS AND IN EXCEPTIONAL SITUATIONS MAY FAIL
records.defect: The side stand fastening bracket may deform from repeated stress and in exceptional situations may fail.
records.remedy: The replacement of the side stand fastening bracket spring hooking plate and side stand will be carried out with re-designed parts.

records.concern: THE INTEGRATED BRAKE SYSTEM HYDRAULIC UNIT MAY HAVE BEEN PRODUCED INCORRECTLY
records.defect: The Integrated Brake system hydraulic unit may have been produced incorrectly
records.remedy: Replace the Integrated Brake system hydraulic unit.

records.concern: IN THE EVENT OF eCALL TRIGGER THE VIN NUMBER INFORMATION MAY NOT BE SENT
records.defect: The vehicle VIN information may not be registered correctly within the eCall unit.
records.remedy: Register the VIN information within the vehicle by resetting the E-call unit and updating.

records.concern: THE REAR SUSPENSION TOE LINK COULD CORRODE OVER TIME LEADING TO REDUCED MATERIAL AND LOAD CAPACITY AND FINALLY BREAKAGE OF THE BOLT
records.defect: The Rear Suspension Toe Link bolt is exposed to corrosion growth which over time leads to reduced material and load capacity and finally to a breakage of the bolt.
records.remedy: Replace the bolt utilising an alternative bolt supplier and update all affected vehicles.

records.concern: SOME 22 CONTINENTAL TYRES WERE PRODUCED OUT OF SPECIFICATION
records.defect: Some 22� Continental tyres were produced out of specification.
records.remedy: The tyres will be inspected for a specific DOT and mould number and will be replaced if found to be within the faulty range.

records.concern: FAULTY CRASH SENSORS FOR AIR BAG AND RESTRAINT SYSTEMS MAY HAVE BEEN FITTED IN THE FRONT DOORS
records.defect: Faulty crash sensors for airbag and restraint systems may have been fitted in the front doors.
records.remedy: The crash sensors in the front doors are to be checked and if necessary replaced.

records.concern: A POSSIBLE LOSS OF MOTIVE POWER OR PARK FUNCTION DUE TO WEAR IN THE POWER TRANSFER UNIT
records.defect: A possible loss of motive power or PARK function due to wear in the Power Transfer Unit.
records.remedy: Reprogram the Drive Train Control Module and Electric Park Brake.

records.concern: THE DEGRADATION OF THE CATALYTIC CONVERTER MAY RESULT IN VEHICLES EXCEEDING THE EMISSIONS STANDARDS
records.defect: The degradation of the catalytic converter may result in vehicles exceeding the emissions standards.
records.remedy: Update the Powertrain Control Module with the latest available software and replace the catalytic converters and the oxygen sensors.

records.concern: THE ELECTRICAL WIRING HARNESS PRE-INSTALLATION FOR THE HERMES CONTROL UNIT COULD BECOME STUCK BETWEEN THE BRAKE LIGHT SWITCH AND THE BRAKE PEDAL
records.defect: The electrical wiring harness pre-installation for the HERMES control unit (communication module) could become stuck between the brake light switch and the brake pedal
records.remedy: Correct the routing of the concerned wiring harness through the installation of an additional cable tie.

records.concern: THE RIGHT HANDLE FOR ATTACHING THE CHILD SEAT TO THE ISOFIX BRACKET MAY BE MISSING ON THE REAR RIGHT SEAT
records.defect: The ISOFIX bracket might be missing on the right rear seat.
records.remedy: Check the ISOFIX bracket on the affected vehicles and replace it if necessary.

records.concern: VEHICLES COULD HAVE BEEN ASSEMBLED WITH INCORRECT FRONT SUSPENSION SPRING RETAINERS
records.defect: Vehicles could have been assembled with incorrect front suspension spring retainers.
records.remedy: Inspect and replace the front suspension spring retainers if necessary.

records.concern: RISK OF A FUEL LEAK IN THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT
records.defect: Risk of a fuel leak in the engine compartment.
records.remedy: Inspect and install protection to the fuel pipe or replace the fuel pipe if damaged

records.concern: A WELDING TO THE TUBULAR FRAME OF THE DRIVER SEATMAY HAVE BEEN INCORRECTLY PERFORMED
records.defect: A welding to the tubular frame of the driver seat may have been incorrectly performed.
records.remedy: The welding on the rear tubular frame of the driver seat will be checked and if necessary replaced.

records.concern: THE RETAINER FOR THE BATTERY POWER CABLE AT THE ELECTRICAL DISTRIBUTION CENTRAL MIGHT HAVE BEEN INCORRECTLY ASSEMBLED
records.defect: The retainer for the battery power cable at the electrical distribution central might have been incorrectly assembled.
records.remedy: Inspect the retainer and cable. Where necessary repair the cable and reassemble the retainer.

records.concern: FRONT SPOILER SIDE COVER CAN COME ADRIFT DURING OPERATION OF VEHICLE
records.defect: The front spoiler side cover could come adrift during operation of the vehicle
records.remedy: Check the side covers and adjust if required

records.concern: THE SPORT MODE SYSTEM MAY NOT BE SET CORRECTLY AND THEREFORE MAY NOT COMPLY WITH TYPE APPROVAL REQUIREMENTS
records.defect: The �Sport� mode system may not be set correctly and therefore may not comply with type approval requirements.
records.remedy: The proxi file must be updated to solve the non conformity.

records.concern: THE START & STOP SYSTEM MAY NOT BE SET CORRECTLY AND THEREFORE MAY NOT COMPLY WITH TYPE APPROVAL REQUIREMENTS
records.defect: The Start & Stop system may not be set correctly and therefore may not comply with type approval requirements.
records.remedy: The proxi file must be updated to solve the non conformity.

records.concern: LIQUID COULD ENTER THE POWER WINDOW MASTER SWITCH AND A SHORT CIRCUIT COULD OCCUR
records.defect: Power window switch can accumulate water causing overheat and possible fire.
records.remedy: Replace power window master switch with one designed to prevent water accumulation

records.concern: THE BRAKE CYLINDER OF THE REAR AXLE SLOTTED NUTS HAVE INSUFFICIENT TIGHTENING TORQUE
records.defect: Brake calliper was mounted using slotted nuts whose tightening torque is insufficient
records.remedy: Increase the tightening torque of the slotted nuts on the brake callipers of affected vehicles.

records.concern: THE POTENTIAL FOR DAMAGE TO THE WIRING HARNESS
records.defect: The potential for damage to the wiring harness.
records.remedy: Carry out a rework to the tail end lower part and inspect the wiring harness for damage and repair where necessary.

records.concern: THE SEAT MATERIAL DOES NOT MEET THE BURN RATE REQUIREMENTS OF (UN-ECE) 118
records.defect: The front seat material does not meet the regulation required burn rate
records.remedy: Replace the seat covering on the front seats.

records.concern: THE EXHAUST GAS RECIRCULATION COOLER COULD LEAK OVER TIME
records.defect: Leaking glycol coolant could create in combination with soot and oil sediments in the EGR module ignitable deposits.
records.remedy: The EGR cooler will be internally inspected with an endoscope and replaced if evidence of leaking is found.

records.concern: ZINC OXIDE CONTAMINATION OF THE FUEL TANK FOLLOWING PRODUCTION
records.defect: Zinc oxide contamination of the fuel tank following production.
records.remedy: Cleaning the inside of the fuel tank and replace the fuel pump suction filter high pressure filter and fuel pump chamber.

records.concern: AXLE HUB BOLTS LOOSE
records.defect: Axle hub bolts may become insecure.
records.remedy: Recheck torque value of axle hub bolts to 500nm.

records.concern: DRIVELINE SOFTWARE HOLDS THE LAST KNOWN TROTTLE POSITION IN THE EVENT OF A LOSS OF SIGNAL
records.defect: Driveline software holds the last known throttle position in the event of a loss of signal.
records.remedy: Revision to the electric vehicle control unit software and parameter settings.

records.concern: A DEFECTIVE DRIVE TRAIN MAY HAVE BEEN INSTALLED
records.defect: A defective drive chain may have been installed.
records.remedy: Replacement of the drive chain.

records.concern: A DEFECTIVE DRIVE TRAIN MAY HAVE BEEN INSTALLED
records.defect: A defective drive chain may have been installed.
records.remedy: Replacement of the drive chain.

records.concern: A DEFECTIVE DRIVE TRAIN MAY HAVE BEEN INSTALLED
records.defect: A defective drive chain may have been installed.
records.remedy: Replacement of the drive chain.

records.concern: AN INCORRECT FRONT BUMPER REINFORCEMENT PANEL HAS BEEN FITTED
records.defect: An incorrect front bumper reinforcement panel has been fitted at the manufacturing plant.
records.remedy: Replace the necessary component with a modified part.

records.concern: PANNIERS HAVE NOT BEEN INSTALLED CORRECTLY
records.defect: Some motorcycle pannier installation has not been fully carried out in accordance with the fitting instructions.
records.remedy: Apply a picture label to both pannier cases and dealers to explain the correct installation.

records.concern: THE 2ND ROW SEAT BELT ASSEMBLIES MAY CONTAIN A PHYSICAL SEAT BELT RETRACTOR PART WHICH IS OF A DIFFERENT SPECIFICATION TO THAT INTENDED FOR THE DESTINATION MARKET.
records.defect: The 2nd row seat belt assemblies may contain a physical seatbelt retractor part which is of a different specification to that intended for the destination market.
records.remedy: Replace the 2nd row seat belt assemblies with the correct specification parts.

records.concern: VEHICLES MAY HAVE BRAKE FLUID CONTAMINATION CAUSED BY TOPPING UP WITH AN INCORRECT FLUID
records.defect: On affected vehicles there may be some contamination of the brake fluid due to topping up with an incorrect fluid.
records.remedy: Replace the brake master cylinder and change the brake fluid on affected vehicles.

records.concern: WHEN THE eMMC REACHES ACCUMULATED LIFETIME WEAR THE CUSTOMER MAY EXPERIENCE A BLANK CENTRE DISPLAY
records.defect: When the eMMC reaches accumulated lifetime wear the customer may experience a blank centre display.
records.remedy: Ensure current software is installed and upgrade the VCM daughterboard to a 64GB Micron eMMC.

records.concern: IF THE ECALL SYSTEM IS ACTIVATED THE VIN NUMBER MAY NOT BE TRANSMITTED
records.defect: If the eCall system is activated the VIN number may not be transmitted.
records.remedy: Reset the eCall system so that the VIN number is transmitted accurately when appropriate.

records.concern: THE STRENGTH OF THE BRAKE BOOSTER PISTON COULD DEGRADE
records.defect: On affected vehicles the strength of the brake booster piston could degrade.
records.remedy: Check the brake booster piston serial number and replace if necessary.

records.concern: DUE TO INSUFFICIENT BONDING PLASTIC END BODY TRIM PIECES CAN LOOSEN AT THE FRONT AND REAR
records.defect: Plastic end Body trim pieces can loosen at the front and rear.
records.remedy: Replace the front and rear plastic end trim pieces and secure with metallic holders.

records.concern: TWO NUTS ON THE BRAKE BOOSTER HAVE BEEN ASSEMBLED WITH INSUFFICIENT TORQUE
records.defect: Two nuts on the Brake Booster have been assembled with insufficient torque.
records.remedy: Replace the existing two nuts with two locks nuts assembled with the correct torque.

records.concern: THE FUEL TANK MAY NOT HAVE BEEN WELDED PROPERLY AND COULD LEAK FUEL
records.defect: The fuel tank in the subject vehicles may not have been welded properly and could leak fuel.
records.remedy: Replace the Fuel Tank.

records.concern: THE THREAD PITCH OF THE SCREWS DOES NOT MATCH WITH THE THREAD PITCH OF THE BEARING
records.defect: The thread pitch of the screws do not match with the thread pitch of the bearing housing.
records.remedy: Supply and fit replacement wheel bearing kits.

records.concern: PASSENGER HAND POLES MAY BECOME INSECURE
records.defect: Passenger hand poles may become insecure.
records.remedy: Fit modified seat consoles hand poles & roof poles.

records.concern: A NUT SECURING THE MHEV BATTERY CONNECTION MAY NOT BE TORQUED TO SPECIFICATION
records.defect: A nut securing the mHEV battery connection may not be torqued to specification.
records.remedy: Remove the nut and inspect the wiring for signs of damage. Any damaged wiring will be replaced. A new nut will be fitted and torqued to specification in all circumstances.

records.concern: A CABLE HARNESS IN THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT MAY BE ASSEMBLED IN THE INCORRECT POSITION
records.defect: A cable harness in the engine compartment may be assembled in the incorrect position.
records.remedy: The cable harness is to be secured in the correct position.

records.concern: THE BATTERY CABLES ON THE 48V STARTER GENERATOR MAY NOT HAVE BEEN SUFFICIENTLY SECURED DURING PRODUCTION
records.defect: The battery cables on the 48V starter generator may not have been sufficiently secured during the production process.
records.remedy: Check the screw connection of the 48V positive / negative battery cables on the starter generator and rework if necessary.

records.concern: IF AN ABNORMALITY IS REGISTERED WITHIN THE IEB SYSTEM THAT MAY ILLUMINATE THE MALFUNCTION INDICATOR LAMP ON THE VEHICLE CLUSTER BRAKING PERFORMANCE MAY BE REDUCED
records.defect: If an abnormality is registered within the IEB system that might illuminate the malfunction indicator lamp (MIL) on the vehicle cluster braking performance may be reduced.
records.remedy: A software upgrade to the ESC (Electronic stability program) system.

records.concern: THERE IS A POSSIBILITY THAT THE CENTRE REAR SEAT BELT MAY BE DAMAGED BY A SHARP EDGE OF THE BRACKET
records.defect: There is a possibility that the centre rear seat belt may be damaged a sharp edge of the bracket.
records.remedy: Add a protective material to the seat belt anchor bracket.

records.concern: SOME REAR INNER SEAT BELTS MAY HAVE INCORRECT STITCHING ON THE BELT MATERIAL
records.defect: On affected vehicles some rear inner seat belts may have incorrect stitching on the belt material.
records.remedy: Check seat belts and relace if necessary.

records.concern: O1 AND O2 TRAILERS BEING SUPPLIED WITHOUT TYPE APPROVAL
records.defect: Trailers being supplied without necessary type approval.
records.remedy: Trailers must be presented for IVA and be tested accordingly to ensure certified compliance.

records.concern: AFFECTED VEHICLES ARE NOT FULLY COMPLIANT TO EUROPEAN REGULATION (165/2014+ EU799/2016) COVERING THE SMART TACHOGRAPH REQUIREMENTS
records.defect: Affected vehicles are not fully compliant to European regulation (165/2014 + EU 799/2016) covering the �Smart Tachograph� requirements.
records.remedy: Replacing the tachograph gearbox and on certain vehicles the windscreen depending on the specification of the vehicle.

records.concern: AFFECTED VEHICLES ARE NOT FULLY COMPLIANT TO EUROPEAN REGULATION (165/2014+ EU799/2016) COVERING THE SMART TACHOGRAPH REQUIREMENTS
records.defect: Affected vehicles are not fully compliant to European regulation (165/2014 + EU 799/2016) covering the �Smart Tachograph� requirements.
records.remedy: Replacing the tachograph gearbox and on certain vehicles the windscreen depending on the specification of the vehicle.

records.concern: THE THROTTLE PEDAL MAY BE SLOW TO RELEASE OR MAY STICK IN THE DEPRESSED POSITION
records.defect: Throttle pedals that may be slow to release or may stick in the depressed position.
records.remedy: An updated throttle pedal needs to be installed in all affected vehicles.

records.concern: NOX EMISSIONS DRIVER ALERT INFORMATION
records.defect: Nox emissions driver alert information.
records.remedy: Update EMS IC and ACM software.

records.concern: THE WELDING OF THE INDIVIDUAL COMPONENTS OF THE TOWBAR MIGHT NOT MEET THE CORRECT SPECIFICATION
records.defect: The welding of some components to the towbar assembly may not meet specification.
records.remedy: The replacement of the towbar.

records.concern: THE WELDING OF THE INDIVIDUAL COMPONENTS OF THE TOWBAR MIGHT NOT MEET THE CORRECT SPECIFICATION
records.defect: The welding of some components to the towbar assembly may not meet specification.
records.remedy: The replacement of the towbar.

records.concern: A REAR DRIVESHAFT BEARING SUPPORT BRACKET HAS NOT BEEN FITTED WITH THE INTENDED INTERNAL BUSHES
records.defect: On affected vehicles the rear driveshaft bearing support bracket has not been fitted with the intended internal bushes.
records.remedy: Fit a new driveshaft bearing support bracket.

records.concern: THE BRAKE VACUUM PUMP MAY BE AFFECTED BY MATERIAL DETACHING FROM THE TIMING BELT
records.defect: The brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt.
records.remedy: Update detection software inspect and if necessary replace vacuum pump and timing belt.

records.concern: THE BRAKE VACUUM PUMP MAY BE AFFECTED BY MATERIAL DETACHING FROM THE TIMING BELT
records.defect: The brake vacuum pump may be affected by material detaching from the timing belt.
records.remedy: Update detection software inspect and if necessary replace vacuum pump and timing belt.

records.concern: THE MHEV BATTERY CONNECTIONS MAY BECOME LOOSE
records.defect: There is a potential that the vehicle's MHEV battery connections may become loose.
records.remedy: Inspect and check torque on 48 volt battery cable connections

records.concern: AN INCORRECT FATIGUE LIMIT WAS APPLIED TO THE PROPELLER SHAFT TUBE
records.defect: On affected vehicles an incorrect fatigue limit has been applied to the prop shaft tube.
records.remedy: Change the prop shaft with a counter measure part.

records.concern: THE RIGHT HAND SIDE RADIATOR COOLANT HOSE MAY CHAFE AGAINST SURROUNDING COMPONENT
records.defect: On affected vehicles the right-hand side radiator coolant hose may chafe against surrounding component due to an insufficient clearance.
records.remedy: Check and replace the coolant hose if necessary. Fit protective spacer ring if needed.

records.concern: THE DRIVER SIDE FLOOR MAT MAY INTERFERE WITH THE ACCELERATOR PEDAL
records.defect: The driver side all-weather floor mat may in certain circumstances interfere with the accelerator pedal.
records.remedy: The rib material on 4 ribs that are in front of the accelerator pedal will be removed.

records.concern: THE VIN NUMBER MENTIONED ON THE PRODUCTION PLATE DOES NOT MATCH WITH THE ACTUAL VIN NUMBER OF THE VEHICLE
records.defect: The VIN number mentioned on the Production plate may not match with the actual VIN number of the vehicle.
records.remedy: Check and if necessary replace the Production plate/label.

records.concern: THE FIXING FOR THE LEFT HAND SIDE (LHS) 3RD ROW SEAT BELT UPPER ANCHORAGE MAY NOT BE INSTALLED TO THE REQUIRED SPECIFICATION.
records.defect: The fixing for the left hand side (LHS) 3rd Row Seat Belt upper anchorage may not be installed to the required specification.
records.remedy: Inspect the rear (3rd row) seat belt anchorage fixing and the rear trim and replace the fixing if necessary.

records.concern: THE CURRENT SOFTWARE DOES NOT PROVIDE SUFFICIENT NOX MONITORING TO CONFIRM THE LEGAL REQUIREMENTS ARE MET
records.defect: The current software does not provide sufficient NOx monitoring to confirm that the legal requirements on NOx emissions are met.
