records.concern: IMPLAUSABLE SIGNALS OF THE ROTARY SENSOR WITHIN THE ELECTRIC DRIVE CAN OCCUR AT HIGH SPEEDS
records.defect: Implausible signals of the rotary sensor within the electric drive can lead to the deactivation of the power electronics of the drive unit resulting in a loss of propulsion.
records.remedy: Update the software of the power electronics control unit.

records.concern: THE BOLTS ON THE REAR AXLE MAY NOT BE TIGHTENED CORRECTLY
records.defect: The bolts on the rear axle might not be tightened correctly
records.remedy: Check the tightening of the bolts on the rear axle on the affected vehicles and correct it if necessary

records.concern: A WELD ON THE INLET PIPE FLANGE COULD BE MISSING
records.defect: On affected components the exhaust flex end clamp ring has been inadequately welded
records.remedy: Check components and replace defective parts

records.concern: THE HYBRID BATTERY CONNECTIONS MAY NOT HAVE BEEN TORQUED TO FORD SPECIFICATION
records.defect: It is possible that the hybrid battery connections may not have been torqued to Ford specification.
records.remedy: The MHEV battery connections need to be checked and torqued to the correct value

records.concern: POSSIBLE MATERIAL DEFECT WHICH COULD REDUCE THE LIFE EXPECTANCY OF THE TOWING HOOK
records.defect: Possible material defect which could reduce the life expectancy of the Towing Hook.
records.remedy: Replace Towing hook for later version.

records.concern: THE LOWER CONTROL ARMS MAY BE FITTED WITH MISSING OR PARTIAL WELDS
records.defect: The lower control arms may have missing or partial welds
records.remedy: Inspect the lower control arms and replace if required.

records.concern: CHILD LOCK DISENGAGES AFTER BEING ACTIVATED
records.defect: The child lock disengages after it was activated by the customer.
records.remedy: Fit a retaining clip to the door locks.

records.concern: THE TENSILE STRENGTH OF THE WELDS ON THE REAR CROSSMEMBER MAY NOT MEET SPECIFICATION
records.defect: The tensile strength of the welds on the rear crossmember might not meet the specification.
records.remedy: Replace the rear crossmember

records.concern: FRONT WIPER ARM SECURING NUTS MAY BE INCORRECTLY TIGHTENED
records.defect: Vehicles may have incorrectly tightened front wiper arm securing nuts
records.remedy: Check and tighten the nuts to an increased torque setting.

records.concern: THE DATA DOCUMENTING THE CORRECT MOUNTING OF THE TURBOCHARGER OIL FEED AS WELL AS THE OIL RETURN LINE MAY BE MISSING
records.defect: The HV battery pack can overheat and result in the venting of hot gas which can ignite vehicle components or in extreme cases the entire vehicle.
records.remedy: To prevent a vehicle fire the vehicles should not be charged using the external charging cable and the vehicles should only be driven using the default Auto EV mode only

records.concern: VEHICLES MAY BE EQUIPPED WITH A FUEL PUMP MODULE MANUFACTURED WITH LOW DENSITY IMPELLARS
records.defect: Affected vehicles may be equipped with a fuel pump module manufactured with low density impellers.
records.remedy: The affected fuel pumps will be replaced.

records.concern: THE LEFT REAR SEAT BACKREST LOCK MAY NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: The left rear seat backrest lock might not meet the specifications
records.remedy: Replace the left rear seat backrest lock on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: TAKATA AIR BAG INFLATOR MAY RUPTURE ON DEPLOYMENT
records.defect: Air bag inflators may not operate as intended
records.remedy: Replace air bag inflator

records.concern: INCORRECT STEERING INNER TIE RODS HAVE BEEN INSTALLED
records.defect: Vehicles have been built with incorrect steering inner tie rods
records.remedy: Replacement of the steering inner tie rods.

records.concern: THE UREA INJECTOR MAY BLOCK AND LEAD TO NOx EMISSIONS GOING OUT OF REGULATORY LIMITS
records.defect: The vehicles may be affected by a defect in the urea injector which might block and lead to NOx emissions going out of the regulatory limits.
records.remedy: Updating the ECU software to avoid the gradual blocking of the urea injector

records.concern: THE UREA INJECTOR MAY BLOCK AND LEAD TO NOx EMISSIONS GOING OUT OF REGULATORY LIMITS
records.defect: The vehicles may be affected by a defect in the urea injector which might block and lead to NOx emissions going out of the regulatory limits.
records.remedy: Updating the ECU software to avoid the gradual blocking of the urea injector

records.concern: ENGINE WIRING LOOM MAY TOUCH A BOLT ON THE TRANSMISSION HOUSING
records.defect: The engine wiring loom may touch a bolt on the transmission housing which could lead to damage to the wiring loom.
records.remedy: Check for enough wiring loom clearance replace the clip and secure harness if not. Any damage to the wiring harness to be repaired as necessary.

records.concern: THE BOWDEN CABLE FOR THE EXHAUST BUTTERFLY VALVE COULD COME INTO CONTACT WITH THE MOTORCYCLE POSITIVE CABLE
records.defect: The Bowden cable for the exhaust butterfly valve could come into contact with the motorcycle positive cable
records.remedy: Fit a cable guide and re-route affected electrical cables.

records.concern: MISROUTED HARNESS WIRING MAY BECOME DAMAGED RESULTING IN ENGINE STALL
records.defect: Wiring harness may become damaged by contact with lower lug on main frame headstock.
records.remedy: Fit a new VIN label protector check the harness for damage and repair or replace as necessary.

records.concern: ROTOR BREAKAGE COULD OCCUR
records.defect: On affected vehicles a potential defect in the production process may result in generator rotor (flywheel) breakage
records.remedy: Inspect and replace the rotor if necessary

records.concern: A STARTER MOTOR BOLT MAY HAVE BEEN INSTALLED INCORRECTLY AND BECOME LOST INSIDE THE TRANSMISSION BELL HOUSING
records.defect: A starter bolt may have been installed incorrectly and become lost inside the transmission bell housing.
records.remedy: The starter motor will be removed and checked for a bolt that is adrift any damage found will be rectified.

records.concern: THE EXHAUST GAS RECIRCULATION MODULE COOLER COULD LEAK OVER TIME
records.defect: The Exhaust Gas Recirculation (EGR) Module cooler could leak over time
records.remedy: The EGR cooler will be inspected on the affected vehicles and replaced if evidence of leaking is found.

records.concern: SPECIFIC ASPECTS OF THE CALIBRATION OF THE ENGINE CONTROL SYSTEM MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION
records.defect: Specific aspects of the calibration of the engine control system may not be to specification.
records.remedy: Update the software in the engine control unit.

records.concern: POSSIBLE REDUCED RETENTION FORCE OF THE REAR DOOR CHILD LOCK SWITCH
records.defect: Possible reduced retention force of the Rear Door Child Lock switch.
records.remedy: Fit a countermeasure part into the child lock door switch aperture of all potentially affected vehicles.

records.concern: THE THREADED CONNECTIONS OF THE LEFT SEAT BASES WITH THE FLOOR MAY NOT BE TIGHTENED CORRECTLY
records.defect: Two threaded connections that connect the left seat bases with the floor of the vehicle's body shell may not have been installed with the required tightening torque.
records.remedy: Check the potentially affected threaded connections on the affected vehicles and ensure that they have been tightened to the specified torque.

records.concern: ENGINE CONTROL UNIT SOFTWARE NEEDS UPDATING
records.defect: Emission control levels may not meet specification
records.remedy: The software in multiple control units will be updated.

records.concern: DUE TO INCORRECT MANUFACTURING THE REAR SEAT BELT ASSEMBLY WEBBING SENSOR COULD BECOME INOPERATIVE
records.defect: The webbing sensor in the rear centre seat belt assembly could become inoperative.
records.remedy: Check and if the seat belt is within the affected range the seat belt will be replaced.

records.concern: INCORRECTLY IMPLEMENTED THREADED CONNECTION OF THE PROPELLER SHAFT INTERMEDIATE BEARINGS AT THE UNDERBODY
records.defect: The threaded connection of the propeller shaft intermediate bearings at the underbody has not been verifiably documented in certain Sprinter vehicles.
records.remedy: Renew the screws of the propeller shaft intermediate bearing and tighten them with the specified torque in the affected vehicles.

records.concern: THE FUEL LOW PRESSURE HOSE QUICK CONNECT IN THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT COULD BE SUBJECTED TO TEMPERATURES ABOVE THE DESIGN OPERATING SPECIFICATION
records.defect: The fuel low pressure hose quick connect in the engine compartment could be subjected to temperatures above the design operating specification.
records.remedy: Replace the existing fuel quick connect with one made of an improved material. Update engine cooling fan software where required.

records.concern: STEERING TIE ROD CAN BECOME BROKEN IN THE 'KINK' GROOVE AREA OF THE ROD
records.defect: A steering tie rod with an earlier design configuration can become broken in the �kink� groove area of the rod.
records.remedy: Both of the steering tie rods will be replaced on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: REAR REFLEX REFLECTOR MAY DETACH
records.defect: The rear reflex reflector may detach from the motorcycle.
records.remedy: Replace the rear reflex reflector.

records.concern: THE CONTROL UNIT OF THE DIFFERENTIAL LOCKING MODULE MAY NOT MEET SPECIFICATION
records.defect: The control unit of the differential locking module might not meet the specification.
records.remedy: Check the differential locking modules on the affected vehicles and exchange them if necessary.

records.concern: THE EMBOSSED LOCK SYMBOL AT THE OPERATING LEVER OF THE CHILD SAFETY LOCK AT THE REAR DOORS MAY INDICATE WRONG LOCKING STATUS
records.defect: The embossed lock symbol at the operating lever of the child safety lock at the rear doors might indicate the wrong locking status.
records.remedy: Cover the incorrectly embossed lock symbol in the rear doors with the correct labelling.

records.concern: THE FRONT LOWER SUSPENSION ARMS MAY HAVE CRACKS ON SOME PORTIONS OF ITS SURFACE
records.defect: The front lower suspension arms may have cracks on some portions of its surface.
records.remedy: Replace the front lower arms of affected vehicles.

records.concern: THE ELASTOMERIC MATERIAL OF THE OIL FEED LINE TO THE TURBOCHARGERS MAY NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: The material of the turbocharger oil feed pipe may not meet specification leading to leakage.
records.remedy: Replace the oil feed pipe to the turbocharger on affected vehicles.

records.concern: THE WIRING HARNESS FOR THE FRONT DOORS MAY NOT BE ROUTED APPROPRIATELY
records.defect: The wiring harness for the front doors might not be routed appropriately.
records.remedy: Modify the route of the harness or replace it in case of damage.

records.concern: CERTAIN FRONT SEAT BELT BUCKLES MAY NOT HAVE BEEN MANUFACTURED ACCORDING TO SPECIFICATION
records.defect: A correctly fastened seat belt could be detected as not fastened impairing the restraint system
records.remedy: Check the relevant seat belt buckles in the affected vehicles and replace if necessary

records.concern: THE BONDING OF THE TYPE LABEL AND/OR NOISE SIGN IS NOT PROCESS-RELIABLE
records.defect: The bonding of the type label and/or the noise sign is not process-reliable.
records.remedy: The type plate and the noise sign are to be replaced.

records.concern: POSSIBLE CRACK OF TAIL LIFT SIDE ARM PROFILES
records.defect: Possible crack of tail lift side arm profiles.
records.remedy: Replace tail lift side arms.

records.concern: CAMSHAFT SUPPORT HOUSING BEARING CAPS MAY BECOME LOOSE
records.defect: It is possible that the camshaft bearing cap screws could come loose on the affected vehicles.
records.remedy: Check and replace camshaft support housing or complete cylinder head as required.

records.concern: UNDER CERTAIN CIRCUMSTANCES THE HYBRID UNIT MAY SHUT DOWN AND CAUSE LOSS OF MOTIVE POWER
records.defect: Under certain circumstances the hybrid unit may shut down and cause loss of motive power.
records.remedy: Reprogram the Power Management ECU.

records.concern: THE SUSPENSION ROLLER PISTON MAY DETACH FROM THE AXLE
records.defect: It may be possible that the suspension roller piston detaches from the axle.
records.remedy: The screw connection of the roller piston on all axles has to be retightened to the torque of 92Nm.

records.concern: THE STEERING SHAFT BEARING PLATE MAY NOT BE SCREWED TO THE ENGINE BULKHEAD CORRECTLY
records.defect: The steering shaft bearing plate may not have been screwed on correctly.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the screw connection of the steering shaft bearing plate will be inspected and if necessary correctly attached or replaced.

records.concern: INCORRECT NOx CONTROL
records.defect: Lack of NOX-neutralizing substance in the catalytic converter meaning incorrect NOx Control
records.remedy: Replace the catalytic convertor

records.concern: THE MATERIAL OF TWO CLOSURE PLUGS ON THE ENGINE MAY NOT WITHSTAND THE MAXIMUM LOADS WHILST DRIVING
records.defect: The material of two closure plugs on the engine might not withstand the maximum loads while driving.
records.remedy: Rework the closure plugs on the engine on the affected vehicles

records.concern: THE WIRING HARNESS UNDER THE RIGHT SEAT OF THE SECOND SEAT ROW MAY NOT BE ROUTED CORRECTLY
records.defect: The wiring harness under the right seat of the second seat row might not be routed according to specification.
records.remedy: Check the routing of the wiring harness correct it if necessary and repair any potentially existing damages on the wiring harness.

records.concern: THE MOUNTING OF THE GAS LINE TO THE GAS GENERATOR OF THE INERTER SYSTEM MAY NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: The mounting of an argon gas line to generator of the inerter system might not meet specifications.
records.remedy: Check the mounting of the gas line to the gas generator on the affected vehicles and rework it if necessary.

records.concern: THE CALIBRATION OF THE OCCUPANT CLASSIFICATION SYSTEM FOR THE PASSENGER SEAT MAY NOT MEET THE SPECIFICATION
records.defect: The calibration of the occupant classification system for the passenger seat might not meet the specification.
records.remedy: Replace the passenger seat cushion

records.concern: WATER OR OIL MAY ENTER THE HYDRAULIC ELECTRONIC CONTROL UNIT
records.defect: Water or oil may enter the Hydraulic Electronic Control Unit over a long period of time causing an electrical short circuit.
records.remedy: Install a relay to isolate the HECU when the ignition is switched off.

records.concern: THE FOUR WHEEL FINAL DRIVE SCREW JOINTS TO THE TRANSMISSION MOUNT HAVE NOT BEEN TIGHTENED TO CORRECT SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: The front four-wheel final drive transmission support mounts may not be tightened according to specifications.
records.remedy: The front-axle final drive will be removed and the transmission support will be secured according to specifications. If necessary the front-axle final drive and any other damaged components will be replaced.

records.concern: THE HEAT SHIELD INSTALLED AT THE TURBOCHARGER MAY NOT MEET THE SPECIFICATION
records.defect: The heat shield installed at the turbocharger may not meet the specification
records.remedy: Replace the heat shield on the affected vehicles

records.concern: THE SEATBELT ON THE FRONT LEFT SEAT MIGHT NOT HAVE BEEN MOUNTED ACCORDING TO SPECIFICATION.
records.defect: The seatbelt on the front left seat might not have been mounted according to specification
records.remedy: Check the routing of the seatbelt on the front left seat on the affected vehicles and correct it if necessary. If the webbing is damaged the seatbelt will be replaced.

records.concern: THE DIMENSION OF THE BRAKE DISCS ON THE FRONT AXLE MAY BE TOO SMALL
records.defect: The dimension of the brake discs installed on the front axle might be too small.
records.remedy: Replace the brake discs on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: SOME 4-POINT HARNESSES SOLD AS AN ACCESORY COULD HAVE BEEN MANUFACTURED WITH MISSING STITCHING AT ATTACHMENT POINTS
records.defect: Some 4-point harnesses sold as an accessory could have been manufactured with missing stitching at attachment points.
records.remedy: BRP is asking its dealers to contact the consumers about the recall and to bring their harnesses for inspection and if necessary a replacement.

records.concern: THERE IS A RISK FOR TRAPPED AIR TO BE IN THE COOLING SYSTEM WHICH MAY RESULT IN INSUFFICIENT COOLING OF ENGINE COMPONENTS
records.defect: There is a risk for trapped air to be in the cooling system which may result in insufficient cooling of engine components.
records.remedy: Add an extra degassing line (Bleeder Hose) between the cooling system radiator and the cooling system expansion tank which will evacuate the trapped air

records.concern: THE INNER TIE RODS ARE NOT CORRECT TO SPECIFICATION
records.defect: The inner tie rods connecting the steering rack to the track rod end are not correct to specification
records.remedy: Replace the steering rack inner tie rods (on both sides)

records.concern: THE INNER TIE RODS ARE NOT CORRECT TO SPECIFICATION
records.defect: The inner tie rods connecting the steering rack to the track rod end are not correct to specification
records.remedy: Replace the steering rack inner tie rods (on both sides)

records.concern: INCORRECT STARTER WIRING HARNESS AND HOLDER FOR FIXING THE EXHAUST SYSTEM MAY BE INSTALLED
records.defect: An incorrect starter wiring harness and a holder for fixing the exhaust system could be installed.
records.remedy: Replace the starter wiring harness and the holder for fixing the exhaust on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: THERE IS A POSSIBILITY THAT THE INTERNAL CORROSION PROTECTION OF THE SUBFRAME IS NOT DURABLE ENOUGH.
records.defect: There is a possibility that the internal corrosion protection of the front subframe is not durable enough.
records.remedy: Replacing the front subframe assembly.

records.concern: POSSIBLE LEAKY CONNECTION ON THE HIGH PRESSURE FUEL PUMP
records.defect: Possible leaky connection on the high pressure fuel pump.
records.remedy: Re-tighten the high pressure fuel pump and replace the fuel supply pipe.

records.concern: THE HEAD RESTRAINT PADDING MAY SEPARATE FROM THE FASTENING RODS
records.defect: The head restraint padding may separate from the fastening rod.
records.remedy: Replace the head restraints on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: INTERNAL WELDING OF THE MAIN CELL CONDUCTORS OF THE HIGH-VOLTAGE BATTERY MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: Internal welding of the main cell conductors of the high-voltage battery might not meet specification.
records.remedy: Replace the high-voltage battery on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: THE THIRD ROW SEAT HEAD RESTRAINTS MAY NOT MEET SPECIFICATION
records.defect: The third row seat head restraints may not meet specification on affected vehicles.
records.remedy: Replace the head restraints on affected vehicles

records.concern: WIRE OF SEAT BELT BUCKLE CAN RUB AGAINST THE PLASTIC COVER
records.defect: Wire of seat belt buckle can rub against the plastic cover.
records.remedy: Replace affected buckle for new designed buckle.

records.concern: THERE IS A RISK FOR TRAPPED AIR TO BE IN THE COOLING SYSTEM
records.defect: There is a risk for trapped air to be in the cooling system which may result in insufficient cooling of engine components.
records.remedy: Add an extra degassing line (Bleeder Hose) between the cooling system radiator and the cooling system expansion tank which will evacuate the trapped air.

records.concern: INCORRECT RESTRAINT BARS AND/OR HEAD RESTRAINTS MAY HAVE BEEN INSTALLED
records.defect: Bench seats in the rear may have been installed with the head restraint bars of a different bench seat and/or head restraint variant.
records.remedy: Check the head restraints in the rear area in the affected vehicles and replace if necessary.

records.concern: THERE IS THE POSSIBILITY THAT A SMALL CHILD COULD CLIMB FROM THE BUNK BED OUT THROUGH THE OPENED ROOF HATCH
records.defect: There is the possibility that small children could climb from the bunk bed out through the opened roof hatch.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles protection against climbing out is to be fitted.

records.concern: SEVERAL FIXATIONS ON THE REAR AXLE COMPONENT WERE NOT TIGHTENED CORRECTLY
records.defect: There is a possibility that several fixations on the rear axle component were not tightened correctly.
records.remedy: Tighten all fixations to correct torque and replace the nuts and bolts if necessary.

records.concern: CERTAIN IMMI 4 POINT AND 6 POINT SEAT BELT HARNESSES MAY HAVE BEEN MANUFACTURED WITH MISSING BELT STITCHING
records.defect: Certain 4-point and 6-point seat belt harnesses may have been manufactured with missing belt stitching.
records.remedy: Check and replace the belt assembly if required.

records.concern: DISTORTION OF THE FUEL TANK MAY OCCUR ON THE SEALING SURFACES IN THE AREAS SURROUNDING THE FUEL PUMP AND THE FUEL LEVEL SENSOR
records.defect: Distortion of the fuel tank may occur on the sealing surfaces in the areas surrounding the fuel pump and the fuel level sensor.
records.remedy: Fuel tanks to be replaced with an improved component.

records.concern: IMMI HARNESSES MAY HAVE BEEN MANUFACTURED WITH MISSING BELT STITICHING
records.defect: Certain 4-point and 6-point seat belt harnesses may have been manufactured with missing belt stitching.
records.remedy: Check and replace the belt assembly if required.

records.concern: THE HIGH VOLTAGE BATTERY CONTROL CHARGER MODULE CONNECTOR MAY BE DAMAGED
records.defect: The High Voltage Battery Control Charger Module (BCCM) connector may be damaged
records.remedy: An inspection of the BCCM is required to confirm an undamaged connector. If a failed inspection occurs the vehicle must be reworked with a replacement BCCM and charge cable.

records.concern: DEGRADE OF EMISSIONS CONTROL COMPONENT
records.defect: Premature degradation of emission control component.
records.remedy: If found then replacement of Silencer

records.concern: THE NOISE VIBRATION AND HARDNESS FOAM PAD CAN OVER TIME CORRODE THE SURFACE OF THE FUEL TANK
records.defect: The Noise Vibration and Harshness (NVH) foam pad underneath the fuel tank may retain moisture and corrode the fuel tank potentially causing a fuel leak
records.remedy: Remove the NVH foam pad from the vehicle and inspect fuel tank. Repair or replace the fuel tank if necessary.

records.concern: OIL COOLER HOSE POTENTIALLY HAS AN INTERNAL DEFECT AND MAY SPLIT
records.defect: Oil cooler hose potentially has an internal defect and may split.
records.remedy: Remedy is not yet confirmed. Owner to contact manufacturer.

records.concern: THE FUEL PIPE MAY CRACK OVER TIME
records.defect: Possibility that the fuel pipe may crack over time and causing it to leak fuel into the engine bay.
records.remedy: Replace the affected fuel pipe

records.concern: POTENTIAL BREAKAGE/FATIGUE OF A FLEXIBLE STEEL CABLE SUPPORTING THE FRONT SEATBELT ANCHOR POINT
records.defect: Potential breakage/fatigue of a flexible steel cable supporting the front seatbelt anchor point.
records.remedy: Replace the seat belt fastener with a new designed seat belt fastening.

records.concern: THERE IS A POTENTIAL FOR THE INTERNAL AGGRESSION IN THE FUEL HOSE CAUSING A FUEL LEAK
records.defect: There is a potential for the internal aggression in the fuel hose causing a fuel leak.
records.remedy: Replace the fuel supple pipe

records.concern: MOISTURE MAY ENTER THE BELT-DRIVEN STARTER-ALTERNATOR
records.defect: It is possible that moisture may enter the belt-driven starter-alternator.
records.remedy: The starter-alternator must be replaced on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: THE RUN ON WATER PUMP MAY OVERHEAT
records.defect: The Run On Water Pump (ROWP) fitted to Transit and Transit Custom vehicles may overheat
records.remedy: Replacing the 15 Amp fuse with a 7.5 Amp fuse to prevent the possibility for the ROWP to overheat.

records.concern: THE STRENGTH OF THE ENGINE CRANKSHAFT CONNECTING ROD MAY BE INSUFFICIENT
records.defect: The strength of the engine crankshaft connecting rod may be insufficient.
records.remedy: Check the material number and where necessary a new replacement engine will be fitted.

records.concern: THE OPERATING MANUAL DOES NOT SPECIFY CERTAIN CONDITIONS UNDER WHICH THE AUTOMATIC PARKING FUNCTION OF THE AUTOMATIC GEARBOX OPERATES
records.defect: The operating manual does not correctly specify certain conditions under which the automatic parking function (Auto-P) of the automatic gearbox operates.
records.remedy: Add a supplementary booklet with a correct description of the Auto-P function to the operating manual.

records.concern: THE GROUND TERMINAL OF THE TRAILER HITCH SOCKET MAY BE INSTALLED IN AN INCORRECT PORT
records.defect: The ground terminal of the trailer hitch socket might be installed in an incorrect port.
records.remedy: Relocate the ground terminal in the trailer hitch socket from pin location 10 to location 3.

records.concern: THE OPTIONAL SPEED LIMITER DOES NOT WORK
records.defect: The optional Speed Limiter does not work.
records.remedy: Reprogramming of the Engine Control Module

records.concern: ENGINE CODE MARKED ON DIESEL ENGINE IN AFTERSALES IS DIFFERENT FROM THE HOMOLOGATED AND PRODUCTION CODE
records.defect: Engine code marked on Diesel engine replaced in aftersales is different from the homologated and Production code
records.remedy: Documentation will be provided to the customer stating the Italian transport authority confirm this marking is an administration error.

records.concern: FRESHWATER TANK BRACKET SECURING BOLT HEAD MAY PULL THROUGH THE FIXING BRACKET
records.defect: Freshwater tank bracket securing bolt head can pull through the fixing bracket causing the tank bracket to drop.
records.remedy: : Add additional brackets to all four fixing bolts to stop the risk of the bolt head pulling through the original bracket.

records.concern: FEED KNOB STARTER SWITCH SUPPORT SPRING FAILURE COULD POSSIBLY RESULT IN IGNITION OFF WHILST VEHICLE IS IN MOTION
records.defect: Feed Knob Starter switch support spring failure could possibly result in ignition off whilst vehicle is in motion.
records.remedy: Change Starter switch harness & cover to new version if not already fitted.

records.concern: THE AIR BAG CONTROL UNIT MAY HAVE BEEN EQUIPPED WITH A DEFECTIVE SENSOR FOR THE ROLLOVER DETECTION
records.defect: The air bag control unit may have been equipped with a defective sensor for the rollover detection.
records.remedy: The Airbag control unit (ACSM4i) will be replaced on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: THE FACTORY ECU PROGRAMMING MAY CAUSE THE ENGINE TO AFTER FIRE WHEN KAWASAKI QUICK SHIFTER IS USED UNDER HEAVY ENGINE LOAD
records.defect: The factory Electronic Control Unit programming may cause the engine to after fire when Kawasaki Quick Shifter is used under heavy engine load.
records.remedy: Reprogram the ECU. Replace the reed valves in the air suction valve assemblies on used motorcycles and if necessary replace any parts that have been heat damaged as a result of after-fire occurring.

records.concern: E-CALL SERVICE MAY NOT ALWAYS BE FUNCTIONAL
records.defect: On affected vehicles the e-call service may not function
records.remedy: Update the Online Control Unit software on affected vehicles

records.concern: THE E-CALL SERVICE FUNCTION MAY NOT ALWAYS FUNCTION
records.defect: On affected vehicles the e-call service may not function
records.remedy: Update the Online Control Unit software on affected vehicle.

records.concern: POSSIBLE COLLISION BETWEEN BRAKE HOSES AND WHEEL ARCH LINER AT THE FRONT AXLE
records.defect: Contact could occur between brake hoses and the rear segment of the front axle wing panel liner resulting in chafing.
records.remedy: Check the position of the wing liner & modify as per working instructions.

records.concern: A FRONT BRAKE PAD MAY DISLODGE UNDER BRAKING
records.defect: The brake pad could detach from its retaining clip and fall away from the brake disc
records.remedy: Fit a 3mm spacer ring to the wheel before the brake disc to prevent the pad detaching

records.concern: POSSIBILITY OF HUMIDITY INGRESS IN THE BOWDEN CABLES OF THE DOORS
records.defect: Possibility of humidity ingress in the Bowden cables of the doors due to missing seals.
records.remedy: Remove cables and humidity and seal off. Poznan produced cables to be replaced.

records.concern: THE ADHESIVE BOND BETWEEN THE SUNROOF AND THE VEHICLE BODY DOES NOT MEET SPECIFICATION
records.defect: A small number of vehicles may have an adhesive bond between the sunroof and the vehicle body which does not meet the specification.
records.remedy: The sunroof glass or sunroof assembly will be replaced.

records.concern: IF MOISTURE ENTERS THE ABS MODULE IT COULD CAUSE AN ELECTRICAL SHORT
records.defect: When the vehicle is turned off if moisture enters the ABS module it could cause an electrical short.
records.remedy: Affected vehicles will have a relay installed in the main fuse box to prevent power going to the ABS module when the ignition key is in the off position.

records.concern: THE WHEEL ARCH LINER ON THE FRONT AXLE COULD TOUCH AND CHAFE THE FLEXIBLE BRAKE HOSE
records.defect: The wheel arch liner on the front axle could touch and chafe the flexible brake hose.
records.remedy: Check the condition and clearance of the flexible brake hoses replacing them if necessary. Additionally the corresponding wheel arch liner will be modified to provide adequate clearance.

records.concern: UNDER BRAKING PRESSURE THE BRAKE PEDAL DEFLECTS AND CONTACTSTHE SKID PLATE INHIBITING REAR WHEEL BRAKING PERFORMANCE
records.defect: The brake pedal deflects under braking pressure and contacts the Skid Plate which inhibits rear wheel braking performance.
records.remedy: Replace the Accessory Skid Plate with a new remedial part.

records.concern: THE TIGHTNESS OF THE QUICK CONNECTOR OF THE FUEL SUPPLY LINE MAY NOT BE ENSURED
records.defect: The tightness of the quick connector of the fuel supply line may not be ensured.
records.remedy: The fuel supply line in the engine compartment has to be replaced.

records.concern: THE STEERING GEOMETRY COULD BE INCORRECTLY SET
records.defect: The steering geometry could be incorrectly set due to an incorrectly calibrated setting rig in the manufacturing plant.
records.remedy: Check the steering alignment and adjusting if set incorrectly. If the front tyres are worn these will also be replaced.

records.concern: THE STEERING GEOMETRY COULD BE INCORRECTLY SET
records.defect: The steering geometry could be incorrectly set due to an incorrectly calibrated setting rig in the manufacturing plant.
records.remedy: Check the steering alignment and adjusting if set incorrectly. If the front tyres are worn these will also be replaced.

records.concern: VEHICLES MAY NOT COMPLY WITH SPECIFIC EMISSIONS CRITERIA
records.defect: Vehicles may not comply with specific emissions criteria.
records.remedy: Carry out a SOPS software conversion or evidence exemption compliance

records.concern: THE FRONT BRAKE PADS FRICTION MATERIAL MAY DETACH FROM THE BACK PLATE WHEN USED IN A CORROSIVE ENVIRONMENT
records.defect: The front brake pads could have potential issues involving detachment of brake pad friction material from the back plate.
records.remedy: Replace all the affected brake pads

records.concern: CORROSION OF THE BRAKE CALIPERS CAN OCCUR
records.defect: Corrosion due to salt may cause brake bind.
records.remedy: Inspect and clean replace the seals or callipers as required.

records.concern: THE BRAKE PAD FRICTION MATERIAL MAY SEPARATE FROM THE PLATES
records.defect: The friction material might separate from the plates of the brake pads due to a non-conformity.
records.remedy: Replace the front brake pads.

records.concern: GEAR OIL MAY ESCAPE DUE TO A FAULTY WELDED JOINT ON THE GEARBOX OIL LINE
records.defect: It is possible that gear oil may escape due to a faulty welded joint on the gearbox oil line.
records.remedy: The production date of the gear oil line must be checked first on the vehicles affected and the gear oil line must be replaced if necessary.

records.concern: IF THE HEAD AIR BAG IS DEPLOYED THE IGNITOR MAY SEPARATE FROM THE INFLATOR
records.defect: Curtain airbags may have propellant which may have a humidity level higher than specification and in the event of a collision may not deploy correctly increasing the risk of injury.
records.remedy: Replace the airbags on affected vehicles.

records.concern: OVER TIME THE FUNCTION OF THE TAKATA NADI AIRBAG INFLATOR CAN DEGRADE DUE TO AIR AND MOISTURE INGRESS INTO THE INFLATOR MATERIAL
records.defect: The function of the driver airbag inflators can degrade due to air and moisture ingress.
records.remedy: Replace Driver air bag inflator

records.concern: A WELDED CONNECTION OF THE GEARBOX OIL PIPE CAN CAUSE A LEAK OF GEAR OIL
records.defect: A welded connection of the gearbox oil pipe can cause a leak of gear oil.
records.remedy: Check whether the gearbox oil pipe is within the affected production period. If this is the case the pipe is replaced.

records.concern: THE + WIRE OF THE GRIPTONE BATTERY CHARGING SOCKET COULD RUB THROUGH
records.defect: The permanent + wire (30) of the GRIPTONE battery charging socket could rub through due to a sharp edge on a fixing bracket.
records.remedy: The geometry of the fixing bracket will be modified to remove the possibility of the wire rubbing.

records.concern: AFTERMARKET REPLACEMENT PRODUCT DOES NOT HAVE NECESSARY TYPE APPROVAL
records.defect: Euro VI DPF replacements don�t currently have necessary type approval.
records.remedy: All parts to be returned to Dinex Warrington office for credit.

records.concern: POSSIBLE DETACHMENT OF THE FIXED GLASS SUNROOF WHILST DRIVING
records.defect: Possible detachment of the fixed glass sunroof while driving.
records.remedy: Check the bonding and replace if required replace the fixed glass sunroof.

records.concern: THE ROOF SPOILER CAN PARTIALLY OR COMPLETELY DETACH FROM THE VEHICLE
records.defect: The roof spoiler can partially or completely detach from the vehicle.
records.remedy: The roof spoiler is additionally fixed in position with bolts on the rear lid.

records.concern: THE FIXING OF THE FRONT WING WHEEL ARCH TRIM DOES NOT CONFORM TO SPECIFICATION
records.defect: The fixing of the front wing wheel arch trim does not conform to specification.
records.remedy: The repair consists of adding an additional fixing screw to the bottom of the front wheel arch trim.

records.concern: THE FIXING OF THE FRONT WING WHEEL ARCH TRIM DOES NOT CONFORM TO SPECIFICATION
records.defect: The fixing of the front wing wheel arch trim does not conform to specification.
records.remedy: The repair consists of adding an additional fixing screw to the bottom of the front wheel arch trim.

records.concern: THE UPPER STEERING COLUMN BOLT MAY NOT HAVE BEEN FITTED
records.defect: The upper steering column bolt may not have been fitted.
records.remedy: Inspect the upper steering column bolt fitment and replace where necessary.

records.concern: THE FIXED SPEED LIMITER IS INOPERATIVE
records.defect: Due to the incorrect calibration of the injection computer the fixed speed limiter is inoperative.
records.remedy: Re-program the injection computer.

records.concern: BRAKE PAD MATERIAL MAY DETACH FROM THE BACK PLATE
records.defect: Brake pad material may detach from the back plate.
records.remedy: Check part number on disc pad replace if the number is the faulty part number

records.concern: BRAKE PAD MATERIAL MAY DETACH FROM THE BACK PLATE
records.defect: Brake pad material may detach from the back plate.
records.remedy: Check part number on disc pad replace if the number is the faulty part number.

records.concern: THE BONDING BETWEEN THE GLASS PANEL AND THE SLIDING ROOF FRAME MAY NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: The bonding between the glass panel and the sliding roof frame might not meet specifications
records.remedy: Check the glass panel bonding on the affected vehicles and replace the sliding roof if necessary

records.concern: THE OUTER PART OF THE AIR BAFFLE ON THE FRONT PANEL FLAP MAY BE LOOSE
records.defect: The outer part of the air baffle on the front panel flap could fully or partially detach from the vehicle.
records.remedy: Replace the outer part with one of a different supplier

records.concern: THE BOWDEN CABLE PIN INSIDE THE INTERNAL DOOR HANDLES MAY NOT BE CORRECTLY ENGAGED
records.defect: The internal door handle mechanism may fail and the door cannot be unlocked from the inside.
records.remedy: Replace the whole internal door handle.

records.concern: OWNER'S MANUALS FOR THE TRANSPORTER WERE INCLUDED INSTEAD OF FOR THE MULTIVAN
records.defect: On T6.1 California vehicles owner's manuals for the Transporter were included instead of for the Multivan.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the Transporter owner's manual is replaced with the Multivan owner's manual.

records.concern: THE FUNCTION OF THE LOCKING MECHANISM ON THE FRONT HEAD RESTRAINTS MAY BE IMPAIRED
records.defect: The function of the locking mechanism on the front head restraints may be impaired.
records.remedy: The front head restraints must be replaced on the affected vehicles

records.concern: TRANSMISSION FLUID PUMP GEAR FAILURE CAN CAUSE A LOSS OF HYDRAULIC FLUID PRESSURE IN THE TRANSMISSION
records.defect: Transmission fluid pump gear failure
records.remedy: Update the Transmission Control Module (TCM) and Powertrain Control Module (PCM) software

records.concern: THE DRIVER'S AIR BAG FABRIC COULD BE DAMAGED BY THE AIR BAG COVER DURING DEPLOYMENT
records.defect: This airbag fabric could be damaged by the airbag cover during deployment.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the driver�s airbag will be replaced.

records.concern: THE SEAT SCISSOR AND/OR GUIDE RAIL OF THE DRIVER'S SEAT CAN BREAK
records.defect: The seat scissor and/or guide rail of the driver's seat can break.
records.remedy: Check the correct installation of the securing strap on the seat scissor of the driver's seat. Fit or re-position if necessary.

records.concern: THE CABLE LENGTHS FOR THE ELECTRIC CONNECTION OF THE HALL SENSOR INSIDE THE SEATBELT BUCKLE COULD BE TOO SHORT
records.defect: The cable lengths for the electric connection of the hall sensor integrated inside the seatbelt buckle could be too short.
records.remedy: R; The front seat belt buckles will be checked and replaced if they are found to be faulty.

records.concern: DEPLOYMENT OF THE PASSENGER AIRBAG COULD DAMAGE THE INSTRUMENT PANEL
records.defect: Deployment of the passenger air bag could damage the instrument panel
records.remedy: On the affected vehicle the instrument panel trim will be replaced

records.concern: THE THROTTLE LEVER STOP MAY HAVE BEEN DAMAGED DURING SHIPPING
records.defect: The throttle lever stop might have been damaged during shipping
records.remedy: Check for damage on the neck of the throttle lever. If damage is found the throttle lever shall be replaced.

records.concern: THE BRACKET OF THE DOUBLE BELT BUCKLE MAY HAVE BEEN DAMAGED DURING THE FORMING PROCESS
records.defect: It is possible that the bracket of the double belt buckle has been damaged during the forming process.
records.remedy: The double belt buckle must be replaced in all affected vehicles.

records.concern: CRACKS MAY FORM ON HOUSING OF THE HIGH-PRESSURE SIDE OF THE GAS PRESSURE REGULATOR
records.defect: The natural gas regulator may develop a crack
records.remedy: Replace the gas regulator on affected vehicles

records.concern: THE DRIVEN REAR AXLE WISHBONE ON AFFECTED VEHICLES CAN CRACK
records.defect: The driven rear axle wishbone on affected vehicles can crack
records.remedy: Check affected vehicles. Change wishbone if necessary

records.concern: WATER CAN ACCUMULATE IN THE BOWDEN CABLES FOR THE THROTTLE VALVE
records.defect: Water can accumulate in the Bowden cables for the throttle valve during intensive cleaning or longer rainy trips.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles the Bowden cables and the Bowden cable holder on the gas handle will be replaced.

records.concern: THE TRANSFER CASE CONTAINS A DUAL DRIVE GEAR WHICH MAY HAVE BEEN INSTALLED IN AN INCORRECT ORIENTATION
records.defect: The transfer case contains a dual drive gear which may have been installed in an incorrect orientation.
records.remedy: Replace the transfer case.

records.concern: FAULTY PARAMETERIZATION OF EXHAUST GAS AFTERTREATMENT CONTROL UNIT
records.defect: Affected vehicles have a faulty parameterization of the �exhaust gas aftertreatment� control unit.
records.remedy: Programming update on the engine control unit.

records.concern: CONNECTING SCREWS ON THE ELECTRIC DRIVE MAY BE MISSING
records.defect: Connecting screws on the electric drive may be missing in certain eVito vehicles.
records.remedy: Check affected vehicles for missing screws on the drive unit. Should at least one of the screws be missing replace the front drive module.

records.concern: IT CANNOT BE GUARANTEED THAT A TIE DOWN EYE WILL NOT BECOME MECHANICALLY OVERLOADED WHEN TIGHTENING A TENSIONING STRAP/CHAIN
records.defect: It is possible that qualitatively defective tie-down eyes may have been installed on the body platform of these vehicles
records.remedy: Replace the tie-down eyes on the potentially affected vehicles

records.concern: ENGINE WIRING LOOM MAY TOUCH A STUD ON THE TRANSMISSION HOUSING
records.defect: Engine wiring loom may touch a stud on the transmission housing
records.remedy: Transmission stud to be replaced with a bolt and rerouting of the wiring loom

records.concern: THE ELECTRIC PARKING BRAKE CAN BE UNINTENTIONALLY RELEASED WHEN DISENGAGING THE CLUTCH PEDAL
records.defect: The electric parking brake can be unintentionally released when disengaging the clutch pedal.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the brake control unit has to be recoded

records.concern: THE DRIVE CLUTCH STATIONARY SHEAVE MAY HAVE BEEN MANUFACTURED INCORRECTLY
records.defect: Some 2020 RANGER XP 1000 and RANGER Diesel vehicles may have been produced with a drive clutch stationary sheave that was manufactured incorrectly.
records.remedy: Inspect and measure drive clutch components. Replace the EBS sleeve if required.

records.concern: CRACKS MAY APPEAR AROUND THE REAR LEAF SPRING BUSH EYE
records.defect: Cracks may appear around the rear leaf spring bush eye.
records.remedy: Replace the rear leaf springs and handbrake cable.

records.concern: THE TRANSMISSION MAY EXPERIENCE A BUILD UP OF PRESSURE AND HEAT INSIDE THE TRANSMISSION
records.defect: Expelled transmission fluid may come in contact with the turbocharger or other ignition sources within the engine compartment and lead to a vehicle fire
records.remedy: Replace the transmission valve body separator plate and reprogram the Powertrain Control Module.

records.concern: THE OCCUPANT RESTRAINT CONTROL MODULE (ORC) MAY INADVERTENTLY DEPLOY THE AIRBAGS AND/OR SEAT BELT PRETENSIONERS
records.defect: The Occupant Restraint Control (ORC) module may inadvertently deploy the airbags and/or seat belt pretensioners
records.remedy: Replace the ORC module

records.concern: THE FOLDABLE REAR CENTRE HEAD RESTRAINT INTERLOCK WAS NOT WELDED ACCORDING TO SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: The rear center head restraint interlock was not welded according to specification.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the center rear head restraint will be replaced.

records.concern: A MISROUTED FRONT BRAKE HOSE MAY DAMAGE IGNITION SWITCH WIRING
records.defect: A misrouted front brake hose may damage ignition switch wiring.
records.remedy: Check the hose and cable routing repair as necessary.

records.concern: INCORRECT HEAT SHRINK TUBING ON THE BATTERY POSITIVE CABLE TERMINAL/HARNESS
records.defect: Incorrect heat shrink tubing on the battery positive cable terminal/harness connected to the fuse board.
records.remedy: Check and rectify the heat shrink tubing on the cable terminal/harness if necessary.

records.concern: THE MATERIAL COMPOSITION OF THE GAS SYSTEM HIGH PRESSURE REGULATOR IS OUT OF SPECIFICATION
records.defect: The material composition of the gas system high pressure regulator has been found to be outside of specification.
records.remedy: Check the component serial number and renew the high pressure regulator if it is in the defined batch of defective components.

records.concern: MALFUNCTION IN THE HEAT EXCHANGER FOR THE LNG FUEL TANK HEATING
records.defect: Malfunctions in the heat exchanger for the LNG fuel tank heating may result in very cold liquefied gas reaching components that are not designed to withstand such low temperatures.
records.remedy: Carry out a software update to Engine and Gas Management systems creating control measures and a warning light in the event of a fault occurring.

records.concern: THE HEAD RESTRAINTS OF THE LUXURY BENCH SEATS IN THE REAR MAY HAVE BEEN INSTALLED INCORRECTLY
records.defect: Bench seats in the rear may have been installed with the head restraint bars of a different bench seat and/or head restraint variant.
records.remedy: Check the head restraints in the rear area in the affected vehicles and replace if necessary.

records.concern: THE HEAD RESTRAINT PADDING MAY SEPARATE FROM THE FASTENING RODS
records.defect: The head restraint padding may separate from the fastening rod.
records.remedy: Replace the head restraints on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: THE ELECTRIC MOTOR ELECTRONICS PRINTED CIRCUIT BOARD WAS NOT MANUFACTURED ACCORDING TO THE SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: The Electric Motor Electronics (EME) printed circuit board was not manufactured according to specifications
records.remedy: The Electric Motor Electronics (EME) of vehicles affected will be replaced.

records.concern: THE GEAR POSITION SWITCH MAY PROVIDE AN INACCURATE SIGNAL
records.defect: The gear position switch may provide an inaccurate signal.
records.remedy: Replace the gear position switch on impacted models

records.concern: DURING ASSEMBLY THE ENGINE OUTPUT SHAFT BEARING MAY NOT HAVE HAD ADEQUATE INITIAL LUBRICATION
records.defect: The engine output shaft bearing may not have had adequate initial lubrication during assembly
records.remedy: Disassemble and apply required lubricant in the engine output shaft housing

records.concern: THE BRAKE MECHANISM SUPPORT COULD BREAK AND CAUSE TOTAL LOSS OF BRAKING CAPACITY
records.defect: The brake pedal mount could break during an emergency stop and cause a total loss of braking capacity.
records.remedy: Install a bracket to secure the brake mechanism to the rear footrest support.

records.concern: THE STEERING GEAR TIE ROD MAY NOT HAVE BEEN ASSEMBLED WITH THE REQUIRED SPHERICAL WASHER
records.defect: The steering gear tie rod may not have been assembled with a required spherical washer
records.remedy: Both steering gear tie rods will be checked and if affected tie rod/s and accompanying swivel bearing/s will be replaced

records.concern: POSSIBLE MATERIAL NONCONFORMITY OF THE BRAKE LINE
records.defect: A possible material nonconformity of the rear brake line
records.remedy: Replace the brake line leading from the rear brake caliper to the ABS modulator.

records.concern: THE REAR LOWER SHOCK ABSORBER MOUNTING BOLT MAY NOT BE TIGHTENED TO THE CORRECT TORQUE SETTING
records.defect: The rear lower shock absorber mounting bolt might not be tightened to the correct torque setting
records.remedy: The campaign requires the bolt to be loosened and re-torqued to the correct setting

records.concern: THE FIXINGS OF THE HIGH LEVEL 3RD BRAKE LIGHT COULD COME LOOSE
records.defect: The 3rd brake light may not be correctly secured to the vehicle.
records.remedy: Connections of the 3rd brake light will be reworked new nuts will be fitted with thread locking agent applied to the threads to prevent them coming loose.

records.concern: THE TIGHTENING OF THE REAR SUSPENSION FIXINGS MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION
records.defect: The tightening of some rear suspension fixings may not be correct to specification
records.remedy: Correcting some tightening torques and replacing some nuts and bolts.

records.concern: POSSIBLE NON CONFORMITY OF SEALS IN FRONT WHEEL ARCHES COULD LEAD TO WATER INGRESS INTO CERTAIN ELECTRONIC UNITS
records.defect: Possible non-conformity of certain seals in the front wheel arches could lead to water ingress into the passenger compartment.
records.remedy: Resealing these areas checking for the presence of water in the passenger compartment and replacing certain components in the interior if required

records.concern: ONE OR MORE FIXATIONS OF THE SEATBELTS LOWER BOLTS MAY NOT BE TIGHTENED CORRECTLY
records.defect: The tightening and positioning of the seat belt lower bolts may be incorrect.
records.remedy: This campaign consists of checking and if necessary correcting both the position of the bolt and the tightening torque of all of the lower fixings of the seat belts.

records.concern: ONE OR MORE FIXATIONS OF THE SEATBELTS AND ONE GROUND CABLE MAY NOT BE TIGHTENED CORRECTLY
records.defect: The tightening of the seat belt fixings and of certain earth cables may not conform to specification.
records.remedy: Tightening of the seat belt fixings and of certain earth cables

records.concern: NON-CONFORMITY OF THE REAR BRAKE CALLIPERS
records.defect: A non-conformity of the rear brake callipers could reduce the efficiency of the parking brake
records.remedy: Check and if necessary replace the callipers.

records.concern: FUEL TUBES UNDER BODY MAY BECOME DAMAGED OVER TIME
records.defect: The fuel pipes under the body may have been damaged over time due to a relative movement between these pipes and their surroundings
records.remedy: Check the condition of the fuel pipes and replacing them if necessary. New protection will be fitted on all vehicles to prevent this damage in the future.

records.concern: THE REAR BRAKE HOSES MAY HAVE BEEN DAMAGED DUE TO MOVEMENT BETWEEN THESE HOSES AND A CLIP
records.defect: The rear brake hoses may have been damaged over time due to inappropriate movement between these hoses and a clip.
records.remedy: Check the condition of the rear left-hand and right-hand brake hoses and replacing them if necessary. A new retaining clip is fitted on all vehicles to prevent this relative movement.

records.concern: THERE MAY BE INCREASED PEDAL TRAVEL AS A RESULT OF PRODUCTION TOLERANCES
records.defect: There may be increased pedal travel as a result of production tolerances
records.remedy: The brake calliper housing (with actuator motor) must be replaced on the vehicles affected

records.concern: THE REAR BRAKE HOSE MAY BECOME DAMAGED OVER TIME DUE TO MOVEMENT BETWEEN THE HOSE AND HOLDING CLIP
records.defect: There is a possibility that the rear brake hose may become damaged due to relative movement between the hose and the holding clip.
records.remedy: Check the condition of the left and right rear brake hoses and replace them if necessary.

records.concern: TIGHTENING OF REAR SUSPENSION FIXINGS MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION
records.defect: The tightening of some rear suspension fixings may not be correct to specification.
records.remedy: Correcting some tightening torques and replacing some nuts and bolts.

records.concern: POSSIBLE NON CONFORMITY OF SEALS IN FRONT WHEEL ARCHES COULD LEAD TO WATER INGRESS INTO CERTAIN ELECTRONIC UNITS
records.defect: Possible non-conformity of certain seals in the front wheel arches could lead to water ingress into the passenger compartment.
records.remedy: Resealing these areas checking for the presence of water in the passenger compartment and replacing certain components in the interior if required.

records.concern: ONE OR MORE FIXATIONS OF THE SEATBELTS LOWER BOLTS MAY NOT BE TIGHTENED CORRECTLY
records.defect: The tightening and positioning of the seat belt lower bolts may be incorrect.
records.remedy: This campaign consists of checking and if necessary correcting both the position of the bolt and the tightening torque of all of the lower fixings of the seat belts.

records.concern: ONE OR MORE FIXATIONS OF THE SEATBELTS AND ONE GROUND CABLE MAY NOT BE TIGHTENED CORRECTLY
records.defect: The tightening of the seat belt fixings and of certain earth cables may not conform to specification
records.remedy: Tightening of the seat belt fixings and of certain earth cables.

records.concern: NON-CONFORMITY OF THE REAR BRAKE CALIPERS
records.defect: A non-conformity of the rear brake callipers could reduce the efficiency of the parking brake.
records.remedy: Check and if necessary replace the callipers

records.concern: FUEL TUBES UNDER BODY MAY BECOME DAMAGED OVER TIME
records.defect: The fuel pipes under the body may have been damaged over time due to a relative movement between these pipes and their surroundings.
records.remedy: Check the condition of the fuel pipes and replacing them if necessary. New protection will be fitted on all vehicles to prevent this damage in the future.

records.concern: THE REAR BRAKE HOSES MAY HAVE BEEN DAMAGED DUE TO MOVEMENT BETWEEN THESE HOSES AND A CLIP
records.defect: The rear brake hoses may have been damaged over time due to inappropriate movement between these hoses and a clip.
records.remedy: Check the condition of the rear left-hand and right-hand brake hoses and replacing them if necessary. A new retaining clip is fitted on all vehicles to prevent this relative movement.

records.concern: THE BRAKE SERVO PULL ROD BALL COUPLING MAY HAVE BEEN PUT INTO THE MOUNTING OF THE BRAKE PEDAL INCORRECTLY
records.defect: The ball coupling of the push rod of the electromechanical brake servo may have been wrongly slotted into the mounting on the brake pedal.
records.remedy: Check the ball coupling into the mounting of the brake pedal. If the ball coupling is incorrectly slotted in the brake servo and mounting in the brake pedal must be replaced.

records.concern: IN THE EVENT OF AN ACCIDENT THE FUEL TANK COULD BE DAMAGED AND LEAK
records.defect: The fuel tank could be damaged and leak in the event of an accident.
records.remedy: A component protector must be fitted to a bracket on the body of the vehicles affected.

records.concern: THE E-CALL FUNCTION MAY NOT WORK CORRECTLY
records.defect: Due to a fault of the software of the OCU control unit (Online Connectivity Unit) the e-call function may work incorrectly.
records.remedy: An update of the software of the OCU control unit has to be carried out.

records.concern: THE CURRENT ENGINE CONTROL UNIT CALIBRATION MAY PREVENT THE THROTTLE PLATES FROM RETURNING TO IDLE POSITION
records.defect: Engine Control Unit (ECU) calibration may prevent the throttle plates from returning to idle position after an engine stalling.
records.remedy: Updating ECU calibrations of the affected vehicles.

records.concern: THIRD ROW SEAT BELT PILLAR D-LOOP UPPER ANCHORAGES MAY NOT FULFILL LEGAL REQUIREMENTS
records.defect: The third row seat belt pillar D-loop upper anchorages may not fulfil the legal load requirements
records.remedy: Replace the existing 14x26 mm bolt used to attach the seat belt D-loop with a 14x40mm bolt.

records.concern: AUTOMATIC EMERGENCY BRAKING SYSTEM WILL NOT OPERATE BETWEEN 10 AND 40 DEG C
records.defect: Under abnormal operation the AEB (Automatic Emergency Braking) feature will not operate between 10 to 40 deg C.
records.remedy: Install a software improvement.

records.concern: THE REAR SPOILER ATTACHED TO THE TOP EDGE OF THE TAILGATE ADJOINING THE REAR OF THE ROO CAN BE INADEQUATELY BONDED ON THE RIGHT HAND SIDE
records.defect: The rear spoiler attached to the top edge of the tailgate adjoining the rear of the roof can be inadequately bonded on the Right Hand side
records.remedy: Check for correct adhesion and replace if faulty

records.concern: ONE OR BOTH LED DAYTIME RUNNING LAMPS MAY FLICKER FLASH OR FAIL COMPLETELY
records.defect: One or both LED daytime Running Lamps may flicker flash or fail completely.
records.remedy: Replace sealing gaskets and install gas absorbing sheets on affected units that operate normally. Replace any faulty units.

records.concern: THE DATA VERSION OF THE ENGINE CONTROL UNIT MUST BE UPDATED TO IMPROVE THE NITROGEN OXIDE EMISSIONS
records.defect: The affected vehicle may not meet prescribed emission limits.
records.remedy: The engine control unit must be updated in order to improve the engine control system.

records.concern: THE STOP SCREWS FOR THE PIN BETWEEN THE FIFTH WHEEL PLATE AND PEDESTAL MIGHT BE MISSING
records.defect: The stop screws for the pin between the fifth wheel plate and pedestal might be missing.
records.remedy: Fit the stop screws where required

records.concern: THE INSTRMENT CLUSTER MAY BECOME NON-OPERATIONAL.
records.defect: The instrument cluster may become non-operational
records.remedy: Reprogram the instrument cluster

records.concern: VEHICLES MAY HAVE BEEN FITTED WITH THE INCORRECT TWIN BATTERY POSITIVE CABLE
records.defect: Vehicles may have been fitted with the wrong twin battery positive cable.
records.remedy: Inspect affected vehicles install a new twin battery cable and correct the cable routing if the concern is identified.

records.concern: THE ELECTRIC CHILD LOCK MAY NOT BE MECHANICALLY LOCKED ALTHOUGH SWITCHED ON BY DRIVER
records.defect: Under very specific conditions the electric child lock is not mechanically locked although it has been switched on by the driver.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the software of the on-board supply control unit has to be reconfigured.

records.concern: THE ENGINE OIL MAY POSSIBLY REACH THE BRAKE SERVO THROUGH THE VACUUM HOSE
records.defect: It is possible that engine oil reaches the brake servo through the vacuum hose from the tandem pump to the brake servo.
records.remedy: The vacuum line from the tandem pump is replaced. It must also be checked whether other components have come into contact with oil and therefore need to be replaced too.

records.concern: BOLTED CONNECTION BETWEEN STEERING SHAFT AND STEERING RACK MAY LOOSEN
records.defect: The bolted connection between the steering shaft and the steering rack may not have been tightened to the correct torque.
records.remedy: The bolted connection of the intermediate steering shaft has to be replaced

records.concern: BOLTED CONNECTION BETWEEN STEERING SHAFT AND STEERING RACK MAY COME LOOSE
records.defect: The bolted connection between the steering shaft and the steering rack may not have been tightened to the required torque
records.remedy: The bolted connection between the steering shaft and the steering rack will be checked and if necessary replaced.

records.concern: VEHICLES WITH AN INTEGRATED BACKUP BATTERY HAVE BEEN DELIVERED WITHOUT A SEAT BASE COVER
records.defect: Vehicles fitted with an auxiliary battery installed under the right front seat may have been delivered without a seat base cover
records.remedy: Retro-fit the seat box cover to the affected vehicles

records.concern: CRYSTALLIZATION IN SILENCER AND ACTIVE MIL WITH ENGINE DERATE
records.defect: Crystallization in silencer and active MIL with engine derate.
records.remedy: Update EMS and ACM software.

records.concern: THE FINAL PART OF THE VEHICLE VERSION DISPLAYED ON THE MANUFACTURER LABEL ON THE A PILLAR CONTAINS INCORRECT VERSION INFORMATION
records.defect: Incorrect sticker shows data M1561F4 5W correct version is M1561F 4APD.
records.remedy: Replacement of the sticker label.

records.concern: SOFTWARE ISSUE MEANS THAT AUTOMATIC EMERGENCY BRAKE SYSTEM MAY NOT ENGAGE
records.defect: The Automatic Emergency Brake System a function of the IntelliSafe system may not always engage increasing the risk of a collision
records.remedy: Affected vehicles must have new software downloaded

records.concern: ONE OF THE NUTS SECURING THE BRAKE BOOSTER TO THE FIREWALL IS MISSING.
records.defect: On affected vehicles one of the nuts securing the brake booster to the firewall is missing
records.remedy: Fit the missing nut.

records.concern: OIL MAY GET INTO THE BRAKE SERVO THROUGH THE VACUUM LINES OF THE TANDEM PUMP.
records.defect: Oil may get into the brake servo through the vacuum lines of the tandem pump leading to a loss of braking assistance.
records.remedy: Replace the vacuum line from the tandem pump. Check other components for oil and replace if necessary.

records.concern: IN THE EVENT OF DEPLOYMENT THE AIR BAG MAY NOT INFLATE PROPERLY

records.remedy: Check and replace the seat frame if a crack is found.

records.concern: THE INCORRECT UPPER CONTROL ARM HAS BEEN ASSEMBLED ON THE LEFT SIDE
records.defect: The incorrect upper control arm has been assembled on the left side.
records.remedy: The correct upper control arm is to be installed

records.concern: THE HANDBRAKE CABLE STOPPER MAY HAVE BEEN INCORRECTLY MANUFACTURED
records.defect: The hand brake cable stopper may have been incorrectly formed in production and may fail.
records.remedy: Replace the handbrake cable and bracket with countermeasure parts

records.concern: POSSIBLE CRACKS IN LEFT FRONT SEATS
records.defect: There is a possibility that due to a fault in the production process there is a crack on the frame of the left front seat.
records.remedy: Check and replace the seat frame if a crack is found

records.concern: A WELDING STUD ON THE MAIN FLOOR MAY BE INCORRECTLY WELDED
records.defect: A welding stud on the main floor may not have been welded correctly
records.remedy: The vehicles will be recalled and the affecting welding stud sealed

records.concern: ROOF LID FRONT LOCK DOWN STUDS MAY DE-LAMINATE FROM THE UNDERSIDE

records.remedy: Removal of the 2 existing lockdown studs laminated to the underside of the roof and replaced with tie-down studs.

records.concern: RUPTURED FLEXIBLE FRONT BRAKE HOSES MAY OCCUR DURING SUSPENSION AND STEERING ARTICULATIONS
records.defect: Ruptured flexible front brake hoses may occur from cyclic fatigue.
records.remedy: Replace the front brake hoses with a redesigned component.

records.concern: IT IS POSSIBLE THAT THE LATCHING CONNECTION ON THE WHEEL HOUSING LINER MAY FAIL.
records.defect: It is possible that the latching connection on the wheel housing liner may fail.
records.remedy: The wheel arch covers on the affected vehicles must be fixed in place with an additional bolt.

records.concern: SIDE STEP SHADE RIVETS MAY CORRODE AND FRACTURE
records.defect: Corrosion of fixing rivets can lead to the side step shade becoming insecure
records.remedy: Change the 12 aluminium rivets to M8 bolts and nuts

records.concern: A NUMBER OF NO COATING CATALSYER EXHAUST PIPES MANUFACTURED FOR TESTING PURPOSES ONLY WERE MIXED WITH MASS PRODUCTION PARTS
records.defect: Exhaust Catalyser coating missing
records.remedy: Affected units will be inspected and the exhaust pipe replaced with a new part.

records.concern: POSSIBLE FUEL LEAK FROM TANK
records.defect: Possible Fuel leak from tank
records.remedy: Check the date of manufacture of the fuel tank and change it if necessary

records.concern: FUEL TANK MAY NOT MEET REQUIRED MATERIAL WALL THICKNESS
records.defect: A fuel tank that may not meet required material wall thickness specification
records.remedy: Check and replace the fuel tank if necessary

records.concern: POSSIBLE CRACK ON THE FRAME OF THE LEFT FRONT SEAT
records.defect: There is a possibility that due to a fault in the production process there is a crack on the frame of the left front seat.
records.remedy: Check and replace the seat frame if a crack is found.

records.concern: REAR SPOILER TO BOOT LID MAY NOT BE ATTACHED SECURELY
records.defect: Vehicles may not have had the rear spoiler properly attached
records.remedy: The screw connection of the rear spoiler will be inspected and if necessary screws installed.

records.concern: INTERNAL MALFUNCTION OF THE CONTROL UNIT
records.defect: Internal malfunction of the air bag control unit
records.remedy: Replacement of the air bag control unit

records.concern: FASTENING NUTS TO SECURE THE DRIVE SHAFT AND WHEEL HUB ON THE REAR AXLE ARE INCORRECTLY COATED
records.defect: Incorrectly coated nuts were used to secure the drive shaft and wheel hub on the rear axle.
records.remedy: Replace the fastening nuts and torque to specification.

records.concern: THE REAR END IMPACT LIMITER MIGHT NOT HAVE BEEN INSTALLED IN PRODUCTION
records.defect: The rear end impact limiter might not have been installed in production.
records.remedy: Check if the rear end impact limiter is present and install one if required.

records.concern: THE ELECTRICAL POWER STEERING WIRING HARNESS CAN BECOME TRAPPED AT THE FRONT AXLE ASSEMBLY
records.defect: The electrical power steering wiring may have been damaged during assembly.
records.remedy: Inspect and if damaged replace harness

records.concern: THE CENTRE CONSOLE SWITCHPACK COULD SUFFER LOSS OF SPECIFIC FUNCTIONS
records.defect: Hazard warning and vehicle demisters may become inoperable
records.remedy: Install a software update to the centre console switch pack

records.concern: DEGRADE OF EMISSIONS CONTROL COMPONENT
records.defect: Premature degradation of emission control component
records.remedy: Check and If found then replacement of Silencer.

records.concern: A COMPONENT SECURING SEAT RAIL FOR FRONT PASSENGER SEAT MAY BE IMPAIRED
records.defect: The rigidity of a component securing the seat rail for the front passenger seat may be impaired
records.remedy: Both guide rails for the front passenger seat must be replaced on the vehicles affected

records.concern: MOVEMENTS OF THE CONNECTOR OF THE BLOWER REGULATOR WIRING HARNESS COULD LEAD TO FRICTIONAL CORROSION
records.defect: The blower regulator wiring could be damaged increasing the risk of fire.
records.remedy: The connection of the blower-regulator will be checked and reworked and if necessary the blower regulator will be replaced.

records.concern: POSSIBILITY OF FUEL SPRAYING OUT OF THE FILLER PLUG WHEN OPENING.

records.concern: THROTTLE MAY STICK
records.defect: Throttle may stick due to a defective bush.

records.concern: THE U BOLT SECURING THE RIGHT HAND REAR LEAF SPRING MAY BE INCORRECTLY FASTENED
records.defect: The rear axle U-bolts may not be fastened according to specification.
records.remedy: Check the tightening torque of the rear axle U-bolts and replace where incorrect

records.concern: THE RIGHT SIDE OF DRIVE SHAFT MAY FAIL
records.defect: Drive shaft may fail.
records.remedy: Replace the right hand drive shaft

records.concern: BLIND SPOT DETECTION SYSTEM HAS BEEN MARKED WITH INCORRECT ECE CERTIFICATION LABELLING
records.defect: Blind spot detection system has been marked with the wrong ECE certification labelling.

records.concern: THE BODY CONTROL MODULE SOFTWARE MAY ALLOW THE ENGINE STOP START SYSTEM TO OPERATE OUTSIDE OF THE EMISSIONS CERTIFICATION
records.defect: The body control module software may allow engine stop start behaviour that was not part of the emissions certification.
records.remedy: Update the body control module software.

records.concern: FUEL LEAKAGE MAY OCCUR FROM THE FUEL TANK
records.defect: Due to a non-conformity in production fuel leakage may occur from the fuel tank

records.concern: FIRST GEAR COULD BE ENGAGED WHILST THE VEHICLE IS IN MOTION AND THE SHIFT LEVER IN THE D POSITION
records.defect: First gear could be engaged with the vehicle in motion and the shift lever in the D position.

records.concern: IMPROPER MATERIAL USED IN REAR BRAKE LIGHTS SWITCH COULD RESULT IN CORROSION
records.defect: Improper material for the internal parts of the rear brake light switch can result in corrosion.
records.remedy: Replacement of the brake light switch.

records.concern: AN INCORRECT INSTALLATION OF THE HEAD AIRBAGS ON DRIVER AND PASSENGER SIDE WOULD RESULT IN AN INCOMPLETE INFLATION
records.defect: Driver and passenger side head airbags may have been twisted on installation

records.concern: THE HIGH BEAM CANNOT BE DEACTIVATED BY USING THE HIGH BEAM LEVER
records.defect: Main beam not deactivating automatically with 'High-Beam Assist'
records.remedy: Update the software for the signal acquisition and actuation module on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: A CENTRALISING SLEEVE MAY NOT HAVE BEEN INSTALLED BETWEEN THE AUTOMATIC TRANSMISION AND THE DIRECT SHIFT MODULE
records.defect: Automatic transmission Direct Shift Module fault. Vehicle may roll away or drive in a direction not intended.

records.concern: THE MOUNTING BOLTS OF THE TURBOCHARGER OIL RETURN LINE AND THE CRANK CASE VENTILATION LINE MIGHT HAVE BEEN INTERCHANGED
records.defect: The mounting bolts of the turbocharger oil return line might have been interchanged

records.concern: THE PANORAMIC GLASS ROOF DEFLECTOR MAY NOT BE SECURED CORRECTLY
records.defect: The panoramic roof deflector may not be secured correctly.
records.remedy: Inspect and repair the panoramic roof deflector as necessary.

records.concern: THE FUEL PIPE FROM THE EXTERNAL FUEL PUMP ON THE LEFT HAND SIDE CAN SHOW SIGNS OF DETERIORATION AND SPLITTING
records.defect: Fuel pipe deteriation
records.remedy: The fuel pipes affected are to be replaced

records.concern: REAR BENCH SEATBELT BUCKLE BOLTS MAY NOT BE CORRECTLY TIGHTENED
records.defect: Rear bench seatbelt buckle bolts may not be correctly tightened.
records.remedy: Check the buckle bolts are at the correct torque.

records.concern: POTENTIAL RISK OF FAILURE TO THE SECONDARY PARKING BRAKE
records.defect: Possible failure of the parking brake due to a non-conformity (crimping) at cable connection ends.
records.remedy: Replace the secondary cables and connectors.

records.concern: REAR SPRING BOLT COULD FRACTURE AND MIGRATE
records.defect: The rear suspension spring locating bolt could fail and migrate.
records.remedy: Fitment of an anti-migration bracket.

records.concern: INCORRECTLY SHAPED RIVET HOLES FOR THE FIXTURE BETWEEN THE MOVEABLE DRIVEN FACE COMPONENTS
records.defect: Clutch may not be to specification
records.remedy: Replace the clutch and cover plate

records.concern: THE MAXIMUM PERMISSIBLE ROOF LOAD OF 150 KG IS NOT DOCUMENTED IN THE OPERATING MANUAL
records.defect: The maximum permissible roof load is not documented in the operating manual
records.remedy: The vehicle operating manuals are to be exchanged. For all vehicles with canopies installed the corresponding accessory operating manual will also be exchanged

records.concern: NON-CONFORMITY IN THE AIR BAG CONTROL MODULE SOFTWARE
records.defect: Non-conformity in the airbag control module software
records.remedy: Update the airbag control module software

records.concern: INCORRECT MOUNTING INSTRUCTIONS SUPPLIED FOR RETROFITTING A TRAILER COUPLING
records.defect: Incorrect specified tightening torque for the mounting screws of a cross member to be installed in conjunction with towbar fitment.
records.remedy: Mounting bolts on the trailer coupling are to be replaced if already fitted. Instructions to be updated on supplied kits.

records.concern: ELECTRICAL FRAME WIRING HARNESS
records.defect: Damage may occur at the electrical frame wiring harness along the right longitudinal frame member.
records.remedy: Check the wiring harness and repair as necessary.

records.concern: OVERHEATING OF THE ENGINE CYLINDER HEAD MAY CAUSE THE CYLINDER HEAD TO CRACK
records.defect: localized overheating of the engine cylinder head may cause the cylinder head to crack.This may cause a pressurized oil leak which in extreme circumstances could result in a fire in the engine compartment.
records.remedy: A coolant level sensor needs to be fitted to provide an audible and visual warning to the customer and in extreme circumstances reduce the engine power.

records.concern: ELECTRICAL POWER STEERING WIRE COULD BECOME TRAPPED BETWEEN THE CROSS BEAM AND UNDERFLOOR COVER
records.defect: The electric power steering harness could become trapped and damaged.
records.remedy: Check and replace the electric power steering harness if necessary.

records.concern: UNINTENDED ACTIVATION OF THE SIDE AIR BAG CURTAIN AIR BAG AND SEAT PRE TENSIONER MAY OCCUR WHEN REAR DOOR IS SLAMMED SHUT.
records.defect: Unintended activation of side and curtain air bags and seat belt pre-tensioner.
records.remedy: Software update to Airbag Controle Module.

records.concern: EXHAUST VALUE SOLENOID WIRING MAY SHORT CIRCUIT
records.defect: Exhaust value solenoid wiring may short circuit due to contact on the exhaust.
records.remedy: Fit a protective sleeve to the wiring.

records.concern: POTENTIAL INCORRECT TIGHTENING OF FRONT LUGGAGE COMPARTMENT (BONNET) BOLTS
records.defect: Incorrect tightening of front luggage compartment (bonnet) bolts. Extreme risk front luggage compartment may open when driving.
records.remedy: Check and if required correct the torque of the front luggage compartment bolts.

records.concern: FRAME BREAKAGE TOWARDS FRONT SECTION OF THE MOTORCYCLE
records.defect: Possible weak points in the frame that under certain conditions could fail.
records.remedy: Replace affected vehicles.

records.concern: REDUCTION IN BRAKING POWER WHERE THE BRAKE PEDAL IS APPLIED SLOWLY AND CONSTANTLY
records.defect: Potential for a reduction in braking power where the brake pedal is applied slowly and constantly.
records.remedy: Replacement of hydraulic brake and clutch system components.

records.concern: A CRACK COULD DEVELOP ON THE INSULATION OF THE WIRE HARNESSES OF THE FRONT SEAT SIDE AIRBAG SENSORS
records.defect: The front seat side airbags could be deactivated and/or the curtain airbags may not operate as intended.
records.remedy: Inspect the front door wire harness and replace if necessary.

records.concern: OIL PASSAGE HOLES IN THE OIL FILTER HOUSING MAY BE INCORRECTLY MACHINED
records.defect: There is a possibility that the oil passage holes in the oil filter housing have not been correctly machined.
records.remedy: If the oil passage holes have not been correctly machined the engine assembly will be replaced.

records.concern: WATER MAY ENTER THE HIGH VOLTAGE BATTERY
records.defect: Water ingress into the high- voltage battery potentially causing a short circuit and risk of fire.
records.remedy: Permanent solution being developed. Owners offered an alternative vehicle until solution availible if required.

records.concern: A POSSIBLE NON- CONFORMITY OF THE AIR BAG AND THE SEAT BELT PRETENSIONERS ELECTRONIC CONTROL UNIT
records.defect: Non-conformity of the air bag and seatbelt pre-tensioner ECU.

records.concern: THE LOCKING MECHANISM IN THE HINGED TOWING BRACKET COULD BE FAULTY
records.defect: Hinged towing bracket on which the locking mechanism in the hinge module could be faulty.

records.concern: TOW BAR WITH A POSSIBLE DEFECTIVE LOCKING MECHANISM MAY HAVE BEEN FITTED
records.defect: A tow bar with a possible defective locking mechanism in the swivelling module.
records.remedy: The affected tow bar has to be checked and if necessary the swivelling module of the tow bar replaced.

records.concern: FRONT SPRING MAY BREAK
records.defect: Front spring may fail allowing excess axle movement.
records.remedy: Fitting of an axle catcher bracket and bush to limit movement.

records.concern: CORROSION COULD OCCUR WITHIN THE UNANODIZED CALLIPER PISTON BORE
records.defect: Corrosion on the surface of the calliper could impair the piston's clearance within the bore.

records.concern: THE OCCUPANT RESTRAINT CONTROLLER (ORC) SPECIAL FEATURES / FUNCTION CONFIGURATION MEMORY MAY BE INCORRECTLY UPDATED WHEN CERTAIN DIAGNOSTIC SERVICE TOOLS ARE USED
records.defect: An incorrect update may inadvertently disable certain passive safety features.
records.remedy: Update the occupant restraint controller software..

records.concern: AIR BAG MAY NOT INFLATE QUICKLY ENOUGH ON DEPLOYMENT
records.defect: Driver�s airbag may not inflate quickly enough in case of its activation

records.concern: POTENTIAL MALFUNCTION OF THE A/C BLOWER CONTROL UNIT
records.defect: Possible short circuits in the heater blower control unit.
records.remedy: Inspect and where necessary replace the control unit.

records.concern: INNER PRESSURE OF THE INFLATOR MAY IRREGULARLY RISE UPON AIRBAG DEPLOYMENT RUPTURING THE INFLATOR CONTAINER
records.defect: Driver air bag may not ignite correctly.

records.concern: INSUFFICIENT CONNECTION OF FUEL SUPPLY PIPE CONNECTOR OF THE FUEL TANK

records.concern: LOSS OF PARKING BRAKE FUNCTION
records.defect: Incorrect crimping of the secondary parking brake cable ferrules.
records.remedy: Replacement of the secondary parking brake cables the adjuster and the adjustment nut.

records.concern: A REDUCTION OF CONTACT PRESSURE ON THE MAIN RELAYS CAUSES HEAT BUILD UP IN THE MAIN POWER RELAY ASSEMBLY.

records.concern: LOOSE CAB SIDE WINDOWS

records.defect: Turn signal hazard signal and high beam may not operate as designed.

records.defect: The steering intermediate shaft may contain a loose foreign nut in the cardan joint boot.

records.concern: THE BATTERY METAL CLAMPING BAR MAY COME INTO CONTACT WITH THE TERMINALS CREATING A SHORT CIRCUIT
records.defect: The leisure battery clamping bar may contact the battery terminals and cause a short circuit

records.concern: THE PRINTED CIRCUIT BOARD WAS NOT MANUFACTURED ACCORDING TO SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: The electric motor electronics are not manufactured to specification.

records.concern: THE FRONT WINDSCREEN WIPERS MAY BECOME INOPERABLE
records.defect: The front windscreen wipers may become inoperable due to a defect in the relay.

records.concern: THE ECE HOMOLOGATION NUMBER IS NOT PERMANENTLY MARKED ON THE VISOR
records.defect: The ECE homologation number is not permanently marked on the visor.

records.concern: LOSS OF ELECTRIC POWER STEERING ASSIST WHILST DRIVING

records.concern: THE PARKING BRAKE LEVER MIGHT NOT LOCK IN THE ENGAGED POSITION OR MIGHT DISENGAGE AFTER APPLICATION
records.defect: The parking brake lever might not lock in the engaged position or might disengage after application

records.concern: THE PARKING BRAKE LEVER MAY NOT LOCK OR MAY DISENGAGE AFTER APPLICATION

records.defect: Brake hose connection may crack and fail.

records.concern: THE EMERGENCY CALLING SYSTEM MAY NOT BE ENABLED

records.defect: The two conduits in the aftermarket Cafe Racer Fairing kits have insufficient clearance and may cause damage to the wiring

records.concern: THE ELECTRICAL CONTACT OF THE TAIL LAMPS MIGHT BE IMPAIRED
records.defect: The electrical contact of the tail lamps might be impaired.

records.concern: SOFTWARE UPDATE TO IMPROVE EMISSIONS

records.defect: The switches in certain seat belt buckles might not have been manufactured according to specifications.

records.concern: A PLASTIC COMPONENT INSIDE THE EXHAUST LINE COULD UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS DAMAGE THE DIESEL PARTICLE FILTER

records.concern: A REAR SUSPENSION LINK NUT AND SCREW MAY NOT HAVE BEEN CORRECTLY ASSEMBLED
records.defect: A rear suspension link nut and screw may not have been correctly assembled.

records.concern: THE BATTERY SURGE PROTECTOR COULD FAIL AND CAUSE A RISK OF FIRE.
records.defect: The battery surge protector could fail and cause a risk of fire.
