records.concern: VEHICLE COULD SUFFER CLUTCH PRESSURE PLATE FRACTURE
records.defect: A number of vehicles fitted with a 1.0 1.5 or 1.6 Ecoboost engine and 6-speed manual transmission could suffer clutch pressure plate fracture. This results in clutch smell reduced vehicle speed and performance. In the unlikely event of clutch pressure plate fracture a noise (thud / bang) could be heard from the vicinity of the transmission in extreme cases resulting in clutch / transmission fragments being released and striking under hood components creating a risk of smoke and fire from the under hood area.
records.remedy: To prevent the repeated heating /cooling events a new calibration has been developed for vehicles fitted with Engine Stop Start feature. The software with the additional feature sets the Instrument panel �Wrench light� and de-rates the engine performance if prolonged clutch slip is detected. The software feature includes a drive cycle strategy for latching the wrench light and engine performance de-rate if the customer should experience repeated clutch slip events. For vehicles that do not have Engine Stop Start feature an alternative clutch kit has been released.

records.concern: INCORRECTLY TORQUED LEFT HAND SEATBELT TO SEATBELT SHOULDER HEIGHT ADJUSTER BOLT
records.defect: An incorrectly torqued left hand seatbelt to seatbelt shoulder height adjuster bolt.
records.remedy: Replace the left hand seatbelt and shoulder height adjuster with new parts.

records.concern: THE FENDER BRACKET MAY CRACK AT THE WELDED STRUCTURE BETWEEN 1ST AND 2ND REAR AXLES
records.defect: The fender bracket may crack and become insecure at the welded structure between the rear axles.
records.remedy: Replace bracket with modified component.

records.concern: ENGINE OIL COOLER HOSES MAY SEPARATE FROM THEIR CLAMP JOINTS
records.defect: Risk of fire due to possible oil cooler pipes and fuel cap leaks.
records.remedy: Replacement of oil cooler pipes and fuel filler cap.

records.concern: IN THE SEAT AREA THERE MAY BE MINIMAL FUEL LEAKAGE
records.defect: There may be fuel leakage at the lower fitting insert of the fuel tank fairing.
records.remedy: Check for leaks replace tank if leak evidenced.If no leak evident fit a retrofit kit to prevent leaks occurring in the area.

records.concern: POSSIBLE LEAK MAY OCCUR IN THE FUEL LINE AT THE QUICK RELEASE CONNECTOR
records.defect: There is a possibility that a leak may occur in the fuel line.
records.remedy: Replacement of the fuel delivery line.

records.concern: REAR AXLE BRAKE PIPES MAY CHAFE ON THE PROPELLER SHAFT WHEN SUSPENSION IS AT IT'S LOWEST POSITION
records.defect: Air brake pipes could be damaged by propshaft.
records.remedy: Check and if required reposition repair or replace the brake pipes.

records.concern: THE ELECTRICAL WIRING HARNESS OF THE AIR BAG CONTROL UNIT MUST BE RELOCATED
records.defect: In severe collisions the electrical wiring harness of the airbag control unit could be damaged.
records.remedy: The electrical wiring harness of the airbag control unit must be relocated.

records.concern: THE ADJUSTED HANDBRAKE LEVER TRAVEL FOR PARKING CAN INCREASE
records.defect: Hand brake lever travel increase due to adjuster nut movement.
records.remedy: Re-adjust assembly and fit locking device to nut.

records.concern: THE ADJUSTED HANDBRAKE LEVER TRAVEL FOR PARKING THE VEHICLE CAN INCREASE
records.defect: Hand brake lever travel increase due to adjuster nut movement.
records.remedy: Re-adjust assembly and fit locking device to nut.

records.concern: INCORRECT ECU PARAMETERS OF THE INTAKE PRESSURE SENSOR VALUES
records.defect: Incorrect ECU parameters of the intake pressure sensor values may cause engine stall.
records.remedy: Affected units must have the ECU mapping reprogrammed with countermeasure software

records.concern: THE DURABILITY OF THE FINAL DRIVE BELT IS NOT RELIABLE ENOUGH
records.defect: The durability of the final drive belt is not reliable enough.
records.remedy: Affected units must have the final drive belt replaced by a countermeasure one.

records.concern: THE STEERING RACK ASSEMBLY MAY NOT BE CORRECT TO SPECIFICATION
records.defect: The steering rack assembly may not be correct to specification.
records.remedy: Replace the steering rack assembly and the fixings.

records.concern: THE STEERING RACK ASSEMBLY MAY NOT BE CORRECT TO SPECIFICATION
records.defect: The steering rack assembly may not be correct to specification.
records.remedy: Replace the steering rack assembly and the fixings.

records.concern: THE FIXING BOLT OF THE FRONT SUSPENSION WISHBONE MAY NOT BE CORRECT TO SPECIFICATION
records.defect: The fixing bolt of the front Suspension wishbone may not be correct to specification.
records.remedy: Replace the fixing bolts and nuts of the front suspension wishbones.

records.concern: THE FIXING BOLT OF THE FRONT SUSPENSION WISHBONE MAY NOT BE CORRECT TO SPECIFICATION
records.defect: The fixing bolt of the front Suspension wishbone may not be correct to specification.
records.remedy: Replace the fixing bolts and nuts of the front suspension wishbones.

records.concern: REAR SUSPENSION WISHBONE MOUNTING BOLTS NAY NOT BE CORRECT TO SPECIFICATION
records.defect: The rear suspension wishbone mountings bolts may not be correct to specification.
records.remedy: Replacement of the rear suspension wishbone bolts.

records.concern: THE REAR SUSPENSION WISHBONE MOUNTING BOLTS MAY NOT BE CORRECT TO SPECIFICATION
records.defect: The rear suspension wishbone mountings bolts may not be correct to specification.
records.remedy: Replacement of the rear suspension wishbone bolts.

records.concern: UNDER CERTAIN DRIVING CONDITIONS THE AIR CONDITIONING COMPRESSOR PULLEY COULD BREAK
records.defect: The air conditioning compressor pulley could break and damage other components.
records.remedy: Replace the air conditioning compressor pulley and if necessary the protective cover.

records.concern: UNDER CERTAIN DRIVING CONDITIONS THE AIR CONDITIONING COMPRESSOR PULLEY COULD BREAK
records.defect: The air conditioning compressor pulley could break and damage other components.
records.remedy: Replace the air conditioning compressor pulley and if necessary the protective cover.

records.concern: EXCESSIVE LOADING OF THE FRONT SUSPENSION COULD RESULT IN THE LOOSENING OF THE FRONT WISHBONE LOWER BALL JOINTS
records.defect: Excessive loading of the front suspension could result in the loosening of the front wishbone lower ball joints.
records.remedy: Increasing the tightening torque of the ball joint and adding thread lock to the ball joint threads if the ball joint threads are found to be rusty the ball joint will be replaced.

records.concern: EXCESSIVE LOADING OF FRONT SUSPENSION COULD RESULT IN THE LOOSENING OF THE FRONT WISHBONE LOWER BALL JOINTS
records.defect: Excessive loading of the front suspension could result in the loosening of the front wishbone lower ball joints.
records.remedy: Increasing the tightening torque of the ball joint and adding thread lock to the ball joint threads if the ball joint threads are found to be rusty the ball joint will be replaced.

records.concern: THE IDLER PULLEY BOLT COULD BECOME LOOSENED OVER TIME
records.defect: The power steering idler pulley may detach.
records.remedy: Replace the pulley securing bolt with an alternative component.

records.concern: THE BRAKE CALIPER BORE AREA MAY EXPERIENCE A BUILD UP OF CORROSION OVER TIME
records.defect: Brake pistons dragging in the caliper bores.
records.remedy: Replace the brake calipers.

records.concern: THE DIRECTIONAL INDICATORS FAIL TO OPERATE WHEN THE STEERING COLUMN MOUNTED CONTROL STALKS ARE USED
records.defect: The directional indicators may fail to operate.
records.remedy: Update the vehicle with the latest software on affected vehicles.

records.concern: CRANKSHAFT PULLEY RETAINING BOLT MAY FRACTURE
records.defect: The crankshaft pulley retaining bolt may fracture due to a production specification error.
records.remedy: Replace the crankshaft pulley centre retaining bolt with one that has been manufactured to the correct specification.

records.concern: THE AIRBAG CONTROL UNIT MAY DETECT A CRASH SIGNAL AND COMMAND DEPLOYMENT OR NON DEPLOYMENT OF THE AIRBAG
records.defect: The airbag may not deploy properly during a crash due to a programming issue
records.remedy: Upgrade the software in the Airbag Control Unit.

records.concern: TAKATA PASSENGER AIRBAG INFLATOR MAY RUPTURE
records.defect: Passenger airbag inflators may not operate as intended.
records.remedy: Replacement of Airbag Assembly on affected vehicles.

records.concern: TAKATA PASSENGER AIRBAG INFLATOR MAY RUPTURE
records.defect: Passenger airbag inflators may not operate as intended.
records.remedy: Replacement of Airbag Assembly on affected vehicles.

records.concern: SEATBELT MAY BECOME STUCK DUE TO INCORRECT FITTING OF THE REEL HOUSING
records.defect: Rear seatbelt may become stuck due to incorrect fitting of the reel housing.
records.remedy: Check the fitting of the seat belt inertia reel housings and adjust as required.

records.concern: THE CRANKSHAFT PULLEY RETAINING BOLT MAY FRACTURE
records.defect: The crankshaft pulley retaining bolt may fracture due to a production specification error.
records.remedy: Replace the crankshaft pulley centre retaining bolt with one that has been manufactured to the correct specification.

records.concern: THE LOCK STATUS OF THE STEERING COUPLING WAS NOT CORRECTLY DOCUMENTED
records.defect: The lock status of the steering coupling was not correctly documented following assembly.
records.remedy: As a precautionary measure on affected vehicles the lock status of the steering coupling will be determined and reworked if necessary.

records.concern: THE LOCKS OF THE RIGHT AND/OR LEFT SEAT BACKREST WILL NOT BE ABLE TO LOCK
records.defect: The locks of the right and/or left seat backrest may not be able to lock.
records.remedy: The seat backrest locks will be checked and replaced if necessary.

records.concern: IN SPECIFIC DRIVING CONDITIONS THE ELECTRIC POWER STEERING CONTROL UNIT DISPLAYED AN ERROR
records.defect: Temporary loss of power assistance to the steering.
records.remedy: Reprogramme the electric power steering control unit on affected vehicles.

records.concern: THE TAILGATE LIFTING ARMS MAY FREEZE
records.defect: Under certain conditions in cold climates the tailgate lifting arms may freeze and separate.
records.remedy: Replace both lifting arms on the tailgate.

records.concern: ACTIVATION OF A NON-DESSICATED AMMONIUM NITRATE INFLATOR WITH DEGRADED PROPELLANT MAY RESULT IN AN INFLATOR RUPTURE
records.defect: Activation of a non-desiccated ammonium nitrate inflator with degraded propellant may result in an inflator rupture.
records.remedy: Replace the airbag inflator (LANCER) or the airbag module (i) with a new non-AN (ammonium nitrate) based unit.

records.concern: DRIVER AIRBAG GENERATOR HOUSING COULD COME LOOSE
records.defect: Increased humidity may have got into the propellant of the gas generator for the drivers air bag.
records.remedy: The gas generator of the front airbag on the driver side is replaced.

records.concern: THE CFK DRIVE SHAFT 3 HOLE FLANGE WITH A PUSHING PIECE IS NOT PRODUCED WITH SUFFICIENT LONG TERM DURABILITY
records.defect: The flange of the propshaft may become detached.
records.remedy: Replace the propshaft with a alternative construction.

records.concern: THE REAR SEAT BELT ANCHORAGE PERFORMANCE MAY NOT FULFIL THE LOAD REQUIREMENTS ON 5 SEAT CONFIGURATION VEHICLES
records.defect: Rear seat belt anchorage incorrect specification.
records.remedy: A reinforcement plate will be fitted to affected vehicles.

records.concern: A POTENTIAL CRACK COULD DEVELOP IN THE FUEL EVAPORATIVE EMISSION CONTROL UNIT MOUNTED IN THE FUEL TANK
records.defect: Possible fuel leak from fuel tank.
records.remedy: Replace the fuel tank emission control Canister.

records.concern: AN INCORRECT TOOLING SETUP DURING THE MANUFACTURING OF THE FUEL TANK MAY RESULT IN REDUCED WALL THICKNESS OR SMALL PIN HOLE IN THE TANK'S BOTTOM SURFACE
records.defect: An incorrect tooling setup during the manufacturing of the fuel tank may result in reduced wall thickness
records.remedy: Check the serial number and replace the fuel tank if necessary.

records.concern: THERE IS A POSSIBILITY THAT THE GLUE HOLDING THE GLASS ON THE REAR DOOR COULD DETACH
records.defect: There is a possibility that the glue holding the glass on the rear door could detach.
records.remedy: Inspect and repair or replace the rear window glass if necessary.

records.concern: THE STEERING COLUMN UNIVERSAL JOINT CLAMP MAY BE INCORRECTLY FITTED TO THE STEERING COLUMN
records.defect: The universal clamp fixing bolt is not correctly fitted in the recess at the end of the steering column.
records.remedy: Check and if necessary refit the steering column universal joint fixing.

records.concern: THE STEERING COLUMN UNIVERSAL JOINT CLAMP MAY BE INCORRECTLY FITTED TO THE STEERING COLUMN
records.defect: The universal clamp fixing bolt is not correctly fitted in the recess at the end of the steering column.
records.remedy: Check and if necessary refit the steering column universal joint fixing.

records.concern: THE ROUTING OF THE FUEL FEED HOSE MIGHT NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: Fuel hose might be incorrectly routed with a possibility of chaffing and leakage.
records.remedy: Check the routing of the fuel feed hose on affected vehicles and rework it if necessary.

records.concern: FRONT PASSENGER AIR BAG INFLATORS CONTAINING DEGRADED PROPELLANT MAY RESULT IN AN INFLATOR RUPTURE
records.defect: Passenger air bag may cause injury if activated.
records.remedy: Replace affected air bag assembly.

records.concern: VEHICLE MAY NOT ENTER FAILSAFE DRIVING MODE AS INTENDED IN RESPONSE TO CERTAIN HYBRID SYSTEM FAULTS
records.defect: The vehicle may not enter a failsafe driving mode as intended.
records.remedy: Reprogram the Power Management ECU.

records.concern: DETERIORATION FAILURE OF OVERCURRENT PROTECTION ELEMENT INSIDE ECU
records.defect: Failure of Overcurrent Protection Element (PPTC) Inside ECU
records.remedy: Power supply of transmission shaft sensors will be changed from 12V power supply to a 5 V power supply.

records.concern: THE PROPELLANT IN THE FRONT PASSENGER AIRBAG INFLATOR MAY DEGRADE OVER TIME
records.defect: The front passenger airbag inflator could rupture in the event the airbag is deployed.
records.remedy: Replace the front passenger air bag on affected vehicles.

records.concern: POTENTIAL FOR PREMATURE FAILURE OF PROP SHAFT UNIVERSAL JOINT
records.defect: Potential for premature failure of the propshaft universal joint.
records.remedy: Replace propshaft and with a modified propshaft that can be greased at one end (Axle end) Propshaft to be replaced every 300000km

records.concern: IN ORDER TO IMPROVE THE EMISSIONS CERTAIN SPECIFIC CALIBRATIONS OF FUNCTINALITIES MUST BE CHANGED IN THE ENGINE MANAGEMENT OF THE VEHICLES
records.defect: Improve the vehicle emissions via software updates.
records.remedy: Update the relevant control unit�s software and if necessary replace the NOx sensors before & after the catalytic convertor.

records.concern: THE BONDED JOINT BETWEEN THE UPPER AND LOWER SECTION OF THE REAR SPOILER MAY BE FAULTY
records.defect: The bonding of the upper and lower sections of the rear spoiler may be faulty.
records.remedy: Inspect and repair or replace the spoiler if required.

records.concern: TO IMPROVE THE EMISSIONS OF OUR VEHICLE AS QUICKLY AND EFFECTIVELY AS POSSIBLE VIA SOFTWARE UPDATES TO CERTAIN VEHICLES FROM MODEL SERIES V CLASS (447.8)
records.defect: Improve the vehicle emissions via software updates.
records.remedy: Update the relevant control unit�s software and if necessary replace the NOx sensors.

records.concern: INCORRECT POSITIONING OF WIRING POTENTIALLY CAUSING A RISK OF THE SERVICE INDICATOR OR VEHICLE STOP WARNING LIGHT COMING
records.defect: Incorrect positioning of the wiring causing a risk of the service indicator or vehicle stop warning light coming. The vehicle engine may no longer start or even shut down during use.
records.remedy: Check the battery wiring replacing it if necessary and in any case protecting it.

records.concern: INAPPROPRIATE ECU PROGRAM FOR THE BATTERY DETERIORATION JUDGMENT (STATE OF CHARGE)
records.defect: Inappropriate ECU program for battery deterioration judgement.
records.remedy: Reprogram the software with the countermeasure software.

records.concern: THE DROP ARM DOES NOT CONFORM TO PRESCRIBED SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: The drop arm does not conform to prescribed specifications
records.remedy: Check the drop arm and replace if necessary.

records.concern: GEAR SHIFT INDICATOR MAY NOT BEHAVE AS INTENDED
records.defect: The gear shift indicator may not display under specific driving conditions.
records.remedy: Upgrade the gear shift indicator software.

records.concern: SMALL CRACKS ON THE INSIDE OF A RUBBER FUEL HOSE
records.defect: Small cracks on the inside of a rubber fuel hose.
records.remedy: Replacement of affected fuel hoses.

records.concern: DRIVER'S AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY CORRECTLY DURING AN IMPACT
records.defect: Drivers air bag may not deploy correctly.
records.remedy: Replace drivers air bag.

records.concern: CENTRAL DOOR LOCKING SYSTEM MAY UNLOCK THE DOORS WHILST VEHICLE IS PARKED
records.defect: The Central Door Locking (CDL) might unlock the doors while the vehicle is parked or the doors can only be unlocked with the mechanical key. This is caused by inadequate sealing allowing water ingress into the door connector
records.remedy: Seal both A-pillar areas above the door connectors with sealer to avoid water ingress to the door connector.

records.concern: THE SUNROOF/FRONT DOME COULD POTENTIALLY DETACH FROM THE VEHICLE
records.defect: Possibility the sunroof/front dome could detach from the vehicle.
records.remedy: Drill additional holes and insert new screws to go into the bonded fixing points.

records.concern: MISROUTING OF CANISTER CHARGE TUBE
records.defect: Some canister charge tubes are routed improperly and can touch the exhaust pipes.
records.remedy: All affected units will be inspected and if necessary the canister charge tube will be replaced.

records.concern: SUNROOF GLASS MAY DETACH FROM THE SUNROOF ASSEMBLY
records.defect: The sunroof glass may detach from the sunroof assembly.
records.remedy: Replace the sunroof glass and bonding material.

records.concern: THE FLANGE OF THE DRIVE BELT AUTOMATIC TENSIONER MAY CRACK
records.defect: Power steering drive belt automatic tensioner may crack and fail.
records.remedy: Replace the automatic tensioner and bolts.

records.concern: ELECTRONIC PARKING BRAKE CAPACITOR ON INNER CIRCUIT BOARD AND MAGNET RING OF THE SENSOR MAY FRACTURE
records.defect: Electronic park brake capacitor may fracture and fail.
records.remedy: Replace the park brake actuator on affected vehicles.

records.concern: CLUTCH PIPE MAY CONTACT BULKHEAD WIRING AND POTENTIALLY CAUSE THE ENGINE TO CUT OUT
records.defect: Clutch pipe may contact and damage the bulkhead wiring.
records.remedy: Check and replace clutch pipe and wiring replace as necessary.

records.concern: POST-COLLISION BRAKE FUNCTION WITHIN ESP WAS NOT ACTIVATED DURING PRODUCTION
records.defect: The post-collision brake function within the Electronic Stability Programme was not activated during production.
records.remedy: The Electronic Stability Program control unit software will be updated to the latest version.

records.concern: HOLE MAY APPEAR IN THE HEAT SHIELD CONNECTION AT THE DIESEL PARTICULATE FILTER/CATALYTIC CONVERTER HOUSING
records.defect: A fault in the welding process could cause a leak
records.remedy: Replace particulate filter/catalyst converter on affected vehicles

records.concern: VEHICLE MAY NOT BRAKE AS EXPECTED
records.defect: It is possible that the vehicle will not brake as expected and the driver may be required to brake harder as a result.
records.remedy: Update vehicle software.

records.concern: VEHICLES MIGHT HAVE FOLLOWED A WRONG PROCEDURE TO PERFORM THE REFLASH OF THE ENGINE SOFTWARE OF THE ENGINE ECU
records.defect: Vehicles might have followed a wrong procedure to perform the reflash of the engine software of the engine ECU.
records.remedy: Reflash the engine software with appropriate procedure.

records.concern: THE SCREW/NUT FOR THE CAB LIFT CYLINDER MAY COME LOOSE
records.defect: The screw/nut for the cab tilt cylinder might come loose.
records.remedy: Inspection and if found necessary replacement of screw nut and spacer in tilt cylinder upper attachment.

records.concern: A BRAKE PEDAL HINGE BOLT DOES NOT MEET SPECIFICATION
records.defect: A brake pedal hinge bolt which does not meet specification.
records.remedy: Check torque of brake pedal hinge bolt. If the vehicle fails the test replace the brake pedal box

records.concern: AN INCORRECT LENGTH LINKAGE WAS MOUNTED ON THE ROTATION ANGLE SENSOR OF THE REAR AXLE
records.defect: An incorrect length linkage fitted to headlight range control sensor.
records.remedy: Replace headlamp range control level sensor.

records.concern: THE BLIND SPOT MONITORING EXIT WARNING SUB FEATURE DOES NOT FUNCTION AS DESIGNED AFTER THE IGNITION IS SWITCHED OFF
records.defect: Vehicle exit warning feature does not function as designed after the ignition is switched off.
records.remedy: Update both front door control units software on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: REAR WING (SPOILER) VALVE BLOCK MAY LEAK HYDRAULIC OIL ONTO EXHAUST
records.defect: The rear wing (spoiler) valve block may leak of hydraulic fluid onto the exhaust.
records.remedy: Software update to the Fully Integrated Vehicle Controller.

records.concern: NON CONFORMITIES OCCURED IN THE PRODUCTION PROCESS OF THE REAR FUEL TANK
records.defect: Nonconformities occurred in the production process of the rear fuel tank.
records.remedy: The rear fuel tanks need to be replaced on the vehicles affected

records.concern: THE MALFUNCTION INDICATOR LIGHT IS NOT ACTIVATED PROPERLY IN THE EVENT OF A FAULT
records.defect: The malfunction indicator light is not activated correctly in the event of a fault.
records.remedy: Install a software upgrade to the malfunction indicator system.

records.concern: CRACKED CHASSIS/SIDE MEMBERS AND/OR TWISTING/DEFORMATION OF CHASSIS
records.defect: Cracked chassis/side members and/or twisting/deformation of the chassis.
records.remedy: Inspect each vehicle repair any damage and fit a sub frame where required.

records.concern: ELECTRIC POWER STEERING MAY SPORADICALLY BE UNAVAILABLE FOR A LIMITED PERIOD OF TIME
records.defect: Electric power steering may be unavailable.
records.remedy: Re-programme power steering control unit with software upgrade.

records.concern: DRIVER SUPPORT AND ASSIST FUNCTIONS DISTRONIC HOLD DRIVE AWAY ASSIST AND RCTA ARE NOT ACTIVE OR AVAILABLE IN THE ESP DUE TO A SOFTWARE ERROR
records.defect: Driver support and assistant functions are not active or available in the ESP control unit due to a software error.
records.remedy: The software of the ESP control unit will be up-dated with the latest version.

records.concern: GEAR SHIFT LEVER PIN MAY COME OUT
records.defect: The interference present between the pivot pin and the gear shift lever may be incorrect.
records.remedy: The gear shift lever will be checked and replaced if necessary.

records.concern: POSSIBLE OIL LEAK FROM ONE OF THE TWO HYDRAULIC TENSIONERS OF THE TIMING CHAINS
records.defect: Possible oil leak from one of the two hydraulic timing chain tensioners.
records.remedy: Increase the tightening torque of the two hydraulic tensioners.

records.concern: THE TILT/SLIDE ROOF OPENING PANEL GLASS S NOT CORRECTLY BONDED TO ITS MOUNTING
records.defect: Tilt/slide roof opening panel glass is not correctly bonded to its mounting.
records.remedy: Install a new roof opening glass panel on affected vehicles.

records.concern: FRONT PASSENGER SEAT OCCUPANT CLASSIFICATION SYSTEM CALIBRATION MAY NOT CORRESPOND TO THE SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: Incorrect calibration of the front passenger occupant classification system.
records.remedy: Replace the seat cushion of the front passenger seat.

records.concern: THE BACKUP CAMERA COULD FAIL INTERNALLY AND MELT THE VOLTAGE REGULATOR OVER-MOLD
records.defect: The backup camera could fail internally and cause the fuse for the rear lights to blow.
records.remedy: Inspect the camera version and replace if necessary.

records.concern: REAR FIXED GLASS LID BONDING MAY NOT MEET CORRECT SPECIFICATION
records.defect: There is a possibility that the glass bonding on the panoramic sunroof is not bonded correctly.
records.remedy: Replace the affected glass section with new bonding.

records.concern: FRONT PASSENGER AIR BAG INFLATORS CONTAINING DEGRADED PROPELLANT MAY RESULT IN AN INFLATOR RUPTURE
records.defect: Passenger air bag may cause injury if activated.
records.remedy: Replace affected air bag assembly.

records.concern: AIR BAG CONTROL MODULE FOR THE SUPPLEMENTAL RESTRAINT SYSTEM COULD BE SUSCEPTIBLE TO INTERNAL SHORTING
records.defect: Possible inadvertent air bag deployment.
records.remedy: Replace the airbag sensor assembly.

records.concern: REAR SLIDING DOORS MAY CLOSE SUDDENLY
records.defect: Rear sliding door fully open catch not holding door correctly.
records.remedy: Replace sliding door catch on affected vehicles.

records.concern: BACKLIGHT ILLUMINATION OF THE HAZARD WARNING PUSH BUTTON SWITCH IS DEACTIVATED AFTER APPROX 20 MINS DRIVING DUE TO FAULTY SOFTWARE
records.defect: The backlight illumination of the hazard warning push button switch is deactivated after approximately 20 minutes driving.
records.remedy: Software in the control unit will be updated with the latest version.

records.concern: OIL LEAKAGE FROM OIL COOLER AT DELIVERY HOSE FITTING
records.defect: Potential failure of the oil cooler at the delivery hose fitting (vehicle LH side) resulting in oil leakage.
records.remedy: A new modified oil cooler is to be fitted on affected vehicles.

records.concern: PASSENGER AIRBAG MODULE BOLTS SECURING TO THE DASH PANEL MAY BE INSUFFICIENTLY TIGHTENED
records.defect: Air bag securing bolts may not be to the correct torque.
records.remedy: Check and replace bolts as required.

records.concern: THE SCREW AT THE BOTTOM STEERING SPINDLE CONNECTION MAY BE INCORRECTLY TIGHTENED
records.defect: The screw at the bottom steering spindle connection may be tightened incorrectly.
records.remedy: The screw connection at the bottom steering spindle will be checked replaced and tightened to the correct specifications.

records.concern: A WELDED CONNECTION OF THE REAR SEAT BENCH MAY NOT HAVE BEEN CORRECTLY PERFORMED
records.defect: The rear back rest head restraint mounting is not correctly welded.
records.remedy: Check and replace rear back rest frame if required.

records.concern: BLIND SPOT MONITORING EXIT WARNING INOPERABLE AFTER IGNITION SWITCHED OFF
records.defect: Blind spot vehicle exit warning failure
records.remedy: Update software on affected vehicles

records.concern: REAR BRAKE HOSE AND/OR REAR WHEEL ROTATION SENSOR LEAD MAY TOUCH REAR TYRE DUE TO INCORRECT ROUTING
records.defect: Due to incorrect routing the rear brake hose and / or the rear wheel rotation sensor lead may touch the rear tyre.
records.remedy: Inspect and re-route the hose and lead as needed replace the rear brake hose and / or sensor lead if they are damaged.

records.concern: THE BONDING OF THE REAR DOOR WINDOW GLASS TO THE HINGE ASSEMBLIES MAY NOT CONFORM TO SPECIFICATION
records.defect: On the affected vehicles the bonding of the rear door window glass to the hinge assemblies may not conform to specification.
records.remedy: Check and if necessary replace the rear window or re- bond the rear window glass hinges.

records.concern: THE BONDING OF THE REAR DOOR WINDOW GLASS TO THE HINGE ASSEMBLIES MAY NOT CONFORM TO SPECIFICATION
records.defect: On the affected vehicles the bonding of the rear door window glass to the hinge assemblies may not conform to specification.
records.remedy: Check and if necessary replace the rear window or re- bond the rear window glass hinges.

records.concern: POSSIBLE DEVIATIONS IN A WELD IN THE REAR SEATS
records.defect: The rear back rest head restraint mounting is not correctly welded.
records.remedy: Check and replace rear back rest frame if required.

records.concern: REAR SEAT BENCH WELDED CONNECTION MAY NOT BE CORRECTLY PERFORMED
records.defect: The rear back rest head restraint mounting is not correctly welded.
records.remedy: Check and replace rear back rest frame if required.

records.concern: REDUCTION IN BRAKING POWER WHERE THE BRAKE PEDAL IS APPLIED SLOWLY AND CONSTANTLY
records.defect: Extended brake pedal travel and a reduction in braking power where the brake pedal is applied slowly and constantly.
records.remedy: Replace numerous brake and clutch hydraulic components.

records.concern: HYBRID WARNING LAMP ELIMINATED ON INSTRUMENT CLUSTER MAY INDICATE THERMAL DAMAGE TO POWER RELAY ASSEMBLY AND POWER CABLE
records.defect: Power relay connections with increased risk of a thermal incident.
records.remedy: Replace power relays. Inspect relay holders and replace if required.

records.concern: EXHAUST GAS RECIRCULATION MODULE COOLER COULD LEAK
records.defect: The EGR cooler may leakpresenting a fire risk
records.remedy: A visual inspection of the EGR cooler to check for leaks and excessive build-up of deposits. The EGR cooler will be replaced on all affected vehicles

records.concern: THE CHILD SAFETY REAR DOOR LOCK INDICATES THE WRONG POSITIONS IN THE OWNER'S MANUAL
records.defect: Rear door child lock function in the Owner�s Manual incorrectly indicates the locked & unlocked positions
records.remedy: Place addendum in the Owner's Manual correcting the lock and unlock position of the rear child lock.

records.concern: CRACKS MAY APPEAR IN THE BYPASS PIPE IN THE RECIRCULATING GAS COOLING UNIT
records.defect: Cracks may occur in the pipe connection of the Exhaust Gas Recirculation device�s cooler.

records.concern: DURING ASSEMBLY THE CABIN HARNESS CLIP WAS BROKEN RESULTING IN THE HARNESS NOT BEING CORRECTLY SECURED IN FRONT LEFT CHASSIS RAIL / SUSPENSION TURRET AREA
records.defect: During vehicle assembly the cabin harness was pulled to make the process easier to manage. By pulling the harness a clip was broken or dislodged resulting in the harness not being correctly secured in the front left chassis rail / suspension turret area. In around 10% of affected units the harness makes contact with the transmission mount. The vibration of the transmission can cause the harness to be damaged. If the conductors are exposed this can result in a short circuit and blown fuse. Customer complaints are that the engine does not start and/or the wiper does not work. The engine does not start and/or the windscreen wipers do not work.
records.remedy: The technician will carry out an inspection of the cabin harness and harness clip to determine the required repair: Replace harness clip if it is damaged/missing; Repair the cabin harness in the case of mild abrasion to the harness outer; Replace the cabin harness in the case of exposed conductors.

records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the crash protection plate will be retrofitted.

records.concern: POSSIBLE OIL LEAKAGE MAY OCCUR AT THE GEARBOX BREATHER
records.defect: it is possible that oil leakage may occur at the gearbox breather when the vehicle is being driven on a racetrack and extreme driving manoeuvres are being undertaken. As a result smoke may be produced and a vehicle fire cannot be ruled out.
records.remedy: On the vehicles affected the single breather pipe for the gearbox breather system must be replaced by a dual breather pipe.

records.concern: INJECTOR MOUNTING NUTS TIGHTENING FORCE MAY BE INSUFFICIENT
records.defect: The tightening force of the injector mounting nuts may be insufficient. This could cause combustion gas to leak from the injector and contaminate the engine oil within the cylinder head. This in turn could cause the engine oil strainer to become blocked. This could cause the engine to stall. Engine Pressure Oil Light appears along with the engine malfunction indicator. Possible Engine Stall without Warning
records.remedy: Vehicles affected will have the engine checked for contamination and repaired / replaced if necessary. The Fuel injectors will also be re-tightened to the appropriate torque.

records.concern: FUEL INJECTOR SOFTWARE DOES NOT CONTROL THE ELECTRIC CURRENT CORRECTLY
records.defect: The Software controlling the fuel injectors does not control the electric current correctly. This may cause the injector control circuit to short circuit and cause the engine to stall. Results in possible Engine Stall without Warning
records.remedy: Vehicles affected will have the injector control software re-programmed

records.concern: THE SEAT ATTACHMENT RAILS MAY IN CERTAIN CASES LACK THE STIPULATED EXTRA RIVETS AT THE END OF EACH RAIL
records.defect: The seat attachment rails may lack the stipulated extra rivets at the end of each rail.
records.remedy: Check the assembly and install additional rivets as required.

records.concern: CONTROL LOGIC WHICH MONITORS THE CHARGING CONTROL PROGRAM FAILS TO DIVERT ELECTRICAL POWER AWAY FROM CAPACITOR IN THE EVENT OF A FAULT
records.defect: On the subject vehicles the control logic which monitors the charging control program fails to divert the electrical power away from the capacitor when a fault is detected within the capacitor circuit. This can cause a short circuit inside the DCDC converter and could cause the engine to stall or overheating of the DCDC converter itself which could cause a fire. The fault is accompanied by the �i-ELOOP� warning light being illuminated on the instrument cluster along with the �i-Stop� warning light flashing The engine may in some circumstances stall and fail to restart. In extreme cases the DCDC converter could overheat and cause a fire
records.remedy: Reprogram the PCM with the correct control logic. If error code �U3000: 49-DCDC� is stored � the DCDC Converter must also be replaced.

records.concern: VACUUM PUMP MAY WEAR PREMATURELY.
records.defect: The vacuum pump may wear prematurely meaning that in some applications where the brake pedal is pressed quickly whilst at low engine speed � the servo assistance provided by the vacuum system in decreased. This could cause a momentary decrease in braking performance. Braking assistance available to the driver can be reduced
records.remedy: Vehicles affected will be fitted with a modified Vacuum pump.

records.concern: UNSUITABLE CLUTCH OUTER AND HEAT TREATMENT OF JUDDER SPRING
records.defect: The shape of the clutch outer and heat treatment of judder spring are unsuitable. Because of that if a unit is ridden repeatedly with high engine rpm the temperature of clutch outer will become high decreasing material strength resulting in breakage of the clutch outer. The Clutch Failing could result in the Engine Locking Possibly causing the rider to fall off the bike.
records.remedy: Clutch outer to be replaced free of charge.

records.concern: FUEL FILLER NECK RUBBER HOSES MAY CRACK OVER TIME
records.defect: Rubber hoses in the fuel filler neck may crack over time and could leak.
records.remedy: Improved quality levelling and filler hoses will be installed replacing all of the potentially defective items.

records.concern: THE PIVOT BEARING FOR THE BEARING PIN ON THE DOOR COULD BREAK
records.defect: The pivot bearing for the bearing pin on the door drive could break.
records.remedy: Installation of an optimised pivot bearing.

records.concern: TWO NUTS ATTACHING THE BUSBARS WITHIN THE PREFUSE BOX IN THE TRUNK MAY NOT HAVE BEEN INSTALLED
records.defect: Two nuts attatching the busbars within the prefuse box may not have been installed
records.remedy: Check the prefuse box and replace if necessary on affected vehicles

records.concern: IF REAR SEAT BELTS ARE NOT FASTENED AND PRETENSIONERS ARE DEPLOYED THE LATCH COULD BE RELEASED
records.defect: In case of an accident if the rear seat belts are not fastened i.e. if the rear seat is not occupied by a passenger or is occupied by a child restraint system coupled only to the Isofix anchors and the pretensioners are deployed the rear seat latch could be released. The contents of the rear luggage area if unsecured could enter the cabin area
records.remedy: Replace the latch bezels with bezels the shape of which prevents the seat belts from interfering with the latch and releasing the seat in the event of a pretensioner deployment.

records.concern: THE CLIP OF A FUEL LINE BUNDLE MAY CHAFE AGAINST THE FUEL PUMP RETURN HOSE
records.defect: On a certain number of Insignia B - Model Year 18 the clip of a fuel line bundle might chafe against the fuel pump hose resulting in fuel leaks and in the worst case in a risk of fire.
records.remedy: Vauxhall Authorised Repairers will check the hose routing to turn the clip by 180� and to replace the hose and add a grommet to the fuel hose if necessary on all affected vehicles where the hose has signs of damage or leakage

records.concern: IMPROPER WELDING OF THE SPRING MOUNTING PIN TO THE LEFT SIDE CENTRE STAND MOUNTING BRACKET
records.defect: Improper welding of the spring mounting pin to the left side centre stand mounting bracket may cause a failure allowing the centre stand spring to fall off.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the left centre stand bracket.

records.concern: INTERNAL IGNITION SWITCH SPRING MAY HAVE BEEN MAUNFACTURED WITH A SURFACE DEFECT
records.defect: Ignition Switch spring defect may cause engine to be turned off while driving
records.remedy: Inspect and where necessary replace the Ignition Switch

records.concern: INTERNAL IGNITION SWITCH SPRING MAY HAVE BEEN MANUFACTURED WITH A SURFACE DEFECT
records.defect: Ignition Switch spring defect may cause engine to be turned off while driving
records.remedy: Inspect and where necessary replace the Ignition Switch

records.concern: PETROL LEAKS FROM THE PETROL TANK UNDERSIDE
records.defect: Petrol leaks from the underside of the petrol tank.
records.remedy: Affected motorcycles will be replaced or bought back by manufacture

records.concern: SIDE STAND CONNECTION MAY BEND/BREAK
records.defect: On G310-models the side stand connection might bend or in extreme case break. It is not possible to completely rule out an insecure standing position of the vehicle where this fault occurs.
records.remedy: On affected machines the side stand connection will be checked for prior damage and an additional bearing block for reinforcement purposes will be installed.

records.concern: SIDE STAND CONNECTION MAY BEND/BREAK
records.defect: On G310-models the side stand connection might bend or in extreme case brake. It is not possible to completely rule out an insecure standing position of the vehicle where this fault occurs.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles the side stand connection will be checked for prior damage and an additional Bearing block for reinforcement purposes will be installed.

records.concern: HYDRAULIC CLUTCH INNER ACTUATOR HOUSING MAY DAMAGE INNER OIL SEAL
records.defect: Hydraulic Clutch Actuator could cause fire
records.remedy: Inspect and repair or replace actuator

records.concern: FAULT IN NAVIGATION SOFTWARE
records.defect: There is a fault in the navigation software on certain E-Class (213) Cars that have SD card navigation.
records.remedy: Update the software of the navigation system on affected vehicles.

records.concern: ACCESSORY TOP BOX COULD BECOME DETACHED
records.defect: The bosses in the top case plate may not be strong enough and could cause the securing plate to break
records.remedy: Replace top case plate

records.concern: FRONT WHEEL CHAIR LIFT CONTROL WIRE INCORRECTLY FUSED.
records.defect: The front wheelchair lift control wire has been fused incorrectly leading to the possibility of an electrical short circuit and subsequently an electrical fire.
records.remedy: The remedy involves inspecting the electrical circuit and protecting the wire with a lower rated fuse.

records.concern: ENGINE SUSPENSION REACTION BRACKET NOT FITTED ON THE TRANSMISSION SIDE
records.defect: Some vehicles were assembled without the engine suspension reaction bracket fitted on the transmission side. The vehicles must be repaired by fitting the missing components (transmission reaction bracket and washer). The defect can be detected by noise and vibration being emitted from the front area of the vehicle. If ignored a possible consequence is a failed differential box resulting in oil leakage and in some cases the drive shaft could become disengaged and drop below the vehicle whilst in motion.
records.remedy: Fit the missing components (transmission reaction bracket and washer).

records.concern: OIL FOAM MAY DEVELOP IN THE ACTIVE CURVE SYSTEM OIL RESERVOIR
records.defect: It has been determined that on Model series ML/GLE GL/GLS (166) & GLE Coupe (292) with ACTIVE CURVE SYSTEM (ACS) Oil foam may develop in the systems oil reservoir under dynamic operating conditions and at an oil level below the minimum level and escape via the ventilation bores in the cap of the reservoir. Depending on the orientation of the two ventilation bores the escaping oil could spray onto hot component parts of the exhaust system. In this case risk of fire cannot be ruled out.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the oil dipstick of the reservoir for the ACTIVE CURVE SYSTEM.

records.concern: COMMUNICATION MODULE SOFTWARE INCORRECT SPECIFICATION FOR EMERGENCY CALL SYSTEM
records.defect: Emergency call software not to specification
records.remedy: Update software on affected vehicles

records.concern: REAR LOWER CONTROL ARM MAY EXPERIENCE EXCESSIVE CORROSION
records.defect: The rear lower control arms may experience excessive corrosion eventually resulting in a fracture A fractured rear control arm could cause reduced vehicle control and can cause a vehicle crash without prior warning
records.remedy: Replace both rear lower control arms

records.concern: VEHICLE SHORT CAUSING CAN-C BUS TO STOP COMMUNICATING
records.defect: A short in the vehicle causing the CAN-C bus to stop communicating while the cruise control is active and the vehicle speed is below the set speed such that the cruise control system is requesting positive torque at the exact moment of the short it is possible for a positive torque request to be locked on the PCM. This may result in either the vehicle maintaining its current speed or possibly accelerating.
records.remedy: Inspect the software level of the Powertrain Control Module (PCM) and if necessary reprogram the PCM

records.concern: VEHICLE SHORT CAUSING CAN-C BUS TO STOP COMMUNICATING
records.defect: A short in the vehicle causing the CAN-C bus to stop communicating while the cruise control is active and the vehicle speed is below the set speed such that the cruise control system is requesting positive torque at the exact moment of the short it is possible for a positive torque request to be locked on the PCM. This may result in either the vehicle maintaining its current speed or possibly accelerating.
records.remedy: Inspect the software level of the Powertrain Control Module (PCM) and if necessary reprogram the PCM

records.concern: REAR BRAKE PADS HAVE EXCEEDED THE DISC
records.defect: The rear brake pads have exceeded the disc and once they have worn to a certain level then the rear brake may become inoperable. The front brake will still work as they are independent.
records.remedy: The dealers will be required to change the calliper mounting bracket and brake pads.

records.concern: TOO LITTLE OR MISSING CLEARANCE FROM HYDRAULIC OIL PRESSURE HOSE TOWARDS FRAME MEMBER
records.defect: Too little or missing clearance from hydraulic oil pressure hose towards frame member causing chaffing and oil leakage.
records.remedy: Adjust hose clearance to ensure chaffing is avoided with the engine running.

records.concern: SOLAR PANEL MAY BECOME DETACHED WHILST DRIVING
records.defect: Potential for solar panel to become detached from the vehicle.
records.remedy: Inspect and if the problem is evident the panel will need to be resealed.

records.concern: INCORRECT UNDERFLOOR PANELLING INSTALLED
records.defect: Incorrect engine undertray fitted.
records.remedy: Check and replace engine undertray on affected vehicles.

records.concern: THE ANTI-ENTRAPMENT PROTECTION OF THE PNEUMATIC OUTWARDS OPENING DOOR STOPS WORKING AFTER DE-POWERING OF THE DOOR
records.defect: Pneumatic door sensitive edge not operating when powered down
records.remedy: Modify door electronics of affected vehicles

records.concern: PROPSHAFT MAY FAIL AND FALL OFF VEHICLE.
records.defect: The propshaft may fail and fall of the vehicle causing injury and damage to other road users.
records.remedy: The remedy involves installing a prop shaft catcher to prevent failing prop shafts falling off.

records.concern: SOFTWARE FAULT WITH CRANKSHAFT SENSOR
records.defect: The affected vehicles may be equipped with a crankshaft sensor with a software fault. The crankshaft sensor cannot process the signal values from the crankshaft transmitter due to an improper firmware level. The firmware does not compensate sufficiently the temperature gradients and the magnetic field strength of the sensor electronic. If the crankshaft sensor cannot process the signal values from the transmitter the Digital Diesel Electronic (DDE) will notice that and change to the emergency operation mode. The emergency mode will be displayed by the check control message �engine malfunction�. The driver may notice a rough running engine and a reduced driving power (70%). However an engine stalling during driving conditions cannot be excluded.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the crankshaft sensor will be replaced with a new version.

records.concern: REAR SEAT BACK LOCK STRIKERS MAY BE MISSING ON BOTH SIDES OF THE SEAT
records.defect: The rear seat back lock strikers may be missing on both sides of the seat which could cause the backrest not to remain in the upright position.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles install the missing striker plates.

records.concern: A NON-DESSICATED PASSENGER AIRBAG INFLATOR WAS USED DURING PREVIOUS RECALL TO REPLACE THIS COMPONENT
records.defect: In 2013 Nissan announced a Recall campaign to replace Takata SPI front passenger airbag inflators. A non-dessicated passenger airbag inflator was used for the replacement. Although there have been no known incidents associated with inflators of this type Nissan has decided to replace all inflators previously repaired with a non-dessicated inflator to a new dessicated version.
records.remedy: Replace the front passenger airbag inflator with a new dessicated type.

records.concern: FRONT PANEL AND REAR FIXED SECTION OF PANORAMIC GLASS SUNROOF MAY NOT BE BONDED CORRECTLY
records.defect: Panoramic glass sunroof the front panel and rear fixed section may not be bonded correctly
records.remedy: Check and replace the frame of the panoramic glass sunroof if necessary.

records.concern: STARTER MOTOR HEATSHIELD MAY BREAK OFF
records.defect: The starter motor heatshield may break off.
records.remedy: Replace the starter motor heatshield with a new version.

records.concern: BURRS IN THE INNER HYDRAULIC CLUTCH ACTUATOR HOUSING CAN CAUSE DAMAGE TO THE OIL SEAL
records.defect: Burrs in the inner hydraulic clutch actuator housing can damage the oil seal causing oil to leak and accumulate in the phase cap. The HEV warning light will be displayed on the dashboard.An electrical short may occur which could result in a fire risk.
records.remedy: Inspect and repair or replace actuator

records.concern: DRIVER'S AIRBAG GAS GENERATOR HOUSING FAILURE DURING DEPLOYMENT
records.defect: On affected vehicles it has been determined that drivers airbags with potentially faulty gas generator housing material may have been installed in vehicles of model series 156 176 246 205 238 & 253. If the material of the gas generator housing fails during airbag deployment in the event of a crash the airbag system would possibly no longer have a restraint effect. In addition separating parts could enter the passenger compartment. This could lead to an increased risk of injury.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the driver�s airbag

records.concern: LASER WELDING BETWEEN BACKREST RAIL AND BACKREST METAL FITTING OF FRONT SEATS MAY NOT MEET SPECIFICATION
records.defect: It has been determined that on certain C-Class (205) and E-Class (213) Cars with AMG performance seats the laser welding between the backrest rail and the backrest metal fitting of the driver or passenger seat might not meet the specification. The laser welding between the backrest member and the backrest metal fitting may not withstand the required load values. As a result the fitting may detach from the backrest member. In the case of an accident this could result in a higher occupant load. Due to the delivery scenario the fault can only occur on one side of the seat.
records.remedy: As a precautionary measure recall the affected vehicles and check the backrest member and replace if necessary

records.concern: ANTI THEFT WHEEL BOLTS MAY NOT BE TIGHTENED TO THE CORRECT SPECIFICATION.
records.defect: On the affected vehicles the tightening torques of the anti-theft wheel bolts may not be to the correct to specification.
records.remedy: The remedy involves correcting the anti-theft wheel bolts tightening torques.

records.concern: ROTATING FRONT SEAT WIRE FIXINGS CAN LOOSEN
records.defect: It has been determined that on Vito models with rotating front seats (SA codes SB5/SB6) the front seats can loosen the wire fixings under the seats when being rotated. Should the wiring harness be damaged in the worst-case scenario this could lead to deactivation of the thorax bag or to unintentional triggering of the thorax bag in the case of a short circuit caused in the process. A disarmed thorax bag is indicated via the SRS indicator lamp. The reason for this is the technical concept which allows for flexible cable harness installation depending on the seat mounting.
records.remedy: Since the beginning of June 2017 the series has protected the wiring from jamming and damage by using an optimized mounting clip. We will recall and bring the installation of the cables under the swivel seats on the affected vehicles up to the optimized current series status.

records.concern: ROTATING FRONT SEAT WIRE FIXINGS CAN LOOSEN
records.defect: It has been determined that on V-Class and Vito models with rotating front seats (SA codes SB5/SB6) the front seats can loosen the wire fixings under the seats when being rotated. Should the wiring harness be damaged in the worst-case scenario this could lead to deactivation of the thorax bag or to unintentional triggering of the thorax bag in the case of a short circuit caused in the process. A disarmed thorax bag is indicated via the SRS indicator lamp.
records.remedy: Since the beginning of June 2017 the series has protected the wiring from jamming and damage by using an optimized mounting clip. We will recall and bring the installation of the cables under the swivel seats on the affected vehicles up to the optimized current series status

records.concern: PISTONS IN REAR BRAKE CALIPERS MAY NOT BE COATED TO SPECIFICATIONS
records.defect: The fault affects the brake system in particular the brake calipers on the rear axle. Because of a faulty coating hydrogen gas (approximately 10 ml) could be created in the coating of the piston of the brake caliper. This will be completely outgassed during the first 2 months after the production process causing longer brake pedal travel. Under certain circumstances the relevant brake pressure cannot be build up in the rear brake circuit. As a result the brake force of the system may be reduced by up to 30%. The driver may feel a soft brake pedal and a reduction of the brake performance. In certain cases the rear brake circuit could fail leading to increased risk of an accident.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the brake system will be bled.

records.concern: DISTANCE BETWEEN SENSOR AND IN-TANK FUEL LINE COULD BE TOO SMALL
records.defect: The fault affects the fuel level sensor within the fuel tank.The distance between the sensor and an in-tank fuel line could be too small which could allow the sensor to contact the fuel line and in some cases become stuck. If the fuel sensor becomes stuck the fuel gauge in the instrument cluster displays a larger amount of fuel than is actually in the tank. Therefore the tank could become empty leading to the engine stalling without prior warning.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the fuel line supply unit system will be reworked.

records.concern: INCORRECT SOFTWARE SPECIFICATION FOR THE STEERING COLUMN SWITCH MODULE
records.defect: Software of switch module incorrect specification
records.remedy: Update software of affected vehicles

records.concern: Incorrect engine oil software
records.defect: Subject vehicles are equipped with incorrect engine oil software leading to the oil temperature not being detected over a certain threshold. This could lead to the oil pan deformimg due to high engine oil temperatures which in turn could lead to oil loss onto the road surface.
records.remedy: The remedy involves reprogramming the engine ECU which will give the driver a timely warning regarding possible high oil temperature.

records.concern: Oil plug incorrectly tightened
records.defect: There is a possibility that an oil plug located on the side of the engine may not be properly tightened. An engine oil leak could occur that could lead to a certain amount of oil hitting the ground.
records.remedy: The remedy involves tightening the engine oil plug to the correct torque.

records.concern: INAPPROPRIATE WATER PROOF STRUCTURE OF THE FRONT DECK
records.defect: Due to inappropriate water proof structure of the front deck water can drop on the wiper link. The wiper link ball joint may corrode and cause excessive wear of the resin part of the ball joint. In the worst case the wiper link may detach itself and the windshield wipers may be inoperative.
records.remedy: The water proof pad has been added to the end of wiper link rubber boot since April 1st 2016

records.concern: PARKING BRAKE CALIPER SHAFT BOOTS INCORRECTLY SEALED
records.defect: Due to improper sealing of parking brake caliper shaft boots water might penetrate inside and rust the shaft. As the result of continuous use the rust will erode into the internal caliper and the shaft becomes stuck causing decreased parking brake force. Due to improper manufacturing process automatic adjuster for brake pad clearance of rear brake caliper might not work properly. As the result as brake pad wear the clearance is not correctly adjusted and brake force becomes insufficient to hold a vehicle. In the worst case scenario parking brake will not work even though a lever is fully operated and parked vehicle may move.
records.remedy: Anti-rust coating (Fluorine) has been applied to parking brake shaft from 27/01/2016 supplied parts & the Inspection process for the caliper has been changed from 14/12/2014 supplied parts.

records.concern: HEAD RESTRAINT GUIDE RETAINING SPRING MAY BE FAULTY
records.defect: On Passat vehicles of a limited production period the retaining spring of the head restraint guide may be faulty because of a production problem. Because of a faulty retaining spring in an accident the head restraint may not be sufficiently secured in the guide and can come off the backrest. In the event of an accident the head restraint will come off the backrest increasing the risk of injury.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles the left head restraint guides on both front seats have to be replaced.

records.concern: TYRE PRESSURE MONITORING SYSTEM SOFTWARE ERROR
records.defect: On affected vehicles the possibility exists that there may be a software error in the tyre pressure monitoring system of some X-Class vehicles If the tyre pressure falls below the minimum level required the intended warning message may not be shown in instrument cluster as a result of this error. Driving with tyre pressure that is too low causes increased and/or uneven tyre wear and changes the steering and braking behaviour of the vehicle. This may increase the risk of accident
records.remedy: As a precautionary measure recall the affected vehicles and perform a software check/update in the tyre pressure monitor control unit.

records.concern: SPOT WELDS MAY NOT HAVE BEEN CORRECTLY APPLIED TO DOOR FRAME
records.defect: Spot welds on the front side wall that join the door frame with the hinge reinforcements behind it might not have been applied
records.remedy: On affected vehicles check spotwelds and apply if missing.

records.concern: POTENTIAL DETACHMENT OF BRAKE PAD FRICTION MATERIAL FROM BACK PLATE
records.defect: Brake pad friction material detachment from backplate.
records.remedy: Replacement of brake pads

records.concern: Air bag inflator may rupture on activation.
records.defect: There is a possibility the air bag inflator may rupture on activation. Hino has not received any reports of this occurring in its vehicles in global markets. The recall is being conducted as a precautionary measure.
records.remedy: The remedy involves replacing the faulty air bag module with one made by a different manufacturer.

records.concern: POTENTIAL OIL LEAK FROM TRANSMISSION OIL COOLER LINES
records.defect: It has been determined that it is possible that the connectors for the transmission oil cooler lines were not pressed together in accordance with specifications. As a result the transmission oil cooler lines could work loose while driving and transmission oil could leak out. Because of a deviation in the supplier�s production process it is possible that the connectors on transmission oil cooler lines from two specific batches were not pressed together in accordance with specifications. In this case the vehicle could possibly lose propulsion due to oil loss in the transmission. The escaping oil could get onto the roadway thus increasing the risk of an accident for following traffic. Also it cannot be excluded that escaping transmission oil could come into contact with hot component parts of the exhaust system and ignite
records.remedy: Check the transmission oil cooler lines and replace them if necessary

records.concern: REPLACEMENT AIRBAG INFLATOR INSTALLED IN AN INCORRECT ORIENTATION
records.defect: Affected vehicles received a recall remedy in which the replacement inflator may have been installed in an incorrect orientation.This may prevent the front passenger air bag from inflating as intended during deployment as designed.
records.remedy: Affected vehicles will have the inflator checked and corrected if it is necessary.

records.concern: AIRBAG INFLATORS MAY NOT OPERATE AS INTENDED
records.defect: On the subject vehicles the Takata Driver and Passenger airbag inflators may not operate as intended Injury may result due to incorrect deployment of the Airbag
records.remedy: Replacement of Airbag Assembly

records.concern: RIGHT SIDE OF FRONT SEAT BACKRESTS MAY NOT LOCK INTO PLACE
records.defect: The seat backrests on the right side of the front seats in the c-class Coupe/Convertible and E-Class Coupe/Convertible may not fully lock.
records.remedy: As a precautionary measure the lock of the seat backrest on affected vehicles will be check for operation. Where necessary the backrest will be replaced.

records.concern: SIDE AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY AS INTENDED
records.defect: The front seat back pad mould (seat back cushion) and side airbag (SAB) are fitted to the seat back frame. The SAB is fitted underneath the pad mould and the pad mould has been designed with a slit that allows the SAB to deploy from underneath the pad mould. Seat back pad moulds that were supplied for after-sales use were not manufactured correctly; the slit process was not completed. When a front seat pad without the slit is assembled to the car it may block SAB deployment and may not satisfy occupant protection performance which is a non-conformance to side impact regulation.
records.remedy: Registered owners of affected vehicles will receive a notification letter that will ask them to take their vehicles to a dealership or authorised repairer for a free repair. The technician will carry out inspection to verify the condition of the front seat back pad mould and will replace the pad mould and if necessary the seat heater element and seat back cover.

records.concern: POSSIBLE INCORRECT WHEEL NUTS FITTED DURING PRODUCTION
records.defect: Incorrect wheel nut fitment
records.remedy: Replace affected wheel nuts and inspect wheels for damage

records.concern: STEERING COLUMN BEARING POSSIBLY CRIMPED TO THE INCORRECT SPECIFICATION.
records.defect: On the affected vehicles the crimping preventing lateral movement of the steering column bearing may not be correct to specification. This may result in noise and play in the steering. Ultimately it could lead to steering malfunction.
records.remedy: The remedy involves checking the crimping on the steering column and replacing the steering column if necessary.

records.concern: Tow ball support bracket durability inadequate
records.defect: The tow ball bracket could not withstand mechanical constraints when subjected to the highest stress levels which can occur during the vehicle's lifetime.
records.remedy: The manufacturer�s remedy involves the replacement of the tow ball support bracket with a redesigned version.

records.concern: Tow ball support bracket durability inadequate
records.defect: The tow ball bracket could not withstand mechanical constraints when subjected to the highest stress levels which can occur during the vehicle's lifetime.
records.remedy: The manufacturer�s remedy involves the replacement of the tow ball support bracket with a redesigned version.

records.concern: COOLING SYSTEM STRATEGY COULD OVERHEAT THE ENGINE.
records.defect: The cooling system strategy and the maximum temperature alert could cause the engine to overheat this may cause an oil leak from the sump drain cap. Due to the incorrect operation of the warning system there is no driver alert.
records.remedy: The remedy involves downloading new engine management software.

records.concern: COOLING SYSTEM STRATEGY COULD OVERHEAT THE ENGINE.
records.defect: The cooling system strategy and the maximum temperature alert could cause the engine to overheat this may cause an oil leak from the sump drain cap. Due to the incorrect operation of the warning system there is no driver alert.
records.remedy: The remedy involves downloading new engine management software.

records.concern: PIPING SEAM OF FRONT SEAT DOES NOT OPEN IF AIR BAG IS DEPLOYED
records.defect: A certain number of Grandland X - Model Year 18 the piping seam of the front leather seat cover does not open as required in case of a seat airbag deployment.
records.remedy: Replace all affected leather front seat leather covers.

records.concern: FRONT PASSENGER AIRBAG INFLATOR MAY RUPTURE IN A DEPLOYMENT EVENT
records.defect: Potential injury if Airbag deployed
records.remedy: On Affected vehicles replace Airbag inflator unit

records.concern: AIRBAG MAY HAVE BEEN INCORRECTLY FOLDED WHEN PASSENGER AIRBAG MODULE WAS PRODUCED
records.defect: On Tiguan Allspace vehicles of a limited production period faulty passenger airbags may have been fitted. When the passenger airbag module was produced the airbag may have been incorrectly folded. As a result there is risk that in case of deployment the airbag may not open up correctly and would therefore be ineffective leading to injury of vehicle occupants.
records.remedy: On all affected vehicles the passenger airbag unit has to be replaced.

records.concern: Engine oil gallery sealing plug incorrectly tightened
records.defect: On the affected vehicles the tightening of a sealing plug on the engine oil gallery may not be correct to specification.This could lead over time to an oil leak which in rare cases could result in oil leaking on to the road.
records.remedy: The remedy consists of tightening the engine oil gallery sealing plug to the correct torque.

records.concern: Engine oil gallery sealing plug incorrectly tightened
records.defect: On the affected vehicles the tightening of a sealing plug on the engine oil gallery may not be correct to specification.This could lead over time to an oil leak which in rare cases could result in oil leaking on to the road.
records.remedy: The remedy consists of tightening the engine oil gallery sealing plug to the correct torque

records.concern: FORK AXLE CARRIER WITH EXCESSIVE PLAY OF WHEEL CLAMPING SCREW
records.defect: Due to a production error there may be excessive play in the axial clamping screw on the forks. This could lead to a loss of control. THE MANUFACTURER RECOMMENDS NOT TO RIDE THE MACHINE UNTIL THE RECALL IS COMPLETED.
records.remedy: On affected machines check the threaded holes in the axle carriers with a special tool. If the nonconformity is present the fork leg with a defective axle carrier will be replaced.

records.concern: OIL PLUG LEAKAGE
records.defect: On a certain number of Grandland X - Model Year 18 with LCI engine (D20DTH) Engine oil might leak from an oil plug in the cylinder block. This could lead to oil stains on the floor low engine oil volume (warning on dashboard if volume is low) or MIL on if the oil pressure is low.
records.remedy: Vauxhall Authorised Repairers are instructed to tighten the oil plug in the cylinder block on the timing case side to 42 Nm

records.concern: Engine could overheat leading to failure
records.defect: Engine could overheat leading to failure in extreme cases
records.remedy: Download new engine management software

records.concern: Engine could overheat leading to failure
records.defect: Engine could overheat leading to failure in extreme cases
records.remedy: Download new engine management software

records.concern: DRIVE CHAIN GUARD FIXING BOLT TO SWING ARM MAY LOOSEN
records.defect: The bolt fixing the drive chain guard to the swing arm may loosen due to vibration.
records.remedy: Affected units must have the Collar & Bolt replaced with the countermeasure parts.

records.concern: CLUTCH PRESSURE PLATE MAY FRACTURE
records.defect: A number of vehicles fitted with a 1.0 1.5 or 1.6 Ecoboost engine and 6-speed manual transmission could suffer clutch pressure plate fracture. This results in clutch smell reduced vehicle speed and performance. In the unlikely event of clutch pressure plate fracture a noise (thud / bang) could be heard from the vicinity of the transmission in extreme cases resulting in clutch / transmission fragments being released and striking under hood components creating a risk of smoke and fire from the under hood area.
records.remedy: To prevent the repeated heating /cooling events a new calibration has been developed for vehicles fitted with Engine Stop Start feature. The software with the additional feature sets the Instrument panel �Wrench light� and de-rates the engine performance if prolonged clutch slip is detected. The software feature includes a drive cycle strategy for latching the wrench light and engine performance de-rate if the customer should experience repeated clutch slip events. For vehicles that do not have Engine Stop Start feature an alternative clutch kit has been released.

records.concern: SEAT BELT BUCKLE MAY SEPARATE FROM SEAT FRAME
records.defect: A certain number of Insignia A - Model Year 17 the front seat belt buckles may not be produced according specification. In a worst case the seat belt buckles may separate from the seat frame in the event of an accident.
records.remedy: Vauxhall Authorised Repairers are instructed to check and if necessary replace the seat belt buckles on all affected vehicles.

records.concern: CLUTCH PRESSURE PLATE MAY FRACTURE
records.defect: Affected vehicles fitted with a 1.0 1.5 or 1.6 Ecoboost engine and 6-speed manual transmission could suffer clutch pressure plate fracture. This results in clutch smell reduced vehicle speed and performance. In the unlikely event of clutch pressure plate fracture a noise (thud / bang) could be heard from the vicinity of the transmission in extreme cases resulting in clutch / transmission fragments being released and striking under hood components creating a risk of smoke and fire from the under hood area.
records.remedy: To prevent the repeated heating /cooling events a new calibration has been developed for vehicles fitted with Engine Stop Start feature. The software with the additional feature sets the Instrument panel �Wrench light� and de-rates the engine performance if prolonged clutch slip is detected. The software feature includes a drive cycle strategy for latching the wrench light and engine performance de-rate if the customer should experience repeated clutch slip events. For vehicles that do not have Engine Stop Start feature an alternative clutch kit has been released.

records.concern: OIL LEAKAGE ON TURBOCHARGER
records.defect: The oil inlet nozzle on the turbocharger that is screwed on to the bearing housing is sealed with a copper seal. An adhesive that disintegrates when heated was applied in error. This may allow oil to leak onto the turbo housing.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles correctly reseal the connection.

records.concern: FRONT BRAKE HOSES INCORRECTLY INSTALLED
records.defect: On a certain number of Astra K - Model Year 2016-2017 (Only converted UK Police vehicles are affected) the front brake hoses might be incorrectly installed. This can lead to contact with the drive shaft boots finally resulting in failure/leakage.
records.remedy: Vauxhall authorised repairers or Police Workshops are asked to reroute the brake hoses and to inspect the brake hose installation if necessary replace any damaged parts to guarantee accurate functionality of the brakes.

records.concern: CORROSION/ POOR ADHESION POTENTIALLY CAUSING THE FRONT SPOILER BRACKETS TO COME LOOSE
records.defect: The front spoiler brackets may become loose.
records.remedy: Secure brackets with additional screws.

records.concern: THROTTLE MAY BE SUSEPTIBLE TO JAM OPEN
records.defect: Throttle may jam open
records.remedy: Replace the throttle assembly yoke regulator and battery

records.concern: FUEL TANK MOUNTING BRACKET JOINT BREAKS/CRACKS
records.defect: On affected vehicles the fuel tank mounting bracket joint may break/crack with the risk of the fuel tank dropping to the floor and parting from the fuel filler neck resulting in fuel spillage (environmental contamination).
records.remedy: On affected vehicles the fuel tank mounting bracket is inspected implementing welding reinforcement to the mounting bracket.

records.concern: FRONT AXLE SWIVEL BEARINGS MAY NOT HAVE BEEN PRODUCED TO SPECIFICATION
records.defect: Due to a fault in the supplier production process the swivel bearings on the front axle of the affected vehicles may not have been produced to specification. Due to an insufficient heat treatment the fracture strain has been reduced. The affected swivel bearings could break causing loss of wheel guidance during driving.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles both swivel bearings will be checked and if necessary replaced with a part produced to specification.

records.concern: ENGINE CONTROL UNIT CONTROL OF FUEL PUMP
records.defect: Insufficient control of the fuel pump by the engine control unit the fuel pump may stop functioning in certain driving conditions which could lead in individual cases to a drop of the fuel pressure. When the fuel pressure drops an engine stalling cannot be excluded.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles the engine control unit will be reprogrammed

records.concern: ELECTRICAL WIRING IN STEERING ASSEMBLY MAY BE INSUFFICIENTLY GROUNDED
records.defect: The steering column clock spring may break. This will cause warning messages to illuminate in the instrument cluster but in extreme instances it may cause the driver's airbag to deploy
records.remedy: .Affected vehicles will be recalled to be checked to ensure there is sufficient grounding of the steering components.

records.concern: SEAT BELT BUCKLE RUBBING AGAINST PLASTIC SEAT COVER
records.defect: On affected vehicles in certain circumstances the drivers seat belt buckle (steel rope) is rubbing against the plastic seat cover which may result in damage to the wire. In the event of an accident there is a risk the seat belt buckle steel rope could break.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles inspect the seat belt buckle and in the case of damage replace accordingly.

records.concern: INCORRECT SOFTWARE CONFIGURATION IN COMBI METER FITTED TO PREM3 VARIANT VEHICLES
records.defect: Warning light not coming on with steering fault
records.remedy: Software upgrade

records.concern: FRONT AXLE TOE ADJUSTMENT INCORRECTLY CALCULATED
records.defect: The toe adjustment for the front axle was incorrectly calculated and set during production.
records.remedy: Measure the front axle adjustments (toe and camber) and correct them.

records.concern: GAS FUEL CYLINDERS MAY FAIL
records.defect: Gas fuel tanks fitted to affected vehicles may be affected by corrosion. Over time corrosion may weaken the tank wall(s) and the tank may burst.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles check gas fuel tanks for corrosion. assess and where necessary replace.

records.concern: RISK OF FUEL LEAKAGE FROM TOP OF THE FUEL TANK
records.defect: There is a risk of a fuel leak from the filler neck area of the fuel tank
records.remedy: On affected machines replace the fuel tank.

records.concern: MISSING WELDING POINTS AT BOTH FRONT SIDE MEMBERS
records.defect: It has been determined that the A-Class 177 might have some missing welding points in the area of both front side members. It is possible that due to a deviation in the internal production process a couple of welding points could not have been set .
records.remedy: If these welding points are not present the structural behaviour would be impaired in the event of a crash. In this case an increased risk of injury for the passengers cannot be excluded. As a precautionary measure recall the affected vehicles and check the welding points and rework if necessary.

records.concern: THERMAL DEGRADATION OF ACTUATION MODULE
records.defect: The lift axle actuator may experience thermal degradation during operation. This may also impact on other modules relays etc.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles fit circuit protection diodes.

records.concern: FRONT SWIVEL JOINT NUT INCORRECTLY SECURED ON WHEEL BEARING HOUSING (LEFT AND RIGHT)
records.defect: On affected vehicles the nut of the bolted connections of the front (left and right) swivel joints on the wheel bearing housing may not have been tightened to the correct torque. in case of unusual mechanical noises the vehicle has to be stopped straight away and the workshop contacted control of the vehicle may be lost.
records.remedy: The nut of the bolted connection for the swivel joint on the front right and left wheel bearing housing has to be replaced.

records.concern: VARIATION TO ELECTRICAL RESISTANCE IN THE BLOWER REGULATOR WIRING HARNESS CONNECTOR
records.defect: Over time irregularities in the crimp connection in conjunction with relative movements of the tin coated connector at the end of the wiring harness which connects to the tin coated blower regulator pin could lead to frictional corrosion. In combination with very high current flow which would occur which could lead to a temperature increase. As a result the blower regulator wiring could be damaged and could lead to partial contact of individual wire strands. this could result in an irregular current flow further overheating and increase the risk of fire.
records.remedy: The blower regulator wiring harness will be inspected and a new part will be installed.

records.concern: CONTACT BETWEEN FUEL TANK AND/OR AIRBOX DRAIN HOSES WITH HORIZONTAL CYLINDER EXHAUST MANIFOLD
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have been fitted with incorrectly routed fuel tank and/or airbox drain tubes. This may cause contact with the horizontal cylinder exhaust manifold. This contact could result in a fire in the lower LH area under the battery.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles rerouting of the fuel tank and airbox drain hoses to prevent contact with the horizontal cylinder exhaust manifold.

records.concern: FUEL GAUGE DISPLAYS AN INACCURATE READING
records.defect: On certain 2018 and 2019 Model Year Land Rover Range Rover and Range Rover Sport PHEV vehicles where the indicated fuel level on the fuel gauge shows approximately 30% the fuel tank is empty resulting in an engine stall. The vehicle will enter into reduced performance mode and if the customer continues to drive the vehicle will continue to run for circa 8 miles/13Km. The vehicle engine will then cut out without warning. If the traction battery charge status is at least 10% or greater the electric motor will take up drive until such time as traction battery power is depleted. Where the traction battery charge status is below 10% drive from the electric motor is not possible and the vehicle will cut out whilst in motion. All 12 volt powered electrical functions such as power assisted steering exterior lighting and brake assistance will continue to operate as designed. Engine cut out with minimal warning to the driver may lead to an increased risk of an accident.
records.remedy: Fit a new revised fuel level sensor float to the vehicle.

records.concern: INSUFFICIENT FORGING STATUS IN STEERING ARM
records.defect: Steering arm may have insufficient forging status and become insecure
records.remedy: Replacement of steering arm on front axle

records.concern: PRESENCE OF AIR IN THE BRAKE CIRCUIT MAY DECREASE BRAKE PERFORMANCE
records.defect: May experience decreased brake performance resulting from the presence of air in the brake circuit.
records.remedy: Bleed the front and rear brake circuits by following the instructions in the bulletin.

records.concern: BLOCKED FUEL TANK VENT
records.defect: The fuel tank may build excessive pressure due to a blocked vent. This could cause fuel to spray on occupants or bystanders when opening the fuel cap potentially causing injury. Additionally if an ignition source was present this could create a risk of fire causing injury and/or damage to property.
records.remedy: Cut the vent hose to the specified length. Route the vent according to the correct procedure.

records.concern: POSSIBLE OIL LEAKAGE FROM TURBO CHARGER OIL FEED PIPE
records.defect: We would like to make you aware that on a certain number of Astra J GTC Insignia B - Model Year 18 there is the possibility of oil leakage from the turbo charger oil feed pipe. In worst case the spilled oil may inflame on hot engine parts. Possible oil leakage from turbo charger oil feed pipe. In worst case the spilled oil may inflame on hot engine parts.
records.remedy: check/adjust turbo oil feed pipe connector on all affected vehicles

records.concern: LED LIGHT FITMENT MAY AFFECT OTHER LAMPS
records.defect: Lighting fault after LED fitment
records.remedy: Re-programme and re-configure the Energy Manangement Module

records.concern: RISK OF FUEL LEAK
records.defect: Risk of a diesel fuel leak in the engine bay
records.remedy: Fit a protective clip or replace pipe.

records.concern: POWER STEERING WARNING LAMP MAY NOT ILLUMINATE
records.defect: No warning light on the dashboard should the power steering fail
records.remedy: Re-programme dashboard computer
