records.concern: REAR BRAKE PISTONS COATED INCORRECTLY
records.defect: The rear brake pistons may have been coated incorrectly potentially causing the brake pedal travel to increase under braking and the effectiveness of the rear brakes to be reduced. Gas bubbles may form in the hydraulic system on the rear brake circuit under certain conditions as a function of temperature and time. In the event of a fault only the rear brake circuit will be affected. As a result the vehicle may take significantly longer to stop.
records.remedy: The rear brake hydraulic system (rear left and rear right brake calipers) must be bled on the affected vehicles.

records.concern: BEARING DAMAGE WITHIN ENGINE
records.defect: Standard quality testing discovered that one particular supply part in the engine does not meet the required long-term properties. It is not possible to completely rule out bearing damage within the engine.
records.remedy: In affected machines the engine will be replaced or repaired.

records.concern: HIGH VOLTAGE BATTERY SYSTEM MAY MALFUNCTION AND CAUSE A SUDDEN LOSS OF POWER
records.defect: Incorrect operation of the Voltage Protection Device (VPD) may lead to the high voltage battery system intermittently switching off the Hybrid Electric Vehicle (HEV) motor whilst driving. If the fault occurs a warning light will be displayed on the dashboard and the vehicle could suffer a sudden loss of power.
records.remedy: Replace the Battery Management System (BMS) main and sub units and wiring loom

records.concern: INCORRECTLY SEALED ELECTRICAL CIRCUITS IN LEFT HAND SWITCH CUBE
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have been fitted with an incorrectly sealed left hand switch cube. This may cause the turn signal indicators and headlamp not to function correctly.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles fit a newer version switch cube.

records.concern: INCORRECTLY COATED BRAKE PISTONS
records.defect: Rear caliper pistons incorrectly coated.
records.remedy: Replace rear calipers.

records.concern: POSSIBLE INCORRECT WELDING
records.defect: Possible incorrect welding due to human error of the 4 sections of the front engine under frame. This has been caused by an interruption in the welding process Possible brake of the welds Sub-frame can lost the correct alignment and the vehicle could lose the stability
records.remedy: Inspection of the welded points if welding Is defective replacement of the front sub-frame required

records.concern: RISK OF OVERHEATING AND FAILURE OF ADDITIONAL COOLANT PUMP
records.defect: On affected vehicles moisture may enter the electronic components and cause overheating and failure of the additional coolant pump. localised smoulder damage cannot be ruled out and in individual cases may cause vehicle to catch fire.
records.remedy: The additional coolant pump must be replaced and in addition a software update of the engine control unit must be carried out

records.concern: ELECTRICAL WIRING IN STEERING ASSEMBLY MAY BE INSUFFICIENTLY GROUNDED
records.defect: The steering column clock spring may break. This will cause warning messages to illuminate in the instrument cluster but in extreme instances it may cause the driver's airbag to deploy.
records.remedy: Affected vehicles will be recalled to establish sufficient grounding of the steering components

records.concern: CONNECTING LINKS ON THE REAR AXLE ANTI ROLL BAR
records.defect: The connecting links on the rear axle anti roll bar cannot be ensured over the life of the vehicle. This may lead to noise and an activated yellow warning light. This may impair the function which is characterised by greater understeer and increased roll behaviour.
records.remedy: Replacement of the links on the anti roll bar.

records.concern: THE PLUG-IN CONTACT OF THE POSITIVE BATTERY CABLE ON THE FRONT POWER DISTRIBUTION BOX CAN BECOME DAMAGED BY VEHICLE VIBRATIONS AND FRICTIONAL CORROSION
records.defect: The plug-in contact of the positive battery cable on the front power distribution box can become damaged by vehicle vibrations and frictional corrosion.
records.remedy: Replace the plug-in contact on the positive battery cable by installing a repair cable.

records.concern: PLUG IN CONTACT CABLE MAY MALFUNCTION
records.defect: The positive battery cable to the front distribution box behind the glove box can become damaged by vibrations and frictional corrosion. This may cause a loss of electrical connection to the distributions box. Symptoms include being unable to gain entry or start the car but the most common are a flickering instrument panel or uneven engine performance. However if the electrical connection is completely lost this will also affect the operation of the vehicles lighting systems; e.g. sidelights or hazard warning lamps.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles carry out a suitable repair to the battery cable positive cable.

records.concern: GEARBOX MAY FAIL TO HOLD IN PARK POSITION WHEN VEHICLE IS STATIONARY
records.defect: The gearbox may not hold the vehicle in the park position when the vehicle is stationary (Position �P�). The vehicle may roll if the handbrake is not applied.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the gearbox parking pin.

records.concern: AIRBAG CONTROL UNIT CONNECTION MAY NOT BE MANUFACTURED TO SPECIFICATION
records.defect: The connector pins of the occupant classification system to the airbag control unit might have been manufactured outside specification. After a period of time this may cause decativation of the passnger airbag.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the connector pins of the occupant classification system.

records.concern: WATER INGRESS MAY CAUSE WINDSCREEN WIPERS TO FAIL
records.defect: Due to inappropriate waterproofing water may be drawn into the front wiper motor and/or may cause corrosion of the wiper link ball joint. This may over time cause the wipers to fail.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the wiper motor which has a modified breather and wiper link ball joint.

records.concern: DOOR LATCHING MECHANISM MAY MALFUNCTION IN HOT TEMPERATURES
records.defect: The locking mechanism in the door latch assembly may not operate properly in high temperatures. As a result the door may not latch correctly and may unintentionally open whilst driving. This may affect one or more doors depending on vehicle identification number.
records.remedy: Modified assemblies are available and the remedy is to replace door latch mechanisms as identified by the manufacturer.

records.concern: PROPELLANT IN THE FRONT PASSENGER AIRBAG INFLATOR MAY BE DETIORATED
records.defect: The propellant in the passengers front airbag inflator may deteriorate due to high temperature and humid conditions over a longer period in use. As a result the inflator body may rupture during airbag deployment and may injure occupants.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the passenger airbag inflator.

records.concern: FRONT SEAT BELT MAY JAM
records.defect: The front seat belt webbing may jam in the belt guide loop. This may affect the operation of the belt. As a result the risk of injury may possibly be increased in the event of a collision.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles remove the spacer ring and install an additional slide element for the seat belt guide to prevent jamming.

records.concern: FRONT SEAT BELT MAY JAM
records.defect: The front seat belt webbing may jam in the belt guide loop. This may affect the operation of the belt.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles remove the spacer ring and install an additional slide element for the seat belt guide to prevent jamming.

records.concern: ON BOARD DIAGNOSTIC SYSTEM MAY FAIL TO DISPLAY FAILURE OF THE POWER STEERING ASSIST PUMP
records.defect: on a certain number of Movano B - Model Year 17 and 18 the alerts on failures from power steering assist pump might not be indicated in the instrument cluster due to incorrect calibration file in Instrument Cluster. OBD System does not work to specification because a potential failure on the power steering assist pump might not be indicated in the instrument cluster
records.remedy: Apply the new calibration file for Instrument Cluster

records.concern: FRONT SEAT SIDE AIRBAG BRACKET MAY BE INSECURE
records.defect: The front seat side airbag bracket may not be secured and may not work correctly in the event of an accident. The airbag may fail to deploy in an accident.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles check and secure bracket if required.

records.concern: FUEL MAY LEAK
records.defect: on a certain number of Chevrolet Captiva (RHD) with 2.0L Diesel Engine Model Year 2007 - 2010 there is a potential for a fuel leak caused by a partial or complete disconnection of a fuel feed hose connector. This fuel leak leads to engine stalling and in a worst case it might potentially result in an engine bay fire. This fuel leak leads to engine stalling and in a worst case it might potentially result in an engine bay fire. No reported cases of fires.
records.remedy: Check and correct the fuel feed hose routing replace the fuel feed hose quick connector retainer and apply a warning sticker to advice that the retainer is a single-use part

records.concern: THE BLOWER-REGULATOR WIRING COULD BE DAMAGED AND COULD LEAD TO PARTIAL CONTACT OF INDIVIDUAL WIRE STRANDS
records.defect: The blower-regulator wiring could be damaged and could lead to partial contact of individual wire strands.
records.remedy: The blower-regulator wiring harness will be inspected and a new part will be installed. Additional components will be replaced if necessary as determined at the time of repair.

records.concern: ON BOARD DIAGNOSTIC SYSTEM MAY MALFUNCTION
records.defect: on a certain number of Movano B - Model Year 16 and 17 with LWK or L0D engine there are some problems of the OBD (on Board Diagnostic) which should be indicated but do not trigger the MIL (Malfunction Indication Lamp). occurs Possible faults which should be indicated but do not trigger the MIL (Malfunction Indication Lamp). Under worst-case conditions the OBD would recognize a failure on Exhaust System components (e.g. components of the Exhaust Gas Recirculation EGR) but would not display the failure with a malfunction indicator lamp.
records.remedy: Reprogram the K20 Engine Control Module via SPS with the latest software available on TIS2WEB:

records.concern: FRONT DOOR HANDLES MAY NOT BE INSTALLED CORRECTLY
records.defect: Driver and front passenger door exterior handles may not have been installed correctly.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles check installation of the door handles and if necessary replace and correctly install.

records.concern: SOME ELECTRICAL COMPONENTS MAY MALFUNCTION DUE TO WATER INFILTRATION
records.defect: On some Alfa Romeo Stelvio vehicles due to a potential nonconformity some electric-electronic components may malfunction as a result of water infiltrations and their performance may be compromised. The vehicle may not function as the driver expects it to during use including unintended activation and opening of the rear liftgate door at vehicle speeds up to 3.1 MPH. An unintended activation and opening of the rear liftgate door may result in a loss of unrestrained cargo. Lost cargo may create a road hazard and could cause a following vehicle to crash without prior warning.
records.remedy: Sealing and/or application of sealants in specific places will ensure full parts conformity is restored.

records.concern: HEAD RESTRAINT MAY BE INSECURE
records.defect: On a limited production period a burr may have developed on the locking bar of the head restraint guide.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles the left head restraint guide on both front seats must be replaced.

records.concern: HEAD RESTRAINT MAY BE INSECURE
records.defect: On a limited production period a burr may have developed on the locking bar of the head restraint guide.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles the left head restraint guide on both front seats must be replaced.

records.concern: CHILD LOCKS ON THE REAR DOORS MAY NOT OPERATE
records.defect: On some Rio models the child locks on the rear doors may not operate; this is caused by the incorrect length release lever cable being installed.
records.remedy: Replacement cable of correct length will be fitted to affected vehicles.

records.concern: STEERING COMPONENTS MAY BE INSUFFICIENTLY GROUNDED
records.defect: It has been determined that the steering airbag electrical components are insufficiently grounded. Failure of the steering column module clock spring could result in an inadvertent deployment of the driver airbag which may cause risk of injury to the driver and an increased risk of a potential collision.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles the manufacturer will fit a contact bridge to the outer race of the steering column top bearing which will provide correct grounding.

records.concern: AIRBAGS MAY NOT BE TRIGGERED IN THE EVENT OF A COLLISION
records.defect: On the affected vehicles an internal component within the airbag triggering ECU may have been damaged which could lead to non deployment. There are no early warning signs or symptoms for the customer to indicate if the ECU is incorrect.
records.remedy: The manufacturer has no simple method to check the internal component. Therefore all ECU's in affected vehicles to be changed as a precaution.

records.concern: AIRBAGS MAY NOT BE TRIGGERED IN THE EVENT OF A COLLISION
records.defect: On the affected vehicles an internal component within the airbag triggering ECU may have been damaged which could lead to non deployment. There are no early warning signs or symptoms for the customer to indicate if the ECU is incorrect.
records.remedy: The manufacturer has no simple method to check the internal component. Therefore all ECU's in affected vehicles to be changed as a precaution.

records.concern: FUEL MAY LEAK
records.defect: on a certain number of Antara (RHD) with 2.0L Diesel Engine Model Year 2007 - 2010 there is a potential for a fuel leak caused by a partial or complete disconnection of a fuel feed hose connector. This fuel leak leads to engine stalling and in a worst case it might potentially result in an engine bay fire. This fuel leak leads to engine stalling and in a worst case it might potentially result in an engine bay fire. No reported cases of fires.
records.remedy: to Check and correct the fuel feed hose routing replace the fuel feed hose quick connector retainer and apply a warning sticker to advice that the retainer is a single-use part

records.concern: REVERSE LIGHTS INTERACT WITH EPB
records.defect: Operation of the reversing lamp may be affected on certain vehicles. When the driver engages reverse gear and the Electric Park Brake (EPB) is applied the reversing lamps will not illuminate.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles download the latest software to correct this.

records.concern: SIDE AIRBAG INITIATOR MAY BE DEFECTIVE
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have been fitted with a defective side airbag initiator. This may cause the side airbag not to deploy in an accident.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles fit new side airbags.

records.concern: LONGITUDINAL AND TRANSVERSE CONTROL ARMS MAY BE PRONE TO CORROSION
records.defect: Internal tests have shown that the longitudinal and transverse control arms installed on the affected vehicles may be prone to corrosion. The durability of these components cannot therefore be unequivocally guaranteed. f the fastening bolts on the longitudinal and transverse control arms crack due to corrosion vehicle handling in extreme situations e.g. during race track driving may be restricted and this can increase the risk of an accident.
records.remedy: The affected components on the vehicles will therefore be replaced by components made of more robust material.

records.concern: OUTER REAR SEATBELTS MAY BE INCORRECTLY ROUTED AT THE ANCHOR POINT
records.defect: In a certain number of Insignia B - Model Year 18 the outer rear seatbelts might be incorrectly routed at anchor point. In the event of a frontal crash this may lead to a higher load than the belt system is designed for or it may allow the passenger to slip through under the seatbelt.
records.remedy: Vauxhall Authorised Repairers are instructed to check the seatbelt and change the routing if necessary on all affected vehicles.

records.concern: FUEL MAY LEAK FROM THE FILLER PLUG
records.defect: Risk of fuel leaking from the tank filler cap and valve plug.
records.remedy: MfR to replace filler cap seal and fit new style valve plug.

records.concern: FRONT ENGINE MOUNTING BOLTS MAY NOT BE TO CORRECT SPECIFICATION
records.defect: If continuously ridden in the condition the front engine mounting bolts may break and in the worse case the frame could break and cause a loss of control on the motorcycle: If continuously ridden in the condition the front engine mounting bolts may break and in the worse case the frame could break and cause a loss of control on the motorcycle.This could seriously affect the handling of the machine.
records.remedy: On affected machines check bolts for security and depending upon outcome of the inspection clean frame and replace bolts or replace bolts and frame.

records.concern: STEERING WHEEL MAY DETACH
records.defect: On affected vehicles when the steering wheel is turned form lock to lock it will be possible for the outer rim of the steering wheel to break away from the boss. If this occurs the vehicle cannot be steered by the driver.
records.remedy: The steering wheel airbag must be removed to determine the lot number of the steering wheel. If found to be faulty the steering wheel will be replaced.

records.concern: COOLANT MAY LEAK INTO ELECTRIC POWER CONTROL UNIT
records.defect: The Electric Power Control Unit (EPCU) to have some cracks in the aluminium casting which may cause the casting to become porous. The EPCU is cooled by a coolant channel and due to the porous cracks it is possible for the coolant to leak inside the EPCU unit causing the high voltage system to immediately shut down.
records.remedy: To inspect the units with UV lamp. If found to be porous the unit will be replaced.

records.concern: TRAILER CHASSIS MAY CRACK
records.defect: Affected machines may have been constructed using a steel grade other than that specified by the manufacturer leading to a risk of the chassis structural integrity being compromised.
records.remedy: Repair the chassis using chassis members constructed of the correct grade steel

records.concern: FRONT PASSENGER AIRBAG INFLATOR MAY FAIL
records.defect: Front passenger air bag inflator may fail.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace airbag inflator unit.

records.concern: DOOR LOCKS MAY MALFUNCTION AND ALLOW DOORS TO OPEN UNINTENTIONALLY
records.defect: On a number of Fiat Fullback vehicles in some weather conditions (high temperatures) the mechanism inside the door lock may not function as intended. This can allow the door(s) to open unintentionally.
records.remedy: The door locks must be replaced with compliant components.

records.concern: ALUMINIUM TRIM MAY PARTLY DETACH FROM LOUDSPEAKER TRIM IN DOORS AND CAUSE INJURY TO OCCUPANTS
records.defect: The aluminium trim may become detached from the loud speaker trim in the front or rear doors. Cuts and other injuries from the sharp edges may occur.
records.remedy: The affected vehicles will be recalled and all four aluminium strips on the loud speaker trims will be replaced.

records.concern: WATER INGRESS MAY CAUSE WINDSCREEN WIPER MOTOR TO FAIL
records.defect: On the affected vehicles the windscreen wiper motor breather system may not be To the correct specification. This could in some cases result in water ingress leading to jamming of the motor due to corrosion. This could cause the wipers to cease operation or not start which in turn could result in restricted visibility for the driver.
records.remedy: Replace the windscren wiper motor and one of the windscreen wiper mechanism rods.

records.concern: WATER INGRESS MAY CAUSE WINDSCREEN WIPER MOTOR TO FAIL
records.defect: On the affected vehicles the windscreen wiper motor breather system may not be To the correct specification. This could in some cases result in water ingress leading to jamming of the motor due to corrosion. This could cause the wipers to cease operation or not start which in turn could result in restricted visibility for the driver.
records.remedy: Replace the windscren wiper motor and one of the windscreen wiper mechanism rods.

records.concern: IGNITION SWITCH FAULT COULD CAUSE ENGINE TO STOP DURING USE
records.defect: Excess soldering flux is left on the terminals of the ignition switch; continuing to drive in this condition the remaining flux may soften and spread across and cause poor conduction of the ignition switch. In the worst-case scenario the engine could stop when the motorcycle is running.
records.remedy: Replace the ignition lock set.

records.concern: THE RETAINING CLIP IN THE ACTIVE HEAD RESTRAINT ASSEMBLY MAY NOT BE INSTALLED
records.defect: On vehicles with active head restraints the retaining clip which holds the extendible part of the head restraint in its end position may not have been installed.
records.remedy: Manufacturer to recall all affected vehicles to check for missing clip and replace if necessary.

records.concern: FRONT BRAKE FLEXI HOSE BRACKETS MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION
records.defect: Both front brake flexi hose brackets may not be to design specification. The brake flexi-hose may come into contact with the front tyres leading to chafing and ultimately a loss of brake fluid. Brake fluid loss will illuminate a red warning triangle on the instrument cluster and if sufficient brake fluid leaks out this will ultimately result in extended brake pedal travel combined with reduced braking performance and vehicle stopping distances will increase. Loss of one braking circuit could compromise vehicle stability and increase the risk of an accident.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and inspect the front brake flexi hose brackets. If the clearance is not to the required specification the technician will replace either one or both of the front brake flexi hose brackets.

records.concern: RISK OF FUEL LEAKAGE FROM TOP OF THE FUEL TANK
records.defect: There is a risk of a fuel leak from the filler neck area of the fuel tank.
records.remedy: On affected machines replace the fuel tank.

records.concern: RISK OF FUEL LEAKAGE FROM TOP OF THE FUEL TANK
records.defect: There is a risk of a fuel leak from the filler neck area of the fuel tank.
records.remedy: On affected machines replace the fuel tank.

records.concern: THROTTLE LEVER STOP MAY MALFUNCTION
records.defect: Throttle lever damaged during shipping.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace throttle lever.

records.concern: VIN GROSS COMBINATION WEIGHT INFORMATION IS INCORRECT
records.defect: VIN label contains incorrect Gross Combination Weight (GCW) information for manual and CVT vehicles.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the VIN label with a new one showing the correct information.

records.concern: BODY CONTROL MODULE MAY FAIL TO WARN DRIVER OF INDICATOR LIGHT MALFUNCTION
records.defect: Due to an incorrect software setting of the Body Control Module (BCM) the system may not trigger a warning (double speed flashing) in the case of a direction indicator lamp failure.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles reprogram the Body Control Module.

records.concern: ACCELERATOR PEDAL MAY BE INSTALLED INCORRECTLY
records.defect: On affected vehicles there is the possibility the electric plug connection of the accelerator pedal module is not secured correctly due to an assembly error. The assembly error could potentially lead to a loosening of the contact of the electric plug connection of the accelerator pedal and as a result throttle response may no longer be available. If this happens while driving the vehicle will decelerate to a walking pace and it can only be moved with the engine power available at idle speed.
records.remedy: To prevent this from occuring correct locking of the electric plug connection of the accelerator pedal has to be checked and confirmed by a Porsche dealership.

records.concern: INFLATOR IN DRIVER AIRBAG MODULE MAY NOT BE PRODUCED TO SPECIFICATION
records.defect: The driver airbag module may not have been produced to specification. This could lead to excessive pressure building up inside the inflator causing the inflator to rupture resulting in metal fragments passing through the airbag cushion material into the vehicle interior at high speed. This could lead to injury or death of the vehicle occupants.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the driver airbag module.

records.concern: RESTRICTED FUEL SUPPLY COULD CAUSE ENGINE TO STALL
records.defect: The sealing cap of the pressure-limiting valve in the fuel tank delivery module may be damaged. This concern could lead to a reduction in fuel transfer from the left side to the right side of the fuel tank. Therefore it is possible for the engine to stall even though the fuel gauge would show fuel present.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the fuel pressure of the delivery module and the distance of the cap on the pressure-limiting valve. Where necessary the delivery module will be replaced.

records.concern: RIGHT HAND SWITCH CUBE DOES NOT MEET QUALITY STANDARDS
records.defect: Some motorcycles have been manufactured with a right-hand switchcube that does not meet quality standards. Affected switch cubes may develop corrosion within the Stop/Run/Start circuit. If the key fob is stored on or near the motorcycle and all other safety interlocks are met this condition could lead to unintentional vehicle power-up or start sequence.
records.remedy: Affected machines will be recalled to dealerships who will pelace the righ-thand switch cube with an updated version.

records.concern: REAR WHEEL HUB BEARINGS MAY NOT BE TO CORRECT SPECIFICATION
records.defect: On affected vehicles the locking nut of the rear wheel hub bearings may not be correct to specification. In extreme cases this may affect control of the vehicle.
records.remedy: The recall consists of checking the hub nut and if the locking of the nut does not conform to specification replacing the stub axle and the hub.

records.concern: WINDSCREEN MAY NOT BE INSTALLED CORRECTLY
records.defect: on a certain number of Insignia B - Model Year 18 with special color option (RPO code: GAF) the windscreen might not be installed correctly and can potentially detach from body. The one affected vehicle was repaired in the Luton Technical Centre
records.remedy: Check the bonding of the windscreen and rework if required.

records.concern: FUEL RETURN LINE MAY LEAK
records.defect: The rigid fuel return pipe may break at the fuel pump module due to engine vibrations. This will allow fuel to leak onto the road surface which will be a hazard to other road users. Fuel may also leak onto hot engine parts with a risk of fire.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles the rigid pipes are to be replaced with flexible fuel hoses which will cancel the effects of engine vibration.

records.concern: AN ELECTRICAL SHORT CIRCUIT MAY OCCUR INSIDE THE ABS MODULE
records.defect: Affected vehicles might experience and electrical short inside the ABS control module. On the affected vehicles moisture can enter the ABS module electrical system. Over time the moisture can cause a short circuit. This could cause the ABS module to fail and in extreme instances increase the risk of a thermal incident inside the engine bay.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the Module printed circuit board with one which has additional sealing.

records.concern: ELECTRICAL WIRING IN STEERING ASSEMBLY MAY BE INSUFFICIENTLY GROUNDED
records.defect: The steering column clock spring may break. This will cause warning messages to illuminate in the instrument cluster but in extreme instances it may cause the driver's airbag to deploy.
records.remedy: Affected vehicles will be recalled to establish sufficient grounding of the steering components.

records.concern: ELECTRICAL WIRING IN STEERING ASSEMBLY MAY BE INSUFFICIENTLY GROUNDED
records.defect: The steering column clock spring may break. This will cause warning messages to illuminate in the instrument cluster but in extreme instances it may cause the driver's airbag to deploy.
records.remedy: Affected vehicles will be recalled to establish sufficient grounding of the steering components.

records.concern: FUEL MAY LEAK
records.defect: Under certain operating conditions resonance caused by fuel pressure could damage the pulsation damper in either of the high pressure fuel pumps. This damage can lead to abnormal noise/vibration and over time can cause the pump cover to develop a fatigue crack and fuel may leak.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the high pressure fuel pumps with a nev version.

records.concern: BRAKE LAMP SWITCH MAY MALFUNCTION
records.defect: The brake lamp switch may malfunction which can be identified by a Malfunction Indicator Lamp (MIL) illumination an audible chime and the brake lights will be illuminated. A malfunctioning brake switch could allow the vehicle to be shifted out of PARK without the brake pedal being depressed and could cause the rear brake lamps to be continuously illuminated. Being able to shift a vehicle out of PARK when the brake pedal is not depressed (and the ignition is in the RUN mode) and/or having the rear brake lamps continuously illuminated could cause a vehicle to crash without prior warning.
records.remedy: Replace the brake lamp switch.

records.concern: TRAILER LIGHTING MAY FAIL
records.defect: When towing a trailer the lights and/or the LED module mail fail due to incorrect contact between the towing harness and the trailer coupling.
records.remedy: Check affected vehicles for harness reference and replace where necessary.
models: TOW BAR FITTED TO DACIA DUSTER

records.concern: DIPPED HEADLIGHT MAY FAIL TO LIGHT THE ROAD AHEAD TO SUFFICIENT LEVEL
records.defect: Headlight (dipped beam) may not adjust correctly when switched on and therefore not light the road ahead sufficiently.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles make an adjustment of the headlight beam sensor.

records.concern: FUEL PUMP FLANGE MAY DEGRADE OVER TIME AND ALLOW FUEL TO LEAK
records.defect: Fuel pump flange that when exposed to chemicals may degrade and leak causing fire risk.
records.remedy: Fit a fuel pump cover to shield the pump flange from potential contamination.

records.concern: FUEL PUMP FLANGE MAY DEGRADE OVER TIME AND ALLOW FUEL TO LEAK
records.defect: Fuel pump flange that when exposed to chemicals may degrade and leak causing fire risk.
records.remedy: Fit a fuel pump cover to shield the pump flange from potential contamination.

records.concern: HEAT SHIELD UPGRADE REQUIRED
records.defect: Heat shield may not adequately shield exhaust gasses in the event of an exhaust silencer crack. This could cause nearby components to melt and pose a fire hazard.
records.remedy: Replace heat sheild on affected vehicles.

records.concern: SOFTWARE ERROR CAN CAUSE ENGINE TO FAIL
records.defect: On the subject vehicles the engine protection logic does not work properly. When the engine speed reaches maximum with no engine load present � the software is unable to cut the engine. This could in extreme cases cause catastrophic engine failure. Immediate and catastrophic engine damage may result.
records.remedy: Re-program the engine protection software within the PCM.

records.concern: LOSS OF POWER STEERING ASSISTANCE
records.defect: Potential failure of steering gear motor bolts when exposed to long term high corrosive environment. This can lead to loss of power assistance to the steering which would result in additional effort from the driver to steer the vehicle.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the aluminium bolts with stainless steel bolts. Where necessary the steering rack will be replaced.

records.concern: TIGHTENING TORQUE OF TOWBAR FIXING MAY BE TO WRONG SPECIFICATION
records.defect: Tightening of some towbar fixings may not be to correct specification.
records.remedy: Checking and if necessary correcting the tightening torque of the fixings.

records.concern: FUEL MAY LEAK
records.defect: The brazing of the fuel rail end caps is inconsistent and may not correctly seal the fuel rail ends. Fuel vapour and liquid fuel leaks can occur over time. This can lead to a liquid fuel leak into the engine bay.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the fuel rail with a correctly manufactured version.

records.concern: PINION NUT MAY LOOSEN
records.defect: For 5.10 type axle the pinion nut may over an extended period of time. become loose due to an undersized pinion shaft spline. This may cause the pinion flange to separate and in extreme cases the differential may seize.
records.remedy: On affected vehicle check pinion nut for tightness and fit a locking plate to the nut to prevent nut movement.

records.concern: SEAT BASE FRAME MAY BE DEFECTIVE
records.defect: Driver-side and passenger-side seatbase frames may have been improperly manufactured Driver-side seatbase frames may also contain a seat slider defect.
records.remedy: Frames on affected vehicles will be checked and if necessary replaced.

records.concern: STEERING COLUMN JOINT MAY NOT BE SECURE
records.defect: The Steering column may become detached from the rack due to incorrectly tightened bolt.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles check for presence of retaining nut. If present tighten nut to specified torque. If nut is absent replace bolt and screw and tighten to specified torque. THE MANUFACTURER HAS ADVISED NOT TO DRIVE THE VEHICLE.

records.concern: DASH WARNING LIGHT MAY FAIL TO WARN DRIVER WHEN BRAKE DISCS ARE WORN AND CAUSE DAMAGE TO DISCS
records.defect: The software algorithm that calculates the percentage value of wear on the carbo-ceramic brake discs of the vehicle may not function properly due to a software bug which under certain specific conditions may cause a reset of the wear value estimated by the software. The risk is that the critical threshold of wear of the brake discs is reached without the relevant warning lamp and message being shown to the driver. If such a condition occurs the worst case scenario could be damage to the brake discs with increased risk of an accident.
records.remedy: Update of software for the instrument panel node.

records.concern: INTEGRATED STARTER GENERATOR BELT BELT MAY FAIL
records.defect: Due to a lack of strength in the Integrated Starter Generator (ISG) Belt may break during usage. If this happens the water pump will become inoperative and the charging light will illuminate. The coolant temperature warning light will also light due to an increase in coolant temperature. In the worst case scenario the engine may stall and not restart.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the ISG belt.

records.concern: TYRE MAY HAVE INCORRECT RUBBER COMPOUND
records.defect: Certain tyres may have an incorrect rubber compound which may cause an in service noise unsatisfactory ride experience tread distortion and/or belt separation. If undetected the tyre may fail.
records.remedy: Owners of affected tyres should immediately contact the manufacturer's customer care (tyrecall@coopertire.com) to arrange an inspection and where necessary replacement.

records.concern: FASTENING NUT OF THE REAR AXLE HUB MAY WORK LOOSE
records.defect: on a certain number of Crossland X - Model Year 18 the Fastening Nut of the Rear Axle Hub might potentially become loose. This can lead to a separation of the rear wheel resulting in a loss of steering control.
records.remedy: Vauxhall Authorised Repairers are instructed to check both Rear Axle Hub Nuts for correct application of the securing punch if correct no further action. if incorrect replace hubstud and nut assembly

records.concern: FRONT WHEEL HUB MAY NOT BE MANUFACTURED TO CORRECT SPECIFICATION
records.defect: The front wheel hub may suffer cracking. Drivers may notice abnormal noise and in extreme cases the hub may fail.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles check manufacturing date of the wheel hubs and replace if required.

records.concern: STEERING COLUMN JOINT MAY NOT BE SECURE
records.defect: The Steering column may become detached from the rack due to incorrectly tightened bolt.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles check for presence of retaining nut. If present tighten nut to specified torque. If nut is absent replace bolt and screw and tighten to specified torque. THE MANUFACTURER HAS ADVISED NOT TO DRIVE THE VEHICLE

records.concern: FRONT WHEEL HUBS MAY CRACK
records.defect: The front wheel hub may suffer cracking. Drivers may notice abnormal noise and in extreme cases the hub may fail.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles check manufacturing date of the wheel hubs and replace if required

records.concern: FRONT WHEEL HUBS MAY CRACK
records.defect: The front wheel hub may suffer cracking. Drivers may notice abnormal noise and in extreme cases the hub may fail.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles check manufacturing date of the wheel hubs and replace if required.

records.concern: FRONT BRAKE DISCS MAY NOT BE CORRECT THICKNESS
records.defect: The front brake discs may not meet the required thickness dimension. Under extreme loads this could cause cracking which may lead to fractures.
records.remedy: The front discs on affected vehicles will be checked for conformity and where necessary they will be replaced.

records.concern: REAR SPOILER MAY BE INSECURE
records.defect: The rear spoiler may not have been properly attached Wind noise and deformation of the spoiler may occur. Continued use may cause the spoiler to detach.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles inspect the attachment of the spoiler and where necessary install new fixings.

records.concern: Passenger Airbag inflator
records.defect: The front passenger airbag inflator (PAB) may contain propellant that could possibly degrade over a period of time. This may cause metal fragments to pass through the air bag and into the vehicle interior at high speed which may result in injury to vehicle occupants in the event of a deployment event.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the inflator assembly.

records.concern: AIR CONDITIONING MAY FAIL TO DE-MIST INTERIOR WINDOWS
records.defect: The air inlet door linkages to the Heating Ventilation and Air Conditioning may detach become detached and depending on operating mode position cause unexpected severe condensation/fogging of the interior windows. At temperatures below 0 degrees Celsius where the linkage detaches in recirculation mode it may not be able to clear condensation/fog from the inside of the front windscreen or other windows which can restrict the driver�s field of vision and could lead to an increased risk of an accident.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and download the latest software to the vehicle. Additionally the actuator arm will be replaced.

records.concern: CASTING DEFECT MAY CAUSE ALLOY WHEEL(S) TO CRACK
records.defect: A small batch of alloy wheels may have a casting defect that may initiate a fatigue crack and result in wheel failure.
records.remedy: Check wheels on affected vehicles for a specific batch code. Replace those wheels which have the identified batch code.

records.concern: INTERCOOLER SLEEVE MAY DETACH FROM THE THROTTLE BODY
records.defect: The intercooler sleeve may detach from the throttle body. The engine management warning light will illuminate and a loss of power may occur.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the current retainer with a new version to ensure the sleeve connection between intercooler sleeve and throttle body.

records.concern: ROLL BAR CONFIGURATION DOES NOT MEET LEGAL REQUIREMENTS
records.defect: On AMG- GT R vehicles fitted with Track package the combination of Sport Seat and Rollbar does not meet requirements. In the rearmost postion it is possibel the seat headretraint could contact the roll bar.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the Rollbar

records.concern: BRAKE SERVO MAY FAIL
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have been fitted with a brake booster which may have a faulty diaphragm plate. This could lead to a loss of brake servo assistance.
records.remedy: An affected brake booster can be identified by its date of manufacture. This can be found on a label on the brake booster. An affected brake booster must be removed and replaced a new one.

records.concern: DRIVE CHAIN MAY STRETCH COME OFF OR BREAK
records.defect: When upshifting between first and second gear if the rider fails to engage second gear a neutral condition will exist continued opening of the throttle will cause high engine RPM. If the rider shifts in to second gear without disengaging the clutch under the very high RPM condition an excess load can be applied to the powertrain. This could cause the drive chain to stretch and in the worst case the drive chain could come off or break.
records.remedy: Replace ECM. Inspect drive chain if free play is detected replace drive chain assembly.

records.concern: WIRING TO ELECTRICAL LOOMS MAY BECOME DAMAGED
records.defect: On Wrightbus StreetLite (Micro Hybrid) vehicles that are fitted with electric cooling pack fans it is possible the electrical looms (cooling pack fan harness power cable and body harness looms) and the compressor delivery line hose may chafe on bodywork within the engine bay. This may affect the cooling fan operation and could lead to engine overheating or in extreme cases an outbreak of fire.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles check condition and routing of affected looms. Where necessary repair and re-route looms according to manufacturer's instructions.

records.concern: SUPPLEMENTARY RESTRAINT SYSTEM (SRS) MAY NOT PERFORM AS INTENDED IN A COLLISION
records.defect: The calibration of the Restraints control Module does not provide the correct fire signals in the event of a collision. In the event of a collision the supplementary Restraint System may not provide the level of protection required to the driver and front passenger and front seat occupants leading to an increased risk of injury.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and download the correct software to the vehicle.

records.concern: STEERING COLUMN JOINT MAY NOT BE SECURE
records.defect: The Steering column may become detached from the rack due to incorrectly tightened bolt
records.remedy: On affected vehicles check for presence of retaining nut. If present tighten nut to specified torque. If nut is absent replace bolt and screw and tighten to specified torque. THE MANUFACTURER HAS ADVISED NOT TO DRIVE THE VEHICLE.

records.concern: BATTERY MAY FAIL TO CHARGE WHICH COULD CAUSE ENGINE TO STALL AND LIGHTS TO FADE
records.defect: Due to incorrect software in the Engine Control Module (ECM) the ENG A-STOP (Engine Auto Stop Start System) OFF light may blink & the ENG A-STOP system may become inoperative. If the car is driven continuously in this condition the lead-acid battery will not be charged. In the worst case there is a possibility that the lights will dim and the engine may stall and not restart due to low battery voltage.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and reprogramme the ECM with corrected software.

records.concern: FUEL MAY LEAK
records.defect: The brazing of the fuel rail end caps is inconsistent and may not correctly seal the fuel rail ends. Fuel vapour and liquid fuel leaks can occur over time. This can lead to a liquid fuel leak into the engine bay.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the fuel rail with a correctly manufactured version.

records.concern: OIL SUMP MAY CRACK DUE TO THE ENGINE OVERHEATING
records.defect: The engine control module calibration may not adequately detect an overheat condition in certain 2.0L Duratorq Diesel engines. In extreme cases an overheated engine can result in a breach of the oil sump leading to loss of the engine oil.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and download revised software for the control module calibration that improves overheat detection and provides an instrument cluster warning indicator to the driver and engine de-rate strategy.

records.concern: REAR SPRING LOWER LEAF MAY BREAK AND DETACH
records.defect: Due to a fault in the manufacturing process the lower leaf of the parabolic spring may break. The leaf may detach and fall on to the road surface.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles examine spring and where necessary replace leaves.

records.concern: BRAKE AND/OR CLUTCH SYSTEM COMPONENTS MAY BECOME DAMAGED BY MINERAL OIL
records.defect: The brake/clutch system components may be damaged and system performance may decay as a result of the potential presence of mineral oil in the brake-clutch fluid because the components are not compatible with mineral oil. As a result brake/clutch system performance may deteriorate.
records.remedy: Replace the components in the brake-clutch system.

records.concern: CONNECTION IN FUSE BOX MAY BE INSECURE
records.defect: The bus bar of the fuse panel on the power distribution board (PDB) could be loose. This may cause faults in circuits associated with the fuse board circuits.
records.remedy: Check the PDB production period and if necessary replace the screws with new ones.

records.concern: KEY INFORMATION ABOUT PASSEGER PROTECTION SYSTEMS IS NOT INCLUDED IN OWNER'S MANUAL
records.defect: Owner's Manuals with incomplete information about the restraint system were delivered. Warnings instructions and information for 'Proactive Passenger Protection System' 'Airbag System' and 'Transporting Children Safely' are missing from the Owner's Manual. Without correct instruction it is possible for someone to unknowingly put another in danger.
records.remedy: Notify the vehicle owners so a supplement can be be added to the Owner�s Manual.

records.concern: REPLACE FRONT PASSENGER AIRBAG
records.defect: The front passenger airbag may be faulty. There may be insufficient protection especially for smaller passengers in the front seat because of incorrectly folded passenger airbags.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the passenger airbag.

records.concern: REPLACE FRONT PASSENGER AIRBAG
records.defect: The front passenger airbag may be faulty. There may be insufficient protection especially for smaller passengers in the front seat because of incorrectly folded passenger airbags.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the passenger airbag.

records.concern: STARTER MOTOR MAY MALFUNCTION AND OVERHEAT
records.defect: On vehicles with diesel engines and stop/start system the starter motor may be permanently activated because the return spring in the solenoid switch is bent or broken. If the permanent current supply to the starter motor is not noticed overheating of the component with local scorching damage and a vehicle fire is possible.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the solenoid switch.

records.concern: STARTER MOTOR MAY MALFUNCTION AND OVERHEAT
records.defect: On vehicles with diesel engines and stop/start system the starter motor may be permanently activated because the return spring in the solenoid switch is bent or broken. If the permanent current supply to the starter motor is not noticed overheating of the component with local scorching damage and a vehicle fire is possible.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the solenoid switch.

records.concern: STARTER MOTOR MAY MALFUNCTION AND OVERHEAT
records.defect: On vehicles with diesel engines and stop/start system the starter motor may be permanently activated because the return spring in the solenoid switch is bent or broken. If the permanent current supply to the starter motor is not noticed overheating of the component with local scorching damage and a vehicle fire is possible.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the solenoid switch.

records.concern: POTENTIAL LOSS OF BRAKE FUNCTION ON BIKES FITTED WITH ABS
records.defect: If the brake fluid has not been changed as per manufacturer's instructions deposits may form which may affect the operation of the ABS module. Continued use may lead to loss of braking.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles flush the brake systems and replace with an uprated specification fluid.

records.concern: FUEL FILTER SUPPORT MAY BREAK
records.defect: The fuel filter support bracket may crack and the fuel filter could become insecure As a result the fuel filter and or fuel tube may leak.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the fuel filter support bracket Check condition of filter and fuel tube. Replace if necessary

records.concern: INSTRUMENT CLUSTER MAY DISPLAY INCORRECT INFORMATION
records.defect: Due to a nonconformity in the production process the instrument cluster may stick and display incorrect speed information.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the instrument cluster.

records.concern: AIRBAG INFLATOR BODY MAY RUPTURE DURING DEPLOYMENT
records.defect: In the event that the airbag is activated it may overinflate due to overly aggressive combustion of the propellant. As a result the excessive internal pressure may cause the inflator body to rupture and metal fragments may pass through the cushion material causing severe injury to the rider.
records.remedy: On affected machines replace the airbag assembly.

records.concern: PASSENGER AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY CORRECTLY
records.defect: The propellant used in the air bag inflators may degrade over time due to heat cycles and exposure to moisture. In the event that the airbag is activated it may overinflate due to overly aggressive combustion of the propellant. The excessive internal pressure may cause the inflator body to rupture and metal fragments may pass through the cushion material causing severe injury to the vehicle occupants.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the airbag inflator and airbag.

records.concern: PASSENGER AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY CORRECTLY
records.defect: The propellant used in certain air bag inflators may degrade over time due to heat cycles and exposure to moisture. In the event that the airbag is activated it may overinflate due to overly aggressive combustion of the propellant. The excessive internal pressure may cause the inflator body to rupture and metal fragments may pass through the cushion material possibly causing severe injury to the vehicle occupants.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the airbag inflator unit.

records.concern: CATALYTIC CONVERTER SUPPORT BRACKET MAY BE INSECURE
records.defect: The screws retaining the catalytic converter bracket on the engine bracket may have an incorrect clench. This could lead to vibration and cause the exhaust to crack.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles check screws according to manufacturer's procedures..Depending on findings either replace screws or refer to manufacturer for further guidance

records.concern: BONDING OF THE WINDSHIELD MAY BE INADEQUATE
records.defect: The bonding of the windshield in the lower area may not correspond to the specification. During a collision the bonding may fail and the windscreen may detach. This could have an adverse affect on the effectiveness of the passenger airbag.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles check bonding and if necessary replace windscreen.

records.concern: DRIVER'S DOOR PANEL MAY DETACH
records.defect: The bonding on the panelling under driver's window may be incorrect and the panel could detach.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the panel with a correctly bonded version.

records.concern: AUXILLIARY HEATER ELEMENT IN AIR CONDITIONING MAY FAIL AND/OR OVERHEAT
records.defect: The auxiliary heater element in the air conditioner may fail as the result of overheating in the area of the connectors. This can lead to smoulder damage or potentially a fire.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and change the auxiliary heater element for one with optimised electrical connectors.

records.concern: FUEL MAY LEAK
records.defect: The fuel tank shield may foul the fuel supply pipes. Over a period of time this may cause a fuel leak.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles check condition of fuel pipes and replace where necessary. In addition add extra protection to existing and replacement pipes.

records.concern: DOOR LATCHING MECHANISM MAY MALFUNCTION IN HOT TEMPERATURES
records.defect: The locking mechanism in the door latch assembly may not operate properly in high temperatures. As a result the door may latch correctly and may unintentionally open whilst driving.
records.remedy: A modified assembly is available and depending on vehicle identification number the remedy is to replace either both O/S door latches or on all four doors.

records.concern: ECU RELAY MAY OVERHEAT AND CAUSE ECU TO MALFUNCTION
records.defect: The engine Electronic Control Unit Relay may overheat and fail. This could interrupt power supply to the engine and will cause the engine malfunction warning lamp to illuminate. The engine may stall and may not restart.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles the engine ECU power relay will be replaced with a new relay.

records.concern: ENGINE MAY OVERHEAT
records.defect: The engine electronic cooling management control strategy and the maximum temperature alert threshold could cause the engine to overheat. This could result in a warning light and a message being displayed on the instrument panel.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles download a new engine management software in order to modify the cooling management parameters to improve the control of the engine operating temperature.

records.concern: ENGINE MAY OVERHEAT
records.defect: The engine electronic cooling management control strategy and the maximum temperature alert threshold could cause the engine to overheat. This could result in a warning light and a message being displayed on the instrument panel.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles download a new engine management software in order to modify the cooling management parameters to improve the control of the engine operating temperature.

records.concern: PASSENGER AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY AS INTENDED
records.defect: A connection between the detonator and generator in the front passenger airbag module may not be correctly welded. Therefore the airbag may not be triggered in the event of a collision.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the front passenger airbag module.

records.concern: PASSENGER AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY AS INTENDED
records.defect: The weld joint that joins the central tube for the dash panel to the chute may be defective. The result could be damage to the passenger airbag potentially reducing the airbag�s protective capabilities.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the dashboard with a quality assured unit.

records.concern: HEAD AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY CORRECTLY
records.defect: The Head airbag may have been damaged during installation. As a result the airbag may not deploy correctly after activation.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles inspect and where necessary relace the Head airbag module

records.concern: TRANSMISSION MAY FAIL
records.defect: The strength of some gears in the transmission may not be sufficient and could break if they receive excessive impact force during shifting. Drive could be lost and In the worst case the transmission may lock.
records.remedy: On affected machines replace the 2nd 3rd and 4th output gears and the 2nd input gear

records.concern: RISK OF ELECTRICAL SHORT CIRCUIT
records.defect: A potential chafing condition has been identified between the alternator power cables and urea coolant pipe which may result in short circuit. Electrical cables might short circuit.
records.remedy: Add a rubber spacer with cable tie to secure power cables from chafing on coolant pipe. If the power cable is identified to be damaged the cable will be replaced.

records.concern: FUEL MAY LEAK FROM TANK FILLER NOZZLE
records.defect: Due to a deviation in the manufacturing process the fuel tank filler nozzle may leak. A modified version has been developed.
records.remedy: On affected machines replace the fuel tank filler neck and gasdket. The fule level sensor must alsio be replaced.

records.concern: BONDING OF THE WINDSHIELD MAY BE INADEQUATE
records.defect: The bonding of the windshield in the lower area may not correspond to the specification. During a collision the bonding may fail and the windscreen may detach. This could have an adverse affect on the effectiveness of the passenger airbag.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles check bonding and if necessary replace windscreen.

records.concern: PASSENGER AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY AS INTENDED
records.defect: There is a possibility of a faulty weld on the gas generator. If the airbag is deployed there is a risk that parts could be projected into the cabin with risk of injury to the occupants.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the front passenger air bag module with a correctly manufactured version.

records.concern: FUEL MAY LEAK
records.defect: The fuel tank shield may foul the fuel supply pipes. Over a period of time this may cause a fuel leak.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles check condition of fuel pipes and replace where necessary. In addition add extra protection to existing and replacement pipes.

records.concern: PASSENGER AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY AS INTENDED
records.defect: There is a possibility of a faulty weld on the gas generator. If the airbag is deployed there is a risk that parts could be projected into the cabin with risk of injury to the occupants.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the front passenger air bag module with a correctly manufactured version.

records.concern: FRONT SEAT BELT TENSIONERS MAY NOT FUNCTION
records.defect: The front seatbelt pre-tensioner ignitors may not perform as expected. This could increase the risk of injury to the seat occupants. The lock function of the seatbelts is not impaired.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace seatbelts with quality assured units.

records.concern: BACKREST COULD FOLD FORWARD UNDER HEAVY LOAD
records.defect: The latching element of the Easy Entry Kit on the driver's seat does not lock correctly into the lower swinging arm. As a result the backrest could fold under heavy load such as in a collision or unsecured load in the rear and harsh braking.
records.remedy: The vehicle that is likely to be affected will be recalled and a new seat mechanism fitted. R/2018/027 refers.

records.concern: INCORRECT THROTTLE PEDAL FITTED
records.defect: An incorrect accelerator pedal may be fitted which could cause discomfort or in extreme circumstances the pedal may get suck under the floor mat.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the accelerator pedal fitted. Replace the pedal where necessary.

records.concern: ENGINE COMPONENT MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION
records.defect: An engine component may not be to specification which could result in loss of engine performance. This may lead to the engine stalling and potentially causing an engine failure. In very unlikely circumstances the vehicle speed may increase without warning but will stop on its own after a few seconds.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles carry out a functional diagnostic check of the engine. If necessary replace the engine.

records.concern: ENGINE STALL
records.defect: Certain riding styles can cause the engine to stall.
records.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and download revised software for the engine management.

records.concern: PASSENGER AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY AS INTENDED
records.defect: There is a possible faulty weld to the gas generator. If the airbag is deployed there is a potential danger to the vehicle occupants by gas generator parts being ejected into the cabin.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the airbag inflator unit.

records.concern: ELECTRICAL WIRING IN STEERING ASSEMBLY MAY BE INSUFFICIENTLY GROUNDED
records.defect: The steering column clock spring may break. This will cause warning messages to illuminate in the instrument cluster but in extreme instances it may cause the driver's airbag to deploy.
records.remedy: Affected vehicles will be recalled to establish sufficient grounding of the steering components.

records.concern: ELECTRICAL WIRING IN STEERING ASSEMBLY MAY BE INSUFFICIENTLY GROUNDED
records.defect: The steering column clock spring may break. This will cause warning messages to illuminate in the instrument cluster but in extreme instances it may cause the driver's airbag to deploy.
records.remedy: Affected vehicles will be recalled to establish sufficient grounding of the steering components.

records.concern: ELECTRICAL WIRING IN STEERING ASSEMBLY MAY BE INSUFFICIENTLY GROUNDED
records.defect: The steering column clock spring may break. This will cause warning messages to illuminate in the instrument cluster but in extreme instances it may cause the driver's airbag to deploy.
records.remedy: Affected vehicles will be recalled to establish sufficient grounding of the steering components.

records.concern: POSSIBILITY OF A FUEL LEAK
records.defect: In certain specific conditions fuel may leak from the low pressure line due to a compatibility issue between the fuel filter and fuel line connector.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the fuel line connector and fit an improved filter.

records.concern: SKID CONTROL ECU MAY MALFUNCTION
records.defect: The Skid Control ECU may incorrectly interpret signals and may malfunction. This may affect the operation of the Electronic Parking Brake (EPB) although an EPB warning lamp will illuminate and a warning message will display.
records.remedy: On affected vehicle reprogramme the skid control ECU to correct this.

records.concern: BOTTOM OF THE FUEL TANK MAY CORRODE AND ALLOW FUEL TO LEAK
records.defect: The distance between the packing holder and the filler of the fuel tank cap is unsuitable. If the tank cap packing becomes swollen and climbs over the filler sealing failure occurs. When the fuel level is high in that condition if rapid acceleration and deceleration are repeated the fuel level will fluctuate making fuel leak from the gap between the filler mouth and the fuel tank cap packing. The leaked fuel will then be discharged onto the road surface via the drain tube. The fact that fuel leakage may occur under these conditions may constitute a violation of regulations. In addition to this if water from washing the unit enters inside the fuel tank from the sealing area the engine may malfunction. In the worst case the bottom of the fuel tank may corrode and if it is continued to be used in that state corrosion would progress and fuel may leak from the tank.
records.remedy: Fuel tank caps for all the vehicles are to be replaced with modified parts. At the same time Honda will inspect how well the caps are sealed and if water is inside the tanks. If water is found in tanks Honda will replace fuel tanks fuel pumps and injectors for steel fuel tanks and fuel pumps and injectors for titanium fuel tanks. Titanium fuel tanks do not get rusty and do not have to be replaced.

records.concern: PASSENGER AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY AS INTENDED
records.defect: The propellant in the front passenger airbag inflator might degrade over time which could cause the inflator body torture in the event the airbag is deployed. This could cause injury to occupants.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the passenger airbag.

records.concern: FRONT LOWER SUSPENSION ARM BALL JOINT CASTING MAY CRACK / BREAK
records.defect: The front lower arm ball joint casting may have a crack due to inappropriate manufacturing process being used. In extreme driving conditions this could cause the casting to break and the ball joint to become detached. If this happens it could result in the driver losing control of the vehicle.
records.remedy: Replace both left side and right side lower arms with modified units.

records.concern: FUEL MAY LEAK
records.defect: On the subject vehicles the resin fuel pump rings located on the top surface of the fuel tank may deteriorate by heat from the engine and exhaust pipes. Over time this deterioration could cause the fuel tank to leak which may increase the risk a vehicle fire. The resin fuel pump discharge pipe mounted to the upper part of the fuel pump body (within the fuel tank) may also deteriorate following exposure to heat from the engine and exhaust systems. This deterioration may cause the pipe to crack creating a fuel leak which could increase the risk of a vehicle fire. Fuel may leak from either the upper surface of the fuel tank and /or the fuel pump discharge pipe. In the worst case this may result in a fuel leak. This in turn could increase the risk of a vehicle fire.
records.remedy: Replacement of the resin fuel pump rings and the fitment of heat insulating pads on the upper surface of the fuel tank to prevent future deterioration by heat of the engine and exhaust systems. The fuel pump filter body will also be replaced with a modified version in order to address the concern of the deterioration of the fuel discharge pipe.

records.concern: DRIVER'S AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY AS INTENDED
records.defect: The driver's airbag inflator may rupture due to uncontrolled burning of propellant. As a consequence violent deployment of the airbag may cause injuries to occupants.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles inspect and replace the driver's air bag where necessary.

records.concern: LOSS OF ENGINE POWER
records.defect: The resistor for the low pressure fuel pump may fail which can cause loss of power and eventually the engine to shut down.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the low pressure fuel pump resistor.

records.concern: THE FLOATING PISTON IN THE FRONT BRAKE MASTER CYLINDER MAY CRACK
records.defect: A manufacturing defect exists in a production batch of front brake master cylinder components which MV AGUSTA has installed on a series of F4 RR and F4 RC model motorcycles. The defect in the front brake master cylinder could cause it to malfunction during normal use of the motorcycle leading to a loss of front braking ability and increasing the risk of a crash. Specifically crack generation on the front brake master cylinder PPS (polyphenilene sulphide) piston connecting the internal pressure area to the external surface. The consequence is that the front brake may not participate in stopping the bike properly. The rear brake is not affected and works correctly.
records.remedy: Replace the synthetic piston in the front brake master cylinder with one made from aluminium machined from solid billet guaranteeing a higher strength material as well as eliminating the possibility of porosity.

records.concern: LOSS OF POWER ASSISTANCE TO STEERING
records.defect: In certain cases a driver may experience sudden loss of power assistance to the steering due to voltage irregularities in the Electro Hydraulic Power Steering (EHPS) system.
records.remedy: This is a further action to a previous recall. On affected vehicles the invertor software is to be further updated to cope with voltage spikes / drops and to improve fault tracing. The braided earth cable will also be replaced by a copper cable to ensure the invertor earthing is secured.

records.concern: PASSENGER AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY AS INTENDED
records.defect: A connection between the detonator and generator in the front passenger airbag module may not be correctly welded. Therefore the airbag may not be triggered in the event of a collision.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the front passenger airbag module.

records.concern: PASSENGER AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY AS INTENDED
records.defect: Due to a process deviation in the production front passenger airbag module the connection between detonator and generator may not be sufficient. This may cause the airbag not to deploy as intended.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the front passenger air bag module with a correctly manufactured version.

records.concern: CENTRAL HINGE IN REAR SEATS MAY FAIL UNDER LOAD
records.defect: In the event of heavy breaking such as an emergency stop or an impact with heavy luggage in the boot the rear seats central hinge may break. There would be no prior warning to the customer. In extreme circumstances may cause the luggage to enter the passage compartment.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and fit a reinforcing bracket.

records.concern: IT MAY BE POSSIBLE TO START THE VEHICLE WITHOUT DEPRESSSING THE CLUTCH PEDAL.
records.defect: The clutch pedal inhibitor may fail and it will then be possible to start the vehicle in gear without pressing the clutch pedal down.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles fit a modified clutch inhibitor switch to prevent this.

records.concern: FUEL MAY LEAK
records.defect: On vehicles fitted with the high power R diesel engine fuel may leak from the fuel feed pipe connection at the high pressure pump. Drivers would feel a lack of power from the engine and possibly smell diesel.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the feed pipe with a new version.

records.concern: BOLTS ON THE EXHAUST SIDE OF THE TURBOCHARGER ASSEMBLY MAY BE INCORRECTLY TIGHTENED
records.defect: Affected vehicles have a 2.0 litre turbocharged diesel engine. There is a possibility that the bolts on the exhaust-side of the turbocharger assembly may not have been correctly tightened during manufacture.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles check bolts. Where necessary replace the turbocharger.

records.concern: HANDBRAKE MAY DISENGAGE UNEXPECTEDLY
records.defect: On the subject vehicles the tolerances of the teeth on the handbrake sector gear are outside Mazda Corporations design secifications. This reduces engagement between the handbrake sector gear and the ratchet pawl and can cause the handbrake to disengage unexpectedly. This could cause the parking brake to release unintentionally and the vehicle to move unexpectedly.
records.remedy: Replacement of Handbrake lever mechanism.

records.concern: THE FLOATING PISTON IN THE FRONT BRAKE MASTER CYLINDER MAY CRACK
records.defect: Because of a manufacturing fault the floating piston in the front brake master cylinder may crack under high stress conditions typical of track use frequent ABS interventions or if a machine is dropped. This could reduce the efficiency of the front brake.
records.remedy: On affected machines replace the floating piston in the front brake master cylinder with a modified version

records.concern: THE FLOATING PISTON IN THE FRONT BRAKE MASTER CYLINDER MAY CRACK
records.defect: Because of a manufacturing fault the floating piston in the front brake master cylinder may crack under high stress conditions typical of track use frequent ABS interventions or if a machine is dropped. This could reduce the efficiency of the front brake.
records.remedy: On affected machines replace the floating piston in the front brake master cylinder with a modified version.

records.concern: INADVERTANT AIRBAG DEPLOYMENT
records.defect: When combined with a damaged steering column control module clock spring and insufficient grounding of the steering column an electrostatic discharge may lead to an inadvertent deployment of the driver's airbag. Drivers will be alerted to a potential fault by the airbag warning in the instrument cluster and an additional warning message.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles install a contact bridge and a contact spring that will provide a suitable ground for the steering column.

records.concern: FUEL LINE MAY LEAK
records.defect: Due to material imperfections the fuel delivery line may leak at line unions. This is more likely after prolonged use.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the fuel delivery line.

records.concern: POSSIBILITY OF A FUEL LEAK
records.defect: There is a possibility that the resin weld between the fuel tank and the fuel inlet pipe may be insufficient because the fuel tank and fuel inlet pipe were misaligned during the manufacturing process.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the fuel tank with a correctly manufactured version.

records.concern: WATER MAY ENTER REAR LIGHT WIRING HARNESS AND CAUSE CORROSION
records.defect: Due to a manufacturing error water may enter a rear light wiring harness. This may cause corrosion and may adversely affect operation of the rear lights
records.remedy: On affected machines replace the harness and check for other corrosion. If other corrosion is present replace or repair components.

records.concern: THE FLOATING PISTON IN THE FRONT BRAKE MASTER CYLINDER MAY CRACK
records.defect: Because of a manufacturing fault the floating piston in the front brake master cylinder may crack under high stress conditions typical of track use frequent ABS interventions or if a machine is dropped. This could reduce the efficiency of the front brake.
records.remedy: On affected machines replace the floating piston in the front brake master cylinder with a modified version.

records.concern: THE WHEELCHAIR RAMP DOES NOT LOCK CORRECTLY
records.defect: The wheelchair ramp on affected vehicles may not lock correctly
records.remedy: Update the control unit software.

records.concern: A-PILLAR PASSENGER PROTECTION TRIMS MAY PEEL OFF IN SUB-ZERO TEMPERATURES
records.defect: A-pillar trims are fitted to the vehicle affected with a fleece on their inner side which may peel off during temperatures below zero. This fleece should prevent the broken off parts of the A-pillar trim from entering the vehicles interior during a head airbag activation. If the fleece has peeled off the broken parts of the trim could penetrate into the interior potentially injuring the occupants.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and fit new front A-pillar trims.

records.concern: PARKING BRAKE MAY NOT FUNCTION AS INTENDED
records.defect: This affects vehicles with double drive axles and a trailing axle. Under very specific axle load conditions including lowered chassis and slippery or loose terrain traction at both drive axles may be compromised and the vehicle may move.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles fit spring brake actuators to the trailing axle.

records.concern: POSITIVE BATTERY CABLE MAY HAVE BEEN INCORRECTLY FITTED
records.defect: The battery positive lead may have been incorrectly fitted and may chafe. This may cause a short circuit.
records.remedy: Check cable on affected vehicles. Where necessary correctly fit the positive cable and if damaged replace with new cable.

records.concern: FRAME MAY CRACK
records.defect: Cracks may appear on the side tubes between the engine mounting point and the lower cradle which could cause the frame to fail.
records.remedy: On affected machines inspect the frame for signs of damage. Fit t reinforcement plates and where cracks are found replace the frame. For other damage in the designated area the manufacturer should be contacted for further advice.

records.concern: SEATBELT PRETENSIONER MAY NOT OPERATE
records.defect: Due to a deviation in the suppliers production process a specific squib batch may not comply with specifications In the event of an accident during which the left or right hand seat belt tensioner in the rear is activated with out squib ignition the belt may not fully restrain the occupant.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the left and right hand rear seat belts with a correct version.

records.concern: THE ENGINE CYLINDER HEAD MAY CRACK
records.defect: Localized overheating of the engine cylinder head may cause the cylinder head to crack.This may cause a pressurized oil leak which in extreme circumstances could result in a fire in the engine compartment.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles Inspect engine and cooling system. Replace affected components and fit a Coolant Level Sensor along with associated software to provide and audible and visual warning to the driver.

records.concern: THE ENGINE CYLINDER HEAD MAY CRACK
records.defect: Localized overheating of the engine cylinder head may cause the cylinder head to crack.This may cause a pressurized oil leak which in extreme circumstances could result in a fire in the engine compartment.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles Inspect engine and cooling system. Replace affected components and fit a Coolant Level Sensor along with associated software to provide and audible and visual warning to the driver.

records.concern: AUXILLIARY HEATER ELEMENT IN AIR CONDITIONING MAY FAIL AND/OR OVERHEAT
records.defect: The auxilliary heater element in the air conditioner may fail as a result of overheating in the area of the connectors in conjunction with smoulder damage or potential fire.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and fit an auxilliary heater element with opimised electrical connectors. The activation of the electric auxilliary heater must be adjusted by updating the software for the air conditioning control console.

records.concern: PASSENGER SEAT OCCUPANCY SENSING SYSTEM MAY MALFUNCTION
records.defect: The passenger seat occupancy classification system may not function as specified. This may cause or adversely affect the operation of the passenger air bag. deployment.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles update the software and if necessary replace the passenger seat cushion.

records.concern: STEERING MAY FAIL
records.defect: The steering shaft has the potential to separate from the steering rack assembly. If this occurs it may result in a loss of vehicle steering control.
records.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and ensure the locating plate is fitted correctly. An additional plate will be fitted to ensure the locating plate cannot come out of its fixing.

records.concern: ENGINE COMPONENT MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION
records.defect: An engine component may not be to specification which could result in loss of engine performance. This may lead to the engine stalling and potentially causing an engine failure. In very unlikely circumstances the vehicle speed may increase without warning but will stop on its own after a few seconds.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles carry out a functional diagnostic check of the engine. If necessary replace the engine.

records.concern: ENGINE COMPONENT MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION
records.defect: An engine component may not be to specification which could result in loss of engine performance. This may lead to the engine stalling and potentially causing an engine failure. In very unlikely circumstances the vehicle speed may increase without warning but will stop on its own after a few seconds.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles carry out a functional diagnostic check of the engine. If necessary replace the engine.

records.concern: HUB NUT MAY NOT BE TIGHTENED TO CORRECT TORQUE
records.defect: This affects vehicles with the AS903 Tag Axle fitted. The wheel hub retaining nut may not be correctly tightened.
