The nut may come loose which will allow the hub to float and in the worst case detach. Movement of the hub should in the first instance cause the ABS warning lamp to illuminate.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the nut along with a locking washer and tighten to the recommended torque.

records.concern: THE ENGINE PISTONS MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION
records.defect: The engine pistons may not be according to specification leading to oil entry in the inlet circuit. In a worst case this may cause an increased engine rpm for a few seconds possibly resulting in a total engine failure.
records.remedy: Perform a test of the engine to establish if the pistons are to specification. Where necessary the engine will be replaced.

records.concern: TAILGATE GAS SPRING END CAP MAY CORRODE AND COME OFF
records.defect: Anti-corrosion treatment of the gas spring end cap in production was insufficient. The tailgate gas spring end cap corrodes to such an extent that the gas pressure inside can force the end cap to come off. In the worst case the end cap can hit the customer and/or the tailgate can fall down suddenly and result in possible injury.
records.remedy: The anti-corrosion coating has been improved in vehicle production. On affected vehicles the rear tailgate gas springs will be replaced with improved gas springs.

records.concern: WATER INGRESS MAY DAMAGE THE WIPER MOTOR
records.defect: Due to inappropriate water proof structure of the front deck water can ingress into the wiper motor. Water accumulated around the air breather hole might enter into the wiper motor when the motor is cooling down after operation. As a result the internal part of the front wiper motor may rust and seize In the worst case the wiper motor may not operate.
records.remedy: The waterproof fabric has been introduced to the air breather cap since 10/01/2014 for RHD wiper motors. Check which type of breather cap is fitted and replace with new motor if the latest waterproof type is not fitted.

records.concern: PARKING BRAKE LEVER MAY FAIL TO ENGAGE CORRECTLY
records.defect: The parking brake lever may not engage correctly when the vehicle is pulled up because the teeth in the ratchet mechanism may balance on the tooth tops. In this condition teeth may slip out of place due to vibration.In extreme instances the lever may be released due to inadequate spring force inside the ratchet mechanism and the vehicle may move.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the handbrake lever with a unit with improved spring pressure.

records.concern: RETAINING RING OF THE FRONT BEARING MAY BE INCORRECTLY LOCATED
records.defect: The front wheel bearing retaing ring may not be correctly fitted. this may allow the axle to float in the hub.
records.remedy: On affected vehciles check location of retaing ring. Refit or replace where necessary. R/2017/323

records.concern: RETAINING RING OF THE FRONT BEARING MAY BE INCORRECTLY LOCATED
records.defect: The front wheel bearing retaing ring may not be correctly fitted; this may allow the axle to float in the hub.
records.remedy: On affected vehciles check location of retaing ring. Refit or replace where necessary.

records.concern: AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION MALFUNCTION MAY AFFECT VEHICLE EMISSIONS
records.defect: Incorrect software in the engine control module can lead to malfunctions of the automatic transmission that could affect vehicle emissions. There may be no communication of the defect to the driver (MIL) and the defect would not be visible to a scanning diagnostic tool during servicing. There is no known concern affecting the safety of the automatic transmission in relation to this campaign but vehicle emissions may not be to the manufacturers specification.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and reprogram the Electronic Control Module with latest level software.

records.concern: DRIVER'S AIRBAG MAY DEPLOY
records.defect: The steering column has no electrical connection to ground other than the spiral cable. In the event that the spiral cable is damaged the airbag warning light will illuminate. If the customer ignores the warning light and continues to drive for extended periods electrostatic charge may be discharged through the electrical circuit of the drivers airbag. In an extreme case this discharge could be sufficient to trigger an unintended deployment of the driver airbag.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and fit a slip ring to the steering column on all potentially affected vehicles.

records.concern: FUEL MAY LEAK
records.defect: There is a possibility that the wall thickness of the fuel tank may be thinner than specification due to improper tank moulding at the supplier. This may allow fuel to leak which could ignite if an ignition source is present..
records.remedy: On affected vehicles inspect walls of tank and replace where necessary

records.concern: FUEL MAY LEAK
records.defect: Possible fouling between fuel lines and the fuel tank shield may over time cause the pipes to wear and fail. Over an extended period of time fuel leakage may be noticed under the vehicle.
records.remedy: On the affected vehicles check condition of the fuel lines. Replace where necessary and add extra protection.

records.concern: TOWING EYE MAY BE DEFETCIVE
records.defect: The welding of the towing eye in the vehicle tool kit may not be fail-proof and may detach if the vehicle is towed.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the towing eye with an improved version.

records.concern: SEAT BELT SECURING BOLTS MAY NOT BE CORRECTLY TIGHTENED.
records.defect: The bolts securing the seat belts to the B- and C-pillars on the left side of the vehicle may possibly not have been tightened to specification.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles check bolts for tightness and if necessary tighten to correct torque.

records.concern: EXHAUST GAS TEMPERATURES MAY DROP BELOW THE OPTIMAL OPERATIONAL LEVEL
records.defect: Exhaust gas temperatures may drop below the optimal operational level for the selective catalyst reduction affecting its efficiency when reducing nitrogen oxides.
records.remedy: Engine software update

records.concern: TOWING EYE IN THE VEHICLE TOOL KIT MAY DETACH DURING USE
records.defect: The welding of the towing eye in the vehicle tool kit may not be to specification. As a result the weld on the eye may fail during use causing loss of propulsion and the towrope with the attached eye can potentially cause property damage and personal injury.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the towing eye in the vehicle tool kit.

records.concern: TOWING EYE IN THE VEHICLE TOOL KIT MAY DETACH DURING USE
records.defect: The welding of the towing eye in the vehicle tool kit may not be to specification. As a result the weld on the eye may fail during use causing loss of propulsion and the towrope with the attached eye can potentially cause property damage and personal injury.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the towing eye in the vehicle tool kit.

records.concern: GEARSHIFT BOLT MAY LOOSEN
records.defect: The catch bolt for the range change gearshift mechanism may work loose. This may affect gear changes and it is possible drive can be lost.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles place catch bolt with a mdified version.

records.concern: FUEL HOSES MAY CRACK AND LEAK
records.defect: Some fuel hoses were not manufactured to specification and as a result could crack and leak fuel. The fuel could affect the drivability of the subject vehicle and possibly others using the roads.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affect and replace 3 fuel hoses.

records.concern: FUEL HOSES MAY CRACK AND LEAK
records.defect: Some fuel hoses were not manufactured to specification and as a result could crack and leak fuel. The fuel could affect the drivability of the subject vehicle and possibly others using the roads.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affect and replace 3 fuel hoses.

records.concern: DPS SHAFT MAY BREAK CAUSING A LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL
records.defect: The DPS shaft may break causing a loss of steering control.
records.remedy: Affected machines will be assessed and where possible an interim repair can be completed. The manufacturer advises to STOP using the machine until the recommended repair is completed.

records.concern: REPLACE ELECTRICAL POWER STEERING
records.defect: Due to a non-conformity in the production process the electrical power steering (EPS) must be replaced. This will prevent a potential loss of steering assistance. Loss of EPS functionality could increase the risk of a collision occurring.
records.remedy: Replace the Electrical Power Steering unit

records.concern: REDUCED BRAKE EFFICIENCY
records.defect: The front brake master cylinder piston when subjected to particular shock load and vibration conditions may fail and result in the failure of the front brake. This will lead increased braking distances.
records.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and fit replacement parts kit which includes piston and seals with appropriate lubrication.

records.concern: VEHICLE MAY ROLL AWAY
records.defect: Due to a communication error between the Engine Control Module (ECM) software and the Transmission Control Module (TCM) the transmission park pawl may not engage. In certain circumstances such as when the park brake is not applied the vehicle may roll away.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles update the software for the Transmission Control Module.

records.concern: MOVEMENT OF SEAT MAY DAMAGE BATTERY SUPPLY CABLE
records.defect: In some circumstances when the right side front seat is operated to its fully reward position the seat runner can compress the battery supply cable and cause the seat to damage the battery supply cable. This may cause an open circuit and/or ground the supply cable which may then overheat.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles examine the battery supply cable for damage and install a routing block to ensure that the seat runner cannot compress the battery supply cable. If necessary replace the cable.

records.concern: POWER STEERING RETURN HOSE CAN BECOME DAMAGED AND CAUSE HYDRAULIC FLUID TO LEAK AND/OR THE POWER STEERING TO FAIL
records.defect: A hose clip can damage the power steering return hose for the steering rack. The power steering hose can also contact the wheel housing. If the hose is damaged hydraulic fluid can discharge and the power steering assistance could fail. In unfavourable cases the hydraulic fluid can get in contact with hot vehicle component or on the brake disc. This could create a danger of accident or fire.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and fit a serrated ring. Fit or remove a spacer as appropriate.

records.concern: DIESEL FILTER SECURING STRAP MAY BREAK
records.defect: An incorrect surface treatment on the fuel filter collar may lead to breakage of the diesel filter strap resulting in vibration and noise from the engine compartment. In the case of any mechanical pulses when driving with a broken strap or as a consequence of an accident this could result in breakage of the fuel pipes with subsequent leakage.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the diesel filter strap.

records.concern: ELECTRICAL WIRING IN STEERING ASSEMBLY MAY BE INSUFFICIENTLY GROUNDED
records.defect: The steering column clock spring may break. This will cause warning messages to illuminate in the instrument cluster but in extreme instances it may cause the driver's airbag to deploy.
records.remedy: Affected vehicles will be recalled to establish sufficient grounding of the steering components.

records.concern: ENGINE COMPONENT MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION
records.defect: An engine component may not be to specification which could result in loss of engine performance. This may lead to the engine stalling and potentially causing an engine failure. In very unlikely circumstances the vehicle speed may increase without warning but will stop on its own after a few seconds.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles carry out a functional diagnostic check of the engine. If necessary replace the engine.

records.concern: ENGINE COMPONENT MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION
records.defect: An engine component may not be to specification which could result in loss of engine performance. This may lead to the engine stalling and potentially causing an engine failure. In very unlikely circumstances the vehicle speed may increase without warning but will stop on its own after a few seconds.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles carry out a functional diagnostic check of the engine. If necessary replace the engine.

records.concern: BRAKE BOOSTER WATER SHIELD MAY BE INCORRECTLY INSTALLED
records.defect: There is a risk that the brake booster water shield may be incorrectly installed. This may result in limited braking ability due to water ingress into the brake booster.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles the brake booster water shield must be inspected for proper installation. If the brake booster water shield is found to be missing or incorrectly installed the brake booster must also be vacuum tested. Brake boosters that do not pass the vacuum test must be replaced. At the conclusion of this the brake booster must be equipped with a properly installed shield to protect the brake booster crimp joints from water exposure.

records.concern: CORROSION MAY FORM AROUND THE PARKING BRAKE ACTUATING SHAFT AND CAUSE REDUCED HANDBRAKE PERFORMANCE
records.defect: On the subject vehicles corrosion may form around the parking brake actuating shaft within the rear brake caliper. This could cause the handbrake to become difficult to operate (greater force required at the lever) or in some cases prevent the parking brake assembly from applying sufficient force at the rear wheels and cause a failure to hold the vehicle. Insufficient force to hold vehicle stationary causing unintentional and unexpected movement of the vehicle.
records.remedy: Inspect the parking brake actuation lever. If no corrosion is found replace the protective boot with a modified assembly. If corrosion is found on the actuating shaft replace the brake caliper.

records.concern: SUPPLEMENTARY HEATER WIRING MAY BECOME DAMAGED AND CAUSE AN ELECTRICAL SHORT-CIRCUIT
records.defect: On some Fiat 500L vehicles a layout non-conformity could cause abrasion of the supplementary heater (PTC) wiring. This could result in possible electric short-circuiting with the possibility of a loss of some vehicle safety. In the worst case it could cause a vehicle fire..
records.remedy: Apply a cut-proof sheath on the supplementary heater wiring to protect it from abrasions.

records.concern: WINDSHIELD MAY NOT BE INSTALLED CORRECTLY
records.defect: The windscreen may not be correctly sealed in the upper middle area which may allow water to enter the cabin area.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles check installation of windscreen and if necessary re-install.

records.concern: DEFECTIVE REAR WHEEL RIM CAN ALLOW SPOKES TO LOOSEN AND CAUSE THE WHEEL TO FAIL
records.defect: A potentially defective rear wheel rim has been installed on some motorcycles. The rear wheel rim has spokes that may become loose and eventually cause the wheel to fail. If the spokes are loose or become loose the wheel may react abnormally causing the motorcycle to wobble when ridden thus increasing the nsk of an accident.
records.remedy: Recall the seven possibly affected machines and replace the rear wheel rim.

records.concern: WHEEL BEARING RETAINER MAY BE INSECURE
records.defect: Brake drum DRM9926 for Vauxhall Corsa (BATCH CODE 181116C) The circlip that holds the bearing in may not be inserted correctly this would allow the bearing to become loose. This could allow the wheel to detach.
records.remedy: Replace the brake drum/bearing assembly with a correctly manufactured version.
models: BRAKE DRUM DRM9926 FOR VAUXHALL CORSA

records.concern: ANTI-SPILL VALVE FLAP MAY FAIL TO PREVENT FUEL BACK-FLOW
records.defect: The fuel cap seal effectiveness may be compromised by the flap retention spring and fuel may leak in the event of a vehicle rolling over.
records.remedy: Depending on assembly carry out modifications to the sealing arrangement as specified by the manufacturer.

records.concern: ELECTRONIC STABILITY PROGRAM (ESP) MAY MALFUNCTION
records.defect: Affected vehicles will have the manufacturer's DISTRONIC PLUS system fitted. In the event communication between this system and the ESP is lost the systems responses such as engine torque may be adversely affected for the period of the communication loss.. The braking system will not be affected though more effort may be required.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles update the ESP software.

records.concern: DOOR MIRROR DIRECTION INDICATOR MAY NOT OPERATE
records.defect: The door mirror indicator repeater may not operate as intended when the heated rear screen is switched on.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles inspect wiring and where necessaary rework the indicator connnections.

records.concern: REPLACE AIRBAG INFLATORS CHECKED BUT NOT REPLACED UNDER PREVIOUS RECALL R/2015/093
records.defect: The air bag inflators on affected vehicles were previously checked and deemed to be serviceable. As a precautionary measure the manufacturer has decided to replace them with new assemblies.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace air bag assembly.

records.concern: BACKREST FRAME OF DRIVER AND PASSENGER SEATS MAY BE WELDED INCORRECTLY
records.defect: The backrest frame of driver and passenger seats could be welded incorrectly and result in the backrest becoming loose. If the backrest becomes loose this could affect the driver�s ability to control the vehicle and the driver and passenger seats may not perform as intended in the event of a collision.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and visually check the backrest frame welding. If the frame is not welded to the correct specification the seat will be changed.

records.concern: WHEEL MAY FRACTURE
records.defect: Due to a deviation in the production process the wheel may crack and possibly fracture between the ventilation holes of the rim.
records.remedy: On affected vehciles replace wheels.

records.concern: BONNET SKIN MAY BECOME INSECURE
records.defect: The bonnet inner skin may not be adequately retained. This may cause the bonnet to vibrate or distort. In extreme cases the skin could detach.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles apply additional adhesive between the bonnet skin and its inner panel.

records.concern: REAR DOOR MAY MALFUNCTION
records.defect: The rear door leaf may not react to command from the driver's manual control. It may also disable the sensitive edge of the door and a body could become trapped.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles update the software with a revised version to enure the driver's control and door sensitive edge work on demand.

records.concern: THE ELECTRIC VEHICLE (EV) FUSE MAY MALFUNCTION
records.defect: The Electric Vehicle (EV) fuse which may malfunction if the vehicle isrepeatedly operated by the electric motor under high-load driving conditions such as during a long hill climb. If the fuse malfunctions warning lights and warning messages will illuminate. In some cases the vehicle can be driven but with reduced power. In other cases the hybrid system could shut down resulting in the loss of motive power.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the fuse.

records.concern: INVERTOR CAPACITOR MAY NOT BE SECURE
records.defect: The hybrid system of the subject vehicles includes an inverter assembly which contains a capacitor that may not have been properly bolted to the inverter housing. In this condition the terminal of the capacitor could be damaged by vibration during normal vehicle operation.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the invertor assembly

records.concern: REAR AXLES MAY LEAK OIL
records.defect: Due to incorrect welding an axle casing seam may crack and leak oil. In extreme case the axle casing may fail.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the axle casing.

records.concern: EGR PIPE COULD FRACTURE DUE TO A POTENTIAL NON-CONFORMITY
records.defect: The EGR pipe could fracture due to a potential non-conformity the fractured pipe may damage the alternator resulting in a loss of battery voltage and potentially a loss of engine power.
records.remedy: The pipe must be checked and if incorrect replaced with a new part.

records.concern: FRONT SEAT BELT PRETENSIONER COULD MALFUNCTION DURING DEPLOYMENT
records.defect: Due to a potential non-conformity in the supplier's production process the front seat belt pretensioner could malfunction and the front seat belt pretensioner may not function as intended in the event of a deployment. The locking mechanism operates independently from the pretensioner therefore locking mechanism functionality is still guaranteed.
records.remedy: Fit new seat belt assembly to either the driver or passenger front seat or both. The seat belt assembly to be replaced will be determined on the vehicle VIN/ chassis number which will be checked against a list to ensure the correct operation carried out.

records.concern: REAR WHEEL BEARING HOUSINGS MAY BE INCORRECTLY MANUFACTURED AND COULD FAIL PREMATURELY
records.defect: The hardening process for the rear wheel bearing housings may not have been correctly performed. In the worst case this could lead to a fractured housing. Should a fractured housing occur there would be abnormal noises bad tyre wear and a theoretical possibility of wheel loss.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the right and left rear wheel bearing housings.

records.concern: RISK OF DEGRADATION TO THE FRONT LEFT SUB AXLE CARRIER
records.defect: Depending on driving style and road profile there is a risk of degradation of the front left sub axle carrier.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and checking the front left stub axle carrier casting number Where necessary replace the stub axle carrier.

records.concern: ABNORMAL DEPLOYMENT OF PASSENGER AIRBAG
records.defect: The subject vehicles are equipped with front passenger�airbag�inflators which could have been assembled with improperly manufactured propellant This could cause the inflator to rupture and the front passenger�airbag�to deploy abnormally in a crash. This could result in increased risk of injury to the occupant.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the airbag with a new assembly.

records.concern: STARTER MOTOR HEATSHIELD MAY BREAK OFF AND CAUSE AN ELECTRICAL SHORT CIRCUIT
records.defect: The brackets retaining the heat shield of the starter motor may fail and allow the heat shield to fall on and chafe through the B+ cable. If left there is a theoretical risk of fire.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the starter motor heat shield. Additionally the exhaust pipe will be inspected for signs of cracks on flange facing turbo outlet and the gasket will be replaced.

records.concern: FRONT AND SIDE PLASTIC COVERS OF THE PANORAMIC SUNROOF MAY NOT BE BONDED TO SPECIFICATION
records.defect: The bonding retaining front and side plastic covers on the sunroof may not meet specification. As a result these could detach whilst the vehicle is in motion.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles check trims and where necessary re-bond trims.

records.concern: REAR RIGHT WHEEL ARCH PROTECTOR MAY DEFORM AND RUB AGAINST AND DAMAGE BRAKE HOSE
records.defect: In conditions such as high speed and high vehicle loading the rear right wheel arch protector may contact the brake hose. Over time repeated contact could wear through the outer protective cover of the brake hose. This could damage the inner reinforcing braiding and in an extreme case wear a hole in the hose which could lead to brake fluid leakage.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles re-work the rear wheel arch protector and if necessary replace the brake pipe with new.

records.concern: INSTRUMENT CLUSTER MAY INTERMITTENTLY GO BLANK
records.defect: Due to a software issue the Instrument cluster may intermittently go blank.
records.remedy: Affected vehicles will be recalled to have the latest software installed/downloaded.

records.concern: RUBBER DIESEL FUEL FEED PIPE MAY HARDEN OR CRACK
records.defect: The diesel fuel feed pipe that supplies fuel to the high pressure pump may deteriorate prematurely. The customer may initially notice the smell of diesel fuel leaking onto the engine. If the concern is not resolved the rubber hose may harden and crack due to fatigue. This in turn could allow the pipe to leak diesel fuel onto the engine. As with all fuel leaks there is a risk of catching fire.
records.remedy: Recall the 24 vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the fuel feed hose.

records.concern: DIESEL FILTER MAY DETACH FROM ITS HOLDER
records.defect: The strap of the diesel filter may brake causing the diesel filter to disconcert from its holder. Possibility of a noise in the engine compartment and in extreme cases fuel leakage.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the diesel filter strap. The filter strap will be replaced if necessary.

records.concern: AXLE MOUNTING MAY BREAK
records.defect: Under extreme starting conditions (such as full throttle) on wet road surfaces AND with repeated short term rear wheel spin strong torque peaks in the powertrain may occur.This may cause an axle mounting flange to break and possible loss of drive.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles update the ESP and chassis control units.

records.concern: SEATBELT PRETENSIONER MAY NOT OPERATE
records.defect: Due to a deviation in the suppliers production process a specific squib batch may not comply with specifications In the event of an accident during which the left hand seat belt tensioner in the rear is activated the belt may not fully retrain the occupant.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the left rear seat belt with a correct version.

records.concern: VEHICLE CONTROL UNIT MAY NOT HAVE BEEN CORRECTLY UPDATED
records.defect: The vehicles electronic control unit (ECU) may have been incorrectly updated. This may affect the operation of systems controlled by the ECU
records.remedy: On affected vehicles update the software of the control unit

records.concern: REAR HUB CARRIERS NOT MANUFACTURED TO CORRECT STANDARD
records.defect: The hardening process for the rear wheel bearing housings may not have been correctly performed. In the worst case this could lead to a fractured housing. Should a fractured housing occur there would be abnormal noises bad tyre wear and a theoretical possibility of wheel loss.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the right and left rear wheel bearing housings.

records.concern: DEVIATION IN ENGINE CONTROL UNIT SOFTWARE
records.defect: The engine control unit may not have the correct software. This may affect power and emissions outputs.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles update the control unit with the correct software.

records.concern: REAR WHEEL BEARING HOUSINGS MAY FAIL
records.defect: It is possible the tempering process for the rear wheel bearing housing was not correct. This could allow the housing to crack and fail
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the bearing housing with a correctly manufactured version.

records.concern: REAR WHEEL BEARING HOUSINGS MAY BE INCORRECTLY MANUFACTURED AND COULD FAIL PREMATURELY
records.defect: The hardening process for the rear wheel bearing housings may not have been correctly performed. In the worst case this could lead to a fractured housing. Should a fractured housing occur there would be abnormal noises bad tyre wear and a theoretical possibility of wheel loss.
records.remedy: Recall the 420 vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the right and left rear wheel bearing housings.

records.concern: A NON-CONFORMITY IN AN INTERNAL COMPONENT COULD AFFECT DEPLOYMENT OF THE PASSENGER AIRBAG
records.defect: An internal component of the passenger's airbag triggering module may not conform to specification. This could affect the triggering of the device in the event of an impact.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the passenger's air bag assembly

records.concern: A NON-CONFORMITY IN AN INTERNAL COMPONENT COULD AFFECT DEPLOYMENT OF THE PASSENGER AIRBAG
records.defect: An internal component of the passenger's airbag triggering module may not conform to specification. This could affect the triggering of the device in the event of an impact.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the passenger's air bag assembly

records.concern: THE TIE ROD INSTALLATION BRACKET MAY BREAK
records.defect: The holes in the rear shock absorber tie-rod frame mounts can become elongated if the rear shock absorber bottoms out. This could cause the tie rod installation bracket to break.
records.remedy: Inspect the frame for damage and fit additional bracing brackets to the frame. In rare cases the frame may need to be replaced.

records.concern: VEHICLE CAN BE DRIVEN WITHOUT THE DRIVER KNOWING THE MIDDLE DOOR IS OPEN
records.defect: It has been identified that in certain cases the driver is able to manoeuvre the vehicle with the middle door open without a visual or audible warning. Risk of the vehicle being driven with the middle door open.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and apply software updates to the Instrument Cluster and Body Builder Module to warn the driver when the middle door is open. At speeds below 5 km/h the �Any door open� icon and CHECK lamp are illuminated and at speeds above 5 km/h the �Any door open� icon STOP lamp and audible buzzer are activated.

records.concern: DRIVER AND/OR FRONT PASSENGER AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY AS INTENDED
records.defect: An incorrect specification driver or front passenger air bag assembly may have been installed during production. As a result the airbag(s) may not deploy as intended.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the air bag with the correct module.

records.concern: ELECTRONIC BRAKING SYSTEM PARAMETERS MAY BE INCORRECT
records.defect: The High Load parameter setting of the Electronic Braking System may not have been correctly programmed. In extreme instances this may affect EBS brake application and vehicle stability.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles reprogram the EBS High Load parameters.

records.concern: RISK OF ELECTRICAL SHORT
records.defect: On affected machines there is a risk of one of the link leads to the regulator rectifier developing an electrical short. A bracket introduced at the start of production may interfere with the link lead resulting in damage to the outer protective sheathing and over time potentially exposing the wire. Contact between the bracket and the exposed wire may lead to an electrical short. In some cases the electrical short may cause an engine stall without warning.
records.remedy: The original Link Lead will be removed and replaced with a new identical part which will be routed so as to avoid possible contact with the bracket edge.

records.concern: BRAKE HOSE INCORRECTLY CRIMPED
records.defect: A brake hose crimp connection could come loose and cause a reduction in braking effort.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the brake hose with a correctly crimped version.

records.concern: SUSPENSION AND STEERING FIXINGS MAY NOT BE TIGHTENED TO THE CORRECT TORQUE
records.defect: Due to a deviation in the production process certain suspension and steering fixings may not have been tightened to the correct torque.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles check fixings as indicated by the manufacturer. Replace any damaged fixings and tighten all relevant fixings to correct torque.

records.concern: SUSPENSION AND STEERING FIXINGS MAY NOT BE TIGHTENED TO THE CORRECT TORQUE
records.defect: Due to a deviation in the production process certain suspension and steering fixings may not have been tightened to the correct torque.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles check fixings as indicated by the manufacturer. Replace any damaged fixings and tighten all relevant fixings to correct torque.

records.concern: HEADLIGHT MAY NOT PERFORM AS EXPECTED
records.defect: Indian Motorcycle has determined that some motorcycles equipped with halogen headlights may have been assembled using a non-compliant headlight not matching destination market requirements. Certain International models may be equipped with an SAE (North America spec) headlight which is considered non-compliant per ECE standards. The E4 and SAE headlights have different photometric and marking requirements which must be inspected and if necessary replaced with the correct headlight.These headlights have the potential to dazzle other road users if the light is not dipped to the correct side for the market operated in.
records.remedy: Headlamp assembly to be inspected on affected models and where necessary the headlamp will be replaced.

records.concern: VEHICLE MAY NOT MEET REQUIRED SAFETY STANDARDS
records.defect: Necessary technical acceptance not carried out by Porsche AG prior to sale of certain Porsche company cars. As a result one pre-owned vehicle does not comply to the latest standards and related quality standards.
records.remedy: The one car affected will be bought back by Porsche AG through their Porsche centre network.

records.concern: INSTRUMENT CLUSTER MAY INTERMITTENTLY GO BLANK
records.defect: Due to a software issue the Instrument cluster may intermittently go blank.
records.remedy: Affected vehicles will be recalled to have the latest software installed/downloaded.

records.concern: STEERING MAY BECOME RESTRICTED
records.defect: A steering shaft coupling may not have been correctly manufactured. This may create a clicking noise and the steering may become restricted.In extreme instances the steering may lock.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles Check coupling and where necessary replace with a correctly manufactured component.

records.concern: MOVEMENT MAY OCCUR ALONG THE LENGTH OF THE POWER STEERING SPLINE
records.defect: it has been determined that the upper steering shafts on 2016-2017 GENERAL Vehicles may exhibit movement along the length of the power steering spline. In extreme circumstances this movement may ultimately result in separation of the shaft from the spline which may lead to the loss of steering. This movement may ultimately result in separation of the shaft from the spline which may lead to the loss of steering
records.remedy: Polaris is releasing this Safety Bulletin for dealers to install revised steering shaft hardware with a higher torque and clamp-load specification.

records.concern: CVT DRIVE PULLY NUT MAY WORK LOOSE
records.defect: Insufficient torque of the CVT drive pulley securing nut. On affected machines this may cause an abnormal noise leading to the risk of engine stopping and crankshaft damage
records.remedy: On affected machines replacement of CVT nut and crankshaft if required.

records.concern: RPM MAY NOT DECREASE WITH THROTTLE OPERATION RISK OF FUEL LEAK
records.defect: On affected machines there is a possibility that a bolt dropped into the air cleaner assembly during production could enter the throttle body preventing the decrease of RPM by throttle operation. On affected machines the fuel supply hose may not be correctly connected to the fuel injector which could result in a fuel leak.
records.remedy: Remove air cleaner inspect cleaner and throttle body for foreign material. Check fuel hose connection and re-route if required.

records.concern: LOSS OF POWER ASSISTANCE TO STEERING
records.defect: The driver may experience sudden loss of power assistance to the steering due to voltage irregularities in the Electro Hydraulic Power Steering system. The driver will have to apply increased effort to steer the vehicle.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and download new software to the inverter which can cope with voltage spikes and/or drops.

records.concern: PROPELLANT IN THE DRIVER AND PASSENGER SIDE AIRBAG INFLATORS MAY HAVE DETERIORATED
records.defect: The propellant (ammonium nitrate) in the inflator of the drivers and passengers front airbag inflator may deteriorate due to high temperature and humid conditions over a longer period in use. As a result the inflator body may rupture during airbag deployment in the event of an accident where the airbags are required to be deployed. The inflator body may rupture during airbag deployment with the potential to cause injury.
records.remedy: Replacement of the driver and passenger front airbag inflators.

records.concern: INGRESS OF WATER AND CORROSION MAY CAUSE THE WIPER MOTOR TO FAIL
records.defect: A nonconformity of the windscreen wiper motor breather system could in some cases result in the entry of water and complete jamming of the motor due to internal corrosion.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the wiper motor.

records.concern: CORROSION WITHIN THE TAILGATE STRUT ASSEMBLY COULD CAUSE THE STRUT TO FAIL
records.defect: Non-conformity of a tailgate strut internal component may allow corrosion to develop. This may cause the strut to fail and the tailgate may not be held open.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the struts.

records.concern: RIGHT FRONT SEAT BELT PRE-TENSIONER MAY NOT MEET SPECIFICATION
records.defect: The right front seat belt pretensioner may not conform to specification . This may adversely affect it's operation in the event of an accident.
records.remedy: Replace the pretensioner on affected vehicles.

records.concern: REAR SEAT BELT PRE-TENSIONERS MAY FAIL TO RESTRAIN OCCUPANTS AS INTENDED
records.defect: The rear seatbelt pre-tensioner ignitors may not perform as expected. This could increase the risk of injury to the seat occupants. The lock functions of the rear seatbelts are not impaired.
records.remedy: Recall the 3400 vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace any potentially affected seatbelts with quality assured units.

records.concern: BALL JOINT MAY NOT BE SECURE
records.defect: A small batch of wishbones may have been manufactured with out a ball joint secondary securing clip. This may allow the ball joint to dislocate from its location. The ball joint is unlikely to separate but without the securing clip ball joint dislocation could have an affect on the steering.
records.remedy: Recall affected wishbones and replace with a new version which will have the secondary securing clip.

records.concern: ENGINE ECU HAS NOT BEEN CORRCTLY PROGRAMMED
records.defect: Due to an error in the engine control unit software the engine may shut down when braking from slow speeds such as pulling up at traffic lights. This may also affect the vehicles ECO start system. It will still be possible to manually restart the vehicle.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles update engine and transmission control units.

records.concern: STEERING KNUCKLE INCORRECTLY MANUFACTURED
records.defect: Due to an error in production the left hand steering knuckle may not conform to specification. In extreme instances the knuckle may fail.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles check the knuckle and replace where necessary.

records.concern: TYRE MAY DEFORM AND/OR TEAD DETACH
records.defect: The tyres may not comply with the requirements of certain US testing requirements (FMVSS 571.119 S6.1 and S7.2 Endurance). Specifically S6.1.2.(a) requires at the conclusion of the test there shall be no evidence of broken cords and S7.2 (d) requires the tyre complete the wheel test as indicated in Table III. The tyres may not complete the prescribed test distance or meet the post-test visual examination requirements. The affected tyres may develop an in-service unsatisfactory ride condition bulge in the tread area or a tread separation that if undetected may ultimately result in the loss of vehicle control and increase the risk of a possible crash.
records.remedy: The manufacturer is recalling affected stock and asking consumers to return affected tyres and providing a refund.

records.concern: EXHAUST PIPE MAY NOT COMPLY WITH QUALITY STANDARDS
records.defect: Some vehicles may have been manufactured with an exhaust head pipe that does not meet Polaris quality standards. As a result the exhaust temperatures may degrade the exhaust head pipe to the point where a hole or crack may form. This could pose a potential fire and/or burn hazard.
records.remedy: To resolve this concern the exhaust head pipe will be replaced.

records.concern: POOR SOLDERING TO IGNITION SWITCH
records.defect: Poor soldering to wiring of ignition switch leading to poor electrical conduction. This could cause the engine to stop while in use.
records.remedy: Affected motorcycles are being recalled to have the ignition switch replaced.

records.concern: REAR AXLES MAY CRACK / FRACTURE
records.defect: The rear axle casings may crack and oil may leak.In extreme cases the axle casing may fail.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles inspect the rear axle casing and replace where necessary

records.concern: REAR AXLES MAY CRACK / FRACTURE
records.defect: The rear axle casings may crack and oil may leak. In extreme cases the axle casing may fail.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles inspect the rear axle casing and replace where necessary.

records.concern: BONNET MAY OPEN UNEXPECTEDLY
records.defect: Water ingress into the bonnet release cable may cause corrosion and affect the operation of the cable which could lead to unintentional opening of the bonnet.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles the upper bonnet catch cable will be replaced with a new modified cable with better seals at the end of the cable.

records.concern: GEARSHIFT BOLT MAY LOOSEN
records.defect: The catch bolt for the range change gearshift mechanism may work loose. This may affect gear changes and it is possible drive can be lost.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles remove catch and reassemble as per work instructions.

records.concern: PROPELLER SHAFT MAY DETACH
records.defect: Due to an error in production the pinion shaft may not be sufficiently hardened and may fail. This may cause loss of drive and the prop shaft may detach at the pinion.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles examine and carry out torque check. Where necessary replace differential.

records.concern: SEAT MAY NOT CORRECTLY LATCH
records.defect: The left-side fold-flat second row seat may have a misadjusted cable that controls the recliner mechanisms. Incorrect adjustment may prevent one of the recliners from fully latching.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles check cable and adjust if necessary.

records.concern: MISSING SPOT WELDS
records.defect: Due to an error during manufacture the rear cross member may not have been fully spot welded. This may compromise the integrity of the structure.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles check the designated areas and where necessary weld member

records.concern: STARTER MOTOR SUPPLY WIRING HARNESS MAY BECOME DAMAGED
records.defect: The positioning of the starter supply terminal may be incorrect. This may allow it to foul other components and cause a short circuit.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles check the positioning of the terminaL. Correct it if necessary and add additional protection.

records.concern: REAR AXLES MAY CRACK / FRACTURE
records.defect: The rear axle casings may crack and oil may leak. In extreme cases the axle casing may fail.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles inspect the rear axle casing and replace where necessary.

records.concern: FILLER NECK SEAL MAY LEAK
records.defect: The sealing arrangement within the filler neck may be distorted and allow fuel to leak. This may be noticeable as wetting or a small volume within the dust cap. It is more likely to be noticeable immediately after filling.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles check poppet valve and where necessary replace.

records.concern: RISK OF ELECTRICAL SHORT-CIRCUIT
records.defect: A potential chafing condition has been identified between the alternator power cables and coolant pipe which may result in short circuit .Electrical cables might short circuit.
records.remedy: Add a rubber spacer with cable tie to secure power cables from chafing on coolant pipe.

records.concern: STEERING ARM MAY FRACTURE
records.defect: Due to a lack of durability the steering lever may fracture at its fixings.
records.remedy: On affected vehciles replace the steering arm with a new design of arm.

records.concern: REAR AXLES MAY CRACK / FRACTURE
records.defect: The rear axle casings may crack and oil may leak.In extreme cases the axle casing may fail.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace rear axle casing.

records.concern: REAR AXLES MAY CRACK / FRACTURE
records.defect: The rear axle casings may crack and oil may leak. In extreme cases the axle casing may fail.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles inspect the rear axle casing and replace where necessary.

records.concern: POSITIVE BATTERY CABLE INSULATION MIGHT BE DAMAGED
records.defect: The starter motor supply cable from the battery may interfere with the EGR valve. This could cause damage to the insulation and cables.
records.remedy: On affected vehicle inspect cable for position and condition. Where necessary replace cable.

records.concern: REAR AXLES MAY CRACK / FRACTURE
records.defect: The rear axle casings may crack and oil may leak.In extreme cases the axle casing may fail.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace both rear axle casings.

records.concern: THE OCCUPANT RESTRAINT CONTROLLER (ORC) MAY NOT OPERATE AS INTENDED
records.defect: The Occupant Restraint Controller (ORC) may experience a loss of air bag and seat belt pretensioner deployment capability during a crash due to a shorting condition resulting in a negative voltage transient that travels to the Occupant Restraint Controller via the front impact sensor wires
records.remedy: Replace the Occupant Restraint Control module.

records.concern: BONNET STRIKER MAY BE INSECURE
records.defect: The striker wire on the bonnet lining may not have sufficient support to prove it with the security for its intended purpose. This can lead to incorrect locking of the bonnet over time and could result in an unintentional release of the bonnet.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles inspect and if requiredfit an additional strengthener to retain the striker cable on the inner panel of the bonnet. In some cases it may be necessary to replace the bonnet.

records.concern: REDUCED REAR WHEEL GUIDANCE
records.defect: The screwed connection between the frame and the fixed bearing stud for the rear swinging arm may loosen. This results in the rear wheel not being kept aligned as required causing reduced rear wheel guidance. In certain conditions this can lead to critical riding situations.
records.remedy: Check and tighten mounting bolts for rear wheel swing arm.

records.concern: THE EMERGENCY LOCKING RETRACTOR (ELR) IN THE FRONT SEAT BELT ASSEMBLIES MAY BE FAULTY
records.defect: The vehicle sensitive locking mechanism for the front seatbelts may be incorrect causing either the belt not to lock or the webbing very difficult to pull out. If the locking mechanism does not function during a collision it will not restrain the wearer as per design intent and increase the risk of injury.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the seat belts on both front seats and if necessary replaced.

records.concern: REAR DRIVESHAFT MAY BECOME DAMAGED RESULTING IN LOSS OF DRIVE
records.defect: On affected vehicles the clip that retains the gearshift cables may not be fully engaged with the metal portion of the handbrake cable.
records.remedy: Inspect the gearshift cables and driveshaft for signs of contact damage and replace if required. Also the dealership will inspect the gearshift cables clip to ensure it is correctly aligned and fully engaged.

records.concern: FRONT LOWER BALL JOINT MAY FAIL
records.defect: Due to a manufacturing issue with the front lower ball joint there is a possibility that the surface of the ball joint may be damaged while driving. If the vehicle is operated continuously the ball joint may experience excessive damage and fail.
records.remedy: All vehicles identified will have both front lower ball joints replaced

records.concern: FRAME MAY CRACK
records.defect: The frame of the machine may develop a crack. Should a crack develop as it gradually develops the steering and handling will get progressively worse. If not repaired the frame could beak rendering the machine uncontrollable.
records.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and if no cracks are present fit a reinforcement kit. If cracks are present replace the frame.

records.concern: GEARBOX MAY FAIL
records.defect: The countershaft 5th gear dogs used for engaging 3rd gear are broken. Although the material strength of the gear has been increased the fatigue strength was decreased due to the removal of shot peening treatment to the root of the dogs of countershaft 5th gear used for engaging 3rd gear. This led to breakage starting from the root of the dogs.
records.remedy: Affected machines will be recalled to be disassembled and reassembled using the latest countermeasure replacement.

records.concern: HANDBRAKE MAY NOT HOLD
records.defect: Due to possible loosening of the adjuster lock nut parking brake lever travel may become excessive and the parking brake may not be fully applied. If the vehicle is not parked in accordance with handbook instructions it is possible the vehicle could move.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles check and where necessary replace the adjuster lock nut.

records.concern: WRONG DRIVER AIRBAG INFLATOR IS FITTED
records.defect: Affected vehicles may have received the wrong replacement airbag assembly through a previous recall. This replacement air bag may not deploy as intended.
records.remedy: Recall affected vehicles remove existing air bag assembly and replace it with the correct version.

records.concern: FUEL MAY LEAK
records.defect: The engine fuel return pipe is made of material which may adversely react with chemicals paint etc. These may cause the pipe to swell become loose and leak fuel.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the fuel return pipes from the injectors.

records.concern: STARTER MOTOR SUPPLY WIRING HARNESS MAY BECOME DAMAGED
records.defect: The positioning of the starter supply terminal may be incorrect. This may allow it to foul other components and cause a short circuit.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles check the positioning of the terminaL. Correct it if necessary and add additional protection.

records.concern: STEERING RACK MIGHT LOCK
records.defect: If the retaining ring inside the steering gear has not been fitted correctly the sealing cap would not be fixed axially and might start moving. If the sealing cap has moved the ball return channel would not be fixed anymore and might move out of position possibly resulting in a ball jam accompanied by an extensively increased steering force and possibly lock.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit a new steering rack and ensure it is programmed correctly.

records.concern: INCORRECT WIRING IN HORN SYSTEM CAN CAUSE ONE OR MORE SAFETY FAULTS
records.defect: The flange nut can seize on the thread of the studs in the fuse box which could mean the terminals do not have the correct torque and may be loose. Electrical cables connected to the fuse box might become loose and could cause arcing. This condition could cause for example the horn to stop working airbag/s to deploy in exceptional circumstances fire etc.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace all fuse box cable flange nuts to new correct type nuts and tighten to correct torque.

records.concern: STEERING SHAFT MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION
records.defect: Due to an error in the manufacturing process the lower steering shaft universal joint may not have been produced to the correct specification. Under heavy steering forces it is possible for the column shaft to move within the universal joint connection.
records.remedy: Check dimensions of the universal joint and column shaft and replace where necessary.

records.concern: OFFSIDE FRONT SPRING(S) RETAINING BOLTS MAY NOT BE TIGHTENED TO SPECIFICATION.
records.defect: The bolts retaining the offside front leaf spring (or springs) and support bracket(s) may not have been tightened to the correct specification. If a support bracket disconnects this could affect the steering.
records.remedy: Check spring and bracket retaining bolts for tightness. Replace bolts if necessary and tighten all bolts to correct specification.

records.concern: TYRES MAY DEVELOP AN UNEVEN SHAPE IN THE TREAD AREA
records.defect: The tyre may develop an uneven shaped tread area which may affect tyre performance and vehicle handling.
records.remedy: Replace affected tyres with a new replacement and balance.

records.concern: STARTER MOTOR SUPPLY WIRING HARNESS MAY BECOME DAMAGED
records.defect: The positioning of the starter supply terminal may be incorrect. This may allow it to foul other components and cause a short circuit.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles check the positioning of the terminal and correct it if necessary.

records.concern: STARTER MOTOR SUPPLY WIRING HARNESS MAY BECOME DAMAGED
records.defect: The positioning of the starter supply terminal may be incorrect. This may allow it to foul other components and cause a short circuit.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles check the positioning of the terminal and correct it if necessary.

records.concern: STEERING SHAFT MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION
records.defect: Due to an error in the manufacturing process the lower steering shaft universal joint may not have been produced to the correct specification. Under heavy steering forces it is possible for the column shaft to move within the universal joint connection.
records.remedy: Check dimensions of the universal joint and column shaft and replace where necessary.

records.concern: CARBURETTOR FLOAT MAY STICK CAUSING A FUEL LEAK
records.defect: On affected machines carburettor float may stick causing a fuel leak.
records.remedy: Inspect and if necessary modify the carburettor.

records.concern: FUEL MAY LEAK FROM FUEL TAP WHEN OPERATED
records.defect: On affected machines fuel may leak from the fuel tap when it is operated.
records.remedy: Installation of a new fuel tap.

records.concern: HANDLEBARS MAY BECOME LOOSE / INSECURE
records.defect: The clip-on handlebar is susceptible to Stress Corrosion Cracking. This can cause the part to fail during use and could affect control of the machine. The manufacturer recommends to immediately STOP using the clip-ons
records.remedy: Replace affected components with an alternative version with a superior resistance to Stress Corrosion Cracking.

records.concern: SIDE AND/OR KNEE AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY IN A COLLISION
records.defect: The airbag initiator may be defective and may prevent the side airbag(s) and/or knee airbag deploying in the event of an accident. In a collision the airbags not deploying could put the occupants at further risk.
records.remedy: Recall the 1943 vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary replace the side and knee protection airbags complete with initiators.

records.concern: LEFT FRONT SEAT BELT PRE-TENSIONER MAY NOT MEET SPECIFICATION
records.defect: The propellant mix in certain seatbelt pre-tensioners ignitors may be incorrect. If the front seatbelt pre-tensioners are deployed the lock function of the pre-tensioners cannot be guaranteed.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the front seatbelts that are likely to be affected.

records.concern: FRONT SEAT FIXING MECHANISM MAY BE INSECURE
records.defect: Due to a fault in the supplier's production process the bolt on the outer side of the seat mechanism on both front seats might not have been fixed properly. In cases where the bolt loosens the customer would be alerted by noise coming from the seat and a noticeable increase in seat clearance/movement. If this is ignored by the customer the securing bolt on the outer side of the seat might come off. If the securing bolt comes off the seat can move backwards in a rear end crash situation.
records.remedy: The bolt on the seat mechanism will be checked for excessive clearance and if necessary replaced.

records.concern: GEARBOX MAY FAIL TO HOLD IN PARK POSITION 'P' AND VEHICLE COULD ROLL AWAY
records.defect: If the vehicle is parked on a hill with park selected and the parking brake off or not fully applied the vehicle may not stay stationary. This results in a higher risk of collision.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the parking brake mechanism and park wheel which are inside of the reducer.

records.concern: SIDE AIR CURTAIN MAY NOT DEPLOY
records.defect: The curtain airbag (one or both side) may not deploy in the event of a side impact because the pyrotechnic mix ratio in the ignitor could be incorrect..
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the serial number of the curtain airbag. Replace airbag if required.

records.concern: IGNITION SWITCH WIRING HARNESS INSECURE
records.defect: The ignition switch harness connector of some Nissan Micra (K14 models) equipped with a mechanical key may not be correctly locked in position. As a result the connector may disconnect which in an extreme case could result in engine shut down while driving with no possibility to restart.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles inspect wiring harness and where necessary rework the ignition switch retaining latch.

records.concern: B-PILLAR TRIM INSULATION TOO CLOSE TO THE SEAT BELT PRETENTIONER
records.defect: In the event of a colision which deploys the front seat belt retractor pre-tensioner there is a possibility that the insulation material on the inner face of lower 'B' pillar trim could be subjected to a concentrated heat source that could ignite the insulation material resulting in fire.
records.remedy: Remove a section of the insulation material on both �B� pillar trims.

records.concern: FRONT SEAT BELT PRETENSIONER MAY MALFUNCTION DURING DEPLOYMENT
records.defect: Due to a non-conformity in the supplier's production process the front seat belt pretensioner could malfunction in the event of a collision.
records.remedy: Correct operation will be restored by applying a service kit designed for this purpose. Affected vehicles will be recalled to have this fitted.

records.concern: STEERING POWER ASSIST MAY DEACTIVATE
records.defect: The connector on the electric power steering control unit may not be properly sealed against water entry. If water enters the control unit the power steering assistance can be lost. The steering assistance not working could increase the risk of collision.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the plug housing of the electric power steering.

records.concern: BRAKES MAY FAIL
records.defect: The Combined Braking valve has a rubber washer fitted to a threaded fitment. The rubber washer isn�t suitable for the purpose and has shown signs of allowing hydraulic fluid to pass. If the seal was to completely fail it would result in a complete brake failure. The motorcycle would lose all braking ability which could result in a serious incident.
records.remedy: Recall the 225 machines that are likely to be affected and replace the front caliper two way valve brake hose and associated components.

records.concern: DISC BOLT HOLES HAVE INCORRECT THREAD
records.defect: The half shaft retaining bolt holes in the rear disc may have an incorrect thread. Retaining bolts may fit but may become loose and fall out. This would allow the half shaft and wheel/hub assembly to detach from the vehicle.
records.remedy: Replace affected components with discs which have the correct thread. Check and where necessary replace retaining bolts. Manufacturer also advises to replace brake pads and hub seal.
models: REAR BRAKE DISC FOR FORD TRANSIT

records.concern: RISK OF FIRE
records.defect: There is a possibility that the relay linked to the electrical circuit of the starter is out of specification. As such the relay might be blocked in a closed position. If this occurs there is a risk of the starter overheating and a theoretical risk of fire. Also if left in gear the vehicle could also start to move.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the starter relay.

records.concern: AIR CONDITIONING COMPRESSOR MAY DETACH
records.defect: There is a possibility that the bracket holding the air conditioning compressor onto the engine is not properly tightened. As a result there is a risk that this bracket might break during driving. If this occurs the air conditioning compressor might become detached from the vehicle and could potentially fall on the road.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check bracket holding the air compressor is correctly secured. In case the bracket was not properly secured it will be replaced by a new one.

records.concern: SHORT-CIRCUIT MAY CAUSE ELECTRICS TO FAIL
records.defect: It is possible for the wiring harness in the main switch panel to chafe on a bracket cut-out which could result in a short to earth. If a short circuit occurs it could result in the loss of various electrical systems. In the worst case the engine could cut out.
records.remedy: Recall the 143 vehicles that are likely to be affected and tape the edges of the bracket cut-out with adhesive felt tape & secure wiring harness.

records.concern: REAR SPRING SEAT BASES MAY FAIL
records.defect: The rear spring seat bases may develop cracks. Therse could case the seat base(s) to fail and the spriing(s) may detach.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles repalce the rear spring seat bases

records.concern: THROTTLE MAY STICK
records.defect: In the event of a stuck throttle cable the ECU will illuminate the check engine light but will not limit engine RPM or vehicle speed.
records.remedy: A calibration update that enables the ECU to place the engine into safe mode in the event of a stuck throttle cable. Polaris is contacting its customers and sending a recall letter to each registered owner.

records.concern: STEERING COLUMN UJ PINCH BOLT MAT NOT BE TIGHTENED TO CORRECT SPECIFICATION
records.defect: The steering column UJ pinch bolt may not have been tightened to the correct specification. Under heavy steering loads such as at low speeds movement between UJ and column is possible.
records.remedy: Check the tightness the steering column bolt on affected vehicles. Where necessary tighten to correct torque.

records.concern: REAR BRAKE LIGHT MAY FAIL
records.defect: Vibrations can cause the tail / brake light bulb socket to displace and come away from the lamp assembly.
records.remedy: On affected machines replace the light socket with a quality assured unit.

records.concern: UNEXPECTED LOSS OF ENGINE POWER
records.defect: The short hose on the pipe between the turbocharger and the intercoolers could break during the normal use of the vehicle. This could result in loss of performance and cause the check engine light to illuminate as the hose material may not conform to manufacturers specification.
records.remedy: Replace the short hose on the pipe between the turbocharger and the intercoolers. In some cases the replacement of the entire intercooler pipe will be necessary; this will be determined by the VIN number.

records.concern: SEAT BELT RESTRAINT FUNCTION MAY BE INADEQUATE
records.defect: The front passenger seatbelt stalk may become deformed. This may weaken the stalk cables and may not act as intended in the event of a collision.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles check condition of affected belt stalks. Where necessary replace stalk and fit additional cover.

records.concern: WINDOW AIRBAGS MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY AS INTENDED
records.defect: The left and right airbag actuation has been swapped due to an incorrect connector assignment on the wiring harness. In a collision where the airbags are required to deploy the incorrect airbag could be deployed with the protective affect not being ensured.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and correct the pin assignment on the airbag control plug.

records.concern: LOWER BALLJOINT MAY FAIL
records.defect: Water could enter the front lower suspension ball joint which can cause noise from front suspension and in worst-case failure of lower ball joint. If this occurs directional control could be impaired.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the lower suspension arm (which includes lower ball joint).

records.concern: SIDE CURTAIN AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY
records.defect: The electrical harness from the Restraints Control Module (RCM) to side crash sensors has been incorrectly orientated. The RCM signal wire for the right hand C Pillar impact sensor is wired to the left hand C Pillar impact sensor and vice versa. In the event of a collision requiring the Supplementary Restraint System (SRS) to deploy the curtain airbags they may not deploy or deploy later than design intent which can lead to increased injuries to the rear outboard seat occupant.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and repair the harness to change the wiring at the RCM connector.

records.concern: SUDDEN LOSS OF BRAKE FLUID
records.defect: P053 campaigned vehicles - Brake Disc to Hub Bolts where the front brake pipe from caliper to the brake flexible hose is subsequently showing signs of a chafe condition in some instances it has been reported that a noise is present or the loss of brake fluid has occurred. If the brake pipe continues to chafe through sudden loss of brake fluid could be experienced. Brake fluid loss will illuminate a red warning triangle. Brake fluid loss will ultimately result in extended brake pedal travel combined with reduced braking performance in the corresponding brake circuit increasing stopping distances. Loss of one braking circuit could compromise vehicle stability and significantly increase the risk of an accident.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected. Where recall campaign P053 is yet to be completed provide the P053 remedy and ensure that the specified clearances are achieved following completion of the P053 recall remedy. In the case of vehicles that have already had recall campaign P053 completed the dealer will ensure the correct clearances are achieved. If there are any signs of damage to the left hand right hand or both sides of the front brake pipe the damaged pipe will be replaced.

records.concern: SRS DID NOT DEPLOY AIRBAGS AS INTENDED
records.defect: When connected to Jaguar Land Rover�s Symptom Driven Diagnostics (SDD) device and an update is unsuccessfully undertaken the calibration may default to a pre-set condition. In the event of a frontal impact of a sufficient severity to require the Supplementary Restraint System (SRS) to deploy the front airbags the airbags will deploy but at impact thresholds that exceed those which provide the required occupant protection. Failure of the airbags to deploy as required can lead to increased injuries to the occupants.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and update the RCM with the latest software.

records.concern: PARTICLE FILTER BRACKET MAY DETACH
records.defect: There is a possibility the clamp between the particle filter and the front exhaust pipe is not closed fully due to an unfavourable tolerance pairing.The particle filter could become detached from the exhaust pipe when travelling over bumps for example. This can then cause exhaust gas to leak out and rattling noises. If this happens the customer will notice an exhaust smell and the pre-mentioned noise.
records.remedy: Affected vehicles will be recalled so the clamp can be checked. Where necessary relevant components will be replaced.

records.concern: FUEL TANK MAY CRACK / RISK OF FIRE
records.defect: Some vehicles may have been manufactured with fuel tanks that do not meet Polaris quality standards. As a result the fuel tank may crack resulting in a fuel leak. A fuel leak in the presence of an ignition source may present a fire hazard.
records.remedy: A new updated fuel tank will be fitted to affected vehicles to replace the original tank.

records.concern: RISK OF FIRE
records.defect: Some vehicles may have been manufactured with wiring harnesses that may short to ground with no circuit protection.
records.remedy: A harness kit will be fitted to add an in-line fuse for the un-switched power circuit together with chafing protection for the starter cable. The overall condition of the harness will also be inspected to ensure the ground circuits are properly connected.

records.concern: BRAKES MAY FAIL
records.defect: Brake caliper assembly may be incomplete on the models referred to above due to deviations in manufacturing at our supplier. The anti-rattle plates and cotters may be missing. This may lead to problems on the brake caliper through to brake failure and therefore to serious consequential events
records.remedy: Check both brake calipers (front and rear) for completeness and in particular whether the anti-rattle plates cotters and pins are present and correctly mounted. If parts are missing then fully assemble with replacement parts in accordance with the repair manual.

records.concern: FRONT BRAKE DISC MAY BECOME INSECURE
records.defect: One or more of the front brake disc retaining screws may loosen. This may be identified by rattling and may affect the brake's efficiency. In extreme instances the brake disc could detach.
records.remedy: On affected machines remove the brake disc and retaining screws. If necessary replace damaged components. In all cases apply thread lock to the disc retaining screws and tighten to the correct specification.

records.concern: SOME OCCUPANT SAFETY SYSTEMS MAY MALFUNCTION IN THE EVENT OF A COLLISION
records.defect: Due to incorrect wiring assembly the vehicles main power supply is disconnected after airbag deployment. This will affect the operation of vehicle safety functions such as automatically unlocking doors. The SRS systems are still functional.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles carry out manufacturer's recommended modification.

records.concern: FUEL MAY ESCAPE FROM THE FUEL TANK
records.defect: Polaris Industries Inc. (Polaris) have issued a STOP ride and STOP sale notice on a small number of machines. These machines were manufactured with a fuel tank vent line end location in the headlight pod which may result in liquid fuel exiting the vent line and create a risk of fire.
records.remedy: On affected machines fit a new and rerouted vent pipe.

records.concern: HAZARD WARNING LIGHTS MAY FAIL
records.defect: The hazard warning lamps wiring may not be of the correct length and can become damaged during steering operations. This may cause the hazard lamps not to work but will not affect the individual direction indicators.
records.remedy: On affected machines extend the wiring by installing a new electrical block connector and fly lead.

records.concern: HEADLAMP AUTO AIM FUNCTION MAY NOT OPERATE
records.defect: Due to a non confromity in production the headlamp auto aim function may not operate
records.remedy: Reconfigure and then reinitialise the headlamp leveliser control unit on affected vehicles.

records.concern: STARTER RELAY MAY OVERHEAT
records.defect: Possible non-compliance of an internal component of the starter control relay could cause damage by overheating. This could cause unintended operation of the starter motor and in extreme instances; there is a risk of fire.
records.remedy: Check and if necessary replace the Electrical relay

records.concern: STARTER RELAY MAY OVERHEAT
records.defect: Possible non-compliance of an internal component of the starter control relay could cause damage by overheating. This could cause unintended operation of the starter motor and in extreme instances; there is a risk of fire.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles check and if necessary replace the relay

records.concern: OIL LEAK FROM TURBOCHARGER FEED PIPE.
records.defect: Under certain conditions the oil feed pipe to the turbocharger may leak.Oil may contact hot components and there is a risk of fire.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the oil feed line to the turbocharger.

records.concern: LOSS OF POWER STEERING ASSISTANCE
records.defect: A pipe to the power steering cooler may not be corrctly secured and may come adrift. This may cause a loss of power steering assistance.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles fit a new bracket to more securely retain the pipes.

records.concern: ERRATIC ACCELERATOR BEHAVIOUR
records.defect: A faulty accelerator pedal sensor may cause erratic accelerator operation during operation of the accelerator pedal.This may vary between no throttle reaction to a speed greater than expected for a throttle position
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the accelerator pedal with a new variant and install an adapter wiring harness

records.concern: BRAKE HOSE RETAINING CLIP MAY FAIL.
records.defect: Surface finishing of brake hose retaining clip may be insufficient causing possibility of corrosion and failure of clip.
records.remedy: Replace brake hose clips with modified ones

records.concern: DOOR ANTITRAP DEVICE MAY NOT OPERATE
records.defect: Depending on type of control unit fitted the antitrap protection device on inwards opening doors may not operate and objects could become trapped.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles fit electrical cable bridges as required.

records.concern: TYRE PRESSURE MONITORING SYSTEM INCORRECTLY SET
records.defect: The Tyre Pressure Monitoring System (TPMS) on the affected vehicles was calibrated incorrectly and as a result does not illuminate the low tyre pressure warning tell-tale at the required minimum activation pressure.
records.remedy: Recalibrate the TPMS on affected vehicles.

records.concern: FRONT SUSPENSION COULD FAIL
records.defect: The fixed fork tube can suffer preliminary damage due to unusual incidents with momentary high stress without the user noticing the damage. Through longer usage with high stress the pressed in seal plug can loosen. This usually leads to oil leaks a clacking noise as well as increasingly imprecise drivability. If these signals are not perceived or ignored and further high stress incidents occur the plug may become completely loose. Subsequently critical driving conditions cannot be ruled out.
records.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and retrofit with an additional fixed fork bush or � if the preliminary damage is too much � the fixed front tubes are replaced by appropriately modified new parts.

records.concern: POSSIBLE SHORT CIRCUIT OF DRIVER SEAT WIRING
records.defect: Some vehicles may have been manufactured with an incorrect driver seat wiring harness layout which can cause the seat wiring harness to rub against metal points on the seat/seat frame assembly through normal seat adjustment operation. Over time this can lead to an inoperative seat adjustment system and in rare cases a potential risk of fire due to an electrical short to ground between the seat wiring harness and the seat adjustment motor assembly.
records.remedy: Replace 2 seat circuit breakers with 25 amp mini-fuses check harness apply protective barrier and reposition if undamaged. If damaged replace harness and then ensure repositioned and protective barrier applied.

records.concern: ABS/ESC SYSTEM MAY FAIL
records.defect: On vehicles with ABS/ESC the earth connection may be interrupted. This may cause failure of the ABS/ESC system.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles install new software.

records.concern: CAMSHAFT GEAR TEETH MAY BREAK
records.defect: Poor heat treatment to the camshaft gears may cause the teeth to break off and fall into the timing gear causing the engine to stop suddenly. This could increase the risk of collision.
records.remedy: Recall the 1102 vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the camshaft and timing gear.

records.concern: OIL COOLER MAY LEAK
records.defect: The engine oil cooler feed pipe may disconnect and leak oil. This may reach the front brakes and affect the braking efficiency.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace engine cooler pipe.

records.concern: BRAKE LIGHTS MAY FAIL WHEN THE ELECTRONIC PARKING BRAKE IS OPERATED
records.defect: Due to a software error the brake lights may not function during an emergency operation of the electronic parking brake. The normal foundation brake lights will still function as intended.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles update software to correct this.

records.concern: PARTS OF THE FRONT SEAT BELT PRETENSIONER(S) PYROTECHNICAL SYSTEM COULD ENTER THE CABIN
records.defect: Due to a faulty connection parts of the pyrotechnical system could enter the vehicles cabin during deployment.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the seatbelt(s)

records.concern: STARTER SUPPLY WIRE MAY CHAFE
records.defect: The positioning of the starter motor supply terminal may not conform to specification. Contact with a neighbouring component could cause a short circuit.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles check the position of the terminal and where necessary reposition. Replace damaged components if necessary.

records.concern: STARTER SUPPLY WIRE MAY CHAFE
records.defect: The positioning of the starter motor supply terminal may not conform to specification. Contact with a neighbouring component could cause a short circuit.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles check the position of the terminal and where necessary reposition. Replace damaged components if necessary.

records.concern: FRONT AXLE HOUSING MAY BREAK
records.defect: The front axle housing could have sustained material damage during the production process leading to a potential to fail without warning. An axle break can lead to wheel loss and the vehicle may no longer be steerable increasing the risk of an incident.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicle that is likely to be affected and replace the front axle with a quality assured unit.

records.concern: FUEL PIPE CONNECTING THE FUEL FILTER TO THE HIGH PRESSURE PUMP MAY LEAK
records.defect: There may be a fuel leak from the fuel pipe connecting the fuel filter to the high-pressure pump. Drivers would feel a lack of power form the engine and a possible smell of diesel. If the diesel pipe starts to leak and it is not replaced immediately is it possible for the pipe to split and the vehicle will break down. The diesel form the fuel filter will leak onto the road.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the fuel pipes from the fuel filter to the high-pressure pump with a modified component.

records.concern: INTERNAL COMBUSTION ENGINE MAY NOT PERFORM AS EXPECTED
records.defect: The Internal Combustion Engine may not operate correctly. DTC�s will be generated the engine-warning lamp will illuminate and the combination meter will display a message.
