In the worst case the internal combustion engine will fail to start and charge the main traction battery. If the warnings are ignored the main traction battery will become depleted and the vehicle will lose all drive.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and apply countermeasure software to the ECU and replace the spark plugs with ones of approved specification.

records.concern: OIL LINE MAY DETACH
records.defect: An oil line may not have been correctly clamped which may allow oil to leak.
records.remedy: On affected machines check for correct installation of the clamp. where necessary replace clamp.

records.concern: RIGHT HAND CURTAIN AIRBAG MAY NOT CONFORM TO SPECIFICATION
records.defect: A component within the right-hand curtain airbag may not conform to specification and the air bag may not deploy correctly.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the right hand curtain air bag.

records.concern: LEFT HAND CURTAIN AIRBAG MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION
records.defect: A component within the left-hand curtain airbag may not conform to specification and the air bag may not deploy correctly.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the left hand curtain air bag.

records.concern: Driver airbag inflator
records.defect: In the event that the airbag is activated excessive internal pressure may cause the inflator body to rupture and metal fragments may pass through the cushion material causing injury to the vehicle occupants and / or in worst cases a fatality. The concern is caused by moisture in the air getting past faulty seals and being absorbed by the pyrotechnic biscuits in the inflator. As a result it is more likely to occur sooner in areas of high humidity and high temperature difference.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the passenger front air bag module which includes the inflator.

records.concern: AIR CONDITIONING HIGH PRESSURE HOSE MAY BE FITTED INCORRECTLY
records.defect: A faulty air conditioning high pressure hose may have been fitted. In the event of a frontal collision there could be a leak of polluting and flammable gas.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the air conditioning high pressure hose with a quality assured component.

records.concern: ABS/ESC SYSTEM MAY FAIL
records.defect: On vehicles with ABS/ESC the earth connection may be interrupted. This may cause failure of the ABS/ESC system
records.remedy: On affected vehicles install new software. Where necessary a new ABS/ESC control unit will be fitted.

records.concern: AIRBAG MAY FAIL
records.defect: The airbag manufacturer have informed Nissan of a potential concern with propellant degradation of Front Passenger Airbag fitted with Smokeless Passenger Inflator (SPI). It has been confirmed that this degradation is a function of time temperature and environmental moisture. Deterioration of the Inflator propellant may under certain usage conditions lead to abnormal deployment of the Passenger Airbag. In an extreme situation this condition could create excessive pressure within the inflator during airbag deployment and may result in separation of the airbag housing.
records.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to replace the front passenger airbag module with a new quality controlled item.

records.concern: HYDRAULIC CONNECTOR MAY LEAK
records.defect: A hydraulic connector may fail and cause a transmission oil leak. This may have an adverse effect on gear selection.
records.remedy: Add a support bracket which will be installed to hold the pipe securely in position and prevent movement of the assembly.

records.concern: HYDRAULIC CONNECTOR MAY LEAK
records.defect: A hydraulic connector may fail and cause a transmission oil leak. This may have an adverse effect on gear selection.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the clutch pipe connector assembly related brackets and parts

records.concern: TRANSMISSION CAN CHANGE GEAR WITHOUT CONTROL FROM DRIVER
records.defect: As part of a software update the stored adjustment settings for the automatic clutch were not deleted and re-taught. These stored settings are incompatible with the updated software and can result in incorrect operation in certain circumstances. This may adversely affect gear changes including uncommanded selection of neutral. If neutral is selected manual gear selection will be available.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles the clutch software will be re-installed and the system re-taught.

records.concern: DRIVER AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY
records.defect: The driver�s airbag was manufactured with an incorrectly manufactured airbag inflator initiator that may not ignite when a deployment voltage is provided to the initiator. As a result vehicles may experience a �non-deployment� of the driver airbag during a crash event warranting an airbag deployment which could increase the risk of injury.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the driver airbag unit (initiator included) with a quality assured unit.

records.concern: DRIVER AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY
records.defect: The driver�s airbag was manufactured with an incorrectly manufactured airbag inflator initiator that may not ignite when a deployment voltage is provided to the initiator. As a result vehicles may experience a �non-deployment� of the driver airbag during a crash event warranting an airbag deployment which could increase the risk of injury.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the driver airbag unit (initiator included) with a quality assured unit.

records.concern: FUSE BOX CONNECTIONS INSECURE
records.defect: The flange nut can seize on the thread of the studs in the fuse box which could mean the terminals do not have the correct torque and may be loose. This could cause arcing.
records.remedy: Check fuse box; Replace all fuse box cable flange nuts to new correct type nuts and tighten to correct torque. If necessary replace the fuse box

records.concern: PARTS OF SEAT BELT PRETENSIONER MAY BE DISLODGED ON DEPLOYMENT
records.defect: Due to a faulty connection part of the pyrotechnical system could become dislodged on deployment in an accident and enter the vehicle interior putting the occupants at risk of injury. On affected vehicles.
records.remedy: Replace seat belt on affected vehicles.

records.concern: BRAKE SWITCH MAY BE ACTIVATED PERMANENTLY
records.defect: The ball head connecting the brake pedal and the master brake cylinder the ball head might not be locked properly into the ball cage. If the driver accidentally pulls up the brake pedal the brake switch would be activated permanently. This will cause: The brake lamps to be illuminated even while driving A Check Control Message would not alert the driver. An engine start or gear selection would be possible without brake actuation. If the driver's door were opened after switching off the engine the gear would not switch automatically to P as designed.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the locking of the ball head on the brake pedal. If necessary the pedal mechanism will be replaced.

records.concern: ABS/ESC SYSTEM MAY FAIL
records.defect: On vehicles with ABS/ESC the earth connection may be interrupted. This may cause failure of the ABS/ESC system.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles install new software. Where necessary a new ABS/ESC control unit will be fitted.

records.concern: ABS/ESC SYSTEM MAY FAIL
records.defect: On vehicles with ABS/ESC the earth connection may be interrupted. This may cause failure of the ABS/ESC system
records.remedy: On affected vehicles install new software. Where necessary a new ABS/ESC control unit will be fitted.

records.concern: VACUUM LINE BRAKE BOOSTER MAY BREAK
records.defect: The connection fitting of the vacuum line to the brake booster is not to specification and my not be durable. If the connection fails the brake booster will no longer be supplied with vacuum. After a few brake applications the driver will have to apply additional pressure to the brake pedal to gain the appropriate braking effect.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the vacuum line on the brake booster with a quality assured component.

records.concern: AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY CORRECTLY
records.defect: The propellant mixing ratio in the igniters of the front passenger airbag assembly may not meet specification. If the airbag is required and activated it might not deploy or not completely deploy. This could increase the risk of injury to the occupants.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the front passenger airbag assembly.

records.concern: RIGHT WINDOW AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY AS INTENDED
records.defect: The right widow airbag may not meet specification. As a result it may not deploy in the event of an accident.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the right window air bag.

records.concern: LEFT WINDOW AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY AS INTENDED
records.defect: The left widow airbag may not meet specification. As a result it may not deploy in the event of an accident.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the left window air bag.

records.concern: LEFT AND RIGHT WINDOW AIRBAGS MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY AS INTENDED
records.defect: The left and right widow airbags may not meet specification. As a result they may not deploy in the event of an accident.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the left and right window air bags.

records.concern: STARTING CURRENT LIMITER MAY OVERLOAD
records.defect: Where the car incurs severe engine damage resulting in the engine failing to turn over (engine seizure) and if the driver repeatedly attempts to start the engine despite the engine not cranking the very high electrical current could lead to overheating of the starting current limiter and the potential for a fire.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and install an additional fuse in the electrical line to the starter.

records.concern: AIR CONDITIONING COMPRESSOR SUPPORT MOUNTINGS MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION
records.defect: The tightness of one of the air conditioning compressor support mountings may not be correct to specification. This will result in an abnormal noise and possibility of the compressor becoming insecure
records.remedy: On affected vehicles check the tightness of the support; where necessary the support will be replaced.

records.concern: AIR CONDITIONING COMPRESSOR SUPPORT MOUNTINGS MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION
records.defect: The tightness of one of the air conditioning compressor support mountings may not be correct to specification. This will result in an abnormal noise and possibility of the compressor becoming insecure
records.remedy: On affected vehicles check the tightness of the support; where necessary the support will be replaced.

records.concern: STEERING COLUMN COUPLING MAY NOT BE TIGHT
records.defect: Insufficient tightening of the steering column coupling could lead to wear of the steering coupling during use. In case of excessive wear of the steering coupling the coupling eventually may not transfer the effort the driver inputs to the steering to the steering gear in which case the steering control would be lost.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the steering column coupling.

records.concern: REAR PASSENGER SEAT BELT PRE TENSIONER MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION
records.defect: The pre-tensioner in the driver�s side third row passenger seat belt may not have been produced according to the correct specification In the event of a collision the pre tensioner and seat belt will still operate as intended but a very small part could enter the passenger compartment. As a temporary measure until the seat belt has been replaced it is recommended that the seat belt is not used.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the seat belt.

records.concern: BRAKES MAY OVERHEAT CREATING A RISK OF SMOKE AND/OR FIRE
records.defect: The software for the Electronic Stability Program (ESP) is faulty. The fault could lead to a low residual pressure in the hydraulic system so the brakes are applied and gain heat. This increased heat will apply the brakes further and could adversely affect the brake fluid. Fire in the wheel housing cannot be ruled out.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and update the software for the ESP.

records.concern: SPORADIC REBOOT OF HEADLIGHT CONTROL UNIT
records.defect: Under certain conditions the headlight control unit may reboot which can affect the headlight operation
records.remedy: On affected machines update headlight control unit software.

records.concern: FRETTING BETWEEN ABS AND SECONDARY BRAKE MAY CAUSE LOSS OF BRAKING SYSTEM
records.defect: There is a possibility of interference and fretting between the ABS brake pipes and the secondary air system connection which over a period of time could in the most extreme cases lead to loss of braking capability.
records.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and check the fitment of the ABS brake pipes in relation to the secondary air system connection. Where necessary fit the modified mount.

records.concern: WINDSCREEN MAY NOT BE CORRECTLY FITTED
records.defect: Due to an in the fitting process replacement screens may not have been correctly fitted. Drivers may notice water ingress and/or wind noise
records.remedy: On affected vehicles remove and correctly refit windscreen.

records.concern: EGR FLANGE COULD CORRODE AND CRACK
records.defect: The urea water injector mounting flange on the exhaust front pipe may fail and allow the urea water injector to separate from the front pipe. This situation could result in noncompliance with requirements prescribed in applicable safety or emission regulations in the involved countries.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace front exhaust pipe.

records.concern: STEERING WHEEL MAY COME LOOSE
records.defect: The screw securing the steering wheel to the splines may be missing. This can lead to loss of directional control thereby increasing the risk of a collision.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check for the presence of the retaining screw where necessary a screw will be fitted.

records.concern: VEHICLE SAFETY SYSTEM MAY INCORRECTLY DIAGNOSE AN IMMINENT CRASH
records.defect: In unusual situations the Active Electronic Braking System (AEBS) can misinterpret freeze frame data and cause the brakes to fully apply when not required. The driver does have time to cancel the braking activity. Brake lamps and warning flashers alert drivers behind. If the truck driver or the driver following are not alert there is an increased risk of collision.
records.remedy: Vehicle Owners are to be contacted informing them of the concern and asking them to observe the notes in the Owner�s Manual regarding potentially initiated random braking procedures. When the new update to the sensor system has been validated the vehicles will be recalled for the Control Units to be updated.

records.concern: HEADLIGHTS MAY PRODUCE EXCESSIVE GLARE
records.defect: Due to an error in the manufacturing process the headlamp lens may not conform to specification.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace high and low beam headlight assemblies

records.concern: PASSENGER AIRBAG WILL NOT DEPLOY
records.defect: Due to a firmware error the vehicle's restraint control module will not recognise the passenger seat is occupied. In the event of an accident the passenger airbag will not deploy
records.remedy: On affected vehicles the updated software will be downloaded to the vehicle. However the installation of the software will immobilise the vehicle and the vehicle keepr should install when the vehicle is suitably parked up. .

records.concern: ELECTRIC POWER STEERING MOTOR DEFECTIVE
records.defect: Contacts inside the electric power steering motor may not have been correctly formed. Failure of these contacts would cause the loss of power steering assistance.If this happens a warning lamp will illuminate
records.remedy: Replace the electric power steering motor on affected vehicles.

records.concern: 3RD SEAT ROW SEATS AND 2ND SEAT ROW SHOULDER BELTS MAY BE INSECURE
records.defect: 3rd row seat retaining bolts and 2nd row seat belt shoulder anchor retaining bolts may not be tightened to the correct specification
records.remedy: Re-tighten the 2nd rear seat shoulder belt bolts the 3rd row seat bolts and the 3rd row seat shoulder belt buckle bolts to the correct specification .

records.concern: BATTERY LINE HAS NOT BEEN ROUTED CORRECTLY
records.defect: The battery supply line for the engine electrical system may be incorrectly routed and could result in a short circuit. This will produce a thermal overload of the battery line and melting of the protective sheath may occur. There is also a possibility that all electrics could be lost the engine could stop and fire could start.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and if necessary correct the routing of the battery supply line for the engine electrical system.

records.concern: BUMPER TRIM BONDING MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION
records.defect: On the affected vehicles the bonding of the front bumper trim may not conform to specification. Over time the bonding may allow the trim to detach
records.remedy: Check the bonding of the front bumper lower trim and rectify or replace it if necessary

records.concern: STEERING COLUMN MAY NOT HAVE BEEN SECURED
records.defect: Securing nuts at one of the upper steering column attachments may be issing or loose. Also the universal joint cross screw joint in the upper steering column must be checked
records.remedy: Check nuts are fitted and tightened to the correct tightening torque. Also check the vertical steering column is fitted correctly in the upper steering column universal joint cross rectifying where necessary.

records.concern: FRONT PASSENGER AIRBAG MAYNOT DEPLOY CORRECTLY
records.defect: It is possible a recess on the inside of the instrument panel was not machined correctly. The recess is the predetermined break point of the instrument panel when the front passenger airbag is activated. If the milling has not been carried out correctly the proper deployment of the front passenger airbag cannot be ensured.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the milling of the predetermined break point. Where necessary the instrument panel will be replaced.

records.concern: HEATED WASHER JETS MAY OVERHEAT
records.defect: The heated washer jets fitted to some Kuga vehicles may have jet heating elements that are not correctly sealed. There is a possibility that poor sealing could lead to corrosion due to water ingress and subsequent overheating of the jets. An overheating jet element will damage the nozzle housing and may cause local heat/fire damage to the cowl grille accompanied by smoke and burning smell.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and fit new washer jets.

records.concern: AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY
records.defect: The subject vehicles are equipped with right front seat side airbags which may not deploy in a collision as intended.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the right front seat side airbags.

records.concern: NO OCCUPANCY DETECTION MAT FITTED IN FRONT PASSENGER SEAT
records.defect: The nearside front passenger detection mat was not fitted during production of the seat. No alarm or warning lamp will warn the driver if the front passenger has not fastened the seatbelt.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and fit an occupancy detection mat to the front passenger seat.

records.concern: VEHICLE MAY ROLL BACKWARDS
records.defect: When trying to drive off uphill from a standstill the vehicle may roll backwards. This is because of a software problem in the CMU.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and download countermeasure software to the CMU.

records.concern: REAR LIGHTS AND/OR BRAKE LIGHTS MAY FAIL DURING OPERATION
records.defect: Rear lights / brake lights may fail during operation creating an increased risk of accidents.
records.remedy: Check the LED rear light production date and replace lamp where necessary. All vehicles require installation of a complete cable set with ground line extension.

records.concern: TAILGATE MAY DROP DOWN WITHOUT WARNING
records.defect: Water may penetrate the tailgate strut cylinder. This may cause corrosion which may affect the strut's attachment.
records.remedy: Replace both tailgate struts on affected vehicles

records.concern: MOUNTING POINTS FOR SEAT RUNNER MAY FAIL
records.defect: One or more of the mounting points between the runner and the driver�s seat may fail.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles inspect the driver�s seat frame to determine if seat lifter links are damaged. If no damage is evident fit reinforcement brackets and �push nuts�. If damage is present to the seat lifter link replace seat frame. If damage is restricted to stabilizer bar then the bar will be repaired plus brackets and� push nuts� fitted.

records.concern: STEERING RACK/ STEERING COLUMN CONNECTOR MAY DETACH
records.defect: It has been identified that the connection block/shaft between the splined parts of the steering rack and steering column have not been manufactured to specification. This can result in the splines not engaging in the block/shaft sufficiently. This could lead to a disconnection of the steering column and steering rack which can result in loss of control of the vehicle.
records.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to replace the connection block with a longer connector. The connector block is of a different size and shape

records.concern: FRONT SUSPENSION FORKS MAY CRACK
records.defect: Due to a non-compliance in the surface treatment on the fork tubes cracks may appear. This may lead to breakage of the fork tube
records.remedy: On affected machines replace the fork tubes.

records.concern: FUEL MAY LEAK
records.defect: Due to a non conformity in production an engine fuel pie protective sleeve could cause wear due to contact with surrounding components.This may cause a fuel leak
records.remedy: On affected vehicles reposition the fuel pipe protective sleeve or replace the pipe if wear is noted.

records.concern: FRONT WISHBONE RETAINING BOLTS MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION
records.defect: The front suspension wishbone fixing bolts may have a non-conformity which could lead to a risk of them breaking. The driver would be aware of a change in the behaviour of the vehicle�s directional control.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the front suspension wishbone fixing bolts

records.concern: PASSENGER ANTI-TRAP MECHANISM MAY FAIL WHEN PNEUMATIC DOORS ARE DEPOWERED
records.defect: A design error stops the sensing working on the door when it is depowered. If an object/person is in the centre of the door frame at the depowering moment they could be pinched.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and fit bridging cables to modify the door valve and enable the sensor to keep detecting obstructions until the door is fully closed.

records.concern: ONE OR BOTH FRONT INDICATORS MAY FAIL
records.defect: The driver will not be alerted to a failure of one or both of the front directional indicator lamps. This could lead to an extended period of driving with failed lamps where other drivers will not have clear indication of the driver�s intent.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and update the vehicle with the latest software.

records.concern: LOCKING RING MAY BE INCORRECTLY ASSEMBLED
records.defect: The locking ring retaining the fuel delivery module into the fuel tank may not have been correctly assembled onto the fuel tank during the tank assembly process. The driver may smell an increase in fuel odour and in some circumstances with the vehicle static there could be liquid fuel underneath the rear of the vehicle which in the presence of an ignition source could lead to a fire. It is also possible for fuel to leak onto the road surface which in the case of diesel fuel can present a skid hazard to other road users increasing the risk of a crash.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and inspect the fuel pump module retaining ring ensuring it is tightened to the correct specification if required.

records.concern: FRONT BRAKE EFFICIENCY MAY BE REDUCED
records.defect: The connection sleeves of the engine oil cooler pipes (feed and return) may not have been crimped correctly. This may result in the connection sleeves becoming loose and engine oil suddenly escaping. If the oil gets to the front brake discs the efficiency could be adverely affected.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the connection sleeves for the engine oil cooler pipes. Where necessary replace the pipes.

records.concern: FUEL HOSE MAY LEAK
records.defect: The fuel return hose may leak. Increased fuel odour may be noticed and drivers may also observe liquid fuel puddles underneath the vehicle. It is possible that fuel may leak onto the road surface which can present a skid hazard to other road users increasing the risk of a crash. Should leaking fuel come into contact with a sufficiently hot surface in the engine bay there will be an increased risk of fire.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the fuel return hose.

records.concern: FRONT DRIVER AIRBAG INFLATOR MAY RUPTURE
records.defect: On affected vehicles the drivers front airbag inflator could produce excessive internal pressure. If an affected airbag deploys the increased internal pressure may cause the inflator to rupture. In the event of an inflator rupture metal fragments could be propelled into the passenger compartment potentially causing injury to a vehicle occupant.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the inflator inside the drivers airbag module with a new one.

records.concern: FUEL HOSE MAY LEAK
records.defect: The fuel return hose may leak. Increased fuel odour may be noticed and drivers may also observe liquid fuel puddles underneath the vehicle. It is possible that fuel may leak onto the road surface which can present a skid hazard to other road users increasing the risk of a crash. Should leaking fuel come into contact with a sufficiently hot surface in the engine bay there will be an increased risk of fire.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the fuel return hose.

records.concern: PRINTED CIRCUIT BOARD MAY OVERHEAT
records.defect: The printed circuit in the power supply unit may overheat.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the power supply unit with an unaffected version

records.concern: CURTAIN AIRBAG CYLINDER MAY CORRODE LEADING TO POSSIBLE REAR PASSENGER INJURY
records.defect: If the water drain in the area of the panoramic sunroof is not functioning properly water can seep into the vehicle�s headliner. If sufficient water accumulates the foam adjacent to the pressure cylinder of the curtain airbag can become wet and cause the pressure cylinder to corrode. The corrosion can weaken the cylinder causing sudden pressure release possibly with fragments.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check for water seepage and the drainage is correct from the panoramic sunroof area. Check the pressure cylinders for corrosion treat with anti-corrosion wax or replace as necessary. Remove foam which is next to the pressure cylinder.

records.concern: FRONT DRIVER SIDE AIR BAG INFLATOR HOUSING MAY RUPTURE
records.defect: In the event of a crash necessitating deployment of the driver side frontal airbag the front driver side air bag inflator housing may rupture and deploy the airbag abnormally. An inflator rupture could also result in metal fragments striking the driver or other occupants resulting in serious injury or death.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and fit a revised Airbag Inflator into all affected vehicles.

records.concern: OUTER SKIN OF REAR SPOILER AND BONNET MAY DETACH
records.defect: Operations 1) or 2) or operations 1) and 2) could be required: 1) The upper part of the bonnet (the bonnet skin) may detach from the rest of the bonnet due to poor adhesive being applied at the factory and deterioration over time. There would be no obvious signs to the customer. 2) The outer part (skin) of the rear spoiler may detach from the vehicle and /or the pins on the glass tailgate. There would be no warning to the customer.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and add re-enforcement to the spoiler and/or bonnet or both as required.

records.concern: OUTER SKIN OF REAR SPOILER MAY DETACH
records.defect: The outer part (skin) of the rear spoiler may detach from the vehicle and /or the pins on the glass tailgate. There would be no warning to the customer. However the possibility of detachment is increased due to the use of car washes.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and fit additional re-enforcement to the spoiler and bonnet.

records.concern: ECU SOFTWARE MALFUNCTION COULD CAUSE STALLING
records.defect: Due to a software issue some motocross machines may stall under certain conditions.
records.remedy: Affecetd machines will be recalled the ECU removed and sent for updating.

records.concern: STEERING WHEEL MAY BE ADJUSTED WHILST DRIVING
records.defect: The driver can adjust the steering wheel position while the vehicle is in motion. The vehicle may become difficult to control if the driver was to adjust the steering position while driving.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and fit an Interlock device so adjustment can only be made while the handbrake is applied.

records.concern: STEERING MAY FAIL
records.defect: It has been identified that the material used to manufacturer the Pitman arm from is not to the correct specification. This can cause wear of the arm and lead to possible detachment of the drag link which could lead to loss of control of the vehicle.
records.remedy: Recall all vehicles for the replacement of the pitman arm with a new quality enhanced item.

records.concern: PRINTED CIRCUIT BOARD MAY OVERHEAT
records.defect: The printed circuit in the power supply unit may overheat.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the power supply unit with an unaffected version

records.concern: CHARGER MAY BE INCORRECTLY WIRED
records.defect: When charging the battery externally from the vehicle there is a possibility that the earth provision for some sides of charger enclosure may not function. This is due to the anodising and bonding of the charger enclosure not being sufficiently conductive. For the unit to be affected the hot AC wire must detach and contact a part of the charger enclosure that does not have effective earth provision. If the above situation occurs the user could be subject to an electric shock.
records.remedy: A power supply cable with Ground Fault Circuit Interrupter will be supplied for all affected charger units.

records.concern: SUSPENSION MAY FAIL
records.defect: If the machine is intensively used off road there is a potential for the shock-end eyelet on the rear shock absorber to fail.
records.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and replace the rear shock absorber with a redesigned unit.

records.concern: PASSENGR SEAT BELT LOCKING RETRACTOR MAY NOT FUNCTION CORRECTLY
records.defect: The Emergency Locking Retractor in the front passenger safety belt assembly may not function correctly. The Emergency Locking Retractors are equipped with a vehicle-sensitive locking mechanism and a webbing-sensitive locking mechanism. The vehicle-sensitive locking mechanism may not lock as designed. In the event of a pre-crash brake event where the passenger airbag deploys front passenger seat forward facing child seat occupants may sustain more severe injuries.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the left hand front seat belt assembly.

records.concern: COOLANT PUMP MAY OVERHEAT
records.defect: Foreign particles in the engine coolant can lead to a blockage in the additional coolant pump and cause the pump to overheat.Foreign particles in the coolant can lead to a blockage in the additional coolant pump and cause the pump to overheat.
records.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and update the software which will deactivate the additional coolant pump in the event of malfunction. If there has been a malfunction of the additional water pump it will be replaced.

records.concern: FRONT PASSENGER AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY
records.defect: The front passenger airbag may not function properly due to a deviation in generant mix ratio. In the event of a crash of sufficient severity the front passenger airbag may not deploy when required. Failure to deploy can lead to increased injuries to the passenger seat occupant.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the front passenger airbag.

records.concern: SUPPLEMENTARY RESTARINT SYSTEM MAY NOT ACT AS INTENDED.
records.defect: In certain circumstances the Airbag Control Unit (ACU) may not be correctly configured. This may cause the Supplemental Restraint System (SRS) not to perform as intended in the event of an accident.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles reprogram with latest ACU software

records.concern: STEERING COUPLING MAY BECOME LOOSE
records.defect: The threaded connection for the steering column coupling to the steering rack pinion may not be tightened correctly. Overtime time the connection could loosen and fall out allowing a situation where the steering control could be lost.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the tightness of the threaded connection for the steering column coupling. Where necessary the joint will be removed and inspected. If not serviceable it will be replaced. A new threaded connection will be used where the tightness is not correct.

records.concern: AXLE BRACKET MAY DETACH
records.defect: The threaded connection of the axle stop bracket on the rear axle may not have been tightened to specification. As a result the threaded connection could work loose and allow the bracket to fall on the roadway which can increase the risk of a collision.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check the tightness of the threaded connection. If loose the threaded connection will be replaced and tightened to specification.

records.concern: FRONT CALIPER COULD BE INSECURE
records.defect: The front brake caliper might not be fully secure. As a consequence of this the brake caliper can get loose and in the worst case the brake could be lost.
records.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and rework the screw connections of the brake caliper.

records.concern: RISK OF REAR UNDERRUN DETACHING
records.defect: It has been identified the mounting bolts/nuts for the rear underrun device may not have been torqued to the correct specification. This could result in the rear underrun device becoming detached from the vehicle.
records.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check for damage replace the mounting bolts/nuts and torque them to the correct specification.

records.concern: STARTER MOTOR MAY NOT OPERATE CORRECTLY
records.defect: A possible nonconformity of an internal component of the starter motor relay could affect the control of the starter motor. This could adversely affect the starting operation and damage the starter motor due to overheating and in extreme cases there is a risk of fire.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles check and where necessary replace the starter motor relay.

records.concern: STARTER MOTOR MAY NOT OPERATE CORRECTLY
records.defect: A possible nonconformity of an internal component of the starter motor relay could affect the control of the starter motor. This could adversely affect the starting operation and damage the starter motor due to overheating and in extreme cases there is a risk of fire.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles check and where necessary replace the starter motor relay.

records.concern: CARGO BOX CLOSE-OFF BRACKE FASTERS MAY DISLODGE
records.defect: On affected machines the Cargo box retaining bracket fasteners may become loose or dislodged under certain conditions.
records.remedy: Fit an improved Cargo box bracket and fasteners

records.concern: SUNROOF GLASS MAY DETACH
records.defect: A deviation in the supplier manufacturing printing process caused a high viscosity in the black print which might lead to a loss of adhesion over vehicle lifetime.
records.remedy: Until such time a final remedy is determined affected vehicles will have additional fixation added to secure the glass roof to the vehicle.as an interim measure

records.concern: SUNROOF GLASS PANEL INSECURE
records.defect: A deviation in the supplier manufacturing printing process on the glass panel caused may cause a loss of adhesion over vehicle lifetime. This may cause the sunroof panel to detach.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles rework the adhesive connection between the sunroof panel and the vehicle body.

records.concern: PARKING BRAKE MAY NOT RELEASE CORRECTLY
records.defect: An improperly manufactured internal caliper gear may fail. This may cause the EPB not to release and in some circumstances not to apply. An EPB warning light and message should appear.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the brake caliper.

records.concern: FAULTY CONTROL UNIT MAY CAUSE VEHICLE TO PERFORM OUTSIDE SPECIFICATION
records.defect: Where a control unit coding was updated in a workshop between 3 December 2016 and 5 December 2016 the coding may not correspond to the specification and may trigger unplanned action in the vehicle. The safety and emissions systems may not react as design intent.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and update the software in the corresponding control units.

records.concern: HANDLEBAR MOUNTING/S MAY DETACH
records.defect: The lower handlebar holder may have been manufactured with improper painting instruction and thread locking agent may not have been adequately applied to the stud bolt thread of the lower handlebar holder. Due to this the stud bolt may loosen and fall off from engine vibration resulting in loss of control.
records.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and replace the lower handlebar holders with the countermeasure parts.

records.concern: AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY CORRECTLY
records.defect: The propellant used in the subject air bag inflators may degrade over time due to heat cycles and exposure to moisture. In the event that the airbag is activated it may overinflate due to overly aggressive combustion of the propellant. The excessive internal pressure may cause the inflator body to rupture and metal fragments may pass through the cushion material causing severe injury to the rider and / or in worst cases a fatality.
records.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and replace the airbag.

records.concern: DOOR LOCK MAY FAIL TO RELEASE
records.defect: Following an accident the forces required for releasing the door may be increased. The cable between the inner door handle and the door lock not being to specification may not be able to withstand these increased forces leaving the door unable to be opened from the inside. This may increase the risk of injury. Unlocking the door via the outer door handle is not affected.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and fit a quality assured cable between the inner door handle and door lock on all four doors.

records.concern: INCORRECT DRIVESHAFT MAY DETACH
records.defect: A number of vehicles specified with automatic transmissions may have been fitted with the incorrect specification rear driveshaft. The incorrect driveshaft length is shorter. The driver may experience underbody noise and/or notice an oil leak. In extreme cases the driveshaft may detach from the differential and as a result the vehicle would lose drive which can increase the risk of a vehicle crash.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check if the correct driveshaft is fitted. If not already fitted fit the correct driveshaft.

records.concern: FILTER MAY LEAK
records.defect: Due to contamination during the production process the fuel filter may leak.
records.remedy: Contact those supplied with the filter and provide a replacement.

records.concern: DRIVESHAFT UNIVERSAL JOINT MAY BREAK
records.defect: Due to insufficient strength the front universal joint in the rear front universal joint of the rear prop shaft may fail.
records.remedy: On affected vehicle replace the universal joint with a modified version

records.concern: ELECTRIC FUEL CELL SYSTEM MAY STOP RUNNING
records.defect: Under unique driving conditions such as if the accelerator pedal is depressed to the wide open throttle position after driving on a long descent with the use of cruise control there is a possibility that Fuel Cell system may malfunction.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles update the control software of Fuel Cell Boost control module.

records.concern: PLUG IN CONTACT CABLE MAY MALFUNCTION
records.defect: It is possible that the connection between the B+ cable and the Power Distribution Box can become damaged by wear and heat which is caused by high current flow and high contact resistance. Normally this will result in a non-start situation after parking the vehicle. However it is possible that this could in extreme cases occur whilst the vehicle is in motion. The driver should be made aware of the issue by flickering of the instrument cluster (dash) or an engine mis-fire; but if the driver does not then the engine could cut-out without warning.
records.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles with petrol engines and replace the cable/connection with a more robust item.

records.concern: DRIVERS AIRBAG MAY DEPLOY INCORRECTLY
records.defect: On some of the vehicles affected by this recall the driver's air bag inflator may rupture during deployment. Metal shards may pass through the air bag material and cause injury to occupants.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles the air bag inflator will be checked and if necessary replaced.

records.concern: GEARBOX ACTUATOR AY NOT BE TO SPECTIFICATION
records.defect: A component in the gearbox actuator may not be to the correct specification which may affect gear selection.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the gearbox actuator

records.concern: GEARBOX ACTUATOR AY NOT BE TO SPECTIFICATION
records.defect: A component in the gearbox actuator may not be to the correct specification which may affect gear selection.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the gearbox actuator

records.concern: INCORRECT OIL PAN FITTED
records.defect: It has been established that on certain vehicles fitted with an MDE5 engine they may have been delivered with a lower volume oil pan during production. There is a risk of the sump being overfilled with oil. This could result in either the engine suffering a runaway due to it consuming its own oil or the Catalytic Converter can be contaminated which will affect the exhaust emissions.
records.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to replace the oil pan and dip stick also to update the Engine Management System (EMS) software.

records.concern: VENTILATION LINE MAY RUB AGAINST POSITIVE BATTERY CABLE
records.defect: Due to inappropriate routing the ventilation line might rub against the battery positive cable which can cause a leakage over time. If leakage occurs fuel vapours will enter the engine compartment causing the risk of fire.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the fuel tank ventilation line. If damaged the ventilation line will be replaced. In all cases an additional clip will be attached between the tank ventilation line and the battery positive cable.

records.concern: CLUTCH MAY NOT ENGAGE FULLY
records.defect: In certain acceleration cases the automatic gearbox software does not engage the clutch fully and therefore the driver could experience a loss of drive and/or engine judder. The gearbox overheating warning light may also be displayed and there is a risk of loss of acceleration and or engine jerk.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and update the software for the automatic gearbox.

records.concern: CHILD LOCK MAY DEACTIVATE
records.defect: The rear door child locks may deactivate when a door is slammed. There will be no warning that the child lock has gone from active to inactive.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the door child locks are to specification. If they are not they are to be replaced with ones that are to specification.

records.concern: SPOILER MAY DETACH
records.defect: The bonding of the tailgate spoiler may not conform to specification. This could lead to a lack of adhesion and detachment of the spoiler
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the rear spoiler

records.concern: STEERING POWER ASSISTANCE MAY BE LOST
records.defect: Due to a poor earth connection steering power assistance may by lost.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles check the earth connection. Where necessary remove clean and reconnect the earth cable.

records.concern: FUEL FILTER/ACCUMULATOR MAY CRACK
records.defect: It has been identified that the fuel filter/accumulator installed on the engine may crack causing the element to break which will ultimately resulting in fuel leakage. The issue can be identified to the driver by noticing fuel leaking onto the road surface under the vehicle plus the driver may find it difficult to start the engine.
records.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to replace the fuel filter/accumulator with a new enhanced unit.

records.concern: WIRING HARNESS MAY BE DAMAGED
records.defect: It has been identified that the cab wiring harness can come in contact with a support bracket within the cab which can cause chaffing damage. This can result in either the engine cutting out and/or the wiper motor suddenly stopping.
records.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to fit additional protection to the edge of support bracket and to inspection for damage to the wiring harness. If found damaged then repair as necessary and fit an additional vinyl protection sleeve to the harness.

records.concern: EXHAUST EMISSION CRITERIA IS NOT MET
records.defect: It has been identified that an issue with the engine software may affect the vehicle's exhaust emissions and an issue with the regenerations of the SCR brick.
records.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to update the engine software.

records.concern: SIDE WINDOW AIRBAGS MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY
records.defect: The left and right side window airbags were manufactured with incorrectly manufactured airbag inflator initiators that may not ignite when a deployment voltage is provided to the initiator. As a result vehicles may experience a non-deployment of the window airbag during a crash event warranting an airbag deployment.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the left right or both window airbags as instructed on all involved vehicles.

records.concern: AIRBAG/BELT TENSIONERS MAY NOT TRIGGER IN EVENT OF AN ACCIDENT
records.defect: Due to an error in the manufacturing process the air bag and/or seat belt pretensioner may not trigger in the event of a collision
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace air bag assembly and seta belt pretensioner where necessary.

records.concern: TRANSAXLE WIRING HAS BEEN INCORRECTLY FITTED
records.defect: The transaxle wiring harness may have been built with insufficient wire terminal crimp(s). This may cause the transmission to select neutral.
records.remedy: Reprogram the Powertrain Control Module (PCM) and the Transmission Control Module (TCM). Where necessary the transaxle range sensor wire harness replaced.

records.concern: AIRBAG CIRCUIT MAY BE COMPROMISED
records.defect: The driver' s airbag clockspring may ingest dust. This may cause the airbag warning light to illuminate. It may also affect the air bag operation in the event of a collision.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the air bag clock spring steering wheel back cover and steering column shrouds.

records.concern: AIRBAG MAY MALFUNCTION
records.defect: It has been identified that due to corrosion there maybe a malfunction of the power supply within the Occupant Restraint Control (ORC) module. This could result in either an illuminated airbag warning lamp with the possibility of no airbag deployment in a crash necessitating airbag deployment or an inadvertent airbag deployment without an illuminated airbag warning lamp. Either of these conditions could increase the risk of a crash or injury.
records.remedy: Recall all affected vehicle to replace the Occupant Restraint Control module.

records.concern: SIDE PANEL MAY CONTACT EXHAUST
records.defect: A side panel that may contact the exhaust manifold.This may pose a fire hazard.
records.remedy: On affected machines fit a modified side panel.

records.concern: STEERING COLUMN HOUSING MAY CRACK
records.defect: The steering column housing may crack making the steering wheel adjustment not as expected and/or some control arms may become difficult to use them (indicators headlight control wipers).
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the upper steering column complete with housing and associated fixings.

records.concern: AIRBAG MAY FAIL TO DEPLOY CORRECTLY
records.defect: Abnormal deployment pressure may lead to rupture of the passenger's air bag inflator case. In the event of an inflator rupture metal fragments could be propelled into the passenger compartment
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the inflator inside the passenger's air bag module.

records.concern: FUEL MAY LEAK
records.defect: A fuel leak could occur at the retaining nut for the fuel sensor on the fuel tank which in adverse circumstances can lead to a potential fire risk. The loss of fuel from the fuel tank could occur both whilst riding and when parked.
records.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected and replace the fuel tank.

records.concern: HANDBRAKE MAY DISENGAGE
records.defect: Due to a possible contamination of the tooth segment the handbrake pawl may not latch correctly. This may cause the handbrake to disengage.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles Replace the parking brake lever assembly.

records.concern: INCORRECT DETONATORS FITTED TO FRONT PASSENGER AIRBAGS
records.defect: Incorrect passenger air bag detonators were installed during manufacturer. this may adversely affect the airbag's deployment in the event of an impact.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the passenger's air bag module.

records.concern: AIRBAG INFLATOR MAY RUPTURE
records.defect: It has been identified that vehicles equipped with a single stage inflator driver�s front air bag then there is a possibility that the density of the propellant in the inflator could be reduced over time from the effects of high temperature cycling and moisture within the propellant and its sealed container. This may cause the propellant to degrade which if this occurs then the inflator could rupture in the event of the deployment of the driver�s front air bag.
records.remedy: Recall all affected vehicle to replace the driver's front air bag.

records.concern: PREMATURE BRAKE FAILURE AND/OR WHEEL END DAMAGE
records.defect: It has been identified that due to a production issue there is the potential for the brake shoe web ends where they are located at the cam roller D slots to either break orfail which can cause damage to the brake shoe brake lining and possibly the inner hub bearing. This can result in a reduction in braking efficiency. However early warning signs of the issue are noise high wheel end temperatures and ABS signal errors.
records.remedy: Meritor has quarantined all components within the distribution network and are recovering them. For units which have been fitted Meritor is recalling all the affected components and covering cost of the replacement shoes.

records.concern: TYRE MAY RAPIDLY DEFLATE WITHOUT WARNING
records.defect: Damage to the tyre structure could have occurred during the mounting of the tyre to the wheel. This can lead to severe tyre sidewall deformation and rapid deflation.
records.remedy: Recall the units in the UK that are likely to be affected and the wheel and tyre assembly will be changed.

records.concern: INCORRECT BODY WIDTH COULD RESTRIC REAR VISABIITY
records.defect: An an incorrect maximum permissible vehicle width was incorrectly defined on the Certificate of Conformity (COC) documentation. Due to this a customer installing a body conversion according to that defined on the COC may inadvertently fit a body width that could restrict the rear visibility.
records.remedy: On affected vehciles measure the width of vehicle and where necessary fit extended mirrors

records.concern: AIRBAG/BELT TENSIONERS MAY NOT TRIGGER IN EVENT OF AN ACCIDENT
records.defect: Due to an error in the manufacturing process the air bag and/or seat belt pretensioner may not trigger in the event of a collision
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace air bag assembly and seatbelt pretensioner where necessary.

records.concern: REAR BRAKE HOSE MAY BE INCORRECTLY ROUTED
records.defect: The rear brake hose could be incorrectly routed and chafe against other components. This condition could lead to the brake hose leaking fluid and the loss of performance at the rear brake.
records.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely to be affected to check and reroute or replace the rear brake hose as necessary.

records.concern: FRONT PASSENGER AIRBAGS MAY BE DEACTIVATED
records.defect: The seat occupancy detector system may not be to the correct standard and the passenger's airbags may be deactivated
records.remedy: On affected vehicle replace the sensor mat.

records.concern: DRIVER MAY BE UNABLE TO CHANGE / SELECT GEAR
records.defect: Due to insufficient strength of the gear shift rear shaft it could break off during use.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the gear shift rear shaft

records.concern: WHEEL MAY DETACH
records.defect: It has been identified there is a possibility that the bolt(s) securing the road wheel(s) may not have been tightened to the correct specification. This could result a risk that the road wheel rim(s) may crack/fracture over time or the wheel could detach from the vehicle which could cause loss of control of the vehicle.
records.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check the wheel bolts have been tightened to the correct specification and if required replace any damaged/defective wheel rim(s).

records.concern: LOSS OF BRAKING ASSISTANCE
records.defect: It has been identified there is a possibility one of the nuts fixing the brake pedal to the brake booster may not have been tightened to the correct specification. This could result in the brake booster opening without warning and causing a sudden loss of brake assistance.
records.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check the torque setting of the nuts fixing the brake pedal to the brake booster. If found not to be within specification then the brake booster will be replaced and the new nuts will be tightened to the correct specification.

records.concern: STEERING BOLTS MAY NOT BE TIGHTENED CORRECTLY
records.defect: There is a possibility that the bolts holding the steering valve on the steering rack are missing or have not been correctly tightened. This may affect control of the vehicle.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles check the steering rack and replace if found to be defective.

records.concern: VARIOUS ELECTRICAL MALFUNCTIONS
records.defect: Some ground cable eyelets and/or the fixation of the airbag control unit may not have been tightened correctly. As a result there is a risk of various electrical malfunctions e.g. engine stall fire hazard and airbag malfunction.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the condition of the ground cables and replace them if necessary. Then the various fixations will be checked and tightened if needed.

records.concern: FRONT SHOCK ABSORBER MAY FAIL
records.defect: There is a possibility that the bolts between the front shock absorber and knuckle have not been properly tightened. This may lead to breakage of the connection between the front shock absorber and the knuckle.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles install new bolts between the front shock absorber and knuckle and tighten them to the correct torque and where necessary replace damaged component

records.concern: FUEL MAY LEAK IF VEHICLE ROLLS OVER
records.defect: The seal between the fuel cap and fuel tank filler neck may not be installed correctly. As a result there is a risk of fuel leakage during driving or in case of vehicle rollover. This is a non-compliance to regulation for rollover protection.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and remove and re-install the seal or install a new seal in case one is missing.

records.concern: UNEXPECTED AIRBAG DEPLOYMENT
records.defect: There is a possibility that water could enter the cabin through the panels separating the cabin and the engine compartment. If this occurs water could reach and affect some electrical components such as the airbag module and possibly cause unexpected airbag deployment.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and apply sealant to close the gap between the affected body panels.

records.concern: FAULTY SPLINE ON UNIVERAL JOINT OF STEERING SPINDLE
records.defect: A spline on the universal joint of the steering spindle has been machined incorrectly. It is possible for the steering column to slip on the spline so that directional control is adversely affected.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the steering spindle.

records.concern: SIDEBOARD OR TAILBOARD MAY DETACH
records.defect: It has been identified that the side board/tail board hinges may fail. This could result in the detachment of the side board whilst the vehicle is in motion.
records.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to install additional safety reinforcement brackets to the side boards/tail board of the body and check the existng hinges and repair if necessary.

records.concern: PASSENGER AIRBAG MAY DEPLOY INCORRECTLY
records.defect: The passenger air bag may not deploy as intended
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the airbag module assembly

records.concern: ROOF SIDE RAIL AIRBAG MAY DEPLOY INCORRECTLY
records.defect: A roof side rail air bag may not deploy as intended
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the airbag module assembly

records.concern: DRIVERS AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY CORRECTLY
records.defect: The driver's air bag may not deploy as intended
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the airbag module assembly

records.concern: FRONT SEAT SIDE AIRBAG MAY DEPLOY INCORRECTLY
records.defect: A front seat side air bag may not deploy as intended
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the airbag module assembly

records.concern: SUSPENSION MAY BECOME INSECURE
records.defect: The longitudinal control arm of the rear axle may not be correctly fastened. This may cause the arm to break and/or detach.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles check the torque of the screw connection on the longitudinal rod and replace nuts bolts or rear axle where necessary.

records.concern: PROTECTIVE DEVISE ON THE INVERTER MAY BE INOPERATIVE
records.defect: It has been identified that the socket protective device on the inverter may be defective. This can result in the inverter socket not be protected by the residual current circuit breaker against residual current. Therefore the lack of protection can place objects and /or people in a position where they can be injured as a result of the venting of residual current.
records.remedy: Recall all affected vehicle to carry out a modification to the wiring/socket protection as per the manufacturer's technical bulletin.

records.concern: EARTHING LUG ON ENGINE MOUNTING BOLT MAY BREAK
records.defect: The cable lug of the ground line on the engine�s mounting bolt may break. If the ground connection is interrupted completely the vehicle can become completely de-energised which can lead to a sudden and for the driver unpredictable failure of the instrument panel the vehicle illumination the hazard warning system and the engine shutting down which increases the risk of a collision.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the existing cable lug with a modified terminal lug.

records.concern: STEERING COLUMN SWITCH MODULE MAY BECOME INOPERATIVE
records.defect: It has been identified that the lever used to select the drive range on the steering column switch module may become inoperative due to possible damage of a circuit board. In the event of this fault occurs then manual selection of the drive range (D R N P) would no longer be possible. The Auto-P function as well as the automatic parking brake will still be available as intended. During manoeuvring the vehicle may not change the drive range as intended by the driver when operating the selector lever during standstill. This could result in an increased risk of a collision/accident.
records.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to replace the steering column switch module.

records.concern: FRONT SUSPENSION ARM MAY NOT BE TIGHTENED CORRECTLY
records.defect: The ball joint securing the upper arm to the steering knuckle may not have been tightened to the correct torque.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles check installation of upper arm and replace arm if necessary

records.concern: UINTENDED DOOR OPENING
records.defect: The door striker pins could be damaged/deformed to a position where it is possible for the doors/s to open when the vehicle is travelling at high speed.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and fit reinforcement plates to the door leaf in the area of the striker pins. Exchange the bearing pins of the door drive system for equivalents of new design.

records.concern: BRAKE PEDAL MAY BE INCORRECTLY ASSEMBLED
records.defect: It has been identified there is a possibility that during production the split pin for the brake pedal cross shaft may not have been correctly installed. This could result in the reduction of braking effort due to the movement of the cross shaft.
records.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check and if required fit a split pin or further secure the currently installed split pin.

records.concern: FRONT AIRBAG MAY BE DEACTIVATED
records.defect: It has been identified that the front passenger seat occupancy weight sensing system control unit may have bee incorrectly installed during assembly. If the passenger seat is placed in the rear/lower position range then it can cause the pressure hose to become kinked which will reclassify the occupant as being a child seat. This will result in the front passenger airbag being deactivated and place the occupant at a higher risk of injury if the vehicle is involved in a frontal collision.
records.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to inspect the pressure pipe. If found to be kinked then the dealer is to contact MB Technical Department to establish the rectification process.

records.concern: SHORT CIRCUIT MAY OCCUR
records.defect: The wiring to the front windscreen washers may not have been correctly routed. This may cause a short circuit and render the wipers in operative.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles check wiring and rework where necessary.

records.concern: RISK OF SHORT CIRCUIT
records.defect: It has been identified that the battery positive and negative cables may chaff on a bracket/area between the engine and the gearbox. If this occurs then it can result in a short circuit with associated damage and even possibly a fire. In addition the Circuit 50 cable may also chaff and short circuit on the battery cable. This can cause the starter to engage and cause a risk to persons working around the vehicle.
records.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check the cables and reroute the cabling.

records.concern: RETAINING BOLT FOR INFLATABLE CURTAIN MAY BE BROKEN
records.defect: The retaining bolts used to assemble the Inflatable Curtain may be broken and offer less protection in the event of an incident.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace all retaining bolts.

records.concern: FRONT AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY
records.defect: The ignition module which triggers the front seat airbag may not deploy in the event of an impact. There is no indication to the driver the unit is faulty.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the front seat airbag unit.

records.concern: FRONT AIRBAG MAY NOT DEPLOY
records.defect: The ignition module which triggers the front seat airbag may not deploy in the event of an impact. There is no indication to the driver the unit is faulty.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the front seat airbag unit.

records.concern: WIPERS MAY NOT PERFORM AS INTENDED
records.defect: In sub-zero weather conditions the front windscreen blades arms may become frozen to the screen. In extreme circumstances when the wipers are activated the wiper arm linkage may weaken detach or bend. Should the linkage break or bend the wipers will not clear the screen effectively.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the wiper linkage with a more robustly designed linkage.

records.concern: CAMSHAFT MAY FAIL
records.defect: Due to an error in the production process the engine camshaft may break.
records.remedy: Check affected vehicles and where necessary replace the camshaft.

records.concern: CHAIN CONNECTING LINK MAY FAIL
records.defect: The drive chain connecting link is not manufactured to specification which can lead to premature failure of the connecting link possible consequential damage and loss of drive.
records.remedy: Recall the machines that are likely affected and replace the drive chain connecting link.

records.concern: LOSS OF DRIVE
records.defect: The transmission could unexpectedly switch to the N position due to a nonconformity in the transmission wiring assembly process.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles reprogram the transmission control module. Where necessary replace the transmission wiring

records.concern: ENGINE ECU SOFTWARE INCOMPLETE
records.defect: Polaris Industries Inc. (Polaris) have issued a stop ride stop sale notice on some model year 2016 RZR S 1000 and General vehicles. It has been identified the Engine ECU fitted to these machines have not been installed with a misfire detection calibration. This may allow unburned fuel to enter the exhaust system which can cause excessive exhaust heat that may pose a fire hazard.
records.remedy: Recall all affected machines and install new software.

records.concern: UNINTENDED BRAKE DRAG
records.defect: Polaris Industries Inc. (Polaris) have issued a stop ride stop sale notice on a small number of 2016-2017 RZR and General vehicles. It has been identified that the brake master cylinder on these machine may have been contaminated during manufacture. This can cause the front brake circuit seal to swell. The swollen seal may cause unintended brake drag resulting in a potential fire and/or burn hazard.
records.remedy: Recall all affected machines to check the master cylinder and replace the master cylinder if found to be defective.

records.concern: BONDING ON WINDSCREEN IS INSUFFICIENT
records.defect: On 911 Cabriolet and Targa models only the windscreen may have been fitted with insufficient bonding product. There is a possibility that the windscreen could detach from the vehicle in the event of an accident.
records.remedy: Recall the likely affected vehicles and rebond the windscreen.

records.concern: POOR WELDING CAUSING FOOT BRACKET TO BREAK
records.defect: It has been established that the welding on the foot bracket of the shock absorber is not to specification. This can result in the failure/detachment of the foot bracket which could cause loss of control of the vehicle.
records.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check the shock absorber and if found to be one of the affected unit then replace the unit with a quality assured item.

records.concern: FUEL DELIVERY LINE MAY LEAK
records.defect: There is a possibility that a leak may occur in the fuel delivery line. Prolonged use of the car could result in the possibility of a fuel leak at the engine end of the pipe where the quick release connector is fitted.
records.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the complete fuel delivery line.

records.concern: REDUCTION IN BRAKING PERFORMANCE
records.defect: An incorrect front brake hose may have been fitted which may allow brake fluid to leak
records.remedy: On affected vehicles check and where necessary replace front brake hoses

records.concern: INNER SILL MAY BE CRACKED
records.defect: On affected vehicles the Left Hand Inner Sill Panel may be cracked. During an impact on the left hand side there is a risk that underfloor fuel lines will be ruptured and result in fuel leaking from the vehicle.
records.remedy: If the inner sill panel on an affected is cracked the manufacturer will repurchase the vehicle and the customer will be supplied with a new vehicle.

records.concern: SEATBELT MAY BECOME LOOSE
records.defect: It has been identified that the 3rd row seat belt stalk mounting bolt may not have been tightened to the correct specification during body modification. There is the possibility the seat belt mounting bolt could vibrate loose and in the worst case scenario become detached so not restraining the occupant in the seat should the vehicle be involved in a frontal collision..
records.remedy: Recall all affected vehicle and retorque the mounting bolt to the correct specification.

records.concern: FUEL MAY LEAK LEADING TO ENGINE CUT OUT
records.defect: It has been identified that due to a quality issue a crack or fracture can develop in the fuel passage of the fuel injector. This could therefore result in a fuel leak and possibly cause an engine stalling situation.
records.remedy: Recall all the affected vehicles and replace the affected components with countermeasure components.

records.concern: MAIN SWITCH ELECTRIC TERMINAL MAY CORRODE
records.defect: It has been identified that water/moisture can enter the Sub-Switch Assembly and contaminate the main switch circuit board. This can possibly cause corrosion of the main switch electric terminal. In the worst case this can result in the electrical supply being cut and could cause the engine to stall whilst the machine is being ridden.
records.remedy: Recall all known machines to replace the Sub-Switch Assembly with a new Quality Product.

records.concern: FUEL MAY LEAK
records.defect: It has been identified that the dimensions of the fitting bracket which secures the fuel tank to the frame are incorrect and this can cause the bracket to contact the fuel tank. This may result in engine vibration being resonance being transmitted to the fuel tank. This can cause the spot weld of the tank cover stay to fail which can cause due to transmitted through the stay. In the worst case fuel may leak.
records.remedy: Recall all affected machine to change the fuel tank fitting bracket.

records.concern: RISK OF FIRE
records.defect: In instances where the fuel tank is overfilled and in particular handling conditions liquid fuel could reach the fuel system carbon canister. Fuel reaching purge valves could affect functionality of the fuel EVAP system. This could allow contact between fuel vapour and hot gasses leading to a risk of fire;. This risk may be increased with unapproved aftermarket exhaust systems.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles upgrade the EVAP system.

records.concern: REDUCTION IN BRAKING EFFORT DUE TO AIR IN THE SERVO
records.defect: The tightening torque of one of the nuts of the connection between the brake servo unit and the brake pedal may be not correct to specification. This may allow air to enter the servo
records.remedy: Check servo security and where necessary replace the brake servo unit

records.concern: STEERING BOLTS MAY BE TIGHTENED INCORRECTLY
records.defect: Incorrect assembly of the steering rack which could cause the loss of the mechanical link between the steering pinion valve and the steering rack during parking manoeuvres at full lock.
records.remedy: Check affected vehicles and where necessary replace the steering rack.

records.concern: STEERING BOLTS MAY NOT BE TIGHTENED CORRECTLY
records.defect: Incorrect assembly of the steering rack which could cause the loss of the mechanical link between the steering pinion valve and the steering rack during parking manoeuvres at full lock.
records.remedy: Check affected vehicles and where necessary replace the steering rack.

records.concern: UNEXPECTED AIRBAG DEPLOYMENT
records.defect: It has been identified that due to a possible non-conformity of certain seals on the vehicle�s body there is the possibility that water can enter the passenger compartment of the vehicle. The occupants should experience either wet carpets and or a possible damp smell. However the ingress of water into the cabin could affect the electrical operation of the airbag module which could lead to an unexpected deployment of the airbag.
records.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to add additional sealant to the body interfaces and if required to replace any interior components damaged by the water ingress.

records.concern: UNEXPECTED AIRBAG DEPLOYMENT
records.defect: It has been identified that due to a possible non-conformity of certain seals on the vehicle�s body there is the possibility that water can enter the passenger compartment of the vehicle. The occupants should experience either wet carpets and or a possible damp smell. However the ingress of water into the cabin could affect the electrical operation of the airbag module which could lead to an unexpected deployment of the airbag.
records.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to add additional sealant to the body interfaces and if required to replace any interior components damaged by the water ingress.

records.concern: FRONT SHOCK ABSORBER MAY FAIL
records.defect: The bolts retaining the front shock absorber could come loose. This may adversely affect the steering control of the vehicle.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the front shock absorber retaining bolts.

records.concern: MALFUNCTIONS IN ELECTRICAL SYSTEMS
records.defect: It has been identified that some ground connections of the cabin wiring harness and the fixings of the airbag control unit may not be to specification. This issue or non-compliance could cause erratic malfunctions of certain electrical equipment even in very rare cases causing the engine to cut-off or airbags malfunction.
records.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check tightness of the ground connections and airbag control unit fixings. If required these will need rectification.

records.concern: MALFUNCTIONS IN ELECTRICAL SYSTEMS
records.defect: It has been identified that some ground connections of the cabin wiring harness and the fixings of the airbag control unit may not be to specification. This issue or non-compliance could cause erratic malfunctions of certain electrical equipment even in very rare cases causing the engine to cut-off or airbags malfunction.
records.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check tightness of the ground connections and airbag control unit fixings. If required these will need rectification.

records.concern: WHEEL MAY DETACH
records.defect: It has been identified that the wheel bolts may not have been tightened to the correct specification. The driver may experience a vibration through the steering wheel. However it not rectified there is a risk that the wheels may become damaged over time or the wheel could in extreme cases could detach from the vehicle whilst driving. This could cause loss of control of the vehicle.
records.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check the tightness of the road wheel bolts and rectify as necessary. In certain cases the replacement of the bolt(s) and wheel(s) may be necessary.

records.concern: WHEEL MAY DETACH
records.defect: It has been identified that the wheel bolts may not have been tightened to the correct specification. The driver may experience a vibration through the steering wheel. However if not rectified there is a risk that the wheels may become damaged over time or the wheel could in extreme cases detach from the vehicle whilst driving. This could cause loss of control of the vehicle.
records.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check the tightness of the road wheel bolts and rectify as necessary. In certain cases the replacement of the bolt(s) and wheel(s) may be necessary.

records.concern: FUEL MAY LEAK AROUND FUEL FILLER NECK
records.defect: It has been identified that the fuel filler neck assembly may not have been correctly installed at production. This can therefore result in a fuel leak from around the fuel filler area if the fuel tank is filled to maxumum or can fuel leak if the vehicle rolls over..
records.remedy: Recall all affected vehicles to check fuel filler neck and rework/rectify if required.

records.concern: UNEXPECTED AIRBAG DEPLOYMENT
records.defect: On the affected vehicles a possible nonconformity of certain seals on the vehicle�s body could lead to water ingress in the passenger compartment. This may affect the operation of the passenger air bag. Unintended deployment is possible.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles add extra sealant and replace wet or water damaged components.

records.concern: UNEXPECTED AIRBAG DEPLOYMENT
records.defect: On the affected vehicles a possible nonconformity of certain seals on the vehicle�s body could lead to water ingress in the passenger compartment. This may affect the operation of the passenger air bag. Unintended deployment is possible.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles add extra sealant and replace wet or water damaged components.

records.concern: REDUCTION IN BRAKING EFFORT DUE TO AIR IN THE SERVO
records.defect: The bolts retaining the front shock absorber could come loose. This may adversely affect the steering control of the vehicle.
records.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the front shock absorber retaining bolts.

records.concern: BRAKE SERVO MAY BE INSECURE
records.defect: The tightening torque of one of the nuts of the connection between the brake servo unit and the brake pedal may be not correct to specification. This may allow air to enter the servo
records.remedy: Check servo security and where necessary replace the brake servo unit

records.concern: FUEL MAY LEAK
